Achaan al‑hadaaya al‑jaaboohum yakfu le buna al‑kheema wa yifaddulu kula.
Wa kulla l‑sinaaʼiyiin gammo le buna al‑kheema.Wa sawwooha be achara gitʼe min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa khayyato fi l‑gitaʼ dool suwar makhluugiin samaawiyiin be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf.
Wa tuul al‑gitaʼ dool sawa sawa.Ayyi waahide tuulha 28 duraaʼ wa urdaha 4 duraaʼ.
Wa l‑gitaʼ dool,khamsa lammoohum sawa fi majmuuʼa waahide wa l‑khamsa al‑aakhariin kula lammoohum sawa.
Wa kachkacho taraf al‑khamsa be gumaach zahri wa taraf al‑khamsa al‑aakhariin kula kachkachoohum be nafs al‑gumaach.
Sawwo 50 manaakhir fi l‑majmuuʼa al‑awwal wa 50 manaakhir fi l‑majmuuʼa al‑taaniye.Wa khalaas al‑manaakhir dool bigo mulgaabiliin.
Wa sawwo 50 fangar hana dahab wa chabako beyah al‑manaakhir kulli waahide maʼa l‑aakhara.Wa be da,al‑majmuuʼteen bigo kheema waahide.
Wa sawwo al‑khita al‑awwal le l‑kheema min 11 gitʼe matruuriin be suuf inze.Wa khattooh be foog le l‑kheema.
Wa tuul al‑gitaʼ dool sawa sawa.Wa tuul al‑waahide 30 duraaʼ wa urdaha 4 duraaʼ.
Wa l‑gitaʼ dool,khamsa lammoohum sawa wa l‑sitte al‑aakhariin kula lammoohum sawa.
Wa sawwo 50 manaakhir fi nuss kulli waahide min al‑majmuuʼteen.
Wa sawwo 50 fangar min nahaas le yachbuku beehum al‑majmuuʼteen.Wa be da,al‑majmuuʼteen yabgo khita waahid.
Wa sawwo al‑khita al‑taani be firaaw kubaach madbuukhiin wa mulawwaniin be loon ahmar.Wa l‑khita al‑taalit da,sawwooh be firaaw ijil al‑bahar.
Wa battaan,addalo khachab al‑sunt wa l‑baʼadeen yurussuuh le yabnu beyah kheemat al‑ibaada.
Ayyi waahid min al‑khachab da tuulah 10 duraaʼ wa urdah duraaʼ wa nuss.
Le ayyi khachaba sawwo rijle itneen al‑gidro sabbatooha maʼa l‑aakhariin.Kulla l‑khachab da sawwooh misil da.
Wa addalo 20 khachab fi l‑nuss al‑junuubi hana l‑kheema.
Wa sawwo 40 asaas hana fudda min tihit le l‑ichriin khachab.Le kulli khachaba waahide sawwo asaas itneen tihit rijileenha al‑itneen.
Wa addalo 20 khachab fi l‑nuss al‑munchaakhi hana l‑kheema.
Wa dool kula sawwo leehum 40 asaas hana fudda min tihit.Le kulli khachaba waahide sawwo asaas itneen tihit rijileenha al‑itneen.
Wa addalo sitte khachab fi l‑nuss al‑warraani hana l‑kheema al‑mugaabil al‑kharib.
Wa sawwo khachab itneen le l‑koonyaat al‑wara.
Wa l‑khachab al‑itneen dool mulassagiin min tihit lahaddi foog.Wa be foog sabbatoohum be khaatim.Wa da bigi fi l‑koonyaat al‑itneen al‑gaaʼidiin be wara.
Wa be da,bigi 8 khachab wa induhum 16 asaas hana fudda.Wa tihit kulli khachaba asaas itneen.
Wa sawwo 5 maraadiis min khachab al‑sunt le l‑nuss al‑junuubi.
Wa 5 aakhariin le l‑nuss al‑munchaakhi hana l‑kheema.Wa battaan sawwo 5 le nussaha al‑warraani al‑mugaabil al‑kharib.
Wa l‑murdaas al‑ustaani al‑tawiil al‑gaaʼid fi gismit al‑khachab macha min tarafha le tarafha.
Wa masaho kulla l‑khachab da be dahab wa sanaʼo khawaatim hana dahab al‑yidissu fooghum al‑maraadiis.Wa masaho al‑maraadiis kula be dahab.
Wa sawwo sitaar dakhlaani min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa khayyato foogha suwar makhluugiin samaawiyiin be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf.
Wa allagooh fi manaakhir hana dahab al‑gaaʼidiin fi arbaʼa amuud min hatab al‑sunt al‑mamsuuhiin be dahab.Wa l‑amad dool musabbatiin fi arbaʼa asaas hana fudda.
Wa sawwo sitaar le baab al‑kheema min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf.
Wa allago al‑sitaar da fi manaakhir hana dahab al‑gaaʼidiin fi 5 amuud hana hatab al‑sunt wa ruuseehum wa l‑maraadiis al‑fooghum mamsuuhiin be dahab.Wa sawwo leehum 5 asaas min nahaas.
Wa Basaliil sawwa sanduug min khachab al‑sunt.Wa tuul al‑sanduug da duraaʼeen wa nuss wa urdah duraaʼ wa nuss wa tuulah foog kula duraaʼ wa nuss.
Wa masahah be dahab saafi min daakhal lahaddi barra.Wa darras khachmah kula be dahab.
Wa sawwa arbaʼa khawaatim hana dahab wa lassagaahum fi l‑koonyaat al‑arbaʼa hana l‑sanduug.Wa da itneen fi l‑nuss al‑waahid wa itneen fi l‑nuss al‑aakhar.
Wa addal iidaan itneen min hatab al‑sunt wa masahaahum be dahab.
Wa dakhkhalaahum fi l‑khawaatim al‑arbaʼa al‑mulassagiin fi l‑sanduug achaan yichiiluuh beehum.
Wa sanaʼo sidaade le l‑sanduug min dahab saafi.Tuul al‑sidaade di duraaʼeen wa nuss wa urdaha duraaʼ wa nuss.
Wa sanaʼo min al‑dahab makhluugiin samaawiyiin itneen wa khattoohum ayyi waahid fi taraf al‑sidaade mulgaabiliin.
Khatto ayyi waahid fi taraf al‑sidaade yaʼni al‑waahid be hini wa l‑aakhar be hinaak mulassagiin fi l‑sidaade.
Wa l‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin dool mumattitiin janaaheehum giddaam wa mukhattiyiin beehum al‑sidaade.Ayyi waahid mugaabil al‑aakhar wa mudangiriin ale l‑sidaade.
Wa sawwo tarabeeza be khachab al‑sunt.Tuulha duraaʼeen wa urdaha duraaʼ wa tuulha foog duraaʼ wa nuss.
Wa masahooha be dahab saafi.Wa darraso khachumha be dahab.
Wa hawwago khachum al‑tarabeeza be hatab urdah arbaʼa usbaʼ wa darrasooh be dahab.
Wa sanaʼo arbaʼa khawaatim min dahab wa lassagoohum fi l‑koonyaat al‑arbaʼa hana l‑tarabeeza.Ayyi khaatim bigi muwaafig le rijil waahide min al‑tarabeeza.
Wa l‑khawaatim bigo gariibiin le khachum al‑tarabeeza.Wa be da,gidro yidissu fooghum iidaan itneen wa yichiilu beehum al‑tarabeeza.
Wa l‑iidaan dool sawwoohum be hatab al‑sunt wa masahoohum be dahab le yichiilu beehum al‑tarabeeza.
Wa l‑tarabeeza di sawwo leeha sufar wa kharaariif wa kiisaan wa abaariig min dahab saafi al‑yistaʼmaloohum wakit yigaddumu hadaaya charaab.
Wa sanaʼo faanuus min dahab saafi.Al‑faanuus da wa gaʼarah wa saagah wa kiyeesaatah wa dakaarmah wa zuhuurah kulla ke sunʼa waahide bas.
Wa alfarraʼ min saag al‑faanuus da sitte furuuʼ,talaata furuuʼ min nuss waahid wa talaata min nuss aakhar.
Wa fi ayyi firiʼ,sawwo talaata kiyeesaat yichaabuhu zahrat al‑looz be dukrumitha wa waragha.Wa da fi kulla firiʼ min al‑furuuʼ al‑sitte.
Wa fi saag al‑faanuus kula,sawwo arbaʼa kiyeesaat yichaabuhu zahrat al‑looz be dukrumitha wa waragha.
Wa tihit ayyi machbak hana furuuʼ itneen,sawwo dukrume.
Wa kulla l‑dakaarim wa l‑furuuʼ madguugiin sunʼa waahide bas min dahab saafi.
Wa sawwo sabʼa tiyeesaat le l‑naar min dahab saafi wa khattoohum fi l‑faanuus.Wa sawwo kalaaliib wa taffaayaat kula min dahab saafi.
Wa l‑dahab al‑saafi al‑sanaʼo beyah al‑faanuus wa kulla muʼiddaatah,waznah bigi 34 kiilo.
Wa sawwo mukhbar al‑bakhuur min khachab al‑sunt.Al‑mukhbar da murabbaʼ tuulah duraaʼ wa urdah kula duraaʼ.Wa tuulah foog kamaan duraaʼeen.Wa l‑mukhbar wa guruunah sunʼa waahide bas.
Wa masaho daharah wa kulla jawaanibah wa guruunah be dahab saafi.Wa darraso khachmah kula be dahab.
Wa sawwo leyah khawaatim itneen tihit min al‑diraasa be jaanib al‑waahid wa be l‑jaanib al‑aakhar kula khawaatim itneen.Wa be da,gidro yidakhkhulu le l‑mukhbar iidaan itneen le yichiiluuh beehum.
Wa sawwo al‑iidaan al‑itneen dool be hatab al‑sunt wa masahoohum be dahab.
Wa sawwo battaan al‑dihin al‑khaass le l‑masahaan.Wa l‑bakhuur al‑muʼattar al‑saafi da sawwaah naadum maʼruuf fi khalbitiin al‑itir.
Wa Basaliil wa l‑sinaaʼiyiin al‑aakhariin sawwo al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.Wa l‑madbah da murabbaʼ min khachab al‑sunt.Tuulah 5 duraaʼ wa urdah kula 5 duraaʼ wa tuulah foog 3 duraaʼ.
Wa sawwo arbaʼa guruun fi koonyaatah al‑arbaʼa.Wa l‑madbah wa l‑guruun sunʼa waahide bas.Wa masahooh be nahaas.
Wa sanaʼo kulla muʼiddaatah min nahaas.Humman al‑mawaaʼiin al‑yarfaʼo beehum al‑rumaad al‑mudahhan wa l‑feelaat wa l‑kiisaan al‑yuruchchu beehum al‑damm wa l‑hadiidaay al‑yisillu beeha al‑laham wa khammaamaat al‑naar.
Wa humman sanaʼo le l‑madbah tachaacha min nahaas.Wa khatto al‑tachaacha di fi lubb al‑madbah wa be da,bigat fi gismit al‑madbah.
Wa sanaʼo arbaʼa khawaatim fi l‑chawaarib al‑arbaʼa hana l‑tachaacha le yidissu fooghum al‑iidaan.
Wa sawwo le l‑madbah iidaan itneen min hatab al‑sunt wa masahoohum be nahaas.
Wa l‑iidaan dool dassoohum fi l‑khawaatim al‑gaaʼidiin fi jawaanib al‑madbah le yichiiluuh beehum.Wa l‑madbah mujawwaf yaʼni indah lubb.Wa l‑madbah da sanaʼooh be khachab.
Wa sanaʼo hoot le l‑wadu min nahaas wa gaʼarah min nahaas.Wa l‑nahaas da hana amchawwaafaat al‑jaabanhum al‑awiin al‑gaaʼidaat yakhdiman fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa sawwo fadaay le l‑kheema.Wa be l‑nuss al‑junuubi,tuulha 100 duraaʼ wa indaha sataayir min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil.
Wa indaha 20 amuud wa 20 asaas min nahaas.Wa l‑manaakhir wa l‑rubaat al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑amad dool min fudda.
Wa l‑nuss al‑munchaakhi kula tuulah 100 duraaʼ wa indah sataayir wa 20 amuud wa 20 asaas min nahaas.Wa l‑manaakhir wa l‑rubaat al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑amad dool min fudda.
Laakin al‑nuss al‑kharbaani min al‑fadaay tuulah 50 duraaʼ wa indah sataayir wa 10 amuud wa 10 asaas.Wa l‑manaakhir wa l‑rubaat al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑amad min fudda.
Wa l‑nuss al‑sabhaani ale l‑bakaan al‑harraay tatlaʼ,hu kula tuulah 50 duraaʼ.
Wa fi l‑nuss al‑zeenaay hana l‑baab fiyah sataayir tuulhum 15 duraaʼ wa indah 3 amuud wa 3 asaas.
Wa fi l‑nuss al‑israay hana l‑baab al‑fadaay,fiyah sataayir tuulhum 15 duraaʼ wa indah 3 amuud wa 3 asaas.
Wa kulla l‑sataayir al‑muhawwigiin al‑fadaay humman min kattaan mukhayyat adiil.
Wa asaas al‑amad min nahaas.Wa manaakhir al‑amad wa l‑rubaat kula min fudda.Wa ruuse al‑amad mamsuuhiin be fudda.Kulla l‑amad al‑muhawwigiin al‑fadaay induhum rubaat min fudda.
Al‑baab al‑yadkhulu beyah al‑fadaay indah sitaar min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf.Wa l‑sitaar da tuulah 20 duraaʼ wa tuulah foog 5 duraaʼ yaʼni nafs al‑magaas maʼa sataayir al‑fadaay.
Wa baab al‑fadaay indah arbaʼa amad wa arbaʼa asaas min nahaas.Wa l‑manaakhir wa l‑isay min fudda.Wa ruuse al‑amad masahoohum be fudda.
Wa kulla l‑wutaad hana l‑kheema wa l‑fadaay min nahaas.
Wa daahu wazin al‑khumaam al‑bano beyah kheemat al‑ibaada wa hi al‑kheema al‑baʼadeen yukhuttu foogha liihaan al‑muʼaahada.Wa Muusa amar al‑Laawiyiin yisajjulu al‑muʼiddaat dool tihit masʼuuliiyit Itamaar wileed Haaruun raajil al‑diin.
Wa Basaliil wileed Uuri wileed Huur min gabiilat Yahuuza khadam kulla cheyy al‑Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa musaaʼidah Uhuliyaab wileed Akhisamaak min gabiilat Daan.Wa hu kula khayyaati maʼruuf fi khiyaatit gumaach al‑kattaan al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.
Wa l‑dahab al‑jaabooh Bani Israaʼiil hadiiye marfuuʼa le yistaʼmalooh fi buna kheemat al‑ibaada,waznah yisaawi 1 000 kiilo.Wa da hasab al‑wazin al‑rasmi hana l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas.
Wa wakit wazano al‑fudda al‑jaabooha naas al‑mujtamaʼ hadiiye,wazinha tamma ziyaada min 3 400 kiilo.Wa da hasab al‑wazin al‑rasmi hana l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas.
Achaan kulla insaan min 20 sana wa foog al‑hasabooh anta nuss hajar fudda hasab al‑wazin al‑rasmi hana l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas.Wa jumlit al‑naas al‑hasaboohum kulluhum ke 603 550 raajil.
Wa wazin al‑fudda al‑astaʼmalooha fi l‑miya asaas hana l‑kheema wa l‑sataayir da 3 400 kiilo yaʼni 34 kiilo fi ayyi asaas.
Wa l‑faddal min al‑fudda hawaale 20 kiilo.Wa humman sanaʼo beyah manaakhir al‑amad wa isayhum wa masaho beyah ruuse al‑amad.
Wa l‑nahaas al‑jaabooh hadiiye marfuuʼa,waznah yisaawi 2 400 kiilo.
Wa da,astaʼmalooh le yasnaʼo asaas madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa madbah al‑nahaas wa tachaachtah wa kulla muʼiddaatah
wa asaas al‑fadaay al‑muhawwige al‑kheema wa asaas baab al‑fadaay wa kulla wutaad al‑kheema wa wutaad al‑fadaay.
Basaliil wa l‑sinaaʼiyiin al‑aakhariin sawwo khulgaan le rujaal al‑diin le yakhdumu fi kheemat al‑ibaada min gumaach hana kattaan loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa battaan sawwo khulgaan khaassiin le Haaruun misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa be misil da,humman sawwo al‑farmala be gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa mujammala be dahab.
Daggo al‑dahab rigeeyig misil al‑kheet wa khayyatooh fi l‑gumaach hana kattaan al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf.
Wa sawwo le l‑farmala hubaal al‑yisabbutuuha beehum fi l‑kataafe.
Wa l‑hizaam al‑yarbutuuh kula bigi min nafs al‑sunʼa min dahab wa gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa chaalo hujaar itneen min agiig wa nagacho fooghum asaame awlaad Yaakhuub al‑atnaachar wa sabbatoohum fi halagateen min dahab fi l‑farmala.
Wa baʼad da,khattoohum fi kataafe al‑farmala zikra le Bani Israaʼiil misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa humman sawwo sideeriiyit al‑kharaar misil sawwo al‑farmala.Hi kula min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa mujammala be dahab.Wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf.
Wa sawwo al‑sideeriiye murabbaʼa tuulha chibir wa urdaha kula chibir.Wa matbuuga marrateen misil jeeb.
Wa jammalooha be arbaʼa roog min al‑hujaar al‑khaaliyiin.Al‑roog al‑awwal indah agiig ahmar wa yaakhuut asfar wa zumurrud akhdar.
Wa l‑roog al‑taani indah marajaan ahmar wa yaakhuut akhdar wa maass.
Wa l‑roog al‑taalit indah fayruuz wa yaakhuut ahmar wa zaytuun.
Wa l‑roog al‑raabiʼ indah zabarjad wa agiig wa kharaz.Wa kulla l‑hujaar dool murassasiin fi l‑riigaan hana l‑dahab fi l‑sideeriiye.
Wa l‑hujaar al‑khaaliyiin dool fi adad gabaayil Bani Israaʼiil al‑atnaachar.Ayyi usum gabiila manguuch fi hajar waahid misil nagich al‑khawaatim.
Wa sawwo le l‑sideeriiye silsilateen min dahab saafi maftuuliin misil al‑habil.
Wa sawwo battaan halagateen wa khawaatim itneen min dahab wa sabbatoohum fi koonyaat al‑sideeriiye be foog.
Wa dakhkhalo fi l‑khawaatim dool al‑silsilateen hana l‑dahab.
Wa khachum al‑aakhar hana l‑silsilateen dakhkhalooh fi l‑halagateen al‑gaaʼidiin fi kataafe al‑farmala be giddaam.
Wa battaan sawwo khawaatim itneen min dahab fi koonyaat al‑sideeriiye be tihit.Wa khattoohum be daakhal ambeen al‑sideeriiye wa l‑farmala.
Wa battaan sawwo khawaatim itneen min dahab wa khattoohum fi kataafe al‑farmala be tihit min giddaam gariib le hizaam al‑farmala.
Wa humman rabato al‑khawaatim al‑itneen hana l‑sideeriiye be l‑khawaatim al‑itneen hana l‑farmala be habil zahri.Wa be da,al‑sideeriiye bigat foog min al‑hizaam wa gaaʼide saabte foog al‑farmala ma tilharrak.Wa da misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa humman khayyato jallaabiiye le l‑farmala kullaha min gumaach zahri wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf.
Wa l‑jallaabiiye indaha gabbe makfuufa wa mudarrasa achaan al‑gabbe ma tincharit.
Wa khayyato fi daayir al‑jallaabiiye rummaanaat min gumaach zahri wa garadi wa ahmar wa kulla min kattaan mukhayyat.
Wa sawwo jursaan min dahab saafi wa khattoohum ambeen al‑rummaanaat fi kulla daayir al‑jallaabiiye.
Wa be da,bigi rummaana wa jaras,rummaana wa jaras fi kulla daayir al‑jallaabiiye al‑yalbasooha wakit yakhdumu giddaam Allah misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa sawwo le Haaruun wa iyaalah khulgaan min kattaan be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf.
Wa battaan sawwo kadaamiil wa taaj wa saraawiil kula hana gumaach kattaan mukhayyat adiil.
Wa l‑hizaam kula min gumaach hana kattaan mukhayyat adiil al‑loonah zahri wa garadi wa ahmar.Wa da be khiyaatit khayyaati maʼruuf misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa sawwo hafiide mukhassasa min dahab saafi wa nagacho foogha al‑kalaam al‑buguul Khaass le Allah.
Wa rabatooha be habil zahri fi raas al‑kadmuul misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa khalaas al‑sinaaʼiyiin kammalo al‑amal hana buna kheemat al‑ibaada wa hi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa Bani Israaʼiil sawwo kulla cheyy tamaam misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa humman jaabo giddaam Muusaal‑kheema wa kulla muʼiddaathawa fangarha wa khachabha wa maraadiisha wa amadha wa asaasha
wa l‑khita al‑hu min firaaw al‑kubaach al‑madbuukhiin wa mulawwaniin be loon ahmarwa l‑khita al‑hu min firaaw ijil al‑baharwa l‑sitaar al‑yidaarig al‑sanduug
wa l‑sanduug al‑foogah liihaan al‑muʼaahada wa iidaanah wa sidaadtah
wa l‑tarabeeza wa kulla muʼiddaathawa l‑khubza al‑yigaddumuuha le Allah
wa l‑faanuus min dahab saafiwa l‑tiyeesaat le l‑naar al‑murassasiin foogah wa kulla muʼiddaatahwa dihnah
wa mukhbar al‑bakhuur hana l‑dahabwa dihin al‑masahaanwa l‑bakhuur al‑muʼattarwa l‑sitaar le baab al‑kheema
wa l‑madbah wa tachaachtah al‑humman min nahaaswa iidaanah wa kulla muʼiddaatahwa l‑hoot le l‑wadu wa gaʼarah
wa l‑sataayir al‑muhawwigiin beehum al‑fadaaywa amadhum wa asaashumwa sitaar hana baab al‑fadaaywa hubaalha wa wutaadhawa kulla muʼiddaat al‑yistaʼmaloohum fi khidmit kheemat al‑ibaada wa hi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ
wa l‑khulgaan le l‑khidme fi l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddaswa dool khulgaan al‑khaassiin le Haaruun raajil al‑diinwa khulgaan le awlaadah wakit yakhdumu misil rujaal al‑diin.
Wa fi l‑wakit da,Bani Israaʼiil sawwo kulla l‑khidme di tamaam misil Allah amar beeha Muusa.
Wa wakit Muusa chaaf wa irif kadar humman sawwo kulla cheyy misil Allah amar beyah,hu baarakaahum.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
 Fi l‑yoom al‑awwal hana l‑chahar al‑awwal,abni leyi kheemat al‑ibaada wa hi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa fi lubb al‑kheema di,diss al‑sanduug al‑foogah liihaan al‑muʼaahada wa daarigah be sitaar.
Wa diss al‑tarabeeza wa jahhizha.Wa battaan diss al‑faanuus wa walliʼ niiraanah.
Wa baʼad da,al‑mukhbar hana l‑dahab al‑yiharrugu foogah al‑bakhuur khuttah giddaam al‑sanduug.Wa baab al‑kheema siddah be sitaar.
 Wa battaan khutt al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin giddaam madkhal kheemat al‑ibaada wa hi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa l‑hoot le l‑wadu kamaan,khuttah ambeen kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa l‑madbah.Wa subb foogah almi.
Wa hawwig al‑fadaay hana kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ be sataayir wa sawwi leeha baab.Wa baabha da kula siddah be sitaar.
 Wa chiil dihin al‑masahaan wa amsah beyah al‑kheema wa kulla l‑achya al‑gaaʼidiin fi lubbaha wa khassishum.Wa be da,hi tabga mukhaddasa wa kulla muʼiddaatha kula yabgo mukhaddasiin.
Wa battaan amsah al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin wa muʼiddaatah le tikhassisah wa hu yabga mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa amsah al‑hoot le l‑wadu wa gaʼarah le tikhassisah.
 Wa jiib Haaruun wa awlaadah fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa barridhum be almi al‑hoot da.
Wa baʼad da,labbis Haaruun al‑khulgaan al‑khaassiin wa amsahah wa khassisah le yabga leyi raajil diin.
Wa jiib awlaad Haaruun wa labbishum al‑khulgaan.
Wa amsahhum misil masaht abuuhum le yabgo leyi rujaal diin.Wa be l‑masahaan da,humman yabgo khaassiin le khidmit beeti daayman wa zurriiyithum kula. 
Wa Muusa sawwa kulla cheyy misil Allah amarah beyah.Wa da bas al‑hu sawwaah.
Wa khalaas,bano al‑kheema di fi l‑yoom al‑awwal hana l‑chahar al‑awwal fi l‑sana al‑taaniye min marigiinhum min balad Masir.
Wa wakit Muusa bana kheemat al‑ibaada,hu khatta asaasha wa khazza amadha wa rakkab al‑khachab wa l‑maraadiis.
Wa bana al‑kheema wa khattaaha be khita aakhar min foog misil Allah amarah beyah.
Wa Muusa chaal liihaan al‑muʼaahada wa dassaahum fi l‑sanduug.Wa dassa al‑iidaan al‑yichiilu beehum al‑sanduug wa sadda al‑sanduug be sidaadtah.
Wa khalaas,chaal al‑sanduug al‑foogah liihaan al‑muʼaahada wa dassaah fi l‑kheema wa daaragah be sitaar misil Allah amarah beyah.
Wa Muusa dassa al‑tarabeeza fi lubb kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ fi nussaha al‑munchaakhi barra min al‑sitaar.
Wa khatta foogha al‑khubza al‑yigaddumuuha le Allah misil hu amarah beyah.
Wa dassa al‑faanuus fi lubb kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ fi nussaha al‑junuubi mugaabil al‑tarabeeza.
Wa wallaʼ niiraan al‑faanuus giddaam Allah misil hu amarah beyah.
Wa Muusa dassa mukhbar al‑bakhuur hana l‑dahab fi lubb kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ giddaam al‑sitaar.
Wa harrag foogah al‑bakhuur al‑muʼattar misil Allah amarah beyah.
Wa sadda baab al‑kheema be sitaar.
Wa khatta al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin giddaam madkhal kheemat al‑ibaada wa hi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa gaddam foogah dahiiye muharraga wa hadiiye hana dagiig misil Allah amarah beyah.
Wa khatta al‑hoot le l‑wadu been kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa l‑madbah.Wa sabba foogah almi le l‑wadu.
Wa be almi al‑hoot da,Muusa wa Haaruun wa awlaadah yilwaddo.
Wa humman yilwaddo gubbaal ma yadkhulu fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa gubbaal ma yaju gariib le l‑madbah misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa Muusa hawwag al‑fadaay al‑foogha al‑kheema be sataayir wa sadda baabha be sitaar.Wa be misil da,khalaas Muusa kammal al‑khidme.
Wa baʼad da,al‑sahaabaay khattat kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa majd Allah mala al‑kheema.
Wa Muusa ma gidir yadkhul fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ achaan al‑sahaabaay mukhattiye al‑kheema wa majd Allah malaaha.
Wa kan al‑sahaabaay gammat min al‑kheema,Bani Israaʼiil yisiiru.
Wa laakin kan hi ma gammat min al‑kheema,humman yagoodu fi bakaanhum lahaddi yoom hi tugumm.
Wa sahaabaayit majd Allah gaaʼide foog al‑kheema be nahaar.Wa be leel,al‑sahaabaay indaha nuur.Wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil chaafo al‑sahaabaay di fi kulla masaarhum.
Wa Allah naada Muusa min kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa gaal leyah :
Hajji le Bani Israaʼiil wa guul leehum wakit naadum minku yigaddim hadiiye le Allah,waajib yigaddim al‑hadiiye di min al‑bagar walla min al‑khanam.
Wa kan hadiiytah di dahiiye muharraga min al‑bagar,waajib yigaddim toor al‑ma indah ayyi eeb.Jiibah fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ achaan Allah yarda be l‑toor da.
Al‑naadum da yukhutt iidah fi raas al‑dahiiye wa Allah yarda beeha wa tabga leyah kaffaara.
Wa hu yadbah al‑toor giddaam Allah.Wa rujaal al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun yichiilu al‑damm wa yuruchchuuh fi nawaayit al‑madbah al‑gaaʼid fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa wakit hu yaslakh al‑dahiiye wa yigattiʼ lahamha,
rujaal al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun yukhuttu hatab fi l‑madbah wa yigabbudu naar foogah.
Wa yukhuttu al‑laham al‑mugattaʼ wa l‑raas wa l‑chaham fi l‑hatab al‑mugabbad naar fi l‑madbah.
Wa l‑naadum da yikhassil al‑butuun wa l‑dalaafe be almi wa raajil al‑diin yiharrighum kulluhum fi l‑madbah.Wa di dahiiye muharraga wa hi hadiiye muharraga al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha.
Wa kan hadiiytah di dahiiye muharraga min al‑khanam aw al‑inze,hu yigaddim tees aw kabich al‑ma indah ayyi eeb.
Hu yadbahah fi l‑nuss al‑munchaakhi hana l‑madbah giddaam Allah wa rujaal al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun yuruchchu al‑damm fi nawaayit al‑madbah.
Hu yigattiʼ lahamah wa raasah wa chahamah wa raajil al‑diin yukhuttuhum fi l‑hatab al‑mugabbad naar fi l‑madbah.
Wa l‑naadum da yikhassil al‑butuun wa l‑dalaafe be almi wa raajil al‑diin yigaddimhum kulluhum wa yiharrighum fi l‑madbah.Wa di dahiiye muharraga wa hi hadiiye muharraga al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha.
Wa kan hadiiytah di dahiiye muharraga min al‑tuyuur al‑yigaddimhum le Allah,waajib yigaddim gimri aw hamaam.
Wa raajil al‑diin yigaddim al‑teeraay fi l‑madbah wa yaksir ragabatha wa yiharrigha fi l‑madbah wa yaʼasir dammaha fi l‑durdur hana nawaayit al‑madbah.
Wa yamrug khuzzaanitha wa riichha wa yidaffighum sabaah al‑madbah fi l‑bakaan al‑yusubbu foogah al‑rumaad al‑mudahhan.
Wa yuchugg al‑teeraay min been janaaheeha wa laakin ma yagtaʼha itneen.Wa raajil al‑diin yiharrig al‑teeraay di fi l‑hatab al‑mugabbad naar fi l‑madbah.Wa di dahiiye muharraga wa hi hadiiye muharraga al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha.
Wa kan naadum yigaddim hadiiye hana dagiig le Allah,khalli hadiiytah di tabga hadiiye min ahsan dagiig.Wa hu yusubb fi hadiiytah di dihin wa yichiil lubaan.
Wa hu yiwaddi hadiiytah di le rujaal al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun.Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil malyit iid min al‑dagiig al‑mukhalbat be dihin wa kulla l‑lubaan.Wa yiharrighum fi l‑madbah.Wa di hadiiyit zikra wa hi hadiiye muharraga al‑Allah yarda be riihitha.
Wa l‑yifaddil min al‑hadiiye di yukuun le Haaruun wa le zurriiytah.Wa da hagg mukhaddas marra waahid al‑yifaddil min al‑hadaaya al‑muharragiin le Allah.
Wa kan naadum yigaddim hadiiye hana dagiig wa kan al‑hadiiye di najjadooha fi furun,khalli tukuun min ahsan dagiig wa tukuun kaʼak bala tawwaara mukhalbat be dihin aw kisaar bala tawwaara mamsuuh be dihin.
Wa kan hadiiytah di munajjada fi saaja,khalli tukuun min dagiig mukhalbat be dihin wa bala tawwaara.
Hu yigattiʼha gitaʼ katiiriin wa yusubb fooghum dihin wa di tukuun hadiiye hana dagiig.
Wa kan hadiiytah di munajjada fi tahwa,khalli tukuun min dagiig munajjada be dihin.
Wa hadiiyat al‑dagiig al‑yisawwiiha misil di le Allah,yantiiha le raajil al‑diin wa hu yigarribha le l‑madbah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yarfaʼ hadiiyat al‑zikra hana l‑dagiig wa yiharrigha fi l‑madbah.Wa hi hadiiye muharraga al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha.
Wa l‑yifaddil min al‑hadiiye hana l‑dagiig yukuun le Haaruun wa le zurriiytah.Wa da hagg mukhaddas marra waahid al‑yifaddil min al‑hadaaya al‑muharragiin le Allah.
Wa kulla l‑hadaaya hana l‑dagiig al‑yigaddimhum le Allah,ma yisawwiihum be tawwaara.Achaan ma yiharrig cheyy le Allah al‑indah tawwaara aw asal min al‑hadaaya al‑muharragiin.
Wa laakin yagdar yigaddim tawwaara aw asal le Allah misil hadiiye min awwal intaaj zerʼah.Wa laakin ma yarfaʼha fi l‑madbah misil hadiiye muharraga al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha.
Wa fi kulla l‑hadaaya hana l‑dagiig al‑yigaddimhum,yusubb fooghum mileh.Wa abadan ma yansa sabbiin al‑mileh al‑yimassil al‑muʼaahada al‑daayme maʼa Allah Ilaahah.Wa maʼa kulla l‑hadaaya hana l‑dagiig al‑yigaddimhum,waajib yusubb fooghum mileh.
Wa kan naadum yigaddim hadiiye hana dagiig le Allah min awwal intaajah,waajib yigaddim ganaadiil fariiki wa gameh jadiid madruuch misil hadiiye hana awwal intaajah.
Wa waajib yusubb foogah dihin wa yiziid foogah lubaan wa da yabga hadiiye hana dagiig.
Wa raajil al‑diin yiharrighum misil hadiiyat zikra,nuss min al‑gameh al‑madruuch wa l‑dihin maʼa kulla l‑lubaan.Wa di hadiiye muharraga le Allah.
Wa kan naadum yadbah dahiiyat salaama min al‑bagar,dakar aw antaay,khalli yigaddim le Allah bahiime al‑ma indaha ayyi eeb.
Wa hu yukhutt iidah fi raas al‑bahiime di wa yadbahha fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa rujaal al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun yuruchchu al‑damm fi nawaayit al‑madbah.
Wa min dahiiyat al‑salaama di,hu yigaddim dahiiye muharraga le Allah wa da l‑chaham al‑mukhatti al‑butuun wa l‑chaham al‑fi l‑butuun
wa l‑kalaawe be chahamhum wa chaham al‑nawaayit wa nuss al‑kibde al‑maragah maʼa l‑kalaawe.
Wa zurriiyit Haaruun yiharruguuh fi l‑madbah min foog le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga al‑gaaʼide fi hatab al‑naar.Wa di dahiiye muharraga al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha.
Wa kan hadiiytah al‑yigaddimha le Allah dahiiyat al‑salaama min al‑khanam,dakar aw antaay,khalli yigaddim le Allah bahiime al‑ma indaha ayyi eeb.
Wa kan yigaddim dahiiye hana kharuuf,hu yigaddimah le Allah.
Wa hu yukhutt iidah fi raas al‑bahiime di wa yadbahha fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa rujaal al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun yuruchchu al‑damm fi nawaayit al‑madbah.
Wa min dahiiyat al‑salaama di,hu yigaddim dahiiye muharraga le Allah wa da kulla l‑chaham wa kulla l‑danab al‑magtuuʼ min gaʼarah wa l‑chaham al‑mukhatti al‑butuun wa l‑chaham al‑fi l‑butuun
wa l‑kalaawe be chahamhum wa chaham al‑nawaayit wa nuss al‑kibde al‑maragah maʼa l‑kalaawe.
Wa raajil al‑diin yiharrigah fi l‑madbah wa da misil akil muharrag le Allah.
Wa kan naadum yigaddim dahiiye hana anzaay,hu yigaddimha le Allah.
Wa hu yukhutt iidah fi raas al‑bahiime di wa yadbahha fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa rujaal al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun yuruchchu al‑damm fi nawaayit al‑madbah.
Wa min al‑dahiiye di,yigaddim dahiiye muharraga le Allah al‑chaham al‑mukhatti al‑butuun wa l‑chaham al‑fi l‑butuun
wa l‑kalaawe be chahamhum wa chaham al‑nawaayit wa nuss al‑kibde al‑maragah maʼa l‑kalaawe.
Wa raajil al‑diin yiharrigah fi l‑madbah misil akil.Wa di dahiiye muharraga le Allah al‑yarda be riihitha.Wa kulla l‑chaham hu hana Allah.
Ma taakulu chaham wa la damm.Wa da yabga leeku chart daayim min zurriiye le zurriiye fi ayyi bakaan al‑taskunu foogah.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Hajji le Bani Israaʼiil wa guul leehum : Ayyi waahid minku al‑yisawwi zanib bala raayah wa yikhaalif waahide min kulla wasaaya Allah be sawwiyiin amal muharram,daahu al‑cheyy al‑waajib yisawwiih.
 Wa kan raajil al‑diin al‑masahooh wa darrajooh sawwa zanib wa jaabah le kulla l‑chaʼab,hu yigaddim le Allah toor al‑ma indah ayyi eeb fi chaan al‑zanib da.Wa da yabga dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib.
Wa hu yijiib al‑toor fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ giddaam Allah wa yukhutt iidah fi raas al‑toor wa yadbahah giddaam Allah.
 Wa raajil al‑diin al‑masahooh wa darrajooh yichiil min damm al‑toor wa yiwaddiih fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa raajil al‑diin yidiss usbaʼah fi l‑damm wa yuruchchah sabʼa marraat giddaam Allah,mugaabil al‑sitaara fi l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas.
Wa raajil al‑diin yamsah be l‑damm da guruun mukhbar al‑bakhuur al‑muʼattar al‑gaaʼid fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ giddaam Allah.Wa hu yidaffig kulla damm al‑toor al‑faddal fi gaʼar al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin al‑gaaʼid barra fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
 Wa hu yichiil kulla l‑chaham hana l‑toor al‑yigaddumuuh dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib wa da l‑chaham al‑mukhatti al‑butuun wa l‑chaham al‑fi l‑butuun
wa l‑kalaawe be chahamhum wa chaham al‑nawaayit wa nuss al‑kibde al‑maragah maʼa l‑kalaawe.
Wa da misil al‑yichiilah min toor dahiiyat al‑salaama.Wa raajil al‑diin yiharrigah fi l‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.
 Wa laakin yichiil farwit al‑toor wa kulla lahamah al‑faddal wa l‑raas wa l‑dalaafe wa l‑butuun wa l‑baʼar
yaʼni kulla l‑faddal min al‑toor wa yiwaddiih barra min al‑fariig.Wa da fi l‑bakaan al‑taahir al‑yidaffugu foogah al‑rumaad al‑mudahhan.Wa yiharrigah fi l‑naar be hatab fi l‑bakaan hana l‑rumaad al‑mudahhan.
 Wa kan kulla mujtamaʼ Bani Israaʼiil yisawwu khata bala raayhum wa ma yaʼarfuuh,da amal muharram fi wasaaya Allah.Wa khalaas,be da yabgo khaatiyiin.
Wa wakit yaʼarfu khataahum,al‑mujtamaʼ yigaddim toor dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib wa yiwadduuh giddaam kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa kubaaraat al‑mujtamaʼ yukhuttu iideehum fi raas al‑toor giddaam Allah wa yadbahooh giddaamah.
 Wa raajil al‑diin al‑masahooh wa darrajooh yiwaddi min damm al‑toor da fi lubb kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa yidiss usbaʼah fi l‑damm wa yuruchchah sabʼa marraat giddaam Allah mugaabil al‑sitaara.
Wa raajil al‑diin yamsah be l‑damm da guruun mukhbar al‑bakhuur al‑gaaʼid fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ giddaam Allah.Wa yidaffig kulla damm al‑toor al‑faddal fi gaʼar al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin al‑gaaʼid barra fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
 Wa yichiil kulla l‑chaham wa yiharrigah fi l‑madbah.
Wa yisawwi be l‑toor da misil hu sawwaah be l‑toor hana dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑zanib.Wa be misil da,raajil al‑diin yisawwi leehum kaffaara wa humman yalgo al‑khufraan.
Wa yiwaddi al‑faddal min al‑toor barra min al‑fariig wa yiharrigah misil hu harrag al‑toor al‑awwal.Wa da yabga dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib hana l‑mujtamaʼ.
 Wa kan cheekh sawwa zanib bala raayah,da amal muharram fi wasaaya Allah Ilaahah wa khalaas,hu yabga khaati.
Wa kan arrafooh zanbah al‑sawwaah,hu yigaddim dahiiye hana tees al‑ma indah ayyi eeb.
Wa hu yukhutt iidah fi raas al‑tees wa yadbahah fi l‑bakaan al‑yadbaho foogah al‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin giddaam Allah.Wa da yabga dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib.
 Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil be usbaʼah min damm al‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib wa yamsahah fi guruun al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.Wa yidaffig al‑damm al‑faddal fi gaʼar al‑madbah da.
Wa yiharrig kulla l‑chaham fi l‑madbah misil hu sawwaah be l‑chaham hana dahiiyat al‑salaama.Wa be misil da,raajil al‑diin yisawwi kaffaarat al‑zanib le l‑cheekh wa hu yalga al‑khufraan.
 Wa kan naadum min Bani Israaʼiil sawwa zanib bala raayah,da amal muharram fi wasaaya Allah,khalaas be da hu yabga khaati.
Wa kan arrafooh zanbah al‑sawwaah,hu yigaddim dahiiye hana anzaay al‑ma indaha ayyi eeb fi chaan al‑zanib al‑hu sawwaah.
Wa hu yukhutt iidah fi raas al‑dahiiye al‑yigaddimha le kaffaarat al‑zanib.Wa yadbah al‑dahiiye di fi l‑bakaan al‑yadbaho foogah al‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.
 Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil be usbaʼah min damm al‑dahiiye wa yamsahah fi guruun al‑madbah da.Wa yidaffig kulla l‑damm al‑faddal fi gaʼar al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.
Wa yichiil kulla l‑chaham misil gaaʼidiin yichiiluuh min dahiiyat al‑salaama wa raajil al‑diin yiharrigah fi l‑madbah wa riihtah Allah yarda beeha.Wa raajil al‑diin yisawwi leyah kaffaara wa hu yalga al‑khufraan.
 Wa kan yigaddim min al‑khanam dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib,khalli yigaddim antaay al‑ma indaha ayyi eeb.
Wa hu yukhutt iidah fi raas al‑dahiiye al‑yigaddimha le kaffaarat al‑zanib wa yadbah al‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib di fi l‑bakaan al‑yadbaho foogah al‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.
 Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil be usbaʼah min damm al‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib wa yamsahah fi guruun al‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.Wa yidaffig kulla l‑damm al‑faddal fi gaʼar al‑madbah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil kulla l‑chaham misil gaaʼidiin yichiiluuh min al‑kabich hana dahiiyat al‑salaama wa yiharrigah fi l‑madbah min foog le l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑naar giddaam Allah.Wa raajil al‑diin yisawwi leyah kaffaara le l‑zanib al‑hu sawwaah wa hu yalga al‑khufraan. 
 Wakit insaan hidir fi muchkila aw yaʼarif al‑muchkila di wa hallafooh le yachhad,kan hu labbad nafsah wa aba ma yachhad,al‑naadum da yukuun muznib wa yilhammal natiijat khataayah.
 Wa kan naadum bala raayah yalmas cheyy nijis misil rimme hana haywaan hana kadaade nijis aw rimme hana bahiime nijse aw rimme hana waahid min al‑zawaahif nijis,khalaas al‑insaan da yukuun nijis wa yabga khaati.
 Wakit naadum bala raayah yalmas najaasa hana insaan al‑tinajjis,kan hu irif khataayah,khalaas hu yabga khaati.
 Wa wakit naadum bala fikir kallam wa halaf fi ayyi haala le yisawwi al‑charr aw al‑kheer,kan hu irif khataayah,khalaas hu yabga khaati.
 Wa kan naadum khiti fi waahide min al‑haalaat dool,waajib yiʼtarif be zanbah al‑sawwaah.
Wa fi chaan al‑zanib al‑hu sawwaah,yigaddim dahiiye le Allah min al‑khanam anzaay aw khanamaay dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata.Wa raajil al‑diin yisawwi leyah kaffaara le zanbah.
 Wa kan naadum ma yagdar yalga kharuuf,hu yagdar yigaddim dahiiye le Allah le l‑zanib al‑hu sawwaah itneen gimri aw itneen hamaam,waahide le dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata wa l‑aakhara le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga.
Wa hu yiwaddiihum le raajil al‑diin.Wa fi l‑awwal,raajil al‑diin yigaddim teeraay le l‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib.Hu yaksir ragabatha wa laakin min duun yagtaʼ raasha.
Wa be damm al‑dahiiye,raajil al‑diin yuruchch al‑durdur hana nawaayit al‑madbah.Wa l‑faddal min al‑damm da,yidaffigah fi gaʼar al‑madbah.Wa di dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib.
Wa l‑teeraay al‑aakhara,yigaddimha dahiiye muharraga hasab al‑gawaaniin.Wa be misil da,raajil al‑diin yisawwi le l‑raajil da kaffaara le l‑zanib al‑hu sawwaah.Wa khalaas,hu yalga al‑khufraan.
 Wa kan naadum ma yagdar yalga itneen gimri aw itneen hamaam,khalaas hu yagdar yigaddim hadiiye le l‑zanib al‑hu sawwaah kooro hana dagiig hadiiye le kaffaarat zanbah.Wa ma yiziid foogha dihin wa la lubaan achaan di hadiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib.
Wa hu yiwaddi hadiiytah di le raajil al‑diin.Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil malyit iid min hadiiyat al‑zikra wa yiharrigha fi l‑madbah min foog le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga le Allah.Wa di dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib.
Wa be misil da,raajil al‑diin yisawwi le l‑raajil da kaffaara le l‑zanib al‑hu sawwaah min al‑haalaat dool.Wa hu yalga al‑khufraan.Wa l‑faddal yukuun le raajil al‑diin misil hadiiye hana dagiig. 
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Wa kan naadum sawwa zanib bala raayah didd mukhaddasaat Allah,waajib hu yigaddim le Allah dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata.Wa da,waahid kabich al‑ma indah ayyi eeb al‑yichiilah min al‑khanam wa tamanah yisaawi hajar fudda hasab al‑wazin al‑rasmi hana l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas.
Wa yikaffi taman al‑zanib al‑sawwaah didd al‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas wa yiziid foogah khumsah wa yantiih le raajil al‑diin.Wa raajil al‑diin yisawwi leyah kaffaara be l‑kabich hana dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata wa hu yalga al‑khufraan.
Wa kan naadum yisawwi zanib bala raayah didd waahide min wasaaya Allah,al‑naadum da yabga khaati wa yilhammal natiijat khataayah.
Hu yijiib le raajil al‑diin dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata,waahid kabich al‑ma indah ayyi eeb al‑yichiilah min al‑khanam hasab al‑taman al‑muhaddad.Wa raajil al‑diin yisawwi leyah kaffaara le l‑khata al‑hu sawwaah bala raayah wa min duun yaʼarfah wa hu yalga al‑khufraan.
Wa di dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata achaan al‑naadum da,akiid sawwa zanib giddaam Allah.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Akuun naadum sawwa zanib wa isi Allah be sabab hu khachcha akhuuh fi chaan amaana aw deen aw sirge aw galaʼ be gu
walla hu kadab be sabab cheyy waddar wa hu ligiih walla hu halaf be kidib fi amal waahid misil al‑zunuub dool.
Al‑naadum al‑sawwa al‑zanib da,hu khaati wa waajib yigabbil al‑cheyy al‑hu sirgah aw galaʼah be gu min akhuuh aw al‑amaana walla l‑cheyy al‑waddar wa hu ligiih
aw ayyi cheyy al‑hu halaf be kidib fi chaanah.Waajib hu yigabbil al‑cheyy da kaamil le siidah wa yiziid foogah khumus tamanah.Wa da fi nafs al‑yoom al‑hu yigaddim foogah dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata.
Wa hu yijiib le Allah dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata wa l‑dahiiye di tukuun kabich al‑ma indah ayyi eeb al‑yichiilah min al‑khanam al‑tamanah yisaawi hasab al‑taman al‑waajib le dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata.
Wa raajil al‑diin yisawwi leyah kaffaara giddaam Allah wa hu yalga al‑khufraan,kan zanbah da misil chunu kula.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Anti al‑amur da le Haaruun wa zurriiytah wa guul leehum : Daahu al‑gaanuun hana l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga.Al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga tagood fi naar al‑madbah tuul al‑leel lahaddi fajur wa naar al‑madbah tahrigha.
Wa raajil al‑diin yalbas khalagah hana l‑kattaan wa yalbas surwaalah al‑gisayyir hana kattaan.Wa yamrug al‑rumaad al‑mudahhan hana l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga min al‑madbah wa yukhuttah jamb al‑madbah.
Wa hu yisill khulgaanah wa yalbas khulgaan aakhariin achaan yiwaddi al‑rumaad al‑mudahhan barra min al‑fariig fi bakaan taahir.
Wa l‑naar mugabbide fi l‑madbah abadan ma tumuut.Wa kulli sabaah raajil al‑diin yiziid hatab al‑madbah wa yukhutt foogah al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa yiharrig al‑chaham hana dahiiyat al‑salaama.
Wa l‑naar mugabbide daayman fi l‑madbah abadan ma tumuut.
 Wa daahu al‑gaanuun hana hadiiyat al‑dagiig.Zurriiyit Haaruun yigaddumuuha giddaam Allah mugaabiliin al‑madbah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil malyit iid min al‑dagiig wa l‑dihin wa kulla l‑lubaan al‑gaaʼid fi l‑hadiiye wa yiharrighum fi l‑naar wa di hadiiyat zikra hana dagiig al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha.
Wa Haaruun wa zurriiytah yaakulu al‑faddal min al‑hadiiye.Wa humman yaakuluuh bala tawwaara fi bakaan mukhaddas.Wa yaakuluuh fi l‑fadaay hana kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa ma yirakkubuuh be tawwaara.Wa da,hagguhum al‑ana anteetah leehum min al‑hadaaya al‑muharragiin al‑yigaddumuuhum leyi.Wa l‑hadiiye di mukhaddasa marra waahid misil al‑fadle hana dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib aw dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata.
Wa kulli dakar min zurriiyit Haaruun yaakul minha.Wa da,chart daayim min zurriiye le zurriiye al‑bukhuss al‑hadaaya al‑muharragiin le Allah.Wa kulla cheyy al‑yilammis al‑hadaaya dool yabga mukhaddas. 
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Wa daahu al‑hadiiye al‑yigaddumuuha Haaruun wa zurriiytah,fi yoom yamsaho wa yidarruju waahid minhum.Hu yigaddim le Allah hadiiye kulla yoom kooro hana dagiig,nussaha be fajur wa nussaha be achiiye.
Wa yikhalbutuuha be dihin wa yinajjuduuha fi saaja wa yigaddumuuha hadiiye munajjada wa mugattaʼa al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha.
Wa raajil diin min zurriiyit Haaruun al‑yamsahooh wa yidarrujuuh min baʼadah,hu yigaddim al‑hadiiye di.Wa da hagg daayim le Allah wa yiharruguuh kulla.
Wa kulli hadiiye hana dagiig al‑yigaddimha raajil diin,yiharruguuha kullaha,ma yaakulu minha cheyy.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Hajji le Haaruun wa zurriiytah wa guul leehum : Daahu al‑gaanuun hana dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑zanib.Wa fi l‑bakaan al‑yadbaho foogah al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga bas,yadbaho foogah al‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib giddaam Allah.Wa da cheyy mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa raajil al‑diin al‑yigaddim al‑dahiiye yaakulha.Wa hu yaakulha fi bakaan mukhaddas wa da fi l‑fadaay hana kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa ayyi cheyy al‑yilammis lahamha yabga mukhaddas.Wa kan al‑damm rachcha fi khalag,waajib yikhassulu al‑bakaan al‑rachcha foogah al‑damm fi bakaan mukhaddas.
Wa laakin kan rakkabooh fi burma hana nahaas,waajib yuhukkuuha wa yikhassuluuha be almi.
Wa ayyi raajil min rujaal al‑diin yaakul al‑laham da wa l‑laham da mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa laakin ayyi dahiiye al‑yigaddumuuha le l‑zanib wa yiwaddu dammaha fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ le kaffaarat al‑zanib,yiharruguuha,ma yaakulu minha cheyy. 
Wa daahu gaanuun dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata wa da cheyy mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa fi l‑bakaan al‑yadbaho foogah al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga bas yadbaho foogah dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata wa dammaha yuruchchu beyah nawaayit al‑madbah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yigaddim kulla l‑chaham wa l‑danab wa l‑chaham al‑mukhatti al‑butuun
wa l‑kalaawe be chahamhum wa chaham al‑nawaayit wa nuss al‑kibde al‑maragah maʼa l‑kalaawe.
Wa raajil al‑diin yiharrigah le Allah fi l‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.Wa di dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata.
Wa ayyi dakar min rujaal al‑diin yaakulah.Wa yaakuluuh fi bakaan mukhaddas wa da cheyy mukhaddas marra waahid.
Wa l‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib,hi misil al‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata wa humman al‑itneen gaanuunhum waahid.Wa l‑dahiiye di tabga hint raajil al‑diin al‑yisawwi al‑kaffaara.
Wa kan raajil diin yigaddim dahiiye muharraga hana naadum aakhar,al‑farwa hana l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga di tabga hint raajil al‑diin.
Wa ayyi hadiiye hana dagiig al‑najjadooha fi furun aw fi tahwa aw fi saaja tabga hint raajil al‑diin al‑yigaddimha.
Wa laakin ayyi hadiiye hana dagiig mukhalbata be dihin aw jaaffe tabga hint zurriiyit Haaruun bala tafrikha.
Daahu al‑gaanuun al‑bukhuss dahiiyat al‑salaama al‑yigaddumuuha le Allah.
Wa kan naadum yigaddim dahiiyat chukur,khalli yigaddim maʼaaha kaʼak bala tawwaara mukhalbat be dihin wa kisaar bala tawwaara mamsuuh be dihin wa kaʼak hana dagiig al‑muʼajjan be dihin.
Wa ziyaada fi l‑kaʼak,hu yigaddim khubza al‑indaha tawwaara wa da le yigaddimha maʼa dahiiyat al‑salaama wa dahiiyat al‑chukur.
Wa hu yichiil chiyya min ayyi hadiiye wa yigaddimah le Allah.Wa l‑hadiiye di tabga hint raajil al‑diin al‑yuruchch al‑damm hana dahiiyat al‑salaama.
Wa kan le laham dahiiyat al‑salaama wa dahiiyat al‑chukur,yaakuluuh fi nafs al‑yoom al‑yigaddumuuh foogah wa ma yifaddulu minnah cheyy le ambaakir.
Wa kan le dahiiyat al‑nazir aw be niiye,fi nafs al‑yoom al‑yigaddumuuha foogah bas,yaakuluuha.Wa l‑faddal minha yagdaro yaakuluuh ambaakir.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑taalit,al‑faddal min al‑laham hana l‑dahiiye yiharruguuh fi l‑naar.
Wa kan naadum akal min laham dahiiyat al‑salaama fi l‑yoom al‑taalit,al‑naadum al‑gaddam al‑dahiiye di,Allah ma yakhbalah wa dahiiytah kula ma tinhasib leyah.Wa l‑laham da yukuun haraam.Wa l‑yaakulah yilhammal natiijat khataayah.
Wa kan al‑laham limis ayyi cheyy nijis,ma yaakuluuh wa laakin yiharruguuh fi l‑naar.Wa kan le l‑laham kamaan,ayyi naadum taahir yagdar yaakulah.
Wa laakin kan naadum nijis wa yaakul min laham dahiiyat al‑salaama al‑gaddamooh le Allah,al‑naadum da waajib yafsuluuh min chaʼabah.
Masalan naadum limis ayyi cheyy nijis aw insaan nijis aw bahiime nijse aw ayyi haywaan muharram wa nijis marra waahid.Wa kan al‑naadum da akal min laham dahiiyat al‑salaama al‑gaddamooh le Allah,waajib yafsuluuh min chaʼabah.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Hajji le Bani Israaʼiil wa guul leehum : Ma taakulu ayyi chaham wa la hana bagar wa la hana khanam wa la hana inze.
Wa chaham hana l‑rimme wa chaham hana l‑jiife tagdaro tistaʼmalooh le ayyi khidme wa laakin ma taakuluuh.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yaakul chaham hana bahiime al‑yigaddumuuha dahiiye muharraga le Allah,al‑naadum da waajib yafsuluuh min chaʼabah.
Wa ma taakulu al‑damm wa la hana teer wa la hana haywaan fi ayyi bakaan al‑intu saakniin foogah.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yaakul min ayyi damm,al‑naadum da waajib yafsuluuh min chaʼabah. 
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Hajji le Bani Israaʼiil wa guul leehum : Kan naadum yigaddim dahiiyat salaama le Allah,waajib yijiib le Allah gisim min dahiiytah hana l‑salaama.
Wa hu zaatah yichiil fi iideenah al‑gisim al‑khaass min al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga le Allah,yaʼni al‑chaham wa l‑zoor.Wa l‑zoor da yigaddimah hadiiye marfuuʼa le Allah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yiharrig al‑chaham.Wa l‑zoor kamaan,yabga hana Haaruun wa awlaadah.
Wa waajib tichiilu al‑gaayme al‑zeene al‑warraaniiye hana dahiiyat al‑salaama al‑tigaddumuuha hadiiye wa tantuuha le raajil al‑diin.
Wa l‑gaayme di tabga gisim le raajil al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun al‑yigaddim al‑damm wa l‑chaham hana dahiiyat al‑salaama.
Achaan min dahiiyat al‑salaama al‑gaddamooha Bani Israaʼiil,al‑zoor al‑yigaddumuuh hadiiye marfuuʼa wa l‑gaayme al‑zeene al‑warraaniiye hana l‑dahiiye,ana Allah chiltuhum wa anteethum le raajil al‑diin Haaruun wa le zurriiytah.Wa da yukuun leehum hagg daayim min Bani Israaʼiil.
 Wa da gisim Haaruun wa gisim awlaadah min al‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin al‑yigaddumuuhum le Allah.Wa da min yoom al‑yidarrujuuhum rujaal diin wa yukuunu fi khidmit Allah.
Wa l‑gisim da,Allah amar Bani Israaʼiil yantuuh leehum min yoom yamsahoohum wa yidarrujuuhum.Wa da yabga leehum hagg daayim min zurriiye le zurriiye. 
Wa dool gawaaniin al‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin wa hadiiyat al‑dagiig wa dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑zanib wa dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata wa dahiiyat al‑darrijiin wa dahiiyat al‑salaama.
Wa da amur Allah antaah le Muusa fi l‑sahara fi jabal Siinaaʼ min yoom hu amar Bani Israaʼiil yigaddumu leyah dahaayaahum.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Chiil Haaruun wa awlaadah wa l‑khulgaan wa dihin al‑masahaan wa l‑toor hana l‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib wa l‑kubchaan al‑itneen wa l‑guffa al‑indaha khubza bala tawwaara.
Wa limm kulla mujtamaʼ Bani Israaʼiil fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa Muusa sawwa misil Allah amarah beyah wa mujtamaʼ Bani Israaʼiil lammo fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa Muusa gaal le Bani Israaʼiil : Daahu amur Allah al‑waajib titabbuguuh. 
Wa Muusa gaddam Haaruun wa awlaadah giddaam al‑chaʼab wa barradaahum.
Wa labbas al‑khalag le Haaruun wa hazzamah be l‑hizaam wa labbasah al‑jallaabiiye wa l‑farmala wa hu chaal hizaam al‑farmala wa hazzamah beyah.
Wa labbasah al‑sideeriiye wa dassa leyah al‑Uriim wa l‑Tummiim al‑beehum yasʼalo Allah.
Wa hu kajja leyah kadmuul wa khatta fi l‑kadmuul be giddaam hafiide hana dahab.Wa di hafiide mukhassasa misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa Muusa chaal dihin al‑masahaan wa masahah fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ le yikhassisha hi wa kulli cheyy al‑fi lubbaha.
Wa rachcha al‑madbah be l‑dihin sabʼa marraat wa masahah wa kulla muʼiddaatah wa l‑hoot le l‑wadu wa gaʼarah le yikhassishum.
Wa sabba min dihin al‑masahaan da fi raas Haaruun wa masahah le yikhassisah.
Wa Muusa gaddam awlaad Haaruun wa labbasaahum khulgaan wa hazzamaahum ayyi waahid be hizaam wa kajja leehum kadaamiil.Wa da misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa jaab toor le dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑zanib wa Haaruun wa awlaadah khatto iideehum fi raas al‑toor da.
Wa Muusa dabah al‑toor wa chaal min dammah be usbaʼah wa khattaah fi guruun al‑madbah min kulli jiihe le yitahhirah wa l‑faddal min al‑damm sabbaah fi gaʼar al‑madbah.Wa khassasah le yisawwu foogah al‑kaffaara.
Wa Muusa chaal kulla l‑chaham al‑mukhatti al‑butuun wa nuss al‑kibde wa l‑kalaawe be chahamhum wa harragaahum fi l‑madbah.
Wa l‑faddal min al‑toor wa farwitah wa lahamah wa baʼarah,hu harragah fi l‑naar barra min al‑fariig,misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa Muusa jaab al‑kabich hana l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa Haaruun wa awlaadah khatto iideehum fi raas al‑kabich da.
Wa Muusa dabahah wa rachcha dammah fi nawaayit al‑madbah.
Wa gattaʼ lahamah wa tachchaah maʼa l‑raas wa l‑chaham.
Wa Muusa khassal al‑butuun wa l‑dalaafe be almi wa harrag kulla l‑kabich fi l‑madbah.Wa da yabga dahiiye muharraga al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha wa hadiiye muharraga misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa jaab al‑kabich al‑taani misil kabich hana dahiiyat al‑darrijiin.Wa Haaruun wa awlaadah khatto iideehum fi raas al‑kabich.
Wa Muusa dabahah wa chaal min dammah wa khattaah fi halamat al‑adaan al‑zeene hana Haaruun.Wa khattaah kula fi usbaʼah al‑kabiir hana iidah wa rijlah al‑zeene.
Wa Muusa jaab awlaad Haaruun wa khatta al‑damm fi halamat udneehum al‑zeenaayaat wa fi asaabiʼhum al‑kubaar hana iideehum wa rijleehum al‑zeenaayaat.Wa baʼad da,Muusa rachcha nawaayit al‑madbah be l‑damm.
Wa Muusa chaal al‑chaham wa l‑danab wa kulla l‑chaham al‑mukhatti al‑butuun wa nuss al‑kibde wa l‑kalaawe be chahamhum wa l‑gaayme al‑zeene al‑warraaniiye.
Wa min al‑guffa al‑foogha al‑khubza bala tawwaara al‑gaaʼide giddaam Allah,hu chaal kaʼak bala tawwaara wa kaʼak mamsuuh be dihin wa kisaar wa khattaahum min foog le l‑chaham wa l‑gaayme al‑zeene al‑warraaniiye.
Wa kulla ke hu khattaah fi iideen Haaruun wa fi iideen awlaadah wa humman gaddamooh hadiiye marfuuʼa le Allah.
Wa baʼad da,chaalah min iideehum wa tachchaah maʼa l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga.Wa di dahiiye hana darrijiin al‑riihitha Allah yarda beeha wa hadiiye muharraga le Allah.
Wa Muusa chaal zoor al‑kabich hana dahiiyat al‑darrijiin wa rafaʼah wa gaddamah hadiiye marfuuʼa giddaam Allah.Wa da l‑gisim al‑waajib le Muusa misil Allah amarah beyah.
Wa Muusa chaal dihin al‑masahaan wa l‑damm al‑gaaʼid fi l‑madbah wa rachcha Haaruun wa khulgaanah wa awlaadah wa khulgaanhum.Wa be misil da,hu khassas Haaruun wa khulgaanah wa awlaadah wa khulgaanhum.
Wa Muusa gaal le Haaruun wa awlaadah : Rakkubu al‑laham fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa fi l‑bakaan da bas,taakuluuh maʼa l‑khubza hana l‑darrijiin al‑gaaʼide fi l‑guffa misil ana amart beyah wa gult :‹ Haaruun wa awlaadah bas yaakuluuh. ›
Wa l‑yifaddil min al‑laham wa l‑khubza,harruguuh fi l‑naar.
Wa tagoodu sabʼa yoom fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ lahaddi l‑ayyaam hana darrijiinku yikammulu.Achaan haflat darrijiinku tikammil fi sabʼa yoom.
Wa Allah bas amar be l‑cheyy al‑aniina gaaʼidiin nisawwuuh al‑yoom achaan intu talgo kaffaara le zunuubku.
Wa tagoodu fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ leel wa nahaar lahaddi sabʼa yoom.Wa khalaas baʼad da,tagdaro tahfado wasaaya Allah wa ma tumuutu.Wa da bas al‑amarooni beyah. 
Wa Haaruun wa awlaadah tabbago kulla awaamir Allah al‑antaahum leehum be waasitat Muusa.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑taamin,Muusa naada Haaruun wa awlaadah wa chuyuukh Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa gaal le Haaruun : Chiil ijil le l‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib wa kabich le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa humman al‑itneen yukuunu ma induhum ayyi eeb.Wa gaddimhum giddaam Allah.
Wa baʼad da,guul al‑kalaam da le Bani Israaʼiil :‹ Chiilu tees le l‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib wa ijil wa kharuuf awlaad sana wa humman al‑itneen yukuunu ma induhum ayyi eeb.Wa gaddumuuhum dahiiye muharraga.
Wa chiilu toor wa kabich le dahiiyat al‑salaama wa gaddumuuhum giddaam Allah wa hadiiye hana dagiig mukhalbat be dihin achaan al‑yoom Allah yibiin leeku.› 
Wa khalaas,humman jaabo giddaam kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ al‑cheyy al‑Muusa amaraahum beyah wa kulla mujtamaʼ Bani Israaʼiil garrabo wa wagafo giddaam Allah.
Wa Muusa gaal : Da bas al‑cheyy al‑amaraaku beyah Allah.Sawwuuh wa majd Allah yibiin leeku. 
Wa baʼad da,Muusa gaal le Haaruun : Garrib le l‑madbah wa gaddim dahiiytak hana kaffaarat al‑zanib wa dahiiytak al‑muharraga wa sawwi kaffaara leek inta wa le l‑chaʼab.Wa baʼad da,gaddim dahiiyat al‑chaʼab le tisawwi leehum kaffaara misil Allah amar beyah. 
Wa khalaas,Haaruun garrab le l‑madbah wa dabah al‑ijil dahiiye le kaffaarat zanbah.
Wa awlaad Haaruun gaddamo leyah al‑damm wa hu dassa usbaʼah fi l‑damm wa masah guruun al‑madbah.Wa l‑faddal min al‑damm,sabbaah fi gaʼar al‑madbah.
Wa harrag fi l‑madbah al‑chaham wa l‑kalaawe wa nuss al‑kibde hana l‑bahiime al‑gaddamaaha dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib misil Allah amar beyah Muusa.
Wa laakin al‑laham wa l‑farwa,harragaahum fi l‑naar barra min al‑fariig.
Wa Haaruun dabah al‑bahiime hana l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga.Wa awlaadah antooh al‑damm wa hu rachcha beyah nawaayit al‑madbah.
Wa battaan antooh al‑raas wa l‑laham al‑mugattaʼ hana l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa hu harragaahum fi naar al‑madbah.
Wa hu khassal al‑butuun wa l‑dalaafe wa harragaahum fi l‑madbah min foog le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga.
Wa baʼad da,Haaruun gaddam dahiiyat al‑chaʼab.Hu chaal tees le dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑zanib le l‑chaʼab wa dabahah wa gaddamah dahiiye misil al‑bahiime al‑awwal.
Wa hu gaddam al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa sawwa hasab al‑churuut.
Wa gaddam hadiiye hana dagiig.Chaal malyit iid hana dagiig wa harragah fi l‑madbah.Wa da ziyaada fi l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga hana ayyi fajur.
Wa hu dabah al‑toor wa l‑kabich wa gaddamaahum dahiiyat al‑salaama le l‑chaʼab.Wa awlaad Haaruun antooh al‑damm wa hu rachcha beyah nawaayit al‑madbah.
Wa antooh chaham al‑toor wa chaham al‑kabich wa da l‑danab wa l‑chaham al‑mukhatti al‑butuun wa l‑kalaawe wa nuss al‑kibde.
Wa awlaad Haaruun khatto al‑chaham fi l‑zoor hana l‑toor wa l‑zoor hana l‑kabich wa Haaruun harragaahum fi l‑madbah.
Wa Haaruun rafaʼ al‑zoor wa l‑gaayme al‑zeene al‑warraaniiye hana l‑toor wa l‑kabich wa gaddamaahum giddaam Allah misil Muusa amarah beyah.
Wa wakit Haaruun kammal min gaddimiin al‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib wa l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa l‑dahiiye hana l‑salaama,khalaas hu rafaʼ iideenah ale l‑chaʼab wa baarakaahum.Wa baʼad da,nazal min al‑madbah.
Wa Muusa wa Haaruun dakhalo fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa baʼad marago,baarako al‑chaʼab battaan.Wa majd Allah baan le kulla l‑chaʼab.
Wa maragat naar min giddaam Allah wa akalat al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa l‑chaham.Wa kulla l‑chaʼab chaafo al‑cheyy da wa koorako min al‑farha wa wagaʼo be wujuuhhum fi l‑ard wa sajado.
Wa baʼad da,Nadaab wa Abiihu awlaad Haaruun,ayyi waahid chaal mukhbar wa sabba foogah naar wa bakhuur.Wa gaddamo le Allah naar al‑hu ma azan beeha.
Wa khalaas,maragat naar min giddaam Allah wa l‑naar akalathum.Wa humman maato giddaam Allah.
Wa Muusa gaal le Haaruun : Da bas kalaam Allah wakit gaal :‹ Al‑yigarrubu leyi yaʼarfuuni kadar ana khudduus wa yimajjuduuni giddaam kulla l‑chaʼab.›  Wa Haaruun gaaʼid saakit.
Wa Muusa naada Michayiil wa Alisaafan awlaad Uzziyiil imm Haaruun wa gaal leehum : Taʼaalu !Chiilu akhwaanku min giddaam al‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas wa wadduuhum barra min al‑fariig. 
Wa humman jo chaaloohum fi khulgaanhum wa waddoohum barra min al‑fariig misil Muusa gaalah.
Wa Muusa gaal le Haaruun wa le awlaadah Aliʼaazar wa Itamaar : Ma takchufu ruuseeku wa la ticharrutu khulgaanku min al‑hizin.Wa da achaan ma tumuutu wa la tinazzulu khadab Allah fi kulla l‑mujtamaʼ.Wa kulla akhwaanku Bani Israaʼiil yabku le akhwaanku al‑dammaraahum Allah be naar.
Wa hassaʼ intu ma waajib tikissu min madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ le ma tumuutu achaan dihin al‑masahaan hana Allah gaaʼid foogku. Wa khalaas,humman sawwo hasab kalaam Muusa.
Wa Allah hajja le Haaruun wa gaal :
Wa wakit tadkhulu fi kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ,inta wa awlaadak,ma tacharbo khamar wa la mariise achaan ma tumuutu.Wa da yabga leeku chart daayim min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Wa da achaan intu tagdaro tifarrugu been al‑mukhaddas wa l‑ma mukhaddas wa been al‑taahir wa l‑ma taahir.
Wa tagdaro tiʼallumu al‑churuut al‑antaahum Allah le kulla Bani Israaʼiil be waasitat Muusa.
Wa Muusa gaal le Haaruun wa awlaadah al‑faddalo,Aliʼaazar wa Itamaar : Chiilu al‑hadiiye hana l‑dagiig al‑faddalat min al‑hadiiye al‑muharraga le Allah wa sawwuuha khubza bala tawwaara.Wa aakuluuha jamb al‑madbah achaan al‑cheyy da mukhaddas marra waahid le Allah.
Wa aakuluuha fi bakaan mukhaddas achaan da hagg leeku intu wa le zurriiyitku fi l‑hadiiye al‑muharraga le Allah.Wa da bas al‑amaraani beyah Allah.
Wa aakulu fi bakaan taahir,intu wa awlaadku wa banaatku al‑maʼaaku.Aakulu al‑zoor wa l‑gaayme al‑warraaniiye hana l‑hadiiye al‑marfuuʼa achaan humman antoohum leeku.Wa da hagg leeku intu wa le zurriiyitku min dahaaya al‑salaama hana Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa humman yijiibu al‑gaayme al‑warraaniiye wa l‑zoor hana l‑hadiiye al‑marfuuʼa wa l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin hana l‑chaham.Wa yarfaʼoohum wa yigaddumuuhum dahiiye marfuuʼa giddaam Allah.Wa da yabga leeku intu wa le zurriiyitku al‑maʼaaku hagg daayim misil Allah amar beyah. 
Wa laakin wakit Muusa saʼal min al‑tees al‑yigaddumuuh dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib,gaalo leyah : Daahu al‑tees harragooh ! Wa hu ziʼil didd Aliʼaazar wa Itamaar awlaad Haaruun al‑faddalo.Wa gaal :
 Maala ma akaltu dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑zanib fi l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas ?Achaan al‑cheyy da mukhaddas marra waahid.Wa Allah antaah leeku le tamurgu khata al‑mujtamaʼ wa le tisawwu leehum kaffaara giddaam Allah.
Wa daahu,dammah ma jaabooh fi lubb al‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas !Wa waajib taakulu al‑dahiiye di fi l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas misil ana amart beyah. 
Wa Haaruun gaal le Muusa : Al‑yoom humman gaddamo dahiiyithum hana kaffaarat al‑zanib wa dahiiyithum al‑muharraga le Allah.Wa baʼad kulla l‑hizin al‑ja foogi al‑yoom da,kan ana akalt min al‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib di,yaʼajib Allah walla ? 
Wa Muusa simiʼ kalaam Haaruun wa ridi beyah.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa Haaruun wa gaal leehum :
Hajju le Bani Israaʼiil wa guulu leehum : Daahu al‑tagdaro taakuluuhum min kulla haywaanaat al‑ard.
Kulla l‑haywaanaat al‑induhum dalaafe mafruugiin wa yagsaʼo jurra,dool tagdaro taakuluuhum.
 Wa daahu haywaanaat waahidiin induhum dalaafe mafruugiin aw yagsaʼo jurra wa laakin intu ma taakuluuhum.Misil al‑jamal,hu yagsaʼ jurra wa laakin ma indah dalaafe mafruugiin.Wa hu da nijis leeku.
Wa tees al‑hajar,hu yagsaʼ jurra wa laakin ma indah dalaafe mafruugiin.Wa hu da nijis leeku.
Wa l‑arnab,hi tagsaʼ jurra wa laakin ma indaha dalaafe mafruugiin.Wa hi di nijse leeku.
Wa l‑khinziir,hu indah dalaafe mafruugiin wa laakin ma yagsaʼ jurra.Wa hu da nijis leeku.
Humman dool ma taakulu min lahamhum wa ma tilammusu rimmithum.Wa humman dool nijsiin leeku.
 Wa min kulla haywaanaat al‑bahar,al‑tagdaro taakuluuhum humman kulla l‑haywaanaat hana l‑bahar wa hana l‑wudyaan al‑induhum awwaamaat wa gichir.Dool tagdaro taakuluuhum.
Wa laakin kulla haywaanaat al‑bahar wa kulla l‑aaychiin fi l‑almi,kan fi l‑bahar aw fi l‑waadi,al‑ma induhum awwaamaat wa la gichir,humman dool nijsiin marra waahid leeku.
Humman dool nijsiin marra waahid leeku,ma taakulu lahamhum wa ajʼalo rimmithum nijse marra waahid.
Wa ayyi haywaan al‑ma indah awwaamaat wa la gichir nijis marra waahid leeku.
 Wa min kulla l‑tuyuur,daahu al‑tajʼaloohum nijsiin marra waahid wa ma taakuluuhum achaan humman nijsiin marra waahid leeku.Wa l‑tuyuur dool humman al‑sagur wa l‑dagal wa sagur al‑bahar
wa l‑hideyye wa kulla nafar hana l‑suguura al‑kubaar
wa l‑khurbaat hasab kulla nafarhum
wa l‑naʼaam wa amguggum wa tuyuur al‑bahar wa kulla nafar hana l‑suguura al‑dugaag
wa l‑buuma wa l‑wizziin wa l‑kurki
wa l‑buuma al‑beeda wa amʼakk wa l‑dagal
wa abunkhanam wa kulla nafar hana l‑riheew wa l‑hudhud wa abunrigeeʼ.Humman dool,ma taakuluuhum.
 Wa kulla l‑hacharaat al‑induhum janaahe wa yuruukhu be arbaʼa rijle,nijsiin marra waahid leeku.
Wa laakin min kulla l‑hacharaat al‑induhum janaahe wa yuruukhu be arbaʼa rijle,daahu al‑tagdaro taakuluuhum.Humman al‑induhum sakkaakaat min foog le rijleehum le yunuttu beehum fi l‑ard.
Wa l‑tagdaro taakuluuhum,humman kulla nafar hana l‑jaraad misil saar al‑leel wa ambukbuk wa amkachool.
Wa laakin kulla l‑hacharaat al‑induhum janaahe wa rijle arbaʼa,humman dool nijsiin marra waahid leeku.
 Wa haywaanaat waahidiin yinajjusuuku wa ayyi naadum al‑yalmas rimmithum yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yichiil rimmithum,waajib yikhassil khulgaanah wa yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.
 Wa kulla l‑bahaayim al‑induhum dalaafe ma mafruugiin wa yagsaʼo jurra yukuunu leeku muharramiin wa ayyi naadum al‑yalmashum yukuun nijis.
Wa kulla l‑bahaayim al‑induhum arbaʼa rijle wa yamchu be butuun rijleehum,nijsiin leeku.Wa ayyi naadum al‑yalmas rimmithum yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yichiil rimmithum yikhassil khulgaanah wa yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.Humman nijsiin leeku.
 Wa daahu min al‑haywaanaat al‑yazhafo be katara fi l‑ard al‑nijsiin misil al‑durbaan wa l‑faar wa l‑dububba hasab nafarhum
wa abundigeer al‑haddaar wa l‑waral wa amrijeelaat wa l‑zihliiye wa l‑hirbeeye.
Wa dool min al‑haywaanaat al‑yazhafo,humman nijsiin leeku.Wa ayyi naadum al‑yalmas rimmithum yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.
 Wa kan waahid min al‑haywaanaat dool wagaʼ mayyit fi cheyy,al‑cheyy da yukuun nijis hatta kan maaʼuun hana hatab aw khalag aw farwa aw chuwaal,ayyi maaʼuun al‑gaaʼidiin yistaʼmalooh fi ayyi khidme.Dissuuh fi almi wa yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.Wa baʼad da,yukuun taahir.
 Wa kan al‑haywaan da wagaʼ fi maaʼuun hana tiine,kulla cheyy al‑foogah yukuun nijis wa waajib tikassuru al‑maaʼuun da.
Wa kan yusubbu al‑almi da fi ayyi akil,al‑akil da yukuun nijis wa kan charaab gaaʼid fi maaʼuun hana chunu kula,yukuun nijis.
Wa kan rimme hana waahid min al‑haywaanaat dool wagaʼat fi ayyi cheyy,yukuun nijis.Wa l‑furun wa l‑ladaay dool waajib tikassuruuhum achaan humman nijsiin wa intu ajʼaloohum nijsiin.
 Wa laakin kan al‑rimme di wagaʼat fi een almi aw khazzaan almi,humman yukuunu taahiriin.Wa ayyi cheyy al‑yilammis al‑rimme yukuun nijis.
Wa laakin kan rimme hana waahid min al‑haywaanaat dool wagaʼat fi l‑hubuub hana l‑teeraab,al‑hubuub dool yukuunu taahiriin.
Wa laakin kan ballo al‑hubuub dool le yaakuluuhum wa rimme hana waahid min al‑haywaanaat dool wagaʼat fi l‑hubuub,humman yukuunu nijsiin leeku.
 Wa kan waahid min al‑haywaanaat al‑taakuluuhum maat,al‑naadum al‑yalmas rimmitah yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.
Wa l‑yaakul min al‑rimme di,waajib yikhassil khulgaanah wa yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.Wa l‑yichiil al‑rimme di,waajib yikhassil khulgaanah wa yukuun nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.
 Wa kulla l‑haywaanaat al‑yazhafo be katara fi l‑ard,humman nijsiin marra waahid,ma waajib taakuluuhum.
Wa kulla l‑haywaanaat al‑yazhafo be katara fi l‑ard kan yazhafo be butuunhum walla yamchu be arbaʼa rijle aw be rijle katiiriin kula,ma taakuluuhum achaan humman dool nijsiin marra waahid.
Ma tabgo nijsiin marra waahid be kulla l‑haywaanaat al‑yazhafo be katara fi l‑ard.Wa ma tinajjusu nufuusku beehum wa tabgo nijsiin.
Ana Allah Ilaahku wa ana khudduus wa be da,khassusu nufuusku wa tabgo khaassiin.Khalaas,ma tinajjusu nufuusku be kulla l‑haywaanaat al‑yazhafo be katara fi l‑ard.
Achaan ana Allah maragtuku min balad Masir le nabga Ilaahku.Wa waajib tabgo khaassiin achaan ana khudduus. 
Wa dool bas al‑gawaaniin al‑bukhussu al‑bahaayim wa l‑tuyuur wa kulla l‑makhluugiin al‑hayyiin al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑almi aw al‑yazhafo be katara fi l‑ard.
Wa yiwassufu leeku al‑faraga been al‑nijis wa l‑taahir.Wa been al‑haywaanaat al‑yaakuluuhum wa l‑ma yaakuluuhum.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Hajji le Bani Israaʼiil wa guul leehum : Kan mara khalbaane wa wildat wileed,hi tabga nijse le muddit sabʼa yoom wa tabga nijse misil fi ayyaamha hana l‑heed.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑taamin,yitahhuru al‑wileed.
Wa baʼad da,hi tagood 33 yoom le tittahhar min dammaha.Wa ma talmas cheyy mukhassas wa la tamchi fi l‑beet al‑mukhaddas,lahaddi titimm ayyaam tihaaritha.
 Wa kan wildat bineeye,hi tabga nijse le muddit subuuʼeen wa tabga nijse misil fi ayyaamha hana l‑heed.Wa tagood 66 yoom le tittahhar min dammaha.
 Wa wakit ayyaam tihaaritha hana l‑nufaas be l‑wileed aw al‑bineeye yikammulu,hi tijiib le raajil al‑diin fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ kharuuf wald sana le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga.Wa battaan kula tijiib farkh hamaam aw gimriiye le l‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib.
Wa raajil al‑diin yigaddimhum giddaam Allah wa yisawwi leeha kaffaara.Wa khalaas,hi tabga taahire min dammaha hana l‑waaluuda. Wa dool gawaaniin al‑bukhussu al‑mara al‑talda wileed aw bineeye.
 Wa kan hi ma tagdar talga kharuuf,hi tichiil gimri itneen aw hamaam itneen.Waahid tigaddimah le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa l‑aakhar le l‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib.Wa raajil al‑diin yisawwi leeha kaffaara wa hi tabga taahire. 
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa Haaruun wa gaal :
Wakit naadum gammat leyah khurraaja fi jismah aw bahag aw bugʼa al‑baʼadeen tabga uwaara hana marad al‑jisim,al‑naadum da wadduuh le raajil al‑diin Haaruun aw le waahid min rujaal al‑diin al‑humman min zurriiytah
wa raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑uwaara di.Kan al‑suuf al‑fi bakaan al‑uwaara di bigi abyad wa l‑uwaara di indaha nugra fi daakhal al‑laham,khalaas da marad al‑jisim.Fi l‑bakaan da,raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑marad wa yiballikh kadar al‑naadum da nijis.
Wa kan fi l‑jisim fi bugʼa beeda wa tiraari wa ma indaha nugra fi daakhal al‑laham wa suufha kula ma bigi abyad,khalaas raajil al‑diin yukhutt al‑mardaan da taraf le muddit sabʼa yoom.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiifah fi l‑yoom al‑saabiʼ.Wa kan al‑uwaara di ma zaadat fi l‑jisim,raajil al‑diin yukhuttah taraf le taani marra le muddit sabʼa yoom.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiifah battaan fi l‑yoom al‑saabiʼ.Wa kan al‑uwaara di ma tiraari wa ma zaadat fi l‑jisim,khalaas raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑mardaan da taahir.Al‑cheyy da bahag bas wa waajib yikhassil khulgaanah wa khalaas,hu yabga taahir.
Wa laakin kan al‑bahag da zaad fi l‑jisim baʼad raajil al‑diin ballakh kadar al‑mardaan da taahir,fi l‑haala di al‑mardaan waajib yigabbil le raajil al‑diin le yichiifah taani marra.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiifah wa kan al‑bahag da zaad fi l‑jisim,raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑mardaan da nijis wa l‑cheyy da marad al‑jisim.
Wa wakit marad al‑jisim karab naadum waahid,waajib yiwaddu al‑naadum da le raajil al‑diin
wa raajil al‑diin yichiifah.Wa kan fi jismah fi khurraaja beeda wa bayyadat al‑suuf wa l‑laham kula binchaaf minnaak le l‑farwa,
khalaas da marad al‑jisim al‑yitawwil fi l‑jisim wa raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑mardaan da nijis wa laakin ma yukhuttah taraf le mudda achaan da waadih kadar hu nijis.
Akuun marad al‑jisim da alwassaʼ wa khatta kulla jisim al‑naadum al‑mardaan,min raasah lahaddi rijileenah,hasab al‑chaafah raajil al‑diin.
Wa kan misil da,raajil al‑diin yichiifah adiil.Wa kan sahiih marad al‑jisim da khatta kulla jismah,khalaas raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑mardaan da taahir.Hu taahir achaan kulla jismah bigi abyad.
Wa laakin yoom jismah bigi ahmar,hu nijis.
Wa wakit raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑jisim al‑ahmar da,hu yiballikh kadar al‑mardaan da nijis wa lahamah al‑binchaaf minnaak le l‑farwa kula nijis.Wa da marad al‑jisim.
Wa kan al‑jisim al‑binchaaf ahmar khayyar wa bigi abyad,khalli al‑mardaan yigabbil le raajil al‑diin.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiifah battaan.Wa kan al‑uwaara bigat beeda,hu yiballikh kadar al‑jisim taahir.Wa l‑naadum da kula taahir.
Wa wakit naadum indah fi jismah hibin baryaan
wa fi nafs al‑bakaan al‑hibin da gammat khurraaja beeda aw bugʼa beeda muhammire wa tiraari,khalli al‑naadum da yiwassif nafsah le raajil al‑diin
wa raajil al‑diin yichiifah.Wa kan al‑bugʼa di sawwat nugra fi l‑laham wa l‑suuf bigi abyad fi l‑bakaan da,raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑naadum da nijis.Wa da marad al‑jisim al‑yugumm fi lubb bakaan al‑hibin.
Wa kan raajil al‑diin chaaf ma fi suuf abyad fi l‑bugʼa wa ma sawwat nugra fi l‑laham wa ma gaaʼide tiraari,hu yukhutt al‑mardaan da taraf le muddit sabʼa yoom.
Wa kan al‑bugʼa alwassaʼat fi l‑jisim,khalaas raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑mardaan da nijis.Wa di uwaara.
Wa kan al‑bugʼa al‑tiraari di gaaʼide fi bakaanha wa ma alwassaʼat,khalaas di alaama hana hibin bas.Wa raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar hu taahir.
Wa wakit naadum indah haraag min naar wa fi l‑uwaara di baanat bugʼa beeda muhammire aw beeda wa tiraari,
waajib raajil al‑diin yichiifha.Wa kan al‑suuf al‑fi l‑uwaara al‑tiraari bigi abyad wa kan hi sawwat nugra fi l‑laham da,khalaas da marad fi l‑jisim yidoor yugumm fi l‑uwaara.Wa raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑naadum da nijis.Wa da marad al‑jisim.
Wa laakin kan raajil al‑diin chaaf ma fi suuf abyad fi l‑bugʼa wa ma sawwat nugra fi l‑laham wa ma gaaʼide tiraari,hu yukhutt al‑mardaan da taraf le muddit sabʼa yoom.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑saabiʼ,raajil al‑diin yichiifah wa kan al‑bugʼa di alwassaʼat fi l‑jisim,hu yiballikh kadar al‑mardaan da nijis.Wa da marad al‑jisim.
Wa laakin kan al‑bugʼa al‑tiraari di gaaʼide fi bakaanha wa ma alwassaʼat wa ma gaaʼide tiraari,khalaas di khurraaja jaaye min al‑haraag.Wa raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑naadum da taahir achaan di alaama hana haraag bas.
Wa wakit raajil aw mara indah uwaara fi raasah aw fi dignah,
waajib raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑uwaara di.Wa kan al‑uwaara di sawwat nugra fi l‑laham wa indaha suuf musaffir wa rugaag,khalaas raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑naadum da nijis.Wa da guub,hu marad al‑jisim al‑yakrub fi l‑raas aw fi l‑digin.
Wa kan raajil al‑diin chaaf al‑uwaara ma indaha nugra fi l‑laham wa ma indaha suuf azrag misil fi l‑aadi,khalaas hu yukhuttah taraf le muddit sabʼa yoom le l‑mardaan al‑indah guub.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑saabiʼ,raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑uwaara.Wa kan al‑guub da ma alwassaʼ wa ma fi suuf musaffir wa kan ma sawwa nugra fi l‑laham,
al‑naadum da yizzayyan.Wa laakin ma yizayyin al‑bakaan al‑indah guub.Wa raajil al‑diin yukhutt siid al‑guub taraf le mudda taaniye hana sabʼa yoom.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑guub fi l‑yoom al‑saabiʼ.Wa kan al‑guub da ma alwassaʼ fi l‑jisim wa ma sawwa nugra fi l‑laham,khalaas raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar al‑naadum da taahir.Wa baʼad yikhassil khulgaanah,hu yabga taahir.
Wa laakin kan al‑guub alwassaʼ fi jismah baʼad ballakho kadar hu taahir,
raajil al‑diin yichiifah.Wa kan al‑guub da ma alwassaʼ fi l‑jisim,raajil al‑diin ma yifattich kan fi suuf musaffir walla la,al‑mardaan da hu nijis.
Wa kan al‑guub da gaaʼid fi bakaanah wa ma zaad wa suufah al‑azrag kula gamma foogah,khalaas al‑naadum da biri wa bigi taahir.Wa raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar hu taahir.
Wa wakit bugaʼ buyud wa biraaru marago fi jisim hana mara aw raajil,
waajib raajil al‑diin yichiifah.Wa kan al‑bugaʼ al‑fi l‑jisim dool buyud wa ma biraaru,khalaas dool bugaʼ saakit bas al‑gammo fi l‑jisim wa l‑naadum da taahir.
Wa kan naadum waddar suufah wa bigi musalliʼ,hu taahir.
Wa kan waddar suuf raasah min giddaam wa buguchtah musalliʼe kula,hu taahir.
Wa laakin kan fi l‑bakaan al‑musalliʼ be wara aw fi l‑bugcha indah uwaara beeda muhammire,khalaas da marad al‑jisim gaaʼid yugumm fi l‑bakaan al‑musalliʼ be wara aw fi l‑bugcha
wa waajib raajil al‑diin yichiifah.Wa kan al‑uwaara di tisawwi khurraaja beeda muhammire fi l‑bakaan al‑musalliʼ be wara aw fi l‑bugcha,wa kan hi tichaabih marad al‑jisim hana l‑farwa,
khalaas fi l‑bakaan da,al‑naadum da indah marad al‑jisim wa hu nijis.Wa raajil al‑diin yiballikh kadar hu nijis wa l‑marad da karabah fi raasah.
Wa fi l‑haala di,kan naadum karabah marad al‑jisim wa bigi mardaan,waajib yalbas khulgaan mucharratiin wa ma yiʼaddil suuf raasah wa yikhatti chanabah wa yiʼiit wa yuguul : Nijis !Nijis ! 
Wa hu yukuun nijis fi kulla l‑mudda al‑gaaʼide foogha al‑uwaara al‑nijse.Hu yagood wiheedah wa yukhutt beetah barra min al‑fariig.
Wa wakit fi bugʼa hana barnuug fi khalag hana suuf aw hana kattaan,
aw fi gumaach aw fi khattaay hana suuf aw hana kattaan aw fi farwa aw fi ayyi cheyy hana farwa,
wa kan al‑bugʼa di mukhaddire aw muhammire fi l‑khalag aw fi l‑farwa aw fi l‑gumaach aw fi l‑khattaay aw fi ayyi cheyy hana farwa,khalaas di bugʼa hana barnuug.Khalli yiwassufuuha le raajil al‑diin.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑bugʼa di wa yichiil al‑cheyy al‑hi foogah wa yukhuttah taraf le muddit sabʼa yoom.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑saabiʼ,raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑bugʼa di wa kan hi alwassaʼat fi l‑khalag aw fi l‑gumaach aw fi l‑khattaay aw fi l‑farwa aw fi ayyi cheyy hana farwa,khalaas da barnuug mudammir.Wa l‑cheyy da nijis.
Wa raajil al‑diin yiharrig al‑khalag aw al‑gumaach aw al‑khattaay hana l‑suuf aw hana l‑kattaan aw ayyi cheyy hana farwa,al‑foogah al‑bugʼa.Achaan da barnuug al‑mudammir wa l‑cheyy al‑hu foogah,waajib yiharruguuh fi l‑naar.
Wa laakin kan raajil al‑diin chaaf al‑bugʼa di ma gaaʼide tilwassaʼ fi l‑khalag aw fi l‑gumaach aw fi l‑khattaay aw fi ayyi cheyy hana farwa,
khalaas raajil al‑diin yaamur yikhassulu al‑cheyy al‑foogah al‑bugʼa wa yichiilah battaan wa yukhuttah taraf le muddit sabʼa yoom.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiif al‑bugʼa baʼad khassalooha.Wa kan al‑bugʼa ma alkhayyarat wa ma gaaʼide tilwassaʼ,khalaas al‑cheyy al‑foogah al‑bugʼa di nijis.Wa waajib yiharruguuh achaan al‑khalag da maʼkuul be giddaam aw be wara.
Wa kan raajil al‑diin chaaf al‑bugʼa di gaaʼide tiwaddir baʼad khassalooha,hu yagtaʼha min al‑khalag aw al‑farwa aw al‑gumaach aw al‑khattaay.
Wa laakin kan battaan cheyy baan fi nafs al‑khalag aw al‑gumaach aw al‑khattaay aw fi ayyi cheyy hana farwa,khalaas di bugʼa hana barnuug al‑gaaʼide tugumm.Waajib yiharrugu al‑cheyy al‑foogah al‑bugʼa di marra waahid.
Wa ayyi khalag aw gumaach aw khattaay aw ayyi cheyy hana farwa al‑yikhassuluuh wa l‑bugʼa tamrug minnah,khalli yikhassuluuh battaan wa hu yabga taahir.
Wa dool gawaaniin al‑bugʼa hana l‑barnuug,kan fi khalag hana suuf aw hana kattaan aw gumaach aw khattaay aw ayyi cheyy hana farwa.Wa dool al‑gawaaniin al‑be sababhum yiballukhu kan al‑cheyy nijis aw taahir.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa gaal :
Daahu al‑gaanuun al‑yitabbigah al‑naadum al‑indah marad al‑jisim fi yoom tihaartah.Wakit yiwadduuh le raajil al‑diin,
raajil al‑diin yamrug barra min al‑fariig wa yichiif al‑mardaan.Kan hu ligi al‑aafe min marad al‑jisim da,
raajil al‑diin yaamur le l‑naadum al‑yittahhar yijiib itneen tuyuur hayyiin wa taahiriin wa uud min hatab al‑arz wa kheet ahmar wa warchaal zuufa.
Wa raajil al‑diin yanti amur yadbaho waahid min al‑tuyuur dool fi maaʼuun hana tiine malaan almi nadiif.
Wa yichiil al‑teeraay al‑hayye wa uud min hatab al‑arz wa l‑kheet al‑ahmar wa warchaal al‑zuufa.Wa yidissuhum fi l‑damm hana l‑teeraay al‑dabahooha fi l‑almi al‑nadiif.
Wa raajil al‑diin yuruchch sabʼa marraat al‑naadum al‑yittahhar min marad al‑jisim.Wa hu yiballikhah taahir wa yatlig al‑teeraay al‑hayye titiir fi l‑kadaade.
Wa l‑naadum al‑yittahhar yikhassil khulgaanah wa yizayyin kulla suufah wa yilbarrad wa khalaas,hu yabga taahir.Wa baʼad da,hu yagdar yadkhul fi l‑fariig.Wa laakin waajib yagood sabʼa yoom barra min kheemtah.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑saabiʼ,hu yizayyin kulla suuf raasah wa dignah wa hadagah wa yizayyin kulla suuf jildah.Wa yikhassil khulgaanah wa yilbarrad wa hu yabga taahir.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑taamin,hu yichiil itneen kharuuf al‑ma induhum ayyi eeb wa khanamaay bitt sana al‑ma indaha ayyi eeb wa hadiiye hana dagiig talaata kooro mukhalbat be dihin wa tilit liitir hana dihin.
Wa raajil al‑diin al‑yisawwi al‑tihaara yukhutt al‑naadum al‑yittahhar wa l‑hadaaya giddaam Allah fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil waahid min al‑khurfaan dool wa tilit al‑liitir hana l‑dihin wa yigaddimhum dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata wa hadiiye marfuuʼa le Allah.
Wa hu yadbah al‑kharuuf fi l‑bakaan al‑yadbaho foogah al‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib wa l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga,fi bakaan mukhaddas.Achaan al‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata,hi le raajil al‑diin misil dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑zanib.Humman mukhaddasiin marra waahid.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil min damm al‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata wa yukhuttah fi halamat al‑adaan al‑zeene hana l‑naadum al‑yittahhar wa fi usbaʼah al‑kabiir hana iidah wa rijlah al‑zeene.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil tilit al‑liitir hana l‑dihin wa yusubb minnah fi kaffah al‑israay.
Wa yidiss usbaʼah hana iidah al‑zeene fi l‑dihin al‑fi kaffah al‑israay wa yuruchch be usbaʼah al‑dihin sabʼa marraat giddaam Allah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yukhutt min al‑dihin al‑faddal fi halamat al‑adaan al‑zeene hana l‑naadum al‑yittahhar wa fi usbaʼah al‑kabiir hana iidah wa rijlah al‑zeene,min foog le damm hana l‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑khata.
Wa l‑faddal min al‑dihin al‑fi iid raajil al‑diin,yusubbah fi raas al‑naadum al‑yittahhar.Wa khalaas,yisawwi leyah kaffaara giddaam Allah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yigaddim dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑zanib wa be misil da,yisawwi kaffaara le l‑naadum al‑yittahhar min najaastah.Wa baʼad da,raajil al‑diin yadbah al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga.
Wa raajil al‑diin yigaddim fi l‑madbah al‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa l‑hadiiye hana l‑dagiig wa yisawwi kaffaara le l‑naadum da.Wa khalaas,hu yabga taahir.
Wa kan al‑naadum da fagri,ma yagdar yalga kulla l‑achya dool,khalli yichiil kharuuf waahid bas le dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata wa da yigaddumuuh hadiiye marfuuʼa le yisawwu leyah kaffaara.Wa yichiil kooro hana dagiig mukhalbat be dihin le l‑hadiiye hana l‑dagiig wa tilit liitir hana dihin.
Wa gimri itneen aw hamaam itneen wa da hasab gudurtah,waahide le l‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑zanib wa l‑aakhara le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑taamin,hu yijiib kulla l‑hadaaya hana tihaartah le raajil al‑diin fi madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ giddaam Allah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yichiil al‑kharuuf hana dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata wa tilit liitir hana dihin wa yigaddimhum hadiiye marfuuʼa giddaam Allah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yadbah al‑kharuuf hana dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata.Wa hu yichiil min damm al‑dahiiye hana kaffaarat al‑khata wa yukhuttah fi halamat al‑adaan al‑zeene hana l‑naadum al‑yittahhar wa fi usbaʼah al‑kabiir hana iidah wa rijlah al‑zeene.
Wa raajil al‑diin yusubb dihin chiyya fi kaffah al‑israay.
Wa yichiil min al‑dihin al‑fi kaffah be usbaʼah hana iidah al‑zeene wa yuruchchah sabʼa marraat giddaam Allah.
Wa raajil al‑diin yukhutt dihin fi halamat al‑adaan al‑zeene hana l‑naadum al‑yittahhar wa fi usbaʼah al‑kabiir hana iidah wa rijlah al‑zeene,min foog le damm hana dahiiyat kaffaarat al‑khata.
Wa l‑faddal min al‑dihin al‑fi iid raajil al‑diin yusubbah fi raas al‑naadum al‑yittahhar wa yisawwi leyah kaffaara giddaam Allah.
Wa hu yigaddim waahide min al‑gimri aw waahide min al‑hamaam hasab gudurtah.
Wa min al‑cheyy al‑gidir ligiih,hu yigaddimah,waahide le l‑dahiiye le kaffaarat al‑zanib wa l‑aakhara le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa maʼaahum al‑hadiiye hana l‑dagiig.Wa raajil al‑diin yisawwi le l‑naadum al‑yittahhar kaffaara giddaam Allah.
Wa dool al‑gawaaniin al‑bukhussu tihaarat al‑naadum al‑indah marad al‑jisim wa fagri ma indah gudra le yittahhar.
Wa Allah hajja le Muusa wa Haaruun wa gaal :
Wakit tiwassulu fi balad Kanʼaan al‑nantiiha leeku warasa,kan ana nukhutt barnuug fi waahid min al‑buyuut hana l‑balad al‑tabga hintuku,
waajib siid al‑beet da yamchi yiʼoori raajil al‑diin.Wa yuguul leyah : Ana chift cheyy bichaabih bugʼa fi lubb beeti. 
Wa raajil al‑diin yanti amur yifaddu al‑beet gabul hu ma yaji yichiif al‑bugʼa achaan kulla cheyy fi lubb al‑beet,hu ma yiballikhha nijis.Wa baʼad da,raajil al‑diin yadkhul yichiif al‑beet.
Wa hu yichiif al‑bugʼa.Wa kan hu yichiif kadar al‑bugʼa fi l‑durdur hana l‑beet indaha nugaar mukhaddiriin aw muhammiriin wa kan sawwo nugaar fi l‑durdur,
khalaas raajil al‑diin yamrug min al‑beet.Wa wakit lihig al‑baab,hu yisidd al‑beet le muddit sabʼa yoom.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑saabiʼ,raajil al‑diin yigabbil.Wa kan hu yichiif al‑bugʼa gaaʼide tilwassaʼ fi l‑durdur hana l‑beet,
hu yaamur yamurgu al‑hujaar al‑gaaʼide fooghum al‑bugʼa wa yazguluuhum barra min al‑madiina fi bakaan nijis.
Wa yuhukku kulla l‑beet min daakhal wa yidaffugu turaabah al‑hakkooh barra min al‑madiina fi bakaan nijis.
Wa yichiilu hujaar aakhariin wa yukhuttuuhum fi gadd al‑hujaar al‑maragoohum.Wa yichiilu turaab aakhar le yitallusu al‑beet min daakhal.
Wa kan battaan al‑bugʼa gammat baʼad marago al‑hujaar wa baʼad hakko al‑beet min daakhal wa tallasooh,
waajib raajil al‑diin yigabbil.Wa kan yichiif al‑bugʼa zaadat fi l‑beet,khalaas da barnuug muʼdi.Wa l‑beet da nijis.
Wa yikassuru al‑beet.Wa kulla hujaarah wa hatabah wa kulla turaabah yamurguuh wa yidaffuguuh barra min al‑madiina fi bakaan nijis.
Wa kan naadum yadkhul fi l‑beet wakit hu masduud,al‑naadum da yabga nijis lahaddi l‑achiiye.
Wa kan naadum yargud fi l‑beet da,waajib yikhassil khulgaanah.Wa kan yaakul foogah kula,waajib yikhassil khulgaanah.
Wa laakin kan raajil al‑diin ja wa yichiif kadar baʼad tallaso al‑beet al‑bugʼa ma al‑wassaʼat fi l‑beet,khalaas raajil al‑diin yiballikh al‑beet da taahir achaan al‑bugʼa alʼaalajat.
Wa le yitahhir al‑beet min al‑bugʼa,hu yichiil itneen tuyuur wa hatab al‑arz wa kheet ahmar wa warchaal zuufa.
Wa raajil al‑diin yadbah waahid min al‑tuyuur dool fi maaʼuun hana tiine malaan almi nadiif.
Wa yichiil uud min hatab al‑arz wa warchaal al‑zuufa wa l‑kheet al‑ahmar wa l‑teeraay al‑hayye wa yidissuhum fi l‑damm hana l‑teeraay al‑dabahooha fi l‑almi al‑nadiif.Wa yuruchch beyah al‑beet sabʼa marraat.
Wa hu yitahhir al‑beet be damm al‑teeraay wa l‑almi al‑nadiif wa l‑teeraay al‑hayye wa hatab al‑arz wa warchaal al‑zuufa wa l‑kheet al‑ahmar.
Wa yatlig al‑teeraay al‑hayye titiir barra min al‑madiina fi l‑kadaade.Wa be misil da,hu yisawwi kaffaara le l‑beet wa khalaas,al‑beet yabga taahir.
Wa khalaas,dool al‑gawaaniin al‑bukhussu ayyi marad al‑jisim wa l‑guub
wa l‑barnuug hana l‑khulgaan wa l‑buyuut
wa l‑kharaariij wa l‑bahag wa l‑bugaʼ al‑yiraaru.
