Wa Ahaaz wilid Yahuʼaadawa Yahuʼaada wilid Alamaat wa Azmaawat wa Zimri.Wa Zimri wilid Mussa.
Wa Mussa wilid Binʼawa Binʼa wilid Raafawa Raafa wilid Alʼaasawa Alʼaasa wilid Asiil.
Wa Asiil wilid sitte awlaad wa humman Azrikhaam wa Bukru wa Ismaaʼiil wa Chaʼarya wa Ubadya wa Hanaan.Wa dool kulluhum awlaad Asiil.
Wa awlaad Ichakh akhu Asiil humman Ulaam al‑bikir wa Yaʼuuch al‑taani wa Alifaalat al‑taalit.
Wa awlaad Ulaam humman rujaal furraas wa yaʼarfu yazurgu al‑nuchchaab.Wa humman induhum iyaal wa iyaal al‑iyaal katiir,fi l‑jumla 150.Wa humman dool kulluhum ke min zurriiyit Banyaamiin.
Wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil hasaboohum wa sajjalo usumhum fi kitaab muluuk Bani Israaʼiil.Wa naas Bani Yahuuza waddoohum fi l‑khurba fi balad Baabil achaan iso Allah.
Wa awwal naas al‑gabbalo min al‑khurba wa jo fi hillaalhum ard warasathum,humman naas min Bani Israaʼiil rujaal al‑diin al‑Laawiyiin wa l‑khaddaamiin hana beet Allah.
Wa l‑naas al‑jo wa sakano fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,humman min gabaayil Yahuuza wa Banyaamiin wa Afraayim wa Manassa.
Wa min gabiilat Yahuuza,ja Utaay wileed Amihuud wileed Umri wileed Imri wileed Baani min khachum beet Faaris wileed Yahuuza.
Wa min khachum beet Chiilooh,ja Asaaya wileed al‑bikir hana aayiltah wa iyaalah.
Wa min khachum beet Zaarah,ja Yaʼuwiil.Wa kulla l‑naas al‑min gabiilat Yahuuza al‑sakano fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,adadhum 690.
Wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin fiyahSallu wileed Machullam wileed Hudawya wileed Hasnu
wa Yibniya wileed Yaruuhaamwa Iila wileed Uzzi wileed Mikriwa Machullam wileed Chafatya wileed Raʼuwiil wileed Yibniiya.
Wa kulla l‑naas al‑min gabiilat Banyaamiin al‑sakano fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,adadhum 956.Wa kulla l‑naas dool,ayyi waahid kabiir fi aayiltah.
Wa min rujaal al‑diin fiyahYadaʼyawa Yuyaaribwa Yaakiin
wa Azarya wileed Hilkhiiya wileed Machullam wileed Saduukh wileed Marayuut wileed Akhituub wa hu masʼuul fi beet Allah
wa Adaaya wileed Yaruuhaam wileed Fachhuur wileed Malkiiyawa Maʼasaay wileed Adiyiil wileed Yahziira wileed Machullam wileed Machillimuut wileed Immiir.
Wa maʼa akhwaanhum rujaal al‑diin al‑aakhariin,al‑naas dool kubaaraat fi aayilaathum wa adadhum 1 760 rujaal gaadriin fi khidmit beet Allah.
Wa min al‑Laawiyiin fiyahChamaʼya wileed Hachuub wileed Azrikhaam wileed Hachabya min zurriiyit Maraari
wa Bagbagarwa Haraachwa Galaalwa Mattanya wileed Miika wileed Zikri wileed Asaaf
wa Ubadya wileed Chamaʼya wileed Galaal wileed Yaduutuunwa Barakya wileed Aasa wileed Alikhaana.Wa Alikhaana sakan fi l‑hillaal al‑taabʼiin madiinat Natuufa.
Wa min hurraas al‑biibaan fiyah Challuum al‑masʼuul wa Akhuub wa Talmuun wa Akhimaan wa akhwaanhum.
Wa lahaddi l‑yoom kula,zurriiyithum bas gaaʼide tahris al‑baab al‑sabhaani hana beet Allah al‑binaaduuh baab al‑Malik.Wa juduudhum bas al‑zamaan hurraas hana furgaan al‑Laawiyiin.
Wa Challuum hu wileed Khuuri wileed Abiyaasaf wileed Khuurah.Wa hu maʼa akhwaanah al‑min zurriiyit Khuurah masʼuuliin fi khidmit hurraas madkhal kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa da misil juduudhum awwal kula hurraas fariig chaʼab Allah.
Wa zamaan Fiinhaas wileed Aliʼaazar,hu bas kabiirhum wa Allah maʼaayah.
Wa Zakariiya wileed Machalaamya,hu bas al‑gaaʼid yahris baab kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa l‑rujaal al‑azaloohum hurraas hana l‑biibaan adadhum 212.Humman sajjaloohum min hillaalhum al‑wildoohum fooghum.Wa Dawuud wa l‑nabi Samuwiil humman bas al‑kallafoohum be l‑khidme di daayman.
Wa humman wa iyaalhum hafado khidmit hafidiin kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa haraasat biibaan beet Allah.
Wa l‑hurraas dool gaaʼidiin fi l‑biibaan hana l‑arbaʼa jiihe,sabaah wa kharib wa wati wa munchaakh.
Wa akhwaanhum al‑gaaʼidiin fi hillaalhum yaju leehum fi kulla wakit achaan yisaaʼuduuhum fi l‑haraasa le muddit sabʼa yoom.
Wa laakin al‑kubaaraat al‑arbaʼa hana l‑hurraas yagoodu daayman.Wa l‑Laawiyiin dool masʼuuliin fi l‑buyuut wa l‑makhaazin hana beet Allah.
Humman yunuumu hawaale beet Allah achaan yahfadooh wa yaftaho al‑biibaan kulli sabaah.
Wa waahidiin min al‑Laawiyiin masʼuuliin fi hisaab muʼiddaat al‑ibaada wakit yichiiluuhum wa yijiibuuhum.
Wa waahidiin minhum masʼuuliin fi kulla l‑muʼiddaat al‑mukhassasiin wa fi l‑dagiig wa l‑khamar wa l‑dihin wa l‑samukh al‑muʼattar wa l‑itir.
Wa laakin rujaal al‑diin bas yikhalbutu al‑itir.
Wa Mattitya,hu waahid min al‑Laawiyiin wa hu bikir Challuum min zurriiyit Khuurah.Hu daayman masʼuul be sawwiyiin al‑kaʼak.
Wa waahidiin min al‑Laawiyiin al‑aakhariin al‑humman min zurriiyit Gahaat,humman dool masʼuuliin be sawwiyiin al‑khubza al‑yigaddumuuha le Allah kulli yoom sabt.
Wa kubaaraat aayilat al‑Laawiyiin al‑mukallafiin be khine,khattoohum fi buyuut taraf wa ma antoohum khidme aakhara achaan humman gaaʼidiin yakhdumu leel wa nahaar.
Wa dool bas kubaaraat aayilat al‑Laawiyiin ayyi waahid hasab zurriiytah.Wa humman saakniin fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa Yaʼiyiil abu Gibʼuun sakan fi hillit Gibʼuun maʼa martah al‑usumha Maʼaaka.
Wa wileedah al‑bikir usmah Abduun wa awlaadah al‑aakhariin humman Suur wa Khiich wa Baʼal wa Niir wa Nadaab
wa Gaduur wa Akhyu wa Zakariiya wa Mikhluut.
Wa Mikhluut wilid Chimaam.Wa humman kula sakano fi Uruchaliim maʼa akhwaanhum al‑min khachum beethum.
Wa Niir wilid Khiichwa Khiich wilid Chaawuulwa Chaawuul wilid Yuunataan wa Malkichuuʼ wa Abinadaab wa Ichbaʼal.
Wa Yuunataan wilid Mariibaʼalwa Mariibaʼal wilid Miika.
Wa awlaad Miika humman Fiituun wa Maalik wa Taahriʼ.
Wa Ahaaz wilid Yaʼarawa Yaʼara wilid Alamaat wa Azmaawat wa Zimri.Wa Zimri wilid Mussa.
Wa Mussa wilid Binʼawa Binʼa wilid Rafaayawa Rafaaya wilid Alʼaasawa Alʼaasa wilid Asiil.
Wa Asiil wilid sitte awlaad wa humman Azrikhaam wa Bukru wa Ismaaʼiil wa Chaʼarya wa Ubadya wa Hanaan.Wa dool kulluhum awlaad Asiil.
Wa yoom waahid,al‑Filistiyiin hajamo Bani Israaʼiil wa Bani Israaʼiil jaro giddaam al‑Filistiyiin wa katiiriin minhum maato fi jabal Gilbuuʼa.
Wa l‑Filistiyiin zarroohum le Chaawuul wa iyaalah.Wa humman katalo Yuunataan wa Abinadaab wa Malkichuuʼ,iyaal Chaawuul.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,al‑harib bigi chadiid le Chaawuul.Wa siyaad al‑nuchchaab chaafooh wa wakit hu chaafaahum,gamma yarjif giddaamhum.
Wa Chaawuul gaal le l‑sabi al‑chaayil leyah silaahah : Sill seefak wa aktulni.Achaan ma nidoor al‑ma mutahhariin dool yiʼazzubuuni. Laakin al‑sabi aba achaan hu khaaf marra waahid.Wa khalaas Chaawuul chaal seefah wa wagaʼ foogah wa maat.
Wa wakit al‑sabi da chaaf Chaawuul maat,hu kula wagaʼ fi seefah wa maat.
Wa be misil da,Chaawuul wa awlaadah al‑talaata wa kulla aayiltah maato sawa.
Wa wakit Bani Israaʼiil al‑saakniin jamb al‑waadi simʼo be haziimat Bani Israaʼiil wa moot Chaawuul wa awlaadah,humman kula arrado wa khallo hillaalhum.Wa l‑Filistiyiin jo wa sakano fi l‑hillaal dool.
Wa ambaakir,wakit al‑Filistiyiin jo fi bakaan al‑duwaas le yichiilu khumaam al‑maytiin,ligo Chaawuul wa awlaadah maytiin fi raas jabal Gilbuuʼa.
Wa humman chaalo silaah Chaawuul wa gataʼo raasah.Wa rassalo al‑khabar da fi kulla balad al‑Filistiyiin wa khabbaro beyah chaʼabhum wa fi buyuut asnaamhum.
Wa humman khatto silaah Chaawuul fi beet ilaahaathum.Wa allago raasah fi beet ilaahhum Daguun.
Wa kulla sukkaan hillit Yaabiich fi turaab Gilʼaad simʼo be kulla cheyy al‑Filistiyiin sawwooh fi Chaawuul.
Khalaas kulla l‑rujaal al‑fahaliin gammo wa macho chaalo janaazaat Chaawuul wa awlaadah wa jaaboohum fi Yaabiich.Wa humman dafano udaamhum fi gaʼar al‑chadara al‑kabiire al‑gaaʼide fi Yaabiich.Wa saamo sabʼa yoom.
Wa Chaawuul maat achaan isi Allah wa ma taabaʼ kalaamah.Wa battaan hu macha saʼal naadum al‑yikallim maʼa l‑maytiin
wa aba ma yasʼal Allah.Wa be sabab da,Allah jaʼal leyah al‑moot wa sallam al‑muluk le Dawuud wileed Yassa.
Wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil jo le Dawuud fi Hibruun wa gaalo leyah : Chiif !Aniina min dammak wa lahamak.
Zamaan wakit Chaawuul malik,inta gaaʼid tuguud deech Bani Israaʼiil.Wa fi l‑wakit daak bas,Allah Ilaahak gaal leek :‹ Inta tabga raaʼi le chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil wa tahkim fooghum.› 
Wa fi chaan da,kulla chuyuukh Bani Israaʼiil jo le Dawuud fi Hibruun wa hu sawwa maʼaahum muʼaahada giddaam Allah.Wa humman masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi Bani Israaʼiil hasab kalaam Allah al‑gaalah zamaan be waasitat Samuwiil.
Wa yoom waahid,Dawuud wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil macho Uruchaliim.Wa fi l‑wakit da,al‑hille di usumha Yabuus wa l‑Yabuusiyiin bas saakniin fiiha.
Wa l‑Yabuusiyiin gaalo le Dawuud : Inta ma tagdar tadkhul fi l‑hille di. Wa laakin Dawuud chaal bakaanhum al‑gawi al‑usmah Sahyuun.Wa be da,sammo al‑bakaan da madiinat Dawuud.
Wa gubbaal ma yichiil al‑bakaan da,Dawuud gaal : Al‑naadum al‑yugumm awwal wa yahjim al‑Yabuusiyiin,ana nidarrijah khaayid al‑deech. Wa khalaas fi l‑bakaan da,Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya hajamaahum awwal wa hu bigi khaayid al‑deech.
Wa Dawuud sakan fi l‑bakaan al‑gawi da.Wa achaan da bas,sammo al‑bakaan da madiinat Dawuud.
Wa hu wassaʼ al‑hille min ayyi jiihe wa da min durdur al‑difaaʼ al‑sammooh Millu lahaddi hawaaleeha.Wa Yuwaab kamaan jaddad al‑baagi hana l‑hille.
Wa gudrat Dawuud gaaʼide tiziid be ziyaada achaan Allah al‑Gaadir gaaʼid maʼaayah.
Daahu kubaaraat furraas Dawuud al‑saaʼadooh marra waahid fi kulla wakit mulkah.Wa humman maʼa kulla Bani Israaʼiil darrajooh malik hasab kalaam Allah fi Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa daahu asaame furraas Dawuud.Al‑awwalaani Yachabʼaam wileed naadum waahid min hillit Hakmuun wa hu khaayid majmuuʼat al‑talaatiin.Wa hu bas al‑be haribtah katal 300 raajil fi l‑duwaas fi yoom waahid.
Wa l‑taani Aliʼaazar wileed Duudu min hillit Akhuukh.Hu kula faaris min al‑furraas al‑talaata.
Wa hu bas al‑macha maʼa Dawuud fi Faas Dammiim wakit al‑Filistiyiin lammo le l‑harib.Wa fi l‑bakaan da,fiyah zereʼ hana gameh abyad wa rujaal Bani Israaʼiil arrado min al‑Filistiyiin.
Wa karaso fi lubb al‑zereʼ wa baʼad da,marago wa haaraboohum le l‑Filistiyiin.Wa Allah anta nasur kabiir le Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa yoom waahid,talaata min al‑furraas al‑talaatiin hana Dawuud jo ligooh le Dawuud fi karkuur Adullaam.Wa fi l‑wakit da,muʼaskar al‑Filistiyiin gaaʼid fi waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa Dawuud gaaʼid fi bakaanah al‑gawi.Wa l‑Filistiyiin kamaan gaaʼidiin fi muʼaskarhum fi Beet Laham.
Wa tawwaali Dawuud atmanna wa gaal : Yaatu yijiib leyi almi nachrab min al‑biir al‑gaaʼide fi madkhal Beet Laham ? 
Wa khalaas al‑furraas al‑talaata dool macho dakhalo fi muʼaskar al‑Filistiyiin,chaalo almi min al‑biir al‑gaaʼide fi madkhal Beet Laham,jaabooh wa antooh le Dawuud.Wa laakin hu aba ma yacharbah wa gaddamah hadiiyat charaab le Allah.
Wa gaal : Istakhfar Allah !Abadan ma nisawwi cheyy misil da !Ma nagdar nachrab min al‑almi da achaan hu misil damm al‑rujaal al‑macho jaabooh be taman hayaathum.Aywa !Be taman hayaathum bas humman jaabo al‑almi da. Wa Dawuud aba ma yachrab al‑almi da.Wa da l‑cheyy al‑sawwooh al‑furraas al‑talaata dool.
Wa Abichaay akhu Yuwaab hu bas khaayid al‑talaata.Wa yoom waahid,hu bas be haribtah katal 300 raajil.Wa usmah bigi taaliʼ ambeen al‑furraas al‑talaata dool.
Wa hu ligi charaf ziyaada min al‑tineen wa hu bigi khaayidhum.Wa ma fi al‑yufuutah ambeen al‑furraas al‑talaata.
Wa Banaaya al‑min hillit Khabsiil,hu wileed Yahuuyadaʼ raajil waahid fahal.Wa Banaaya da,hu zaatah fahal wa chadiid.Da hu al‑katal rujaal itneen fahaliin hana balad Muwaab.Wa yoom waahid wakit al‑talaj nazal,hu dakhal fi nugra wa katal duud.
Wa battaan hu bas katal Masri al‑tuulah yisaawi 5 duraaʼ wa uud haribtah gadur murdaas al‑ligdaabe.Wa Banaaya macha leyah hajamah be asa wa galaʼ minnah haribtah wa katalah beeha.
Wa dool al‑aʼmaal al‑sawwaahum Banaaya wileed Yahuuyadaʼ wa usmah bigi taaliʼ misil al‑furraas al‑talaata.
Wa hu ligi charaf ziyaada min al‑talaatiin wa laakin ma lihig al‑talaata.Wa Dawuud khattaah masʼuul harasah.

Wa l‑rujaal dool hummanAkhiʼaazar kabiirhum wa akhuuh Yuwaach humman awlaad Chamaaʼa al‑min hillit Gibeeʼawa Yaziyiil wa Faalat awlaad Azmaawatwa Barakawa Yaahu al‑min hillit Anatuut

Wa fi rujaal waahidiin min gabiilat Gaad ansahabo wa macho ligooh le Dawuud fi bakaanah al‑gawi fi l‑kadaade.Wa l‑naas dool rujaal furraas wa gaadriin fi l‑harib.Wa musallahiin be darag wa huraab.Wa humman chudaad misil al‑diidaan wa ajiiliin misil khazaal fi raas al‑jibaal.

Wa l‑naas dool min gabiilat Gaad wa humman khuyyaad al‑askar.Al‑sakhayyar kula khaayid fi 100 askar wa l‑kabiir kamaan khaayid fi 1 000 askar.
Wa humman bas al‑gataʼo bahar al‑Urdun fi l‑chahar al‑awwal fi wakit al‑seel yisiil.Wa tarado al‑naas al‑saakniin jamb al‑waadi be nuss al‑sabaah wa l‑kharib.
Wa rujaal waahidiin min gabaayil Banyaamiin wa Yahuuza kula macho ligooh le Dawuud fi bakaanah al‑gawi.
Wa Dawuud marag leehum wa gaal : Kan jiitu leyi be l‑salaam le tisaaʼuduuni,nifaddilku be niiye mukhlisa.Wa laakin kan intu jiitu le tukhuchchuuni le faaydit udwaani wa ana ma sawweet cheyy fasil,khalli Allah Rabb juduudna yichiif wa yihaakim ambeenaatna. 
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal fi Amaasaay kabiir al‑furraas al‑talaatiin wa hu gaal : Aniina maʼaak !Aywa aniina maʼaak,ya Dawuud wileed Yassa !Khalli al‑salaam yukuun maʼaak wa maʼa l‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin yisaaʼuduuk achaan Rabbak gaaʼid yisaaʼidak. Wa khalaas fi l‑bakaan da,Dawuud laagaahum wa sawwaahum kubaaraat askarah.
Wa fiyah rujaal min gabiilat Manassa dawwaro yindammo le Dawuud fi wakit al‑hu maachi maʼa l‑Filistiyiin yihaarubu Chaawuul.Laakin Dawuud wa askarah ma gidro saaʼado al‑Filistiyiin fi l‑harib achaan wakit kubaaraat al‑Filistiyiin lammo wa achchaawaro,taradooh le Dawuud wa gaalo ambeenaathum : Baʼadeen yigabbil diddina wa yisallimna le sayyidah Chaawuul. 
Wa wakit Dawuud gabbal le hillit Sikhlaag,al‑rujaal al‑min gabiilat Manassa jo wa andammo leyah.Wa humman Adnaah wa Yuuzabaad wa Yadiyaʼiil wa Mikaayiil wa Yuuzabaad wa Aliihu wa Siltaay.Wa ayyi waahid minhum khaayid fi 1 000 raajil min gabiilat Manassa.
Wa humman saaʼado Dawuud wa askarah achaan humman rujaal furraas wa bigo khuyyaad askarah.
Wa ayyi yoom,fiyah naas al‑yaju yindammo le Dawuud le yisaaʼuduuh.Wa be misil da,askarah bigo katiiriin misil askar al‑Rabb.
Wa daahu adad al‑askar al‑musallahiin al‑macho wa andammo le Dawuud fi Hibruun.Wa humman macho le yisallumu muluk Chaawuul le Dawuud hasab amur Allah.

wa maʼaahum Yahuuyadaʼ al‑masʼuul fi khachum beet Haaruun wa maʼaayah 3 700 raajil.

Wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin gabiila hint Chaawuul 3 000 raajil.Wa gubbaal da,katiir min al‑rujaal dool khadamo le aayilat Chaawuul.
Wa min gabiilat Afraayim 20 800 rujaal furraas wa usumhum taaliʼ fi lubb aayilaathum.
Wa min nuss gabiilat Manassa 18 000 rujaal al‑azaloohum le yaju yidarruju Dawuud malik.
Wa min gabiilat Yassaakar 200 khaayid maʼa l‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin tihit amurhum.Al‑khuyyaad dool yaʼarfu yimayyuzu al‑wakit wa yaʼarfu al‑cheyy al‑waajib Bani Israaʼiil yisawwu.
Wa min gabiilat Zabuluun 50 000 rujaal musallahiin wa jaahiziin le l‑harib be niiye waahide.
Wa min gabiilat Naftaali 1 000 khaayid wa maʼaahum 37 000 rujaal musallahiin chaayliin darag wa huraab.
Wa min gabiilat Daan 28 600 rujaal jaahiziin le l‑harib.
Wa min gabiilat Achiir 40 000 rujaal jaahiziin le l‑harib.
Wa min gabaayil Raʼuubiin wa Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa al‑gaaʼidiin khaadi le bahar al‑Urdun,adadhum 120 000 rujaal musallahiin le l‑harib.
Wa kulla l‑rujaal al‑muhaaribiin dool,jo fi Hibruun be niiye waahide le yidarruju Dawuud malik fi Israaʼiil.Wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil al‑faddalo,humman kula be galib waahid jo le yidarruju Dawuud malik.
Wa humman gaʼado talaata yoom maʼa Dawuud wa akalo wa chirbo achaan akhwaanhum jahhazo leehum akil.
Wa kulla l‑naas al‑saakniin fi l‑mantaga di wa zurriiyit Yassaakar wa Zabuluun wa Naftaali kula,jaabo akil be hamiir wa jumaal wa bikhaal wa tiiraan.Jaabo dagiig wa abbuud hana tiin wa inab yaabis wa khamar wa dihin wa khanam wa bagar be katara achaan induhum farha kabiire fi balad Israaʼiil.
Wa Dawuud chaawar maʼa khuyyaad al‑aalaaf wa maʼa khuyyaad al‑miyaat wa maʼa kulla l‑chuyuukh.
Wa baʼad da,hu gaal le kulla jamaaʼat Bani Israaʼiil : Kan tikhassudu wa kan Allah Ilaahna yarda beyah,khalli nirassulu le akhwaanna al‑gaaʼidiin fi kulla balad Israaʼiil wa le rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Laawiyiin al‑fi mudunhum wa l‑fi hillaalhum al‑saakniin foogah achaan yaju yilimmu maʼaana.
Wa khalaas nigabbulu sanduug al‑Rabb wa nijiibuuh fi bakaanna achaan aniina ma jaʼalnaah fi wakit Chaawuul. 
Wa kulla l‑chaʼab khassado achaan al‑cheyy da ajabaahum.
Wa Dawuud lamma kulla Bani Israaʼiil min waadi Masir fi l‑junuub lahaddi Labu Hamaat fi l‑munchaakh le yijiibu sanduug al‑Rabb min hillit Kharyat Yaʼariim.
Wa Dawuud wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil macho le Baʼla yaʼni Kharyat Yaʼariim hille waahide fi balad Yahuuza achaan yijiibu min hinaak sanduug al‑Rabb.Wa da l‑sanduug al‑foogah usum Allah,hu al‑archah gaaʼid been al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin al‑masnuuʼiin fi sidaadit al‑sanduug.
Wa humman chaalo sanduug al‑Rabb min beet Abinadaab wa khattooh fi kaarro jadiid.Wa awlaad Abinadaab,Uzza wa Akhyu gaadooh wa macho beyah.
Wa Dawuud wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil gaaʼidiin yalʼabo giddaam sanduug al‑Rabb be kulla gudrithum wa yikhannu fi hiss aalaat al‑musiikha misil jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa tambal wa nuggaara wa burunji.
Wa wakit wassalo fi l‑madagg hana Kiiduun,al‑bagar attartaʼo wa Uzza madda iidah le yakrub al‑sanduug.
Wa tawwaali Allah khidib khadab chadiid didd Uzza wa tawwaali darabah achaan hu madda iidah wa karab al‑sanduug.Wa Uzza wagaʼ maat hinaak giddaam al‑Rabb.
Wa Dawuud ziʼil zaʼal chadiid achaan Allah khidib didd Uzza wa darabah.Wa samma al‑bakaan da Faaris Uzza (maʼanaatah darab Uzza) wa l‑usum da gaaʼid lahaddi l‑yoom.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,Dawuud khaaf khoof chadiid min al‑Rabb wa gaal : Ana ma nagdar nijiib sanduug al‑Rabb fi beeti. 
Wa fi chaan da,Dawuud ma wadda al‑sanduug fi beetah fi madiinat Dawuud.Wa laakin waddaah fi beet Ubeed Adoom al‑min hillit Gaat.
Wa sanduug al‑Rabb gaʼad talaata chahar fi beet Ubeed Adoom.Wa Allah baarak beet Ubeed Adoom wa kulla cheyy al‑indah.
Wa Hiiraam malik balad Suur rassal naas le Dawuud wa waddo leyah hatab al‑arz.Wa rassal bannaayiin wa najjaariin al‑hatab le yabnu beet le l‑malik Dawuud.
Wa be da,Dawuud irif kadar Allah sabbatah malik fi Bani Israaʼiil.Wa Allah rafaʼ darajat mulkah fi chaan chaʼabah Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Dawuud akhad awiin aakharaat fi Uruchaliim wa hinna wildan leyah awlaad wa banaat.
Wa daahu asaame hana iyaal Dawuud al‑wildoohum leyah fi Uruchaliim.Humman Chammuuʼ wa Chuubaab wa Naataan wa Suleymaan
wa Yibhaar wa Alichuuʼ wa Alfalat
wa Nuga wa Nafag wa Yafiiʼa
wa Alichamaʼ wa Baʼliyaadaʼ wa Alifaalat.
Wa wakit al‑Filistiyiin simʼo kadar Dawuud masahooh wa darrajooh malik fi kulla Bani Israaʼiil,kulluhum gammo macho le yifattuchuuh.Wa laakin Dawuud simiʼ beehum wa macha le yiwajjihhum.
Wa l‑Filistiyiin macho wa hajamo sukkaan fi waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa Dawuud saʼal al‑Rabb wa gaal : Namchi nihaarib al‑Filistiyiin walla ?Inta tisallimhum fi iidi walla ? Wa Allah radda le Dawuud wa gaal : Amchi haaribhum wa ana nisallimhum fi iidak. 
Wa l‑Filistiyiin macho hillit Baʼal Faraasiim wa Dawuud haarabaahum hinaak wa annasar fooghum.Wa gaal : Be iidi ana,al‑Rabb fatah al‑derib wa darabt udwaani misil al‑seel. Wa be sabab da bas,al‑bakaan da sammooh Baʼal Faraasiim (maʼanaatah al‑Rabb al‑darab).
Wa l‑Filistiyiin khallo asnaamhum fi l‑bakaan da wa Dawuud anta amur achaan yutuchchuuhum.
Wa battaan al‑Filistiyiin macho wa hajamo sukkaan waadi Rafaayiin.
Wa battaan Dawuud saʼal al‑Rabb.Wa l‑Rabb gaal leyah : Ma tamchi tahjimhum tawwaali laakin hawwig leehum be wara min jiihat al‑chadar wa garrib leehum.
Wa wakit inta simiʼt haraka misil khatwaat al‑rijil fi raas al‑chadar,tawwaali amrug wa ahjimhum.Achaan al‑Rabb macha giddaamak le yadrub askar al‑Filistiyiin. 
Wa Dawuud sawwa kulla cheyy al‑amarah beyah al‑Rabb.Wa khalaas,humman haarabo askar al‑Filistiyiin wa taradoohum min hillit Gibʼuun lahaddi hillit Gaazar.
Wa min al‑yoom da,Dawuud usmah bigi taaliʼ fi kulla l‑buldaan.Wa Allah sawwa kulla l‑umam yakhaafo min Dawuud.
Wa Dawuud bana buyuut le nafsah fi hillitah al‑usumha madiinat Dawuud.Wa jahhaz bakaan le sanduug al‑Rabb wa bana leyah kheema.
Wa baʼad da,Dawuud gaal : Sanduug al‑Rabb naadum ma yichiilah illa l‑Laawiyiin bas yichiiluuh achaan humman bas Allah azalaahum le yichiilu sanduug Allah wa yakhdumu leyah ila l‑abad. 
Wa Dawuud lamma kulla Bani Israaʼiil fi Uruchaliim le yiwaddu sanduug Allah fi l‑bakaan al‑hu jahhazah leyah.
Wa hu lamma rujaal al‑diin min zurriiyit Haaruun wa l‑Laawiyiin.
Min zurriiyit Gahaat cheekhhum Uriyiil wa maʼaayah naasah adadhum 120.
Wa min zurriiyit Maraari cheekhhum Asaaya wa maʼaayah naasah adadhum 220.
Wa min zurriiyit Girchuun cheekhhum Yuwiil wa maʼaayah naasah adadhum 130.
Wa min zurriiyit Alisaafan cheekhhum Chamaʼya wa maʼaayah naasah adadhum 200.
Wa min zurriiyit Habruun cheekhhum Aliyiil wa maʼaayah naasah adadhum 80.
Wa min zurriiyit Uzziyiil cheekhhum Aminadaab wa maʼaayah naasah adadhum 112.
Wa Dawuud naada rujaal al‑diin Saduukh wa Abiyaatar wa naada al‑Laawiyiin Uriyiil wa Asaaya wa Yuwiil wa Chamaʼya wa Aliyiil wa Aminadaab.
Wa gaal leehum : Intu,ya kubaaraat aayilaat al‑Laawiyiin,khassusu nufuusku intu wa akhwaanku.Wa chiilu sanduug Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil wa wadduuh fi l‑bakaan al‑ana jahhaztah leyah.
Achaan awwal wakit intu ma fiiku,Allah Ilaahna darabaana be sabab aniina ma tabbagna al‑churuut al‑bukhussu sanduug al‑muʼaahada. 
Wa khalaas rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Laawiyiin khassaso nufuushum achaan yichiilu wa yiwaddu sanduug Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa l‑Laawiyiin chaalo sanduug al‑Rabb be l‑iidaan fi kataafeehum misil Muusa amar beyah hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa Dawuud amar kubaaraat al‑Laawiyiin yikallufu akhwaanhum al‑khannaayiin be aalaat al‑musiikha misil al‑jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa l‑nuggaara.Wa yistaʼmalo al‑aalaat dool be chidde achaan yiwassufu farahhum.
Wa khalaas kubaaraat al‑Laawiyiin kallafo Heemaan wileed Yuwiil wa gariibah Asaaf wileed Barakya wa Itaan wileed Khuchaaya al‑hu min zurriiyit Maraari.
Wa maʼaahum akhwaanhum Laawiyiin aakhariin hurraas biibaan beet Allah.Wa humman Zakariiya wa Been wa Yaʼaziyiil wa Chamiiramuut wa Yahiyiil wa Unni wa Aliyaab wa Banaaya wa Maʼasiiya wa Mattitya wa Alifaliihu wa Mikhniya wa Ubeed Adoom wa Yaʼiyiil.
Wa l‑khannaayiin Heemaan wa Asaaf wa Itaan induhum nagaagiir hana nahaas al‑yadurbuuhum.
Wa Zakariiya wa Aziyiil wa Chamiiramuut wa Yahiyiil wa Unni wa Aliyaab wa Maʼasiiya wa Banaaya humman dool yadurbu al‑jigindiiye be soot aali.
Wa Mattitya wa Alifaliihu wa Mikhniya wa Ubeed Adoom wa Yaʼiyiil wa Azazya humman dool yadurbu al‑jigindiiye al‑indaha tamaane habil le yuguudu al‑khine.
Wa Kananya kabiir al‑Laawiyiin,hu bas masʼuul be cheeliin al‑sanduug.Wa hu yiraakhib al‑cheeliin achaan hu yaʼarif kikkeef yisawwiih.
Wa Barakya wa Alikhaana humman hurraas al‑sanduug.
Wa Ubeed Adoom wa Yahiya humman kula hurraas al‑sanduug.Wa rujaal al‑diin Chabanya wa Yuchaafaat wa Nataniil wa Amaasaay wa Zakariiya wa Banaaya wa Aliʼaazar,humman yadurbu al‑burunji giddaam sanduug al‑Rabb.
Wa khalaas,be farha chadiide Dawuud wa chuyuukh Bani Israaʼiil wa khuyyaad al‑aalaaf macho achaan yijiibu sanduug muʼaahadat Allah min beet Ubeed Adoom.
Wa be musaaʼadat al‑Rabb,al‑Laawiyiin chaalo al‑sanduug.Wa gaddamo dahaaya le Allah hana sabʼa toor wa sabʼa kabich.
Wa Dawuud maʼa kulla l‑Laawiyiin al‑chaayliin al‑sanduug wa l‑khannaayiin wa Kananya al‑masʼuul hana l‑cheeliin,humman kulluhum laabsiin jalaaliib hana gumaach sameh.Wa Dawuud kamaan laabis khalag gisayyir misil hana rujaal al‑diin.
Wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil waddo sanduug muʼaahadat Allah fi Uruchaliim be zakhraat wa daribiin buug wa burunji wa nuggaara wa be daribiin amsibeybe wa jigindiiye.
Wa wakit gaaʼidiin yijiibu al‑sanduug fi madiinat Dawuud,Mikaal bineeyit Chaawuul gaaʼide tichiif min al‑chubbaak.Wa chaafat al‑malik Dawuud gaaʼid yalʼab wa yinattit.Wa khalaas hi abatah min galibha.
Wa humman jaabo sanduug al‑Rabb wa khattooh fi lubb al‑kheema al‑Dawuud jahhazaaha leyah.Wa baʼad da,gaddamo le l‑Rabb dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.
Wa wakit Dawuud gaddam al‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin wa dahaaya al‑salaama dool khalaas,hu baarak al‑chaʼab be usum Allah.
Wa baʼad da,Dawuud gassam akil le kulla Bani Israaʼiil,mara wa raajil.Le ayyi waahid antaah khubza wa abbuud hana tamur wa abbuud hana inab.
Wa Dawuud kallaf waahidiin min al‑Laawiyiin yagoodu giddaam sanduug Allah le yachkuru wa yahmudu wa yimajjudu Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa l‑Laawiyiin dool kabiirhum Asaaf wa naaybah Zakariiya wa maʼaahum Yaʼiyiil wa Chamiiramuut wa Yahiyiil wa Mattitya wa Aliyaab wa Banaaya wa Ubeed Adoom wa Yaʼiyiil.Humman dool gaaʼidiin yadurbu aalaat al‑musiikha misil al‑jigindiiye wa amsibeybe wa Asaaf kamaan gaaʼid yadrub al‑nuggaara.
Wa rujaal al‑diin Banaaya wa Yahaziyiil gaaʼidiin yadurbu daayman al‑burunji giddaam sanduug muʼaahadat al‑Rabb.
Wa l‑yoom da,awwal marra Dawuud kallaf Asaaf wa l‑Laawiyiin al‑aakhariin le yachkuru Allah.
Wa daahu khineehum.Achkuru Allah wa atru usmah !Wa arrufu al‑chuʼuub al‑aakhariin be aʼmaalah.
Khannu leyah wa amdahoohwa fakkuru fi kulla ajaaybah.
Anbastu achaan usmah al‑mukhaddaswa khalli guluubku yinmalu be farahintu al‑gaaʼidiin titaabuʼu Allah.
Fattuchu Allah wa gudurtahwa wajjuhu aleyah daayman
Azzakkaro ajaaybah al‑sawwaahum,aywa,ajaaybah wa gawaaniinah al‑amar beehum.
Intu,ya zurriiyit Israaʼiil,intu abiidah.Intu,ya iyaal Yaakhuub,intu al‑Allah azalaaku.
Allah hu bas Ilaahnaal‑yahkim fi kulla l‑ard.
Azzakkaro daayman muʼaahadatahwa kalaamah al‑amar beyah le alif zurriiye.
Wa di muʼaahadatah al‑sawwaaha maʼa Ibraahiimwa akkadha be haliife le Ishaakh.
Hu sabbat chart le zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa sawwa muʼaahada daayme maʼa Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa gaal : Ana nantiiku balad Kanʼaanwa da gisim al‑talgooh misil warasa. 
Wa fi l‑zaman da,adadku chiyya,intu chiyya marra waahidwa saakniin fi l‑balad di misil ajaanib.
Intu raaykhiin min umma le ummawa min mamlaka le chaʼab aakhar.
Laakin Allah ma khalla naadum yazlumkuwa aakhab muluuk fi chaanku.
Wa gaal : Ma tilammusu al‑naasal‑ana masahtuhum wa darrajtuhumwa ma tisawwu al‑fasaala le anbiyaayi. 
Ya sukkaan al‑ard,achkuru Allah be khinewa kulla yoom bachchuru be najaatah.
Hajju be majdah le kulla l‑umamwa be ajaaybah le kulla l‑chuʼuub.
Achaan Allah aziimwa waajib leyah al‑hamd al‑katiir.Hu mukhiif ziyaadawa faayit kulla l‑ilaahaat.
Achaan kulla ilaahaat al‑chuʼuub ma naafʼiinwa laakin Allah hu bas khalag al‑samaawaat.
Al‑majd wa l‑azama hineeyahwa fi bakaanah tinlagi al‑gudra wa l‑farha.
Majjudu Allah,ya gabaayil al‑ard !Majjudu Allahachaan hu al‑Majiid wa l‑Gaadir.
Majjudu Allahachaan usmah al‑Majiid !Gaddumu hadaayaaku giddaamahwa asjudu leyah achaan hu al‑Khudduus.
Arjufu giddaamah,ya kulla sukkaan al‑ard.Al‑aalam yagood saabit,ma yinhazza.
Khalli al‑sama tinbasit wa l‑ard tafrahwa yuguulu fi ust al‑umam : Allah hu al‑malik. 
Khalli al‑bahar yidagdigbe kulla cheyy al‑fi lubbah.Wa khalli al‑kadaade tafrahbe kulla cheyy al‑foogha.
Wa khalli chadar al‑khaaba yizakhrutugiddaam Allahachaan Allah yajiyahkim al‑ard.
Achkuru Allah achaan hu rahiimwa rahmatah daayme ila l‑abad.
Wa guulu leyah : Ya Ilaah al‑naja,najjiina !Ajmaʼna wa najjiina min ust al‑umam.Wa be da,nahmudu usmak al‑mukhaddaswa nimajjuduuk wa nachkuruuk. 
Baarak Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiilmin zamaan wa ila l‑abad.Wa kulla l‑chaʼab gaalo : Aamiin ! Wa chakaro Allah.
Wa Dawuud amar Asaaf wa akhwaanah yagoodu giddaam sanduug muʼaahadat Allah achaan yisawwu khidmithum al‑waajib hasab al‑churuut al‑yoomi.
Wa Ubeed Adoom wileed Yaduutuun wa Huusa wa 68 min akhwaanhum humman hurraas biibaan beet Allah.
Wa Dawuud wakkal Saduukh raajil al‑diin wa rujaal diin aakhariin al‑min aayiltah be khidmit kheemat Allah al‑gaaʼide fi bakaan al‑ibaada fi Gibʼuun.
Wa yigaddumu dahiiye muharraga le Allah ayyi yoom,fajur wa achiiye,fi l‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya.Wa da le yitabbugu kulla cheyy al‑maktuub fi kitaab al‑Tawraat al‑Allah amar beyah Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa maʼaahum Heemaan wa Yaduutuun wa l‑naas al‑aakhariin al‑azaloohum khaassatan le yachkuru Allah achaan rahmatah daayme ila l‑abad.
Wa Heemaan wa Yaduutuun humman dool yadurbu al‑burunji wa l‑nuggaara wa aalaat al‑musiikha le yachkuru al‑Rabb be khine.Wa awlaad Yaduutuun kamaan yaharsu al‑baab.
Wa baʼad da,khalaas kulla l‑chaʼab chatto wa ayyi waahid macha beetah.Wa Dawuud gabbal beetah le yibaarik aayiltah.
Wa wakit Dawuud saakin fi beetah,yoom waahid gaal le l‑nabi Naataan : Chiif,ana saakin fi beet jamiil hana hatab al‑arz.Wa laakin sanduug muʼaahadat Allah gaaʼid fi kheema bas. 
Wa Naataan radda le Dawuud wa gaal : Sawwi kulla cheyy al‑fi galbak achaan al‑Rabb maʼaak. 
Wa laakin fi l‑leele di,al‑Rabb kallam le Naataan wa gaal :
 Amchi guul le abdi Dawuud :‹ Daahu Allah gaal :“Da ma inta al‑tabni leyi beet al‑ana naskun foogah.
Achaan ana abadan ma sakant fi beet min yoom al‑ana maragt Bani Israaʼiil min Masir lahaddi l‑yoom.Wa laakin ana sirt maʼaahum wa sakant fi kheema.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan,ana sirt maʼa kulla Bani Israaʼiil.Wa ana abadan ma kallamt le waahid min hukkaam Bani Israaʼiil al‑ana amartuhum le yahkumu foog chaʼabi walla saʼaltah maala ma banaah leyi beet hana hatab al‑arz” ? ›
 Wa hassaʼ da,amchi guul le abdi Dawuud :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal :“Ana jibtak min sarhit al‑khanam achaan tabga kabiir hana chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa ana kunt maʼaak fi ayyi bakaan al‑inta macheet foogah wa gachcheet kulla udwaanak min giddaamak.Wa ana nisawwi usmak aali misil asaame hana l‑naas al‑kubaar al‑fi l‑ard.
Wa ana nanti bakaan le chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil wa nimakkinhum.Wa humman yaskunu fi l‑bakaan da bala khoof.Wa naas fasliin ma yazulmuuhum battaan misil awwal.
Wa min wakit al‑ana kallaft hukkaam fi chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil,ana najjeetak min kulla udwaanak.Wa nikhabbirak kadar ana Allah nisabbit beet aayiltak.
Wa wakit ayyaamak yikammulu,tumuut wa talhag abbahaatak.Wa ana naʼazil waahid min zurriiytak wa hu yabga waahid min awlaadak wa ana nisabbit mulkah.
Wa hu bas al‑yabni leyi beet wa ana nisabbit mulkah ila l‑abad.
Wa ana nabga leyah abu wa hu yabga leyi ibn.Wa ma nichiil minnah rahmati misil chiltaha min Chaawuul al‑hakam gablak.
Wa ana nisabbitah fi beeti wa fi mamlakati ila l‑abad wa mulkah kula yasbit ila l‑abad.”› 
Wa Naataan hajja le Dawuud be kulla l‑kalaam al‑gaalah leyah Allah fi l‑ruʼya di.
Wa l‑malik Dawuud dakhal fi l‑kheema fi hadarat Allah wa gaal : Ana yaatu,ya Allah Ilaahi ?Wa aayilti tisaawi chunu lahaddi tantiini daraja misil di ?
Wa da cheyy hayyiin saakit leek inta,ya Ilaahi,wa inta aahadt aayilat beeti ana abdak fi l‑mustakhbal.Wa sawweetni naadum muhimm,ya Allah Ilaahi.
Wa inta taʼarifni tamaam ana abdak.Wa nagdar nuguul chunu battaan fi l‑daraja al‑anteetni ?
Ya Allah !Be sababi ana abdak wa hasab niiytak,inta sawweet leyi al‑achya al‑kubaar dool le tiʼarrif kulla azamatak.
Ya Allah !Inta ma indak chabiih wa abadan ma fi ilaah illa inta.Wa da hasab kulla l‑kalaam al‑simiʼnaah.
Fiyah umma fi kulla l‑ard misil chaʼabak Bani Israaʼiil walla ?Ya Rabb,inta fadeethum wa sawweethum chaʼabak achaan usmak yabga aali.Wa inta sawweet ajaayib kubaar al‑bikhawwufu.Wa taradt al‑umam al‑aakhariin giddaam chaʼabak al‑inta fadeethum min balad Masir.
Wa sawweet chaʼabak Bani Israaʼiil le yabgo chaʼabak daayman.Ya Allah,inta bigiit leehum Ilaahhum.
 Wa hassaʼ da,ya Allah,al‑kalaam al‑gultah foogi ana abdak wa foog aayilti da,khalli yilhaggag ila l‑abad.Wa tammim kulla cheyy al‑gultah.
Wa khalli kalaamak yilhaggag wa be da,yimajjudu usmak ila l‑abad wa yuguulu :‹ Allah al‑Gaadir,hu bas Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil !› Wa khalli beeti ana abdak Dawuud yagood saabit giddaamak.
Achaan inta zaatak,ya Ilaahi,khabbartini ana abdak wa gult leyi :‹ Nisabbit beet aayiltak fi l‑muluk.› Wa fi chaan da,ana abdak ligiit al‑chajaaʼa wa gaddamt leek al‑sala di.
 Wa hassaʼ da,ya Allah,inta bas al‑Rabb wa aahadtini ana abdak be kulla l‑kheer da.
Wa khalaas hassaʼ da,inta chilt niiye tibaarik aayilti ana abdak le yamulku giddaamak ila l‑abad.Ya Allah,al‑naadum inta bas baaraktah,hu yalga baraka ila l‑abad. 
Wa baʼad da,Dawuud haarab al‑Filistiyiin wa annasar fooghum.Wa galaʼ minhum hillit Gaat wa l‑hillaal al‑taabʼiin leeha.
Wa hu annasar fi naas Muwaab.Wa baʼad da,naas balad Muwaab gaʼado tihit hukum Dawuud wa yikaffu miiri.
Wa Dawuud annasar fi Hadadʼaazar malik Suuba al‑fi Hamaat.Wa da,fi l‑wakit al‑Hadadʼaazar dawwar yiwassiʼ hukmah lahaddi mantagat bahar al‑Furaat.
Wa Dawuud galaʼ min Hadadʼaazar 1 000 arabaat harib wa karab 7 000 masaajiin min siyaad al‑kheel wa 20 000 askar maachiin be rijleehum.Wa hu gattaʼ araagiib hana l‑kheel al‑yukurru al‑arabaat wa khalla minhum illa 100 kheel.
Wa naas balad Araam al‑min Dimachkh jo fazaʼ le Hadadʼaazar malik Suuba.Wa laakin Dawuud katal min naas Araam 22 000 raajil.
Wa Dawuud khatta muhaafiziin fi l‑Araamiyiin al‑gaaʼidiin tihit hukum madiinat Dimachkh.Wa l‑Araamiyiin gaʼado tihit hukum Dawuud wa gaaʼidiin yikaffu miiri.Wa Allah anta al‑nasur le Dawuud fi ayyi bakaan al‑yamchi foogah.
Wa Dawuud galaʼ darag hana dahab min hurraas Hadadʼaazar wa waddaahum Uruchaliim.
Wa min Tibha wa Kuun hillaal Hadadʼaazar,Dawuud galaʼ nahaas katiir.Wa baʼadeen,wileedah Suleymaan sanaʼ be l‑nahaas da hoot kabiir wa amad wa muʼiddaat hana beet Allah.
Wa Tuuʼi malik balad Hamaat simiʼ kadar Dawuud annasar fi kulla askar Hadadʼaazar malik Suuba.
Khalaas rassal wileedah Haduraam le yisallimah wa yachkurah achaan Dawuud haarab Hadadʼaazar wa annasar foogah.Wa gubbaal da,Tuuʼi wa Hadadʼaazar humman udwaan.Wa Haduraam wileed Tuuʼi jaab le Dawuud muʼiddaat katiiriin hana dahab wa fudda wa nahaas.
Wa l‑muʼiddaat al‑jaabaahum leyah dool,Dawuud khassasaahum le Allah.Wa da misil awwal kula,hu khassas le Allah al‑fudda wa l‑dahab al‑chaalaahum min al‑umam,min al‑Adoomiyiin wa l‑Muwaabiyiin wa Bani Ammuun wa l‑Filistiyiin wa l‑Amaalikh.
Wa Abichaay wileedha le Saruuya annasar fi l‑Adoomiyiin wa katal minhum 18 000 raajil fi waadi al‑Mileh.
Wa Dawuud khatta muhaafiziin fi balad Adoom wa kulla l‑Adoomiyiin gaʼado tihit hukmah.Wa Allah yanti al‑nasur le Dawuud fi ayyi bakaan al‑yamchi foogah.
Wa Dawuud malak fi kulla balad Israaʼiil.Wa hakam fi kulla chaʼabah be l‑hagg wa l‑adaala.
Wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya,hu khaayid al‑deech wa Yahuuchafat wileed Akhiluud,hu kaatib al‑yizakkir al‑malik.
Wa Saduukh wileed Akhituub wa Abiimalik wileed Abiyaatar,humman dool rujaal diin wa Chawcha,hu kaatib hana l‑malik.
Wa Banaaya wileed Yahuuyadaʼ,hu masʼuul fi l‑Kiritiyiin wa l‑Filtiyiin wa humman dool hurraas al‑malik.Wa awlaad Dawuud,humman mumassiliin al‑malik.
Wa baʼad da,Nahaach malik Bani Ammuun maat.Wa wileedah Hanuun hakam fi badalah.
Wa Dawuud gaal : Nisawwi al‑kheer le Hanuun wileed Nahaach misil al‑kheer al‑abuuh sawwaah leyi. Wa Dawuud rassal masaaʼiilah le Hanuun achaan yikalwudu leyah fi moot abuuh.Wa humman wassalo fi balad Bani Ammuun le yikalwudu le Hanuun.
Wa laakin kubaaraat Bani Ammuun gaalo le Hanuun : Hal le yicharrif abuuk bas Dawuud rassal naasah achaan yikalwudu leek walla ?La,hu rassal naasah misil jawaasiis achaan yiʼakkudu min al‑balad wa baʼadeen yaju yichiiluuha. 
Wa khalaas,Hanuun karab masaaʼiil Dawuud wa zayyan duguunhum wa gattaʼ khulgaanhum min ale jaʼabaathum.Wa baʼad da,taradaahum.
Wa macho khabbaro Dawuud be l‑ihaana al‑ziyaada al‑bigat fi naasah.Wa hu rassal leehum naadum le yuguul leehum : Agoodu fi hillit Ariiha lahaddi duguunku yugummu wa baʼad da,taʼaalu. 
Wa naas Bani Ammuun irfo kadar humman bigo makruuhiin le Dawuud.Khalaas,Hanuun wa Bani Ammuun rassalo ziyaada min 30 000 kiilo hana fudda le yijannudu leehum murtazakha min Araam been al‑Nahreen wa min al‑Araamiyiin al‑min hillit Maʼaaka wa l‑min hillit Suuba wa arabaat harib wa siyaad kheel.
Wa humman ajjaro leehum 32 000 arabaat hana harib.Wa malik Maʼaaka wa naasah kula jo wa nazalo mugaabil hillit Miidba.Wa baʼad da,Bani Ammuun lammo wa marago min hillaalhum le l‑harib.
Wa wakit Dawuud simiʼ be l‑cheyy da,rassal Yuwaab maʼa kulla l‑askar al‑fahaliin didduhum.
Wa Bani Ammuun marago wa rasso le l‑harib fi khachum baab hillithum.Wa laakin al‑muluuk al‑jo leehum fazaʼ kamaan,gaʼado taraf fi l‑khala.
Wa Yuwaab chaaf kadar hu wa naasah waajib yihaarubu majmuuʼteen,al‑waahide waraahum wa l‑aakhara giddaamhum.Wa khalaas,hu azzal naasah al‑chudaad min Bani Israaʼiil wa gaabalaahum le l‑Araamiyiin.
Wa naasah al‑faddalo kamaan,kallaf beehum akhuuh Abichaay wa humman gaabalo Bani Ammuun.
Wa baʼad da,Yuwaab gaal le Abichaay : Kan al‑Araamiyiin khalabooni,inta taji tafzaʼni.Wa kan Bani Ammuun khalabook,ana naji nafzaʼak.
Chidd heelak,khalli nabgo rujaal !Nidaafuʼu le chaʼabna wa le l‑hillaal al‑Ilaahna antaahum leena.Wa khalli Allah yisawwi al‑cheyy al‑yidoorah. 
Wa khalaas,Yuwaab wa l‑askar al‑maʼaayah macho le yihaarubu al‑Araamiyiin al‑gaaʼidiin taraf fi l‑khala.Wa l‑Araamiyiin dool arrado minhum.
Wa wakit Bani Ammuun chaafo al‑Araamiyiin arrado,humman kula arrado min Abichaay akhu Yuwaab wa gabbalo hillithum.Wa khalaas,Yuwaab kula gabbal Uruchaliim.
Wa laakin wakit al‑Araamiyiin chaafo kadar Bani Israaʼiil annasaro fooghum,gammo rassalo naas achaan yilimmu kulla l‑Araamiyiin al‑gaaʼidiin khaadi le bahar al‑Furaat.Wa fi raashum Chufak khaayid deech Hadadʼaazar.
Wa wakit khabbarooh le Dawuud,hu kula lamma kulla askar Bani Israaʼiil wa gataʼ bahar al‑Urdun wa macha le yihaaribhum.Wa l‑Araamiyiin kula rasso gaabalooh le Dawuud wa haarabooh.
Laakin askar al‑Araamiyiin arrado min Bani Israaʼiil.Wa wakit humman muʼarridiin,Dawuud wa askarah katalo 7 000 naas min siyaad arabaat al‑harib wa katalo 40 000 askar.Wa katalo Chufak khaayid deech al‑Araamiyiin kula.
Wa wakit kulla l‑muluuk al‑gaaʼidiin tihit Hadadʼaazar irfo kadar Bani Israaʼiil annasaro fooghum,khalaas humman sawwo salaam maʼa Dawuud wa gaʼado tihit hukmah.Wa l‑Araamiyiin ma dawwaro yaju yafzaʼo Bani Ammuun battaan.
Wa fi l‑sana al‑jadiide,fi l‑wakit al‑muluuk yamchu al‑harib,Yuwaab khaayid al‑deech macha dammar balad Bani Ammuun wa haasar madiinat Rabba aasimathum.Wa laakin Dawuud gaʼad fi Uruchaliim.Wa Yuwaab chaal Rabba wa dammaraaha.
Wa baʼad da,Dawuud chaal al‑taaj min raas Milkuum sanam Bani Ammuun.Wa l‑taaj da hana dahab wa yawzin gariib 34 kiilo wa mujammal be hajar khaali.Wa khattooh fi raas Dawuud.Wa chaalo khaniime katiire min al‑madiina di.
Wa Dawuud chaal naas al‑madiina di wa khaddamaahum be gu khidme al‑yisawwuuha be munchaar wa khaazuug hana hadiid wa faas.Wa hu sawwa misil da fi kulla hillaal Bani Ammuun.Wa baʼad da,Dawuud wa kulla l‑chaʼab gabbalo fi Uruchaliim.
Wa baʼad da,gamma harib maʼa l‑Filistiyiin fi hillit Gaazar.Wa fi l‑bakaan da,Sibbakaay min hillit Huucha katal Siffaay min zurriiyit Raafa.Wa be misil da,al‑Filistiyiin anhazamo.
Wa battaan al‑harib bada maʼa l‑Filistiyiin.Wa Alihanaan wileed Yaʼiir katal Lahmi akhu Jaaluut min hillit Gaat wa uud haribtah takhiin misil murdaas al‑ligdaabe.
Wa battaan kula al‑harba bigat fi hillit Gaat.Wa fiyah raajil waahid tawiil wa asaabiʼ rijileenah wa iideenah sitte sitte wa kulluhum ke 24.Wa hu kula min zurriiyit Raafa.
Wa l‑raajil da ayyar Bani Israaʼiil.Wa khalaas,Yuunataan wileed Chimʼa akhu Dawuud katalah.
Wa kulla l‑rujaal dool min zurriiyit Raafa min hillit Gaat.Wa humman maato be iid Dawuud wa naasah.
Wa yoom waahid,Ibliis gamma didd Bani Israaʼiil wa lazza Dawuud le yahsibhum.
Wa khalaas,Dawuud gaal le Yuwaab wa le kubaaraat al‑chaʼab : Amchu ahsubu kulla Bani Israaʼiil min turaab Daan fi l‑munchaakh lahaddi Biir Sabʼa fi l‑wati.Wa gabbulu jiibu leyi adadhum achaan naʼarfah. 
Wa Yuwaab gaal : Khalli Allah yiziid adad al‑chaʼab miya marra,ya siidi al‑malik !Al‑naas dool ma kulluhum ke khaddaamiinak walla ?Wa maala inta ya siidi tidoor tisawwi al‑cheyy da ?Wa maala tilizz Bani Israaʼiil fi l‑khata da ? 
Wa laakin amur al‑malik bigi chadiid bilheen fi Yuwaab.Wa khalaas,Yuwaab gamma raakh fi kulla balad Israaʼiil le yahsib al‑chaʼab.Wa baʼad da,gabbal fi Uruchaliim.
Wa Yuwaab anta adad hisaab al‑chaʼab le l‑malik.Wa rujaal Bani Israaʼiil adadhum 1 100 000 askar al‑yaʼarfu harb al‑suyuuf wa min Bani Yahuuza kamaan 470 000.
Wa Yuwaab ma hasab al‑Laawiyiin wa la gabiilat Banyaamiin achaan hu jaʼal amur al‑malik muharram.
Wa l‑cheyy da,fasil giddaam al‑Rabb wa hu aakhab Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l‑Rabb : Ana sawweet zanib kabiir achaan hasabt al‑chaʼab.Wa laakin hassaʼ da,akhfir leyi khataayi ana abdak.Achaan ana sawweet al‑cheyy da misil naadum matmuus. 
Wa Allah hajja le l‑nabi Gaad al‑yichiif ruʼya le Dawuud wa gaal leyah :
 Amchi guul le Dawuud :‹ Daahu Allah gaal :“Ana nigaddim leek talaata nafar hana masaayib.Wa aʼazil minhum waahid wa ana ninazzilah.”› 
Wa khalaas,Gaad macha le Dawuud wa gaal leyah : Daahu Allah gaal :‹ Hassaʼ aʼazil al‑waba al‑tahmalah.
Inta tidoor talaata sana hana juuʼ fi baladak ?Aw tidoor tajri giddaam udwaanak wa humman yaturduuk le muddit talaata chahar ?Aw tidoor Allah yinazzil waba le muddit talaata yoom fi baladak wa malak Allah yijiib al‑kharaab fi kulla balad Israaʼiil ?› Hassaʼ da,fakkir wa ooriini al‑radd al‑nuguulah le Allah al‑rassalaani. 
Wa Dawuud gaal le Gaad : Ana addaayagt marra waahid.Khalli nagaʼ fi iid Allah achaan rahmatah wasiiʼe.Wa khalli ma nagaʼ fi iid insaan. 
Wa khalaas,Allah nazzal waba fi Israaʼiil.Wa maato 70 000 naas fi kulla balad Israaʼiil.
Wa l‑Rabb rassal malak fi Uruchaliim le yidammirha.Wa wakit al‑malak gaaʼid yidammir,Allah khalla al‑fasaala al‑awwal kharrar yisawwiiha.Wa gaal le l‑malak al‑mudammir : Khalaas kafa.Arfaʼ iidak ! Wa fi l‑wakit da,malak Allah gaaʼid fi madagg hana Urnaan al‑Yabuusi.
Wa Dawuud rafaʼ raasah wa chaaf malak Allah waagif ambeen al‑sama wa l‑ard wa seefah masluul fi iidah wa maddaah ale Uruchaliim.Khalaas fi l‑bakaan da,Dawuud wa l‑chuyuukh libso khulgaan al‑tooba wa wagaʼo be wujuuhhum fi l‑ard.
Wa Dawuud gaal le l‑Rabb : Ma ana bas amart yahsubu al‑chaʼab walla ?Wa ana bas aznabt wa sawweet al‑khata da.Laakin al‑chaʼab dool misil khanam bas,ma sawwo cheyy !Ya Allah Ilaahi !Aakhibni ana wa aayilti wa laakin ma tinazzil al‑waba da fi chaʼabak. 
Wa malak Allah gaal le Gaad : Amchi guul le Dawuud khalli yamchi yabni madbah le Allah fi l‑madagg hana Urnaan al‑Yabuusi. 
Wa khalaas Dawuud macha misil gaalah leyah Gaad be usum Allah.
Wa Urnaan gaaʼid yudugg al‑gameh fi l‑madagg.Wa wakit anlafat,chaaf al‑malak.Wa awlaadah al‑arbaʼa al‑maʼaayah arrado wa allabbado.
Wa Dawuud macha le Urnaan wa wakit Urnaan chaafah,hu marag min al‑madagg wa wagaʼ fi l‑ard wa sajad giddaam al‑malik.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Urnaan : Antiini bakaan al‑madagg da.Nidoor nabni foogah madbah le Allah achaan al‑waba da yagiif min al‑chaʼab.Antiini wa nikaffiik tamanah kaamil. 
Wa Urnaan radda le Dawuud wa gaal : Ya siidi al‑malik,chiil al‑madagg wa sawwi beyah ayyi cheyy al‑tidoorah.Chiif,ana nantiik al‑bagar le l‑dahiiye al‑muharraga wa l‑kaarro al‑yifajjukhu beyah al‑gameh yabga leek hatab wa l‑gameh kamaan yabga hadiiye hana dagiig.Ana nantiik kulla l‑achya dool. 
Wa laakin al‑malik Dawuud gaal le Urnaan : La,abadan !Ana nachriih minnak wa nikaffiik tamanah kaamil.Ma nidoor nichiil khumaamak wa nigaddimah le Allah wa be da,nigaddim dahiiye al‑ma nakhsar foogha. 
Wa khalaas,Dawuud chara min Urnaan al‑madagg be 600 jineeh hana dahab.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,Dawuud bana madbah le Allah wa gaddam foogah dahaaya muharragiin wa dahaaya salaama.Wa hu saʼal Allah wa Allah khibil suʼaalah wa nazzal naar min al‑sama le yiharrig al‑dahaaya al‑fi l‑madbah.
Wa baʼad da,Allah amar al‑malak yidakhkhil seefah fi beetah.
Wa fi l‑wakit da,Dawuud irif kadar Allah radda leyah fi suʼaalah fi l‑madagg hana Urnaan al‑Yabuusi.Wa min al‑yoom da,Dawuud gaaʼid yigaddim dahaaya fi l‑bakaan da.
Fi l‑wakit da,kheemat Allah al‑Muusa banaaha fi l‑sahara wa l‑madbah hana l‑dahaaya gaaʼidiin fi bakaan al‑ibaada fi Gibʼuun.
Wa laakin Dawuud ma gidir macha yasʼal al‑Rabb hinaak achaan hu khaaf min seef malak Allah.
Wa baʼad da,Dawuud gaal : Al‑bakaan da yabga beet Allah al‑Rabb.Wa l‑madbah al‑Bani Israaʼiil yigaddumu foogah dahaaya muharragiin. 
Wa Dawuud amar yilimmu kulla l‑ajaanib al‑gaaʼidiin fi balad Israaʼiil.Wa hu kallafaahum yanguchu hujaar le yabnu beehum beet Allah.
Wa Dawuud jahhaz hadiid katiir al‑yisawwu beyah masaamiir al‑biibaan wa hadiid al‑yirakkubu beyah al‑biibaan.Wa lamma nahaas katiir al‑ma yinwazin.
Wa lamma hatab al‑arz kula katiir ma yinhasib achaan naas min balad Seeda wa Suur jaabo hatab al‑arz le Dawuud be katara.
Wa Dawuud gaal : Wileedi Suleymaan lissaaʼ sabi wa ma indah irfe.Wa laakin al‑beet al‑nabnuuh le Allah waajib yihajju be kubrah wa jamaalah fi kulla l‑ard.Wa fi chaan da,ana zaati nijahhiz le buna al‑beet da. Wa be misil da,Dawuud jahhaz khumaam katiir gabul ma yumuut.
Wa Dawuud naadaah le wileedah Suleymaan wa amarah yabni beet le Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Dawuud gaal le Suleymaan : Ya wileedi !Zamaan ana zaati indi niiye nabni beet le Allah Ilaahi.
Wa laakin Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :‹ Inta daffagt damm katiir wakit al‑huruub al‑katiir.Inta ma tabni leyi beet achaan inta daffagt damm katiir fi l‑ard giddaami.
Wa laakin tijiib wileed wa hu yabga siid al‑raaha wa ana nanti leyah raaha min kulla udwaanah al‑mujaawiriinah.Wa l‑wileed da,yinaadu Suleymaan (maʼanaatah al‑salaam).Achaan nijiib al‑salaam wa l‑amaan fi balad Israaʼiil fi kulla muddit hayaatah.
Wa hu bas al‑yabni leyi beet.Wa ana nabga leyah abu wa hu yabga leyi ibn.Wa ana nisabbit mulkah fi Israaʼiil ila l‑abad.› 
Wa Dawuud gaal battaan : Hassaʼ da,ya wileedi,khalli Allah yukuun maʼaak.Wa be da,tanjah wa tagdar tabni beet Allah Ilaahak hasab al‑kalaam al‑hu gaalah foogak.
Wa khalli Allah yantiik agul wa fihim wakit yidarrijak malik fi Israaʼiil.Wa be da,tagdar tahfad wasaaya Allah Ilaahak.
Aywa,inta tanjah kan tahfad al‑gawaaniin wa l‑churuut al‑Allah amar beehum Muusa le Bani Israaʼiil.Abga chadiid wa fahal,ma takhaaf wa la tinbahit.
Chiif be taʼab ana jahhazt le buna beet Allah ziyaada min 3 malyuun kiilo hana dahab wa ziyaada min 30 malyuun kiilo hana fudda.Wa lammeet nahaas wa hadiid katiir ma yinwazin.Wa ana jahhazt al‑khachab wa l‑hajar wa inta tiziid foogah battaan.
Wa inta talga khaddaamiin katiiriin wa naggaachiin al‑hajar wa najjaariin al‑hatab.Wa talga battaan naas al‑induhum khibra fi ayyi khidme.
Wa hassaʼ indak al‑dahab wa l‑fudda wa l‑nahaas wa l‑hadiid bala adad.Gumm wa akhdim !Allah maʼaak. 
Wa Dawuud amar kulla masaaʼiil Bani Israaʼiil yisaaʼudu wileedah Suleymaan.
Wa gaal le l‑masaaʼiil : Allah Ilaahku ma yukuun maʼaaku walla ?Wa ma antaaku al‑raaha min kulli jiihe ?Achaan Allah sallam leyi kulla sukkaan al‑balad di fi iideeni.Wa hassaʼ hi gaaʼide tihit Allah wa chaʼabah.
Hassaʼ da,gummu be kulla guluubku wa gudritku le titaabuʼu Allah Ilaahku.Gummu wa abnu beet mukhaddas le Allah Ilaahku le tijiibu sanduug muʼaahadat Allah wa l‑muʼiddaat al‑mukhassasiin le Allah fi l‑beet al‑tabnuuh leyah. 
Wa wakit Dawuud bigi chaayib marra waahid wa chibiʼ min al‑dunya,darraj wileedah Suleymaan malik fi Israaʼiil.
Wa lamma kulla kubaaraat Bani Israaʼiil wa rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Laawiyiin.
Wa hasabo al‑Laawiyiin al‑umurhum 30 sana wa foog wa adadhum bigi 38 000 raajil.
Wa Dawuud khatta minhum 24 000 le yuguudu al‑khidme hana beet Allah wa 6 000 kamaan muraakhibiin wa hukkaam.
Wa khatta 4 000 haraasa al‑yaharsu al‑biibaan wa 4 000 le yachkuru Allah be aalaat al‑musiikha al‑hu sawwaahum le yachkuru beehum.
Wa Dawuud gassam al‑Laawiyiin be majmuuʼaat ale hasab iyaal Laawi wa humman Girchuun wa Gahaat wa Maraari.
Wa awlaad Girchuun humman Laʼdaan wa Chimʼi.
Wa awlaad Laʼdaan humman talaata,al‑kabiir Yahiyiil wa Zitaam wa Yuwiil.
Wa Chimʼi kula indah talaata awlaad wa humman Chaluumit wa Haziyiil wa Harraan.Humman dool kubaaraat aayilat Laʼdaan.
Wa Chimʼi indah arbaʼa awlaad aakhariin wa humman Yahat wa Ziina wa Yaʼuuch wa Bariiʼa.
Wa Yahat hu bas al‑kabiir wa Ziiza al‑taani.Wa laakin Yaʼuuch wa Bariiʼa ma jaabo awlaad katiir wa be da,humman lammo wa bigo aayila waahide achaan yisawwu khidme waahide.
Wa Gahaat indah arbaʼa awlaad wa humman Amraam wa Yishaar wa Habruun wa Uzziyiil.
Wa awlaad Amraam humman Haaruun wa Muusa.Wa Haaruun azalooh hu wa iyaalah le yabgo mukhassasiin wa yisawwi khidmit Allah fi l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas marra waahid,ila l‑abad.Wa yiharrugu bakhuur giddaam Allah wa yisawwu khidmit Allah wa yibaaruku al‑naas be usum Allah ila l‑abad.
Wa Muusa hu abd Allah,iyaalah hasaboohum maʼa gabiilat Laawi.
Wa awlaad Muusa humman Girchuum wa Aliʼaazar.
Wa min awlaad Girchuum,Chabuwiil al‑kabiir.
Wa Aliʼaazar wilid wileed waahid bas wa hu Rahabya wa hu masʼuul.Wa Rahabya wilid iyaal katiiriin marra waahid.
Wa min awlaad Yishaar,Chaluumit al‑kabiir.
Wa awlaad Habruun humman Yariiya al‑kabiir wa Amarya al‑taani wa Yahaziyiil al‑taalit wa Yakhmaʼaam al‑raabiʼ.
Wa awlaad Uzziyiil humman Miika al‑kabiir wa Yichiiya al‑taani.
Wa awlaad Maraari humman Mahli wa Muuchi.Wa awlaad Mahli humman Aliʼaazar wa Khiich.
Wa Aliʼaazar maat ma indah wileed.Wa laakin indah banaat wa akhwaanhum iyaal immuhum Khiich akhadoohum.
Wa Muuchi wilid awlaad talaata wa humman Mahli wa Idar wa Yarimuut.
Wa kulla l‑naas dool min gabiilat Laawi wa ayyi waahid kabiir fi aayiltah.Wa hasaboohum waahid be waahid wa asaameehum maktuubiin fi l‑daftar.Wa min umur hana 20 sana wa foog,humman mukallafiin be khidmit beet Allah.
Achaan Dawuud gaal : Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil anta al‑raaha le chaʼabah.Wa hassaʼ,hu yaskun ila l‑abad fi Uruchaliim.
Wa be misil da,al‑Laawiyiin ma yangulu battaan kheemat al‑ibaada wa kulla muʼiddaat al‑khidme. 
Wa hasab al‑kalaam al‑aakhir hana Dawuud,al‑Laawiyiin hasaboohum min umur 20 sana wa foog.
Wa l‑Laawiyiin gaaʼidiin tihit zurriiyit Haaruun fi khidmit beet Allah.Wa l‑Laawiyiin humman mukallafiin be l‑fadaay wa l‑khuraf wa tihaarat kulla achya al‑mukhaddasiin.Wa yakhdumu fi khidmit beet Allah.
Wa yijahhuzu al‑khubza al‑yigaddumuuha le Allah wa l‑hadaaya hana l‑dagiig wa l‑khubza bala tawwaara wa l‑kaʼak al‑sallalo be dihin wa kaʼak aakhar.Wa battaan yifakkuru fi l‑miizaan al‑yikiilu wa l‑yigaawusu beyah.
Wa l‑mukallafiin dool yahdaro kulli sabaah wa kulli achiiye le yahmudu wa yachkuru Allah.
Wa yigaddumu le Allah kulla l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin hana kulli yoom al‑sabt wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa kulli iid.Wa da hasab al‑adad al‑muhaddad leehum fi l‑chariiʼa al‑humman taabʼiin leeha daayman giddaam Allah.
Wa yahfado kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ wa l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas wa yisaaʼudu akhwaanhum zurriiyit Haaruun fi khidmit beet Allah.
Wa gassamo zurriiyit Haaruun fi majmuuʼaat.Wa awlaad Haaruun humman Nadaab wa Abiihu wa Aliʼaazar wa Itamaar.
Wa Nadaab wa Abiihu maato gubbaal abuuhum wa ma jaabo awlaad.Wa fi chaan da,khidmit rujaal al‑diin kallafo beeha Aliʼaazar wa Itamaar.
Wa be musaaʼadat Saduukh al‑min zurriiyit Aliʼaazar wa Akhiimalik al‑min zurriiyit Itamaar,Dawuud gassam zurriiyit Haaruun fi majmuuʼaat hasab khidmithum al‑kallafoohum beeha.
Wa laakin zurriiyit Aliʼaazar indaha rujaal ziyaada min zurriiyit Itamaar.Wa achaan da bas,gassamo zurriiyit Aliʼaazar ale 16 majmuuʼa wa zurriiyit Itamaar ale 8 majmuuʼa.Wa ayyi majmuuʼa indaha kabiir aayilitha.
Wa l‑gassimiin da bigi be amʼiyeedaat.Wa da,achaan kubaaraat hana l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas wa kubaaraat al‑Rabb binlagu fi zurriiyit Aliʼaazar wa zurriiyit Itamaar kula.
Wa Chamaʼya wileed Nataniil hu al‑kaatib min al‑Laawiyiin.Wa hu katab asaameehum giddaam al‑malik wa giddaam al‑kubaaraat wa giddaam Saduukh raajil al‑diin wa giddaam Akhiimalik wileed Abiyaatar wa giddaam kubaaraat aayilaat rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Laawiyiin.Wa kan le gabiilat Aliʼaazar,yisawwu amʼiyeedaat marrateen wa baʼad da,le gabiilat Itamaar,yisawwuuha marra waahide bas.
Wa daahu asaame kubaaraat al‑majmuuʼaat al‑azaloohum be amʼiyeedaat.Wa l‑amʼiyeedaat al‑awwal wagaʼat le Yuyaaribwa l‑taani le Yadaʼya
wa l‑taalit le Hariimwa l‑raabiʼ le Saʼuriim
wa l‑khaamis le Malkiiyawa l‑saadis le Miyaamiin
wa l‑saabiʼ le Hagguuswa l‑taamin le Abiiya
wa l‑taasiʼ le Yachuuʼwa l‑aachir le Chakanya
wa l‑ihdaachar le Alyaachibwa l‑atnaachar le Yakhiim
wa l‑talaataachar le Huffawa l‑arbaʼtaachar le Yachbaab
wa l‑khamistaachar le Bilgawa l‑sittaachar le Immiir
wa l‑sabaʼtaachar le Hiziirwa l‑tamaantaachar le Hafisiis
wa l‑tisaʼtaachar le Fatahyawa l‑ichriin le Hizgiyaal
wa l‑waahid wa ichriin le Yaakiinwa l‑itneen wa ichriin le Gaamuul
wa l‑talaata wa ichriin le Dalaayawa l‑arbaʼa wa ichriin le Maʼazya.
Wa be misil da,al‑majmuuʼaat dool kallafoohum be khidmithum fi beet Allah.Wa da,hasab al‑churuut al‑antaahum leehum jidduhum Haaruun misil Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil amarah beyah.
Wa daahu kubaaraat min zurriiyit al‑Laawiyiin al‑faddalo.Min awlaad Amraam,Chubayiilwa min awlaad Chubayiil,Yahadya.
Wa min zurriiyit Rahabya,Yichiiya hu al‑kabiir fi aayiltah.
Wa min zurriiyit Yishaar,Chalumuutwa min awlaad Chalumuut,Yahat.
Wa awlaad Hibruun,humman Yariiya al‑awwal wa Amarya al‑taani wa Yahaziyiil al‑taalit wa Yakhmaʼaam al‑raabiʼ.
Wa wileed Uzziyiil hu Miika wa min awlaad Miika,Chamiir.
Wa akhu Miika hu Yichiiya wa min awlaad Yichiiya,Zakariiya.
Wa awlaad Maraari humman Mahli wa Muuchi wa Yaʼaziiya.
Wa iyaal iyaalah le Maraari al‑min wileedah Yaʼaziiya humman Chuham wa Zakkuur wa Ibri.
Wa min Mahli,Aliʼaazar al‑ma jaab awlaad.
Wa min Khiich,Yarhamiil.
Wa awlaad Muuchi humman Mahli wa Idar wa Yarimuut.Wa kulla l‑naas dool min zurriiyit Laawi wa ayyi waahid kabiir fi aayiltah.
Wa misil akhwaanhum min zurriiyit Haaruun,humman kula sawwo amʼiyeedaat giddaam al‑malik Dawuud wa Saduukh wa Akhiimalik wa kubaaraat aayilaat rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Laawiyiin.Wa humman sawwo misil da,sawa sawa le kulla l‑aayilaat kan hana akhu kabiir walla akhu sakhayyar kula.
Wa be musaaʼadat kubaaraat beet al‑ibaada,Dawuud azal zurriiyit Asaaf wa Heemaan wa Yaduutuun al‑yikhannu be kalaam Allah be aalaat al‑musiikha misil amsibeybe wa l‑jigindiiye wa l‑nuggaara.Wa daahu al‑naas al‑sajjaloohum wa kallafoohum be l‑khidme di.
Min awlaad Asaaf,Zakkuur wa Yuusuf wa Natanya wa Asariila.Wa humman gaaʼidiin tihit muraakhabat abuuhum Asaaf al‑yikhanni be kalaam Allah hasab amur al‑malik.
Min iyaal Yaduutuun,Gadaalya wa Saari wa Yachaʼya wa Chimʼi wa Hachabya wa Mattitya kulluhum ke sitte.Wa humman gaaʼidiin tihit muraakhabat abuuhum Yaduutuun al‑yikhanni be kalaam Allah wa yachkurah wa yahmudah be daribiin al‑jigindiiye.
Min iyaal Heemaan,Bukhiiya wa Mattanya wa Uzziyiil wa Chabuwiil wa Yarimuut wa Hananya wa Hanaani wa Aliyaata wa Giddaalti wa Rumaamti Azar wa Yuchbakhaacha wa Malluuti wa Hutiir wa Mahaziyuut.
Wa kulla l‑naas dool,humman min zurriiyit Heemaan al‑nabi al‑yichiif ruʼya le l‑malik.Hu yihajji le l‑malik be kulla cheyy al‑Rabb yibayyinah leyah le yiwassif gudurtah.Wa l‑Rabb antaah le Heemaan arbaʼtaachar awlaad wa talaata banaat.
Wa tihit muraakhabat abuuhum,humman yikhannu fi beet Allah be aalaat al‑musiikha misil al‑nuggaara wa l‑jigindiiye wa amsibeybe.Wa Asaaf wa Yaduutuun wa Heemaan humman yisawwu al‑khidme di tihit muraakhabat al‑malik.
Wa l‑Laawiyiin wa akhwaanhum al‑mudarrabiin fi l‑khine le Allah adadhum 288 kulluhum mutakhassisiin.
Wa le yantuuhum khidmithum,humman sawwo amʼiyeedaat le l‑kubaar wa l‑dugaag wa le l‑muʼallimiin wa l‑talaamiiz.
Wa l‑amʼiyeedaat al‑awwal sawwooha wagaʼat le Yuusuf wileed Asaaf.Wa l‑taani le Gadaalya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑taalit le Zakkuur wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑raabiʼ le Yisar wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑khaamis le Natanya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑saadis le Bukhiiya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑saabiʼ le Yasariila wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑taamin le Yachaʼya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑taasiʼ le Mattanya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑aachir le Chimʼi wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑ihdaachar le Azariil wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑atnaachar le Hachabya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑talaataachar le Chubayiil wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑arbaʼtaachar le Mattitya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑khamistaachar le Yarimuut wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑sittaachar le Hananya wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑sabaʼtaachar le Yuchbakhaacha wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑tamaantaachar le Hanaani wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑tisaʼtaachar le Malluuti wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑ichriin le Aliyaata wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑waahid wa ichriin le Hutiir wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑itneen wa ichriin le Giddaalti wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑talaata wa ichriin le Mahaziyuut wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa l‑arbaʼa wa ichriin le Rumaamti Azar wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah kulluhum 12.
Wa majmuuʼaat al‑hurraas hana l‑biibaan,chaaloohum min zurriiyit Khuurah wa fi raashum Machalaamya wileed Khuuri min zurriiyit Asaaf.
Wa awlaad Machalaamya humman Zakariiya al‑bikir wa Yadiyaʼiil al‑taani wa Zabadya al‑taalit wa Yatniyiil al‑raabiʼ
wa Ilaam al‑khaamis wa Yuuhanaan al‑saadis wa Aliyuʼnaay al‑saabiʼ.
Wa awlaad Ubeed Adoom humman Chamaʼya al‑bikir wa Yahuzabaad al‑taani wa Yuwaakh al‑taalit wa Saakar al‑raabiʼ wa Nataniil al‑khaamis
wa Amiyiil al‑saadis wa Yassaakar al‑saabiʼ wa Faʼullataay al‑taamin,achaan al‑Rabb baarak Ubeed Adoom.
Wa Chamaʼya al‑bikir jaab iyaal al‑bigo mumassiliin aayilaathum achaan humman rujaal furraas wa gaadriin.
Wa awlaad Chamaʼya humman Utni wa Rafayiil wa Ubeed wa Alzabad wa akhwaanhum al‑fahaliin Aliihu wa Samakya.
Wa kulla l‑naas dool min zurriiyit Ubeed Adoom maʼa awlaadhum wa aayilaathum,kulluhum ke rujaal fahaliin wa gaadriin fi khidmithum wa adadhum 62.
Wa majmuuʼat Machalaamya be iyaalah wa akhwaanah adadhum 18 kulluhum rujaal fahaliin.
Wa Huusa al‑min zurriiyit Maraari indah awlaad.Wa wileedah Chimri ma bikir abuuh wa laakin khattaah kabiir al‑aayila.
Wa Hilkhiiya wileedah al‑taani wa Tabalya al‑taalit wa Zakariiya al‑raabiʼ.Wa kulla awlaad Huusa wa akhwaan adadhum 13.
Wa kulla rujaal hana majmuuʼaat al‑hurraas wa kubaaraathum gaaʼidiin yakhdumu sawa fi beet Allah.
Wa humman gassamo haraasat al‑biibaan be amʼiyeedaat,min al‑kubaar le l‑dugaag hasab aayilaathum.
Wa l‑amʼiyeedaat le haraasat al‑baab al‑sabhaani wagaʼat fi Chalamya.Wa l‑amʼiyeedaat le haraasat al‑baab al‑munchaakhi wagaʼ le wileedah Zakariiya al‑mustachaar al‑indah agul.
Wa Ubeed Adoom hafad al‑baab al‑watiyaani wa iyaalah kamaan hafado al‑makhaazin.
Wa Chuffim wa Huusa humman hafado al‑baab al‑kharbaani wa l‑baab al‑binaaduuh Challaka hu al‑faatih ale derib al‑taaliʼ foog.Wa daahu kikkeef nazzamo al‑haraasa.
Fi l‑baab al‑sabhaani,sitte Laawiyiin fi l‑yoom wa fi l‑baab al‑munchaakhi arbaʼa Laawiyiin fi l‑yoom wa fi l‑baab al‑watiyaani arbaʼa Laawiyiin fi l‑yoom wa le l‑makhaazin kamaan itneen itneen fi bakaanaat chig chig.
Wa le l‑beet al‑kharbaani arbaʼa rujaal hafado al‑derib wa itneen kamaan hafado al‑beet zaatah.
Wa dool majmuuʼaat al‑haraasa al‑chaaloohum min zurriiyit Khuurah wa Maraari.
Wa min al‑Laawiyiin kallafo Akhiiya be l‑makhaazin hana beet Allah wa be l‑makhaazin hana l‑muʼiddaat al‑mukhassasiin le Allah.
Wa awlaad Laʼdaan min zurriiyit Girchuun kabiir aayilaathum Yahiyiil
wa awlaad Yahiyiil humman Zitaam wa akhuuh Yuwiil.Wa humman dool kallafoohum be makhaazin beet Allah.
Wa kan le zurriiyit Amraam wa Yishaar wa Habruun wa Uzziyiil,
Chabuwiil min zurriiyit Girchuum wileed Muusa,hu bas al‑muraakhib al‑aamm fi l‑makhaazin dool.
Wa min aayiltah fi naas min zurriiyit Aliʼaazar.Wa Aliʼaazar da hu akhu Girchuum wileed Rahabyawa Rahabya wileed Aliʼaazarwa Yachaʼya wileed Rahabyawa Yuuraam wileed Yachaʼyawa Zikri wileed Yuuraamwa Chaluumit wileed Zikri.
Wa Chaluumit wa akhwaanah kallafoohum be l‑makhaazin hana l‑muʼiddaat al‑khassasoohum al‑malik Dawuud wa kubaaraat al‑aayilaat wa khuyyaad al‑aalaaf wa khuyyaad al‑miyaat wa kubaaraat al‑askar al‑aakhariin.
Wa l‑kubaaraat dool khassaso min al‑khaniime al‑chaalooha fi l‑harib le yiʼaddulu beeha beet Allah.
Wa Chaluumit wa akhwaanah masʼuuliin min kulla l‑muʼiddaat al‑mukhaddasiin al‑khassasoohum Samuwiil al‑nabi wa Chaawuul wileed Khiich wa Abniir wileed Niir wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya.Wa kulla achya al‑khassasoohum.
Min zurriiyit Yishaar,Kananya wa awlaadah kallafoohum muraakhibiin wa gudiya be khidmit chuʼuun al‑khaarijiiye hana Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa min zurriiyit Habruun,Hachabya wa 1 700 rujaal fahaliin kallafoohum be muraakhabat kulla balad Israaʼiil min jiihat al‑kharib ale Urdun.Wa kallafoohum be kulla l‑khidme al‑tukhuss Allah wa l‑malik.
Wa Yariiya hu bas kabiirhum le naas zurriiyit Habruun.Wa fi sanit 40 hana hukum al‑malik Dawuud,fattacho gurmit aayilaathum.Wa ligo minhum rujaal furraas fi hillit Yaʼziir min balad Gilʼaad.
Wa l‑malik Dawuud chaal 2 700 rujaal fahaliin min zurriiyit Yariiya wa kulluhum kubaaraat al‑aayilaat.Wa kallaf beehum gabiilat Raʼuubiin wa Gaad wa nuss gabiilat Manassa fi kulla l‑khidme al‑tukhuss al‑Rabb wa l‑malik.
Wa daahu naas min Bani Israaʼiil al‑yakhdumu le l‑malik.Wa humman kubaaraat al‑aayilaat wa khuyyaad al‑aalaaf wa khuyyaad al‑miyaat wa l‑muraakhibiin.Wa kulla khidmithum tukhuss al‑majmuuʼaat al‑askariiye al‑yakhdumu be amkaaba ayyi chahar fi tuul al‑sana.Wa ayyi majmuuʼa indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑awwalaaniiye hana l‑chahar al‑awwal,hu Yachabʼaam wileed Zabdiyiil.Majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa hu min zurriiyit Faaris wa khaayid kulla l‑askar hana l‑chahar al‑awwal.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑taaniye hana l‑chahar al‑taani,hu Duudaay min hillit Akhuukh.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil wa l‑yuguudhum hu Mikhluut.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑taalta hana l‑chahar al‑taalit,hu Banaaya wileed Yahuuyadaʼ raajil diin al‑kabiir.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa Banaaya hu raajil faaris been al‑khuyyaad al‑talaatiin wa hu bas kabiirhum.Wa wileedah Amizabaad,hu kula fi l‑majmuuʼa di.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑raabʼe hana l‑chahar al‑raabiʼ,hu Asaahiil akhu Yuwaab wa baʼadah kamaan,wileedah Zabadya.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑khaamse hana l‑chahar al‑khaamis,hu Chamhuut al‑min hillit Yizra.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑saadse hana l‑chahar al‑saadis,hu Iira wileed Ikheech min hillit Takhuuʼa.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑saabʼe hana l‑chahar al‑saabiʼ,hu Haalas min hillit Faluun wa hu min gabiilat Afraayim.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑taamne hana l‑chahar al‑taamin,hu Sibbakaay min hillit Huucha wa hu min zurriiyit Zaarah.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑taasʼe hana l‑chahar al‑taasiʼ,hu Abiʼaazar min hillit Anatuut wa hu min gabiilat Banyaamiin.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑aachre hana l‑chahar al‑aachir,hu Mahraay min hillit Natuufa wa hu min zurriiyit Zaarah.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑ihdaachar hana chahri ihdaachar,hu Banaaya min hillit Firʼatuun wa hu min gabiilat Afraayim.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Wa khaayid al‑majmuuʼa al‑atnaachar hana chahri atnaachar,hu Haldaay min hillit Natuufa wa hu min khachum beet Utniyiil.Wa majmuuʼtah indaha 24 000 raajil.
Daahu kubaaraat gabaayil Bani Israaʼiil.Min gabiilat Raʼuubiin,kabiirhum Aliʼaazar wileed Zikriwa min gabiilat Chimʼuun,kabiirhum Chafatya wileed Maʼaaka
wa min gabiilat Laawi,kabiirhum Hachabya wileed Khamuwiilwa min zurriiyit Haaruun,kabiirhum Saduukh
wa min gabiilat Yahuuza,kabiirhum Aliihu min akhwaan Dawuudwa min gabiilat Yassaakar,kabiirhum Umri wileed Mikaayiil
wa min gabiilat Zabuluun,kabiirhum Yichmaʼya wileed Ubadyawa min gabiilat Naftaali,kabiirhum Yarimuut wileed Azriyiil
wa min gabiilat Afraayim kabiirhum,Huuchaʼ wileed Azazyawa min nuss gabiilat Manassa al‑fi l‑kharib,kabiirhum Yuwiil wileed Fadaaya
wa min nuss gabiilat Manassa al‑fi Gilʼaad fi l‑sabaah,kabiirhum Yiddu wileed Zakariiyawa min gabiilat Banyaamiin,Yaʼsiyiil wileed Abniir
wa min gabiilat Daan,kabiirhum Azariil wileed Yaruuhaam.Wa dool kubaaraat gabaayil Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Dawuud ma hasab al‑subyaan al‑umurhum angas min 20 sana achaan Allah gaal yisawwi Bani Israaʼiil yabgo katiiriin misil nujuum al‑sama.
Wa Yuwaab wileedha le Saruuya bada al‑hisaab wa laakin ma kammalah achaan Allah khidib le Bani Israaʼiil.Wa be sabab da,adad al‑chaʼab ma maktuub fi kitaab taariikh al‑malik Dawuud.
Wa Azmaawat wileed Adiyiil masʼuul fi makhaazin al‑malik.Wa Yuunataan wileed Uzziiya masʼuul fi l‑makhaazin al‑fi l‑kadaade wa l‑mudun wa l‑hillaal wa fi buyuut al‑tuwaal hana l‑muraakhaba kula.
Wa Azri wileed Kaluub masʼuul fi kulla l‑khaddaamiin al‑yahartu fi l‑ziraaʼa.
Wa Chimʼi al‑min hillit al‑Raama masʼuul fi jineenaat al‑inab.Wa Zabdi al‑min hillit Chafaam masʼuul fi l‑makhaazin hana l‑khamar al‑yamrug min al‑inab da.
Wa Baʼal Hanaan al‑min hillit Gadiira masʼuul fi l‑jineenaat al‑zaytuun wa l‑tiin al‑fi l‑sahale.Wa Yuwaach masʼuul fi l‑makhaazin hana dihin.
Wa Chirtaay al‑min hillit Chaaruun masʼuul fi l‑bagar al‑yasraho fi l‑marʼa al‑fi kadaadit Chaaruun.Wa Chaafaat wileed Adlaay masʼuul fi l‑bagar al‑yasraho fi l‑wudyaan.
Wa Ubiil al‑min zurriiyit Ismaaʼiil masʼuul fi l‑jumaal.Wa Yahadya al‑min hillit Miruunuut masʼuul fi l‑hamiir.
Wa Yaziiz al‑min Bani Haajar masʼuul fi door al‑khanam.Wa kulla l‑naas dool masaaʼiil fi maal al‑malik Dawuud.
Wa Yuunataan immah le Dawuud,hu mustachaar wa raajil faahim wa kaatib al‑malik.Wa Yahiyiil wileed Hakmuuni,hu mukallaf be tarbiyat awlaad al‑malik.
Wa Akhituufal,hu kula mustachaar al‑malik.Wa Huuchaay al‑min hillit Arki,hu rafiig al‑malik.
Wa baʼad Akhituufal,jo Yahuuyadaʼ wileed Banaaya wa Abiyaatar.Wa Yuwaab,hu khaayid hana deech al‑malik.
Wa Dawuud lamma kulla kubaaraat Bani Israaʼiil fi Uruchaliim.Wa dool kulla kubaaraat al‑gabaayil wa kubaaraat al‑majmuuʼaat al‑yakhdumu le l‑malik wa khuyyaad al‑aalaaf wa khuyyaad al‑miyaat wa l‑masaaʼiil fi kulla l‑khumaam wa l‑bahaayim hana l‑malik wa awlaadah.Wa lamma kulla l‑khaddaamiin wa kulla l‑fahaliin wa l‑rujaal al‑furraas.
Wa l‑malik Dawuud gamma foog be tuulah wa gaal : Asmaʼooni,ya akhwaani wa chaʼabi.Ana indi niiye le nabni beet al‑raaha le sanduug muʼaahadat Allah.Wa da l‑bakaan al‑Ilaahna yukhutt foogah rijileenah.Wa ana jaahiz le l‑buna da.
Wa laakin al‑Rabb gaal leyi :‹ Inta ma tabni leyi beet achaan inta raajil muhaarib wa daffagt damm katiir. ›
Wa laakin Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil azalaani min kulla aayilat abuuyi achaan nahkim fi Israaʼiil.Achaan hu azal gabiilat Yahuuza tahkim wa min gabiilat Yahuuza hu azal aayilat abuuyi wa min kulla akhwaani iyaal abuuyi hu azalni ana le nabga malik fi kulla Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Allah antaani iyaal katiiriin wa minhum azal wileedi Suleymaan wa khattaah fi kursi al‑malik hana mamlakat Allah fi Israaʼiil.
Wa gaal leyi :‹ Wileedak Suleymaan bas yabni leyi beet be fadaay.Achaan ana azaltah le yabga leyi ibni wa ana nabga leyah abuuh.
Wa nisabbit mulkah ila l‑abad kan hu yahfad wa yitabbig wasiiyaati wa churuuti misil al‑yoom. ›
 Wa hassaʼ da,ya akhwaani !Giddaam kulla Bani Israaʼiil jamaaʼat Allah wa giddaam Ilaahna Allah al‑gaaʼid yasmaʼku,ana nuguul leeku :‹ Ahfado wa taabuʼu wasaaya Allah Ilaahku wa intu tawrusu al‑balad al‑adiile di wa tikhalluuha warasa le iyaalku baʼadku ila l‑abad. ›
 Wa inta,ya wileedi Suleymaan,aʼarif Allah Rabb abuuk wa aʼabudah be kulla galbak wa be niiye mukhlisa.Achaan Allah yakchif galib al‑insaan wa yaʼarif al‑fikir hana ayyi naadum.Wa kan inta tifattichah,hu yikhalliik talgaah.Wa laakin kan abeetah kamaan,hu kula yaabaak ila l‑abad.
Wa hassaʼ,chiif !Daahu Allah azalak le tabni leyah beet wa l‑beet da,yabga leyah bakaan mukhaddas.Chidd heelak wa abda al‑khidme. 
Wa khalaas,Dawuud antaah le wileedah Suleymaan al‑rasim hana l‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas.Wa da khurfit al‑madkhal wa l‑buyuut wa l‑makhaazin wa l‑khuraf al‑foog wa l‑khuraf al‑daakhal wa beet sanduug al‑muʼaahada.
Wa antaah rasim hana kulla cheyy al‑indah fi fikrah al‑yidoor yabniih,misil al‑fadaay hana beet Allah wa kulla l‑buyuut al‑yihawwugu al‑fadaay wa l‑makhaazin hana beet al‑Rabb wa l‑makhaazin hana l‑muʼiddaat al‑mukhassasiin.
Wa antaah asaame hana majmuuʼaat rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Laawiyiin wa kulla l‑khidme al‑tukhuss beet Allah wa kulla muʼiddaat al‑khidme hana beet Allah.
Wa wassafah wazin al‑dahab al‑waajib le l‑muʼiddaat al‑yasnaʼoohum be dahab wa wazin al‑fudda al‑waajib le l‑muʼiddaat al‑yasnaʼoohum be fudda.Wa da hasab al‑istiʼmaal hana ayyi cheyy.
Wa wassafah wazin hana l‑faanuus wa niiraanah al‑yasnaʼoohum be dahab wa wazin hana l‑faanuus wa niiraanah al‑yasnaʼoohum be fudda wa da hasab al‑istiʼmaal hana ayyi faanuus.
Wa wassafah wazin al‑dahab al‑yisawwu beyah taraabiiz al‑yigaddumu fooghum al‑khubza le Allah wa wazin al‑fudda al‑yisawwu beeha taraabiiz aakhariin.
Wa wassafah wazin hana l‑hadaayid al‑yisillu beehum al‑laham wa l‑kiisaan al‑yuruchchu beehum wa l‑abaariig al‑be dahab saafi.Wa wassafah wazin al‑dahab hana l‑kiisaan al‑be dahab wa wazin al‑fudda hana l‑kiisaan al‑be fudda.
Wa wassafah kula,al‑wazin hana l‑dahab al‑saafi al‑yisawwu beyah al‑mukhbar al‑yiharrugu foogah al‑bakhuur.Wa wassafah al‑rasim hana l‑araba al‑mukhassasa yaʼni sidaadit sanduug muʼaahadat Allah al‑gaaʼidiin foogha suurat makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin hana dahab al‑mumattitiin janaaheehum wa mukhattiyiin beehum al‑sanduug.
Wa Dawuud gaal : Wa da kulla maktuub hasab al‑rasim al‑Allah zaatah wassafaani le kulla l‑khidme di. 
Wa khalaas,Dawuud gaal le wileedah Suleymaan : Abga chadiid wa fahal wa abda al‑khidme.Ma takhaaf wa la tinbahit achaan al‑Rabb Allah Ilaahi gaaʼid maʼaak.Hu ma yikhalliik wa ma yaabaak lahaddi kumaalit kulla l‑khidme hana beet Allah.
Wa daahu,aʼarif majmuuʼaat rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Laawiyiin al‑yakhdumu fi kulla khidmit beet Allah.Wa maʼaak fi l‑khidme di,fi naas al‑induhum niiye mukhlisa wa malaaniin be khibra fi kulla l‑khidme.Wa l‑kubaaraat wa kulla l‑chaʼab yisawwu kulla cheyy al‑taamurhum. 
Wa l‑malik Dawuud gaal le kulla l‑chaʼab al‑lammiin : Al‑Rabb azal wileedi Suleymaan bas wa laakin hu lissaaʼ sabi wa ma indah irfe.Wa l‑khidme di,hi kabiire achaan al‑beet al‑mukhaddas da,ma yabnuuh le insaani bas laakin le Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa ana gammeet be kulla gudurti wa jahhazt le buna beet Ilaahi dahab le ayyi cheyy al‑yasnaʼooh be dahab wa fudda le ayyi cheyy al‑yasnaʼooh be fudda wa nahaas le ayyi cheyy al‑yasnaʼooh be nahaas wa hadiid le ayyi cheyy al‑yasnaʼooh be hadiid wa hatab le ayyi cheyy al‑yisawwuuh be hatab.Wa ana jahhazt hajar khaali al‑usmah agiig wa nafar aakhariin min al‑hujaar al‑khaaliyiin le yijammulu beehum.Wa hujaar khaaliyiin al‑loonhum zurug wa khudur wa battaan jahhazt rukhaam be katara.
Wa da achaan ana nihibb beet Ilaahi,nanti min al‑dahab wa l‑fudda al‑haggi halaali le beet Ilaahi.Wa da ziyaada fi l‑cheyy al‑jahhaztah le l‑beet al‑mukhaddas.
Ana nanti 100 000 kiilo hana dahab saafi wa 240 000 kiilo hana fudda saafi le yikhattu beyah daraadir al‑beet.
Wa kulla l‑dahab da le l‑achya al‑be dahab wa l‑fudda le l‑achya al‑be fudda al‑yisawwuuhum al‑sinaaʼiyiin le beet Allah.Wa yaatu minku al‑yoom be niiytah yijiib hadiiye le Allah ? 
Wa khalaas,kubaaraat al‑aayilaat wa kubaaraat gabaayil Bani Israaʼiil wa khuyyaad al‑aalaaf wa khuyyaad al‑miyaat wa masaaʼiil al‑malik jaabo hadaayaahum.
Wa humman anto le khidmit beet Allah 170 000 kiilo hana dahab wa 10 000 jineeh hana dahab wa 340 000 kiilo hana fudda wa gariib 600 000 kiilo hana nahaas wa ziyaada min 3 malyuun kiilo hana hadiid.
Wa humman al‑induhum fi buyuuthum hujaar khaaliyiin jaaboohum le makhazan hana beet Allah wa ammanoohum fi iid Yahiyiil al‑min gabiilat Girchuun.
Wa l‑chaʼab firho be l‑hadaaya dool achaan humman gaddamoohum be galib mukhlis le Allah.Wa l‑malik Dawuud kula firih farha chadiide.
Wa Dawuud chakar Allah giddaam kulla l‑chaʼab wa gaal : Ya Allah Ilaah jiddina Israaʼiil khalli yibaaruku daayman wa ila l‑abad.
Wa leek inta,ya Allah,al‑azama wa l‑gudra wa l‑jalaal wa l‑majd wa l‑nuur achaan kulla cheyy al‑fi l‑sama wa fi l‑ard,hanaak inta.Wa ya Allah,inta bas maalik fi kulla l‑makhluugiin.
Al‑khuna wa l‑majd yaju minnak wa inta bas al‑maalik fi kulla cheyy.Wa indak gudra wa izz wa inta bas al‑tikabbir wa tigawwi.
Wa hassaʼ,ya Ilaahna,nachkuruuk wa nahmudu usmak al‑Jaliil.
 Laakin ana ke yaatu ?Wa chaʼabi yisaawi chunu ?Wa kikkeef ligiina gudra le nigaddumu hadaaya misil dool ?Ayyi cheyy al‑indina jaayi minnak inta wa kulla cheyy al‑gaddamnaah leek,inta bas anteetna.
Wa aniina niʼiichu misil ajaanib wa diifaan giddaamak misil kulla juduudna.Wa hayaatna fi l‑dunya di misil dull al‑daha al‑zawwaal.Hal al‑dull indah acham yagood walla ?
 Ya Allah Ilaahna !Kulla l‑achya dool lammeenaahum be katara wa jahhaznaahum le nabnu leek beet le usmak al‑mukhaddas.Wa laakin kulla l‑achya dool jaayiin minnak wa hineeyak.
Wa ana naʼarif,ya Ilaahi,kadar inta takchif al‑fi l‑galib wa tihibb al‑adaala.Wa be niiye waahide,ana gaddamt leek kulla l‑achya dool.Wa hassaʼ,daahu chaʼabak lammo be farha wa gaaʼidiin yigaddumu leek be niiye waahide al‑hadaaya dool.
 Ya Allah Rabb juduudna Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub !Ahfad daayman al‑fikra hana gaddimiin al‑hadaaya di fi guluub chaʼabak.Wa sabbit guluubhum foogak.
Wa le wileedi Suleymaan da,antiih galib mukhlis le yahfad wasiiyaatak wa taʼliimak wa churuutak wa yitabbighum wa yabni al‑beet al‑mukhaddas al‑ana jahhazt leyah. 
Wa baʼad da,Dawuud gaal le kulla l‑chaʼab : Baaruku Allah Ilaahku. Wa kulla l‑chaʼab baarako Allah Rabb juduudhum.Wa dangaro wa sajado le Allah wa le l‑malik.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑taani min al‑yoom da,humman dabaho dahaaya wa gaddamo dahaaya muharragiin le Allah.Wa humman gaddamo 1 000 toor wa 1 000 kabich wa 1 000 hamal be hadaayaahum hana l‑charaab.Wa l‑dahaaya al‑gaddamoohum katiiriin lihgo le kulla Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,humman akalo wa chirbo giddaam Allah be farha kabiire.Wa le taani marra,humman chaalo Suleymaan wileed Dawuud wa masahooh wa darrajooh malik wa khassaso le Allah.Wa masaho Saduukh raajil diin kabiir.
Wa Suleymaan gaʼad fi kursi al‑muluk hana Allah wa bigi malik fi badal abuuh Dawuud.Wa hu gaaʼid yanjah wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil yikarrumuuh.
Wa kulla l‑kubaaraat wa l‑rujaal al‑fahaliin wa kulla l‑iyaal al‑aakhariin hana l‑malik Dawuud gaʼado tihit hukum Suleymaan.
Wa Allah sawwaah le Suleymaan aali marra waahid fi uyuun kulla Bani Israaʼiil wa anta azama le mamlakatah al‑abadan ma antaaha le ayyi malik al‑gablah fi balad Israaʼiil.
Wa Dawuud wileed Yassa hakam fi kulla balad Israaʼiil.
Wa muddit hukmah fi kulla balad Israaʼiil 40 sana.Hu hakam 7 sana fi Hibruun wa 33 sana fi Uruchaliim.
Wa maat wakit chayyab marra waahid wa chibiʼ min al‑dunya.Wa gabul mootah,hu aach fi khuna wa charaf.Wa khalaas,wileedah Suleymaan hakam fi badalah.
Wa kulla amal al‑malik Dawuud min al‑bidaaya le l‑nihaaya maktuub fi kutub al‑binaaduuhum Aʼmaal al‑nabi Samuwiil wa Aʼmaal al‑nabi Naataan wa Aʼmaal al‑nabi Gaad.
Wa l‑kutub dool,maktuub fooghum kulla taariikh mulkah wa faraasiiytah wa kulla cheyy al‑kaan foogah hu wa foog Bani Israaʼiil wa foog kulla mamaalik hana buldaan aakhariin.
Suleymaan wileed Dawuud sabbat mulkah wa Allah Ilaahah gaaʼid maʼaayah wa sawwaah aali.
Wa Suleymaan naada kulla Bani Israaʼiil khaassatan khuyyaad al‑aalaaf wa khuyyaad al‑miyaat wa l‑gudiya wa kulla kubaaraat Bani Israaʼiil wa dool kubaaraat al‑aayilaat.
Wa Suleymaan wa kulla l‑chaʼab macho fi bakaan al‑ibaada al‑fi hillit Gibʼuun achaan fi l‑bakaan da bas gaaʼide kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ hana l‑Rabb.Wa di bas al‑kheema al‑sawwaaha Muusa abd Allah fi l‑sahara.
Wa sanduug al‑Rabb kamaan,Dawuud jaabah min hillit Kharyat Yaʼariim wa khattaah fi l‑bakaan al‑hu jahhazah leyah wa di kheema fi Uruchaliim.
Wa l‑madbah hana l‑nahaas al‑sanaʼah Basaliil wileed Uuri wileed wileedah le Huur gaaʼid giddaam kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa fi l‑bakaan da bas,Suleymaan wa kulla l‑chaʼab yasʼalo Allah.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da giddaam Allah,Suleymaan rikib fi l‑madbah hana l‑nahaas gariib le kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa gaddam foogah 1 000 dahaaya muharragiin.
Wa fi l‑leel di,al‑Rabb baan le Suleymaan wa gaal leyah : Atlub minni al‑cheyy al‑inta tidoorah wa ana nantiih leek. 
Wa Suleymaan radda le l‑Rabb wa gaal : Inta sawweet kheer katiir le Dawuud abuuyi wa darrajtini malik fi badalah.
Wa hassaʼ da,ya Allah Ilaahi,khalli kalaamak al‑gultah le abuuyi Dawuud da yilhaggag achaan inta bas darrajtini malik fi raas al‑chaʼab al‑katiiriin misil turaab al‑ard.
Wa antiini al‑hikma wa l‑ilim le naʼarif kikkeef nuguud al‑chaʼab da.Achaan yaatu yagdar yahkim fi chaʼabak al‑katiiriin dool ? 
Wa l‑Rabb gaal le Suleymaan : Da bas al‑cheyy al‑galbak dawwarah !Inta ma talabt minni khuna wa la maal wa la azama.Wa ma talabt moot udwaanak wa la tuul al‑umur laakin inta talabt al‑hikma wa l‑ilim le tahkim fi chaʼabi al‑ana darrajtak fooghum malik.
Wa fi chaan da,al‑hikma wa l‑ilim anteethum leek wa niziidak battaan wa nantiik al‑khuna wa l‑maal wa l‑azama al‑abadan muluuk al‑gablak ma ligooh.Wa baʼadak kula,naadum ma yalgaah. 
Wa baʼad da,Suleymaan gabbal fi Uruchaliim min bakaan al‑ibaada al‑fi Gibʼuun al‑gaaʼide foogah kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.Wa hakam fi Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa l‑malik Suleymaan lamma arabaat hana harib wa siyaad kheel.Hu indah 1 400 arabaat harib wa 12 000 siyaad kheel.Wa hu wadda waahidiin minhum fi l‑hillaal al‑yukhutt fooghum arabaatah wa waahidiin kamaan khallaahum maʼaayah fi Uruchaliim.
Wa l‑malik jaab fi Uruchaliim fudda wa dahab katiir ziyaada misil al‑hashas.Wa hatab al‑arz kula bigi katiir ziyaada misil chadar al‑jimmeez al‑yugumm fi sahalat Chafiila.
Wa kheel al‑malik Suleymaan,gaaʼidiin yijiibuuhum leyah min Masir wa min Kuwi.Wa da tujjaar al‑malik bas yamchu wa yachruuhum leyah min hinaak.
Wa ayyi araba al‑yijiibuuha min Masir tamanha 600 hajar fudda wa ayyi juwaad tamanah 150 hajar fudda.Wa be nafs al‑taman da bas,al‑tujjaar gaaʼidiin yijiibu arabaat wa kheel le muluuk al‑Hittiyiin wa le muluuk Araam kula.
Wa l‑malik Suleymaan amar yabnu beet le Allah wa gasir leyah hu.
Wa Suleymaan chaal 70 000 naggaaliin wa 80 000 naas gaaʼidiin fi l‑jibaal achaan yagtaʼo al‑hajar wa 3 600 muraakhibiin.
Wa Suleymaan rassal le Hiiraam malik balad Suur wa gaal leyah : Min fadlak,rassil leyi ana kula misil inta rassalt le abuuyi Dawuud hatab al‑arz le yabnu leyah beet al‑yaskun foogah.
Chiif,ana nidoor nabni beet le Allah Ilaahi wa nikhassisah achaan yiharrugu giddaamah al‑bakhuur al‑muʼattar wa yigaddumu daayman al‑khubza wa l‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin hana l‑fajur wa l‑achiiye wa kulli yoom sabt wa awwal yoom fi kulli chahar wa kulli iid hana Allah Ilaahna.Wa da bukhuss Bani Israaʼiil daayman.
Wa l‑beet al‑ana nidoor nabniih hu kabiir achaan Ilaahna hu kabiir min kulla l‑ilaahaat.
Wa yaatu yagdar yabni leyah beet ?Achaan al‑sama wa kulla l‑samaawaat al‑wasiiʼiin dool ma yagdaro yichiiluuh.Wa ana nisaawi cheyy le nabni leyah beet ?Nidoor bas nabni bakaan yiharrugu foogah bakhuur giddaamah.
 Wa hassaʼ da,rassil leyi naadum al‑indah khibra fi khidmit al‑dahab wa l‑fudda wa l‑nahaas wa l‑hadiid wa l‑gumaach al‑garadi wa l‑ahmar wa l‑zahri wa yaʼarif al‑nagichiin.Wa hu yakhdim maʼa l‑khaddaamiin al‑induhum khibra al‑abuuyi Dawuud jahhazaahum wa gaaʼidiin maʼaayi fi balad Yahuuza wa fi Uruchaliim.
Wa rassil leyi min Lubnaan hatab al‑arz wa hatab al‑sarwi wa hatab al‑sandal achaan ana naʼarif kadar khaddaamiinak yaʼarfu yagtaʼo chadar Lubnaan.Wa khaddaamiini yakhdumu maʼa khaddaamiinak
le yijahhuzu leyi hatab be katara achaan al‑beet al‑nidoor nabniih da kabiir wa ajiib.
Wa daahu nikaffi khaddaamiinak al‑yagtaʼo al‑hatab 50 000 chuwaal hana gameh ahmar wa 50 000 chuwaal hana gameh abyad wa 2 000 birmiil hana khamar wa 2 000 birmiil hana dihin. 
Wa Hiiraam malik balad Suur katab maktuub wa radda le Suleymaan wa gaal : Achaan Allah yihibb chaʼabah da bas,hu khattaak fooghum malik. 
Wa battaan Hiiraam gaal : Baarak Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil al‑khalag al‑samaawaat wa l‑ard wa anta le l‑malik Dawuud wileed hakiim indah agul wa fihim.Wa yabni beet le Allah wa gasir leyah hu kula.
Wa hassaʼ da,nirassil leek raajil al‑indah khibra wa maʼrafa wa hu Huuraam Abi
wileed hana mara waahide al‑min gabiilat Daan wa abuuh min balad Suur.Hu da yaʼarif yakhdim al‑dahab wa l‑fudda wa l‑nahaas wa l‑hadiid wa l‑hajar wa l‑hatab wa l‑gumaach al‑garadi wa l‑zahri wa l‑ahmar wa kattaan.Wa indah khibra fi nagichiin al‑achya al‑yanguchuuhum wa yiʼaddil kulla cheyy al‑yantuuh le yakhdimah.Wa hu yakhdim maʼa naasak al‑induhum khibra wa maʼa l‑khubara hana siidi Dawuud abuuk.
