Wa hu bas al‑ana nichiifahwa uyuuni kula yichiifuuh ma khariib leyi.Galbi fi daakhili muchtaag leyah.
Wa tuguulu : Kikkeef nitaʼʼubuuh ?Le nalgo sabab nichaaruʼu beyah. 
Wa be da khalaas,akhaafo le nufuusku min al‑seefachaan kalaamku yijiib leekual‑ikhaab be l‑seefwa be da,taʼarfu kadar fiyah ikhaab.
Wa Suufar al‑min Naʼama chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :
Daahu afkaari al‑bikhawwufuuniyajburuuni le nuruddwa da be sabab gillit sabri.
Ana simiʼt kalaam al‑yiʼayyibniwa laakin nafsi bas antatni radd.
Inta taʼarif min zamaan,min wakit al‑Rabb khalag al‑insaanwa khattaah fi l‑ard,
farah al‑aasi ma yitawwilwa suruur al‑kaafir kula le wakit chiyya bas.
Hatta kan tuulah yalhag al‑samawa raasah yalmas al‑sahaab kula,
hu yabga ma fiih marra waahid misil huraarahwa l‑yaʼarfuuh yuguulu : Ween hu ? 
Hu yabga misil hilim,ma yalgo minnah cheyywa yaturduuh misil ruʼyat al‑leel.
Wa een al‑awwal tichiifahma tichiifah battaan.Wa l‑bakaan al‑sakan foogahkula ma yichiifah battaan.
Iyaal al‑aasi yigabbuluhuguug al‑masaakiinwa iideenah yirajjuʼual‑maal al‑hu nahabah.
Udaam al‑aasiinduhum gudra fi chabaabahwa laakin yidissuuhum maʼaayahfi l‑turaab.
Al‑fasaala fi khachum al‑aasi misil halaawa,hu yilabbidha tihit lisaanah.
Hu yumussaha wa ma yagiifwa yudummaha fi chidgah.
Wa laakin aklah da yatlaf fi lubb batnahwa yabga misil samm amchideegaat.
Al‑maal al‑hu zaratah yigaddifahwa l‑Rabb bas yamurgah min batnah.
Hu gaaʼid yumuss samm al‑daabiwa yaktulah misil samm amchideegaat.
Al‑rujuul wa l‑buhuurwa l‑wudyaan hana l‑asal wa l‑zibde,hu abadan ma yichiifhum.
Hu yigabbil al‑chaalah,ma yagdar yazurtah.Wa l‑khuna al‑yalgaah min tijaartah,hu ma yitmattaʼ beyah.
Achaan hu rihik wa aba al‑masaakiinwa nahab buyuut badal yabniihum.
Achaan batnah ma taʼarif al‑chabaʼwa cheyy yanja minnah ke ma fiih.
Ma fi al‑yanja min tamaʼahwa be da,raahtah ma titawwil.
Fi wakit khunaayah bas,al‑diige tagaʼ foogahwa kulla tagalat al‑taʼab taji foogah.
Wakit hu machkhuul be batnah,al‑Rabb yinazzil foogah khadabah al‑chadiidWa yinazzilah foogah misil matarawa da bas yabga aklah.
Kan yajri min silaah al‑hadiid kula,nuchchaab al‑nahaas yatʼanah.
Kan yamrug al‑nuchchaab min jismahwa raas al‑nuchchaab min kibditah,khalaas al‑khoof min al‑moot yakurbah.
Kulla l‑dalaam mahfuud le khunaayahwa naar al‑ma nafakhha naadum,taakulahwa masiibe tagaʼ fi l‑faddal fi kheemtah.
Al‑sama takchif zanbahwa l‑ard tugumm diddah.
Al‑seel yarmi beetahwa yiwaddiih fi yoom khadab al‑Rabb.
Khalaas,daahu al‑gisimal‑jahhazah al‑Rabb le l‑aasiwa di al‑warasaal‑hu kharrarha leyah.
Wa Ayyuub chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :
Asmaʼo !Asmaʼo kalaami !Khalli da bas yukuun sabbiriinku leyi.
Khalluuni nihajjiwa baʼad hajjeet,intu achchammato !
Wa ana,chakwiti didd insaan walla ?Wa gaaʼid niwaddir sabribala sabab walla ?
Wajjuhu aleyi wa be da,intu tibarjuluwa tukhuttu iideeku fi khuchuumku !
Wa wakit nifakkir fi l‑cheyy al‑foogi,ninbahit wa jildi kulla yarjif.
Maala al‑aasiyiin gaaʼidiin hayyiin ?Wa maala yiʼiichu umur tawiilal‑yijaddid gudrithum ?
Yichiifu zurriiyithumyasbutu hawaaleehumaywa,iyaal iyaalhumyakburu giddaamhum.
Fi bakaan al‑aasiyiin,ma fi khoof,illa l‑salaamwa asaat khadab al‑Rabbma tadrubhum.
Tiiraanhum yiʼachchuru fi kulla wakitwa bagarhum yaldo,abadan ma yatraho.
Humman yikhallu iyaalhum yajru misil al‑humlaanwa iyaalhum al‑dugaag yinattutu.
Wa yikhannu maʼa hiss al‑tambal wa l‑jigindiiyewa yafraho maʼa hiss al‑suffaara.
Ayyaamhum yagdamowa yikammulu fi l‑haluwa humman yanzulu fi l‑khaburbe raaha.
Wa laakin humman gaalo le l‑Rabb : Baʼʼid minnina !Aniina ma nidooru naʼarfu duruubak !
Al‑Gaadir,hu yaatuachaan naʼabuduuh ?Wa kan nachhadooh,yanfaʼna be chunu ? 
Wa be da kula,kheerhum ma jaayi minhum.Choorit al‑aasiyiin di,hi baʼiide minni.
Hal chiftu faanuus al‑aasiyiin maat ?Hal chiftu al‑waba wagaʼ fooghum ?Aw chiftu khadab al‑Rabb dammar iyaalhum ?
Hal humman bigo misil tibinal‑chaayle al‑riihwalla misil al‑gechch al‑chaayleamzoobaʼaane ?Abadan !
Wa yuguulu al‑Rabb yijahhizikhaabah le iyaal al‑aasi.Laakin le l‑aasi zaatah,khalli al‑Rabb yiʼaakhibahachaan al‑aasi yaʼarif fasaaltah.
Wa be uyuunah,khalli hu zaatahyichiif taʼabahwa waajib hu bas yachrabmin kaas khadab al‑Gaadir.
Achaan ma lammaahbe taʼab aayiltah baʼad mootahwakit ayyaam hayaatah muhaddadiin.
Hal le l‑Rabb,yigarruuh al‑ilim walla ?Yigarruuh leyah hu al‑yihaakimal‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑sama ?La !
Al‑waahid yumuut be gudurtahfi raaha bala hamm.
Nawaaytah malaaniin be chahamwa sihhitah kaamile.
Wa l‑aakhar yumuut taʼbaanwa ma daakh abadan al‑halu.
Wa laakin humman al‑itneen yumuutuwa yarugdu fi l‑turaabayyi waahid jismah yiʼaffinwa l‑duud yikhattiih.
Aywa !Ana naʼarif khittitku intuwa niiyitku wa muʼaamaratku diddi !
Tuguulu : Ween beet al‑masʼuulwa ween al‑kheema al‑yaskunu foogha al‑aasiyiin ?Ma fiihum khalaas ! 
Wa intu ma saʼaltu al‑musaafiriin walla ?Wa ma saddagtu be chahaadithum walla ?
Fi yoom al‑masiibe,al‑fasil yanjawa fi yoom al‑khadab,hu mahfuud.
Yaatu yagdar yathamah giddaamah ?Wa yaatu yagdar yilkaffa al‑cheyy al‑hu sawwaah ?
Wa leyah hu,yiwadduuh fi l‑masaatirwa yiraakhubuuh fi khaburah.
Hatta daraadim turaab al‑waadikhufaaf leyah fi khaburah.Wa kulla l‑naas yamchu waraayahwa katiiriin bala adad yamchu giddaamah.
Wa be da,kikkeef tisabburuunibe kalaam ma indah faayde ?Kalaamku kulla ke khachch !
Wa Alifaaz al‑min balad Teemaan chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :
Hal al‑insaan naafiʼ le l‑Rabb walla ?Achaan al‑insaan kan hakiim kula,yanfaʼ nafsah bas.
Hal adaaltak tifarrih al‑Gaadir walla ?Wa kan inta kaamil fi derbak kula,hu yalga minnak chunu ?
Hal be sabab takhwaak,hu yichaariʼak wa yiʼaakhibak walla ?
La !Charrak ma bigi katiir walla ?Wa zunuubak ma faato al‑hadd walla ?
Achaan bala sabab,inta chilt damaan min akhwaanakwa galaʼt khulgaanhumwa khalleethum aryaaniin.
Inta ma anteet almi le l‑atchaanwa la anteet akil le l‑jiiʼaan.
Al‑ard le siid al‑unufwa l‑mahbuub yaskun foogha.
Al‑araamil,inta tatrudhin iideehin yaabsiinwa zalamt al‑atiim al‑halkaan.
Wa fi chaan da,al‑churukka hawwagookwa l‑ruʼub karabak be khafla.
Inta ma tichiif al‑dalaamwa la l‑almi al‑katiiral‑gaaʼid yikhattiik walla ?
Al‑Rabb ma foog min al‑sama walla ?Wa inta !Chiif al‑nujuum humman aaliyiin !
Wa fi chaan da,inta gult : Al‑Rabb yaʼarif chunu ?Hu yagdar yihaakimnamin al‑dalaam al‑haalik walla ?
Wa l‑sahaab misil khita takhiinyadharah ma yichiifwakit yamchiwa yihawwig al‑samaawaat. 
Hal inta tidoor tahfad al‑derib al‑zamaan,al‑chaalooh al‑naas al‑fasliin walla ?
Humman dool maato gabul wakithummisil beet al‑almi akal asaasah.
Humman gaalo le l‑Rabb : Baʼʼid minnina !Inta al‑Gaadir ma tagdartisawwi leena cheyy ! 
Wa laakin hu basal‑mala buyuuthum be l‑kheer.Wa choorit al‑aasiyiin di,hi baʼiide minni.
Al‑saalihiin yichiifu kharaabhum wa yafrahowa l‑bari yichchammat leehum.
 Al‑wagaf diddina ma addammar walla ?Wa l‑naar ma akalat khumaamhum walla ? 
Sawwi suluh maʼa l‑Rabbwa talga al‑salaam.Wa be da,al‑halu yigabbilleek battaan.
Asmaʼ taʼliim al‑Rabbwa akrub kalaamah fi galbak.
Gabbil le l‑Gaadir wa talga al‑sabaatwa baʼʼid al‑zulum min kheemtak.
Armi dahabak fi l‑turaabwa dahab Ufiir fi ust hashas al‑waadi.
Wa khalaas,al‑Gaadir yabga dahabakwa yabga leek kiimaan hana fudda.
Wa be da,al‑Gaadir yabga farhitakwa ale l‑Rabb,tarfaʼ wijhak battaan.
Inta tachhadah wa hu yasmaʼakwa tihaggig nazrak.
Wa kan chilt kharaar kula,yilhaggag leekwa l‑nuur yinawwir derbak.
Wa kan naas waahidiin yilmaskano,inta tuguul : Gummu foog ! Achaan al‑Rabb yinajji al‑miskiin.
Aywa,hu yinajji hatta al‑ma bari kulawa hu kula yanja be sabab iideenak al‑saalimiin.
Wa Ayyuub chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :
Al‑yoom,ana muʼaarid le l‑Rabbwa nitaabiʼ fi chakwiti.Wa iidi tagiile foogiwa laakin ma tagdar tiwaggif ganiiti.
Yaareet !Kan naʼarif bakaan nalgaahwa kan nagdar nawsal fi bakaan maskanah,
khalaas nagdar niwassif leyah kadar ana bariwa namla khachmi be l‑hujaj.
Wa be da,naʼarif al‑kalaamal‑yuruddah leyiwa nagdar nafham al‑yuguulah.
Hal yihaakimni be kulla gudurtah walla ?La !Yasmaʼni.
Wa hu yaʼarifkadar ana khasiimah,saalih.Wa hu al‑yichaariʼni,fi l‑nihaaya yibarriini.
Wa laakin kan ana macheetale l‑sabaah,hu ma fiihwa fi l‑kharib,ana ma nichiifah.
Kan hu machkhuul fi l‑munchaakh,ma nichiifahwa wakit hu yinlafit wati,ma nichiifah.
Wa laakin le derbi ana,hu yaʼarfah.Wa kan kachafni,yalgaani saafi misil al‑dahab.
Rijli titaabiʼ khatwaatahwa ana hafadt derbah,ma talagtah.
Ana ma khalleet wasiiyaatahwa hafadt gawaaniinah ziyaadamin al‑akil al‑fi khachmi.
Wa kan hu bas kharrar,yaatu yagdar yifachchilah ?Aywa,al‑hu yidoorah,yihaggigah.
Hu yinaffiz al‑hu kharrarah leyimisil kharaaraatah al‑aakhariin kula.
Fi chaan da giddaamah hu,ana ninbahitwa kan fakkart foogah,narjif.
Al‑Rabb,hu al‑waddar chajaaʼtiwa l‑Gaadir malaani be l‑ruʼub.
Wa da,ma dalaam al‑sakkatniwa la sawaad al‑khattaani.
Maala al‑Gaadir ma gataʼ wakitle l‑ikhaab ?Wa maala al‑yaʼarfuuhma chaafo ayyaamah ?
Al‑aasiyiin yihawwulu alaamaat al‑huduudwa yasurgu al‑bagarwa yasraho beehum.
Humman yichiilu humaar al‑ataamawa yakurbu fi l‑damaan toor al‑armala.
Yaturdu al‑masaakiin min al‑deribwa fagraaniin al‑balad yillabbado minhum.
Aywa !Al‑masaakiin yamchu le khidmithummisil hamiir al‑kadaade yifattuchu akil fi l‑sahara.Humman yiʼakkulu iyaalhumfi ard jafaaf.
Fi l‑ziraaʼa,al‑masaakiin yilimmu alfawa fi jineenit al‑aasi,yilimmu inab.
Tuul al‑leel,humman aryaaniin bala khulgaanwa ma induhum khita min al‑bardaay.
Matar al‑yanzil fi l‑jibaal yibilluhumwa min gillit al‑maskan,yittaako fi l‑hajar.
Wa l‑aasiyiin yaglaʼo al‑atiimbe gu min ammahwa yakurbu damaanmin al‑fagraaniin.
Al‑masaakiin maachiin aryaaniinma induhum khulgaanwa be juuʼhum,yangulu al‑gechch.
Fi lubb al‑zaraayib,yaʼasuru dihinwa yaʼasuru al‑inabwa laakin ma induhum hagg yuduukhuuh.
Wa fi daakhal al‑madiina,al‑taʼbaaniin yaguntuwa l‑majruuhiin yikooruku le l‑fazaʼwa laakin al‑Rabb ma yasmaʼhum.
Wa l‑aasiyiin muʼaaridiin le nuur al‑nahaarwa ma yaʼarfu turugahwa ma yamchu fi duruubah.
Wa l‑kaatil yugumm fi wakt al‑chagaagyaktul al‑miskiin wa l‑fagraanwa yasrig be l‑leel.
Al‑zaani yarja al‑leel wa yuguul : Ma fi naadum yichiifni. Hu yikhatti wijhahachaan ma yaʼarfuuh.
Fi l‑dalaam,yasrig al‑buyuutwa be l‑nahaar,yinsadda daakhal ma yidoor al‑nuur.
Aywa,leehum humman kulluhumal‑dalaam al‑haalik misil al‑sabaahachaan humman waalafobe ruʼub al‑leel.
Wa intu tuguulu : Humman misil al‑tibinal‑chaaylah almi.Naas al‑balad yalʼano turaabhumwa ma fi al‑yakhdim fi jineenaat inabhum. 
Wa tuguulu : Misil al‑jafaaf wa l‑hamuyimawwuʼu al‑talajmisil da,al‑moot yichiil al‑muznib.
Wa ammah al‑wildatah kula tansaahwa janaaztah tiʼaffinwa tabga laziize le l‑duud.Naas abadan ma yizzakkaroohwa zulmah yiddammarmisil chadara al‑wagaʼat. 
Laakin hu yisawwi al‑fasaalale l‑mara al‑aagre al‑ma indaha iyaalwa ma yarham al‑armala.
Laakin al‑Rabb be gudurtah,hu bas al‑yamrug siyaad al‑unuf.Wakit yugumm,humman dool ma yalgo al‑haya.
Al‑Rabb yikhalliihum fi l‑amaanwa laakin hu yiraakhib duruubhum.
Wa l‑aasiyiin bigo aaliyiinwa baʼad chiyya,yabgo ma fiihum.Humman yidaffugu misil al‑nuwwaarwa yagtaʼoohum misil yagtaʼo al‑ganaadiil.
Wa kan misil da,yaatu yikaddibni ?Wa yaatu yuguul kalaami da ma sahiih ?
Wa Bildad al‑min Chuuha chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :
Al‑Rabb hu al‑malik al‑mukhiifwa hu al‑yahkim be l‑salaam fi l‑aʼaali.
Hal khuwwaatah binhasbu walla ?Wa fi yaatu,nuurah ma yidawwi ?
Wa be da kula,kikkeef al‑insaanyisawwi nafsah saalih giddaam al‑Rabb ?Wa kikkeef al‑jaabatah marayabga saafi giddaamah ?
Kan al‑gamar kulama indah nuur giddaamahwa l‑nujuum kulama waadhiin fi uyuunah,
kikkeef yukuun al‑insaan al‑misil rimmewa ibn al‑insaan al‑misil duud al‑turaab ?
Wa Ayyuub chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :
Chunu al‑fazaʼ al‑inta jibtah leyi,ya Bildad ?Ana al‑ma indi gudra !Aywa,inta tahsib tinajjial‑duraaʼ al‑ma chadiid walla ?
Wa inta tagdar tanti wasiiyele l‑ma indah hikma walla ?Wa tiʼarrif be katarat ilmak walla ?
Wa laakin kalaamak da,muwajjah le yaatu ?Wa ligiit al‑wahi da min yaatu ?
Al‑maytiin yarjufu tihit al‑almiwa tihit al‑saakniin foogah.
Giddaam al‑Rabb,kulla l‑khubuur makchuufiinaywa,bakaan al‑halaakma mukhatta minnah.
Hu yimidd al‑sama al‑munchaakhi fi l‑faadiwa yiʼallig al‑ard fi l‑hawa.
Hu yakhzin al‑almi fi l‑sahaabwa l‑sahaab ma yinfajir min tagalatah.
Hu yikhatti archahwa yisiddah be sahaabah.
Al‑Rabb sawwa daayira fi l‑almilahaddi l‑huduud al‑been al‑nuur wa l‑dalaam.
Amad al‑sama yinhazzowa yinbahtu min tahdiidah.
Be gudurtah,hu hayyaj al‑baharwa be ilmah,dammar Rahab khuul al‑bahar.
Be nafkhatah,al‑sama bigi saafiwa iidah katal al‑daabi al‑muʼarrid.
Wa dool al‑askhar fi amalahwa di bas al‑mukhaala al‑nasmaʼooha.Kan misil da,yaatu yafham raʼad gudurtah ?
Wa battaan Ayyuub kallam wa gaal :
Nahlif be l‑Ilaah al‑Hayy al‑daharaani huguugiwa be l‑Gaadir al‑jaʼal leyi al‑murr !
Kan ruuh al‑Rabb gaaʼide foogiwa munkhari tadrub riih,
abadan khachmi ma yuguul fasaalawa lisaani ma yantug be khachch.
Lahaddi numuut kula,ana ma nantiiku haggwa ma nuguul ana ma kaamil.
Ana munkarib fi adaalti,ma nikhalliiha !Wa galbi ma indah chakkfi kulla ayyaam hayaati !
Khalli aduuyi yilʼaakhab misil aasiwa l‑yugumm diddi yilʼaakhab misil mujrim !
Achaan intu tuguulu : Al‑kaafir ma indah acham baʼad yumuutwakit al‑Rabb yichiil ruuhah.
Hal al‑Rabb yasmaʼ korooraakahfi wakit diigtah walla ?
Hal hu yafrah be l‑Gaadir walla ?Wa yagdar yinaadi al‑Rabbfi ayyi wakit walla ? 
Ana niʼallimku kikkeef gudrat al‑Rabbwa ma nilabbid leeku niiyit al‑Gaadir.
Wa kan intu kulluku iriftuuh,maala tihajju fi l‑riih saakit ?
Wa khalaas,daahu al‑gisim al‑jahhazahal‑Rabb le l‑aasiyiinwa da misil warasa al‑kharrarhaal‑Gaadir le l‑mujrimiin.
Kan iyaalah yaktaro kula,yaktulhum al‑seefwa zurriiytah ma yalgo akil.
Al‑faddalo minhum yaktulhum al‑wabawa araamilhum ma yabkan leehum.
Al‑aasi,kan yilimm al‑fudda misil al‑turaabwa yilimm al‑khulgaan be katara kula,
khalli yilimmuhum !Al‑saalih bas yalbashumwa l‑fudda kamaan tabga gisim le l‑bari.
Al‑aasi bana beetah daʼiifmisil beet al‑ittewa ma yitawwilmisil illiiyit al‑yihaahi al‑teer.
Hu yunuum khani wa ma yalga kafan.Wa be khafla,yabga ma fiih.
Al‑ruʼub yaji leyah be surʼa misil al‑seelwa amzoobaʼaane taji takhtifah fi ust al‑leel.
Riih al‑sabaah tiwaddiih wa hu yamchiwa tichiilah min maskanah.
Bala rahma,al‑Rabb yizarrigah be nachaachiibwa hu yihaawil yakhnis minhum.
Wa l‑naas yisaffugu le damaarahwa yichchammato leyah min maarig min beetah.
Akiid,fiyah bakaanaat al‑yamurgu minhum al‑fuddawa bakaanaat al‑yisaffu fooghum al‑dahab.
Al‑hadiid yamurguuh min al‑turaabwa yagtaʼo al‑nahaas be naarle yamurguuh min al‑hajar.
Fi lubb al‑ard,al‑naas yiwaddu deyyal‑beyah fi l‑bakaanaat al‑dulumyifattuchu al‑hujaar al‑mulabbadiinbaʼiid fi l‑dalaam al‑haalik.
Yahfuru nugra tawiilebaʼiid min al‑bakaan al‑maskuun.Wa fi bakaan al‑ma yaji foogah insaan,yidallu be hubaal baʼiid min al‑naas.
Wa fi dahar al‑ard yugumm al‑akilwa laakin daakhilha misil akalatah naar.
Wa fi hujaarha,yinlagi al‑yaakhuut al‑akhdarwa fi turaabha,yinlagi al‑dahab.
Al‑suguura ma yaʼarfu al‑tariig dawa een al‑hideyye ma tichiifah.
Al‑wuhuuch ma yamchu foogahwa l‑duud ma yuchuggah.
Al‑naas yikassuru al‑hajarwa yichaglubu al‑jibaal min gaʼarhum.
Fi lubb al‑jibaal,yankutu nugaar katiiriinwa kulla cheyy khaali,een al‑insaan tichiifah.
Yisiddu uyuun almi al‑baharwa yamurgu al‑mullabbid fi l‑deyy.
Laakin al‑hikma,ween tinlagi ?Wa l‑maʼrafa,bakaanha ween ?
Al‑insaan ma yaʼarif tamanhawa hi ma tinlagi fi ard al‑hayyiin.
Almi al‑khariig yuguul : Al‑hikma ma gaaʼide foogi. Wa l‑bahar yuguul : Hi ma maʼaayi. 
Al‑hikma ma tilbaddal be dahab saafiwa la tinchari be wazin hana fudda.
Dahab Ufiir al‑khaali ma yisaawiihawa la l‑agiig wa la l‑yaakhuut al‑akhdar.
Al‑dahab wa l‑balluurma yisaawu tamanhawa hi ma tinlagibe chuwaal hana dahab saafi kula.
Wa l‑marajaan wa l‑maass,ma yihajju beehum jambahawa l‑hikma,khiimitha ziyaada min al‑luʼlu.
Wa l‑yaakhuut al‑asfaral‑min al‑Habacha ma yisaawi tamanhawa be l‑dahab al‑saafi kula,al‑hikma ma tinchari.
Laakin al‑hikma di jaaye min ween ?Wa l‑maʼrafa,bakaanha ween ?
Hi ansatarat min uyuun kulli makhluug hayywa mullabbide min tuyuur al‑sama.
Wa l‑halaak wa l‑moot yuguulu : Udneena simʼo beeha. 
Laakin al‑Rabb bas yafham deribhawa hu wiheedah yaʼarif bakaanha.
Achaan hu bas al‑yanzurlahaddi aakhir al‑dunyawa yichiif kulla cheyyal‑tihit al‑sama.
Wakit wazan tugul al‑riihwa haddad magaas al‑almi,
wa wakit anta amur le l‑matar,wa sawwa derib le l‑barraaga wa l‑raʼad,
khalaas,hu chaaf al‑hikma wa khaddarhawa khattaaha wa kachafha.
Wa baʼad da,khalaas gaal le l‑insaan : Al‑khoof min al‑Rabb,da bas al‑hikma.Wa baʼʼidiin min al‑charr,di bas al‑maʼrafa ! 
Wa battaan Ayyuub kallam wa gaal :
Ana nitmanna zamaani al‑faat yigabbil leyiwakit al‑Rabb gaaʼid yahfadni.
Wa da wakit barakat al‑Rabb gaaʼidefoogi misil faanuuswa nuurah gaaʼid yidawwi leyiderbi fi l‑dalaam.
Dool ahsan ayyaam hayaatiwakit al‑Rabb gaaʼid yifakkir fi beeti misil rafiigi.
Fi l‑wakit daak,lissaaʼ al‑Gaadir gaaʼid maʼaayiwa awlaadi muhawwigiinni.
Fi l‑wakit daak,ana nilbarrad be l‑labanwa assaaraati yisiilu be l‑dihin be katara.
Wa da wakit namrug ale khachum baab al‑hillewa nagood fi nagaʼat al‑malamma.
Wa wakit yichiifuuni,al‑subyaan yitarrufuwa l‑chiyyaab yugummu leyi foog.
Wa l‑masaaʼiil yiwaggufu kalaamhumwa yukhuttu iideehum fi khuchuumhum.
Wa hiss al‑kubaaraat ma yinsamiʼwa lisaanhum kula ma yantug.Wa da kulla le yiwassufu leyi ihtiraamhum.
Al‑adaan al‑tasmaʼnituguul ana mubaarakwa l‑een al‑tichiifnitachhad leyi.
Achaan ninajji al‑miskiinal‑yikoorik leyi le l‑fazaʼwa l‑atiim al‑ma indahnaadum yisaaʼidah.
Wa barakat al‑gariib le l‑moot tanzil foogiwa namla galib al‑armala be l‑farah.
Nalbas al‑adaala wa hi taksiiniwa l‑hagg misil khalag wa kadmuul leyi.
Ana misil uyuun le l‑amyaanwa misil rijle le l‑aʼraj.
Ana misil abu le l‑masaakiinwa nifakkir adiil fi huguug al‑deef.
Wa naksir saalfit al‑mujrimwa min khachmah,naglaʼ fariistah.
Wa khalaas,ana gult : Baʼad ayyaam katiiriinmisil ramla hana khachum al‑bahar,ana numuut fi lubb aayilti.
Nabga misil chadaraal‑uruugha rawyaaniin almiwa be leel,al‑talaj yanzil fi furuuʼi.
Charafi yiljaddad foogiwa nubbaali yabga gawi fi iidi. 
Wa fi l‑wakit daak,al‑naas yarjooniwa yaskutu le yasmaʼo wasiiyti.
Baʼad kalaami,humman ma yinaakhuchuwa kalaami yanzil fooghummisil matara.
Humman yarjoonimisil yarjo al‑matarwa yardo be kalaamimisil almi al‑richaach.
Wa ana nadhak leehumwa humman ma yisadduguuhwa wakit chaafo wijhi daawi,khalaas yalgo acham.
Ana azalt leehum al‑deribwa gaʼadt fi raashum.Wa bigiit misil malik fi lubb askarahwa misil naadum al‑yihannis al‑taʼbaaniin.
Laakin hassaʼ,humman al‑subyaan minni yadhako foogi.Wa zamaan,ana hagart abbahaathum,chiyyaab al‑ma tammo kulaab le yahfado khanami.
Wa l‑chiyyaab dool,gudrithum tanfaʼni be chunu ?Achaan khuwwithum kammalat.
Min al‑juuʼ wa l‑fagur,fattacho akil fi ard al‑jafaafal‑min zamaan hilkat wa addammarat.
Humman gataʼo al‑mikhkheet min chadarawa akalo min taman uruug al‑ratam.
Taradoohum min ust al‑naaswa aato waraahum misil wara l‑saraariig.
Humman sakanofi l‑wudyaan al‑yaabsiinwa fi nugaar al‑ardwa karaakiir al‑jibaal.
Humman kawwako misil al‑hamiir fi lubb al‑khaabawa ragado fi l‑haskaniit.
Humman iyaal al‑mataamiis al‑ma induhum usumwa matruudiin min al‑balad.
Wa hassaʼ,iyaalhum al‑subyaan doolyisawwuuni khinneeyewa yadurbu beyi masal.
Achaan hasabooni misil muharram,yibaʼʼudu minnilahaddi yibazzukhu leyi fi wijhiwa ma yajʼalooni.
Al‑Rabb rakha habil nubbaali wa ayyabaaniwa be da,humman ma yiwaggufu fasaalithum minni.
Fi zeenaayti,chariiriin katiiriin yugummule yicharkulu leyi wa yarmuuniwa yugummu diddi le yiwadduruuni.
Humman yagtaʼo leyi al‑deribwa bala musaaʼadat al‑aakhariinyidooru yidammuruuni.
Humman yadkhulu leyi be khurma kabiirewa yawsalooni misil mooj al‑bahar.
Al‑ruʼub gabbal diddiwa charafi faat misil chaalatah riihwa najaati faatat misil sahaab.
Wa hassaʼ,nafsi antahatwa ayyaam al‑taʼab wagaʼo foogi.
Be l‑leel,udaami boojaʼooni chadiidwa yilmaadakhooni ma yagiifu.
Be unuf,al‑Rabb karabaani min khalagiwa gabbabni min jallaabiiyti.
Hu ramaani fi l‑tiinewa ana bigiit misil ajaaj wa rumaad.
Ya Rabb !Ana koorakt leekwa inta ma raddeet leyi.Ana wagaft be tuuliwa inta ma wajjaht aleyi.
Inta ma indak leyi rahmawa iidak hajamatni be kulla gudritha.
Inta rakkabtini fi l‑riih wa waddeetniwa rameetni fi amzoobaʼaane.
Aywa,ana irift kadar tiwaddiini le l‑mootal‑beyah inta waaʼadt kulli makhluug hayy.
Al‑yagaʼ,ma indah hagg yimidd iidah walla ?Wa l‑yidoor al‑fazaʼ,ma indah hagg yikoorik walla ?
Aywa,ana bakeet le l‑hayaatah fi l‑taʼabwa wassaft mahannati le l‑miskiin.
Ana zaati hasabt nalga al‑kheerlaakin jaani al‑charr.Ana narja al‑nuurwa jaani al‑dalaam.
Wa butuuni hirgo ayyi wakitwa ana waajaht ayyaam al‑taʼab.
Ana raayikh be taʼab wa bigiit azragwa laakin ma min hamu al‑harraay.Wa gammeet fi ust al‑mujtamaʼwa koorakt le l‑fazaʼ.
Ana bigiit akhu al‑baʼaachiimwa rafiig al‑naʼaam.
Farwit jildi dallamatwa udaami yibalbulu foogi min al‑wirde.
Ana bigiit misil jigindiiyit khine al‑hizinwa suffaarit hiss al‑bakkaayiin.
Ana sawweet ahad maʼa nafsima nichiif be chahwa le bineeye.
Kan sawweetah,chunu al‑gisim al‑nalgaahmin al‑Rabb fi l‑aali ?Wa chunu al‑warasa al‑yantiiha leyial‑Gaadir min foog ?
Al‑damaar ma waajible l‑naadum al‑mujrim walla ?Wa l‑masiibe ma tagaʼfi l‑yisawwi al‑charr walla ?
Al‑Rabb ma yichiif duruubi walla ?Wa ma yahsib kulla khatwaati walla ?
Kan ana macheet be kidibaw jareet be surʼa le l‑khachch,
khalli al‑Rabb yawzinnifi l‑miizaan al‑aadilwa yaʼarif kamaali.
Kan ana gabbalt min al‑derib al‑adiilwa chahwat galbi taabaʼat uyuuniwa iideeni allattakho be l‑najaasa,
khalaas,naas aakhariin yaakulu al‑teerabtahwa yidammuru zurriiyti !
Kan galbi mayyal le marawa harastaha fi khachum baab jaari,
khalaas,khalli marti kulayichiilha raajil aakharwa naas katiiriin yaznooha.
Achaan zinaayi da yabga fiʼil cheen.Aywa,da khata al‑yijiib ikhaab min al‑gaadi.
Wa di naar al‑taakul lahaddi l‑aakhirawa tidammir kulla intaaji.
Ana ma rafadt huguug abdi aw khaadmiwakit yiwadduuni fi l‑chariiʼa.
Kan awwal ana sawweetah,nisawwi chunu wakit al‑Rabb yihaasibni ?Wa nuguul chunu wakit yasʼalni ?
Al‑khalagaani ana fi batun ammikhalagaahum humman kula.Hu nafs al‑Ilaahal‑khattaana fi butuun ammahaatna.
Ana ma dahart al‑miskiinmin al‑cheyy al‑yidoorahwa ma jarreet dumuuʼuyuun al‑armala.
Ana ma akalt akli wiheediwa ma dahart al‑atiim ma yuduukhah.
La !Achaan min subaayi,hu kibir maʼaayi misil maʼa abuuhwa daayman ana daafaʼt le l‑armala.
Wakit ana chift naadum fagri ma indah khalagwa miskiin ma indah khita,
hatta kan ma chakaroonibe kulla galibhum kula,ana khatteethum be khattaay daafiyemin suuf khanami.
Hatta kan ana muhimm fi khachum baab al‑hille kula,ana ma rafaʼt iidi le nikhawwif atiim.
Kan awwal ana sawweetah,khalli iidi tingatiʼ min kitfiwa duraaʼi yingatiʼ min kuuʼi.
Achaan al‑damaar al‑jaayi min al‑Rabbyisabbib leyi ruʼubwa fi chaan azamatah,ma indi gudra.
Ana ma khatteet amaani fi l‑dahabwa ma gult leyah : Nitwakkal aleek .
Wa ma firiht be katarat khunaayiwa la be khumaami al‑lammatah iidi.
Wa ma chift nuur al‑harraay wakit talaʼtwa l‑gamar wakit gaaʼid yazhaf be kulla jamaalah,
wa galbi ma mayyal leehum be achiirwa ana ma jaʼaltuhum misil ilaahaat le naʼabudhum.
Kan awwal ana sawweetah,da khata waajib leyi al‑ikhaab,achaan ana khunt al‑Rabb fi l‑aali.
Ana ma firiht be damaaral‑adu al‑yakrahniwa ma natteet min al‑farhawakit al‑charr wagaʼ foogah.
La !Achaan ma waajib lisaani yisawwi zanibwa la natlub mootah be laʼana.
Laakin al‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin fi kheemti buguulu : Yaatu al‑ma chibiʼ min al‑laham fi beet Ayyuub ? 
Abadan,ana ma raggadt al‑deef barrawa baabi daayman faatih le l‑musaafiriin.
Ana ma misil kulla l‑naas,nilabbid isyaaniwa khataayi kula ma dasseetah tihtiwa gaʼadt foogah.
Wa da achaan ana khuft min kalaam al‑naaswa karaahiiyit al‑gabaayil khawwafatnilahaddi ana sakattwa ma maragt min beeti.
Fi naadum al‑yasmaʼni walla ?Wa da kalaami al‑akhiir.Khalli al‑Gaadir yurudd leyi !Kan fi chakwa min aduuyimaktuuba diddi,
khalaas ana nichiilha fi kitfiwa nalbasha misil taaj fi raasi.
Kan misil da khalaas,nigaddim le l‑Rabb kulla hisaab khatwaatiwa nigarrib leyah be farah misil malik.
Kan al‑ard chakat minniwa juruufha andalamo foogi
achaan ana akalt intaajhaal‑ana ma chareetah,wa kan zalamt siyaadah,
khalaas,khalli ardi tigawwim haskaniitfi badal al‑gameh al‑ahmarwa andireesafi badal al‑gameh al‑abyad !Wa da kalaam Ayyuub al‑akhiir.
Wa khalaas,Alifaaz wa Bildad wa Suufar waggafo kalaamhum maʼa Ayyuub achaan hu yichiif nafsah saalih.
Wa be sabab da,Aliihu wileed Barakiil al‑min hillit Buuz min khachum beet Raam ziʼil zaʼal chadiid.Wa zaʼalah da didd Ayyuub achaan Ayyuub sawwa nafsah saalih ziyaada min al‑Rabb.
Wa Aliihu ziʼil zaʼal chadiid didd al‑rufgaan al‑talaata kula,achaan humman ma gidro yuruddu le Ayyuub.Wa be misil da,humman sawwo Ayyuub khaati.
Wa Aliihu sabar ma kallam le Ayyuub achaan humman kulluhum kubaar minnah fi l‑sinn.
Wa laakin wakit Aliihu chaaf kadar al‑rujaal al‑talaata dool ma induhum kalaam al‑yurudduuh leyah,ziʼil zaʼal chadiid.
Wa khalaas,Aliihu wileed Barakiil al‑min hillit Buuz chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :Ana sabi wa intu chiyyaabwa fi chaan da,ana khuft wa rajaftwa ma gidirt nikhabbirku be maʼrafati.
Wa fi nafsi ana gult : Al‑chiyyaab waajib yihajju awwalwa l‑induhum siniin katiiriin yiʼarrufu be l‑hikma. 
Wa laakin fi l‑sahiih,al‑insaan indah ruuhwa l‑nafas al‑jaayi min al‑Gaadir,yantiih al‑fihim.
Al‑siniin al‑katiiriin basma yantu hikmawa ma kulla l‑chiyyaabyafhamo al‑adaala.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nuguul : Asmaʼni !Ana kula nikhabbir be maʼrafati. 
Ana arrajjeet kalaamkuwa khatteet adaani le hujjitkulahaddi intu haggagtu min kalaamku.
Ana khatteet baali foogkuwa daahu waahid minku kulama gidir yuluum Ayyuubwa waahid minku ma gidiryurudd leyah.
Wa laakin ma waajib tuguulu : Aniina ligiina al‑hikma.Al‑Rabb bas yagdar foogah,ma insaan. 
Wa Ayyuub ma kalaam kalaamah leyi anawa ana kula ma nurudd leyah be kalaamku intu.
Humman khaafowa ma yagdaro yuruddu battaanwa l‑kalaam kula waddar leehum.
Ana arrajjeet achaan humman ma hajjoachaan humman wagafo wa sakato wa abo ma yuruddu.
Wa ja doori ana.Ana kula nuruddwa nikhabbir be maʼrafati.
Achaan ana malaan be kalaamwa ruuh fi daakhili tajburni le nikallim.
Galbi fi daakhili faarmisil khamar masduudaw misil girbe jadiide malaane al‑tidoor tinfajir.
Ana nihajji le nirayyih nafsiwa naftah khachmi wa nurudd.
Ana ma nichiif naadum akheer min naadumwa ma nukhuchch insaan.
Achaan ana ma naʼarif nukhuchchwa kan khachcheet kula,al‑khalagaani yichiilni be surʼa.
Wa hassaʼ da,asmaʼ gooli,ya Ayyuubwa khutt adaanak le kulla kalaami.
Daahu !Ana nufukk khachmiwa lisaani yantug.
Kalaam galbi kulla adaalawa lisaani yikallim be maʼrafa sahiihe.
Be ruuhah,al‑Rabb khalagaaniwa nafas al‑Gaadir hayyaani.
Ya Ayyuub !Kan tagdar,rudd leyi !Gumm !Agiif giddaamiwa daafiʼ le nafsak !
Giddaam al‑Rabb,ana zaati mislak inta.Hu khalagaani ana kulamin al‑tiine bas.
Wa be misil da,ma waajib takhaaf minniachaan ana ma nidammirak.
Laakin inta hajjeet giddaami,aywa,ana simiʼtak wakit inta gult :
 Ana saafi,ma indi khata.Ana nadiif,ma indi zanib.
Wa daahu al‑Rabb gaaʼid yihaarijniwa yajʼalni misil aduuh.
Hu dassa rijileeni fi guyuudwa yiraakhibni fi kulla duruubi. 
Wa ana nuguul leek,ya Ayyuub,inta ma indak hagg fi l‑kalaam daachaan al‑Rabb kabiir min al‑insaan.
Maala inta tachki min al‑Rabbwakit hu ma radda leek fi kalaamak ?
Laakin al‑Rabb yikallim be tariiga waahide aw aakharawa l‑insaan ma yaʼarfah.
Hu yihajji fi hilim wa fi l‑ruʼya be l‑leelwakit al‑insaan naayim noom chadiid fi furaachah.
Wa khalaas,al‑Rabb yikallimle l‑naas fi udneehumwa yihazzirhumwa yikhawwifhum marra waahid.
Wa da le yibaʼʼidhum min amalhum al‑cheenwa yahfad al‑insaan min al‑istikbaar.
Wa da le yahfadah min al‑mootwa yadhar ruuhah ma tamrug be l‑seef.
Al‑Rabb yihazzir al‑insaan be taʼab fi furaachahwakit udaamah yarjufu min al‑wajaʼ.
Khalaas,hu yaaba al‑akil.Hatta al‑akil al‑halu kula,yikhalliih.
Wa laham jildah yikammil tak,yifaddil illa l‑udaam.
Ruuhah tigarrib le l‑khaburwa hayaatah le l‑moot.
Wa laakin kan yalga leyah malak wasiit,waahid min been al‑alifal‑yikhabbir al‑insaan be l‑tariig al‑adiil,
khalaas,al‑Rabb yihinn foogahwa yuguul : Najjiih !Achaan ma yanzil fi l‑khabur,ana ligiit al‑fidya al‑ninajjiih beeha. 
Wa be da,jismah yalga gudrat chabaabahwa yigabbil le ayyaam subaayah.
Hu yachhad al‑Rabbwa l‑Rabb yarda beyahwa yichiif wijh al‑Rabb be farah.Wa l‑Rabb yajʼal al‑insaan dasaalih giddaamah battaan.
Hu yikhanni giddaam al‑naaswa yuguul : Ana aznabt wa awwajt al‑adaalawa laakin al‑Rabb ma jaazaani misil waajib leyi.
Wa najja ruuhi min al‑khaburwa nichiif nuur al‑haya battaan. 
Wa daahu kulla cheyy al‑sawwaah al‑Rabbmarrateen wa talaata maʼa l‑insaan
le yigabbil ruuhah min al‑mootwa yinawwirah be nuur al‑hayyiin.
Khutt baalak,ya Ayyuub,wa asmaʼni !Askut wa ana bas nikallim.
Kan indak kalaam,rudd leyi !Kallim achaan nidoor nibarriik.
Wa kan ma fi,askut wa asmaʼniwa ana niʼallimak al‑hikma.
Wa battaan Aliihu chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :
Ya l‑hukama,asmaʼo kalaami !Ya intu al‑faahimiin,khuttu adaanku le l‑nuguulah.
Achaan al‑adaan tifassil al‑kalaammisil al‑lisaan yifarrig al‑taʼaam.
Wa misil da,khalli naʼazulu al‑adaalawa ambeenaatna,khalli naʼarfu al‑sahiih.
Wa simiʼna Ayyuub buguul : Ana saalihwa l‑Rabb bas daharaani min huguugi.
Wa fi chariiʼti,ma yuguul al‑sahiih.Wa ana ma sawweet khatawa jarahaani jiraah hana moot. 
Yaatu misil Ayyuub ?Al‑sawwiyiin al‑chamaate,hayyin leyah misil charaab almi !
Hu muchtarik maʼa l‑yisawwu al‑charrwa yuruukh daayman maʼa l‑fasliin.
Achaan hu gaal : Chunu faaydit al‑insaankan yafrah be l‑Rabb ? 
Wa khalaas asmaʼooni,ya l‑naas al‑faahimiin !Al‑Rabb yisawwi al‑charr ?La !Al‑Gaadir yisawwi al‑zulum ?Abadan !
Achaan hu yijaazi al‑insaan hasab amalahwa yikaafiih hasab tariigah al‑yichiilah.
Al‑Rabb yugumm be l‑fasaala walla ?La !Al‑Gaadir yiʼawwij al‑chariiʼa walla ?Abadan !
Ma fi naadum al‑wakkal al‑Rabb be l‑ardwa khattaah foog kulla l‑aalam.
Kan hu kharrar wa chaal ruuhahwa nafasah al‑antaah le l‑makhluugiin,
khalaas kulluhum yumuutuwa l‑insaan yigabbil fi l‑turaab.
Kan inta indak fihim,khalaas asmaʼ !Wa khutt adaanak le kalaami.
Kan al‑Rabb yakrah al‑adaala,yagdar yahkim walla ?Al‑Saadikh wa l‑Chadiid,tuguul hu khaati walla ?
Hal le l‑malik nuguulu : Inta ma naafiʼ  ?Hal le l‑masaaʼiil nuguulu : Intu aasiyiin  ?
Al‑Rabb ma yichiif al‑masaaʼiilwa ma yifarrig al‑khani min al‑fagriachaan kulluhum,hu bas khalagaahum.
Humman yumuutu be l‑leel be khaflawa l‑chaʼab yibarjulu wa yumuutuwa l‑jaayir yitarrufuuh be suhuula.
Achaan al‑Rabb yiraakhib fi duruub al‑insaanwa yichiif kulla khatwaatah.
Wa ma fi dalaam wa la dalaam haalikal‑yillabbado foogah siyaad al‑fasaala.
Wa l‑Rabb ma muhtaaj le yinaadi al‑naasle muhaakama khaassa.
Hu yidammir al‑chudaad bala ma yihaggigwa yukhutt aakhariin fi badalhum.
Achaan hu yaʼarif amalhumwa yinrahku be leel wa yifajjukhuuhum.
Hu yadrubhum fi bakaan al‑aasiyiinal‑yiʼaakhubuuhum foogah giddaam kulla l‑naas.
Wa da achaan humman baʼʼado minnahwa ma taabo duruubah,
wa daayago al‑daʼiif lahaddiyikoorik le l‑Rabbaywa,al‑Rabb simiʼkorooraak al‑miskiin.
Kan al‑Rabb yaskut,yaatu yisawwiih khaltaan ?Wa kan aba ma yiwajjih aleehum,yaatu yagdar yichiifah ?Wa la l‑umam wa la l‑naas.
Wa ma yikhalli al‑kaafir yahkimwa la yabga charak le l‑chaʼab.
Akuun naadum yuguul le l‑Rabb : Ana himilt ikhaabiwa ma nisawwi battaan cheyy fasil.
Al‑cheyy al‑ana ma chiftah,wassifah leyiwa kan sawweet khata kula,battaan ma nisawwiih. 
Hal hasab fikrak inta bas,al‑Rabb yiʼaakhib al‑naadum da ?Hal al‑Rabb yikaafiik hasab fikrak,wakit inta abeet ma tutuub ?Inta bas waajib taʼazil,ma ana !Wa l‑taʼarfah,guulah !
Wa l‑naas al‑faahimiinwa l‑hakiim al‑gaaʼid yasmaʼni yuguulu :
 Ayyuub yikallim bala maʼrafawa kalaamah kula ma indah maʼaana. 
Khalaas,khalli Ayyuub yagooddaayman tihit al‑tajriba !Achaan hu yuruddmisil al‑naas al‑fasliin.
Achaan hu yiziid al‑isyaan fi zanbahwa yisaffig fi lubbina be hugrawa yihajji katiir didd al‑Rabb.
Wa battaan Aliihu chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal :
Inta tahsib indak hagg wakit tuguul : Ana saalih ziyaada min al‑Rabb. 
Achaan inta gult le l‑Rabb : Da mufiid leek walla ?Kan ma naznib da,yanfaʼni be chunu ? 
Ana bas al‑nurudd leek,nurudd leek intawa le rufgaanak al‑maʼaak.
Anzur al‑sama wa chiifah adiilwa chiif al‑sahaab min foog leek !
Kan taznib da,tudurr al‑Rabb be chunu ?Wa kan isyaanak yabga katiir kula,tisawwi leyah chunu ?
Wa kan inta aadil,hu yistafiid chunu ?Wa yalga minnak chunu ?
Achaan fasaaltak di tudurr naas mislak baswa adaaltak kula tanfaʼ insaan bas.
Al‑naas yikooruku be sababkatarat al‑zaalimiinwa yikooruku le l‑fazaʼmin iid al‑gawiyiin.
Laakin ma fi naadum al‑yuguul : Ween al‑Rabb al‑khalagaani,hu al‑ana ninaadiih be khine be l‑leel ?
Ween hu al‑antaana agul ziyaadamin bahaayim al‑ard,wa sawwaana hakiimiinmin tuyuur al‑sama ? 
Khalaas,al‑naas yikoorukuwa l‑Rabb ma yurudd leehumachaan istikbaar al‑fasliin dool.
Akiid,al‑Rabb ma yasmaʼ korooraakhum fi l‑faadi,wa l‑Gaadir ma yijiib khabarhum.
Ya Ayyuub,kan ke da,al‑Rabb ma yasmaʼakwakit tuguul inta ma gaaʼid tichiifahwa muchkiltak gaaʼide giddaamah wa inta tarjaah.
Wa ziyaada min da,tuguul khadab al‑Rabb ma yugummwa ma indah haaje be l‑isyaan.
Ya Ayyuub,tihajji saakitwa tikattir kalaamak bala faayde !
Wa Aliihu gaal battaan :
Asburni chiyya,nidoor nikhabbirakachaan battaan kula indi kalaamfi chaan al‑Rabb.
Irfiti ligiitha min baʼiidwa niwassif kadar al‑khalagaani aadil.
Achaan be l‑sahiih,kalaami da ma kidibwa ana al‑fikri tamaam nagood maʼaak.
Al‑Rabb gaadir,ma yahgir al‑insaanwa ma fi cheyy al‑hu ma yaʼarfah.
Le l‑aasi,ma yikhalliih yiʼiichwa laakin yanti al‑masaakiin huguughum.
Wa nazrah ma yifaarig al‑saalihwa yukhuttuhum fi kursi al‑mulukwa yabgo aaliyiin daayman.
Wa kan humman masaajiinfi lubb al‑janaaziirwa kan karaboohum figuyuud al‑mudaayaga,
khalaas be misil da,al‑Rabb yikhabbirhum be amalhumwa isyaanhum wakit humman astakbaro.
Hu yufukk adaanhum le yiʼaddibhumwa yaamurhum yigabbulu min al‑fasaala.
Wa kan humman simʼo kalaamahwa abadooh,khalaas yiʼiichu kulla hayaathum be kheerwa kulla muddit umurhum fi niʼma.
Wa laakin kan ma simʼo kalaamah,yumuutu be l‑silaahwa yiddammaro min gillit al‑fihim.
Al‑kuffaar guluubhum malaaniin be zaʼalwa ma yikooruku le l‑fazaʼ wakit yijanzirhum.
Humman yumuutu fi chabaabhumust al‑charaamiit fi buyuut asnaamhum.
Wa laakin al‑Rabb yikhallis al‑miskiin be l‑taʼabwa be l‑diige,yihazzirah.
Ya Ayyuub,inta kula al‑Rabb yamurgak min al‑diigele yantiik hurriiye kaamilewa mawaaʼiinak yinmalu be akil halu.
Wa laakin hassaʼ,inta ligiit muhaakamamisil al‑aasiwa l‑muhaakama di,ma tanja minha.
Fakkir !Ma tikhalli al‑khuna yiwaddirakwa ma tikhalli al‑rachwa tibaʼʼidak.
Wa la khunaak wa la dahabak ma yitimmuukwa kulla gudrat jismak ma tisaaʼidak.
Ma titmanna al‑leelwakit yamurgu al‑naas min bakaanaathum.
Angariʼ ma tiwajjih ale l‑charr,ma taʼazilah fi chaan taʼabak.
Chiifu !Al‑Rabb aali be gudurtah.Yaatu muʼallim mislah ?
Yaatu yagdar yihaasibah fi amalah ?Yaatu yagdar yuguul leyah : Inta sawweet zulum  ?
Azzakkar wa azzim amalah,amalah al‑yikhannu beyah al‑naas.
Ayyi insaan yichiifahwa ayyi naadum yanzurah min baʼiid.
Al‑Rabb aziim wa hu faayit fihimnawa ma fi naadum yahsib siniin umrah.
Wa yilimm bukhaar almi fi l‑sahaabwa yinazzilah battaan matar min jadiid.
Al‑sahaab yusubb al‑matar dawa almiih yisiil le naas katiiriin.
Yaatu yafhamkikkeef al‑Rabb yukhutt al‑sahaabwa yirassil al‑raʼad min lubb al‑sama ?
Hu yirassil al‑nuur hawaaleeyahwa yikhatti al‑bahar al‑khariig.
Wa be kulla l‑cheyy da,yahkim fi l‑chuʼuubwa yantiihum maʼaach be katara.
Hu yichiil al‑barraaga be iideenahwa yiwassif leeha hadafha.
Be l‑raʼad,yiwassif jaytahwa l‑bahaayim yihissu kan hu garrab.
Wa fi chaan da,galbi rajaflahaddi misil yamrug min sadri.
Asmaʼo hissah al‑misil al‑raʼad !Asmaʼo al‑dagdaag al‑chadiid al‑yamrug min khachmah !
Al‑Rabb yatlig barraagtah tihit kulla l‑samawa yirassilha lahaddi aakhir al‑ard.
Wa baʼad da,hissah al‑mukhiif yamrugwa hiss majdah yabga misil raʼad.Wa barraagtah ma tagiifwakit hissah gaaʼid yinsamiʼ.
Hiss al‑Rabb yidagdig wa yikhawwifwa yisawwi ajaayib kubaar al‑aniina ma nafhamoohum.
Hu yuguul le l‑talaj : Daffig fi l‑ard ! Wa yuguul le l‑tchaktchaaka : Abge matar !Aywa,subbi matar chadiid ! 
Wa fi l‑wakit da bas,yiwaggif khidmit kulla insaanachaan kulluhum yaʼarfuda amalah hu.
Khalaas,ayyi haywaan yamchi le nugurtahwa yargud fi maskanah.
Riih al‑zaggaay taji min al‑junuubwa l‑barid yaji min al‑munchaakh.
Nafkhat al‑Rabb tikawwin al‑talajwa tijammid almi al‑bahar.
Hu yamla al‑sahaab be buruudawa yichattit al‑sahaab be barraaga jaay wa jaay.
Hu bas al‑yiliff al‑sahaable yitabbig kulla awaamirah fi kulla wijh al‑ard.
Wa yirassilhum fi l‑ard le yiʼaakhib al‑naasaw yibayyin rahmatah.
Ya Ayyuub,khutt adaanak le l‑kalaam da !Askut wa chiif ajaayib al‑Rabb !
Inta taʼarif kikkeef al‑Rabb yahkim al‑sahaabwa kikkeef al‑sahaab yisawwi al‑barraaga walla ?
Wa inta taʼarif kikkeef al‑Rabb khatta al‑sahaabal‑mutaharrik been al‑sama wa l‑ard ?Wa taʼarif ajaayib al‑Rabbwa ilmah al‑tamaama walla ?
Wakit al‑ard saabte tihit riih al‑junuub,khulgaanak yabgo haamiyiin min hamuuha.
Al‑Rabb khalag al‑sahaab wa gawwaahmisil amchawwaafa hint hadiid magtuuʼ.Wa inta tagdar tisawwi mislah ?
Khalaas,allimnaal‑waajib nuguuluuh le l‑Rabb.Ma naʼarfu cheyywa gaaʼidiin fi l‑dalaam.
Wakit nikallim,waajib nikhabbir al‑Rabb walla ?Misil da,naadum ma yitmannale nafsah al‑halaak walla ?
Ma nagdaro nichiifu deyy al‑harraayfi lubb al‑sahaab al‑katiir.Wa laakin baʼad al‑riih tichiil al‑sahaab da,nuurha yibiin.
Min al‑munchaakh yaji deyy misil al‑dahabwa nuur jalaal al‑Rabb yabhatna.
Hu al‑Gaadir,ma nagdaro nigarrubu leyahwa khuwwatah kabiire.Wa indah al‑hagg wa l‑adaala be katarawa laakin ma yazlum insaan.
Fi chaan da,waajib al‑naasyakhaafo minnah.Wa laakin hu ma lammaahbe l‑yisawwu nufuushum hakiimiin.
Wa khalaas,Allah saʼal Ayyuub min lubb al‑riih al‑chadiide wa gaal :
Yaatu al‑ma yikhalli niiyti tabga waadhebe kalaam bala maʼrafa ?
Arbut sulbak misil raajil fahal !Wa ana nasʼalak wa inta turudd leyi !
Inta gaaʼid ween wakit ana assast al‑ard ?Guulah leyi hasab maʼrafatak.
Yaatu khatta magaas al‑ard,inta taʼarfah walla ?Wa yaatu madda foogha habil al‑magaas ?
Wa amadha dool saabtiin fi chunu ?Wa yaatu khatta al‑hajar al‑muhimm,
wakit nujuum al‑sabaah yikhannu sawawa kulla malaaʼikat al‑Rabb yafraho ?
Wa yaatu khatta huduud le l‑baharwakit marag min batun al‑ard ?
Labbastah be sahaab misil khalagwa khatteetah be khamaam adlam.
Wa khatteet huduudahwa sawweet leyah baab wa guful.
Wa ana gult leyah : Taji hini bas,ma tufuut al‑bakaan da !Hini bas tagiif gudrat moojak ! 
Wa inta !Yoom waahid,amart al‑sabaahle yasbih walla ?Aywa,ooreet al‑fajur le yatlaʼ
le yamsuk al‑ard min tarafhawa yihitt minha al‑aasiyiin walla ?
Wa be fajur,al‑ard tinchaaf waadhemisil al‑tiine al‑khatto foogha al‑khitimwa loonha yabga misil jammalooha be lubaas.
Laakin al‑aasiyiin,nuurhum yiwaddirwa duraaʼhum al‑yarfaʼooh,yinkasir.
Wa inta wassalt lahaddi gaʼar al‑bahar walla ?Wa rukht fi bakaanaat al‑khariigiin hana l‑bahar walla ?
Wa biibaan al‑moot anfataho leek giddaamak walla ?Wa biibaan al‑dalaam al‑haalik,chiftuhum walla ?
Wa taʼarif urd al‑ard walla ?Khalaas kan taʼarif kulla l‑cheyy da,guulah !
Al‑nuur,ween maskanah ?Wa l‑dalaam,ween bakaanah ?
Tagdar takrubhum fi bakaanhumwa ayyi waahid tiwaddiih le maskanah walla ?
Khalaas,akiid inta taʼarfahachaan fi l‑wakit daak,inta wildook walla ?Wa akiid inta umrak tawiilziyaada walla ?
Inta wassaltlahaddi makhaazin al‑talaj walla ?Wa inta chiftmakhaazin al‑barad walla ?
Ana khatteethum taraf le wakt al‑diige,le yoom hana harib wa duwaas.
Ween al‑derib al‑foogah al‑barraaga tingasim ?Wa ween al‑derib al‑beyah riih al‑sabaah tusuug fi l‑ard ?
Yaatu yufukk baab al‑sama wa yinazzil al‑matarwa yisawwi derib le l‑barraaga wa l‑raʼad ?
Yaatu yinazzil matar fi ard al‑bala naaswa fi sahara al‑ma indaha insaan ?
Wa da,le yarwi ard jafaaf wa kharaabachaan al‑gechch yabzurwa yugumm foogha.
Al‑matara indaha abu walla ?Wa yaatu wilid al‑karany ?
Wa batun yaatu jaabat al‑barad ?Wa yaatu wilid al‑talaj al‑yanzil min al‑sama ?
Al‑almi yabga misil hajarwa almi al‑khariig yajmid.
Wa inta tagdar tarbut nujuum al‑Tureyyaaw tihill hizaam al‑Sabi al‑Makhmi walla ?
Hal tagdar titalliʼ al‑nujuum fi wakithum walla ?Wa inta tagdar tuguud najmat al‑Zaraafa wa nujuumha walla ?
Inta taʼarif nizaam al‑sama walla ?Walla inta bas tinazzim gawaaniin al‑ard ?
Inta tagdar taamur al‑sahaab le yinazzil matar chadiidlahaddi almiih yikhattiik walla ?
Wa inta bas tirassil al‑barraaga lahaddi hadafah walla ?Wa leek inta,humman yuguulu : Daahu aniina. 
Yaatu anta hikma le abunkhanam ?Wa yaatu anta fihim le l‑diik ?
Yaatu yagdar be hikmatahyahsib al‑sahaab ?Wa yaatu yagdaryidangis makhaazin almi al‑sama
achaan al‑turaab yilimm bakaan waahidwa daraadim al‑tiine yillassago ?
Wa yaatu yagnus le yiʼakkil al‑duudwa yisill juuʼ iyaalah
wakit humman gaaʼidiin fi nugrithumwa saakniin fi dungurhum ?
Wa yaatu yanti akil le l‑khuraabwakit iyaalah yinaadu al‑Rabb le l‑fazaʼwa gaaʼidiin wiheedhum bala akil ?
Inta taʼarif al‑wakital‑talda foogah al‑khazaal walla ?Wa inta chift tees al‑hajarwakit yalda walla ?
Wa taʼarif tahsib chuhuur waaluudithumwa l‑wakit al‑yaldo foogah walla ?
Humman yaburkuwa yaldo iyaalhumwa khalaas,yinjammomin wajaʼ al‑waaluuda.
Wa iyaalhum yakburuwa yabgo chudaadwa yibaʼʼudu min ammahaathumwa battaan ma yigabbulu.
Yaatu anta al‑hurriiye le humaar al‑kadaade ?Wa hal fi naadum halla rubaatah ?
Hu bas al‑ana sakkantah fi l‑kadaadewa maskanah fi l‑ard al‑indaha mileh.
Wa hu yichchammat le harakat al‑madiinawa ma yidoor yasmaʼ hiss hana siid.
Wa yuruukh fi raas al‑jibaal le yartaʼwa yifattich al‑gechch al‑akhdar.
Al‑jaamuus yikhassid yakhdim leekwa yaakul maʼa bahaaymak walla ?
Wa tagdar tarbut leyah harraata le yahrit leek walla ?Wa hu yukurr al‑harraata waraak walla ?
Wa inta titwakkal aleyah achaan gudurtah al‑chadiidewa tikhalli leyah kulla khidimtak walla ?
Hal hu yagdar yijiib leek intaajakwa yilimmah fi l‑madagg walla ?
Janaahe al‑naʼaam yilmattato be suhuulawa laakin ma indah riich wa la suuf abunkhanam.
Al‑naʼaamaay talda beedhawa tikhalliih fi l‑turaabwa hamu al‑turaab yifaggiʼah.
Hi tansa kadar rijil insaan tikassirahaw rijil haywaan tafjakhah.
Hi jafiiye le iyaalha misil ma hineehawa ma lammaaha kan taʼabha yamchi fi l‑riih saakit kula.
Achaan al‑Rabb ma antaaha hikmawa hi ma ligat gisimha hana l‑maʼrafa.
Wa laakin wakit hi tugumm wa tajri,tichchammat le l‑juwaad wa siidah.
Ya Ayyuub,inta tagdar tanti al‑gudra le l‑juwaadwa tikhatti ragabatah be safiife walla ?
Tinattitah misil jaraad walla ?La !Hanhiniinah al‑chadiid bikhawwif.
Wa fi l‑waadi,hu yudugg rijileenah.Hu farhaan be gudurtah,yamrug giddaam al‑adu.
Yichchammat le l‑khoof wa ma yinbahitwa ma yiʼarrid min al‑duwaas.
Foogah tinsamiʼ harakat al‑kalootawa l‑harba al‑tiraari wa l‑tabiig.
Al‑juwaad yinattitmin chiddit niiytah le l‑jariwa ma yagdar yasburwakit yasmaʼ al‑buug.
Ayyi wakit al‑buug yadrub,hu yihanhin wa yuguul : Aywa ! Min baʼiid,hu yuchumm al‑haribwa yasmaʼ huraaj al‑kubaaraat wa korooraak al‑harib.
Hal be sabab irfitak inta bas,al‑sagur yimidd janaaheehwa yitiir ale l‑junuub walla ?
Hal be amrak inta bas,al‑sagur yisawwi uchchah fi l‑aʼaali walla ?
Hu yaskun wa yunuum fi l‑jibaal,aywa,fi bakaan gawi fi raas al‑jibaal.
Min al‑bakaan da,yiraakhib fariistahwa min baʼiid,uyuunah yichiifuuha.
Iyaalah yaakulu al‑dammwa fi ayyi rimme,hu yinlagi.
Wa Allah hajja battaan le Ayyuub wa gaal :
Al‑yikhaasimyichaariʼ maʼa l‑Gaadir walla ?Wa l‑yachki al‑Rabbyuguul leyah chunu ?
Wa Ayyuub radda le Allah wa gaal :
Ana al‑ma nisaawi cheyy,nagdar nurudd leek walla ?La !Nisidd khachmi.
Ana hajjeet marra,battaan ma nurudd.Hajjeet marrateenwa ma niziid cheyy.
Wa Allah hajja battaan le Ayyuub min lubb al‑riih al‑chadiide wa gaal :
Arbut sulbak misil raajil fahal !Ana nasʼalak wa inta,turudd leyi.
Inta tidoor tibattil chariiʼti walla ?Wa tidoor tisawwiini khaati achaan tibarri nafsak walla ?
Inta indak gudra misil gudurti ana al‑Rabb walla ?Wa hissak misil raʼad yichaabih hissi walla ?
Kan misil da,jammil nafsak be majd wa kibriyawa albas al‑azama wa l‑charaf.
Be mooj khadabak,khatti kulla l‑naaswa be nazra waahide,nazzil al‑mustakbiriin !
Chiif kulla l‑mustakbiriin wa dangirhumwa fi bakaanhum da bas,dammirhum !
Adfinhum kulluhum fi l‑turaabwa asjinhum fi l‑khubuur !
Wa be da,khalaas ana zaati nafrah beekachaan iidak al‑zeene najjatak !
Daahu Bahimoot al‑ana khalagtah misil khalagtak inta.Hu yaakul gechch misil toor.
Gudurtah fi sulbahwa khuwwatah fi asab batnah.
Hu yiwaggif danabah foog misil uud al‑arzwa asab dawaarjah madfuur.
Udaamah misil hawaadir hana nahaaswa sufaafah misil hadiid.
Hu amal al‑muhimmal‑sawwaah al‑Rabbwa ma fi al‑yinnasir foogahilla hu al‑khalagah.
Wa maʼaachah yaji leyah min al‑jibaalwa da l‑bakaan al‑yilimmu foogahkulla haywaanaat al‑kadaade.
Bahimoot da yargud tihit al‑tibinwa yillabbad tihit ageeg margad almi.
Al‑tibin yikhattiih be dullahwa gana al‑wudyaan yihawwigah.
Kan almi jaari chadiid kula,ma yikhawwifahwa kan bahar al‑Urdun yajri be chidde fi khachmah kula,hu ma lammaah.
Hal naadum yagdar yakurbahmin giddaam walla ?Aw yarmiih fi l‑charakwa yigidd munkharah walla ?
Hal tagdar takrub Luyaataan be jambaatwa tarbut lisaanah be habil walla ?
Hal tagdar tidiss habil fi munkharahwa tigidd chidgah be jambaat kabiir walla ?
Hal hu yagdar yachhadakwa yihajji leek kalaam halu walla ?
Wa yisawwi maʼaak alaakha walla ?Inta tagdar tiʼabbidah le muddit hayaatah walla ?
Hal tagdar talʼab maʼaayah misil teeraaywa tarbutah le banaatak yalʼaban beyah walla ?
Hal al‑muchtarikiin yukhuttuuh le l‑beeʼwa yigassumuuh ambeenaat al‑tujjaar walla ?
Hal tagdar titaʼʼin farwitah be huraabwa raasah be kookaab walla ?
Wa laakin kan dawwart takurbah be iidak,tizzakkar fahaaliiytahwa battaan ma tilammisah.
Giddaamah,ayyi naadum achamah yingatiʼwa l‑yichiifah,al‑khoof yakurbah.
Wa ma fi naadum yagdar yujukhkhah.Wa kan misil da,yaatu yagdar yagiif giddaami ana al‑Rabb ?
Yaatu dayyanaani cheyyle nigabbilah leyah ?Achaan kulla cheyy al‑gaaʼid tihit al‑sama hanaayi ana !
Ana ma naskut fi chaan Luyaataanwa nikallim be iideenah wa rijileenahwa gudurtah al‑aziime wa chaklah al‑jamiil.
Yaatu yagdar yaslakh farwitah ?Wa yaatu yadkhul ambeenaat sawaalfah ?
Wa yaatu yagdar yaftah khachmah ?Achaan sunuunah zaatah bikhawwufu.
Wa daharah mukhattabe riigaan hana daragal‑mulassagiin be nizaam.
Al‑waahid mulassag maʼa l‑aakharlahaddi riih kula ma tufuut ambeenaathum.
Humman marbuutiin al‑waahid maʼa l‑aakharwa lammiin ambeenaathum ma yinfargu.
Wakit yiʼattich,yamrug minnah nuurwa uyuunah yiraarumisil nuur al‑sabaah.
Wa deyy yamrug min khachmahwa charaar al‑naar yamrug minnah.
Wa dukhkhaan yamrug min munkharahmisil bookh al‑burma al‑hajjo naarha.
Wa nafasah yigabbid naarwa ambalbaala tamrug min khachmah.
Wa l‑gudra gaaʼide fi ragabatahwa l‑khoof yajri giddaamah.
Jildah mutabbag wa mulassag ambeenaatahwa gaaʼid foogah gawi ma yilharrak.
Galbah gawi misil al‑hajarwa gawi misil al‑murhaaka.
Giddaam azamatah,al‑kubaaraat yakrubhum al‑khoofwa min chiddit al‑barjaal,yiʼarrudu.
Wa l‑yigarrib leyah,seefah ma yanfaʼahwa haribtah wa tabiigahwa dirʼah kula ma yanfaʼooh.
Aywa !Luyaataan yajʼal al‑hadiid misil al‑ageegwa l‑nahaas misil uud al‑musawwis.
Al‑nuchchaab ma yaturdahwa hujaar al‑miglaaʼ leyah misil ageeg.
Hu yajʼal al‑asa misil ageegaaywa yichchammat le suffaarit al‑harba wakit tufuut.
Farwit batnah misil musmaar tariinwa derbah fi l‑tiine misil derib al‑harraata.
Wa yiharrik al‑almi misil gaaʼid yufuurwa l‑almi yilkhayyar wa yabga rikhwe.
Wa yikhalli waraayah derib waadihwa almi al‑khariig yabga abyad misil suuf al‑chaayib.
Khalaas fi l‑ard,ma fi mislahwa hu makhluug bala khoof.
Wa yahgirkulla l‑makhluugiin al‑mutakabbiriinwa hu malikfoog kulla l‑haywaanaat al‑fasliin.
Wa khalaas,Ayyuub radda le Allah wa gaal :
Ana naʼarifinta tagdar tisawwi kulla cheyywa ma fi waahide min afkaarakal‑ma tilhaggag.
Inta saʼaltini wa gult : Yaatu al‑ma yikhalli niiyti tabga waadhe bala maʼrafa ? Sahiih,ana bala fihim gult achya ajiibiinal‑yufuutuuni wa ma naʼarifhum.
Inta saʼaltini wa gult : Asmaʼni,ana nikallim leekwa nasʼalak wa inta turudd leyi. 
Ana simiʼtak be adaaniwa chiftak be eeni.
Fi chaan da,ana nidimt le kalaami wa tubtwa sabbeet fi raasi turaab wa rumaad.
Wa baʼad Allah gaal al‑kalaam da le Ayyuub,hu wajjah kalaamah le Alifaaz min balad Teemaan wa gaal : Khadabi bigi chadiid diddak inta wa didd rufgaanak al‑itneen achaan intu ma hajjeetu beyi be kalaam sahiih misil kalaam abdi Ayyuub.
Wa be sabab da,chiilu sabʼa toor wa sabʼa kabich wa amchu algooh le abdi Ayyuub wa gaddumu al‑bahaayim dool dahiiye muharraga.Wa abdi Ayyuub yasʼal leeku.Wa fi chaanah hu bas,ana ma nisawwi foogku hasab tamaasitku.Wa intu ma hajjeetu beyi be kalaam sahiih misil kalaam abdi Ayyuub. 
Wa khalaas,Alifaaz min balad Teemaan wa Bildad min Chuuha wa Suufar min Naʼama macho wa sawwo misil Allah al‑Rabb amaraahum beyah.Wa Allah khibil suʼaal Ayyuub.
Wa wakit Ayyuub saʼal Allah fi chaan rufgaanah,Allah gabbal leyah kulla khumaamah misil awwal da,marrateen.
Wa kulla akhwaanah wa akhwaatah wa naas maʼrafatah al‑zamaan jo zaarooh.Humman akalo maʼaayah fi beetah wa hanno foogah wa kaffaro leyah min kulla l‑bala al‑nazzalah foogah Allah.Wa ayyi waahid minhum antaah le Ayyuub hajar fudda wa khaatim hana dahab.
Wa Allah baarak al‑siniin al‑akhiiriin hana Ayyuub ziyaada min siniinah al‑awwal wa hu ligi 14 000 khanam wa 6 000 jumaal wa 2 000 jooz hana bagar wa 1 000 hamiir anaati.
Wa battaan wilid wa jaab sabʼa awlaad wa talaata banaat.
Al‑awwal sammaaha Yamiima wa l‑taani sammaaha Khasiiʼa wa l‑taalit sammaaha Garn Hafuuk.
Wa fi kulla l‑balad,ma fi awiin jamiilaat misil banaat Ayyuub wa abuuhin antaahin warasa maʼa akhwaanhin.
Wa baʼad da,Ayyuub aach 140 sana wa hu chaaf iyaalah wa iyaal iyaalah lahaddi l‑zurriiye al‑raabʼe.
Wa wakit bigi chaayib wa chibiʼ min al‑dunya,hu maat.
Mabruuk le l‑naadum al‑ma yitaabiʼ wasiiyat al‑hawaaniinwa ma yichiil tariig al‑muznibiinwa ma yagood maʼa l‑chammaatiin.

Maala al‑umam atmarrado ?Wa maala al‑chuʼuub yilʼaamaro fi l‑ma indah faayde ?

Ya Allah !Inta tidammir al‑kaddaabiinwa kattaaliin al‑dimam wa l‑khachchaachiin,tajʼalhum misil muharramiin.

Ya Allah !Guudni hasab adaaltakbe sabab udwaaniwa sahhil leyi derbak.

Ya Rabb !Ajʼalhum khaatiyiinwa khalliihum yagaʼo be sabab muʼaamarathum !Atrudhum be sabab jaraayimhum al‑katiiriinachaan humman isook.

Ya Allah !Ahdiini bala zaʼalwa addibni bala khadab !
Arhamni,ya Allah,achaan ana ma indi gudra.Achfiini,ya Allah,achaan udaami maaʼo.
Ana ninbahit ziyaada min daakhal galbi.Wa da le mata,ya Allah ?
Taʼaal,ya Allah !Khallisniwa be rahmatak,najjiini !

Ana iyiit min chiddit al‑ganitiinwa dumuuʼi yuruchchu furaachiwa kulli leele,yibillu sariiri.
Wa uyuuni diʼfo min al‑hizinwa be sabab kulla l‑yidaayuguuni.
Kissu minni baʼiid,intu kulluku al‑tisawwu al‑zulumachaan Allah simiʼ bakiiyi !
Aywa,Allah simiʼ duʼaayiwa Allah khibil salaati.

Achaan ana khaayif yadurbuuni misil al‑diidaanwa yigattuʼu jismi wa ma fi naadum al‑yikhallisni.

aw sawweet al‑fasaala le siid zeeniaw bala sabab nahabt khasiimi,

Gumm,ya Allah,wa akhdab !Gumm didd zaʼal al‑khusmaani !Inta al‑amart be l‑adil,fakkir foogi !
Khalli mujtamaʼ al‑chuʼuub yilimmu giddaamakwa min bakaanak al‑aali,ahkim fooghum !
Ya Allah,inta al‑tichaariʼ al‑chuʼuub !Ya Allah,chaariʼni hasab adaalti wa kamaali.
Waggif fasaalit al‑aasiyiin !Wa sabbit naas al‑saalihiin !Ya l‑Ilaah al‑saadikh !Inta al‑takchif al‑galibwa fikir al‑insaan.
Al‑Rabb hu daragatiwa munajji al‑saalihiin.
Allah Al‑Rabb hu gaadi saadikhwa yiwassif khadabah kulla yoom.
Wa kan al‑insaan ma yutuub,Allah yitarrig seefahwa yajbid nubbaalah wa yisawwibah.
Wa yijahhiz silaah al‑mootwa yisawwi nachaachiib al‑yiharrugu.
Daahu al‑yakhlab be l‑charrwa yahmal be l‑fasaala,yalda al‑kidib.

Ana nachkur Allah fi chaan adaaltahwa namdah usum Allah al‑Aali.
Ya Allah !Ya Rabbina !Usmak aziim fi kulla l‑ard !Inta wassaft majdak foog fi l‑sama.
Al‑atfaal wa l‑bardaʼo majjadowa be majjidiinhum,inta hazamt aduukle tisakkit khusmaanak !
Wakit ana chift khaliigit samaawaatakwa l‑gamar wa katarat nujuumak,
ana gult fi nafsi chunu al‑insaanwa maala tifakkir foogah ?Wa Bani Adam,hu chunuwa maala tihimm beyah ?
Laakin inta sawweetah tihit min al‑malaaʼikawa anteetah azama wa charaf.
Anteetah sulta le yahkim fi kulla makhluugiinakwa khatteet kulla cheyy tihit rijileenah,
kulla l‑khanam wa l‑bagarwa kulla haywaanaat al‑kadaade
wa kulla tuyuur al‑sama wa huut al‑baharwa kulla cheyy al‑aayich fi l‑almi.
Ya Allah !Ya Rabbina !Usmak aziim fi kulla l‑ard !
Ya Allah,ana nachkurak be kulla galbiwa nihajji be kulla ajaaybak.
Nafrah beek wa ninbasitwa nikhanni be usmak,ya Allah al‑Aali !
Wakit udwaani yiʼarrudu,humman yittartaʼowa yiddammaro giddaamak.
Achaan inta chilt daliimtiwa daafaʼt le huguugi.Inta gaaʼid fi archakwa tahkim be l‑adil.
Inta haddadt al‑umamwa dammart al‑aasiyiin.Wa gachcheet usumhumdaayman wa ila l‑abad.
Al‑adu bigi ma fiihwa kharaabhum bigi daayim.Wa l‑mudun al‑inta dammartuhum,battaan ma yizzakkaroohum.
Laakin Allah gaaʼid ila l‑abadwa sabbat archah le yichaariʼ.

Ya Allah !Arhamni wa chiif taʼabial‑sawwooh leyi al‑yakrahooni,ya inta al‑maragtini min al‑moot.

Khalli al‑aasiyiin yigabbulu fi l‑haawiye !Aywa,kulla l‑umam al‑niso al‑Rabb.

Ya Allah,gumm !Ma tikhalli al‑insaan yinnasirwa khalli al‑umam yilʼaakhabo giddaamak !

Maala tibaʼʼid,ya Allah ?Wa maala ma tibiin fi wakt al‑diige ?

Wa yuguul fi nafsah : Ana ma nilbarjalwa ana mahfuud daayman min al‑fasaala. 
Wa kalaamah illa laʼana wa khachch wa unufwa fi lisaanah,taʼab wa fasaala.

Hu kaaris fi bakaan tarafmisil duud fi nugurtah.Hu kaaris le yikhaffil al‑miskiinwa yakrub al‑miskiin wa yarmiih fi charakah.

Maala al‑aasi yiʼayyir al‑Rabb ?Wa maala yuguul fi nafsah : Inta ma tiʼaakhib !

Chiif !Al‑aasiyiin jabado nubbaalhumwa sabbato al‑nuchchaab fi l‑habil fi l‑dalaamle yazurguuh fi l‑naas al‑galibhum adiil.

Wa laakin Allah fi beetah al‑mukhaddas.Allah fi archah fi l‑samaawaat wa yichiifwa yijarrib Bani Adam.

Wa kalaam Allah saafimisil al‑fudda al‑gataʼoohawa saffooha sabʼa marraat.
Ya Allah,inta tahfad al‑mazluumiinwa tahmiina ila l‑abad.
Al‑aasiyiin yiliffu fi kulla bakaanwakit al‑fasaala tiziid ambeen al‑naas.
Le mata,ya Allah,tansaani daayman ?Le mata taaba ma tiwajjih wijhak aleyi ?
Le mata nagood be hammwa be hizin fi galbi kulla yoom ?Le mata aduuyi yinnasir foogi ?
Chiif wa rudd leyi,ya Allah Ilaahi !Khalli uyuuni waaʼiyiin fi l‑hayaachaan ma nunuum noom al‑moot,
wa aduuyi ma yuguul hu annasar foogiwa khusmaani ma yafraho be wagaʼaani.
Laakin ana muʼaamin be rahmatakwa ana farhaan be najaatak.

Al‑mataamiis gaalo fi nufuushum : Ma fi Ilaah ! Humman tallafo wa sawwo amal muharramwa ma fi naadum al‑yisawwi al‑kheer.
Min al‑sama,Allah chaaf Bani Adamle yichiif kan naadum waahid minhum aagilal‑yifattichah hu al‑Rabb.
Kulluhum sawa baʼʼado wa waddaro,ma fi naadum al‑yisawwi al‑kheerwa la waahid.
Al‑yisawwu al‑zulumma induhum al‑maʼrafa walla ?Humman yaakulu chaʼabi misil yaakulu al‑khubzawa ma yachhado Allah.
Wa daahu humman gaaʼidiin yarjufuachaan al‑Rabb gaaʼid fi fariig al‑saalihiin.

Yaatu min Sahyuunyanti al‑naja le Israaʼiil ?Wakit Allah yigabbil chaʼabah min al‑khurba,zurriiyit Yaakhuub yinbastuwa zurriiyit Israaʼiil yafraho.
Ya Allah,yaatu yagdar yadkhul fi beetak ?Yaatu yaskun fi jabalak al‑mukhaddas ?
Hu al‑naadum al‑kaamilal‑yisawwi al‑adaalawa min galbah yuguul al‑hagg.

Gursah be riba ma yidayyinahwa ma yichiil rachwawa la yazlum al‑bari fi l‑chariiʼa.Al‑naadum al‑yisawwi misil dayiʼiich daayman be amaan.
Ya Ilaahi !Ahfadniachaan ana lajaʼt leek.

Ya Allah !Inta gismi wa nasiibi wa kaas charaabiwa inta bas tikharrir kikkeef ana niʼiich fi derbak.

Ya Allah !Sawwi al‑adaala,asmaʼ chakwiti,asmaʼ salaatiwa da bala khachch !

Ya Ilaah,ana naadeetak achaan turudd leyi.Asmaʼni wa asmaʼ kalaami.

Gumm,ya Allah,haarib al‑aasi wa dangir raasah !Wa be seefak,najjiini minnah !
Ya Allah,najjiini be iidak min al‑insaan,min naas al‑dunya al‑hagguhum fi l‑haya di.Amla butuunhum be l‑jahhaztah leehumlahaddi iyaalhum kula yachbaʼo beyahwa yikhallu al‑fadle le zurriiyithum.

Ya Allah !Ana nihibbak,inta gudurti !

Ana sarakht wa gult : Al‑hamdulillah !Allah najjaani min udwaani. 
Guyuud al‑moot karabooniwa seel al‑halaak khawwafni.
Guyuud al‑haawiye hawwagooniwa churukka al‑moot gaaʼidiin giddaami.
Fi l‑diige,naadeet Allahaywa,sarakht le Ilaahiwa min beetah al‑mukhaddas hu simiʼni,hu simiʼ hiss siraakhi.
Al‑ard anhazzat wa rajafatwa asaas al‑jibaal anhazza wa barjalachaan ma himlo khadab Allah al‑chadiid.
Min manaakhirah yatlaʼ dukhkhaanwa min khachmah tamrug naar al‑taakulal‑indaha jamur al‑yahrig.

Hu rikib fi makhluug samaawi wa taarwa be janaahe al‑riih,haam.
Wa allabbad fi dalaamal‑muhawwig misil kheemtahwa da dalaam almiwa l‑sahaab al‑azrag al‑chaayil.
Giddaamah nuur chadiidal‑yamrug minnah sahaabwa barad wa jamur al‑yahrig.
Fi l‑sama,Allah dagdag.Hu al‑Aali wa hissah ansamaʼbe barad wa jamur yahrig.
Hu zarrag nachaachiibah le udwaaniwa chattataahumbe katarat al‑barg al‑chadiidwa hazamaahum.
Min chiddit zaʼalak,ya Allah,wa min hamu riih al‑jaaye minnak,gaʼar al‑bahar baanwa asaas al‑dunya ankachaf.
Wa min foog,madda iidah rafaʼniwa min al‑almi al‑katiir,maragaani.
Najjaani min udwaani al‑chudaadwa min khusmaani al‑gawiyiin minni.
Wa yoom al‑masiibe wagaʼat foogi,humman hajamoonilaakin Allah fazaʼni.
Wa hu maragaani min al‑khutuura wa harraraani,hu najjaani achaan yiriidni.
Allah yiʼaamilni hasab adaaltiwa yikaafiini hasab salaamat iideeni.
Achaan ana taabaʼt derib Allahwa ma isiit Ilaahi.
Aywa,ana tabbagt kulla churuutahwa abadan ma tarraft min gawaaniinah.

Ya Allah !Kheerak katiiral‑hafadtah le l‑naas al‑yakhaafo minnak.Wa tantiih le l‑yaljaʼo leekgiddaam kulla l‑naas.
Wa inta tilabbidhum fi hadaratak,baʼiid min muʼaamarat al‑insaanwa tahfadhum fi maskanak,baʼiid min hujuum al‑lisaan.
Baarak Allah !Achaan hu wassaf leyi rahmatah al‑ajiibefi madiina muhaasara.
Wa fi barjalati,ana gult : Ana matruud baʼiid min hadaratak ! Wa laakin inta simiʼt chihidtiwakit koorakt le l‑fazaʼ.
Hibbu Allah,intu al‑muʼminiin beyah !Allah yahfad al‑amiiniin.Wa laakin le l‑mustakbiriinyihaasibhum be amalhum.
Abgo chudaad wa fahaliinintu kulluku al‑induku acham fi Allah.

Mabruuk le l‑naadumal‑Allah ma yajʼalah khaatiwa ma indah khiyaana fi galbah.
Wakit ma aʼtaraft be zanbi,al‑wajaʼ zaad fi udaamiwa ganatt tuul al‑yoom.

Wa khalaas,ana kallamt leek be zanbiwa ma labbadt khataayi.Wa gult : Ya Rabb,ana aʼtaraft be isyaani. Wa inta,ya Allah,khafart leyi khataayi wa zanbi.Wagfa.
Achaan da,kulla muʼmin waajib yasʼalak fi wakt al‑diigewa be da,hu yanja akiid min al‑kharag al‑chadiid.

Wa Allah gaal : Naʼam.Ana niʼallimakwa niwassifak al‑tariig al‑tichiilahwa niwassiik wa nifakkir fiik.

Al‑azaab al‑ziyaada yarja al‑aasiwa laakin al‑indah fi Allah damaan yalga al‑amaan.
Afraho be Allah wa khannu,ya l‑saalihiin !Wa wassufu farahku,ya l‑aadiliin !
Ya l‑saalihiin !Zakhrutu le Allah min al‑farah !Hamd Allah yiwaafig maʼa l‑naas al‑adiiliin.

Hu jamaʼ almi al‑bahar fi bakaan waahidwa lamma almi al‑muhiitaat fi khazzaan.

Achaan be kilmitah,kulla cheyy kaanwa be amrah,kulla cheyy bigi.

Ya iyaali,taʼaalu wa asmaʼowa ana niʼallimku al‑khoof min Allah.

Khalli deribhum yabga adlam wa amzahalootawakit malak Allah yatrudhum !

Ya Rabb,kikkeef tahmal al‑cheyy da ?Najji ruuhi min damaarhumwa najji nafsi min al‑diidaan dool !

Ya Allah !Rahmatak gaaʼide fi l‑samawa sidkhak yamchi lahaddi l‑sahaab.

Achaan humman misil al‑gechch al‑yamrad ajalawa misil al‑ziraaʼa al‑taybas.
Atwakkal ale Allah wa sawwi al‑kheerwa fi l‑balad,taskun be amaan.

Agood saakit giddaam Allahwa khutt achamak foogah.Wa ma tazʼal didd al‑yanjah fi tariigahwa la didd al‑naadum al‑yisawwi muʼaamara.

Achaan al‑fasliin,yafsuluuhumwa laakin al‑yukhuttu achamhum fi Allah yawrusu al‑ard.
Baʼad chiyya,al‑aasi yabga ma fiih.Kan tifattichah fi bakaanah,ma talgaah fi ayyi bakaan.
Wa laakin al‑masaakiin yawrusu al‑ardwa yafraho be salaam katiir.
Al‑aasi yikhattit didd al‑saalihwa diddah hu,yiʼaddi sunuunah.

Najaat al‑saalihiin jaaye min Allah,hu maljaʼhum fi wakt al‑diige.

Asmaʼ salaati wa siraakhi,ya Allah !Asmaʼ bakiiyi wa ma taaba !Achaan ana misil ajnabi fi bakaanakwa deef misil kulla juduudi.

Aʼarfu gudrat al‑Rabbwa azamatah al‑fi Israaʼiilwa gudurtah al‑gaaʼide fi l‑sahaab.
Ya Rabb,inta al‑tikhawwifmin beetak al‑mukhaddas.Ya Rabb Bani Israaʼiil,inta al‑tantigudra wa sulta le chaʼabak.Ahmudu al‑Rabb !
Ya Rabb,afzaʼni !Achaan almi gariib yazrutni.
Ana wagaʼt fi wahale ma indaha haddwa ma nagdar namrug.Ana wagaʼt fi almi khariigwa l‑seel chaalni.
Ana iyiit min al‑munaadawa halguumi yibis.Wa uyuuni diʼfowakit narja Ilaahi.
Al‑yakrahooni bala sabab,humman aktar min suuf raasi.Wa l‑yidooru yidammuruuni,humman chudaad.Wa bala sababbigo udwaani.Wa l‑cheyy al‑ana ma sirigtah,nagdar nigabbilah walla ?
Ya Rabbi !Inta taʼarif gillit fihimiwa khataayi ma mulabbad leek.
Khalli al‑yukhuttu achamhum foogakma yalgo ayyi eeb be sababi,ya Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir !Wa khalli al‑yifattuchuukma yakhjalo be sababi,ya Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil !
Wa fi chaanak inta,nahmal al‑muʼyaar.Wa fi chaanak inta,al‑eeb yikhattiini.
Wa bigiit deef le akhwaaniwa ajnabi le iyaal ammi.
Achaan hubbi le beetakbigi leyi misil naar haragatni.Wa l‑yiʼayyuruuk,muʼyaarhum wagaʼ foogi.
Bakeet wa sumt be kulla niiytiwa da jaab leyi al‑muʼyaar.
Ana libist khulgaan al‑hizinwa humman achchammato foogi.
Wa naas fi baab al‑madiina yihajju beyiwa ana bigiit khinneeye le l‑sakkaara.
Laakin daahu niwajjih leek salaati,ya Allah,wa da l‑wakit al‑munaasib,ya Rabbi !Be rahmatak al‑kabiire,rudd leyiwa be sidkhak,najjiini !
Amrugni min al‑tiinewa khalli battaan ma nagaʼ.Wa najjiini min al‑yakrahooniwa min almi al‑khariig.
Khalli almi al‑seel ma yichiilniwa l‑bahar al‑khariig ma yazrutniwa l‑biir ma tinsadda foogi.
Rudd leyi,ya Allah,achaan niʼmatak samha !Wa be rahmatak al‑kabiire,wajjih aleyi !
Ma taaba !Wajjih aleyi ana abdak.Ajala rudd leyiachaan ana gaaʼid fi l‑diige.
Garrib leyi wa afdaaniwa najjiini min udwaani !
Inta taʼarif al‑muʼyaar al‑muwajjah leyiwa l‑eeb wa l‑ihaana al‑foogiwa waddiriin charafi.Wa kulla l‑yidaayuguunigaaʼidiin giddaamak.
Al‑muʼyaar chagga galbiwa ana bigiit mardaan.Wa gult akuun nalga minhum mahannalaakin ma chift cheyy.Wa l‑yisabburuuni kula,ana ma ligiithum.
Udwaani sabbo samm fi akliwa le yisillu atachi,zagooni be almi haamud.
Khalli dabalaayithum tabga leehumcharak giddaamhumwa le l‑induhum maʼaahum salaam,khalli tabga leehum amkajjaama.
Khalli uyuunhum yitoochuchuwa battaan ma yichiifuwa daayman aksir duhuurhum !
Nazzil fooghum khadabakwa khalli zaʼalak al‑muhrig yalhaghum !
Wa khalli furgaanhum yakhrabowa khiyamhum yabgo faadiyiin min al‑sukkaan !
Achaan humman taaradoal‑inta darabtahwa hajjo be taʼab al‑naasal‑inta taʼʼabtuhum.
Khalliihum yagaʼo min khata fi khatawa ma yalgo derib yadkhulu fi adaaltak.
Khalli yinmahu min kitaab al‑hayawa ma yinkatbu maʼa l‑saalihiin.
Wa ana miskiin wa mubarjalwa be najaatak ahfadni,ya Ilaahi !
Ana nimajjid usum al‑Rabb be khinewa niʼalliih be chukur.
Wa da adiil le Allah ziyaada min al‑toorwalla min al‑ijil be guruunah wa dalaafeeh.
Wa l‑masaakiin yichiifu najaatiwa yafraho.Wa l‑yifattuchu al‑Rabb,khalli guluubhum yahyo.
Achaan Allah yasmaʼ al‑daʼiifiinwa ma yahgir naasah al‑masaajiin.
Khalli al‑ard wa l‑sama wa l‑buhuurwa kulla cheyy al‑fooghum,yimajjuduuh.
Achaan al‑Rabb yinajji jabal Sahyuunwa yabni battaan hillaal balad Yahuuza.Wa chaʼabah yaskunu fooghumwa yawrusuuhum.
Wa zurriiyit abiidahyalgoohum warasa.Wa l‑yihibbu usmahyaskunu fooghum.
Ya Rabb,najjiini !Ya Allah,taʼaal ajala afzaʼni !
Al‑yidooru mooti,khalli al‑eeb wa l‑chamaate yakurbuuhum !Wa l‑yihibbu leyi al‑charr,khalli yiʼarrudu wa yakhjalo !
Wa l‑yichchammato leyi,khalli yigabbulu be l‑eeb !
Wa kulla l‑yifattuchuuk,khalli yafraho wa yinbastu beek !Wa kulla l‑inta najjeethum,khalli yuguulu daayman : Allah hu akbar ! 
Laakin ana taʼbaan wa miskiin.Ya Rabb,taʼaal leyi ajala,inta fazaʼi wa najaati !Ya Allah,ma tiʼakhkhir !
Ya Allah !Leek inta ana naljaʼ daayman,khalli ma nalga eeb.
Be adaaltak,najjiini !Khutt adaanak leyi wa najjiini !
Kuun leyi maljaʼ gawial‑nagdar naljaʼ leyah fi kulla wakit.Inta kharrart tinajjiiniachaan inta jabali wa bakaani al‑gawi.
Ya Ilaahi !Najjiini min iid al‑aasiaywa,min karbit al‑fasil wa l‑zaalim.
Ya Allah Rabbi !Inta bas al‑nukhutt foogak achamiwa ana atwakkalt aleek min subaayi.
Ana antakalt aleek min wildooniwa inta bas maragtini min batun ammiwa leek inta,nahmudak ila l‑abad.
Ana bigiit ajab le naas katiiriinlaakin inta maljaʼi al‑gawi.
Lisaani yahmudakwa kulla yoom,nimajjidak.
Hassaʼ wakit ana bigiit chaayib,ma tazgulni.Wa wakit gudurti kammalat,ma tikhalliini.
Achaan udwaani yihajju foogi.Aywa,al‑yiraakhubuuni yichchaawaro foogi.
Wa yuguulu : Al‑Rabb khallaah !Taaruduuh wa akurbuuhachaan ma fi al‑yikhallisah ! 
Ya Ilaahi,ma tibaʼʼid minni !Ya Rabbi,wajjih aleyiwa be surʼa,afzaʼni.
Khalli al‑yathamooni yalgo al‑eebwa yiddammaro.Wa l‑yidooru yisawwu leyi al‑charr,khalli al‑eeb yikhattiihum wa charafhum yiwaddir.
Daayman ana narja be achamwa nachkurak be khine.
Khachmi yihajji be adaaltakwa daayman yihajji be najaatakhumman al‑adadhum ma binhasib.
Ya Allah al‑Rabb !Ana naji wa nikhabbir be aʼmaalak al‑gawiyiinwa nizzakkar adaaltak inta bas.
Ya Rabb !Inta allamtini min subaayiwa lahaddi hassaʼ,ana gaaʼid nikhabbir be ajaaybak.
Hassaʼ,ana chayyabtwa suufi bigi abyad.Ya Rabb,ma tikhalliinilahaddi nikhabbir al‑zurriiye di be khuwwatakwa nikhabbir al‑yaju baʼadhum be gudurtak.
Wa adaaltak gaaʼide foog,ya Rabb,achaan inta sawweet achya kubaar.Ya Rabb,yaatu mislak ?
Inta wassaftini iddat marraatal‑diige wa l‑masaayib.Wa laakin baʼad da,tantiini al‑hayawa tamrugni min khatar al‑moot.
Tiziid azamatiwa battaan tihannisni.
Wa khalaas,ana nachkurak be amsibeybefi chaan amaanak,ya Ilaahi.Wa nadrub jigindiiye fi chaanak inta,ya Khudduus Israaʼiil !
Aywa,ana nadrub al‑jigindiiyewa be khachmi nikhanni min al‑farahachaan inta fadeet hayaati.
Wa battaan,lisaani yantugkulla yoom be adaaltak.Achaan al‑eeb wa l‑chamaate yakurbuuhum,humman al‑yidooru yisawwu leyi al‑charr.
Ya Rabb !Anti chariiʼtak le l‑malikwa adaaltak le wileed al‑malik.
Hu yichaariʼ chaʼabak be l‑adaalawa masaakiinak hasab al‑chariiʼa.
Wa min al‑jibaal,yanzil al‑salaamwa min al‑hujaar,tanzil al‑adaala le l‑chaʼab.
Wa l‑malik yahkim be l‑adaalafi l‑chaʼab al‑masaakiin.Wa yinajji iyaal al‑taʼbaaniinwa yarhak al‑zaalimiin.
Kan al‑harraay wa l‑gamar gaaʼidiin,al‑naas yakhaafo min al‑malikmin zurriiye le zurriiye.
Hu yanzil misil matara fi gechch al‑marʼawa misil almi al‑yuruchch al‑ard.
Wa fi ayyaam hukmah,al‑adaala tiziidwa kan al‑gamar gaaʼid da,al‑salaam yiziid.
Wa khalli hu yahkimmin al‑bahar al‑Mayyit lahaddi l‑bahar al‑Abyadwa min bahar al‑Furaat lahaddi aakhir al‑ard.
Wa sukkaan al‑sahara yaburku giddaamahwa udwaanah yisiffu al‑turaab.
Wa muluuk Tarchiich wa jazaayir al‑baharyijiibu leyah hadaaya.Wa muluuk Chaba wa Sabayikaffu miiri.
Wa kulla l‑muluuk yasjudu giddaamahwa kulla l‑umam yakhdumu leyah.
Achaan hu yinajji al‑taʼbaaniin al‑yikoorukuwa l‑masaakiin al‑ma induhum fazaʼ.
Hu yihinn fi l‑daʼiif wa l‑taʼbaanwa yinajji hayaat al‑taʼbaaniin.
Wa min al‑zulum wa l‑unuf,yafdaahumwa hayaathum di khaaliye leyah.
Khalli al‑malik yiʼiichwa yantuuh dahab Saba.Wa yisallu leyah daaymanwa yibaarukuuh kulla yoom.
Wa khalli al‑gameh yabga katiir fi l‑baladwa ganaadiilah yinhazzo fi ruuse al‑jibaalmisil fi jibaal Lubnaan wakit yinawwuru.Wa khalli al‑mudun yittawwaromisil gechch al‑kadaade.
Khalli usmah yagood ila l‑abadwa yuduum misil al‑harraay.Wa beyah hu,khalli al‑naas yilbaarakowa kulla l‑umam yinaaduuh mubaarak.
Baarak Allah al‑Rabb al‑hu Ilaah Israaʼiil,hu wiheedah bas yisawwi ajaayib !
Baarak Allah al‑usmah majiid ila l‑abadwa khalli kulla l‑ard tinmali be majdah.Aamiin !Aamiin !
Da kumaalit salaat Dawuud wileed Yassa.
Be l‑sahiih,al‑Rabb rahiim le Bani Israaʼiilwa le l‑naas al‑guluubhum saafiyiin.
Laakin ana kamaan,garrabt nittartaʼwa faddal leyi chiyya bas nagaʼ.
Achaan ana hasadt al‑mustakbiriinwa chift raahat al‑aasiyiin.
Achaan ma yalgo taʼab lahaddi moothumwa ajsaamhum sumaan.
Humman ma yatʼabomisil taʼab Bani Adamwa ma fi cheyy yadrubhummisil yadrub al‑naas al‑aakhariin.
Wa fi chaan da,al‑istikbaar bigi kijeel fi ragabathumwa l‑unuf bigi khalag al‑yaksiihum.
Wa min wujuuhhum al‑sumaan,uyuunhum bigo dugaagwa l‑fasil al‑fi guluubhumma indah hadd.
Humman yichchammatowa yijahhuzu al‑fasaala wa l‑zulumwa yihajju be istikbaar.
Wa be khuchuumhum,yiʼayyuru al‑samawa be lisaanhum,ma yikhallu muʼyaar fi l‑ard.
Wa hatta chaʼab Allah yamchu waraahumwa yifattuchu kalaamhum be katara misil almi.
Wa l‑aasiyiin yuguulu : Kikkeef al‑Rabb yaʼarfah ?Al‑Aali ma indah maʼrafa ! 
Aywa !Dool humman al‑aasiyiinal‑daayman ma induhum hammwa gaaʼidiin yiziidu khunaahum.
Bala faayde ana saffeet galbiwa hatteet khalagi le niwassif baraaʼti.
Wa be da kula,ana taʼbaan kulla yoomwa muʼaakhab kulli sabaah.
Wa kan gult nihajji misilhumkhalaas,ana bigiit khaayin le chaʼabak.
Wa ana fakkart le naʼarifwa laakin bigi leyi gaasi bilheen
lahaddi dakhalt beetak al‑mukhaddaswa khalaas,ana fihimt mustakhbalhum.
Be l‑sahiih,inta khatteethum fi bakaan amlasle yizzahlato wa yagaʼo fi l‑halaak.
Be surʼa,anbahato wa bigo ma fiihum,angachcho min al‑khariiʼe.
Ya Rabb !Yiwadduru misil hilimwakit tugumm didduhum.
Wakit galbi anjarahwa wakit hasseet be taʼne fi daakhili,
ana bigiit mukhaffalwa ma irift cheyywa giddaamak inta,ana bigiit misil bahiime.
Wa be da kula,ana daayman maʼaakwa inta karabt iidi al‑zeene.
Inta gaaʼid tuguudni hasab wasiiytakwa tiwaddiini fi majdak.
Ana nalga yaatu fi l‑sama,balaak inta ?Wa kan inta maʼaayi,ma niriid cheyy aakhar fi l‑ard !
Jismi addammar wa galbi kulalaakin al‑Rabb hu maljaʼ le nafsiwa warasati ila l‑abad.
Achaan al‑yibaʼʼudu minnak yiddammarowa inta tahlik ayyi waahid al‑yaabaak.
Wa kheeri ana,da wakit nigarrib le l‑Rabb.Wa wakit naljaʼ le Allah al‑Rabb,niballikh kulla khidimtah.
Ya Rabb,maala khalleetna ila l‑abad ?Wa maala khadabak yahrigna,aniina khanamak al‑tasrah beena ?
Azzakkar mujtamaʼak al‑inta azaltah min zamaanwa l‑gabiila al‑fadeetha le tukuun warasatak.Azzakkar jabal Sahyuun,al‑bakaan al‑inta sawweetah maskanak.
Amchi chiif al‑damaar al‑kaamilfi beetak al‑mukhaddas,al‑adu fatfat kulla cheyy.
Udwaanak ragragofi lubb al‑bakaan al‑nilimmu maʼaak foogahwa hinaak khatto alaamithum.
Humman bigo misil al‑yarfaʼo faashumle yagtaʼo chadar al‑khaaba.
Humman kassaro suwar manguuchiin hana khachabwa daggoohum be faas wa mitraga.
Wa dasso naar fi beetak al‑mukhaddas.Aywa,al‑bakaan al‑khatteet foogah usmak,ramooh wa ma jaʼalooh mukhaddas.
Wa gaalo ambeenaathum : Yalla !Nidammuruuhum kulluhum ! Wa fi l‑balad,harrago kulla l‑bakaanaatal‑nilimmu fooghum maʼa l‑Rabb.
Aniina ma chifna battaan alaamaat al‑Rabbwa ma fi anbiya.Wa fi usutna,ma fi naadumal‑yaʼarif al‑cheyy da yagood le mata.
Lahaddi mata,ya Rabb,al‑mudaayigiin yiʼayyuruuk ?Al‑udwaan yahguru usmak daayman walla ?
Maala karabt iidak ?Maala karabt zeenaaytak ?Arfaʼha wa kammilhum !
Ya Rabb !Inta maliki min zamaanwa inta bas al‑tijiib al‑naja fi l‑balad.
Wa be gudurtak,inta chaggeet al‑bahar itneenwa fi l‑almi,kassart raas khuul al‑bahar.
Aywa,inta rihikt ruuse Luyaataanwa sawweetah akil le l‑chaʼabal‑yaskunu fi l‑sahara.
Inta bas jarreet uyuun almi wa wudyaanwa inta bas yabbast buhuur al‑ma yikammulu.
Al‑leel wa l‑nahaar kulahumman hineeyak inta.Wa l‑gamar wa l‑harraay kula,inta khatteet ayyi waahid fi bakaanah.
Inta bas al‑khatteet huduud al‑ardwa l‑seef wa l‑chite kula,inta bas sawweethum.
Ya Allah,azzakkar !Al‑adu ayyarakwa l‑chaʼab al‑matmuus hagar usmak !
Ma tisallim chaʼabak le l‑adumisil gimriiye al‑tantiiha le l‑haywaanaat.Wa ma tansa daaymanhayaat masaakiinak.
Fakkir fi l‑muʼaahadaachaan al‑balad malaane be bakaanaat dulumwa dool bas bakaanaat al‑unuf.
Khalli al‑mazluumiin ma yakhjalowa khalli al‑masaakiin wa l‑daʼiifiin yachkuru usmak.
Gumm,ya Rabb,daafiʼ le hadafakwa fakkir fi l‑muʼyaar al‑jaayi leekdaayman min al‑mataamiis.
Ma tansa harakat udwaanakwa aayit al‑yugummu diddak be chidde.
Aniina nachkuruuk,ya Rabb,wa nachkuru usmak achaan inta gariibwa nihajju be ajaaybak.
Wa l‑Rabb gaal : Fi l‑wakit al‑nihaddidah,ana nihaakim be l‑hagg.
Wakit al‑ard tarjif be kulla sukkaanha,ma ana bas nisabbit asaasha walla ?Wagfa.
 Ana gult le l‑mustakbiriin :‹ Ma tistakbaro ! ›Wa gult le l‑aasiyiin :‹ Ma tarfaʼo ruuseeku !
Ma tarfaʼo ruuseeku foog ziyaadawa ma tihajju misil dawa la tihajju be raas gawi.› 
Achaan al‑azama ma tajimin al‑sabaah wa la min al‑kharibwa la min al‑sahara.
Achaan al‑Rabb hu bas al‑haakim.Hu yinazzil al‑waahid wa yarfaʼ al‑aakhar.
Allah kaarib fi iidah kaasmalaan be khamar al‑bisakkirwa da khadabah.Wa yacharbo minnah kulla l‑aasiyiinal‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑ard.Aywa,yacharbooh lahaddi aakhirah.
Wa ana kamaan nikhabbir daaymanwa nahmud Ilaah Yaakhuub al‑gaal :
 Nidalli ruuse al‑aasiyiinwa narfaʼ ruuse al‑saalihiin.
