Wa hinaak,hu kassar al‑nachaachiib wa l‑nubbaalwa l‑darag wa l‑seef wa l‑silaah.Wagfa.
Ya Allah,inta nuur aziimwa ziyaada min al‑jibaal al‑daaymiin.
Al‑askar al‑fahaliin chaaloohum misil khaniimewa naamo noom al‑moot.Wa kulla l‑rujaal al‑fahaliin doolma gidro yidaafuʼu le nufuushum.
Ya Ilaah Yaakhuub !Be sabab tahdiidak,siyaad al‑kheel wa kheelhum ma alharrako.
Inta al‑tikhawwif,yaatu al‑yagdar yagiif giddaamakfi wakit khadabak ?
Min al‑samaawaat,inta kharrart al‑ikhaabwa min al‑khoof,al‑ard gaaʼide saakit
wakit al‑Rabb yugumm le l‑chariiʼale yinajji masaakiin al‑ard.Wagfa.
Hatta zaʼal al‑insaan yiwassif majdakwa l‑ma yikhallu zaʼalhum yagoodu haznaaniin.
Sawwu nazir le Allah Ilaahkuwa timmuuh.Aywa,jiibu hadaayaaku le l‑Ilaah al‑bikhawwif,intu al‑muhawwigiinah.
Achaan hu yimaskin al‑kubaaraatwa yikhawwif muluuk al‑ard.
Le l‑Rabb,ana narfaʼ hissi wa nachhadah.Aywa,le l‑Rabb,ana narfaʼ hissi wa hu yasmaʼni.
Fi yoom diigti,ana fattacht al‑Rabbwa be l‑leel,maddeet iidi bala jummawa ma dawwart yisabburuuni.
Wakit azzakkart al‑Rabb,ganattwa kan fakkart ziyaada,nakhmar.Wagfa.
Inta bas ma khalleetni nunuumwa ana barjalt wa sakatt.
Ana fakkart fi l‑ayyaam al‑faatowa fi l‑siniin al‑zamaan.
Be l‑leel,ana azzakkart khineeyiwa galbi fakkarwa nafsi tasʼal wa tuguul :
 Hal al‑Rabb yaabaana daayman walla ?Hal abadan ma yakhbalna walla ?
Hal rahmatah waddarat marra waahid walla ?Hal kalaamah bigi ma fiih min zurriiye le zurriiye walla ?
Hal al‑Rabb nisi ma yarham walla ?Hal al‑zaʼal gaffal galbah walla ?Wagfa.
Ana nuguul wajaʼi : Iid Allah al‑Aalima tafzaʼna misil awwal ! 
Ana nizzakkar aʼmaal Allah.Aywa,ana nizzakkar ajaaybak al‑zamaan.
Wa ana nihajji be kulla afʼaalakwa nizzakkar fi aʼmaalak.
Ya Rabb,derbak mukhaddas !Fi ilaah akbar minnak walla ?
Inta al‑Ilaah al‑yisawwi al‑ajaayibwa arraft gudurtak been al‑umam.
Be iidak,inta fadeet chaʼabakzurriiyit Yaakhuub wa zurriiyit Yuusuf.Wagfa.
Kulla l‑buhuur chaafook,ya Rabb !Al‑almi chaafak wa alharrakhatta almi al‑khariig kula anhazza.
Al‑sahaab sabba almiwa l‑raʼad hissah ansamaʼ.Wa barraagtak tachlaʼmisil nachaachiib fi kulla bakaan.
Raʼadak dagdagwa barraagtak nawwarat al‑aalamwa l‑ard anhazzat wa rajafat.
Ya Rabb !Fi l‑bahar,inta sawweet tariigakwa fi l‑almi al‑khariig,sawweet dabaaliikwa ma fi naadum al‑yaʼarif derbak.
Inta gudt chaʼabak misil khanambe iid Muusa wa Haaruun.
Ya chaʼabi !Asmaʼo Tawraatiwa khuttu udneeku le kalaam khachmi.
Ana naftah khachmi be masalwa nihajji hije hana l‑zaman al‑faat
al‑simiʼnaah wa irifnaahwa l‑hajjooh leena abbahaatna.
Aniina ma nilabbuduuh min iyaalhumwa laakin le zurriiyithum al‑taji baʼadhum,nihajju leehum be hamd Allahwa gudurtah wa ajaaybah al‑hu sawwaahum.
Hu anta faraayid le zurriiyit Yaakhuubaywa,anta Tawraatah le Bani Israaʼiilwa amar juduudnayiʼarrufuuhum le iyaalhum.
Achaan yiʼarrufuuhum le l‑zurriiye al‑taji baʼadeenyaʼni iyaalhum al‑yaldoohum.
Wa yitwakkalo ale l‑Rabbwa ma yanso amalahwa yahfado gawaaniinah.
Achaan ma yabgo misil juduudhum,zurriiye haraamiiye wa aasiye,zurriiye al‑galibha ma saabitwa ma indaha iimaan be l‑Rabb.
Wa naas gabiilat Afraayim al‑musallahiinwa yaʼarfu zarigiin al‑nuchchaab,humman arrado fi yoom al‑harib.
Wa da achaan ma hafado muʼaahadat al‑Rabbwa abo ma yitaabuʼu Tawraatah.
Humman niso amalahwa ajaaybah al‑wassafaahum leehum.
Giddaam juduudhumal‑Rabb sawwa ajaayib,fi mantagat Suʼaan fi balad Masir.
Al‑Rabb chagga al‑bahar itneenle yigattiʼhumwa l‑almi wagaf jaay jaay leehummisil durdur.
Be l‑nahaar,hu yuguudhum be sahaabaaywa be l‑leel,be nuur hana naar.
Hu chagga al‑hujaar fi l‑saharale yazgiihum almibe kataramisil almi al‑khariig tihit al‑ard.
Wa min al‑jabal,hu marag almiwa da saal misil almi al‑buhuur.
Wa humman gammo battaan yaznubuwa iso Allah al‑Aali fi ard jafaaf.
Humman hajjo fi galibhum wa jarrabo al‑Rabbwa talabo minnah akilhum al‑yidooruuh.
Wa hajjo didd al‑Rabb wa gaalo : Allah yagdar yantiina akil fi l‑sahara walla ?
Sahiih,hu darab al‑hajarwa l‑almi jara minnah be katarawa bigi wudyaan katiiriin.Wa laakin hu yagdar yanti khubzawa yigaddim laham le chaʼabah walla ? 
Khalaas wakit Allah simiʼ kalaamhum,hu khidibwa naar khadabah gammat didd zurriiyit Yaakhuubaywa,ziʼil chadiid didd Bani Israaʼiil.
Achaan humman ma atwakkalo ale l‑Rabbwa ma aamano kadar hu yinajjiihum.
Wa khalaas,al‑Rabb amar al‑sahaab al‑foogwa fatah biibaan al‑samaawaat.
Hu nazzal matara hana mannale yiʼakkilhumwa antaahum gameh min al‑sama.
Wa ayyi naadum akal khubz misil khubz al‑malaaʼikawa l‑Rabb rassal leehum akil be katara.
Wa min al‑sama,al‑Rabb gawwam riih al‑sabaahwa be gudurtah,jaab riih al‑wati.
Wa misil yinazzil al‑matar be katara,hu nazzal leehum laham katiirmisil ajaaj al‑ard.Aywa,nazzal tuyuur be kataramisil ramla hana khachum al‑bahar.
Hu nazzalaahum leehum fi ust al‑fariigwa hawaale khiyamhum.
Humman akalo wa chibʼo marra waahidwa hu antaahum al‑cheyy al‑atmannooh.
Wa laakin munaahum ma tammahatta kan khuchuumhum malaaniin kula.
Wa tawwaali khadab al‑Rabbgamma didduhumwa katal fi usuthum al‑naas al‑chudaadaywa,kammal subyaan Israaʼiil.
Wa be da kula,humman gaaʼidiin yaznubu daaymanwa ma aamano be ajaaybah.
Khalaas,hu kammal ayyaamhum fi l‑riih saakitwa siniinhum fi l‑khoof.
Wa wakit al‑Rabb yaktulhum,humman yifattuchuuhwa yigabbulu yifattuchuuh be niiye.
Wa yizzakkaro kadar al‑Rabb,hu maljaʼhumwa yifakkuru kadar Allah al‑Aali,hu al‑yafdaahum.
Wa laakin be khuchuumhum,yukhuchchuuhwa be lisneehum,yakdubu leyah.
Wa guluubhum ma saabtiin foogahwa ma yitwakkalo ale muʼaahadatah.
Wa laakin hu al‑Rahiim khafar khataahumwa ma dammaraahumwa iddat marraat,hu ma khidib leehumwa ma gawwam kulla zaʼalah.
Wa fakkar kadar humman makhluugiin baswa ruuhhum tamrugwa abadan ma tigabbil.
Iddat marraat,humman isooh fi l‑saharawa khaddabooh fi bakaan jafaaf.
Wa battaan gammo jarrabo al‑Rabbwa khaddabo Khudduus Israaʼiil.
Humman niso al‑sawwatah iidah,fi l‑yoom al‑hu fadaahum min al‑adu.
Hu sawwa alaamaatah fi Masiraywa,ajaaybah fi mantagat Suʼaan.
Fi Masir,Allah chaglab al‑buhuur dammwa rujuulhum al‑jaariyiin kula,al‑Masriyiin ma gidro chirbo minhum.
Wa rassal didduhum dubbaan akalhumwa difdeʼ bachtanhum.
Hu sallam intaaj ziraaʼithum le l‑jaraadwa natiijat khidmithum le saar al‑leel.
Wa tallaf inabhum be l‑baradwa jimmeezhum be l‑barid al‑chadiid.
Wa sallam maalhum le l‑baradwa bahaayimhum le l‑raʼad.
Hu nazzal fi l‑Masriyiin zaʼalah al‑chadiidwa khadab wa zaʼal wa taʼabwa rassal malaaʼikatah hana l‑damaar.
Wa sahhal al‑derib le khadabahwa ma dahar minhum al‑mootwa sallam hayaathum le l‑waba.
Wa katal kulla awlaad al‑bikir hana l‑Masriyiinal‑humman zurriiyit Haamaywa,chaal awwal intaaj gudrithum.
Hu wadda chaʼabah misil khanamwa gaadaahum misil bahaayim fi l‑sahara.
Hu gaadaahum be amaanwa humman ma rajafowa l‑bahar khatta udwaanhum.
Hu wadda chaʼabah ale l‑ard al‑mukhaddasa,ale l‑jabal al‑iidah al‑zeene galaʼatah.
Hu tarad umam giddaamhumwa kaal al‑ard be hubaalwa gassamaaha leehum warasawa sakkan gabaayil Bani Israaʼiil fi buyuuthum.
Wa be da kula,jarrabo al‑Rabb al‑Aali wa isoohwa ma tabbago faraaydah.
Humman khalloohwa khaanooh misil juduudhumwa gabbalo misil al‑nuchchaabal‑yakhta hadafah.
Humman khaddaboohbe bakaanaathum al‑aaliyiin hana l‑ibaadawa be asnaamhum,gawwamo khiirtah.
Al‑Rabb simiʼ wa khidib chadiidwa rafadaahum marra waahid le Bani Israaʼiil.
Hu aba maskan al‑ibaada fi Chiiloohwa di l‑kheema al‑hu sakan foogha fi ust al‑naas.
Hu sallam sanduug al‑muʼaahadaal‑hu alaamat gudurtahwa jalaalah fi iid al‑udwaan.
Hu khidib didd warasatahwa sallam chaʼabah le l‑harib.
Al‑naar akalat al‑subyaanwa l‑banaat al‑udriiyaat,ma chakkaroohin battaan.
Wa rujaal al‑diin maato fi l‑haribwa araamilhum ma bakan.
Al‑Rabb gammamisil al‑naayim al‑gamma.Wa misil al‑faarisal‑lazzatah al‑khamar fi l‑harib,
hu darab udwaanah min warawa dassaahum fi eeb abadi.

Laakin azal gabiilat Yahuuzawa jabal Sahyuun al‑hu yihibbah.
Wa bana beetah al‑mukhaddasaali misil al‑samawa gawi misil al‑ardal‑hu assasah ila l‑abad.

Min wara l‑khanam hu jaabahwa sawwaah raaʼile chaʼabah zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa le warasatah Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Dawuud raʼaahum be galib mukhliswa gaadaahum be ilim.
Ya Rabb !Al‑umam hajamo ard warasatakwa najjaso beetak al‑mukhaddaswa sawwo Madiinat al‑Khudus koom hana turaab.
Anto janaazaat abiidakle tuyuur al‑samawa jisas al‑muʼminiin beekle haywaanaat al‑kadaade.
Wa daffago dammuhumhawaale Madiinat al‑Khudus misil almiwa ma fi naadum al‑yadfinhum.
Daahu ligiina muʼyaarmin jiiraannawa chamaate wa hugramin al‑muhawwigiinna.
Ya Allah,le mata takhdab ?Ila l‑abad ?Wa le mata khiirtak tahrig misil al‑naar ?
Nazzil khadabak fi l‑umamal‑ma yaʼarfuukwa didd al‑mamaalikal‑ma yinaadu usmak.
Achaan humman kammalo zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa kharrabo baladhum.
Ma tizzakkar khata juduudnalaakin khalli rahmatak taji ajala foognaachaan aniina diʼifna ziyaada.
Afzaʼna,ya Rabb !Inta bas munajjiina,afdaana be sabab usmak al‑majiid !Wa fi chaan usmak,akhfir zunuubna.
Maala al‑umam buguulu : Ween Ilaahhum ? Khalli al‑umam dool yaʼarfuwa wassifhum giddaamnakadar tichiil taar fi chaan abiidak al‑kataloohum.
Khalli ganitiin al‑masaajiin yalhagakwa be iidak al‑gawiiye,najji al‑gaaʼidiin fi khutuurat al‑moot.
Wa l‑muʼyaar al‑ayyarook leyah jiiraanna,gabbilah fi raashum sabʼa marraat,ya Rabb !
Aniina chaʼabakwa khanamak al‑tasrah beehum.Aniina nachkuruuk daaymanwa nihajju be hamdak min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Ya inta al‑tuguud zurriiyit Yuusuf misil khanam,ya raaʼi Israaʼiil,asmaʼ !Ya inta al‑gaaʼid foog al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin,bayyin nafsak !
Giddaam gabaayil Afraayimwa Banyaamiin wa Manassa,gumm be kulla khuwwatakwa taʼaal najjiina !
Ya Rabb,gabbilna aleek !Wajjih aleena nuur wijhakwa be da,aniina nanjo.
Ya Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir !Lahaddi mata yigabbid khadabakdidd salaat chaʼabak ?
Inta tiʼakkilhumkhubza maʼjuuna be dumuuʼ.Wa ticharribhumtalaata mikyaal hana dumuuʼ.
Wa inta sawweetna sabab hana huraaj le jiiraannawa udwaanna yichchammato foogna.
Ya l‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir,gabbilna aleek !Wajjih aleena nuur wijhakwa be da,aniina nanjo.
Min balad Masir,inta maragt chadarat al‑inab.Wa taradt al‑umamwa maggant chadarat al‑inab di.
Inta jahhazt leeha al‑ardwa hi dassat uruughawa malat al‑balad.
Dullaha khatta al‑jibaalwa furuuʼha tuwaal misil al‑arz al‑kubaar.
Hi maddat furuuʼha lahaddi l‑bahar al‑Abyadaywa,maganha lahaddi bahar al‑Furaat.
Maala sawweet khuram katiiriin fi zariibithaal‑beehum al‑naas al‑faaytiin yagtaʼo al‑inab ?
Wa halluuf al‑khaaba yakhribhawa haywaanaat al‑kadaade yartaʼo foogha.
Ya l‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir,gabbilwa min al‑sama foog,anzur wa chiif !Gumm wa fakkirle chadarat al‑inab di.
Ahmi al‑magganatha iidak al‑zeeneaywa,ahfad al‑magan al‑addaltah le nafsak.
Al‑naas gataʼooh wa harragooh fi l‑naar.Khalli yiddammaro giddaam khadabak.
Khutt iidak fi l‑naadum al‑gaaʼid be zeenaaytak,fi l‑insaan al‑inta zaatak anteetah gudra.
Khalaas,aniina ma nikissu minnak abadan.Antiina al‑haya wa be da,aniina ninaadu usmak.
Ya Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir,gabbilna aleek !Wajjih aleena nuur wijhakwa be da,aniina nanjo.
Iitu min al‑farahle Ilaahna,al‑hu gudritna !Afraho be Ilaah Yaakhuub.
Arfaʼo hiss al‑musiikhawa adurbu al‑tambalwa l‑jigindiiye al‑haluuwewa amsibeybe.
Adurbu al‑buugfi awwal yoom fi l‑chaharwa fi ust al‑chahar fi yoom iidna.
Wa da yukuun chart le Bani Israaʼiilwa gaanuun min Ilaah Yaakhuub.
Allah chaal kharaar fi zurriiyit Yuusufwakit hu gamma didd Masir.Ana simiʼt hiss al‑ma iriftahwa l‑kalaam da yuguul :
 Ana chilt al‑tagala min kitfakwa iideenak nazzalo al‑soosal.
Wakit inta gaaʼid tasrakh min al‑taʼab,ana khallastakwa raddeet leek be sirr fi l‑raʼadwa jarrabtak jamb almi Mariiba.Wagfa.
 Ya chaʼabi,asmaʼooni adiil !Ya Bani Israaʼiil,nihazzirku kan tasmaʼooni.
Khalli ma yinlagi fi bakaanku ilaah ajnabiwa ma tasjudu giddaam ilaah aakhar.
Ana bas Allah Ilaahkual‑maragtuku min balad Masir.Aftaho khuchuumku kubaarwa ana namlaahum.
 Laakin chaʼabi ma simʼo hissiwa Bani Israaʼiil ma dawwarooni.
Wa khalaas,ana khalleethumbe ruuseehum al‑gawiyiinwa macho hasab niiyithum.
 Aywa,kan chaʼabi simʼooniwa Bani Israaʼiil taabaʼo derbi,
ana be surʼa niʼayyib udwaanhumwa narfaʼ iidi didd khusmaanhum.
 Al‑yakraho Allah yinhaanowa ikhaabhum yukuun daayman wa ila l‑abad.
Wa niʼakkil Bani Israaʼiil be gameh adiilwa narwiihum be asal al‑kadaade. 
Al‑Rabb wagaf fi lubb mujtamaʼahwa hakam been al‑ilaahaat wa gaal :
 Le mata tahkumu be zulumwa timayyulu al‑chariiʼa fi chaan al‑aasiyiin ?Wagfa.
 Ahkumu be l‑hagg le l‑daʼiif wa l‑atiimwa sawwu al‑adaala le l‑miskiin wa l‑fagri.
Najju al‑daʼiif wa l‑miskiinwa khallusuuhum min iid al‑aasiyiin. 
Laakin humman wa la yaʼarfu wa la yafhamowa yamchu fi l‑dalaamwa kulla asaas al‑ard yinhazza.
Ana gult : Intu ilaahaatwa intu kulluku iyaal al‑Aali.
Wa laakin intu tumuutu misil Bani Adamwa tagaʼo misil chuyuukh. 
Gumm,ya Rabb !Ahkim al‑ard !Achaan kulla l‑umam warasatak.
Ya Rabb,ma taskut !Wa ma tasmut wa la tahdaʼ,ya Rabb.
Achaan daahu udwaanak gaaʼidiin yisawwu harakawa l‑yakrahook yugummu diddak.
Be achiir,yikhattutu be najaada didd chaʼabak.Aywa,yichchaawaro didd al‑inta hafadtuhum.
Humman gaalo : Yalla !Nuguchchuuhum min been al‑umamwa usum Bani Israaʼiil battaan ma yizzakkarooh.

humman bas al‑gaalo : Khalli naglaʼo ard al‑Rabb. 
Ya Ilaahi !Sawwiihum yuduurumisil gechch al‑chaayle al‑riih.

Hatta al‑teeraay al‑sakhayre kula talga beetwa amjaraari talga uchch al‑tifaggiʼ foogah iyaalhajamb madaabhak.Ya Allah al‑Gaadir !Inta maliki wa Ilaahi.

Wa inta maheet zunuub chaʼabakwa khafart kulla khataayaahum.Wagfa.

Ya Allah !Wassif leena rahmatakwa antiina najaatak.

Ya Allah,inta saadikhwa chariiʼtak adiile.
Inta amart wa wassaft al‑adaalawa wasiiyaatak saadikhiin ziyaada.
Wa khiirti sakkatatniwakit udwaani niso kalaamak.
Kalaamak muʼakkad marra waahidwa abdak yihibbah.
Ana miskiin wa mahguurwa laakin ma nansa faraaydak.
Adaaltak tagood ila l‑abadwa Tawraatak hagg.
Taʼab al‑diige lihigniwa laakin gawaaniinak laziiziin leyi.
Adaalit wasiiyaatak tagood ila l‑abad.Antiini al‑fihim le nahya !
Ya Allah,ana naadeet be kulla galbi,rudd leyi wa nahfad churuutak.
Ana naadeetak : Najjiiniwa nahfad wasiiyaatak ! 
Gammeet gabul al‑chagaag wa talabt fazaʼakwa be acham,narja kalaamak.
Uyuuni anfataho be l‑leelwa azzakkart kalaamak.
Asmaʼ hissi hasab rahmatak.Ya Allah,hayyiini hasab chariiʼtak !
Al‑yisawwu fiʼil al‑cheen garrabo leyiwa baʼʼado min Tawraatak.
Ya Allah,inta gariib leyiwa kulla gawaaniinak hagg.
Min zamaan,ana naʼarif wasiiyaatakwa inta assastaha le l‑abad.
Chiif taʼabi wa khallisniachaan ana ma nisiit Tawraatak.
Ahmiini wa afdaani.Hayyiini hasab kalaamak !
Al‑naja baʼiid min al‑aasiyiinachaan ma fattacho churuutak.
Ya Allah,rahmatak wasiiʼe.Hayyiini hasab chariiʼtak !
Al‑yitaaruduuni wa khusmaani katiiriinwa laakin ana ma baareet min wasiiyaatak.
Ana nichiif al‑khaayniin be bukhudachaan ma hafado kalaamak.
Ya Allah,chiif !Ana nihibb faraaydak.Hayyiini hasab rahmatak !
Asaas kalaamak haggwa kulla chariiʼtak adaala ila l‑abad.
Al‑kubaaraat taradooni bala janiiyewa laakin galbi ma yarjif illa le kalaamak.
Ana nafrah be kalaamakmisil al‑ligi khaniime katiire.
Ana bakhadt wa harramt al‑kidibwa gaaʼid nihibb Tawraatak.
Sabʼa marraat fi l‑yoom,ana nahmudakwa da achaan adaalit chariiʼtak.
Fiyah salaam katiir le l‑yihibbu Tawraatakwa ma fi cheyy al‑yitartiʼhum.
Ya Allah,ana khatteet achami fi najaatakwa tabbagt gawaaniinak.
Nafsi tahfad wasiiyaatakwa ana nihibbuhum ziyaada.
Wa ana nahfad faraaydak wa wasiiyaatakachaan kulla duruubi,inta taʼarifhum.
Ya Allah,khalli siraakhi yawsalakwa antiini fihim hasab kalaamak !
Khalli hiss munaadaati yawsalakwa najjiini hasab kalaamak !
Khalli hamdak yisiil min lisaaniachaan inta allamtini churuutak.
Khalli lisaani yikhanni be kalaamakachaan kulla gawaaniinak adaala.
Khalli iidak tafzaʼniachaan ana azalt faraaydak.
Ya Allah,ana dawwart al‑naja minnakwa Tawraatak laziiz leyi.
Khalli nafsi tahya wa tahmudakwa chariiʼtak tafzaʼni.
Ana misil khanamaay muwaddire.Fattich abdak achaan ma nisiit gawaaniinak !
Fi diigti,ana naadeet Allahwa hu fazaʼni wakit gult :
 Ya Allah,najjiini min al‑kaddaabiinwa min al‑naas al‑yahalfu be kidib. 
Ma taʼarfu al‑yisawwiih leeku Allah walla ?Ma yiʼazzibku intu al‑tahalfu be kidib walla ?
Hu yirassil leeku nachaachiib turaan hana l‑faariswa jamur al‑yiharrigku.
Ana aasif achaan gaʼadt fi balad Maachak maʼa naas fasliinwa sakant fi khiyam Khidaar ambeen naas hawaaniin.
Wa ana sakant tawwaltmaʼa l‑naas al‑yakraho al‑salaam.
Ana nihibb al‑salaam wa wakit nihajji beyah,humman yidooru al‑harib.
Wa narfaʼ uyuuni wa nichiif al‑jibaal,min ween yajiini al‑fazaʼ ?
Al‑fazaʼ yajiini min Allah,Khaalig al‑samaawaat wa l‑ard !
Ya akhuuyi,Allah yisabbit khatwaat rijlak,hu haafidak ma yunuum.
Aywa,hu ma yunuum wa la yanʼas kula,hu haafid Bani Israaʼiil.
Allah haafidakwa Allah dullak be iidak al‑zeene.
Wa yahfadak min harraayit al‑nahaarwa min gamar al‑leel.
Wa Allah yahfadak min kulla cheyy fasil,hu yahfad hayaatak.
Wa min al‑yoom le giddaam,Allah yahfadak fi marigiinak wa jaytak.
Ana firiht wakit gaalo leyi : Yalla namchu le beet Allah ! 
Wa daahu aniina waagfiin fi biibaanki,ya Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Madiinat al‑Khudus hi madiina mabniiyebe jamaal wa muwahhada.

Achaan al‑bakaan da,kursi al‑adaala gaaʼid foogahwa zurriiyit Dawuud basyahkumu foogah.
Asʼalo al‑salaam le Madiinat al‑Khudus wa guulu : Khalli al‑yihibbuuki yagoodu be amaan !
Wa khalli al‑salaam yaji fi daraadirkiwa l‑amaan yadkhul fi gusuurki. 
Wa fi chaan hubbi le akhwaani wa rufgaani,nuguul : Agoodi be l‑salaam,ya Madiinat al‑Khudus ! 
Wa fi chaan hubbi le beet Allah Ilaahna,ana nitmanna leeki al‑kheer.
Leek inta,ana rafaʼt uyuuni,inta al‑gaaʼid fi l‑arch fi l‑samaawaat.
Wa daahu aniina musangiʼiin le Allah Ilaahna,raajiyiin hu yihinn foogna.Wa aniina misil abiid al‑yarfaʼo uyuunhumle iideen siyaadhum al‑yantuuhumwa misil khaadim al‑tarfaʼ uyuunhale iid sittaha al‑tantiiha.
Ya Allah,hinn foogna !Ya Allah,hinn foogna !Achaan aniina chibiʼna min al‑hugra.
Wa min chamaatat al‑haggaariin,chibiʼna ziyaadawa hugrat al‑mustakbiriin tammatna.
 Kan Allah ma kaan maʼaana ,Khalli Bani Israaʼiil yuguuluuh !
 Kan Allah ma kaan maʼaanawakit al‑naas gammo diddina,
wa wakit zaʼalhum faar,yaakuluuna bala naar
wa l‑almi yikhattiinawa l‑challaal yitammisna
wa l‑mooj al‑chadiid yufuut fi raasna. 
Al‑hamdulillah !Hu ma dassaana misil lugma fi sunuunhum !

Al‑fazaʼ yajiina min Allah,Khaalig al‑samaawaat wa l‑ard !
Al‑yitwakkalo ale Allah,humman misil jabal Sahyuun al‑ma yilharrakwa gaaʼid ila l‑abad.
Wa misil Madiinat al‑Khudusmuhawwaga be jibaal,Allah kula muhawwig chaʼabahmin hassaʼ wa ila l‑abad.
Wa hu ma yisabbit muluk jaayirfi balad al‑saalihiinwa be da,ma yimiddu iideehumle yisawwu jariime.
Ya Allah,sawwi al‑kheerle l‑naas al‑yisawwu al‑kheerwa le l‑naas al‑guluubhum buyud.
Wa laakin al‑naas al‑yichiilu al‑derib al‑aʼwaj,atrudhum,ya Allah,maʼa l‑naas al‑yisawwu al‑charr.Wa jiib al‑salaam le Bani Israaʼiil !
Wakit Allah gabbalaahum fi Sahyuunle naasna al‑waddoohum abiid,da bigi leena misil hilim.
Wa dihikna ziyaada wa ragragnawa zakhratna min al‑farahlahaddi al‑umam gaalo : Allah sawwa le l‑naas dool cheyy katiir. 
Aywa,Allah sawwa leena cheyy katiirwa aniina farhaaniin !
Ya Allah,gabbil naasna al‑waddoohum abiidwa jiibhum misil almi al‑seel fi saharat Nagab.
Al‑yiteerubu be dumuuʼ al‑taʼab,yagtaʼo be farah.
Al‑yamchi be baki,chaayil teeraabah,hu yigabbil be farah,chaayil ganaadiilah.
Kan Allah ma yabni al‑beet,al‑bannaayiin yakhdumu bala faayde.Wa kan Allah ma yahfad al‑madiina,al‑hurraas yahfadooha bala faayde.
Ma fi faayde kan tugummu badriwa tunuumu mutaʼakhkhiriinwa tatʼabo fi chaan al‑akil.Achaan Allah yanti akil le l‑yiriidhumhatta kan humman naaymiin kula.
Al‑iyaal warasa min Allahwa humman ajur minnah.
Al‑iyaal al‑yaldaahum al‑naadum fi chabaabah,humman misil nachaachiib fi iideen faaris.
Mabruuk le l‑naadumal‑yamla minhum kaloottah.Wa be da,hu ma yafchulwakit yiwaajih udwaanah fi khachum baab al‑madiina.
Mabruuk le ayyi raajil al‑yakhaaf min Allahwa yichiil derbah.
Wa inta tafrah be l‑maʼaach al‑talga min khidimtakwa tinbasit wa talga al‑kheer.
Wa martak tabga misil chadarat al‑inabal‑talda katiir fi lubb beetakwa iyaalak yabgo misil buzuur chadar al‑zaytuunwakit yagoodu le l‑akil.
Wa di bas al‑baraka al‑yalgaahaayyi raajil al‑yakhaaf min Allah.
Wa min Sahyuun,Allah yibaarikakwa inta tichiif al‑kheer fi Madiinat al‑Khudusmuddit kulla ayyaam hayaatak.
Wa tichiif iyaal iyaalak.Khalli Allah yijiib al‑salaam fi Bani Israaʼiil !
 Min ana sabiiye,humman daayagooni ziyaada. Khalli Bani Israaʼiil yuguuluuh !
 Min ana sabiiye,humman daayagooni ziyaadalaakin ma gidro foogi.
Al‑harraatiin halbabo daharimisil zereʼ haratooh be toor.
Wa laakin Allah saadikhwa halla minni hubaal al‑aasiyiin.

Ya Allah,fi diigti ana koorakt leek.
Ya Rabb,asmaʼ hissi.Khutt adaanak le sooti wa akhbal duʼaayi.

Ya Bani Israaʼiil,khuttu achamku fi Allahachaan hu indah al‑rahma wa l‑fida al‑kaamil.
Wa hu al‑yafda Bani Israaʼiilmin kulla khataayaahum.
Ya Allah,galbi ma mutakabbirwa ma nichiif nafsi aali.Wa ma fattacht al‑kubuuriiyewa la l‑cheyy al‑ziyaada minni.

Ya Allah,fakkir fi Dawuudwa chiif kulla taʼabah.
Hu halaf le Allahwa sawwa nazir le l‑Jabbaar,le Ilaah Yaakhuub wa gaal :
 Ma nadkhul fi kheemtiwa la nargud fi furaachi
wa la nikhammid uyuuniwa la nikhalli al‑noom yarkhi jufuuni,
gabul ma nalga bakaan le Allahal‑yabga maskan leyah hual‑Jabbaar,Ilaah Yaakhuub. 
Aywa,fi Afraata simiʼna khabarhana sanduug muʼaahadat Allahwa fi zereʼ Yaʼarligiinaah.
Yalla namchu maskanahwa nasjudu giddaamah !
Ya Allah,gumm wa taʼaal le maskanakinta wa sanduug al‑muʼaahadaal‑hu alaamat gudurtak.
Khalli naasak rujaal al‑diin yalbaso al‑adaalamisil yalbaso khulgaanhum.Wa khalli naasak al‑saalihiinyikhannu min farahhum.

Wa kan iyaalak yihtarumu muʼaahadatiwa awaamiri al‑nantiihum leehum,khalaas iyaalhum kulanidarrijhum muluuk ila l‑abad. 
Achaan Allah azal jabal Sahyuunwa dawwar yaskun foogah
wa gaal : Da bakaan al‑naskun foogah ila l‑abadwa naskun foogah achaan ana azaltah.

Nilabbis naasha rujaal al‑diin be khulgaan al‑najawa naasha al‑saalihiin yikhannu min farahhum.
 Fi Sahyuun,nidarrij malik gaadirmin iyaal Dawuudwa misil nuur,nisabbitah hual‑ana masahtah.
Wa nilabbis udwaanah khulgaan al‑eeblaakin hu kamaan,al‑taaj yiraari fi raasah. 
Da adiil wa sameh le l‑akhwaankan yukuunu sawa !

Wa da misil al‑karanyal‑yanzil fi jabal Harmuunwa yanzil fi jabal Sahyuun.Wa fi Sahyuun,Allah kharrar al‑barakawa hi al‑haya al‑abadiiye.

Ween namchi baʼiid min ruuhak ?Ween najri min hadaratak ?

Hatta al‑dalaam leek inta,ma dalaam.Al‑leel yabga nuur misil al‑nahaarwa l‑dalaam misil al‑nuur.
Inta bas al‑khalagt daakhiliwa kawwantini fi batun ammi.
Nachkurak achaan khalagtini be tariiga ajiibe.Aʼmaalak kulluhum yikhawwufuwa ana niʼajjib fooghum marra waahid.

Achaan Allah yasturakwa yahfad rijlak min al‑charak.
Kan indak gudra le tisawwi al‑zeenma tamnaʼah le l‑naas al‑hawjaaniin leyah.
Kan indak,ma tuguul le akhuuk : Amchi,ambaakir taʼaal nantiik. 
Ma tichiil niiye fasle didd jaarakal‑aayich be amaan jambak.
Ma tihaarij maʼa naadum bala sababkan hu ma sawwa leek cheyy fasil.
Ma tahsid siid al‑unufwa abadan ma tichiil derbah.
Achaan al‑fasaad,Allah harramahwa laakin al‑naadum al‑adiil,Allah yantiih sirrah.
Beet al‑aasiyiin yalga khadab Allahwa beet al‑saalihiin yalga barakatah.
Yichchammat le l‑chammaatiinwa laakin yarda le l‑masaakiin.
Al‑hakiim yawris al‑charafwa l‑matmuus yalga illa l‑eeb.
Asmaʼo,ya iyaali,wasiiyat abuukuwa le tafhamo,khuttu baalku
achaan al‑maʼrafa al‑nantiiha leeku adiile.Abadan ma tikhallu taʼliimi.
Wakit ana sakhayyar maʼa abuuyiwa ammi tihibbiniana wileedha al‑wahiid,
abuuyi allamaani wa gaal : Khalli galbak yakrub kalaamiwa ahfad wasiiytiwa be da,tiʼiich fi raaha.
Fattich al‑hikma wa l‑fihimwa ma tansa wa la tikhalli kalaami.
Hibb al‑hikma wa ma tikhalliihaachaan hi tahfadak wa tahmiik.
Awwalan,fattich al‑hikmale tabga hakiimwa anti kulla l‑indakle talga al‑fihim.
Al‑hikma tiʼalliik wakit takrubhawa hi ticharrifak wakit tahdinha.
Al‑hikma tukhutt fi raasak taaj al‑niʼmawa tijammilak be kadmuul al‑charaf. 
Asmaʼ,ya wileedi,wa chiil kalaamiwa da yikattir siniin hayaatak.
Ana allamtak tariig al‑hikmawa wassaftak duruub al‑adaala.
Kan tamchi,tamchi be suhuulawa kan tajri,abadan ma tittartaʼ.
Akrub al‑wasiiye wa ahfadha.Ma tikhalliihaachaan hi asaas hayaatak.
Ma tamchi fi tariig al‑aasiyiinwa la tichiil derib al‑fasliin.
Khalliih,beyah ma tamchi.Baari be tariig aakhar wa amchi.
Al‑naas dool ma yunuumukan ma sawwo al‑fasilwa ma yanʼasokan ma ramo naadum.
Akilhum jaayi min al‑charrwa charaabhum jaayi min al‑unuf.
Tariig al‑saalihiin misil deyy al‑sabaahwa nuurah yiziidlahaddi al‑harraay tatlaʼ.
Laakin derib al‑aasiyiinmisil al‑leel al‑adlam.Fi l‑dalaam,ma yichiifual‑cheyy al‑yarmiihum.
Ya wileedi,khutt baalak le wasiiytiwa aftah adaanak wa asmaʼ kalaami.
Kalaami,ma tibaʼʼidah min aglakwa wasiiyti,ahfadha fi daakhil galbak.
Al‑yalgaahum,yalga al‑hayawa yalga al‑aafe le kulla jismah.
Ahfad galbak ziyaadamin kulla cheyy aakharachaan minnah hu tisiil al‑haya.
Ma tamrug min khachmakal‑kalaam al‑kidibwa baʼʼid min lisaanakal‑kalaam al‑khabiis.
Chiif adiil giddaamakwa sabbit uyuunak fi derbak.
Addil al‑derib le rijileenakwa be da,kulla duruubak yabgo saabtiin.
Ma tiliff wa la isra wa la zeenewa baʼʼid nafsak min al‑charr.
Ya wileedi,khutt baalak le hikmatiwa asmaʼ al‑ilim al‑indi
le tifakkir adiilwa lisaanak yikallim be maʼrafa.
Achaan al‑zaaniye lisaanha asalwa kalaamha halu.
Wa laakin fi l‑akhiirhi murra min al‑hamdalwa tariine min al‑seef.
Deribha yiwaddi le l‑mootwa tariigha yuguud fi l‑haawiye.
Hi ma indaha haajefi derib al‑haya.Hi waddarat khalaaswa ma indaha khabar.
Wa hassaʼ,ya wileedi,asmaʼniwa ma taaba kalaami.
Ma tamchi aleehawa ma tigarrib le baab beetha.
Kan macheet leeha,giddaam al‑naas titallif charafakwa tisallim nafsakle naadum al‑ma yarhamak
wa l‑ajaanib yaksabo maalakwa le naadum aakhar tantiih khidmit duraaʼak
wa tatʼab wa tagnit fi aakhir umrakfi wakit al‑yanzil lahamak wa l‑tiwaddir gudurtak.
Wa khalaas,tandam wa tuguul : Maala ana abeet al‑addibiin ?Wa maala galbi ma khassadbe luwaamit al‑aakhariin ?
Ana ma simiʼt kalaam al‑naasal‑yigarruuniwa ma karramt saadaatial‑yiʼallumuuni.
Wa hassaʼ gariibnalhag al‑taʼab al‑ziyaadagiddaam al‑naaswa giddaam al‑mujtamaʼ. 
Achrab almi biirak al‑halaalak,almi al‑jaari min een biirak.
Ma tikhalli almi biirak yajri fi l‑chawaariʼwa la yidaffig fi l‑nagaʼaat.
Khalli almi biirak yabga leek inta wiheedakwa ma le l‑ajaanib al‑maʼaak.
Allah yibaarik biirakwa afrah be l‑mara al‑akhadtaha fi subaak.
Hi leek misil al‑khazaala,samha wa mahbuuba.Khalli mahabbitha tarwiik fi kulla wakitwa kuun machkhuul daayman be hubbaha.
Maala,ya wileedi,tinchakhilbe hubb al‑zannaaya ?Wa maala tikhalli chahwatak tiwaddiikle mara aakhara ?
Allah yichiif kulla khidmit al‑insaanwa yiraakhib al‑derib al‑gaaʼid yichiilah.
Al‑aasi yagaʼ fi isyaanahwa zanbah yabga charak yakurbah.
Gillit al‑adab taktulahwa katarat al‑fasaad tiwaddirah.
Ya wileedi,kan dimint rafiigakaw anteet kalaam le naadum ma maʼruuf
wa kan wagaʼt fi charak be sabab khachmakaw ankarabt be sabab lisaanak
khalaas,ya wileedi,sawwi misil daachaan inta wagaʼt fi iideen siid al‑deen.Le tinajji nafsak,amchi achhadah yikhalliik.
Amchi ajala !Wa la targud wa la tunuum.
Anbalis minnah misil al‑khazaal min al‑charakaw misil al‑teer min iid al‑gannaasi.
Ya l‑kaslaan,fakkir fi l‑nimlewa chiif khidmitha wa abga hakiim.
Hi ma indaha khaayidwa la muraakhib wa la siid.
Laakin tilimm maʼaachha fi wakt al‑gatiʼwa takhzin akilha fi wakt al‑darat.
Ya l‑kaslaan,le mata tunuumwa mata tugumm min noomak ?
Inta tuguul tunuum chiyyawa tinjamm chiyyawa titabbig iideenakwa targud chiyya.
Wa be da,al‑fagur yajiikmisil al‑sarraagwa l‑taʼab yakurbakmisil rabbaat al‑duruub.
Al‑naadum al‑fasil ma naafiʼwa khachmah yuguul daayman al‑kidib.
Hu yisawwi ichaara be uyuunah wa rijileenah wa iideenahwa da,le yukhuchch al‑naas.
Galbah malaan be l‑khachchwa yikhattit al‑charrwa daayman yazraʼilla l‑huraaj been al‑naas.
Be l‑sabab da,damaarah yaji ajala.Yinrahik marra waahidwa battaan ma yalga ilaaj.
Fiyah sitte achya Allah yakrahhum.Wa doolhumman al‑sabʼaal‑Allah harramhum.
Al‑een al‑gawiiyewa l‑lisaan al‑yakdib be niiyewa l‑iid al‑taktul bala hinniiye
wa l‑galib al‑yanwi al‑khiyaanawa l‑rijil al‑tajri le l‑fasaala
wa l‑naadum al‑yachhad be l‑kidib al‑hawaanwa l‑yigawwim al‑fitne ambeenaat al‑akhwaan.
Ya wileedi,ahfad wasiiyat abuukwa ma taaba taʼliim ammak.
Ahfadhum adiil fi galbakwa arbuthum gawi fi ragabatak.
Achaan wakit tamchi,humman yuguuduukwa wakit tunuum,yahfadookwa wakit tugumm min noomak,yiwassuuk.
Al‑wasiiye hi misil faanuuswa l‑taʼliim misil nuurwa l‑adab wa ikhaabah yiwadduukfi tariig al‑haya.
Wa humman yahfadookmin al‑mara al‑faslewa min al‑lisaan al‑khachchaach hana l‑ajnabiiye.
Ma titmanna fi galbak jamaalhawa ma tikhalliiha tasharak be uyuunha.
Achaan al‑charmuuta talgaaha rakhiisemisil al‑khubzawa laakin mart al‑raajiltiwaddir hayaatak al‑khaaliye.
Tagdar tahdin naar fi sadrakwa ma tiharrig khulgaanak walla ?
Aw tamchi fi jamurwa ma yutuchch rijileenak walla ?
Nafs al‑cheyy al‑naadumal‑yamchi le marit jaarah.Kan yalʼab maʼaaha,ma yajʼalooh bari.
Al‑naas ma yakraho al‑sarraagwakit yasrig le yachbiʼ nafsah.
Laakin wakit yakurbuuh,yikaffi sabʼa marraatwa da yikammil kulla khumaam beetah.
Wa laakin al‑zaani ma indah fihimwa be l‑zina yidammir nafsah.
Yalga al‑dagg wa l‑hugrawa eebah ma yiwaddir abadan.
Achaan al‑nindili yilizz al‑raajilfi l‑zaʼal al‑haarrwa ma yarham al‑zaaniwakit yilkaffa foogah al‑taar.
Ma yakhbal gurus al‑zaanial‑yikaffiih leyahwa kan yiziid hadaaya kula,ma yarda beyah.
Ya wileedi,ahfad kalaamiwa maʼaak,akrub wasiiyaati.
Kan tidoor tiʼiich,ahfad wasiiyaati.Wa misil wald al‑een,ahfad taʼliimi.
Dissuhum misil khatam fi asaabʼakwa aktibhum fi galbakmisil taktibhum fi looh.
Guul le l‑hikma : Inti akhti ! Wa naadi al‑fihim : Ya gariibi ! 
Wa da yahfadak min al‑mara al‑zaaniyewa min mart al‑raajil be kilmitha al‑haluuwe.
Yoom waahid,ana waagiffi chubbaak beetiwa be faragaatah,gaaʼid nichiif barra.
Ana chift waahid min al‑juhhaalwa irift kadar hu sabi al‑ma yaʼarif cheyy.
Hu faayit fi l‑chaariʼjamb bakaan al‑zaaniyewa be bicheech,mutawajjih ale beetha.
Wa fi l‑yoom da be achiiye,wakt al‑harraay wagaʼat wa l‑dalaam khatta,
khalaas,al‑mara maragat laagatahwa laabse lubaas hana l‑charaamiitwa galibha malaan be l‑khachch.
Al‑mara di,harkaane wa aasiyewa haffaafa,abadan ma tagood fi l‑beet.
Marraat fi l‑chaariʼ wa marraat fi l‑nagaʼawa fi ayyi bakaan hi kaajje charakha.
Hi karabat al‑sabi wa habbatah chadiidwa chaafatah fi uyuunah wa gaalat :
 Taʼaal,indi laham fi l‑beetachaan al‑yoom,dabaht dahiiyat al‑salaamaal‑aahadt beeha Allah.
Wa fi chaan da,ana maragtle nifattichak wa ninaadiik.Wa daahu ligiitak !
Wa farracht sariiri be bawaajowa hariir mulawwan al‑jaabooh min Masir.
Wa attart furaachi be khumrawa dukhkhaan samukh wa sandal.
Taʼaal narugdu sawa lahaddi l‑sabaahwa narwu nufuusna be l‑hubb.
Achaan al‑raajil ma fiih fi l‑beet,hu khatar macha baʼiid.
Hu chaal mukhlaatah hana l‑fuddawa ma yaji illa fi bidaayit al‑chahar. 
Hi be katarat khachchaha,jabbadatahwa be kalaamha al‑halu,jaabatah.
Wa tawwaali hu taabaʼhamisil kabich al‑dahiiyeaw misil khazaala al‑tamchi le l‑charak
lahaddi al‑harba tatʼanha fi kibdithaaw misil teeraay al‑tagaʼ fi l‑charak.Wa hu ma yaʼarifkadar da khatar le hayaatah.
Wa hassaʼ da,asmaʼ ya wileediwa khutt baalak le kalaami.
Wa khalli galbak ma yitaabiʼ mara misil diwa la turuuh fi duruubha.
Achaan hi ramat naas katiiriin dahaayawa hatta al‑gawiyiin kula,katalathum.
Wa hassaʼ da,angariʼ.Beetha da hu derib al‑mootal‑yiwaddi le l‑khubuur.
Asmaʼo,al‑hikma tinaadiwa l‑fihim yarfaʼ hissah.
Al‑hikma waagfe fi machbak al‑duruubwa fi l‑bakaanaat al‑aaliyiin jamb al‑turug.
Wa hi tinaadi fi baab al‑madiinawa tinaadi fi dakhuul al‑hille wa tuguul :
 Ya naas,leeku intu ana ninaadiwa le Bani Adam niwajjih kalaami.
Ya l‑juhhaal,sawwu leeku agul.Wa ya l‑mataamiis,afhamo adiil fi guluubku.
Asmaʼo achaan nuguul kalaam muhimmwa khachmi yuguul kalaam adiil.
Achaan al‑hagg daayman gaaʼid fi khachmiwa l‑charr haraam le lisaani.
Wa kulla kalaam khachmi sahiihwa la indah kidibwa la indah khachch.
Wa kalaami sameh le l‑naas al‑induhum fihimwa adiil le l‑naas al‑induhum maʼrafa.
Chiil wasiiyti,hi akheer min al‑fuddawa akrub al‑ilim,hu akheer min al‑dahab al‑saafi.
Achaan al‑hikmahi ziyaada min al‑marajaanwa ayyi cheyy al‑tihibbahma yigaadirha. 
 Ana al‑hikma naskun maʼa l‑agulwa be da,nalga al‑ilim wa l‑raay.
Al‑yakhaaf min Allah,yakrah al‑fasaala.Wa ana kula nakrahal‑kuluufiiye wa l‑istikbaarwa derib al‑fasaala wa l‑khachum al‑kaddaab.
Al‑wasiiye wa l‑agul hineeyi ana.Wa l‑ilim wa l‑fahaaliiye kula leyi ana.
Wa beyi ana,al‑muluuk yamulkuwa l‑gudiya yaamuru be l‑adaala.
Wa beyi ana,al‑chuyuukh yahkumuwa l‑hukkaam wa kulla l‑gudiyayichaaruʼu be l‑adaala.
Ana nihibb al‑yihibbuuniwa l‑yifattuchuuni,yalgooni.
Wa nantiihum maal wa charafwa khuna daayim wa mukaafa.
Wa natiijti akheermin al‑dahab al‑saafiwa intaaji akheermin al‑fudda al‑maʼzuula.
Ana nuruukh fi derib al‑saalihiinwa namchi adiil fi tariig al‑aadiliin.
Wa nanti maal warasa le l‑yihibbuuniwa namla makhaazinhum. 
 Ana al‑hikma,Allah khalagaani awwal,misil wald al‑bikir fi kulla khaliigtah.
Wa ana makhluuga min zamaanwa min al‑bidaayawa min gabul al‑ard.
Wa ana makhluugagabul al‑bahar al‑muhiitwa gabul uyuun almi al‑jaari.
Wa ana makhluugagabul al‑hujaarwa gabul al‑jibaal ma yukhuttuhum.
Wa ana mawjuudagabul ma yisawwi al‑ard wa l‑kadaadewa gabul khaliigit turaab al‑dunya.
Wa ana mawjuudawakit bana al‑samaawaatwa khatta huduud beenhum wa been al‑bahar al‑muhiit
wa wakit khatta al‑sahaab foogwa gawwa majaari al‑almi tihit fi lubb al‑ard.
Wa ana mawjuudawakit khatta huduud le l‑baharachaan al‑almi ma yikhaalif amrah.Wa wakit khatta asaas al‑ard,
ana al‑hikma kunt maʼaayah bannaaya.Wa hu firih beyi fi kulla yoomwa ana mabsuuta giddaamah fi kulla wakit.
Wa ana mabsuuta be ardah al‑aamrewa firiht be Bani Adam. 
 Wa hassaʼ,asmaʼo ya iyaali.Mabruuk le l‑yichiilu derbi.
Asmaʼo wasiiyti wa abgo hakiimiinwa abadan ma tikhalluuha.
Mabruuk le l‑naadum al‑yasmaʼniwa yagiif kulla yoom fi baabiwa yahfad madkhal beeti.
Achaan al‑yalgaani,yalga al‑hayawa yalga rida min Allah.
Wa laakin al‑yaʼasaani,yajrah nafsahwa l‑yakrahni,yihibb al‑moot. 
Al‑hikma gataʼat chiʼab sabʼawa beehum banat beetha.
Hi dabahat wa daayarat khamarhawa farrachat bustaatha.
Hi rassalat khaddaamaathawa tinaadi min al‑bakaan al‑aali hana l‑hille.
Wa tuguul : Ayyi naadum al‑jaahil khalli yaji hini. Wa le l‑ma indah fihim,hi tuguul :
 Yalla aakulu min akliwa acharbo min khamari al‑daayartah.
Khallu minku al‑jahal wa tahyowa chiilu al‑derib al‑yantiiku fihim. 
 Al‑yiʼaddib al‑chammaatiyalga al‑bakhaadawa l‑yuluum al‑aasiyalga al‑muʼyaar.
Ma tuluum al‑chammaatiachaan hu yabkhudaklaakin kan tuluum al‑hakiim,hu yiriidak.
Allim al‑hakiimwa yalga hikma ziyaada.Arrif al‑saalihwa maʼrafatah tabga ziyaada.
Al‑khoof min Allahhu asaas al‑hikmawa maʼrafat Allah al‑Khudduustifahhimah le l‑insaan.
Wa beyi ana al‑hikma,ayyaam hayaatak yiziiduwa siniin umrak yutuulu.
Kan hakiim,hikmatak tanfaʼakwa kan chammaati,tilhammal awaakhib fiʼilak. 
Al‑mara al‑matmuusa kalaamha katiir.Hi mukhaffala wa ma taʼarif cheyy.
Hi tagood fi baab beethawa fi l‑bakaan al‑aali hana hillitha
le tinaadi al‑faaytiin be deribhumwa l‑maachiin adiil fi tariighum.
Wa tuguul : Ayyi naadum al‑jaahil khalli yaji hini. Wa le l‑ma indah fihim,hi tuguul :
 Al‑charaab al‑masruug,laziizwa l‑akil al‑mulabbad,halu. 
Humman ma yaʼarfukadar da bakaan al‑maytiinwa maʼzuumiinhagaaʼidiin fi l‑haawiye.
Amsaal Suleymaan ibn Dawuud.Al‑wileed al‑hakiim yifarrih abuuh wa ammahwa l‑wileed al‑matmuus kamaan yaktulhum be hammah.
Al‑maal al‑haraam ma yifiidakwa laakin adaaltak tinajjiik min al‑moot.
Allah ma yijiib le l‑saalihiin al‑juuʼwa ma yanti le l‑aasiyiin al‑cheyy al‑garmaaniin leyah.
Tabbigiin al‑iideen bijiib al‑fagurwa laakin al‑iid al‑khaddaama tijiib al‑khuna.
Al‑yilimm aklah fi wakt al‑gatiʼ,aagil ziyaadawa l‑yunuum fi l‑darat,yiwassif fasaadah.
Al‑baraka tanzil fi raas al‑saalihiinwa be sabab al‑lisaan,al‑unuf yanzil fi l‑aasiyiin.
Zikir al‑saalih barakawa laakin usum al‑aasi afin.
Al‑galb al‑hakiim yakhbal al‑wasiiyewa laakin lisaan al‑munaafikh yijiib al‑wadaar.
Al‑yamchi adiil yiʼiich be amaanwa laakin al‑ma yamchi adiil yinʼarif.
Al‑een al‑takhmiz tijiib al‑barjaalwa lisaan al‑munaafikh yijiib al‑wadaar.
Lisaan al‑saalih yijiib al‑hayawa lisaan al‑aasi yilabbid unufah.
Al‑karaahiiye tisabbib al‑huraajwa laakin al‑mahabba tisaamih al‑khata.
Al‑hikma tinlagi fi khachum al‑faahimwa l‑ma indah fihim,al‑soot yifahhimah.
Al‑hakiimiin yakhzunu al‑ilimwa laakin kalaam al‑munaafikhiin yigarrib al‑halaak.
Al‑maal al‑katiiryahmi siidah misil madiina gawiiyewa l‑faguryisabbib halaak al‑masaakiin.
Be maal ujurtah,al‑saalih yijiib al‑hayawa be maksabah halaalah,al‑aasi yisawwi al‑zanib.
Al‑yahfad al‑wasiiye chaayil derib al‑hayawa l‑yaaba al‑nasiihe yiwaddir nafsah.
Al‑yilabbid karaahiiytah kaddaabwa l‑yagtaʼ al‑naas matmuus.
Katarat al‑kalaam tarmi fi l‑khatawa laakin al‑yahfad lisaanah aagil.
Lisaan al‑saalih misil al‑fudda al‑saafiyewa laakin galb al‑aasi ma indah faayde.
Kalaam al‑saalihiin yanfaʼ naas katiiriinwa laakin min gillit al‑fihim yumuutu al‑munaafikhiin.
Al‑khuna yaji be barakat Allah.Wa balaaha,kan tatʼab kula,ma talga cheyy.
Sawwiyiin al‑fasaala halu le l‑matmuuswa fattichiin al‑hikma halu le l‑faahim.
Al‑aasi yalga al‑cheyy al‑yakhaaf minnahwa laakin al‑saalih yalga al‑yitmannaah.
Wakit al‑riih al‑chadiide taji,le l‑aasi tichiilahwa laakin al‑saalih saabit daayman.
Al‑kaslaan yudurrah le l‑yikhaddimahmisil al‑dukhkhaan fi l‑uyuun aw al‑suusa fi l‑sunuun.
Al‑khoof min Allah yiziid al‑umurwa laakin al‑aasiyiin,siniinhum yigassuru.
Acham al‑saalihiin yijiib al‑farhawa laakin muna al‑aasiyiin ma yilhaggag.
Derib Allah yahmi al‑tamaamiinwa laakin yahlik al‑fasliin.
Al‑saalihiin ma yibarjulu abadanwa laakin al‑aasiyiin ma yaskunu fi l‑ard.
Kalaam al‑saalih yijiib al‑hikmawa lisaan al‑kaddaab yingatiʼ.
Kalaam al‑saalih yaʼajibwa kalaam al‑aasi kulla kidib.
Al‑miizaan al‑makhchuuch,Allah harramahwa l‑mikyaal al‑aadil,Allah yarda beyah.
Al‑fachaar yijiib al‑eebwa l‑tawaaduʼ yijiib al‑hikma.
Kamaal al‑adiiliin,fi l‑derib al‑adiil yiwaddiihumwa laakin khachch al‑khaddaariinyidammirhum.
Al‑maal ma yanfaʼ fi yoom khadab Allahwa laakin al‑adaala tinajji min al‑moot.
Adaalit al‑naadum al‑tamaam tiʼaddil derbahwa laakin al‑aasi yagaʼ fi isyaanah.
Adaalit al‑adiiliin tinajjiihum,wa tamaʼ al‑khaddaariin yarmiihum.
Wakit yumuut al‑aasi,achamah yumuutwa l‑muna al‑indah fi maalah kula yiwaddir.
Al‑diige al‑yanja minha al‑saalihtaji tagaʼ fi raas al‑aasi.
Be khachmah,al‑kaafir yidammir jiiraanahwa laakin be maʼrafathum,al‑saalihiin yanjo.
Wakit yaji al‑kheer le l‑saalihiin,al‑hille tafrahwa wakit yumuutu al‑aasiyiin,hi tizakhrit.
Be barakat al‑adiiliin,al‑hille tittawwarwa be kalaam al‑aasiyiin,al‑hille tiddammar.
Al‑naadum al‑yiʼayyir jiiraanahgaliil fihimwa laakin al‑yalzam lisaanahindah ilim.
Al‑yangul al‑kalaam yakchif al‑achiirwa laakin al‑amiin yahfadah fi galbah.
Kan ma fi khiyaada,al‑chaʼab yagaʼwa katarat al‑mustachaariin tijiib al‑naja.
Al‑yadman al‑ma maʼruufiin yilbachtanwa laakin al‑yaaba al‑damaan yiʼiich be amaan.
Al‑mara al‑tarham talga charafwa siid al‑unuf yalga al‑maal.
Al‑yisawwi al‑kheeryijiib al‑jamiil le nafsahwa l‑yisawwi al‑unufyijiib al‑damaar fi raasah.

Ma tikattir machiik le beet rafiigakachaan hu yachbaʼ minnak wa baʼadeen yakrahak.
Al‑yachhad be kidib fi akhuuhhu misil safaroog aw seef aw nuchchaab tariin.
Amaan al‑khaayin fi yoom al‑diigehu misil sinn al‑machguuga wa l‑rijil al‑maksuura.
Al‑khine jamb al‑haznaanmisil taglaʼ khalag al‑naadum al‑bardaanwa tusubb fi l‑uwaara taʼaam.
Kan aduuk jiiʼaan,antiih yaakulwa kan atchaan,antiih yachrab.
Wa be da,al‑eeb yakurbahwa yabga misil jamur al‑sabbooh fi raasahwa Allah yikaafiik be l‑kheer.
Al‑zaggaay al‑taji min al‑watitijiib al‑matarwa l‑lisaan al‑yakchif al‑sirryijiib al‑khatar.
Akheer taskun wiheedak fi raas beetakmin tiʼiich maʼa l‑mara al‑tikhaalifak.
Al‑khabar al‑halu al‑jaayi min baʼiidmisil al‑almi al‑baaridfi lisaan al‑ayyaan.
Kan al‑saalih yikhassid be haal al‑aasi,da misil rahad almi al‑yatlafwa een almi al‑tiʼaffin.
Ma waajib taakul al‑asal be katarawa ma waajib tidoor al‑naas yicharrufuuk fi kulla wakit.
Al‑raajil al‑ma yamluk nafsah,hu misil madiina al‑ma indaha durdur yahmiiha.
Al‑charaf ma biwaafig le l‑matmuusmisil al‑barad fi l‑seefwa l‑matar fi l‑darat.
Al‑laʼana bala sabab ma talhag.Hi titiir misil abunfiseywa tuduur misil sagur.
Al‑sariime sawwooha le l‑juwaadwa l‑asa le l‑humaarwa l‑soot le dahar al‑matmuus.
Ma turudd le l‑matmuus hasab tamaastahachaan ma tabga mislah.
Rudd le l‑matmuus hasab tamaastahachaan ma yuguul indah hikma.
Kan anteet risaaltak le l‑matmuusda misil gataʼt rijlak aw chiribt samm.
Al‑masal fi khachum al‑matmuusma indah faayde misil rijil al‑aʼraj.
Kan tanti charaf le l‑matmuusda misil inta rabat hajar fi l‑miglaaʼ.
Al‑masal fi khachum al‑matmuusmisil firiʼ hana kitir fi iid al‑sakkaari.
Al‑yiʼajjir al‑matmuusaw yiʼajjir al‑ma maʼruuf al‑maachi fi l‑chaariʼ,hu misil siid al‑nuchchaabal‑yajrah kulla l‑naas.
Al‑matmuus yigabbil fi nifaakhahmisil al‑kalib yigabbil yaakul al‑gaddafah.
Akheer tukhutt achamak fi l‑matmuusmin tukhutt achamak fi l‑yahsib nafsah hakiim.
Al‑kaslaan buguul ke : Fiyah duud barra.Fi ayyi chaariʼ,raayikh duud khatari. 
Wa hu yichchaglab fi furaachahmisil al‑baab al‑yinfatih wa yinsadda.
Al‑kaslaan yidiss iidah fi l‑gadahwa kadar yijiibha le khachmah kula gaasi leyah.
Wa hu yichiif nafsah hakiimziyaada min sabʼa naas aagliin.
Al‑yadkhul fi machaakil ma hineeyahmisil karab kalib min udneeyah.
Al‑naadum al‑yukhuchchakwa yuguul : Ana gaaʼid nalʼab maʼaak ,hu da misil muchootin al‑yazurgakbe nuchchaab musammam le yaktulak.
Kan ma fi hatab,al‑naar tumuutwa kan ma fi gawwaal,al‑kalaam yumuut.
Katarat al‑faham tiziid al‑jamurwa katarat al‑hatab tiziid al‑naarwa l‑gawwaal yiziid al‑machaakil.
Kalaam al‑gawwaal misil al‑halaawa,taakulah wa yanzil fi batnak.
Al‑galb al‑azrag kan kalaamah halu kulahu misil jarr al‑tiine al‑mamsuuh be fudda.
Al‑yakrah al‑naas yillabbad wara kalaamahlaakin galbah malaan be l‑khachch.
Kan kalaamah ajabaak kula,ma tisaddigahachaan galbah malaanbe l‑fikir al‑haraam.
Wa kan yilabbid karaahiiytah be khachch kula,yoom waahid yinkachif giddaam kulla l‑naas.

Lisaan al‑kaddaabyakrah al‑zalamaahumwa khachum al‑khachchaachyijiib al‑damaar.
Ma tachkur nafsakfi l‑tisawwiih ambaakirachaan fi l‑yoom da,inta ma taʼarif chunu yukuun.
Ma tachkur nafsak,khalli al‑aakhariin yachkuruukwa ma tamdah nafsak,khalli al‑naas yamdahook.
Sahiih,al‑hajar tagiilwa chuwaal al‑turaab kula tagiilwa laakin machaakil al‑munaafikhtugaal minhum.
Al‑zaʼal yikhawwifwa l‑khadab yaglib misil al‑seel.Wa laakin yaatu yagdar yagiifgiddaam al‑husud ?
Akheer al‑rafiig al‑yuluumakmin al‑yilabbid reedtah leek.

Al‑raajil al‑jara min beetahmisil al‑teer al‑khalla uchchah.
Al‑itir wa l‑bakhuur yifarruhu al‑galibwa hubb al‑rafiig yinlagi fi wasiiytah al‑naafiʼ.
Ma tikhalli rafiigak wa la rafiig abuukwa fi wakt al‑diige ma tamchi fi beet akhuuk.Jaar gariib akheer min akhu baʼiid.
Ya wileedi,abga hakiim wa farrih galbiwa be da,nagdar nurudd le l‑yuluumuuni.
Al‑aagil yichiif al‑charr wa yibaariihwa laakin al‑jaahil yagaʼ foogah wa yiʼaaziih.
Al‑yadman naadum ma maʼruuf,chiil khalagahwa kan yadman ajnabiiye,akrub minnah damaan.

Al‑mara al‑daayman mukhaalife,khilaafha ma yagiifmisil tchaktchaak al‑iine.

Al‑hadiid yitarrig al‑hadiidwa l‑insaan yitarrig al‑insaan.
Al‑yirayyis zereʼ al‑tamuryaakul min tamrah.Wa l‑khaddaam al‑yifakkir fi siidahyalga charaf.
Fi l‑almi,yinchaaf wijh al‑insaanwa fi galbah,tinchaaf nafsah.
Chahwat al‑insaan abadan ma tachbaʼmisil al‑moot wa l‑halaak abadan ma yachbaʼo.
Be l‑naar,al‑sayyaakhi yakchif al‑dahab wa l‑fuddawa laakin al‑insaan yinʼarif be simʼitah.
Kan tudugg al‑munaafikhmisil daggiin al‑khallabeen al‑fundug wa l‑amuud kula,abadan ma yikhalli nifaakhah.
Aʼarif khanamak adiilwa rayyis door bahaaymak.
Achaan al‑khuna ma yuduum ila l‑abadwa l‑taaj ma yinhafid min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Wakit al‑gechch al‑yaabis yikammil,agtaʼ al‑haya al‑akhdarwa limm gechch al‑gooz.

Wa laban inzeek,yitimm le iichtakwa le iichit beetak wa le khaddaamaatak.
Kan ma yaturduuh kula,al‑aasi yajri wa yinbalis.Wa laakin al‑saalihfahal misil al‑duud.
Al‑isyaan kan kitir fi l‑balad,hukkaamha yabgo katiiriinwa l‑salaam ma yajiilla be raajil faahim wa hakiim.
Al‑raajil al‑fagraan al‑yazlum al‑daʼiifiinhu misil matara chadiideal‑tidammir kulla cheyy.Baʼadha ma fi maʼaach.
Al‑yaabo al‑gaanuun,yachkuru al‑aasiyiinwa l‑yahfado al‑gaanuun,yugummu didduhum.
Al‑fasliin ma yafhamo cheyy fi l‑adaalawa laakin al‑yifattuchu Allah yafhamo kulla cheyy.
Akheer fagri maachi be sahiihmin khani aayich be kidib.
Al‑wileed al‑faahim yitaabiʼ taʼliim abuuhwa laakin al‑yiraafig al‑mukhaalifiin yiʼayyibah.

Al‑yisidd adaanah min wasaaya Allah,salaatah kula Allah yajʼalha haraama wa ma yakhbalha.
Al‑yuguud al‑naas al‑adiiliinfi l‑derib al‑fasil,hu kula yagaʼ fi l‑nugra al‑nakatha.Wa laakin al‑naas al‑tamaamiinyawrusu al‑kheer.
Al‑khani kan yichiif nafsah hakiim kula,al‑fagri al‑faahim yagdar yaʼarif al‑fi galbah.

Al‑yilabbid khataayah ma yanjah.Wa laakin al‑yutuub min khataayah wa yikhalliih,Allah yarhamah.
Mabruuk le l‑insaanal‑daayman yakhaaf min Allahwa laakin al‑yigawwi raasahyagaʼ fi l‑charr.

Kaatil al‑dimme yajri le l‑haawiye.Khalluuh,ma tiwaggufuuh !
Al‑yamchi adiil,yanjawa l‑aʼwaj yichiil duruub tineen wa yagaʼ ajala.
Al‑yahrit ardah yachbaʼ be l‑maʼaachwa laakin al‑yitaabiʼ al‑hawa yachbaʼ be l‑fagur.

Al‑yitwakkal ale nafsah,hu da matmuuswa laakin al‑yamchi be hikma,hu da yanja.

Wakit al‑aasiyiin yanjaho,al‑naas yillabbado.Wakit al‑aasiyiin yiddammaro,al‑saalihiin yaktaro.
Al‑raajil al‑fakko adaanahwa gaaʼid yigawwi raasah,yinrahik marra waahidwa battaan ma yalga ilaaj.

Kattaaliin al‑dimam yakraho al‑raajil al‑tamaamwa laakin al‑adiiliin yahmu hayaatah.

Al‑naas hana hassaʼ ma yizzakkaroal‑naas al‑aacho gubbaalhum.Wa l‑naas al‑lissaaʼ ma wildoohum,al‑naas al‑yaju baʼadhum kulama yizzakkaroohum.
Ana Muʼallimwa hakamt fi Bani Israaʼiilfi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Ana chilt niiyewa fattacht wa kachaft be hikmafi ayyi cheyy al‑gaaʼid yukuun tihit al‑sama.Wa di chakhala tagiileal‑antaaha al‑Rabb le Bani Adam le yisawwiiha.
Wa ana chift kulla l‑khidmeal‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuha fi l‑ard.Wa da kula zaayil saakitmisil al‑jari wara l‑riih.
Al‑aʼwaj ma binʼadilwa l‑ma fi,ma binlagi.
Wa ana gult fi nafsi : Ana kibirt wa indi hikma ziyaadamin kulla l‑hakamo gubbaalifi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa hafadt fi galbihikma wa maʼrafa be ziyaada. 
Ana chilt niiye le naʼarif al‑hikmawa le naʼarif al‑jahal wa l‑tamaasa.Wa baʼad da,ana iriftkadar da kula jari wara l‑riih.
Achaan katarat al‑hikma,tikattir al‑hizinwa ziyaadat al‑ilim,tiziid al‑taʼab.
Wa ana gult le nafsi : Yalla !Nijarribki be l‑farahwa tichiifi al‑kheer. Wa khalaas,da kula zaayil saakit.
Wa fi l‑dihik,ana gult : Da jahal ! Wa fi l‑farah,ana gult : Da yanfaʼ chunu ? 
Wa ana kharrartnifarrih nafsi be l‑khamar.Wa nuguud nafsi be l‑hikmawa ninrabit fi l‑tamaasa kula.Be da,nichiif kikkeefwaajib al‑insaan yiʼiich adiil fi tihit al‑sama,fi kulla muddit ayyaam hayaatah.
Wa ana sawweet achya kubaar.Baneet buyuutwa maggant jineenaat inab.
Wa sawweet jineenaatwa ziraaʼa kubaar.Wa fooghum,maggant kulla nafar hana chadaral‑indah fawaakih.
Wa sawweet khazzaanaatachaan be almiihum,nazgi magan al‑chadar.
Ana chareet abiid wa khadiimwa humman wildo iyaalhum fi beeti.Indi battaan bagar wa khanam be katara,ziyaada min kulla l‑hakamo gubbaali fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Ana lammeet battaan fudda wa dahabwa kanz min muluuk wa buldaan.Ligiit khannaayiin wa khannaayaatwa indi sirriiyaat be katara le chahwaatiwa da misil chahwat kulla l‑rujaal.
Ana bigiit aziim wa khani ziyaadamin kulla l‑hakamo gubbaalifi Madiinat al‑Khuduswa ana gaaʼid daayman be hikmati.
Ana chilt kulla l‑cheyy al‑wagaʼ fi eeniwa ma abeet ayyi cheyy al‑yifarrih galbi.Aywa,galbi firih be kulla khidimti.Wa da bas gismi al‑ligiitahmin kulla khidimti di.
Wa ana fakkart le kulla cheyy al‑sawwooh iideeni,fakkart le l‑khidme al‑tiʼibt foogha.Wa da kula zaayil saakitmisil al‑jari wara l‑riihwa ma indah faayde fi l‑ard.
Wa ana gabbalt wa fakkart fi l‑hikmawa l‑jahal wa l‑tamaasa.Khalaas,chunu yisawwi al‑raajilal‑yidarruju malik baʼadi ?Yisawwi misil al‑sawwooh awwal bas !
Daahu al‑ana iriftah.Al‑hikma indaha faayde ziyaada min al‑tamaasamisil al‑nuur indah faayde ziyaada min al‑dalaam.
Al‑hakiim yichiif baʼiidwa l‑matmuus yuruukh fi l‑dalaam.Wa laakin be da kula,ana naʼarif kadarnafs al‑cheyy yukuun leehum humman al‑itneen.
Wa ana gult fi nafsi : Al‑yukuun le l‑matmuus,yukuun leyi ana kula.Wa kan misil da,chunu faaydit hikmati ? Wa khalaas,ana gult : Da kula zaayil saakit. 
Achaan al‑hakiim,ma yizzakkarooh daayman.Hu kula misil al‑matmuus.Fi l‑mustakhbal,humman al‑itneen,yansoohum !Wa khalaas,al‑hakiim wa l‑matmuusyumuutu nafs al‑moot !
Khalaas,ana kiriht al‑hayaachaan khidmit al‑insaan fi l‑ard di,ana nichiifha fasle.Achaan da kula zaayil saakitmisil al‑jari wara l‑riih.
Wa ana kiriht kulla l‑khidmeal‑ana sawweetha fi l‑ard.Wa di l‑khidme al‑nikhalliihale l‑naadum al‑yaji min baʼadi.
Wa yaatu yaʼarif kan al‑naadum dayukuun hakiimaw fikrah mahduud ?Be da kula,hu yabga siid al‑khidmeal‑ana sawweetha be hikma fi l‑ard.Wa da kula zaayil saakit.
Ana nidimt wa achami angataʼfi chaan kulla l‑khidme al‑sawweetha fi l‑ard.
Achaan fi naadum khadambe hikma wa maʼrafa wa najaah.Wa be da kula,daahu yantu natiijat khidimtahle naadum al‑ma khadam cheyy !Wa da kula zaayil saakitwa di masiibe kabiire.
Wa kan misil da,chunu al‑yalgaah al‑insaanmin kulla juhdahwa khidimtah al‑sawwaaha fi l‑ard ?
Achaan ayyaam hayaatah kulluhum taʼabwa chakhalatah kullaha hizin.Hatta be leel kula,galbah ma raagid.Wa da kula zaayil saakit.
Wa l‑adiil le l‑insaanyaakul wa yachrabwa yichiif al‑halu fi khidimtah.Wa ana chift da kulayaji min al‑Rabb.
Wa bala izin al‑Rabb,yaatu yagdar yaakulwa yitmattaʼ fi hayaatah ?
Achaan al‑Rabb yanti al‑hikma wa l‑maʼrafa wa l‑farah le l‑naadum al‑adiil giddaamah.Wa laakin le l‑muznib,al‑Rabb yantiih chakhala hana fattichiin wa lammiin le yijiibah wa yantiih le l‑naadum al‑adiil giddaam al‑Rabb.Wa da kula zaayil saakit misil al‑jari wara l‑riih.
Le kulla cheyy fi zamanwa le kulla cheyy tihit al‑sama,fi wakit munaasib.
Fi wakit le l‑waaluudawa fi wakit le l‑moot.Fi wakit le l‑magginiinwa fi wakit le mallitiin al‑magan.
Fi wakit le l‑katilwa fi wakit le l‑chifa.Fi wakit le l‑haddimiinwa fi wakit le l‑buna.
Fi wakit le l‑bakiwa fi wakit le l‑dihik.Fi wakit le l‑nuwaahwa fi wakit le l‑liʼib.
Fi wakit le zarrigiiin al‑hujaarwa fi wakit le lammiin al‑hujaar.Fi wakit le l‑muhaadanawa fi wakit le khalliyiin al‑muhaadana.
Fi wakit le l‑fattichiinwa fi wakit le l‑waddiriin.Fi wakit le l‑hafadaanwa fi wakit le l‑zagalaan.
Fi wakit le l‑charritiinwa fi wakit le l‑khiyaata.Fi wakit le l‑sukuutwa fi wakit le l‑hije.
Fi wakit le l‑mahabbawa fi wakit le l‑karaahiiye.Fi wakit le l‑haribwa fi wakit le l‑salaam.
Chunu al‑faaydeal‑yalgaaha al‑khaddaam min khidimtah ?
Ana chift al‑chakhalaal‑khattaaha al‑Rabb fi Bani Adam.
Kulla cheyy al‑sawwaah al‑Rabbjamiil fi waktahwa khatta acham al‑dawaamfi guluubhum.Laakin al‑insaan ma yagdar yaʼarifal‑khidme al‑sawwaaha al‑Rabbmin al‑bidaaya le l‑nihaaya.
Ana naʼarfah ma fi cheyy adiil le l‑insaanilla l‑farha wa l‑kheer fi hayaatah.
Wa waajib le ayyi insaan yaakul wa yachrabwa yalga al‑kheer fi kulla khidimtah.Wa di hadiiye min al‑Rabb.
Wa ana naʼarif kulla cheyyal‑sawwaah al‑Rabbda daayim.Ma fi al‑yangusahwa la yiziidah.Wa l‑Rabb sawwa kulla cheyyachaan yakhaafo minnah.
Al‑gaaʼid hassaʼ,kaan min awwalwa l‑yukuun kula,kaan min zamaan.Wa l‑Rabb yigabbil al‑cheyy al‑faat.
Wa daahu battaan al‑cheyy al‑ana chiftah fi l‑ard.Fi bakaan al‑adaala,al‑zulum gaaʼid !Wa fi bakaan al‑chariiʼa,al‑zulum gaaʼid !
Wa ana gult fi nafsi : Al‑Rabb yihaasib al‑saalihwa l‑aasi kulaachaan le kulla cheyy fi wakit munaasibwa kulla amal be waktah. 
Wa ana gult fi nafsi : Kan le Bani Adam,khalli al‑Rabb yijarribhumle yaʼarfukadar humman zaathum misil bahaayim. 
Achaan al‑yukuun le Bani Adam,yukuun le l‑bahaayim kula.Al‑waahid yumuutmisil al‑aakhar.Induhum nafs al‑ruuhwa l‑insaan misil al‑bahiime.Khalaas,da kula zaayil saakit.
Kulluhum keyamchu le bakaan waahid.Kulluhum min al‑turaabwa yigabbulu fi l‑turaab.
Yaatu yaʼarif kan ruuh al‑insaantamchi foog fi l‑samawa kan ruuh al‑bahiimetanzil tihit fi l‑ard ?
Wa ana chift kadar ma fi cheyy ahsan le l‑insaanmin yafrah be amalahachaan da bas gismah.Yaatu yihayyiih battaanle yichiif al‑cheyyal‑yukuun baʼad mootah ?
Ana chift battaan kulla l‑zulumal‑gaaʼid yukuun fi l‑ard.Daahu ana chift dumuuʼ al‑mazluumiinwa ma fi al‑yisabbirhum.Wa l‑gudra daayman le l‑zaalimiinwa l‑mazluumiin,ma fi al‑yisabbirhum.
Wa fi fikri,al‑maytiin khalaas humman murtaahiinmin al‑hayyiin al‑lissaaʼhum aaychiin.
Wa laakin al‑lissaaʼ ma wildoohum murtaahiinmin al‑maytiin wa l‑hayyiin kula !Achaan humman lissaaʼ ma chaafoal‑amal al‑fasilal‑gaaʼid yukuun fi l‑ard.
Ana chift kadar kulla l‑khidmewa kulla najaah al‑amaljaayi min husud al‑insaan le akhuuh.Wa da kula zaayil saakitmisil al‑jari wara l‑riih.
Al‑matmuus kan yitabbig iideenah,yidammir hayaatah.
Wa laakin iid waahide munjammeakheer min iide itneen yakhdumu daaymanwa yajru wara l‑riih.
Ana chift battaan cheyy aakhar fi l‑ardzaayil saakit.
Daahu naadum wiheedahma indah naadum maʼaayah,wa la wileed wa la akhu.Wa hu yakhdim bala haddwa be da kula,hu ma yachbaʼ min al‑khuna.Wa hu yifakkir wa yuguul : Le yaatu ana nakhdim misil dawa nitaʼʼib nafsi ? Wa da kula zaayil saakitwa di chakhala hint taʼab.
achaan yalgo ujra adiile min khidmithum.
Achaan kan waahid wagaʼ,al‑aakhar yarfaʼah.Wa laakin al‑khassaarale l‑gaaʼid wiheedahachaan kan yagaʼ,ma fi naadum al‑yarfaʼah.
Wa misil da,kan naaseen yunuumu sawa,yalgo dafu.Wa laakin al‑gaaʼid wiheedahyalga dafu min ween ?
Naadum yagdar yakhlib naadum waahidwa laakin ma yagdar yakhlib naaseen.Wa l‑habil al‑mutallatma yingatiʼ ajala.
Akheer sabi fagri wa hakiimmin malik chaayib wa matmuusal‑yaaba al‑wasiiye.
Achaan al‑sabi da yagdar yamrugmin al‑sijin wa yahkim,hatta kan wildooh fi l‑fagurfi usut chaʼab mamlakatah kula.
Ana chift battaan kulla l‑naasal‑maachiin fi l‑ard,yagiifu maʼa l‑sabial‑yarkab baʼad al‑malik.
Wa l‑chaʼab da ma yinhasbuwa la l‑waagfiin giddaamah.Wa laakin al‑yaju baʼadahma yafraho beyah.Akiid da kula zaayil saakitmisil al‑jari wara l‑riih.
Ahfad nafsak,wakit tamchi fi beet Allah.Garrib le tasmaʼ,da akheer min tigaddim dahiiyat al‑mataamiis.Achaan humman ma yaʼarfukadar gaaʼidiin yisawwu al‑fasaala.
Ma tissaʼjal fi kalaamakwa khalli kalaam galbak ma yamrug ajalagiddaam al‑Rabb.Achaan al‑Rabb gaaʼid fi l‑samawa inta gaaʼid fi l‑ard.Wa fi chaan da,khalli kalaamakma yabga katiir.
Achaan katarat al‑chakhalatijiib al‑hilimwa katarat al‑kalaamtijiib al‑tamaasa.
Wakit tisawwi nazir le l‑Rabb,ma tiʼakhkhir le titimmah.Achaan al‑Rabb ma yardabe l‑mataamiis.Khalaas,haggig kulla nazrakal‑sawweetah.
Akheer leek ma tisawwi nazirmin tisawwiih wa ma tihaggigah.
Ma tikhalli kalaamak yisawwiik muznibwa tuguul le raajil al‑diin : Ma nagdar nitimm nazri.Ana sawweet khata ! Be misil da,al‑Rabb yakhdab min kalaamakwa yidammir khidmit iideenak.
Achaan katarat al‑hilimzaayil saakitWa misil da,fi katarat al‑kalaam kula,akhaaf min al‑Rabb.
Wa kan inta chift fi balad waahideyazulmu al‑miskiinwa yadharooh min al‑hagg wa l‑adaala,ma tilʼajjab min al‑cheyy da.Achaan al‑masʼuul yahmi al‑masʼuulwa fi masaaʼiil aakhariin kubaar minhum.
Intaaj al‑ard yanfaʼ le kulla l‑naaswa l‑malik waajib yahmi al‑ziraaʼa.
Al‑yihibb al‑gurus ma yachbaʼ minnahwa l‑yihibb al‑khuna ma yaksab.Wa da kula zaayil saakit.
Wa kan al‑kheer bigi katiir,al‑yaakuluuh kula yabgo katiiriin.Wa misil da,chunu al‑faayde al‑yalgaaha siidah ?Illa bichiifah be eenah bas !
Noom al‑khaddaam halu leyah,kan yaakul katiir wa la chiyya kula.Wa laakin hamm al‑khunayadhar al‑noom.
Fi l‑ard,ana chift fasaalatajrah al‑galib.Al‑khuna al‑siidah yudummahyisabbib leyah al‑halaak.
Wa l‑khuna da yiwaddirfi chakhala al‑ma indaha faayde.Wa wileed al‑khanima yalga cheyy yawrisah.
Wa misil marag min batun ammah aryaan,yamchi fi l‑khabur aryaan.Wa min kulla khidimtahma yalga cheyy yiwaddiih maʼaayah.
Wa di kula fasaala al‑tajrah al‑galib.Hu yamchi sawa sawa misil ja.Wa chunu al‑faayde al‑ligiihamin al‑khidme al‑sawwaaha fi l‑riih ?
Hu waddar kulla ayyaamah fi l‑dalaamwa fi katarat al‑hamm wa l‑taʼab wa l‑zaʼal.
Daahu al‑ana chiftah.Adiil le l‑insaan yaakul wa yachrabwa yalga al‑kheer fi kulla khidimtahal‑yisawwiiha fi l‑ard.Yisawwi misil dafi kulla muddit hayaatahal‑yantiiha leyah al‑Rabb.Wa da bas gismah.
Wa misil da,wakit al‑Rabb anta naadummaal wa khuna al‑beehum hu yiʼiich,hu yagdar yalga minhum gismahwa yitmattaʼ be khidimtah.Wa di hadiiye min al‑Rabb.
Wa khalaas,wakit al‑Rabb yamla galbah be l‑farah,hu ma yifakkir ziyaada fi ayyaam umrah.
Fiyah fasaala ana chiftaha fi l‑ard,al‑titaʼʼib Bani Adam.
Al‑fasaala di,hi raajil al‑Rabb antaahmaal wa khuna wa charafwa cheyy gassar leyah ma fiihmin al‑yitmannaah.Laakin al‑Rabb ma khallaahyitmattaʼ be maalah da,illa l‑ajnabi bas yitmattaʼ beyah.Wa da kula zaayil saakitwa di fasaala al‑tajrah al‑galib.
Akuun naadum wilid miya iyaalwa aach umur tawiilwa siniinah bigo katiiriinlaakin ma firih be kheerahlahaddi ma ligi dafin adiil.Khalaas,ana nuguul kadar al‑naadum da,sakhiir al‑rumaaye kula akheer minnah !
Achaan al‑rumaaye tajifi wakit al‑ma wakitha.Hi zaayle saakit wa tamchi fi l‑dalaamwa ma fi al‑yizzakkarha.
Al‑rumaaye ma chaafatwa la irfat cheyy fi l‑ard.Wa laakin hi indaha raaha ziyaadamin al‑naadum da !
Wa kan al‑naadum da yiʼiich alif sanawa battaan alif sana aakhariin kulawa ma chaaf al‑kheer,khalaas hu wa l‑rumaaye di,bakaanhum yabga waahid.
Ayyi khidme al‑yisawwiiha al‑insaan,da le iichtah baswa laakin be da kula,hu ma yachbaʼ.
Al‑faayde al‑yalgaaha al‑hakiim ma ziyaadamin al‑faayde al‑yalgaaha al‑matmuus.Wa l‑fagri kula ma yalga faaydehatta kan yiʼaddil haalah giddaam al‑naas.
Akheer tafrah be l‑indakmin tifakkir fi cheyy al‑ma yilhaggag.Wa da kula zaayil saakitmisil al‑jari wara l‑riih.
Kulla cheyy al‑gaaʼid fi l‑ardmaʼruuf min zamaanwa naʼarfu chunu al‑insaan.Hu ma yagdar yihaarijmaʼa l‑gaadir minnah.
Al‑kalaam kan katiir kula,zaayil saakit.Wa l‑insaan,chunu al‑faaydeal‑yalgaaha minnah ?
Khalaas,yaatu al‑yaʼarif al‑cheyy al‑adiille l‑insaan fi muddit hayaatah ?Aywa,chunu adiil fi muddit ayyaam hayaatahal‑zaayle saakit misil al‑dull ?Wa yaatu yikhabbir al‑insaanbe l‑yukuun baʼadah fi l‑ard ?
Al‑usum al‑taaliʼ akheermin al‑itir al‑khaali.Wa yoom al‑moot akheermin yoom al‑waaluuda.
Al‑machi le bakaan al‑moot akheermin al‑machi le bakaan al‑aazuuma.Achaan al‑moot waajib le kulli insaanwa l‑hayyiin,waajib yifakkuru foogah.
Al‑hizin akheer min al‑dihikachaan be karibiin al‑wijihal‑galib yifakkir adiil.
Galb al‑hakiim yifakkir fi l‑hizinwa galb al‑matmuus yifakkir fi l‑farah.
Akheer le l‑insaan yasmaʼ luwaamit al‑hakiimmin yasmaʼ khine al‑mataamiis.
Dihik al‑mataamiis misil hiss al‑chookal‑gaaʼid yahrag ajala tihit al‑burma.Wa da kula zaayil saakit.
Achaan al‑zulum yisawwi al‑hakiim matmuuswa l‑rachwa tiwaddir aglah.
Ayyi cheyy,nihaaytah akheermin bidaaytah.Wa l‑insaan al‑saabir akheermin al‑mustakbir.
Ma tissaʼjal le tazʼalachaan al‑zaʼal gaaʼidfi guluub al‑mataamiis.
Ma tuguul : Maala ayyaamna al‑faato akheermin ayyaamna al‑hassaʼ dool ? Al‑suʼaal dama jaayi min al‑hikma.
Al‑hikma adiile misil maal al‑warasawa indaha faayde le l‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑ard.
Achaan al‑gaaʼid fi dull al‑hikmamisil al‑gaaʼid fi dull al‑maal.Faaydit al‑maʼrafa di chunu ?Hi al‑hikma al‑tinajji siidha.
Chiif amal al‑Rabb !Al‑hu awwajah,yaatu yagdar yiʼaddilah ?
Fi ayyaam al‑kheer,afrah !Wa fi ayyaam al‑charr,fakkir !Al‑Rabb bas yirassil al‑kheer wa l‑charrwa be da,al‑insaan ma yaʼarif mustakhbalah.
Ana chift kulla l‑cheyy dafi wakit ayyaami al‑zaayliin saakit.Fi waahid saalih yumuuthatta kan hu saalih kula.Wa fi waahid fasil yiʼiich umur tawiilhatta kan hu fasil kula.
Naas waahidiin buguulu : Ma tabga saalih ziyaadawa la tabga hakiim ziyaada.Achaan be da,tidammir nafsak.
Ma tabga fasil ziyaadawa la tikhalli fikrakyabga mahduud ziyaada.Achaan be da,tumuut gabul ayyaamak. 
Akheer takrub al‑wasiiye al‑waahidewa l‑aakhara kula,ma tikhalliiha.Achaan al‑yakhaaf min al‑Rabbyanja min al‑dammar wa l‑moot.
Al‑hikma tigawwi al‑hakiim ziyaadamin achara hukkaam fi madiina.
Akiid,ma fi naadum saalih fi l‑ardal‑yisawwi al‑adiil wa ma yaznib.
Ma tichiil kulla kalaam al‑buguuluuh al‑naaswa be da,ma tasmaʼ abdak yalʼanak.
Achaan inta taʼarif adiilkadar inta zaatak laʼant naas aakhariin.
Wa da,ana jarrabtah kulla be hikmawa gult : Khalli nabga hakiim. Laakin al‑hikma baʼiide minni.
Hi baʼiide taamse fi l‑khariigwa l‑fi l‑khariig,yaatu yalgaaha ?
Ana chilt niiye be kulla galbile nifattich wa nakchifal‑hikma wa l‑agulwa le naʼarif al‑fasaala hi al‑tamaasawa tamaasa hi al‑jahaala.
Wa ana ligiit cheyy waahid murr min al‑mootwa di mara al‑misil al‑charak.Galibha misil amkajjaamawa iideenha misil janaaziir.Al‑yakhaaf min al‑Rabb yanja minhawa laakin al‑muznib yagaʼ fi charakha.
Al‑Muʼallim gaal :Daahu al‑cheyy al‑ana ligiitah.Ana fakkart fi l‑achya doolal‑waahid baʼad al‑aakharle naʼarif maʼanaathum.
Ana fattacht battaan wa ma ligiit.Ana ligiit raajil waahid bas fi ust al‑alifal‑ana nagdar nisammiih raajil.Wa laakin fi usut kulla l‑awiin,ma ligiit waahide al‑ana nikarrimha.
Wa daahu al‑cheyy al‑ana ligiitah.Al‑Rabb khalag kulla l‑insaan adiilwa laakin humman yifattuchu machaakil be katara.
Yaatu hakiim ?Wa yaatu al‑yagdar yifassir al‑kalaam da ?Al‑hikma tidawwi wijh al‑insaanwa khalaas,yatlig wijhah al‑karabah.
Kan leyi ana,nuguul :fi chaan al‑haliife al‑inta sawweetha giddaam al‑Rabb.
Ma tissaʼjal wa taaba sultitahwa la tagiif didd kalaamahhatta kan hawaan kula.Achaan al‑malik yisawwi kulla cheyyal‑hu yidoorah.
Kan hu yuguul chunu kula,hu bas al‑malik !Wa kan misil da,yaatu yagdar yuguul leyah : Inta tisawwi chunu ? 
Al‑yitabbig amur al‑malikma yichiif minnah ayyi fasaala.Wa l‑hakiim yaʼarif al‑wakit al‑munaasibwa kikkeef tukuun al‑chariiʼa.
Achaan le kulla cheyy fi wakit munaasibwa fi wakit le l‑chariiʼa.Aywa,fasaalit al‑insaantabga khatiire leyah hu.
Achaan hu ma yaʼarifal‑cheyy al‑yukuun.Wa yaatu yagdar yuguul leyahyabga misil da walla da ?
Ma fi ayyi insaan yagdar yakrub ruuhahwa la insaan al‑indah gudra fi yoom mootah.Ma fi insaan indah hagg yamrug min al‑haribwa l‑fasaala ma yinajji siidha.
Wa kulla l‑cheyy da,ana chiftahwakit fakkart fi kulla l‑khidmeal‑gaaʼide tukuun fi l‑ard.Fi wakit al‑foogah al‑insaan yamluk fi l‑insaanle yisawwi leyah al‑fasaala.
Wa misil da,ana chiftal‑fasliin dafanoohum fi l‑khubuur be charaf.Wa awwal humman yamchu wa yajumin al‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas.Laakin fi l‑madiina di,al‑naas nisoohum.Wa da kula zaayil saakit.
Al‑ikhaab ma yinnaffaz ajalafi l‑amal al‑fasil.Wa be da,galb al‑insaan fi daakhilahmalaan be niiye hana sawwiyiin al‑fasaala.
Al‑muznib yagdar yisawwi al‑amal al‑fasil alif marrawa yiʼiich yitawwil.Wa laakin be da kula,ana naʼarifkadar al‑insaan al‑yakhaaf min al‑Rabbyalga al‑kheerachaan hu khaayif giddaamah.
Laakin al‑fasil ma yalga kheerwa ayyaam hayaatahyufuutu misil al‑dullachaan hu ma khaayif giddaam al‑Rabb.
Fi l‑ard,fiyah cheyy al‑zaayil saakitwa daahu al‑cheyy da.Fi naas saalihiin,yiʼaamuluuhummisil yiʼaamulu al‑fasliin.Wa fi naas fasliin,yiʼaamuluuhummisil yiʼaamulu al‑saalihiin.Wa ana gult battaan : Da kula zaayil saakit. 
Khalli al‑naas yiʼiichu be farahachaan akheer le l‑insaanyalga al‑akil wa l‑charaab wa l‑farah.Wa da yukuun maʼaayah fi khidimtahfi kulla ayyaam hayaatah fi l‑ardal‑antaaha leyah al‑Rabb.
Ana chilt niiye le naʼarif al‑hikmawa nichiif al‑chakhalaal‑gaaʼide tukuun fi l‑ard.Achaan een al‑insaan ma tunuumwa la leel wa la nahaar.
Wa ana chift kulla amal al‑Rabb.Wa l‑insaan ma yagdar yaʼarifal‑amal al‑gaaʼid yukuun fi l‑ard.Wa kan al‑insaan yifattichah be taʼab kula,ma yalgaah.Hatta kan al‑hakiim yuguul yaʼarfah kula,hu ma yagdar yaʼarif cheyy !
Aywa,ana fakkart fi kulla l‑achya doolwa fihimt kadar al‑saalihiin wa l‑hakiimiinwa khidmithum kulluhum fi iid al‑Rabb.Al‑insaan ma yaʼarifkan yalga al‑mahabbaaw al‑karaahiiye.Aywa,hu ma yaʼarifal‑cheyy al‑yarjaah !
Kulla cheyy yukuunle kulla l‑naas.Nafs al‑cheyy yukuunle l‑saalih wa l‑fasilwa le l‑adiil wa l‑taahir wa l‑nijiswa le l‑naadum al‑yigaddim al‑dahiiyewa le l‑naadum al‑ma yigaddimha.Aywa,nafs al‑cheyy yukuun le l‑adiilmisil le l‑muznibwa le l‑yahlifmisil le l‑yakhaaf min al‑haliife.
Wa daahu al‑fasaala al‑gaaʼide tukuun fi l‑ard.Nafs al‑cheyy yarja kulla l‑naas.Wa guluub al‑naas malaaniin be l‑fasaala wa l‑jahal kula gaaʼid fi kulla muddit hayaathum.Wa baʼad da,al‑moot gaaʼid yarjaahum.
Laakin kulla l‑hayyiininduhum acham.Al‑masal buguul : Al‑kalib al‑hayyakheer min al‑duud al‑mayyit. 
Achaan al‑hayyiin yaʼarfukadar yoom waahid yumuutu.Laakin al‑maytiinma yaʼarfu cheyy.Humman ma yalgo ayyi ajurwa battaan ma yizzakkaroohum.
Wa mahabbithum wa karaahiiyithum wa husudhumwaddaro khalaas.Wa battaan ma induhum gisim ila l‑abadfi kulla cheyy al‑yabga fi l‑ard.
Wa be da,aakulwa achrab khamarak be farah.Achaan da bas al‑amalal‑yarda beyah al‑Rabb.
Wa fi kulla wakit,albas khalag mukallafwa khalli ma yigassir leek al‑dihinal‑yamsahooh fi l‑raas.
Afrah be hayaatak maʼa martakal‑tihibbahafi kulla ayyaam hayaatakal‑antaahum leek al‑Rabb.Wa dool al‑ayyaamal‑zaayliin saakit fi l‑ard.Achaan da gismak al‑talgaahfi kulla muddit hayaatakwa fi khidimtak al‑tisawwiiha fi l‑ard.
Ayyi cheyy al‑tisawwiih,sawwiih be kulla gudurtak.Achaan ma fi khibra wa la maʼrafawa la hikma fi l‑khabur,al‑bakaan al‑inta maachi leyah.
Wa battaan ana chift fi l‑ardal‑sabag ma daayman le l‑ajiiliinwa l‑nasur ma daayman le l‑furraaswa l‑iiche al‑haluuwe ma daayman le l‑hakiimiinwa l‑khuna ma daayman le l‑faahimiinwa l‑rahma ma daayman le l‑induhum al‑maʼrafa.Achaan kulla l‑naasyiwaajuhu al‑kheer wa l‑charr.
Achaan al‑insaan ma yaʼarif yoomahmisil al‑huut wa l‑teeral‑karaboohum fi l‑charakwa yumuutu foogah.Wa misil da,le l‑insaan kula,al‑fasaala tagaʼ foogah fajʼatan.
Wa daahu ana chift fi l‑ardmasal hana l‑hikmaal‑bigi leyi ajiib.
Fiyah hille waahide sakhayreal‑indaha rujaal chiyya.Wa malik waahid gaadir gamma didd al‑hille diwa hawwagha be durdur le yihaasirha.
Wa fiyah raajil waahid miskiin wa hakiimwa hu najja al‑hille di be hikmatah.Laakin baʼadeen,ma fi naadum azzakkaral‑miskiin da.
Wa khalaas,ana gult : Al‑hikma akheer min al‑fahaaliiye.Wa laakin hikmat al‑miskiin da,al‑naas hagaroohawa ma simʼo kalaamah. 
Kalaam haadi hana l‑hakiimiinakheer min awwit al‑malik le l‑mataamiis.
Al‑hikma akheermin silaah al‑harib.Wa laakin al‑khaltaanyagdar yidammir kheer katiir.
Al‑dubbaan al‑mayyityihammid wa yiʼaffinal‑dihin hana siid al‑itir.Wa misil da,chiyya min al‑tamaasatitallif al‑hikma wa l‑charaf.
Galb al‑hakiimyimayyil ale l‑tariig al‑adiilwa galb al‑matmuusyimayyil ale l‑tariig al‑aʼwaj.
Wa wakit al‑matmuus yamchi fi l‑derib,yinʼarif kadar hu ma indah fihimwa yiwassif le l‑naaskadar fikrah mahduud.
Wakit al‑malik yazʼal diddak,angariʼ,ma tikhalli bakaanak.Agood haadiwa da yinajjiik min zunuub katiir.
Fiyah fasaala ana chiftaha fi l‑ardwa l‑fasaala di,hi khata jaayi min al‑malik.
Al‑mataamiis yukhuttuuhumfi bakaan aali ziyaadawa l‑khaniyiin yukhuttuuhumfi bakaan tihit.
Ana chift battaan abiid raakbiin fi kheelwa masaaʼiil maachiin be rijleehum misil abiid.
Al‑yankut nugra,akuun yagaʼ fooghawa l‑yisawwi khurma,akuun daabi yiʼaddiih.
Al‑yagtaʼ al‑hajar,akuun yinjarihwa l‑yichaggig al‑hatab,yadkhul fi l‑khatar.
Al‑faas kan kaalle wa ma tarragooha,waajib gudra ziyaada fi istiʼmaalha.Khalaas,faaydit al‑hikmahi al‑najaah.
Kan naadum yaʼarif yihaddi al‑daabiwa l‑daabi yiʼaddiih,chunu al‑faayde al‑yalgaaha ?
Wakit al‑hakiim yihajji,kalaamah yaʼajib al‑naaswa laakin lisaan al‑matmuusyiwaddirah.
Kalaamah fi l‑bidaaya hu tamaasawa fi l‑nihaaya hu jahaala wa charr.
Al‑naadum al‑fikrah mahduud,yikattir kalaamah.Wa l‑insaan ma yaʼarif al‑yukuunwa yaatu al‑yikhabbirahbe l‑yukuun baʼad mootah ?
Khidmit al‑matmuus tiʼayyiihlahaddi ma yaʼarif deribal‑yiwaddiih le l‑madiina !
Al‑azaab le l‑balad al‑malikha sabiwa kubaaraatha yaakulu tuul al‑yoom !
Mabruuk le l‑balad al‑malikha min iyaal al‑chuyuukhwa kubaaraatha yaakulu fi wakit munaasible yalgo gudra bala sakar !
Fi wakt al‑kasal,raas al‑beet yagaʼwa wakt al‑iide yinrakhu,al‑beet yinaggit.
Al‑naas yisawwu akil le yadhakowa l‑khamar le yifarruhu hayaathum.Wa laakin be l‑gurus,yalgo kulla cheyy.
Ma talʼan al‑malikhatta fi daakhal galbak kulawa fi beetak wiheedak,ma talʼan al‑khani.Achaan al‑teeraay tiwaddi al‑khabarwa tihajji be l‑cheyy al‑inta gultah.
Armi khubzitak fi l‑almiachaan yoom waahid talgaaha.
Gassim maalakale sabʼa aw tamaane bakaanachaan inta ma taʼarif al‑fasaalaal‑taji fi l‑ard.
Wakit al‑sahaab yichiil almi,al‑matara tusubb fi l‑ard.Wa kan chadara wagaʼatale l‑wati aw ale l‑munchaakh,fi bakaanha al‑wagaʼat foogah da bas,hi tagood.
Al‑harraati al‑yichiif al‑riihyaʼarif al‑wakit al‑ma waajib yiteerib.Wa l‑harraati al‑yichiif al‑sahaabyaʼarif al‑wakit al‑ma waajib yagtaʼ.
Misil inta ma taʼarif wijh al‑riihwa kikkeef yilkawwano udaam al‑sakhiir fi batun ammah,khalaas ma tagdar tafhamkikkeef al‑Rabb yisawwi kulla cheyy.
Be fajur,teeribwa be achiiye,ma tinjamma.Achaan inta ma taʼarif weenu al‑yanjah,da walla daak,walla kan al‑itneen kulluhum adiiliin.
Nuur al‑sabaah haluwa adiil le l‑uyuun yichiifu al‑harraay.
Kan naadum yiʼiich siniin katiiriin,khalli yafrah be ayyi waahid minhum.Wa laakin khalli yizzakkarkadar ayyaam al‑moot aktar.Wa kulla cheyy al‑yaji zaayil saakit.
Ya l‑sabi !Afrah be ayyaam subaakwa khalli galbak yafrah be ayyaam chabaabak.Taabiʼ kalaam galbakwa l‑yichiifuuh uyuunak.Laakin aʼarif kadar fi kulla l‑cheyy da,al‑Rabb yihaasibak.
Baʼʼid al‑hizin min galbakwa baʼʼid al‑taʼab min jismak.Achaan al‑suba wa l‑gudra zaayliin saakit.
Fi wakit chabaabak,azzakkarah,hu al‑khalagaak.Azzakkarah gabul ayyaam al‑diigema yajuukwa gabul ma yajuuk al‑siniinal‑fooghum inta tuguul : Hayaati ma indaha taʼam. 
Azzakkarah gabul ma yidallumual‑harraay wa l‑nuurwa l‑gamar wa l‑nujuum kulawa gabul al‑sahaab ma yigabbilbaʼad al‑matar.
Azzakkarah gabul al‑haaris ma yarjif min al‑khoofwa rujaal al‑fahaliin ma yidanguruwa gabul awiin al‑rahhaakaat al‑ma katiiraat yiwaggifan al‑rahiikwa l‑yichiifan be chabaabiik ma yiwaddiran jamaalhin.
Azzakkarah gabul biibaan al‑chawaariʼ abdalfiteen ma yinsaddowa harakat al‑murhaaka ma tinsamiʼwa gabul ma tugumm wakit al‑tuyuur yikhannuwa yaʼayan kulla l‑khannaayaat.
Azzakkarah gabul ma takhaaf min al‑aaliwa min ruʼub al‑deribwa gabul chadarat al‑looz ma tinawwirwa l‑jaraad ma yisiir be tagalawa gabul al‑chadara al‑tiziid al‑chahwa ma tafchulwa l‑insaan ma yamchi le beetah al‑abadiwa l‑nawwaahaat ma yamchan fi l‑chaariʼ.
Azzakkarah gabul al‑haya ma tingatiʼ misil habil al‑fuddawa kharraaf al‑dahab ma yingaddawa gabul al‑jarr ma yilkassar fi l‑hootwa l‑jurra ma tinkasir wa tagaʼ fi l‑biir.
Azzakkarah gabul al‑insaan ma yigabbilfi l‑turaab al‑khalagooh minnahwa gabul al‑ruuh ma tigabbille l‑Rabb al‑khalagha.
Al‑Muʼallim gaal : Al‑haya zaayle !Zaayle saakit !Kulla cheyy zaayil ! 
Al‑Muʼallim ma hakiim bas,hu battaan allam al‑maʼrafa le l‑chaʼab.Hu kachaf be maʼrafa wa wazanwa nazzam adad kabiir hana amsaal.
Al‑Muʼallim fattachle yalga kalaam al‑yaʼajib.Wa katab kalaam da adiilwa da kalaam al‑hagg.
Kalaam al‑hakiimiin misil asaal‑yusuugu beeha al‑bahaayim.Wa muʼallifiin al‑kutub gawiyiin misil masaamiiral‑yutugguuhum wa yasbutu.Wa di hadiiye al‑jaaye min raaʼi waahid.
Wa l‑faddal min al‑kalaam da,khalli yabga leek daris,ya wileedi.Kitaabit al‑kutub ma tikammilwa katarat al‑giraay tiʼayyi al‑jisim.
Wa fi l‑akhiir,daahu nihaayat al‑kalaam ansamaʼat.Akhaaf min al‑Rabbwa ahfad wasiiyaatahachaan da l‑waajib le ayyi insaan.
Achaan al‑Rabb yihaasib kulla amal al‑insaanhatta kan mulabbad kula,kan zeen walla fasil.
Al‑khine al‑aziim hana l‑malik Suleymaan.
Hibbini !Min fadlak,hibbini !Achaan hubbak halu min asiir al‑inab.
Itrak yinchamma haluwa usmak chattat misil riihit al‑itir.Fi chaan da,al‑banaat bihibbannak.
Chiilni maʼaak.Yalla najru !Ya maliki,waddiini fi khurfitakwa hinaak,nalʼabo wa nafraho sawa.Wa nizzakkaro hubbak al‑halu min asiir al‑inab.Al‑bihibbannak indihin hagg !
Ya banaat Madiinat al‑Khudus,ana samra wa laakin jamiile,zarga misil khiyam al‑sayyaarawa jamiile misil sitaarat beet Suleymaan.
Ma tichiifanni achaan ana samra.Di l‑harraay bas galabat looni.Awlaad ammi ziʼilo diddiwa sawwooni haarisat jineenit inab.Wa laakin jismi al‑misil jineenti,ana ma harastah.
Guul leyi,inta al‑ana nihibbak,ween tisarrih khanamak ?Ween bakaan tigayyil foogah ?Wassifni achaan ma nifattich wa nuruuhwa nagaʼ fi diiraan jiiraanak.
Ma taʼarfiih,inti al‑ajmal min al‑awiin ?Taabʼi derib khanamahwa asrahe be inzeekijamb dara aniina al‑ruʼyaan.
Ya habiibti,inti misil faras arabat Firʼoon malik Masir.
Khuduudki jamiiliinambeenaat khuruuskiwa ragabatki samhafi usut ribig zaytuunki.
Nisawwu leeki khuruus hana dahabwa ziina hint fudda.
Wakit maliki gaaʼid fi usut rufgaanah,riihit itri anchammat.
Habiibi misil balʼuumi hana sandal al‑muʼallag fi ragabatiwa yargud fi sadri be l‑leel.
Habiibi misil nuwwaar al‑hinnefi jineenit inab fi Een Jidi.
Inti jamiile,ya habiibti.Aywa,inti jamiilewa uyuunki samhiinmisil al‑hamaam.
Inta jamiil,ya habiibi.Inta kula halu.Wa narugdu fi goozna al‑akhdar.
Narugdu tihit chadar al‑arz misil chiʼab beetnawa tihit furuuʼ al‑sarwi misil amadah.
Ana misil nuwwaar al‑gechch fi sahalat Chaaruunwa misil zahra jamiile fi l‑waadi.
Habiibti fi ust al‑banaatmisil zahra jamiile fi lubb al‑chook.
Habiibi fi ust al‑subyaanmisil chadarat al‑tuffaah fi lubb chadar al‑khaaba.Fi dullah,niriid ninjammawa hu halu leyi misil fawaakih fi lisaani.
Hu waddaani fi beet al‑aazuumawa khattaani be hubbah.
Akkuluuni be kaʼak al‑inabwa azguuni be asiir al‑tuffaahachaan ana miridt min katarat al‑chahwa.
Iidah al‑isra gaaʼide tihit raasiwa iidah al‑zeene hadanatni.
Ya banaat Madiinat al‑Khudus,nihallifkan be jamaal al‑khuzlaanwa araayil al‑kadaadekadar ma tigawwimanwa la tiwaʼʼan al‑hubb gabul waktah.
Asmaʼan,daahu habiibi jaayi.Yunutt min jabal le jabalwa min hajar le hajar.
Habiibi misil al‑khazaalwa misil jidi al‑aryal.Daahu waagif wara durdurna.Yichiifni be l‑chubbaakwa yitaawigni be l‑guduud.
Hu chaal al‑kalaam wa gaal leyi : Gummi,ya habiibti al‑jamiile,wa taʼaali leyi.
Achaan wakt al‑seef kammalwa l‑matar bada wa l‑khariif ja.
Wa fi kulla l‑balad,al‑nuwwaar baanwa wakt al‑khine ja.Wa hiss al‑gimri ansamaʼfi kulla l‑balad.
Chadar al‑tiin rama iyaalahwa nuwwaar al‑inab anchamma.Gummi,ya habiibti al‑jamiile,wa taʼaali leyi.
 Ya hamaamti,al‑mullabbidefi karaakiir al‑jibaalwa fi juruuf al‑hujaar.Wassifi leyi wijihkiwa khalli nasmaʼ hissikiachaan hissiki haluwa wijihki jamiil.
 Aturdu leena al‑baʼaachiim,aywa,al‑baʼaachiim al‑yitallufu al‑inabachaan chadar inabna nawwar. 
Habiibi,ana leyah hu wa hu leyi ana.Wa hu saarih be khanamah fi l‑nuwwaar.
Wa gabul buruudit al‑leelwa wakit al‑dalaam yisidd,gabbil,ya habiibi,wa taʼaal leyi.Abga misil al‑khazaalwa misil jidi al‑aryalfi juruuf al‑jibaal.
Wa be l‑leel,fi sariiri,ana fattacht al‑galbi biriidah,ana fattachtah wa ma ligiitah.
Ana gammeet wa hawwagt al‑madiinafi l‑chawaariʼ wa fi ayyi bakaan.Ana fattacht al‑galbi biriidah,ana fattachtah wa ma ligiitah.
Wa l‑hurraas al‑buruukhu al‑hillebe l‑leel ligooniwa ana gult : Ma chiftu al‑galbi biriidah ? 
Wa min futt minhum,ana ligiit al‑galbi biriidah.Hadantah wa ma khalleetahlahaddi waddeetah fi hooch ammiwa dakhkhaltah fi beet hana l‑wildatnilahaddi fi l‑khurfa.
Ya banaat Madiinat al‑Khudus,nihallifkan be jamaal al‑khuzlaanwa araayil al‑kadaadekadar ma tigawwimanwa la tiwaʼʼan al‑hubb gabul waktah.
Yaatu al‑jaayi min al‑saharawa ajaajah misil dukhkhaan al‑taaliʼ ?Yaatu al‑muʼattar be sandal wa lubaanwa be kulla dukhkhaan al‑tujjaar ?
Aywa,da Suleymaan al‑raakibfi baasuur utfitah.Muhawwigiinah 60 rujaal furraasmin ahsan furraas Bani Israaʼiil.
Kulluhum chaayliin suyuufwa humman naas muhaaribiin.Ayyi waahid seefah fi sulbahjaahiz le ayyi khatar al‑yaji be l‑leel.
Al‑malik Suleymaan indah utfaal‑sawwooha be hatab Lubnaan.
Wa amadha mujammaliin be fuddawa baasuurha be dahab.Wa furaachha loonah garadiwa banaat Madiinat al‑Khudus addalan daakhilhawa jammalannah be mahabba.
Amurgan,ya banaat Sahyuun !Taʼaalan chiifan al‑malik Suleymaan !Indah taaj al‑ammah khattatah leyah fi yoom ariisahwa da yoom al‑farah mala galbah.
Inti jamiile,ya habiibti,inti jamiile.Wa uyuunki misil al‑hamaamkhaadi le laffaahitki.Wa chaʼarki misil danab al‑farasal‑naazle min jabal Gilʼaad.
Wa sunuunki buyudmisil laban al‑khanamwa misil al‑riheew al‑barradah al‑matar.Ayyi sinn be gabiilitha,ma fi waahide kula wagaʼat.
Wa chalaaliifki zurug misil al‑kheet al‑azragwa khachumki jamiil.Wa khuduudki misil al‑rummaanaatkhaadi le laffaahitki.
Wa ragabatki tawiilemisil beet al‑muraakhaba hana Dawuud.Wa ziinitha tichaabih al‑alif daragal‑muʼallagiin fi l‑beet daroog baʼad roog.
Wa duyuudki misil tiimaan al‑khazaalal‑raatʼiin fi l‑nuwwaar.
Wa gabul buruudit al‑leelwa wakit al‑dalaam yisidd,ana namchi le jabal al‑sandalwa le hajar al‑lubaan.
Inti kulliki jamiile,ya habiibti,ma indiki ayyi eeb.
Taʼaali maʼaayi min Lubnaan,ya aruusi.Dalli maʼaayi min jibaalha.Anzili min raas jabal al‑Amaanawa min raas jabal Saniir wa Harmuun,bakaan dungur al‑diidaanwa margad al‑numuura.
Inti malakti galbi,ya akhti,ya aruusi.Inti malakti galbi be nazra waahidewa be zaytuunaay waahide min ribigki.
Hubbiki halu,ya akhti,ya aruusi.Hubbiki halu min asiir al‑inab !Wa riihitki haluuwemin kulla itir al‑dunya.
Wa chalaaliifki haluwiin min al‑asal,ya aruusi,wa lisaanki indah asal wa laban.Wa riihit khulgaankimisil sandal Lubnaan.
Inti jineene mazruuba,ya akhti,ya aruusi.Inti biir magfuulawa een almi makhtuuma.
Wa nabaat jineenitki rummaanal‑fawaakihah haluwiin.Wa fi jineenitki fiyah nabaataat hana dukhkhaanmisil al‑hinne wa l‑naardiin.
Aywa,fi naardiin wa zaʼfaraanwa dufur wa girfawa samukh lubaanwa hatab sandal wa gamaariwa kulla dukhkhaan al‑riihtah haluuwe.
Wa fiyah een almi fi lubb al‑jineene diwa hi biir almi al‑saafial‑yisiil min jibaal Lubnaan.
Gummi,inti riih al‑munchaakh.Taʼaali,inti riih al‑junuub.Hijji jineentiwa khalli riihitha al‑haluuwe tisiil.Wa khalli habiibi yadkhul foogi ana jineentahwa yaakul min fawaakihha al‑haluwiin.
Aywa,ana nadkhul fi jineenti,ya akhti,ya aruusi !Wa nagtaʼ sandaliwa dukhkhaani al‑halu !Wa naakul asali min chamʼitahwa nachrab asiir inabi wa labani.Aakulu,ya l‑rufgaan !Acharbo wa askaro min al‑hubb !
Aywa,ana numt wa galbi waaʼi.Wa daahu habiibi tagga al‑baab wa gaal : Aftahe leyi,ya akhti,ya habiibti,ya hamaamti,ya jamiilti !Achaan al‑karany khatta raasiwa chaʼari anballa ! 
Wa ana raddeet wa gult : Ana salleet khalagiwa kikkeef battaan nalbasah ?Ana khassalt rijileeniwa kikkeef battaan niwassikhhum ? 
Habiibi madda iidah le yaftah al‑baabwa galbi gaaʼid yadrub min al‑farah.
Wa gammeet le naftah le habiibiwa itir saal min iideeni.Wa min asaabʼi,al‑itirmalat tarbaaz al‑baab.
Ana fataht le habiibiwa laakin habiibi gabbal wa faatwa galbi alhayyar.Maragt fattachtah wa ma ligiitahwa naadeetah wa hu ma radda leyi.
Wa l‑hurraas hana durdur al‑madiina ligooni.Humman farachooni wa jarahooniwa chaalo laffaahti.
Ya banaat Madiinat al‑Khudus,nihallifkan !Kan ligiitan habiibi,guulan leyahkadar ana miridtmin katarat al‑chahwa.
Be chunu habiibki faatal‑subyaan al‑aakhariin ?Guuli leena,inti al‑ajmal min al‑awiin !Be chunu habiibki faatal‑subyaan al‑aakhariin,lahaddi tihallifiina fi chaanah ?
Habiibi jamiil wa nachiitwa bayyin fi ust al‑aalaaf.
Wijhah misil al‑dahab al‑saafiwa chaʼarah mulawlaw wa azrag kurummisil loon al‑khuraab.
Uyuunah samhiinmisil hamaam jamb al‑waadi.Wa buyud misil khassaloohum be labanwa gaaʼidiin fi wijih jamiil.
Wa dignah misil jineene al‑mazruuʼa be riiheal‑tigawwim chadar al‑dukhkhaan.Wa chalaaliifah misil nuwwaar al‑sitteebwa yinaggit minhum al‑itir.
