Wa iideenah misil isay hana dahabal‑mujammal be hajar khaali.Wa jittitah misil looh hana aajal‑mujammal be yaakhuut akhdar.
Wa rijileenahmisil amad hana rukhaam abyadfi asaas hana dahab saafi.Hu ajmal min jibaal Lubnaanwa maʼruuf misil chadar al‑arz.
Khachmah haluwa jismah kulla ke mahbuub.Wa da bas,habiibiwa da bas,rafiigi.Aʼarfannah,ya banaat Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Habiibki ween macha ?Ooriina,ya inti al‑ajmal min al‑awiin !Habiibki faat be ween ?Ooriina,achaan nifattuchuuh maʼaaki.
Habiibi nazal foogi ana jineentahal‑mazruuʼa be chadar al‑dukhkhaan.Wa yasrah fi jineentahwa yagtaʼ al‑nuwwaar.
Habiibi,ana leyah hu wa hu leyi ana.Hu saarih fi l‑nuwwaar.
Inti jamiile,ya habiibti,misil hillit Tirsawa samha misil Madiinat al‑Khudus.Inti ajiibe misil deech aziimal‑maachi be raaytah !
Dalli uyuunki minniachaan gaaʼidiin yibarjuluuni.Wa chaʼarki misil danab al‑farasal‑naazle min jabal Gilʼaad.
Wa sunuunki buyudmisil laban al‑khanamwa misil al‑riheew al‑barradah al‑matar.Ayyi sinn be gabiilitha,ma fi waahide kula wagaʼat.
Wa khuduudki misil al‑rummaanaatkhaadi le laffaahitki.
Mumkin malik al‑balad indah60 malikaatwa 80 sirriiyaatwa banaat udriiyaat bala adad.
Wa laakin ana,hamaamti hi waahide wa jamiile.Hi waahide fi ammahawa waalditha tihibbaha.Al‑banaat chaafanha wa gaalan : Mabruuk leeki. Al‑malikaat wa l‑sirriiyaat chaafanhawa chakaranha wa gaalan :
 Hi di yaati al‑tibiinmisil taluuʼ al‑harraay ?Hi beeda misil al‑gamarwa tiraari misil al‑harraay.Hi ajiibe misil deech aziimal‑maachi be raaytah ! 
Ana nazalt fi jineenit al‑fawaakihle nichiif nabaat al‑waadi.Jineenit al‑inab ramat walla ?Chadar al‑rummaan nawwar walla ?
Wa min duun naʼarfah,hasabt nafsiana raakib fi arabat al‑malik !
Taʼaali !Taʼaali,ya bitt hillit Chulaam !Gabbili le nichiifuuki !Maala waajib nichiifu bitt hillit Chulaamal‑talʼab been saff al‑banaat wa saff al‑subyaan ?
Ya bitt al‑muluuk,rijileenki samhiin fi lubb niʼleeki.Wa daayir dawaarijkimisil ribig al‑zaytuunal‑laddamooh al‑naas al‑induhum khibra.
Wa fandoogki mudawwarmisil jarr asiir al‑inab be haraarah.Wa batunki misil koom al‑gamehal‑muhawwag be nuwwaar.
Wa duyuudkimisil tiimaan al‑khazaal.
Wa ragabatki tawiile wa samhamisil beet al‑muraakhabaal‑mabni be aaj.Wa uyuunki biraarumisil uyuun almi Hachbuunal‑jamb baab Beet Rabbiim.Wa munkharki rigeeyge misil seefwa adiile misil beet al‑muraakhaba hana Lubnaanal‑muwajjih ale madiinat Dimachkh.
Wa raaski foogmisil jabal al‑Karmal.Wa chaʼarki azrag kurumwa ana malikki madfuur fi muchaatki.
Inti jamiile wa haluuwe,ya habiibti al‑bitt al‑laziize.
Inti tawiile misil tamuraaywa duyuudki misil anaagiid al‑tamur.
Ana gult : Ana natlaʼ fi l‑tamuraaywa nilammis tamurha ! Wa khalli duyuudki yabgo leyimisil anaagiid al‑inabwa nafaski yinchamma halumisil riihit al‑tuffaah
wa khachumki yabga laziizmisil asiir al‑inab al‑ahsan.Aywa,al‑asiir da yisiil be suhuulafi l‑chalaaliif wa l‑sunuun.
Ana le habiibiwa hu indah chahwa leyi.
Taʼaal,ya habiibi,namchu fi l‑kadaade,nunuumu tihit chadarat al‑hinne.
Wa be fajur badri,namchu fi jineenit al‑inabwa nichiifu kan al‑inab nawwarwa kan nuwwaarah alfattahwa kan al‑rummaan nawwarwa fi l‑bakaan daak,ana nantiik nafsi.
Al‑zuhuur al‑haluwiin,riihithum tinchamma.Wa min foog leena,fi fawaakih laziiziin,al‑fawaakih al‑jadiidiin wa l‑gaddimiinal‑ana hafadtuhum leek,ya habiibi.
Yaareet,inta bigiit misil akhuuyial‑raddaʼatak ammi fi deedha.Be da,kan ana nalgaak fi l‑chaariʼ,nihibbak wa l‑naas ma yiʼayyuruuni.
Ana nuguudak wa nidissak fi beet ammiwa inta tiʼallimni al‑hubb.Wa ana nazgiik asiir al‑inab be haraarahwa asiiri hana l‑rummaan.
Wa iidah al‑isra gaaʼide tihit raasiwa iidah al‑zeene hadanatni.
Ya banaat Madiinat al‑Khudus,nihallifkan ma tigawwimanwa la tiwaʼʼan al‑hubb gabul waktah.
Yaati al‑jaaye min al‑saharamurrakkize fi habiibha ?Ya habiibi,ana gawwamtaktihit chadarat al‑tuffaah.Wa da bas al‑bakaan al‑ammak taalagat beek,al‑bakaan al‑wildatak foogah.
Khuttini fi galbak wa akhtim foogahwa dissini misil khaatim fi usbaʼak.Achaan al‑hubb chadiid misil al‑mootwa l‑reede chadiide misil al‑khabur.Wa naar al‑hubbmisil naar daribiin al‑raʼadwa lahiibhamisil ambalbaala al‑jaaye min Allah.
Naar al‑hubb,almi al‑wudyaan ma yaktulhawa almi al‑seel ma yaakulha.Al‑yahsib yibiiʼ al‑hubb be kulla khunaayah,yalga illa l‑eeb wa l‑ihaana.
Aniina indina akhut sakhayrewa deedha lissaaʼ ma gamma.Nisawwu chunu le akhutnagabul ma yichiiluuha aruus ?
Kan hi misil durdur,nigawwuuha be buyuut muraakhaba hana fudda.Wa kan misil baab,nigawwuuha be hatab al‑arz.
Ana misil durdurwa duyuudi misil buyuut al‑muraakhaba.Wa fi uyuun habiibi,ana bas nabga leyah bakaan salaam.
Suleymaan indah jineenit inabfi Baʼal Hamuunwa hu ajjarha le l‑tujjaarle yahfadooha.Wa humman yikaffu leyahtaman fawaakihha alif hajar fudda.
Wa leek inta,ya Suleymaan,al‑alif hajar fudda.Wa miiteen hajar kamaan,nafaag le tujjaar inab jineentak.Wa laakin jineenti ana,ana bas nahfadha.
Inti al‑taskuni fi l‑jineene,rafiigaatki simʼan hissiki.Wa ana kula,khalliini nasmaʼah.
Ajri taʼaal ajala,ya habiibi,wa abga misil al‑khazaalwa misil jidi al‑aryalfi jibaal al‑dukhkhaan.
Daahu ruʼyat Ichaʼya wileed Ammuus al‑tukhuss balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa l‑ruʼya di kaanat fi ayyaam hukum Uzziiya wa Yuutaam wa Ahaaz wa Hizkhiiya muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza.
Ya l‑sama,asmaʼe !Wa ya ard,aftahe adaanki !Daahu kalaam Allah al‑hu gaalah : Ana addabt wa rabbeet iyaalwa laakin humman atmarrado diddi.
Al‑toor yaʼarif siidahwa l‑humaar yaʼarif al‑naadum al‑yantiih akil.Laakin Bani Israaʼiil ma yaʼarfuuniwa chaʼabi ma yafhamo. 
Al‑azaab le l‑umma al‑muznibeaywa,le l‑umma al‑chaayle al‑khata !Intu zurriiyit al‑naas al‑fasliin,iyaal al‑mudammariin !Intu abeetu Allahaywa,abeetu Khudduus Israaʼiilwa gabbaltu wara.
Allah yadrubku ween battaan ?Achaan intu gaaʼidiin tiziidu fi isyaanku.Raasku kulla malaan awaawiirwa galibku kulla taʼbaan.
Min raasku le rijleekuma fi cheyy adiil.Kulla ke juruuh wa halaabiibwa awaawiir jadiidiin.Wa la munaddafiin wa la malfuufiinwa la masahoohum be dihin.
Baladku khirbatwa mudunku hirgo.Al‑ajaanib yaakulu intaaj arduku giddaamku.Hi khirbat wa l‑ajaanib dammarooha.
Madiinat Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye,aboohawa bigat misil ligdaabe fi jineenit inab baʼad al‑gatiʼ.Abooha misil illiiye fi usut zereʼ al‑fagguuswa misil hille muhaasara.
Wa kan Allah al‑Gaadirma khalla leena naas chiyya al‑nijo,aniina niddammaro misil naas Saduumwa nahlako misil naas Amuura.
Ya Bani Yahuuza,khuyyaadku fasliinmisil khuyyaad Saduum.Asmaʼo kalaam Allahal‑yuguulah leeku !Ya Bani Yahuuza,chaʼabku fasliinmisil naas Amuura.Khuttu adaanku le wasaaya Ilaahna !
Allah gaal : Dahaayaaku al‑katiiriin dool,nisawwi beehum chunu ?Kafaani min al‑dahaaya al‑muharragiinhana kubchaanku wa chaham ajjaalku.Aywa,damm tiiraanku wa humlaankuwa tuyuusku kula,ma narda beyah.
Wakit taju wa tagiifu giddaami,yaatu gaal leeku tifajjukhu fadaayti ?
Waggufu ma tijiibu leyi battaandahaayaaku al‑makruuhiinwa bakhuurku damuharram leyi !Waggufu dahaayaakuhana awwal yoom fi kulli chaharwa hana kulli yoom sabtwa malammaatkuachaan ana ma nakhbalal‑fasaala fi malammaatku al‑khaassiin.
Ana nakrah dahaayaakuhana awwal yoom fi kulli chahar.Wa aʼyaadku,ma nahmalhum !Bigi leyi katiir.
Wakit timiddu iideeku leyi be duʼaaku,ana ma niwajjih aleeku.Wa wakit tikatturu salaawaatku kula,ma nasmaʼkuachaan iideeku malaaniin be damm.
Albarrado wa tahhuru nufuuskuwa baʼʼudu min giddaami amalku al‑fasilwa khallu minku al‑fasaala.
Alʼallamo al‑adiil wa fattuchu al‑adaalagabbulu al‑zaalim min derbah hana l‑zulum.Sawwu al‑adil le l‑atiimwa daafuʼu le l‑armala. 
Allah gaal : Taʼaalu ninaakhuchu.Kan zunuubku humur kula,yabgo buyud karr misil al‑laban.Wa kan humur tchu misil al‑damm kula,yabgo buyud karr misil al‑gutun.
Wa kan khassadtu wa simiʼtu kalaami,taakulu min ahsan intaaj al‑ard.
Laakin kan abeetu wa isiituuni,al‑seef yabga misil naar yaakulku ! Aywa,da kalaam Allah al‑gaalah.
Kikkeef al‑madiina al‑amiine bigat charmuuta ?Awwal hi malaane be l‑adaala.Aywa,awwal al‑adaala saakne fooghalaakin hassaʼ saakniin fooghakattaaliin dimam.
Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus !Fudditki malaane be l‑wasakhwa khamarki al‑sameh mukhalbat be almi.
Masaaʼiilki bigo haraamiyiinwa munrabitiin maʼa l‑saraariig.Wa yihibbu al‑rachwawa yajru wara l‑faayde.Humman ma yidaafuʼu le huguug al‑atiimwa ma lammaahum be chakwat al‑armala.
Fi chaan kulla l‑cheyy da,daahu kalaam Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir,Jabbaar Israaʼiil.Hu gaal : Al‑azaab leeki,ya Madiinat al‑Khudus !Nichiil al‑taar foogki,inti khasiimtiaywa nikammilki,inti aduuyi.
Battaan nugumm diddikiwa nagtaʼki fi l‑naar.Wa nisaffiiki wa namrug wasakhkimisil khassalooki be saabuun.
Nijiib leeki gudiya misil awwalwa mustachaariin misil fi l‑bidaaya.Wa baʼad da,yinaaduukiMadiinat al‑Adaalawa Hillit al‑Amaan.
Sahyuun tanja be l‑adaalawa sukkaanha al‑yigabbulu yanjo be l‑hagg.
Al‑aasiyiin wa l‑muznibiinyiddammaro sawawa l‑abo Allah,yikammulu.
Aywa,intu talgo eebmin chadarku al‑kubaaral‑gaaʼidiin titmannooh.Wa tabgo khajlaaniin fi chaan al‑jineenaatal‑azaltuuhum le ibaadat asnaamku.
Khalaas,intu tabgomisil chadara al‑waragha yibiswa jineene al‑almiiha kammal.
Al‑raajil al‑chadiid yabga misil gechchwa amalah yabga misil charaara.Hu wa amalah yahrago sawawa ma fi naadum al‑yaktul al‑naar minhum. 
Daahu kalaam al‑ruʼya al‑chaafha Ichaʼya wileed Ammuus,fi chaan balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Fi aakhir al‑wakit,jabal beet Allahyasbit fi ruuse al‑jibaalwa yabga aali min kulla l‑hujaar.Wa kulla l‑umam yaju leyah be kataramisil almi al‑jaari.
Wa chuʼuub katiiriin yaju wa yuguulu : Taʼaalu natlaʼo fi jabal Allah,fi beet Ilaah Yaakhuub.Hu yiʼallimna derbahwa aniina namchu foogah. Achaan min Sahyuun,yamurgu churuut al‑Tawraatwa min Madiinat al‑Khudusyamrug kalaam Allah.
Allah yabga gaadi been al‑umamwa yihaakim chuʼuub katiiriin.Humman yuduggu suyuufhum jaraariwa yuduggu huraabhum khanaajir.Wa umma ma tarfaʼ suyuufha le ummawa ma fi tadriib le l‑harib battaan.
Ya zurriiyit Yaakhuub,taʼaalunuruukhu fi nuur Allah.
Ya Rabb !Inta abeet chaʼabakzurriiyit Yaakhuubachaan humman malaaniinbe aadaat min al‑sabaah.Yihajju be ilim al‑kheebmisil al‑Filistiyiinwa yistafugu maʼa l‑ajaanib.
Al‑balad malaane be l‑fudda wa l‑dahabwa kanzaha katiir bala adad.Al‑balad malaane be l‑kheelwa arabaatha hana l‑harib katiiriin bala adad.
Al‑balad malaane be l‑ilaahaatwa l‑naas yasjudu le l‑sanaʼooh be iideehumaywa,yasjudu le l‑sawwooh be asaabiʼhum.
Ya Rabb !Al‑insaan yidangirwa ayyi raajil yilmaskan.Ma takhfir leehum !
Ya l‑naas adkhulu fi karaakiir al‑jibaalwa allabbado fi l‑nugaarbaʼiid min khoof Allah al‑chadiidwa nuur majdah.
Al‑insaan al‑fachchaar,yidalli raasahwa l‑naadum al‑mustakbir,yidangir.Wa fi l‑yoom da,Allah wiheedah bas yiʼazzumuuh.
Achaan fi l‑yoom da,Allah al‑Gaadir yugummdidd kulla l‑mustakbiriinwa didd kulla l‑yarfaʼo ruuseehum.Hu yugummdidd kulla l‑yikabburu nufuushumwa hu yinazzilhum.
Wa yugummdidd kulli chadar al‑arz hana Lubnaanal‑mustakbir wa yarfaʼ raasahwa didd kulla chadar al‑balluut hana Baachaan.
Aywa,Allah yugummdidd kulla l‑jibaal al‑aaliyiinwa didd kulla l‑hujaar al‑kubaar.
Wa yugummdidd kulla l‑buyuut al‑tuwaal hana l‑muraakhabawa didd kulla l‑daraadir al‑gawiyiin.
Allah yugumm diddkulla l‑sufun hana Tarchiichwa didd kulla l‑sufunal‑chaayliin khumaam sameh.
Wa khalaas,al‑insaan al‑fachchaar yidalli raasahwa l‑naadum al‑mustakbir,yidangir.Wa fi l‑yoom da,Allah wiheedah bas yiʼazzumuuh.
Kulla l‑ilaahaat yiwadduru.
Khalli yadkhulu fi karaakiir al‑jibaalwa yillabbado fi l‑nugaarmin khoof Allah al‑chadiidwa nuur majdahwakit yugumm yirajjif al‑ard.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑insaan yidaffigle l‑faar wa abunrigeeʼilaahaatah hana l‑fuddawa ilaahaatah hana l‑dahabal‑sanaʼaahum le yasjud leehum.
Wa l‑naas yadkhulu fi karaakiir al‑jibaalwa chuguug al‑hajarmin khoof Allah al‑chadiidwa nuur majdahwakit yugumm yirajjif al‑ard.
Khalli ma titwakkalo ale l‑insaan,hu ma indah cheyy illa l‑nafas al‑foogahwa ma indah khiima.
Daahu Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadiryagtaʼ kulla l‑musaaʼadaatmin balad Yahuuza wa Madiinat al‑Khudus,kulla l‑musaaʼadaat wa l‑mawaaridhana l‑akil wa l‑charaab.
Wa yamrug min lubbuhumal‑faaris wa l‑raajil al‑muhaarib,al‑gaadi wa l‑nabi,al‑chawwaafi wa l‑cheekh,
khaayid al‑khamsiin wa l‑mukarram,al‑mustachaar wa l‑sinaaʼi al‑indah khibrawa l‑mutakhassis fi l‑sihir.
Allah gaal : Nukhutt fi badalhum subyaanle yabgo kubaaraathumaywa,iyaal dugaagyahkumu fooghum. 
Al‑chaʼab yiddaayago,al‑raajil yidaayig raajilwa raajil yidaayig akhuuh.Wa l‑sabi yitaʼʼib al‑chaayibwa l‑mahguur yitaʼʼib al‑indah charaf.
Wa naadum yakrub akhuuhal‑min aayiltah wa yuguul leyah : Inta indak khalag,abga khaayidna !Wa l‑kharaab da yabga tihit sultitak. 
Wa fi l‑yoom da,akhuuh yuguul : Ana ma nagdar niʼaalijku.Fi beeti kula,ma fi akil wa la khalag.Ma tidarrujuuni khaayid al‑chaʼab ! 
Madiinat al‑Khudus tittartaʼwa balad Yahuuza tagaʼ.Achaan humman atmarrado didd Allahbe kalaamhum wa amalhumwa abo majdah.
Amalhum yinchaaf fi wujuuhhumwa humman bigo misil naas Saduum al‑hajjo be zunuubhum,ma labbadoohum.Al‑azaab leehum !Achaan humman jahhazoal‑fasaala le nufuushum.
Guulu : Al‑saalihiin yafrahoachaan yaakulu min intaaj amalhum. 
Al‑azaab le l‑aasiyiin !Humman yalgo al‑fasaala,achaan yijaazuuhumhasab al‑sawwooh iideehum.
Ya chaʼabi !Al‑yidaayuguuku iyaal dugaagwa l‑yahkumu foogku awiin.Ya chaʼabi !Al‑yuguuduuku yiwadduruukuwa yiwadduuku fi l‑derib al‑aʼwaj.
Allah gamma le yichaariʼwa le yiʼaakhib al‑chuʼuub.
Allah yihaakim kubaaraat chaʼabahwa masaaʼiilhum.Wa yuguul : Intu dammartu jineenaat al‑inab !Wa l‑khumaam al‑saragtuuh min al‑masaakiingaaʼid fi buyuutku.
Maala tifajjukhu chaʼabi ?Maala tidissu wujuuh al‑masaakiin fi l‑turaab ? Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir.
Wa Allah gaal : Banaat Sahyuun mustakbiraat,yarfaʼan ruuseehinwa yaktulan uyuunhin.Wa yikoolifan fi machiihinwa yiharrikan hujuulhin. 
Achaan da,al‑Rabb yigawwim guubfi ruuse banaat Sahyuunaywa,Allah yiʼarri jabhaathin.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑Rabb yamrug minhinziinithin hana l‑hujuulwa l‑zaytuun wa l‑hafaayid
wa l‑khuruus wa l‑suure wa l‑laffaahaat
wa l‑tarhaat wa l‑saal wa l‑karraabaatwa gazzaaz al‑itir dugaag wa l‑waragaat.
Aywa,al‑Rabb yamrug minhinal‑khawaatim wa l‑chanafa
wa khulgaan al‑iid wa l‑manaadiilwa l‑ibaayaat wa l‑makhaali
wa l‑chawwaafaat wa l‑tiibaanwa khimaar al‑raas wa l‑rabbaataat.Aywa,al‑Rabb yamrug minhinkulla ziinithin.
Badal al‑itir,tinchamma fooghin al‑afanawa badal al‑karraab,yarbutan habil.Badal al‑muchaat,yizzayyananwa badal al‑khalag al‑sameh,yalbasan chuwaalwa badal al‑jamaal,wujuuhhin yahragan.
Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus !Rujaalki yumuutu fi l‑haribwa furraaski yumuutu fi l‑duwaas.
Wa sukkaanki yabku wa yahzanomisil mara al‑waddarat kulla cheyywa gaʼadat fi l‑turaab.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,sabʼa awiin yakurbanraajil waahid wa yuguulan : Aniina ma indina rujaal !Aniina be nufuusna nifattuchu akilnawa nifattuchu lubaasna.Min fadlak,khassid abga raajilnawa astur eebna ! 
Wa fi l‑yoom da,bizrit Allah tijiib al‑majdwa l‑charaf le l‑faddalo min Bani Israaʼiil.Wa intaaj al‑ardyijiib al‑farah wa l‑charaf.
Wa khalaas,al‑faddalo fi Sahyuun,al‑khalloohum hayyiin fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,yinaaduuhum mukhassasiin.Aywa,kulluhum Allah katabaahumachaan yiʼiichu fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa da,baʼad al‑Rabb yinaddifwasaakhat banaat Sahyuun.Aywa,yikhassil Madiinat al‑Khudusmin al‑damm al‑fooghabe l‑hukum wa be l‑naar.
Allah yakhlig fi kulla bakaan fi jabal Sahyuunwa fi kulla l‑bakaanaat al‑yilimmu fooghumsahaabaay wa dukhkhaan be l‑nahaar.Wa deyy hana naar ambalbaala be l‑leelwa majd Allah yikhatti kulla cheyy.
Wa l‑majd da yabgamisil ligdaabe al‑tanti dullwa tahmi min al‑hamuwa min al‑riih wa l‑matara al‑chadiide.
Khalli nikhanni le mahbuubi.Wa da khine le mahbuubiwa le jineentah hana l‑inab.Mahbuubi indah jineenit inabfi gooz al‑yigawwim adiil.
Hu harat al‑ard wa marag hujaarhawa chaal ahsan magan wa magganah.Wa bana beet tawiil le l‑muraakhabafi lubb al‑jineenewa fi l‑hajar,sawwa assaara.Indah acham yalga inab adiilwa laakin jineentah antajat illa inab talfaan.
Khalaas,gaal : Hassaʼ da,ya sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus !Wa ya naas Yahuuza !Ahkumu beeni anawa been jineenti hana l‑inab.
Chunu nagdar nisawwiih le jineentiziyaada min al‑sawweetah ?Ana gaaʼid narja be acham inab adiilwa maala hi antajat inab talfaan ?
 Wa hassaʼ niʼooriikual‑nisawwiih le jineenti.Ana namrug al‑zariibewa l‑bahaayim yaakuluuhawa nigidd khurma fi l‑durdurle yadkhulu yifajjukhuuha.
Al‑jineene di,ana nakhribhawa la niʼaddilha wa la nijankibhawa l‑chook wa andireesayugummu foogha.Wa nanti amur le l‑sahaabma yinazzil al‑matara foogha. 
Achaan jineenit Allah al‑Gaadir,hi zurriiyit Bani Israaʼiil.Wa naas Yahuuza,humman magan al‑hu yihibbah.Be acham hu yarja minhum al‑adaalawa laakin ligi al‑zulum.Hu yarja minhum al‑salaahwa laakin simiʼ siraakh al‑mazluum.
Al‑azaab le l‑yilimmubeet fi beet wa zereʼ fi zereʼlahaddi yichiilu kulla l‑bakaanwa yaskunu wiheedhum fi ust al‑balad.
Be udneeyi,ana simiʼthaliifit Allah al‑Gaadir,hu gaal : Adad kabiir hana buyuut yakhraboaywa,humman buyuut kubaar wa samhiinwa yabgo faadiyiin min sukkaanhum.
Wa 10 habil hana jineenit inabyantij illa 10 kooro hana asiirwa l‑yiteerib 100 kooro hana gamehyalga 10 kooro bas. 
Al‑azaab le l‑yugummu badriwa yifattuchu al‑mariisewa le l‑yidaffu jisimhumbe l‑khamar fi aakhir al‑leel.
Al‑jigindiiye wa amsibeybewa l‑tambal wa l‑suffaara,humman dool yichajjuʼu sakarhum.Laakin al‑naas dool,ma gaaʼidiin yifakkuru fi amal Allahwa la yichiifu cheyy al‑sawwatah iidah.
Fi chaan gillit al‑maʼrafa,chaʼabi yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba.Wa l‑induhum charaf,yumuutu min al‑juuʼwa katiiriin min naas al‑hilleyumuutu min al‑atach.
Wa fi chaan da,al‑haawiye tiwassiʼ halguumhawa khachumha,taftahah wasiiʼ bala hadd.Wa yanzulu foogha al‑induhum charafwa katiiriin min naas al‑hillewa harakathum hana l‑farha kulatanzil maʼaahum.
Wa kulla l‑naas yidanguruwa ayyi raajil yilmaskanwa l‑yichiifu be istikbaaryidallu ruuseehum.
Wa Allah al‑Gaadir yibayyin adaaltah,aywa,al‑Ilaah al‑Khudduusyiwassif adaaltah.
Al‑humlaan yasraho fi l‑hille al‑kharbaanemisil fi marʼaahumwa l‑khanam al‑sumaanyaakulu fi bakaanha al‑kharaab.
Al‑azaab leehum !Humman al‑yukurru khataahumbe hubaal al‑kidib misil kaarro,yukurru waraahum zunuubhum.
Wa yuguulu : Khalli Allah yisawwi khidimtah ajalaachaan nichiifuuha !Wa Khudduus Israaʼiil,khalli yigarribwa yihaggig niiytahachaan naʼarfuuha ! 
Al‑azaab le l‑naasal‑yuguulu al‑charr kheerwa l‑kheer charr !Wa yisawwu al‑dalaam nuurwa l‑nuur dalaam.Al‑yisawwu al‑murr haluwa l‑halu murr.
Al‑azaab le l‑yichiifu nufuushum hakiimiinwa yajʼalo nufuushum faahimiin !
Al‑azaab le l‑yaʼarfu charaab al‑khamaraywa,al‑induhum khibra fi khalbitiin al‑mariise !
Humman yibarru al‑khaati fi chaan al‑rachwawa ma yantu hagg le l‑saalih fi l‑chariiʼa.
Fi chaan da,humman yabgomisil gechch al‑taakulah al‑naarwa misil ageeg al‑yiwaddir fi ambalbaala.Wa uruughum yiʼaffunuwa nuwwaarhum yabgo misil ajaaj.Achaan humman ma tabbagoTawraat Allah al‑Gaadirwa hagarokalaam Khudduus Israaʼiil.
Wa be sabab da,khadab Allah yanzildidd chaʼabah.Hu yarfaʼ iidah didduhumle yadrubhum.Wa l‑jibaal yarjufuwa janaazaat chaʼabah yabgomisil wasakh fi ust al‑chawaariʼ.Laakin be da kula,ma khalla zaʼalahwa iidah gaaʼide marfuuʼa le l‑ikhaab.
Hu yarfaʼ raaye le umam baʼiidiinwa yisaffir le yinaadi al‑gaaʼidiin fi aakhir al‑ard.Daahu !Humman yugummu ajalawa yaju be surʼa.
Wa l‑naas doolwa la yaʼayo wa la yittartaʼowa la yanʼaso wa la yunuumu.Humman wa la yihillu hizaamhumwa la yifartugu niʼleehum.
Nachaachiibhum turaanwa nubbaalhum jaahiz le yazurgu.Dalaafe kheelhum misil al‑hujaarwa rijle arabaathum ajiiliinmisil amzoobaʼaane.
Wa yabku misil al‑duudaywa,yabku misil furuukh al‑duud.Yabku wa yakurbu fariisithumwa ma fi naadum al‑yinajjiiha minhum.
Wa laakin fi l‑yoom da,humman yikirru didd fariisithummisil hiss al‑bahar al‑yugumm.Wa fi l‑ard,daahu fiyah illa l‑dalaam wa l‑diigewa l‑nuur yabga dalaam be sabab al‑khamaam.
Wa fi sanit moot al‑malik Uzziiya,ana chift al‑Rabb gaaʼid fi kursimarfuuʼ foog marra waahidwa daayir khalagahmala al‑beet al‑mukhaddas.
Wa l‑makhluugiin al‑niiraaniyiinwaagfiin min foog leyahwa ayyi waahid indah sitte janaahe.Itneen yikhatti beehum wijhahwa itneen yikhatti beehum rijileenahwa itneen yitiir beehum.
Wa l‑waahid yinaadi al‑aakharwa yuguul : Khudduus !Khudduus !Khudduus !Allah al‑Gaadir !Majdah yamla kulla l‑ard. 
Wa l‑biibaan anhazzomin al‑hiss al‑gaaʼid yinaadiwa l‑beet al‑mukhaddasanmala be l‑dukhkhaan.
Wa khalaas,ana gult : Al‑azaab leyi !Ana waddart !Achaan ana naadumkhachmi ma taahirwa saakin fi usut chaʼabkhuchuumhum ma taahiriin.Wa uyuuni chaafo al‑malikwa hu Allah al‑Gaadir ! 
Wa waahid min al‑makhluugiinal‑niiraaniyiin doolchaal jamraay min al‑madbah be kullaabwa taar ja aleyi.
Wa hu limis khachmi beeha wa gaal : Min al‑jamraay di limsat chalaaliifak,aʼarif kadar khataak anmahawa zanbak angachcha. 
Wa ana simiʼt hiss al‑Rabb gaal : Yaatu al‑nirassilah ?Wa yaatu al‑yamchi leena ? Wa ana gult : Daahuuni ana !Rassilni ! 
Wa hu gaal : Amchi wa guul le l‑chaʼab dool :‹ Tasmaʼo wa laakin ma tafhamowa tichiifu wa laakin ma taʼarfu. ›
Gawwi guluub al‑chaʼab doolwa sidd udneehumwa aʼami uyuunhumachaan ma yichiifuwa la yasmaʼo wa la yafhamo.Wa be da,ma yutuubule yalgo al‑chifa. 
Wa ana gult : Da le mata,ya Rabbi ? Wa hu gaal : Lahaddi kulla l‑mudun yiddammarowa yabgo faadiyiin min sukkaanhumwa l‑buyuut yabgo bala naaswa l‑ard tiddammar wa takhrab.
Lahaddi ana Allah nibaʼʼid al‑naaswa l‑balad tagood faadiye marra waahid.
Wa hatta kan faddalo uchurmin al‑sukkaan kula,battaan yahrago be naar.Wa humman yabgomisil chadar al‑butumaw al‑balluut al‑gataʼooh.Yifaddil illa dumburahlaakin dumburahyijiib zurriiye mukhaddasa. 
Wa Rasiin malik balad Araam wa Fagah wileed Ramalya malik mamlakat Israaʼiilgammo didd Madiinat al‑Khudus le yihaarubuuha wa laakin ma gidro yahjumuuha.Wa da fi ayyaam hukum Ahaaz wileed Yuutaam wileed Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Wa gaalo le l‑malik Ahaaz al‑min zurriiyit Dawuud : Daahu malik Araam khatta muʼaskarah fi turaab gabiilat Afraayim. Khalaas fi l‑bakaan da,al‑malik wa chaʼabah barjalo bigo misil chadar al‑khaaba al‑hazzatah al‑riih.
Wa Allah gaal le Ichaʼya : Amrug inta wa wileedak Chaar Yachuub (maʼanaatah al‑faddulu yigabbulu).Wa gaabulu al‑malik Ahaaz.Talgooh fi taraf majra al‑birke al‑aali ale derib zereʼ al‑khassaaliin.
Wa guul leyah :‹ Agood saakit ma takhaaf !Wa khalli galbak ma yibarjilfi chaan al‑zaʼal al‑chadiidhana Rasiin malik Araam wa wileed Ramalya.Achaan humman misil machaahiib itneenal‑gaaʼidiin yidakhkhunu.
Achaan balad Araamwa turaab gabiilat Afraayim wa wileed Ramalyadawwaro yisawwu leek al‑fasaala wa gaalo :
“Yalla nugummu didd balad Yahuuzawa nadkhulu al‑madiina.Wa nikhawwufuuha wa nichiiluuhawa nukhuttu foogha wileed Tabiil misil malik.”› 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Da ma yukuun wa da ma yabga.
Achaan madiinat Dimachkh,hi raas balad Araamwa malik Rasiin,hu raas Dimachkh bas.Wa baʼad 65 sana,turaab gabiilat Afraayim yiddammarwa chaʼabha yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa madiinat al‑Saamira,hi raas turaab gabiilat Afraayimwa wileed Ramalya,hu raas al‑Saamira bas.Kan ma tiʼaamunu be kalaami ana al‑Rabb,abadan ma tasbutu. 
Wa battaan Allah hajja le Ahaaz wa gaal leyah :
 Atlub alaama min Allah Ilaahak kan min tihit al‑ard walla min foog fi l‑sama. 
Wa Ahaaz radda leyah wa gaal : Ana ma natlub cheyy wa la nijarrib Allah. 
Wa khalaas,Ichaʼya gaal : Asmaʼo,ya zurriiyit Dawuud.Gallaltu sabur al‑naas da chiyya leeku walla ?Hal tagdaro tigallulu sabur Ilaahi ?
Wa fi chaan da,al‑Rabb hu zaatah yantiiku alaama.Daahu al‑bineeye khalbaanewa talda wileedwa tisammiih Immaanuwiil(maʼanaatah Allah maʼaana).
Hu yachrab laban raayib wa yaakul asallahaddi yakburwa yaʼarif al‑zeen wa l‑fasil.
Wa laakin gubbaal al‑wileed dama yaʼarif al‑zeen wa l‑fasil,turaab al‑muluuk al‑itneen dool yabga khala.
Wa Allah yijiib foogak inta,ya l‑malik Ahaaz,wa fi chaʼabak wa aayiltakayyaam al‑abadan ma jomin yoom turaab Afraayim anfaragmin turaab Yahuuza.Wa l‑ayyaam al‑fasliin dool yaju leekbe sabab malik balad Achuur. 
Fi l‑yoom da,Allah yisaffir le yinaadi askar Masirwa humman yaju katiiriin misil dubbaanmin kulla majaari Masir.Wa yinaadi askar min balad Achuurwa humman yaju katiiriin misil nahale.
Wa humman yaju kulluhumwa yanzulu fi karkaw al‑wudyaanwa fi chuguug al‑jibaalwa fi kulla l‑chadar al‑induhum chookwa fi kulla l‑maraaʼi.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑Rabb yiʼajjir muuswa hu malik balad Achuur.Wa yijiibahmin khaadi le bahar al‑Furaat.Wa beyah al‑Rabb yizayyin al‑raaswa kulla suuf al‑jilidwa l‑digin kula yisillaha.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ayyi naadum yirabbi ijle min al‑doorwa khanam itneen.
Wa min katarat al‑laban,al‑naas yacharbo al‑laban al‑raayib.Aywa,al‑naas al‑faddalo fi l‑baladyiʼiichu be l‑laban al‑raayib wa l‑asal bas.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑bakaan al‑awwal indah 1 000 chadara hana inabal‑tamanah 1 000 hajar fudda,yikhalluuh fi l‑chook wa l‑haskaniit.
Wa yadkhulu foogah be huraabwa nubbaalachaan kulla l‑balad tabga kadaade,malaane be l‑chook wa l‑haskaniit.
Kan le l‑jibaal al‑awwal haratoohum be jarraay,battaan ma yahartuuhummin katarat al‑chook wa l‑haskaniitwa illa l‑bagar wa l‑khanam basyasraho fooghum.
Wa Allah gaal leyi : Chiil looh kabiir wa aktib foogah be huruuf waadhe al‑usum Mahiir Chalaal Haach Baz. 
Wa ana wassaft al‑looh da le chuhuud amiiniin wa humman Uriiya raajil al‑diin wa Zakariiya wileed Yabarkiya.
Wa ana garrabt le marti al‑nabiiye wa hi bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileed.Wa Allah gaal leyi : Sammi wileedak Mahiir Chalaal Haach Baz (maʼanaatah ajri le l‑khaniime wa amchi ajala le l‑nahib).
Achaan gubbaal al‑wileed ma yaʼarif yuguul :‹ ammi wa abuuyi ›,yijiibu giddaam malik balad Achuur khuna Dimachkh wa khaniimit al‑Saamira. 
Wa Allah hajja leyi battaan wa gaal :
 Al‑chaʼab da abaalmi hillit Chiiloohal‑yajri be bicheechwa firho be l‑malik Rasiinwa be wileed Ramalya.
Wa fi chaan da,al‑Rabb yigawwim didduhumalmi bahar al‑Furaat al‑chadiid wa katiir.Wa da,malik balad Achuurwa kulla azamatah.Hu yatlaʼ foog min bakaan margadahwa yufuut huduudah al‑awwal.
Wa yaakul balad Yahuuzawa yisiil wa yinayyilwa yalhag lahaddi l‑ragaba.Wa rujuulah yamlo urd baladak,ya Immaanuwiil. 
Ya chaʼab Achuur,arjufu wa akhaafo !Ya kulla l‑naas al‑baʼiidiin fi l‑ard,asmaʼo !Jahhuzu le l‑harib wa akhaafo.Aywa,jahhuzu le l‑harib wa akhaafo.
Sawwu chooritkuwa laakin chooritku di tafchul.Guulu kalaamku misil tidooruuhwa laakin kalaamku da ma yilhaggagachaan Immaanuwiil,Allah maʼaana.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah leyi wakit iidah karabatni wa hazzarni ma nichiil derib al‑chaʼab da.Hu gaal :
 Ma tuguulu muʼaamara le ayyi cheyyal‑yinaadi al‑chaʼab da muʼaamara.Ma takhaafo min ayyi cheyyal‑humman yakhaafo minnahwa ma tarjufu.
Wa le Allah al‑Gaadir bas,tikhaddusuuhwa minnah hu bas takhaafowa minnah hu bas tarjufu.
Wa hu yabga bakaan mukhaddasle l‑mamaalik al‑itneen hana Bani Israaʼiil.Yabga leehum hajaral‑yintaggo foogah wa yittartaʼowa yabga chabaka wa charakle sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa katiiriin yittartaʼo fi l‑hajarwa yagaʼo wa yilkassarowa yagaʼo fi l‑charak wa yakurbuuhum. 
Ahfad al‑chahaada diwa akhtim al‑taʼliim fi guluub talaamiizi.
Ana nukhutt achami fi Allahal‑aba ma yiwajjih ale zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa ana nitwakkal aleyah.
Ana wa l‑iyaal al‑antaahum leyi Allah,aniina misil alaamaat wa masalle Bani Israaʼiil.Allah al‑Gaadir bas jaabaahum,hu al‑saakin fi jabal Sahyuun.
Akuun yuguulu leeku : Amchu le l‑naas al‑yikallumumaʼa l‑maytiinwa le l‑jannaaniyiinal‑humman yilkhaalowa yihajju tihit tihit.Al‑chaʼab ma yasʼalo ilaahaathum walla ?Wa l‑naas ma yikallumu maʼa l‑maytiinfi chaan al‑hayyiin walla ? 
Khalaas,ruddu leehum wa guulu : Al‑naas al‑ma yitaabuʼual‑taʼliim wa l‑chahaadama yichiifu nuur al‑sabaah. 
Al‑naas yuchuggu al‑baladtaʼbaaniin wa jiiʼaaniin.Wakit yujuuʼu,yakhdabowa yalʼano malikhum wa Ilaahhumwa yisanguʼu ale l‑sama.
Wa baʼad da,yichiifu al‑ardwa daahu taʼab wa dalaam.Wa dalaam al‑diige yilizzuhumfi dalaam azrag kurum.
Wa laakin al‑dalaam ma yagood daaymanfi l‑balad al‑gaaʼide fi l‑taʼab.Zamaan Allah ayyabturaab Zabuluun wa turaab Naftaali.Wa laakin fi l‑mustakhbal,yicharrif al‑derib al‑jamb al‑baharkhaadi le bahar al‑Urdunwa daar al‑Jaliil,daar al‑ajaanib.
Al‑chaʼab al‑maachiin fi l‑dalaamyichiifu nuur aziim.Aywa,al‑saakniin fi balad al‑dalaam al‑haalik,nuur yibiin leehum.
Ya Rabb !Inta kattart naas al‑umma diwa kabbart farahhum.Wa yafraho giddaamakmisil farah hana yoom al‑gatiʼwa farah hana gisim al‑khaniime.
Achaan inta rafaʼt al‑tagala al‑fooghumwa l‑daami al‑fi kataafeehumwa kassart asaat al‑mudaayigmisil najjeethum min naas Midyaan fi l‑yoom daak.
Wa ayyi naʼaal adu al‑tafjakh wa tirajjifwa ayyi khalag al‑dassooh fi damm,khalaas yazguluuhum fi ambalbaalawa l‑naar taakulhum.
Achaan wildo leena sakhiirwa l‑wileed da,antooh leena.Wa l‑sulta tabga fi iideenahwa yinaaduuh be l‑asaame dool,al‑Mustachaar al‑Ajiibwa l‑Ilaah al‑Gaadirwa l‑Abu al‑Daayimwa Malik al‑Salaam.
Wa yikabbir sultitah wa salaam bala haddfi kursi al‑muluk hana Dawuud.Wa mamlakatah tasbit wa tabga gawiiyefi l‑hagg wa l‑adaalamin al‑yoom wa ila l‑abad.Wa be mahabbitah al‑chadiide,Allah al‑Gaadir yisawwi al‑cheyy da.
Al‑Rabb rassal kalaam didd zurriiyit Yaakhuub,aywa,al‑kalaam wagaʼ fi Bani Israaʼiil.
Al‑chaʼab kulluhum yaʼarfuuh.Humman gabiilat Afraayimwa sukkaan madiinat al‑Saamira.Kulluhum be fachaarwa galib mutakabbir yuguulu :
 Diringeel al‑durdur wagaʼlaakin aniina nabnuuh battaanbe hajar mugassas.Chadar al‑jimmeez gattaʼoohlaakin aniina nimaggunuchadar al‑arz fi badalah. 
Wa Allah yansur fooghum khusmaan Rasiinwa yanti silaah le udwaanhum.
Araam fi l‑sabaahwa l‑Filistiyiin fi l‑kharibyaakulu Bani Israaʼiil akle waahide.Wa be da kula,zaʼal Allah ma yagiifwa iidah gaaʼide marfuuʼa le l‑ikhaab.
Al‑chaʼab ma gabbalole Ilaahhum al‑darabaahumwa ma fattacho Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa khalaas fi yoom waahid bas,Allah yagtaʼ min Israaʼiilal‑raas wa l‑danabwa l‑nakhal wa l‑ageeg.
Al‑kubaaraat wa l‑ajaawiid,humman al‑raas.Wa l‑anbiya al‑yitnabbaʼo be kidib,humman al‑danab.
Al‑kubaaraat al‑yuguudu al‑chaʼabwaddaroohumwa l‑chaʼab dooladdammaro marra waahid.
Wa fi chaan da,al‑Rabb ma yafrah be subyaanhumwa ma yihinn fi ataamaahum wa araamilhum.Achaan humman kulluhumkuffaar wa fasliinwa kulla khuchuumhum yikallumube kalaam al‑tamaasa.Wa be da kula,zaʼalah ma yagiifwa iidah gaaʼide marfuuʼa le l‑ikhaab.
Achaan fasaalithum tahrig misil al‑naaral‑taakul al‑chook wa l‑haskaniitwa titichch chadar al‑khaabawa titalliʼ ale l‑sama amuud hana dukhkhaan.
Min chiddit khadab Allah al‑Gaadir,al‑balad tahragwa l‑chaʼab yabgo hatab al‑naarwa ma fi naadum al‑yihinn fi akhuuh.
Wa akalo ale l‑zeene wa gaaʼidiin be l‑juuʼwa akalo ale l‑isra wa ma chibʼowa ayyi waahid yaakul laham jisim gariibah.
Gabiilat Manassa tugummdidd gabiilat Afraayimwa gabiilat Afraayim tugummdidd gabiilat Manassawa kulluhum sawa yugummudidd Bani Yahuuza.Wa be da kula,zaʼalah ma yagiifwa iidah gaaʼide marfuuʼa le l‑ikhaab.
Al‑azaab le l‑yikharruru churuut hana fasaalawa yaktubu gawaaniin hana taʼab !
Humman yadharoal‑miskiin min al‑chariiʼawa yaglaʼo al‑haggmin fagraan chaʼabi.Wa yaksabo al‑araamilwa yanhabo al‑ataama.
Intu tisawwu chunu fi yoom al‑ikhaab,wakit al‑halaak yaji leeku min baʼiid ?Le yaatu tajruwa min yaatu talgo al‑fazaʼ ?Wa ween tudummu khunaaku ?
Ma faddal illa tidanguru maʼa l‑masaajiinwa tagaʼo maʼa l‑maytiin.Wa be da kula,zaʼal Allah ma yagiifwa iidah gaaʼide marfuuʼa le l‑ikhaab.
Al‑azaab le malik balad Achuur !Hu asaat zaʼaliwa ninazzil khadabi be l‑asa al‑fi iidah.
Ana nirassil malik balad Achuurdidd al‑umma al‑kaafrewa nuguudah didd al‑chaʼabal‑yigawwumu khadabiachaan malik Achuur yanhabhumwa yaksabhumwa yifajjikhhum tihit rijileenahmisil al‑tiine fi l‑chawaariʼ.
Wa laakin hu ma yafham misil dawa galbah kula ma yifakkir misil da.Achaan fi galbah illa l‑damaarwa katil al‑umam be katara.
Achaan hu gaal : Khuyyaadi ma ziyaadamin al‑muluuk dool walla ?
Wa dammarna hillit Kalnamisil hillit Karkamiichwa hillit Hamaatmisil hillit Arfadwa madiinat al‑Saamiramisil madiinat Dimachkh !
Iidi kula dammarat mamaalik al‑ilaahaatal‑asnaamhum katiiriinmin asnaam Madiinat al‑Khudus wa l‑Saamira.
Hal ana ma nidammirMadiinat al‑Khudus wa asnaamhamisil dammart al‑Saamira wa ilaahaatha walla ? 
Wa wakit al‑Rabb yikammil kulla khidimtah fi jabal Sahyuun wa fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,hu yuguul : Nugumm didd afkaar al‑istikbaar hana malik balad Achuur wa choofah hana l‑bukhud.
Achaan al‑malik da gaal :‹ Be gudrat iidi,ana sawweet kulla l‑cheyy dawa be hikmati,ana bigiit faahim.Ana khayyart huduud al‑chuʼuubwa nahabt maalhumwa be faraasiiye nazzaltmuluuk min karaasiihum.
Wa misil yichiilu beed min al‑uchch,ana khataft khuna al‑chuʼuub.Wa misil yukhummu al‑beed al‑khallooh,ana khammeet kulla buldaan al‑ard.Wa ma fi waahid harrak jinhahwa la fakka khachmahwa la sarakh diddi.› 
Wa Allah gaal : Hal al‑faas tafchurfi siidha al‑yagtaʼ beeha walla ?Hal al‑munchaar yilʼallafi l‑yistaʼmalah walla ?Wa da misil al‑asa tiharrik al‑iid al‑tarfaʼhawalla misil al‑dugul yigill al‑insaan !
Wa be sabab da,ana Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir ninazzilal‑batuul fi l‑askar al‑sumaan hana l‑malik.Wa be azamathum di kula,al‑naar taakulhum wa tahrighum. 
Wa l‑Rabb,nuur Israaʼiil,yabga misil naaraywa,Khudduus Israaʼiilyabga misil ambalbaalaal‑fi yoom waahid bas,taakul wa tahrigal‑chook wa l‑haskaniit.
Be l‑kaamil,al‑Rabb yidammir al‑khaabaatwa l‑jineenaat al‑kubaar hana malik Achuur.Wa humman yabgomisil mardaan al‑waddar gudurtah.
Wa yifaddil chiyya bas min chadar khaabaatahlahaddi sakhiir sakhayyar kula yagdar yahsibhum.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑yifaddulu min Bani Israaʼiil wa l‑muʼarridiin wa l‑nijo min zurriiyit Yaakhuub ma yintaklu ale malik Achuur al‑darabaahum.Wa laakin yintaklu be amaan ale Allah Khudduus Israaʼiil.
Wa l‑yifaddulu yigabbulu.Aywa,al‑yifaddulu min zurriiyit Yaakhuub yigabbulu le Allah al‑Gaadir.
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,kan chaʼabku bigo katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al‑bahar kula,al‑yigabbulu minku chiyya bas.Kharaar al‑damaar marag wa hu kharaar malaan be l‑adaala.
Wa khalaas,kharaar al‑damaar da marag wa akiid Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir yitabbigah fi kulla l‑balad.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir gaal : Ya chaʼabi al‑saakniin fi madiinat Sahyuun,ma takhaafo min malik balad Achuur.Hu gaaʼid yadrubku be asaatah wa yarfaʼ asaatah didduku misil sawwooh al‑Masriyiin zamaan.
Hassaʼ faddal wakit chiyya bas,khadabi didduku yagiif wa laakin zaʼali yidammir askar balad Achuur. 
 Wa ana Allah al‑Gaadir narfaʼleyah al‑soot wa nadurbahmisil darabt naas Midyaan fi hajar Uriib.Wa narfaʼ asaati didd al‑baharmisil rafaʼtaha didd al‑Masriyiin zamaan.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,narfaʼtagalatah min kataafeekuwa nichiil al‑daami min rigaabkuwa l‑daami yilkassarachaan tachbaʼo wa tabgo sumaan. 
Wa askar Achuur yaju fi hillit Ayyatwa yuchuggu hillit Migruunwa fi hillit Mikmaach,yikhallu muʼiddaathum.
Wa yagtaʼo al‑maʼadd wa yuguulu : Fi l‑leele di,nanzulu fi hillit Gabaʼ. Wa be da,hillit al‑Raama tarjifwa Gibeeʼa hillit Chaawuulsukkaanha yiʼarrudu.
Asrakho,ya naas hillit Bitt Galliim !Wa khutti baalki,ya hillit Laycha !Wa hillit Anatuut al‑Miskiine !
Wa hillit Madmiina tiʼarridwa sukkaan hillit Gabiimyifattuchu maljaʼ.
Wa fi nafs al‑yoom,askar Achuuryagiifu fi hillit Nuubwa yarfaʼo iideehumdidd jabal Sahyuun al‑misil bineeyewa da hajar al‑foogah Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa chiifu !Daahu Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadiryidammir askar Achuurmisil naadumyikassir al‑furuuʼ be chidde.Wa misil yagtaʼ al‑furuuʼ al‑marfuuʼiin foog,Allah yikammil kubaaraathumwa l‑aaliyiin kula,yarmiihum tihit.
Wa da misil hu yagtaʼ chadar al‑khaaba be faaswa khalaas,Lubnaan tagaʼ giddaam al‑Aziim.
Wa yaji waahid min zurriiyit Yassamisil firiʼ al‑yabzur min dumburwa min gaʼarah tugummbizre al‑tisawwi iyaal.
Wa fi l‑naadum da,yanzil Ruuh Allahwa da ruuh al‑hikma wa l‑maʼrafawa l‑choora wa l‑fahaaliiyewa l‑ilim wa l‑khoof min Allah.
Wa hu yafrah be l‑khoof min Allahwa ma yahkim be l‑chaafatah eenahwa ma yikharrir be l‑simʼatah adaanah.
Wa yahkim le l‑fagraaniin be l‑adaalawa yikharrir be l‑adil le masaakiin al‑balad.Wa kalaamah,misil be asa yadrub al‑baladwa be kilme waahide,yaktul al‑aasi.
Wa l‑adaala misil hizaam sulbahwa l‑sahiih misil hizaam batnah.
Wa l‑baʼachoom yaskun maʼa l‑hamalwa l‑nimir yargud jamb al‑sakhal.Wa l‑ijil wa farkh al‑duud yaakulu sawawa wileed sakhayyar yuguudhum.
Wa l‑bagara wa l‑dubb yasraho sawawa iyaalhum yarugdu bakaan waahid.Wa l‑duud yabga misil al‑toor,yaakul al‑gechch.
Al‑tifil yalʼab be uchch abundaragaywa,al‑sakhiir yidiss iidah fi nugrat al‑daabi.
Wa ma tukuun fasaala wa la damaarfi kulla jabali al‑mukhaddasachaan al‑ard tinmali be maʼrafat Allahmisil al‑bahar yinmali be almi.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,irig Yassa yabga misil raaye le l‑chuʼuub.Wa l‑umam yifattuchuuhwa bakaanah al‑yinjamma foogah aziim.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑Rabb yimidd iidah le taani marrale yafda al‑faddalo min chaʼabahal‑gaaʼidiin fi buldaan Achuur wa Masirwa Fatruus wa l‑Habacha wa Ilaamwa Chinʼaar wa Hamaatwa fi jazaayir al‑bahar.
Hu yarfaʼ raaye le l‑umamwa yilimm Bani Israaʼiil al‑matruudiinwa yajmaʼ Bani Yahuuza al‑muchattatiinfi l‑arbaʼa jiihaat hana l‑ard.
Wa husud Afraayim yabga ma fiihwa khusmaan Yahuuza yikammulu.Wa Afraayim ma yahsid Yahuuza battaanwa Yahuuza ma yabga abadankhasiim Afraayim.
Wa humman yinsabbofi l‑Filistiyiin fi l‑kharibwa sawa yanhaboal‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑sabaah.Wa fi buldaan Adoom wa Muwaab,yahkumuwa le Bani Ammuun,yamulkuuhum.
Wa Allah yiyabbis rijil bahar Masirwa yarfaʼ iidah le yadrub bahar al‑Furaatbe chiddit nafkhatah.Wa yigassimah sabʼa wudyaan dugaagal‑yagdaro yagtaʼoohum be rijleehum.
Wa hinaak,hu yisawwi derible l‑faddalo min chaʼabah fi balad Achuurmisil zamaan sawwa derib le Bani Israaʼiilyoom marago min balad Masir.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,inta tuguul : Ana nachkurak,ya Allah !Achaan inta ziʼilt diddiwa laakin khadabak inta khalleetahwa inta sabbartini.
Daahu al‑Ilaah al‑munajji !Ana atwakkalt aleyahwa battaan ma nakhaaf.Achaan gudurti wa khuwwiti,hu Allahwa hu bas al‑najjaani. 
Wa tichiilu almi be farahmin een almi hana l‑naja.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,intu tuguulu : Achkuru Allah wa naadu usmah !Arrufu amalah le l‑chuʼuubwa azzakkaro kadar usmah al‑Aali.
Khannu le Allahachaan hu sawwa achya aziimiinwa arrufu beehum kulla l‑ard.
Iitu be farah wa zakhrutu,ya sukkaan Sahyuun !Achaan Khudduus Israaʼiilal‑gaaʼid fi usutku,hu aziim. 
Muhaakamat Baabil al‑chaafha Ichaʼya wileed Ammuus fi ruʼya.
Al‑Rabb gaal : Khuzzu raaye fi l‑jabal al‑amlaswa naadu le l‑askar.Wa wassufuuhum be iideekule yadkhulu al‑madiinabe biibaan al‑hukkaam.
Ana anteet amur le mukhassasiin hineeyiwa battaan naadeet furraasi al‑yinaffuzu khadabi,al‑yafraho be azamati. 
Asmaʼo al‑haraka al‑katiire fi l‑jibaalmisil chaʼab katiiriin !Wa da hiss harakat al‑mamaalikaywa,harakat malammat al‑umam !Allah al‑Gaadir yijahhizdeechah al‑yihaarib.
Humman yaju min balad baʼiidemin aakhir al‑ard.Allah wa silaah khadabahyisabbubu damaar hana kulla l‑balad.
Abku be hizin achaan yoom Allah garrabwa da yoom hana damaar chadiidal‑jaayi min al‑Gaadir.
Wa be sabab da,kulla l‑iideen yinrakhuwa ayyi naadum galbah yingatiʼ.
Humman yinbahtuwa yakrubhum wajaʼ wa talagawa yittannomisil mara al‑gaaʼide titaalig.Wa l‑waahid yichiif al‑aakharkulluhum munbahitiinwa yisallulu uyuunhum min al‑khoof.
Daahu yoom Allah jaayi,yoom hana khadab mukhiif wa zaʼal chadiidal‑foogah Allah yakhrib al‑ardwa yuguchch minha al‑muznibiin.
Wa be da,nujuum al‑sama wa l‑Sabi al‑Makhminuurhum ma yibiin.Wa min taluuʼha,al‑harraay tabga dalmawa l‑gamar kula,nuurah ma yidawwi.
Wa l‑Rabb gaal : Ana niʼaakhib al‑dunya fi chaan fasaalithawa l‑aasiyiin fi chaan khataahum.Wa niwaggif istikbaar al‑mustakbiriinwa ninazzil fachaar siyaad al‑unuf.
Wa nisawwi al‑insaan khaali ma yinlagimisil al‑dahab al‑saafi.Aywa,Bani Adam yabga khaali ma yinlagimisil dahab balad Ufiir.
 Wa be sabab da,nihizz al‑samawa nirajjif al‑ard min asaasha.Wa da min chiddit zaʼali ana Allah al‑Gaadirfi yoom khadabi al‑muhrig.
Khalaas,misil al‑khazaala al‑matruudawa misil al‑khanam al‑ma induhum raaʼi,ayyi waahid yigabbil le chaʼabahwa ayyi waahid yiʼarrid le baladah.
Wa ayyi waahid al‑yalgooh,yatʼanoohwa ayyi waahid al‑yakurbuuh,yaktuluuh be l‑seef.
Wa atfaalhum yarhakoohum giddaamhumwa yanhabo khumaam buyuuthumwa yarugdu maʼa awiinhum be gu. 
Wa l‑Rabb gaal : Daahu nigawwim al‑Maadiyiin didduhumal‑ma yifakkuru fi l‑fuddawa l‑dahab kula ma yaʼajibhum.
Wa be nuchchaabhum,yaktulu al‑chabaabwa ma yarhamo al‑tifilwa ma yihinnu fi l‑iyaal al‑dugaag. 
Zamaan,madiinat Baabil jamaal al‑mamaalikwa ziinat al‑Baabiliyiin.Wa hassaʼ,hi tabgamisil Saduum wa Amuuraal‑dammaraahum al‑Rabb.
Hi ma yaskunuuha ila l‑abadwa min zurriiye le zurriiye kula,ma yaskunuuha.Al‑arab al‑yisiiruma yabnu khiyamhum hinaakwa l‑ruʼyaan ma yisawwuzaraayibhum hinaak.
Haywaanaat al‑kadaade yaskunuuhawa tuyuur amguggum yamlo buyuutha.Wa l‑naʼaam yaskunhawa tuyuus al‑hajar yalʼabo foogha.
Al‑maraafʼiin yabku fi buyuutha al‑samhiinwa l‑baʼaachiim fi gusuurha al‑kubaar.Wakitha gariib yajiwa ayyaamha mahsuubiin.
Allah yihinn fi zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa yaʼazil battaan Bani Israaʼiilwa hu yantiihum al‑raaha fi baladhum.Wa l‑ajaanib yilimmu maʼaahumwa yinrabtu maʼa zurriiyit Yaakhuub.
Wa chuʼuub aakhariin yichiiluuhumwa yigabbuluuhum fi baladhumfi l‑ard al‑antaaha leehum Allah.Wa Bani Israaʼiil yakurbu al‑naas doolwa yisawwuuhum abiid wa khadiim.Wa yasjunu al‑naas al‑sajanoohumwa yahkumu fi l‑naas al‑daayagoohum.
Yoom waahid,Allah yantiiku al‑jummamin taʼabku wa diigitkuwa min al‑ubuudiiye al‑gaasiye al‑faradooha foogku.
Wa khalaas fi l‑yoom da,tikhannu be l‑masal dawa tichchammato le malik Baabilwa tuguulu : Kikkeef wagaf al‑mudaayig ?Wa kikkeef al‑jaayir bigi ma fiih ?
Allah kassar isay al‑aasiyiinwa asaat al‑hukkaam.
Achaan be khadab al‑mudaayig darab al‑chaʼabwa be daribiin mutataabiʼ.Wa be zaʼal,hu malak al‑umamwa taradaahum bala rahma.
 Wa hassaʼ,kulla sukkaan al‑ard anjammo wa ligo raahawa be farah zakhrato.
Hatta chadar al‑sarwi wa arz Lubnaanfirho be l‑bigi foogak,ya l‑malik !Wa gaalo :‹ Min inta wagaʼt,al‑yagtaʼna abadan ma gidir yaji leena. ›
 Wakit inta wisilt fi bakaan al‑maytiin,humman barjalo wa laagook.Wa gawwamo leek al‑naas al‑maato zamaanwa kulla kubaaraat al‑ard.Wa gawwamo min karaasiihumkulla muluuk al‑umam.
Wa kulluhum yihajju leek wa yuguulu :‹ Inta kula daahu mutt misilnawa bigiit maʼaana sawa sawa.
Istikbaarak nazal fi bakaan al‑maytiinmaʼa musiikha hana jigindiiytak.Wa hassaʼ inta raagid fi l‑duudwa mulkhatti beyah. ›
 Kikkeef inta wagaʼt min al‑samaawaat,ya deyy al‑sabaah al‑yiraari ?Kikkeef ramook fi l‑ard,ya mufachchil al‑umam ?
Inta bas gult fi galbak :‹ Natlaʼ foog fi l‑samaawaatwa nukhutt kursiiyimin foog le nujuum al‑Ilaah.Wa nagood fi jabal al‑ijtimaaʼ al‑ilaahaatfi aakhir al‑munchaakh. ›
Wa battaan inta gult :‹ Natlaʼ foog fi l‑sahaabwa nisawwi nafsi misil al‑Aali. ›
Wa laakin daahu inta nazaltmaʼa l‑maytiin fi aakhir al‑khabur.
Al‑yichiifuuk yihammuruukaywa,yichiifuuk adiil wa yuguulu :‹ Da ma al‑raajil al‑barjal al‑ardwa rajjaf al‑mamaalik walla ?
Da ma hu al‑sawwa al‑aalam saharawa haddam al‑mudunwa ma talag al‑masaajiin walla ? ›
 Kulla muluuk al‑umam bala tafrikharagado be charaf,ayyi waahid fi khaburah.
Wa laakin inta,zagalook baʼiid min khaburakmisil firiʼ al‑jaʼalooh muharramwa misil rimmit al‑insaanal‑taʼanooh be l‑seefwa zagalooh fi nugra al‑fi lubbaha hajarwa misil janaazaal‑fajjakhooha be l‑rijileen.
Wa inta,ma dassookmaʼa l‑muluk fi l‑khaburachaan inta dammart baladakwa katalt chaʼabak.Wa l‑naas al‑yisawwu al‑fasaala,usum zurriiyithum yiwaddir ila l‑abad.
 Yalla !Jahhuzu juzur le katil iyaalahbe sabab khata juduudhum !Achaan ma waajib yugummuwa yaglaʼo al‑ardwa yamlo al‑aalam be mudunhum. 
Wa Allah gaal : Ana nugumm didduhumwa nuguchch usum al‑Baabiliyiinwa l‑faddalo min iyaalhumwa iyaal iyaalhum.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa Baabil nisawwiiha rahadwa maskan abunchook.Wa nuguchchahabe mugchaachat al‑damaar ! Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa Allah al‑Gaadir halaf wa gaal : Akiid,al‑naweetah yukuunwa l‑kharrartah yitimm.
Ana nidammirnaas balad Achuur fi baladiwa nifajjikhhum fi jibaali.Wa be misil da,nidalli al‑daami min kataafe chaʼabiwa ninazzil tagalatah min kataafeehum. 
Da l‑kharaar al‑chaalah Allahdidd kulla l‑ardwa di hi al‑iid al‑marfuuʼadidd kulla l‑umam.
Allah al‑Gaadir chaal kharaar.Yaatu yagdar yifachchilah ?Hu rafaʼ iidah le l‑ikhaab.Yaatu yagdar yinazzilha ?
Wa fi l‑sana al‑maat foogha al‑malik Ahaaz,al‑muhaakama di bigat.
 Ma tafraho,ya kulla l‑Filistiyiin,wa ma tuguulu asaat al‑yadrubku ankasarat.Achaan min rimmit al‑daabi,yamrug abundaragwa min zurriiytah,yamrug al‑daabi al‑indah samm yaktul.
Wa awlaad al‑bikir hana l‑fagraaniinyalgo maʼaachhumwa l‑masaakiin yarugdu be amaan.Wa laakin intu,ya l‑Filistiyiin,naktulku be l‑juuʼwa l‑faddalo minku,nidammirhum.
Nuuhu,ya biibaan !Wa kooruku,ya mudun !Kulla l‑Filistiyiin barjalo.Achaan al‑adu yajimisil dukhkhaan min al‑munchaakhwa askari waahid kula ma yamrugmin al‑saff.
Chunu al‑nurudduuhle murassaliin al‑umma di ?Nuguulu :‹ Aywa,Allah assas Sahyuunachaan masaakiin chaʼabah yaljaʼo leeha.› 
Muhaakamat Muwaab.Fi leele waahide bas,hi addammarat !Hillit Aar al‑fi Muwaab bigat ma fiiha.Aywa fi l‑leele al‑hi addammarat foogha,hillit Khiir al‑fi Muwaab kula bigat ma fiiha !
Wa chaʼabha gaaʼidiin yabku wa talaʼofi l‑bakaanaat al‑aaliyiin hana l‑ibaadaal‑fi hillit Habeet wa fi hillit Diibuun.Naas Muwaab yunuuhule hillaal Nabu wa Miidbawa kulla ruuseehum muzayyaniinwa duguunhum magtuuʼiin min al‑hizin.
Wa fi l‑chawaariʼ,laabsiin khulgaan al‑hizinwa fi ruuse al‑buyuut wa l‑nagaʼaat,kulluhum yunuuhu wa yabku be hizin.
Wa naas Hachbuun wa Aliʼaalagaaʼidiin yikoorukuwa hissuhum gaaʼid yinsamiʼlahaddi hillit Yahaas.Wa fi chaan da,askar Muwaab yiʼiituwa laakin chajaaʼa ma induhum.
Galbi anjarah le naas Muwaab.Al‑muʼarridiin minha lihgolahaddi hillaal Suukhar wa Aglat Chaliicha.Wa gaaʼidiin yatlaʼo fi gooz Luhiit be bakiwa yasrakho siraakh chadiid fi derib Hurunaayim.
Achaan almi rijil Nimriim chiribwa l‑gechch yibis.Wa l‑haya aba ma yugummwa l‑khadaar bigi ma fiih.
Wa fi chaan da,humman chaalo khumaamhum al‑faddalwa waddooh khaadi le waadi al‑Gana.
Wa korooraakhum ansamaʼfi kulla ard Muwaabwa nuwaahhum machalahaddi hillit Aglaayimwa wassal lahaddi biir Iliim.
Almi Diibuun malaan dammwa Allah gaal : Ana ninazzil fi Diibuunmasaayib ziyaada.Al‑duud yaktulal‑muʼarridiin hana Muwaabwa yaakul al‑faddalo fi turaabha. 
Wa kubaaraat Muwaab gaalo : Min madiinat Saalaʼ fi l‑sahara,rassulu kharuufle haakim al‑baladal‑gaaʼid fi jabal Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye. 
Wa fi maʼadd waadi Arnuun,banaat Muwaab yabganmisil tuyuur al‑muchattatiinal‑taradoohum min uchchuhum.
Wa gaalan : Chaawirwa chiil leena kharaar.Be l‑nahaar,khattiina be dullakmisil al‑dalaam yikhatti al‑leel.Wa labbid naasna al‑muchattatiinwa ma tibayyin al‑muʼarridiin.
Khalli al‑muchattatiin min Muwaabyaskunu maʼaakwa abga leehum maljaʼwa labbidhum min al‑yidammirhum. Al‑zulum yagiif wa l‑damaar yikammilwa l‑zaalim yiwaddir min al‑balad.
Khalaas,kursi al‑muluk yasbit be l‑rahmawa yagood foogah haakim amiinmin zurriiyit Dawuud.Wa hu yichaariʼ be l‑haggwa yahkim be l‑adaala.
Wa laakin Ichaʼya gaal : Aniina simiʼnabe l‑istikbaar al‑chadiid hana Muwaabwa fachaarha wa istikbaarhawa khadabha al‑ma indah asaaswa fachaarha al‑ma indah maʼana.
Wa fi chaan da,al‑Muwaabiyiin yunuuhule baladhum Muwaabwa kulluhum yunuuhu.Aywa,intu naas Muwaab tandamole kaʼak al‑inab hana hillit Khiir Haaras al‑bigi ma fiihwa taguntu be hizin.
Achaan ziraaʼat Hachbuun yibsatwa jineenit al‑inab fi hillit Sibma jaffathi al‑awwal khamarha yisakkir kubaaraat al‑umam.Wa zamaan,al‑inab da lihig hillit Yaʼziirwa sarah fi l‑kadaadewa furuuʼah lihgokhaadi le l‑bahar al‑Mayyit.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nabki maʼa Yaʼziir le inab Sibmawa narwiiku be dumuuʼi,ya Hachbuun wa Aliʼaala.Achaan fi gatiʼku wa lammiinku hana l‑inab,al‑khine hana l‑farah bigi ma fiih.
Wa l‑farha wa l‑suruur bigo ma fiihumwa fi jineenaat al‑inab,ma fi zakhraat wa la farha.Wa l‑yagtaʼ al‑inab ma yaʼasirah fi l‑assaarawa khine al‑farah bigi ma fiih.
Wa fi chaan da,butuuni rajafo le Muwaabmisil hubaal al‑jigindiiyewa galbi khaaf le hillit Khiir Haaras.
Wa Muwaab tiʼayyi nafisha saakitfi l‑madbah fi l‑bakaan al‑aali.Hi tamchi fi bakaanha hana l‑ibaada wa tachhadwa laakin ma talga cheyy. 
Wa da kalaam Allah al‑gaalah fi Muwaab min zamaan.
Wa hassaʼ,Allah gaal : Min hini le talaata sana sawa sawa,yahguru charaf Muwaab wa katarat askarha kula.Al‑faddalo chiyya bas wa ma induhum faayde. 
Muhaakamat madiinat Dimachkh.Dimachkh battaanma tukuun madiina.Hi tilhaddamwa tabga koom hana turaab.
Wa mudun Aruuʼir yakhrabowa yabgo bakaan le l‑bahaayim.Al‑bahaayim yarugdu fooghumwa ma fi naadum yibachtinhum.
Al‑mudun al‑gawiyiin fi Afraayim yiddammarowa muluk Dimachkh kula yagiif.Al‑faddalo min balad Araam,charafhum yabga ma fiihmisil charaf Bani Israaʼiil.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,charaf zurriiyit Yaakhuub yangusmisil naadum al‑laham jildahwa chahamah daffag.
Wa humman yabgomisil al‑zereʼ baʼad al‑gatiʼwakit al‑gatiʼiinlammo al‑gameh be katara.Wa da misil wakit yikachchubu al‑ganaadiilfi waadi Rafaayiin.
Al‑yifaddil minhum yabga chiyyamisil al‑kichcheebaw misil al‑faddalbaʼad hatto chadar al‑zaytuun.Waahid aw tineen yifaddulu foog fi raas al‑chadarawa arbaʼa aw khamsa fi l‑furuuʼ.Wa da kalaam Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑insaan yitwakkal ale Ilaahah al‑khalagah wa yiwajjih be amaan ale Khudduus Israaʼiil.
Wa battaan ma yintakil ale l‑madaabih al‑sawwathum iidah wa ma yiwajjih be amaan fi l‑sawwaah be asaabʼah.Wa dool al‑iidaan al‑khazzaahum le ibaadat Achiira wa l‑makhaabir hana l‑bakhuur.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑mudun al‑gawiyiin yikhalluuhummisil khallo al‑khaaba wa ruuse al‑jibaalwakit Bani Israaʼiil jo chaalo al‑balad,kulla l‑balad takhrab.
Achaan intu nisiitu Ilaahku al‑najjaakuwa ma fakkartu foogah hu,jabal maljaʼku.Wa fi chaan da,maggantu chadar laziizwa teerabtu teeraab ajnabi.
Wa yoom maggantuuhum,intu chiftuuhum kibrowa ambaakir fajur,chiftu nuwwaarhum.Wa laakin fi wakt al‑gatiʼ,ma ligiitu intaajwa wajaʼku ma indah ilaaj.
Al‑azaab !Daahu al‑hiss al‑chadiidhana chuʼuub al‑ma induhum adad.Harakathum chadiidemisil harakat al‑baharwa hissuhum chadiidmisil hiss almi al‑seel.
Wa harakat al‑chuʼuubmisil harakat almi al‑katiir.Wakit al‑Rabb yugumm didduhum,humman yiʼarrudu baʼiid,matruudiin misil uttaabgiddaam riih min al‑jibaalwa misil haskaniitgiddaam amzoobaʼaane.
Wa fi l‑achiiye,ruʼub !Wa gabul al‑fajur,ma faddal cheyy !Da bas gisim al‑naas al‑yanhaboonawa mukaafaat al‑naas al‑yaksaboona.
Al‑azaab le l‑balad al‑fooghasufun al‑induhum chiraaʼfi tuul buhuur al‑Habacha !
Di l‑balad al‑tirassil sufara be l‑baharfi maraakib hana birdial‑yamchi ajala fi l‑almi.Ya rusul,amchu ajala !Amchu le l‑ummaal‑naasha tuwaal wa mulus,le l‑chaʼab al‑mukhiifiin fi ayyi bakaan.Aywa,hi umma gawiiye tarhak kulla cheyywa buhuur yuchuggu baladha.
Asmaʼo,intu kullukual‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑aalam,intu al‑saakniin fi l‑ard !Wakit al‑raaye yarfaʼoohafi ruuse al‑jibaal,chiifuuha !Wa wakit yadurbu al‑buug,asmaʼooh !
Achaan daahu Allah gaal leyi : Min bakaani,ana nichiif wa nagood saakitmisil al‑harraay al‑chadiide fi l‑nahaarwa misil sahaabaayit al‑karany fi hamu wakit al‑gatiʼ. 
Wa gabul al‑gatiʼ,wakit al‑inab nawwar khalaaswa wakit al‑nuwwaar bigi inab najiid,al‑Rabb yagtaʼ al‑furuuʼ be l‑sakkiinwa yamrug al‑khusuunwa yukhuttuhum taraf.
Wa misil da,naas al‑Habachayikhalluuhum le suguura al‑jibaalwa le haywaanaat al‑kadaade.Al‑suguura yaakuluuhum fi wakt al‑seefwa haywaanaat al‑kadaade fi wakt al‑chite.
Wa fi l‑wakit da,tijiib hadaaya le Allah al‑Gaadir,al‑umma al‑naasha tuwaal wa muluswa chaʼabha mukhiifiin fi ayyi bakaan.Wa hi umma gawiiye tarhak kulla cheyywa buhuur yuchuggu baladha.Wa hi tijiib hadaaya fi jabal Sahyuunfi l‑bakaan al‑gaaʼid foogah usum Allah al‑Gaadir.
Muhaakamat Masir.Daahu fi sahaabaay sariiʼe Allahjaayi fi Masir.Wa ilaahaat Masir gaaʼidiin yarjufu giddaamahwa l‑Masriyiin galibhum angataʼ.
Ana niharrich al‑Masriyiin yilhaarabo,waahidiin yugummu didd al‑aakhariin.Ayyi waahid yugumm didd akhuuhwa ayyi waahid yugumm didd jaarah,madiina didd madiinawa mamlaka didd mamlaka.
Wa ana niwaddir chajaaʼat al‑Masriyiinwa nibarjil choorithum.Khalaas,humman yasʼalo al‑ilaahaatwa l‑chawwaafiinwa l‑yikallumu maʼa l‑maytiinwa l‑yihajju maʼa l‑jinn.
Wa nisallim al‑Masriyiin fi iid siid gawiwa hu malik jaayir yahkim fooghum.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir.
Wa almi al‑bahar yikammilwa l‑Niil yaybaswa almi al‑bahar yachrabwa hu yabga yaabis.
Wa l‑buhuur yinchammo afniinaywa,rujuul Masir yangusu wa yaybasowa l‑tibin wa l‑birdi yijiffu.
Wa l‑gechch al‑fi khachum al‑Niilwa kulla nabaat al‑Niil yaybasowa yichittu wa yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa l‑hawwaatiin yaguntuwa l‑yazgulu jambaathum fi l‑Niil yahzanowa l‑yazgulu charakhum fi khachum al‑almi yiʼayyusu
wa l‑naas al‑yakhdumu fi l‑kattaan yiʼiibuwa l‑yitirru wa l‑yuduggu al‑tchaaka achamhum yingatiʼ.
Darraabiin al‑tchaaka hana Masir yatʼabowa kulla l‑khaddaamiin al‑muʼajjariin yazʼalo.
Aywa,masaaʼiil hillit Suʼaan munaafikhiinwa l‑hukama mustachaariin Firʼoonsawwo majlas hana mataamiis.Wa intu !Kikkeef tagdaro tuguulu le Firʼoon : Ana wileed hukama.Ana wileed muluuk hana zamaan. 
Ya Firʼoon,mustachaariinak ween ?Khalli yiʼooruuk wa yiʼallumuukkharaar Allah al‑Gaadir al‑chaalah didd Masir.
Wa masaaʼiil hillit Suʼaan ma induhum raaswa masaaʼiil hillit Mamfiis ankhachchowa kubaaraat al‑gabaayil waddaro Masir.
Wa Allah nazzalfi usuthum ruuh hana barjaalwa humman waddaro Masir fi amalha al‑tisawwiihmisil wadaar al‑sakkaari fi lubb gadiifah.
Wa naadum ma yagdaryisawwi cheyy le Masirwa la l‑raas wa la l‑danabwa la l‑nakhal wa l‑ageeg.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,naas Masir yabgo misil awiin wa yakhaafo wa yarjufu wakit yichiifu iid Allah al‑Gaadir marfuuʼa didduhum.
Wa balad Yahuuza tikhawwif al‑Masriyiin.Achaan ayyi Masri al‑yifakkir foogha yarjif fi chaan al‑kharaar al‑chaalah Allah al‑Gaadir didd Masir.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,khamsa mudun fi Masir yikallumu be lukhkhat al‑Ibraaniyiin wa yahalfu kadar yaʼabudu Allah al‑Gaadir.Wa waahide min al‑mudun dool yisammuuha Madiinat al‑Harraay.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,yukuun madbah le Allah fi usut balad Masir wa yukhuzzu hajar le Allah fi huduudha.
Wa l‑hajar da yabga alaama wa chahaada kadar Allah al‑Gaadir gaaʼid fi balad Masir.Wa wakit yikooruku le Allah fi chaan al‑yazulmuuhum,hu yirassil leehum munajji al‑yihaami leehum wa yikhallishum.
Wa Allah yibayyin nafsah le l‑Masriyiin.Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑Masriyiin kula yaʼarfuuh wa yaʼabuduuh.Wa yaʼabuduuh wa yigaddumu leyah dahaaya wa hadaaya wa yisawwu nazir le Allah wa yitimmuuh.
Wa wakit Allah yadrub al‑Masriyiin be chidde,hu yachfiihum.Achaan humman yigabbulu le Allah wa hu yakhbal suʼaalhum wa yachfiihum.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,yukuun derib min balad Masir lahaddi balad Achuur wa l‑Achuuriyiin yamchu Masir wa l‑Masriyiin yamchu Achuur.Wa l‑Masriyiin wa l‑Achuuriyiin yaʼabudu Allah sawa.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,Israaʼiil tabga al‑taalit le Masir wa Achuur.Wa da yijiib al‑baraka fi ust al‑ard.
Achaan Allah al‑Gaadir yibaarikhum wa yuguul : Mubaarakiin al‑Masriyiin chaʼabi wa l‑Achuuriyiin al‑sawwathum iidi wa Bani Israaʼiil chaʼabi wa warasati. 
Wa daahu al‑cheyy al‑kaan fi l‑sana al‑foogha Sarguun malik Achuur rassal khaayid deechah le yihaarib madiinat Achduud wa yichiilha.
Wa gabul Achduud ma tagaʼ,Allah hajja be waasitat al‑nabi Ichaʼya wileed Ammuus.Wa hu gaal le Ichaʼya : Yalla amrug khulgaanak hana l‑hizin wa sill niʼleek min rijileenak. Wa Ichaʼya sawwa misil da wa macha aryaan wa hafyaan.
Wa Allah gaal : Misil abdi Ichaʼya macha aryaan wa hafyaan muddit talaata sana,da yabga alaama wa cheyy ajiib le Masir wa l‑Habacha.
Wa misil da,malik Achuur yichiil subyaan wa chiyyaab min Masir wa l‑Habacha wa yiwaddiihum masaajiin fi l‑khurba.Wa l‑naas dool yiwaddiihum aryaaniin wa hafyaaniin wa jaʼabaathum barra.Wa da eeb le Masir.
Wa misil da,al‑naas al‑khatto achamhum fi l‑Habacha wa faacharo be musaaʼadat Masir yinbahtu wa yiʼiibu.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,sukkaan khachum al‑bahar yuguulu :‹ Chiifu !Khatteena achamna fooghum le yafzaʼoona wa yinajjuuna min malik Achuur.Wa hassaʼ da,kikkeef aniina ninajju nufuusna ?› 
Muhaakamat al‑sahara al‑jamb al‑bahar.Al‑adu yaji min al‑sahara,min balad mukhiifemisil al‑zoobaʼaane al‑jaayemin saharat al‑Nagab.
Ruʼya mukhiife baanat leyi.Nichiif al‑khaayin yukhuunwa l‑mudammir yidammir.Wa Allah gaal : Yalla ahjumu al‑madiina,ya naas Ilaam !Wa haasuruuha,ya naas Maadi !Ana niwaggif kulla l‑ganitiinal‑hi sabbatatah. 
Wa be sabab da,sulbi gaaʼid yarjif min al‑taʼabwa wajaʼ chadiid karabaanimisil wajaʼ hana l‑maraal‑gaaʼide titaalig.Min chiddit al‑wajaʼ,ma nasmaʼwa min chiddit al‑khoof,ma nichiif.
Fikri waddarwa khoof chadiid karabaani.Al‑leel al‑gaaʼid narjaahjaab leyi al‑ruʼub.
Jaabo al‑akil fi l‑dabalaaywa farracho al‑birichwa akalo wa chirbo.Laakin tawwaali,fi hiss gaal : Gummu,ya khuyyaad !Zayyudu duruuʼku. 
Achaan daahu al‑Rabb gaal leyi : Amchi wa khutt haraswa khalli yihajji be l‑yichiifah.
Wa kan chaaf arabaat haribal‑yukurruuhum kheel itneenwa kan chaaf naas raakbiin fi hamiirwa naas aakhariin raakbiin fi jumaal,khalaas khalli yukhutt baalah wa yingariʼ. 
Wa l‑haras sarakh wa gaal : Ya sayyidi !Ana waagif kulla yoomfi bakaan al‑haraasa.Wa waagif kulla l‑leelfi bakaan al‑muraakhaba.
Wa daahu !Naadum raakib fi arabaal‑yukurruuha kheel itneenjaayi wa yuguul :‹ Wagaʼat !Baabil wagaʼat !Wa kulla asnaam ilaahaathakassaroohum fi l‑turaab !› 
Ya chaʼabi !Intu al‑Allah daggaakumisil khalla fi madaggah !Al‑cheyy al‑simiʼtahmin Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil,da bas ana gultah leeku.
Muhaakamat balad Duuma.Aato leyi min Saʼiir wa gaalo : Ya l‑haras !Chunu kaan fi l‑leel ?Ya l‑haras !Chunu kaan fi l‑leel ? 
Wa l‑haras radda wa gaal : Al‑sabaah jawa l‑leel kula maʼaayah.Kan tidooru tiwajjuhu suʼaal,asʼalo !Gabbulu wa taʼaalu battaan. 
Muhaakama balad al‑Arab.Ya naas Dadaan al‑ruhhal !Intu tunuumu fi khaabat balad al‑Arab.
Ya sukkaan balad Tiima !Antu almi le naas Dadaan al‑atchaaniinwa waddu leehum akil,humman al‑muʼarridiin.
Achaan humman muʼarridiin min al‑suyuufaywa,min al‑suyuuf al‑marfuuʼiinwa min al‑nubbaal al‑majbuudwa min chiddit al‑harib.
Daahu al‑Rabb gaal leyi : Baʼad sana waahide sawa sawa,kulla charaf balad Khidaar yabga ma fiih.
Wa yifaddulu chiyya bas fi Khidaarmin al‑rujaal al‑fahaliin siyaad al‑nubbaal. Wa da kalaam Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil al‑hu gaalah.
Muhaakama fi waadi al‑Ruʼya.Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus,maala kulla chaʼabkitalaʼo fi ruuse al‑buyuut ?
Maala kulla l‑awwa wa l‑haraka,ya inti hillit al‑farah ?Maytiinki ma kataloohum be l‑seefwa ma maato fi l‑harib.
Kulla khuyyaadki arradowa siyaad al‑nuchchaab karaboohum masaajiin.Wa kulla sukkaanki karaboohum masaajiinhatta kan humman arrado baʼiid kula.
Wa fi chaan da,ana gult : Ma tichiifuuni !Khalluuni nabki be hurga.Wa ma tihaawulu tihannusuuniachaan ummati al‑misil bitt ammi addammarat. 
Achaan da yoom hana barjaalwa damaar wa chakk.Wa da jaayi min Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadirfi waadi al‑Ruʼya.Al‑durdur wagaʼwa l‑korooraak ansamaʼ ale l‑jabal.
Naas balad Ilaam chaayliin kalootaathumwa arabaat al‑harib wa siyaad al‑kheel jaayiinwa naas hillit Khiir jahhazo duruuʼhum.
Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus !Wudyaanki al‑samhiinanmalo be arabaat al‑harib.Wa siyaad al‑kheel jo wagafofi khuchuum biibaanki
wa daahu balad Yahuuzama indaha difaaʼ battaan.Wa fi l‑yoom da,intu wajjahtu ale beet al‑Khaabaal‑foogah silaahku.
Wa chiftu kadarkhuram madiinat Dawuud katiiriin.Wa waradtu almiwa sabbeetuuh fi l‑khazzaan al‑tihit.
Wa hasabtu adad buyuut Madiinat al‑Khuduswa haddamtu buyuut waahidiin le tigawwu al‑durdur.
Wa sawweetu khazzaanambeenaat al‑daraadir al‑itneenle l‑almi hana l‑birke al‑gadiime.Wa laakin ma wajjahtu le Allahhu al‑jaab al‑masiibe di.Wa ma chiftuuh aleyah,hu al‑jahhazaaha min zaman baʼiid.
Wa da l‑yoom al‑foogah Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadirnaadaaku le tabku wa tunuuhuwa le tizayyunu ruuseekuwa talbaso khulgaan al‑tooba.
Wa laakin daahu be farah wa suruur,intu dabahtu bagar wa khanam.Wa akaltu lahamwa chiribtu khamar wa gultu : Yalla !Naakulu wa nacharboachaan ambaakir,khalaas numuutu ! 
Wa Allah al‑Gaadir bayyan leyi wa gaal : Khataaku da,abadan ma indah kaffaaralahaddi tumuutu. Wa da,Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir gaal : Amchi algaah le Chabnaal‑masʼuul fi gasir al‑malikwa guul leyah :
‹ Indak chunu hini ?Wa indak yaatu hini ?Maala tankut leek khaburfi l‑bakaan da ?Wa maala tahfir khabur fi l‑aaliwa tiʼaddil leek khabur fi l‑jabal le tinjamma foogah ?
Ya l‑raajil al‑chadiid,daahu Allah yarmiik baʼiidwa yakurbak be chidde wa yatwiik.
Wa yidakrimak misil kuuraaywa yazgulak fi balad wasiiʼe.Wa hinaak tumuut maʼa arabaat charafak,inta al‑jibt al‑eeb le beet siidak.
 ‹ Aywa !Ana narmiik min bakaanakwa naturdak min masʼuuliiytak.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ninaadi abdiAliyaakhim wileed Hilkhiiya.
Ana nilabbisah khalagakwa narbut sulbah be hizaamakwa masʼuuliiytak,nantiiha leyah fi iideenah.Wa hu yabga abule sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khuduswa le Bani Yahuuza.
Wa masʼuuliiyit muftaah gasir al‑malik Dawuud,nukhuttaha tihit sultitah.Wa kan hu yaftah al‑baab,ma fi al‑yagdar yisiddahwa kan hu yisiddah,ma fi al‑yagdar yaftahah.
Wa ana nimakkinahmisil witid fi bakaan gawiwa hu yijiib al‑charaf le beet abuuh.
Wa kulla tagalat charaf beet abuuh,al‑kubaar wa l‑sukhaar kula,yukhuttuuha foogah.Wa hu yabga misil chiʼbeal‑yiʼallugu fooghakulla l‑muʼiddaat al‑sukhaarmin al‑kharaariif lahaddi l‑girab.› 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir : Fi l‑yoom da,al‑witid al‑mumakkan fi l‑bakaan al‑gawiyintani wa yinkasir wa yagaʼwa l‑tagala al‑chaayilha tiddammar. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑hu gaalah.
Muhaakamat balad Suur.Nuuhu,ya l‑musaafiriin be sufun Tarchiich !Achaan madiinat Suur addammarat !Ma fi buyuut wa la madkhal !Wa da khabar min jaziirat Khubrus.
Askutu min al‑khoof,ya sukkaan khachum al‑bahar.Ya tujjaar Seeda !Tujjaarku chaggo al‑bahar be katara.
Maʼaach waadi Masirwa darat al‑Niil wa intaajahsaafaro fi l‑baharwa bigo tijaara le l‑umam.
Ya Seeda,akhjale !Ya l‑madiina al‑gawiiye al‑jamb al‑bahar !Achaan al‑bahar gaal : Ana ma taalagt wa la wilidtwa la kabbart wulaadwa la rabbeet banaat. 
Wakit sukkaan Masir yasmaʼobe l‑khabar da,yarjufumisil rajafo wakit simʼo khabar Suur.
Ya sukkaan khachum al‑bahar,nuuhuwa agtaʼo al‑bahar lahaddi Tarchiich !
Hal di bas madiinitku Suural‑awwal farhaane walla ?Hal di bas hi al‑gadiimeal‑gaaʼide min zamaanwa assasat hillaal aakhariin walla ?
Yaatu al‑kharrar al‑cheyy da didd Suur,hi al‑tidarrij muluuk ?Hi charrafat tujjaarha misil masaaʼiilwa tujjaarha mucharrafiin fi kulla l‑ard.
Allah al‑Gaadir bas kharrarahle yidammir istikbaar al‑naas al‑mucharrafiinwa yahgir kulla l‑naas al‑induhum charafal‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑ard.
Ya chaʼab Tarchiich !Chittu fi ardukumisil al‑Niil yamla ardahachaan ma fi cheyy al‑yadharku.
Achaan Allah rafaʼ iidah didd al‑baharwa rajjaf al‑mamaalik.Wa kharrar yidammirmudun Kanʼaan al‑gawiyiin.
Wa Allah gaal : Ya chaʼab madiinat Seeda !Waggufu farahku,ya intu al‑misil bineeye udriiye al‑azzabooha.Gummu wa amchu jaziirat Khubrus !Wa laakin hinaak kula,ma talgo jumma.
Chiifu naas balad Baabil,humman dool bigo ma fiihum.Achaan al‑Achuuriyiin antoohumle haywaanaat al‑kadaade.Al‑Achuuriyiin sawwo khanaadigle yihaasuru al‑hillewa haddamo gusuur madiinat Suurwa sawwoohum koom hana turaab. 
Ya l‑musaafiriin be sufun Tarchiich,nuuhu achaan maljaʼku al‑gawi khirib !
Wa fi l‑yoom da,Suur yansooha le muddit 70 sana misil adad ayyaam malik waahid.Wa fi nihaayat al‑siniin dool,Suur tabga misil charmuuta al‑khanno beeha.Wa gaalo :
 Ya l‑charmuuta al‑nisooki !Chiili jigindiiyewa hawwigi al‑madiina.Duggi al‑jigindiiye adiilwa khanni katiirachaan yizzakkarooki. 
Wa baʼad 70 sana,Allah yifakkir le Suur wa hi tigabbil le ribaaha al‑awwal.Wa hi tichcharmat battaan maʼa kulla mamaalik al‑ard.
Laakin ribaaha wa ujritha yabgo mukhassasiin le Allah.Wa la yudummuuhum wa la yakhzunuuhum.Achaan be ribaaha yiʼakkulu wa yichabbuʼu wa yilabbusu adiil al‑naas al‑yaskunu giddaam Allah.
Daahu Allah yidammir al‑ardwa yisawwiiha kharaab.Hu yitallif wijih al‑ardwa yichattit sukkaanha.
Wa min chiddit al‑taʼab,raajil al‑diin yabga misil waahid min al‑chaʼabwa l‑siid yabga misil abdahwa l‑sitt yabga misil khaadimhawa l‑baayiʼ yabga misil al‑muchtariwa l‑yiʼattil yabga misil al‑yiʼattuluuhwa l‑yidayyin yabga misil al‑yidayyunuuh.
Wa kulla l‑ard tiddammar damaar kaamilwa yanhabooha marra waahidachaan da kalaam Allah al‑hu gaalah.
Al‑ard tijiff wa taybasaywa,al‑aalam yadʼaf wa yaksalwa kubaaraat chaʼab al‑ard yadʼafo.
Wa l‑ard,sukkaanha yinajjusuuhaachaan humman ma tabbago al‑wasaayawa khaalafo al‑gawaaniinwa gataʼo al‑muʼaahada al‑daayme.
Wa sukkaan al‑ard yilʼaakhabobe sabab khataahumwa fi chaan da bas,al‑laʼana talhag al‑ard.Wa be da,sukkaan al‑ard yahragowa yifaddulu minhum chiyya bas.
Wa l‑khamar al‑jadiid yabga chiyyawa chadar al‑inab yamrad.Wa l‑naas al‑awwal guluubhum farhaaniinhassaʼ gaaʼidiin yaguntu.
Wa hiss al‑tanaabil al‑halu yagiifwa aayit al‑farhaaniin yikammilwa daribiin al‑jigindiiye al‑halu kula yagiif.
Ma yacharbo khamar be khinewa l‑khamar al‑bisakkir yabga murr le l‑charraabiin.
Al‑hille al‑kharbaane tilkassarwa ayyi beet yilgaffalwa ma indah madkhal.
Wa yasrakho fi l‑chawaariʼachaan al‑khamar yabga ma fiih.Wa kulla l‑farah yabga ma fiihwa l‑suruur yiwaddir min al‑balad.
Wa fi l‑madiina yinchaaf illa l‑kharaab,al‑biibaan yilkassaro wa yiddammaro.
Wa khalaas fi ust al‑ardwa been al‑chuʼuub ma yifaddil cheyymisil al‑zaytuun baʼad al‑gatiʼwa l‑inab al‑faddal kichcheeb.
Al‑faddalo hayyiin yarfaʼo hissuhumwa yafraho be azamat Allah.Wa wakit yaju min al‑kharib,yiʼiitu be farah.
Majjudu Allah fi l‑sabaah !Majjudu usum Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil fi jazaayir al‑bahar !
Wa min taraf al‑ard,nasmaʼo khine al‑buguul : Al‑majd le Allah al‑saadikh ! Wa laakin ana nuguul : Ana waddart !Ana waddart !Al‑azaab leyi ana !Al‑khaayniin khaano.Khiyaana !Al‑khaayniin khaano. 
Khoof wa nugra wa charakleeku intu,ya sukkaan al‑ard !
Al‑yajri min al‑hiss al‑yikhawwifyagaʼ fi l‑nugrawa l‑yamrug min al‑nugra,al‑charak yakurbah.Achaan biibaan al‑sama yinfathuwa asaas al‑ard yarjif.
Wa l‑ard tichchaggagwa l‑ard tilfatfatwa l‑ard tinhazza.
Al‑ard tittartaʼ misil al‑sakkaariwa tinhazza misil illiiye fi l‑riih.Isyaanha yabga leeha tagiilwa hi tagaʼ marra waahidma tagdar tugumm.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,Allah yiʼaakhib khuwwaat al‑sama foogwa muluuk al‑ard tihit.
Wa yilimmuuhumwa yakurbuuhum masaajiin fi l‑nugra.Wa yigaffuluuhum fi l‑sijinwa baʼad mudda tawiile,yiʼaakhubuuhum.
Al‑gamar yakhjalwa l‑harraay talga al‑eebachaan Allah al‑Gaadir yahkim.Wa yibayyin majdahgiddaam kubaaraat chaʼabahfi jabal Sahyuunwa fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Ya Allah !Inta Rabbi,ana niʼazzimak wa nachkur usmakachaan inta sawweet ajaayibwa min zamaan,wasiiyaatak sidikh wa amaan.
Inta sawweet madiinat udwaannakoom hana turaabwa l‑hille al‑gawiiyesawweetha daraadir muhaddamiinwa gasir al‑ajaanib ma bigi madiinawa battaan ma yinbani.
Wa fi chaan da,chaʼab gawiyiin yimajjuduukwa hillaal al‑umam al‑mujrimiin yakhaafo minnak.
Achaan inta maljaʼ le l‑daʼiifwa maljaʼ le l‑miskiin fi l‑diige.Inta misil bakaan al‑yahmi min al‑matara al‑chadiidewa misil dull al‑yahmi min al‑hamu.Achaan khadab al‑mujrimiinmisil matara al‑chadiide al‑tadrub durdur
wa misil al‑hamu fi ard al‑sahara.Wa inta tisakkit harakat al‑ajaanibmisil sahaabaay al‑tidallil fi l‑hamuwa tiwaggif khine al‑mujrimiin.
Allah al‑Gaadir yisawwi aazuumale kulla l‑chuʼuub fi jabal Sahyuun.Wa yigaddim foogha laham samiinwa khamar gadiim.Aywa,yigaddim laham samiin wa mukhkhwa khamar gadiim saafi.

Daahu Allah jaayi min baʼiidwa khadabah yahrigwa da tagiil ma binhamil.Wa khachmah yihajji be khadabwa lisaanah misil naar al‑tahrig.
Wa nafkhatah misil seel al‑chadiidal‑yatlaʼ lahaddi yalhag al‑ragaba.Wa hu yikharbilal‑umam kharbiliin al‑damaarwa yilajjimal‑chuʼuub le yiwaddirhum.
Ya sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus,intu tikhannumisil fi leele khaassa le l‑iid.Wa l‑farah yamla guluubkumisil al‑yamchi maʼa hiss al‑suffaaraale jabal Allah,aleyah hu,hajar Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Allah yisammiʼ hissah al‑majiidwa yiwassif duraaʼah al‑marfuuʼbe chiddit zaʼalahwa ambalbaala al‑tahrigwa matar chadiid wa barad.
Wa balad Achuur tarjif min hiss Allahal‑yadrubha be asa.
Wa ayyi darbe al‑yiʼaakhibha beeha Allahyinsamiʼ maʼaaha hiss hana tanaabil wa jigindiiyewakit yarfaʼ iidah le yihaaribha.
Wa min wakit tawiil,nugrat al‑naar jaahizeaywa,hi jaahize le malik Achuur !Wa l‑nugra di tawiile wa wasiiʼewa daffago foogha hatab katiir.Wa be nafkhat Allahal‑misil seel chadiid hana kibriit,hu yigabbidha naar.
Al‑azaab le l‑naas al‑yanzulu fi Masir le l‑fazaʼwa yintaklu ale l‑kheelwa yitwakkalo ale arabaat al‑haribachaan humman katiiriinwa yitwakkalo ale siyaad al‑kheelachaan humman induhum gudra.Wa laakin al‑naas dool ma induhum fikir fi Khudduus Israaʼiilwa humman ma yifattuchu Allah.
Akiid,hu hakiim !Yagdar yijiib al‑charrwa ma yangud kalaamah.Wa hu yugumm didd al‑yisawwu al‑fasaalawa didd al‑fazaʼo wa l‑zulum.
Al‑Masriyiin humman insaan,ma ilaahwa kheelhum laham,ma ruuh.Wakit Allah yarfaʼ iidah,al‑Masriyiin al‑yaju fazaʼ,yittartaʼowa l‑dawwaro fazaʼhum,yagaʼowa kulluhum yiddammaro sawa.
Wa daahu Allah gaal leyi : Wakit al‑duud aw farkh al‑duud yikirr fi rimmitah,hatta kan naado ruʼyaan katiiriin diddah kula,hu ma yibarjil min korooraakhumwa la yakhaaf min katarathum.Wa be misil da,Allah al‑Gaadir yanzilfi jabal Sahyuun,fi hajarah le yihaarib.
Wa misil al‑tuyuur yimattutu janaaheehum,Allah al‑Gaadir kula yahmi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Aywa,hu yahmiiha wa yinajjiihawa yafzaʼha wa yikhallisha.
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,gabbulu ale l‑abeetuuh marra waahid !
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ayyi waahid yaaba ilaahaatah hana l‑fuddawa ilaahaatah hana l‑dahab.Aywa,dool al‑sawwoohum leekuiideeku al‑muznibiin.
 Wa balad Achuur tagaʼ tihit seef al‑ma hana naadumwa da ma seef insaan al‑yaktulha.Hi tajri giddaam al‑seef dawa subyaanha yikhaddumuuhum misil abiid.
Wa askarha al‑fahaliin yajru min al‑khoofwa kubaaraatha yinbahtu giddaam al‑raaye. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑indah naar fi jabal Sahyuun wa indah furun fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Aywa,yaji yoom al‑foogahal‑malik yamluk be l‑adaalawa l‑kubaaraat yahkumu be l‑hagg.
Wa ayyi waahid minhum yabgamisil bakaan al‑yillabbado foogah min al‑riihwa misil bakaan al‑yahmi min al‑matara al‑chadiide.Wa yabga misil majaari almi fi bakaan al‑yaabiswa misil dull al‑jabal fi ard jafaaf.
Wa uyuun al‑naas al‑yichiifuabadan ma yikhammudu.Wa udne al‑naas al‑yasmaʼoyinfathu marra waahid.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑naas al‑mussaʼjiliin fi l‑kalaamyifakkuru wa yafhamo.Wa lisaan al‑naas al‑induhum tamtaamayihajji ajala be kalaam waadih.
Wa abadan ma yinaadu al‑matmuus masʼuulwa l‑khachchaach ma yinaaduuh hakiim.
Achaan al‑matmuus yuguul kalaam cheenwa fi galbah yudumm al‑charr.Hu yisawwi al‑fasaala wa yakfurwa yakdib fi Allah.Wa yamnaʼ al‑akil le l‑jiiʼaanwa l‑almi le l‑atchaan.
Al‑khachchaach amalah fasil.Hu yikhattit al‑fasaalale yidammir al‑masaakiin be kalaam kidibwakit yidaafuʼu le huguughum.
Wa laakin al‑hakiimyikhattit amal adiilwa ale l‑amal al‑adiil da,hu yintakil.
Ya l‑awiin al‑munjammaat,gumman wa asmaʼan hissi.Ya l‑banaat al‑gaaʼidaat be amaan,khuttan udneekan le kalaami.
Baʼad sana wa ayyaam,tarjifan,ya l‑gaaʼidaat be amaan.Achaan gatiʼ al‑inab yabga ma fiihbattaan ma fi lammiin hana maʼaach.
Barjilan,ya l‑munjammaat !Arjifan,ya l‑gaaʼidaat be amaan !Assallaban wa agoodan aryaanaatwa arbutan firaad fi salabaakan.
Akurban duyuudkan wa abkanachaan al‑ziraaʼa al‑laziizewa jineenit al‑inab al‑wallaadabigo ma fiihum.
Achaan ard chaʼabigamma foogha chook wa andireesa.Aywa,nuuhan le kulla buyuut al‑suruurwa madiinat al‑farah.
Achaan gasir al‑malik khalloohwa l‑madiina al‑siyaadha katiiriin,abooha.Haarat Ufal wa gasir al‑muraakhabayabgo misil karaakiir ila l‑abad.Wa hamiir al‑kadaade yinattutu fooghum min al‑farahwa l‑bahaayim yasraho fooghum
lahaddi yoom Allah yinazzil ruuhahfoogna min al‑sama.Khalaas al‑sahara tabga jineenewa l‑jineene tabga misil khaaba.
Wa khalaas,al‑hagg yaskun fi l‑saharawa l‑adaala tagood fi l‑jineene.
Natiijat al‑adaala tabga al‑salaamwa l‑adaala tijiib al‑huduwa l‑amin al‑daayim.
Wa chaʼabi yagoodu fi bakaan hana salaamfi buyuut amiiniin wa haadiyiinwa bakaan hana jumma.
Wa laakin al‑khaaba tiddammar tihit al‑baradwa l‑madiina tilhaddam marra waahid.
Wa laakin al‑farah leeku intu al‑titeerubufi ayyi bakaan al‑indah almiwa tatulgu bagarku wa hamiirkubala guyuud.
Al‑azaab leek inta al‑tikharribwa laakin ma kharrabookwa leek inta al‑tukhuunwa laakin ma khaanook.Wa wakit tikammil min al‑kharaab,akiid yakharbuuk.Wa wakit tikammil min al‑khiyaana,akiid yukhuunuuk.
Ya Allah !Hinn foogna !Aniina nukhuttu achamna foogak.Abga gudritna fi kulli sabaahwa fi wakit al‑diige,abga najaatna.
Min haraka chadiide hana jaytak,al‑chaʼab yiʼarrudu.Wa wakit inta tugumm,al‑umam yichittu.
Al‑khaniime yilimmuuha be kataramisil saar al‑leel yaakulu al‑chadar.Wa yagaʼo fooghamisil wagiʼiin al‑jaraad.
Allah aziim achaan gaaʼid foogwa mala Sahyuun be l‑hagg wa l‑adaala.
Ya chaʼab Allah !Kulla ayyaam hayaatku yabgo amiiniin.Al‑hikma wa l‑maʼrafadool khuna al‑naja.Wa l‑khoof min Allahyabga leeku misil kanz.
Wa daahu al‑furraas yiʼiitu fi l‑chawaariʼwa rusul al‑salaam yabku be hurga.
Wa l‑chawaariʼ faadiyiinwa ma fi naadum maachi fi l‑duruub.Al‑mukharrib gataʼ al‑muʼaahadawa le l‑chuhuud,abaahumwa ma fakkar fi ayyi naadum.
Al‑balad jaffat wa yibsataywa,Lubnaan yibsat wa l‑eeb karabha.Sahalat Chaaruunbigat misil al‑saharawa turaab Baachaan wa jabal al‑Karmalwaddaro khadaarhum.
Wa Allah gaal : Hassaʼ ana nugummwa hassaʼ ana ninrafiʼwa hassaʼ ana niwassif azamati.
Intu khilibtu be gechchwa wilidtu tibin !Wa nafasku misil naar al‑tahrigku.
Wa l‑chaʼab al‑aakhariin yahragowa yabgo rumaad.Yabgo misil al‑chook al‑gataʼoohwa gaaʼid yahrag. 
Intu al‑gaaʼidiin baʼiid,asmaʼo be l‑cheyy al‑ana sawweetah !Wa intu al‑gaaʼidiin gariib,aʼarfu gudurti !
Wa fi Sahyuun al‑muznibiin rajafowa l‑kuffaar anbahato wa yuguulu : Yaatu minnina yagdar yagoodfi l‑naar al‑tahrig ?Wa yaatu yagdar yagoodfi l‑jamur al‑daayim ? 
Illa l‑naadum al‑yuruukh fi l‑adaalawa yikallim be l‑haggwa yaaba maal al‑zulum.Wa yihitt iideenahwa yaaba al‑rachwawa yisidd adaanahmin kalaam daffigiin al‑dammwa yisidd uyuunahachaan ma yichiif al‑fasaala.
Al‑naadum da yaskun fi l‑bakaan al‑aaliwa l‑jibaal al‑gawiyiin yabgo maljaʼah.Wa yantuuh akilwa yadmano leyah al‑almi.
Wa uyuunak yichiifu al‑malik fi jamaalahwa yichiifu al‑balad be kulla huduudha.
Wa galbak yifakkir fi l‑ruʼub al‑awwalwa yuguul : Ween al‑yahsib ?Wa ween al‑yawzin ?Wa ween al‑yahsib buyuut al‑muraakhaba ? 
Wa battaan ma tichiif al‑chaʼab al‑mutakabbir,al‑chaʼab al‑kalaamhum gawiwa lukhkhithum ma tinʼarif wa la tinfahim.
Chiif Sahyuun madiinat farahna !Wa uyuunak yichiifu Madiinat al‑Khudus aamine.Hi misil kheema al‑ma tilhawwalwa wutaadha abadan ma yamurguwa hubaalha abadan ma yilfartago.
Wa Allah yiwassif leena azamatahwa l‑bakaan da yabga buhuur wa majaari wasiiʼiin.Wa maraakib harib ma yadkhulu fooghumwa sufun al‑kubaar kula ma yuchugguuhum.
Achaan Allah hu gaadiinawa hu al‑haakim foogna.Wa hu maliknawa hu al‑yinajjiina.
Wa hubaal sufun al‑adu algattaʼowa battaan ma yalzamo amuud al‑safiinawa ma yarfaʼo raayitha.Wa khalaas nigassumu al‑khaniime be katarawa l‑uruj kula yalgo gisimhum.
Wa waahid min sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus ma yuguul : Ana mardaan .Wa l‑chaʼab al‑saakniin fi l‑madiina diyalgo khufraan khataahum.
Garrubu,ya umam wa asmaʼo !Ya chaʼab,khuttu adaanku !Al‑ard wa kulla cheyy al‑foogha,aywa,al‑dunya wa kulla cheyy al‑fiiha,asmaʼo.
Achaan khadab Allah muwajjah didd kulla l‑umamwa zaʼalah didd kulla duyuuchhum.Hu yidammirhum damaar kaamilwa yiwaddiihum le l‑juzur.
Maytiinhum mudaffigiinwa min janaazaathum tatlaʼ afanawa l‑jibaal yinballo min dammuhum.
Wa kulla khuwwaat al‑sama yiʼaffunuwa l‑sama yatwuuh misil kitaab malfuuf.Wa kulla l‑khuwwaat yidaffugumisil warag al‑inab al‑yaabiswa misil warag al‑tiin al‑yibis.
Wa Allah gaal : Fi l‑samaawaat,seefi rawyaan be l‑khadabwa daahu yanzil didd balad Adoom,didd al‑chaʼab al‑ana khassastuhum le l‑damaar. 
Wa seef Allah malaan be dammwa chabʼaan be chahambe damm al‑khurfaan wa l‑tuyuuswa be chaham kalaawe al‑kubchaan.Achaan fiyah dahiiye le Allah fi madiinat Busrawa fi katil katiir fi balad Adoom.
Wa fi nafs al‑wakit,yagaʼo maʼaahumal‑jawaamiis wa l‑ajjaal wa l‑tiiraan.Arduhum tarwa be l‑dammwa turaabhum yiddahhan be l‑chaham.
Wa da yoom taar Allahwa di sanit hisaab fi chaan Sahyuun.
Wa wudyaan Adoom yikhayyuruwa yinmalu gutraanwa turaabha yabga kibriitwa l‑balad tabga misil gutraan muhrig.
Wa l‑gutraan da,naarah ma tumuutwa la leel wa la nahaarwa dukhkhaanah taaliʼ kulla yoom.Wa l‑balad tagood kharaab min zurriiye le zurriiyewa naadum ma yufuut beeha battaan.
Wa l‑bajaʼ wa abungineefit yawrusuuhawa amguggum wa l‑khurbaat yaskunuuha.Wa yawzinha be miizaan al‑faadiwa yikiilha be mikyaal al‑kharaab.
Wa ma fi kubaaraat al‑yidarruju malikwa kulla masaaʼiilha yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa gusuurha al‑gawiyiin yugumm fooghum chookwa mudunha al‑gawiyiin yinmalu be andireesa wa haskaniit.Wa hi tabga margad hana baʼaachiimwa dungur naʼaam.
Wa l‑gitat yillaago maʼa l‑maraafʼiinwa l‑tuyuus yinnaado al‑waahid le l‑aakhar.Wa amguggum talga bakaan tinjammaaywa,hi talga bakaan al‑raaha.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,al‑daabi yisawwi uchchahwa yalda beedah wa yiraggid foogahwa yifaggiʼah wa yahmiih.Wa akiid fi l‑bakaan da,al‑suguura yilimmuayyi waahid maʼa l‑aakhar.
Fattuchu fi kitaab Allah wa agru.Ayyi waahid min al‑haywaanaat ma gassarwa ayyi waahid yagood maʼa rafiigah.Achaan Allah kallam wa anta izinwa ruuhah bas tilimmuhum.
Hu bas sawwa leehum gisim be amʼiyeedaatwa iidah gassamat leehum al‑balad be magaas.Wa humman yawrusuuha daaymanwa yaskunu foogha min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Khalli al‑sahara wa ard al‑jafaaf yafrahowa balad al‑yabaas tinawwir wa tinbasit.
Khalli tinmali be nuwwaar al‑kadaadewa tinattit wa talʼabwa tizakhrit min al‑farah.Allah yanti al‑balad di khaaba jamiilemisil khaabat Lubnaanwa ard al‑indaha intaaj katiirmisil jabal al‑Karmal wa sahalat Chaaruun.Wa yichiifu majd Allahwa azamat Ilaahna.
Gawwu iideeku al‑ayyaaniinwa sabbutu rikabbuku al‑yarjufu.
Wa guulu le l‑guluubhum angataʼo : Abgo gawiyiin !Ma takhaafo.Daahu Ilaahku !Hu yaji yichiil leeku al‑taarwa yilkaffa leeku fi udwaanku.Wa hu zaatah yaji yinajjiiku. 
Wa khalaas,uyuun al‑amyaaniin yinfathuwa udne al‑tarchaaniin yasmaʼo.
Wa l‑aʼraj yinattit misil al‑khazaalwa lisaan al‑abkam yiʼiit be l‑farah.Achaan almi yisiil fi l‑saharawa rujuul almi yajru fi kadaadit al‑jafaaf.
Al‑ard al‑haamiye tabga rahadwa l‑ard al‑atchaane tisiil almi.Wa fi bakaan margad al‑baʼaachiim,al‑gechch yabga tibin wa birdi.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,yisawwu deribwa yisammuuh al‑Derib al‑Khaass.Al‑ma taahir ma yiʼaddi beyahwa l‑munaafikhiin ma yiwadduru foogahachaan al‑derib da le chaʼab Allah bas.
Wa fi l‑derib da,ma fi duudwa ayyi haywaan khatiir ma yuruukh foogahwa ma yinlagi.Illa l‑naas al‑najjaahum Allahyamchu foogah.
Wa l‑naas al‑fadaahum Allahyigabbulu wa yaju fi Sahyuunbe zakhraat wa farha.Wa farah daayim yinawwir wujuuhhumwa suruur wa farha yikhattuuhumwa l‑hizin wa l‑ganitiin yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa fi sanit 14 hana hukum Hizkhiiya,Sanhariib malik Achuur hajam kulla l‑mudun al‑gawiyiin hana mamlakat Yahuuza wa galaʼaahum.
Wa min hillit Lakiich,malik Achuur rassal khaayid al‑deech le l‑malik Hizkhiiya fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa rassal maʼaayah deech kabiir.Wa wakit wassalo fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,gaʼado jamb majra al‑birke al‑aali fi l‑derib al‑maachi ale zereʼ al‑khassaaliin.
Wa Aliyaakhim wileed Hilkhiiya masʼuul fi gasir al‑malik marag min al‑madiina le yilaagiih wa macho maʼaayah Chabna al‑kaatib wa Yuwaakh wileed Asaaf al‑kaatib al‑yizakkir al‑malik.
Wa khaayid al‑deech gaal leehum : Guulu le Hizkhiiya al‑kalaam da al‑jaayi min al‑malik al‑kabiir hana balad Achuur :‹ Ween al‑amaan al‑inta mutawakkil aleyah ?
Inta tahsib al‑kalaam al‑baatil yanti raay wa gudra fi l‑harib walla ?Wa hassaʼ da,ale yaatu inta atwakkalt le titmarrad diddi ?
Daahu inta atwakkalt ale balad Masir wa hi misil muʼaawana hana ageegaay al‑mafjuukha al‑tatʼan ayyi naadum al‑yirrakkaz foogah.Wa Firʼoon malik Masir hu misil da le kulla l‑naas al‑yitwakkalo aleyah. ›
