Khalaas,inta guul leehum :‹ Ana chahadt al‑malik bas achaan ma yigabbilni battaan le beet Yuunataan achaan ana nakhaaf numuut hinaak.› 
Wa baʼad da,kulla masaaʼiil Sidkhiiya jo le Irmiya wa saʼalooh wa hu radda leehum sawa sawa misil al‑malik amarah beyah.Wa khalaas,humman sakato wa gabbalo achaan al‑achiir da ma ligooh.
Wa Irmiya gaʼad fi fadaayit al‑hurraas lahaddi yoom chaalo Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa baʼad da,Madiinat al‑Khudus wagaʼat.
Wa fi l‑chahar al‑aachir fi l‑sana al‑taasʼe hana hukum Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja be kulla askarah le Madiinat al‑Khudus wa haasarha.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑taasiʼ hana l‑chahar al‑raabiʼ fi sanit 11 hana hukum Sidkhiiya,gaddo khurma fi durdur al‑madiina.
Wa khalaas,kulla khuyyaad malik Baabil jo wa gaʼado fi l‑baab al‑usut.Wa humman Nirgal Charaasar kabiir al‑khuyyaad wa Samgar Nabu wa Sar Sakiim kabiir al‑masaaʼiil wa kulla masaaʼiil malik Baabil al‑aakhariin.
Wa min chaafo al‑naas dool,Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza wa kulla askarah marago wa arrado min al‑madiina be l‑leel.Wa da be derib jineenit al‑malik be l‑baab al‑gaaʼid ambeen al‑daraadir al‑itneen hana l‑difaaʼ.Wa humman marago be l‑derib al‑maachi ale waadi al‑Urdun.
Wa laakin askar Baabil taradooh le Sidkhiiya wa lihgooh wa karabooh fi kadaadit Ariiha.Wa humman jaabooh fi hillit Ribla fi balad Hamaat giddaam Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Wa fi l‑bakaan da,haakamah.
Wa malik Baabil dabah awlaad Sidkhiiya giddaamah fi Ribla wa battaan dabah kulla chuyuukh Yahuuza.
Wa baʼad da,hu gaddad uyuun Sidkhiiya wa janzarah be jinziir hana nahaas matbuug le yiwaddiih fi Baabil.
Wa l‑Baabiliyiin gammo harrago gasir al‑malik wa buyuut al‑chaʼab fi Madiinat al‑Khudus wa ramo durdurha.
Wa l‑chaʼab al‑faddalo fi l‑madiina wa l‑naas al‑andammo le malik Baabil wa l‑naas al‑aakhariin da,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas hana l‑malik karabaahum wa waddaahum fi l‑khurba fi Baabil.
Wa laakin chaʼab waahidiin masaakiin al‑ma yamulku ard,Nabuuzaradaan antaahum izin achaan yifaddulu fi balad Yahuuza.Wa fi l‑yoom da,hu gassam leehum jineenaat inab wa ziraaʼa.
Wa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil anta amur le Nabuuzaradaan kabiir hurraasah fi chaan Irmiya wa gaal :
 Chiil Irmiya da maʼaak wa fakkir foogah adiil.Ma tisawwi leyah ayyi cheyy fasil wa sawwi leyah al‑yidoorah. 
Wa khalaas,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas wa Nabuuchazbaan kabiir al‑masaaʼiil wa Nirgal Charaasar kabiir al‑khuyyaad wa kulla khuyyaad malik Baabil
rassalo jaabo Irmiya min fadaayit al‑hurraas wa antooh le Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan.Wa misil da,Gadaalya khalla Irmiya macha beetah wa gaʼad fi ust al‑chaʼab.
Wa wakit Irmiya lissaaʼ makruub fi fadaayit al‑hurraas,Allah hajja leyah wa gaal :
 Gumm wa amchi le Abdalmalik al‑Habachi wa guul leyah :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal :“Akiid ana nihaggig al‑kalaam al‑gultah didd al‑madiina di wa da le l‑charr ma le l‑kheer.Wa l‑yoom da,inta kula tichiifah.
Wa laakin fi l‑yoom da,ana ninajjiik wa inta ma yisallumuuk le l‑naas al‑inta takhaaf minhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa akiid ana ninajjiik.Inta ma tumuut fi l‑harib wa tiʼiich wa tabga farhaan achaan ligiit al‑haya wa da be sabab inta atwakkalt aleyi.”›  Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Irmiya anlaga mujanzar be janaaziir fi ust al‑masaajiin hana Madiinat al‑Khudus wa Yahuuza al‑yidooru yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba fi Baabil.Wa laakin Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas maragah min ust al‑masaajiin wa khallaah yamchi min al‑Raama.Wa baʼad da,Allah hajja le Irmiya.
Wa gabul ma yufuut min al‑Raama,Nabuuzaradaan gaal leyah : Allah Ilaahak bas kharrar al‑fasaala di didd al‑bakaan da.
Wa hassaʼ,Allah haggag kalaamah al‑gaalah achaan intu Bani Israaʼiil aznabtu wa gammeetu didd Allah wa ma simiʼtu kalaamah.Wa fi chaan da bas,kulla l‑cheyy da bigi.
Wa hassaʼ,daahu ana fakkeet minnak al‑janaaziir wa khalleetak.Kan inta tidoor tamchi maʼaayi fi Baabil,taʼaal ana nichiil masʼuuliiytak.Wa kan ma tidoor tamchi maʼaayi fi Baabil,khalaas amchi fi ayyi bakaan al‑tidoorah wa l‑yaʼajibak fi l‑balad di. 
Wa gabul Irmiya ma yurudd le Nabuuzaradaan,gaal leyah battaan : Gabbil amchi le Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan hu al‑haakim al‑khattaah malik Baabil fi hillaal balad Yahuuza.Agood fi ust al‑chaʼab aw amchi fi ayyi bakaan al‑yaʼajibak. Wa Nabuuzaradaan antaah zaad wa hadiiye wa khallaah macha.
Wa be misil da,Irmiya macha le Gadaalya fi Misfa wa gaʼad hinaak fi ust al‑chaʼab al‑faddalo fi l‑balad.
Wa fiyah rujaal waahidiin musallahiin min Bani Yahuuza gaaʼidiin fi l‑kadaade.Wa l‑rujaal dool wa kubaaraathum simʼo kadar malik Baabil khatta Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam haakim fi balad Yahuuza.Wa l‑malik ammanah al‑rujaal wa l‑awiin wa l‑iyaal wa l‑masaakiin al‑ma karaboohum wa waddoohum fi l‑khurba fi Baabil.
Wa l‑rujaal al‑musallahiin wa kubaaraathum dool jo le Gadaalya fi Misfa.Wa kubaaraathum hummanIsmaaʼiil wileed Natanyawa Yuuhanaan wa Yuunataan awlaad Gaarihwa Saraaya wileed Tanhuumatwa iyaal Ifaay min hillit Natuufawa Yazanya min hillit Maʼaaka.
Wa Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan hajja le l‑kubaaraat dool wa naashum wa gaal : Ma takhaafo min sultit al‑Baabiliyiin.Agoodu fi l‑balad wa akhdumu tihit sultit malik Baabil wa akiid da yabga leeku adiil.
Wa ana nagood hini fi Misfa wa nimassilku giddaam al‑Baabiliyiin al‑yaju leena.Wa intu kamaan takhdumu wa tagtaʼo al‑inab wa l‑fawaakih wa tiʼassuru dihin al‑zaytuun wa tudummuuh fi l‑makhaazin.Wa taskunu fi l‑hillaal al‑intu chiltuuhum fi wakt al‑harib. 
Wa kulla Bani Yahuuza al‑arrado wa macho fi Muwaab wa fi usut Bani Ammuun wa fi Adoom wa fi buldaan aakhariin simʼo kadar malik Baabil khalla waahidiin min Bani Yahuuza faddalo fi l‑balad.Wa khatta fooghum Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan haakim.
Wa be da,khalaas al‑naas al‑arrado gabbalo min al‑bakaanaat al‑muchattatiin fooghum.Wa jo fi balad Yahuuza fi Misfa le Gadaalya.Wa humman gataʼo al‑inab wa l‑fawaakih be katara.
Wa yoom waahid,jo le Gadaalya fi Misfa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al‑rujaal al‑musallahiin al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑kadaade.
Wa gaalo leyah : Inta ma indak khabar kadar Baʼaliis malik Bani Ammuun kallaf Ismaaʼiil wileed Natanya le yaktulak walla ? Wa laakin Gadaalya aba ma saddag kalaamhum.
Wa baʼad da,Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih macha battaan be achiir le Gadaalya fi Misfa.Wa gaal leyah : Antiini izin namchi naktul Ismaaʼiil wileed Natanya wa naadum yasmaʼ beyah ke ma fiih.Walla inta tidoor hu yaktulak ?Wa kan katalak,kulla Bani Yahuuza al‑taabʼiinak yichittu wa l‑faddalo minhum yabgo ma fiihum. 
Wa Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam radda le Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa gaal : Ma tisawwi misil da !Al‑inta gaaʼid tuguulah fi Ismaaʼiil,da kidib ma sahiih. 
Wa laakin fi l‑chahar al‑saabiʼ,Ismaaʼiil wileed Natanya wileed Alichamaʼ ja le Gadaalya fi Misfa.Wa Ismaaʼiil da hu min zurriiyit al‑mamlaka wa waahid min kubaaraat al‑malik.Hu ja maʼa achara rujaal wa akalo maʼa Gadaalya.
Wa baʼad da,Ismaaʼiil wa l‑rujaal al‑achara al‑maʼaayah gammo darabo Gadaalya be l‑seef wa katalooh.Wa misil da,humman katalo al‑naadum al‑malik Baabil khattaah haakim fi l‑balad.
Wa Ismaaʼiil katal battaan kulla l‑Yahuud al‑gaaʼidiin maʼa Gadaalya fi Misfa wa askar Baabil al‑gaaʼidiin hinaak.
Wa lahaddi l‑yoom al‑taani baʼad moot Gadaalya kula,ma fi naadum simiʼ cheyy.
Wa fi l‑wakit da,jo rujaal waahidiin adadhum 80.Wa l‑naas dool,duguunhum muzayyaniin wa khulgaanhum mucharratiin wa jisimhum munakhkhach min al‑hizin.Wa humman min mudun Chakiim wa Chiilooh wa l‑Saamira wa chaayliin fi iideehum hadaaya hana dagiig wa bakhuur le yigaddumuuh fi beet Allah.
Wa Ismaaʼiil marag min Misfa le yilaagiihum,maachi wa gaaʼid yabki.Wakit wassalaahum gaal leehum : Alfaddalo bakaan Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam. 
Wa wakit dakhalo fi l‑madiina,Ismaaʼiil wa l‑naas al‑maʼaayah gammo karaboohum wa dabahoohum wa zagaloohum fi nugra.
Wa laakin fi ust al‑rujaal dool fi achara minhum gaalo le Ismaaʼiil : Ma taktulna achaan aniina labbadna maʼaach katiir fi l‑kadaade,gameh ahmar wa gameh abyad wa dihin wa asal. Wa khalaas,hu ma katalaahum maʼa akhwaanhum.
Wa l‑nugra al‑Ismaaʼiil daffag foogah al‑jisas hana l‑naas al‑katalaahum fi bakaan Gadaalya,hi al‑nugra al‑zamaan nakatha Aasa malik mamlakat Yahuuza wakit hu gaaʼid yidaafiʼ le baladah didd Baʼaacha malik mamlakat Israaʼiil.Wa l‑nugra di,Ismaaʼiil malaaha be jisas al‑naas al‑hu katalaahum.
Wa baʼad da,Ismaaʼiil karab kulla l‑chaʼab al‑faddalo fi Misfa masaajiin wa humman banaat al‑malik wa kulla l‑naas al‑faddalo fi Misfa.Wa dool al‑naas al‑Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas ammanaahum le Gadaalya.Wa Ismaaʼiil karabaahum masaajiin wa macha beehum ale balad Bani Ammuun.
Wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al‑rujaal al‑musallahiin al‑maʼaayah simʼo be kulla l‑fasaala al‑sawwaaha Ismaaʼiil wileed Natanya.
Humman chaalo kulla rujaalhum wa macho yahjumu Ismaaʼiil wa lihgooh fi l‑machiiche al‑kabiire hint Gibʼuun.
Wa wakit kulla l‑chaʼab al‑karabaahum Ismaaʼiil chaafo Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kubaaraat al‑rujaal al‑musallahiin al‑maʼaayah,humman firho.
Wa khalaas,kulla l‑chaʼab al‑Ismaaʼiil karabaahum fi Misfa gabbalo wa jo lammo maʼa Yuuhanaan.
Wa laakin Ismaaʼiil wa l‑tamaane naas al‑maʼaayah nijo min Yuuhanaan wa macho le Bani Ammuun.
Wa Yuuhanaan wa kulla kubaaraat al‑rujaal al‑musallahiin al‑maʼaayah chaalo al‑chaʼab al‑faddalo al‑Ismaaʼiil karabaahum fi Misfa baʼad katal Gadaalya.Wa l‑chaʼab al‑gabbaloohum min Gibʼuun,humman askar wa awiin wa iyaal wa masaaʼiil gasir al‑malik.
Humman macho lahaddi beet al‑diifaan al‑fi Kimhaam gariib le Beet Laham.Wa min hinaak,yidooru yamchu le Masir
achaan yakhaafo min al‑Baabiliyiin be sabab Ismaaʼiil katal Gadaalya haakim al‑balad al‑khattaah malik Baabil.
Wa baʼad da,kulla kubaaraat al‑rujaal al‑musallahiin wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa Yazanya wileed Huchaaʼya wa kulla l‑chaʼab min al‑daʼiif lahaddi l‑gaadir jo
le l‑nabi Irmiya.Wa gaalo : Min fadlak,chahadnaak wa akhbal duʼaana.Asʼal Allah Ilaahak fi chaanna aniina al‑faddalna achaan nagasna bigiina chiyya misil inta gaaʼid tichiifah.
Wa khalli Allah Ilaahak yiwassif leena al‑bakaan al‑namchu leyah wa l‑cheyy al‑nisawwuuh. 
Wa Irmiya gaal leehum : Tamaam !Hassaʼ da,nasʼal Allah Ilaahku hasab intu gultuuh.Wa nihajjiiku be kulla l‑kalaam al‑yuruddah leeku Allah Ilaahku.Wa kalaamah da ma nilabbid minnah kilme waahide kula. 
Wa humman gaalo le Irmiya : Kulla cheyy al‑gaalah Allah Ilaahak,guulah leena wa aniina nitabbuguuh.Khalli Allah yukuun leena chaahid saadikh wa amiin.
Al‑kalaam da kan kheer aw charr kula aniina nitaabuʼuuh achaan da kalaam Allah Ilaahna al‑aniina kallafnaak tamchi tasʼalah.Wa wakit nasmaʼo kalaam Allah Ilaahna,da yabga leena adiil. 
Wa baʼad achara yoom,Allah hajja le Irmiya.
Wa khalaas,Irmiya naada Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al‑rujaal al‑musallahiin al‑maʼaayah wa kulla l‑chaʼab min al‑daʼiif lahaddi l‑gaadir.
Wa Irmiya gaal leehum : Intu kallaftuuni le namchi giddaam Allah wa nachhadah.Wa daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal :
‹ Kan battaan taskunu fi l‑balad di,ana nabniiku wa ma nakhribku wa nisabbitku foogha wa ma namrugku minha.Achaan ana hizint le l‑fasaala al‑sawweetha foogku.
Ma takhaafo min malik Baabil al‑intu khaayfiin minnah.Ma takhaafo minnah abadan achaan ana gaaʼid maʼaaku,nahmiiku wa ninajjiiku min iidah.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana ninazzil foogku al‑rahma wa fi chaan rahmati di,al‑malik kula yikhalliiku tagoodu fi baladku.› 
Wa Irmiya gaal battaan : Akuun tuguulu :‹ Aniina ma naskunu fi l‑balad di !› Wa misil da,intu ma gaaʼidiin tasmaʼo kalaam Allah Ilaahku.
Wa akuun tuguulu :‹ La !Aniina namchu Masir wa hinaak wa la nichiifu harib wa la nasmaʼo hiss burunji wa la yigassir leena akil.Wa da bas al‑bakaan al‑aniina naskunu foogah. ›
Ya intu al‑faddaltu min Bani Yahuuza,asmaʼo kalaam Allah !Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal :‹ Kan wajjahtu ale Masir le tamchu taskunu foogha,
khalaas al‑harib al‑khuftu minnah yalhagku hinaak wa l‑juuʼ al‑hammeetu minnah yawsalku hinaak wa fi Masir bas tumuutu.
Kulla l‑naas al‑wajjaho ale Masir le yamchu yaskunu foogha da yumuutu be l‑harib wa l‑juuʼ wa l‑waba.Wa waahid minhum kula ma yifaddil hayy min al‑fasaala al‑ninazzilha fooghum. ›
Achaan daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal :‹ Misil ana nazzalt khadabi wa zaʼali fi sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus,daahu ana ninazzil khadabi foogku intu kula wakit tadkhulu fi balad Masir.Wa intu tabgo malʼuuniin wa mukhiifiin wa naas yalʼanooku wa yiʼayyubuuku wa battaan baladku ma tichiifuuha.› 
Wa Irmiya gaal : Ya l‑faddaltu min Bani Yahuuza !Daahu Allah gaal leeku :‹ Ma tamchu balad Masir.› Wa aʼarfu tamaam kadar al‑yoom,ana Irmiya bas chaahid foogku.
Wa daahu intu bas waddartu nufuusku wakit kallaftuuni namchi le Allah Ilaahku wa gultu :‹ Asʼal leena Allah Ilaahna.Wa kulla cheyy al‑gaalah Allah Ilaahna,guulah leena wa aniina nitabbuguuh. ›
Wa daahu al‑yoom,ana gult al‑kalaam al‑hu raddah leeku.Wa laakin intu ma simiʼtu kalaam Allah Ilaahku wa la kulla l‑kalaam al‑kallafaani le nuguulah leeku.
Wa be sabab da,aʼarfu tamaam kadar intu tumuutu be l‑harib wa l‑juuʼ wa l‑waba fi l‑bakaan al‑intu dawwartu tamchu taskunu foogah. 
Wa Irmiya kammal min kalaamah le kulla l‑chaʼab wa da kulla kalaam Allah Ilaahhum al‑kallafah le yuguulah leehum.
Wa Azarya wileed Huchaaʼya wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla l‑rujaal al‑mustakbiriin dool gaalo le Irmiya : Kalaamak da kidib !Ma sahiih.Wa Allah Ilaahna kula ma kallafaak le tuguul leena ma namchu Masir le naskunu hinaak.
Wa laakin da Baruuk wileed Nariiya bas gaaʼid yiharrichak le tisawwi leena al‑fasaala wa tisallimna le l‑Baabiliyiin.Wa humman yaktuluuna aw yiwadduuna fi l‑khurba fi Baabil. 
Wa khalaas,Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al‑rujaal al‑musallahiin wa kulla l‑chaʼab ma simʼo amur Allah al‑gaal yaskunu fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa Yuuhanaan wileed Gaarih wa kulla kubaaraat al‑rujaal al‑musallahiin chaalo kulla l‑faddalo min Bani Yahuuza al‑gabbalo min al‑buldaan al‑humman muchattatiin fooghum wa saakniin fi balad Yahuuza.
Wa chaalo battaan al‑rujaal wa l‑awiin wa l‑iyaal wa banaat al‑malik wa kulla l‑naas al‑Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas ammanaahum le Gadaalya wileed Akhigaam wileed Chaafaan.Wa chaalo maʼaahum battaan al‑nabi Irmiya wa Baruuk wileed Nariiya.
Al‑naas dool macho le hillit Tahfaniis fi Masir achaan humman ma simʼo kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja le Irmiya fi hillit Tahfaniis wa gaal :
 Amchi chiil hujaar itneen kubaar wa adfinhum fi l‑fadaay giddaam madkhal gasir Firʼoon fi Tahfaniis.Wa l‑hujaar dool adfinhum giddaam Bani Yahuuza.
Wa guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal :“Ana nirassil nijiib abdi Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa nukhutt kursiih hana l‑muluk fi l‑hujaar al‑mulabbadiin dool.Wa hu yukhutt dallaaltah fi l‑bakaan da.
Wa hu yaji yihaarib balad Masir.Wa l‑waajib leyah al‑moot,yaktuluuh wa l‑waajib leyah al‑ubuudiiye,yiʼabbuduuh wa l‑waajib leyah daribiin al‑seef,yadurbuuh.
Wa ana nahrig buyuut al‑ilaahaat fi Masir be iid Nabuukhadnasar wa hu yahrig al‑asnaam aw yiwaddiihum masaajiin.Wa hu yanhab balad Masir wa yilaggit khumaamha misil al‑raaʼi yilaggit al‑gamul min khalagah.Wa baʼad da,yamrug minha be l‑salaam.
Hu yarmi al‑amad al‑khazzoohum fi beet ibaadat al‑harraay fi Masir wa yahrig buyuut ilaahaat Masir.”› 
Allah hajja le Irmiya kalaam bukhuss Bani Yahuuza al‑saakniin fi Migduul wa Tahfaniis wa Mamfiis wa fi junuub Masir.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal : Intu chiftu kulla l‑fasaala al‑jibtaha fi Madiinat al‑Khudus wa fi kulla hillaal balad Yahuuza.Lahaddi l‑yoom,al‑mudun dool kharbaaniin wa ma induhum sukkaan.
Wa da be sabab al‑fasaala al‑humman sawwooha.Khaddabooni wakit harrago bakhuur wa abado ilaahaat aakhariin al‑awwal ma yaʼarfuuhum wa la humman wa la intu wa la juduudku.
Ana rassalt leehum daayman abiidi al‑anbiya wa be waasitat al‑anbiya dool ana gult leehum :‹ Ma tisawwu al‑haraam da achaan ana nakrahah. ›
Wa laakin humman ma khatto adaanhum wa ma simʼooni wa ma taabo min al‑fasaala al‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuha.Wa ma waggafo harrigiin al‑bakhuur le l‑ilaahaat al‑aakhariin.
Wa be sabab da bas,khadabi wa zaʼali gammo didduhum wa harrago hillaal balad Yahuuza wa chawaariʼ Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa bigo koom hana turaab wa bakaan kharaab lahaddi l‑yoom. 
Daahu Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal : Maala tisawwu le nufuusku fasaala kabiire misil di ?Wa maala tidooru tidammuru al‑rujaal wa l‑awiin wa l‑iyaal wa l‑atfaal ?Wa be misil da,waahid kula min Bani Yahuuza ma yifaddil leeku.
Wa khaddabtuuni be khidmit iideeku wakit harragtu bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin fi balad Masir al‑intu jiitu wa sakantu foogha.Wa be da,dammartu nufuusku wa bigiitu malʼuuniin wa aaybiin fi ust kulla umam al‑ard.
Wa intu nisiitu al‑fasaala al‑sawwooha juduudku wa muluuk Yahuuza wa awiinhum ?Wa nisiitu fasaalitku intu wa awiinku al‑sawweetuuha fi balad Yahuuza wa fi chawaariʼ Madiinat al‑Khudus ?
Wa lahaddi l‑yoom intu ma tubtu wa la khuftu minni wa la tabbagtu churuuti al‑fi l‑Tawraat wa la gawaaniini al‑ana anteethum leeku wa le juduudku. 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal : Akiid ana kharrart nisawwi leeku al‑fasaala wa nidammir kulla Bani Yahuuza.
Wa nichiil al‑faddalo min Bani Yahuuza,humman al‑wajjaho ale balad Masir wa macho le yaskunu foogha.Humman dool kulluhum ana nikammilhum fi Masir.Yumuutu be l‑harib wa l‑juuʼ wa yikammulu tak min al‑daʼiif lahaddi l‑gaadir.Wa yabgo malʼuuniin wa mukhiifiin wa l‑naas yalʼanoohum wa yiʼayyubuuhum.
Ana niʼaakhib al‑naas al‑yaskunu fi Masir misil aakhabt sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus be l‑harib wa l‑juuʼ wa l‑waba.
Wa l‑faddalo min Bani Yahuuza,naadum waahid kula minhum ma yifaddil hayy.Wa dool al‑naas al‑macho sakano fi balad Masir wa induhum niiye le yigabbulu fi balad Yahuuza.Wa laakin ma yigabbulu leeha illa waahidiin minhum al‑arrado. 
Wa kulla l‑chaʼab al‑yaskunu fi junuub Masir lammo wa fiihum awiin katiiraat wa rujaal al‑yaʼarfu kadar awiinhum gaaʼidaat yiharrigan bakhuur le ilaahaat aakhariin.Wa l‑naas dool gaalo le Irmiya :
 Aniina ma nidooru nasmaʼo al‑kalaam al‑inta gaaʼid tuguulah leena be usum Allah.
Wa akiid aniina nitabbugu kulla l‑kalaam al‑marag min khachumna.Wa niharrugu bakhuur wa nigaddumu hadiiyat charaab le ilaahna malikat al‑sama misil awwal aniina sawweenaah,aniina wa juduudna wa muluukna wa kubaaraatna fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa fi chawaariʼ Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa khalaas fi l‑wakit daak,aniina chibiʼna wa ichna fi l‑raaha wa abadan ma chifna taʼab.
Wa laakin min waggafna harrigiin al‑bakhuur wa gaddimiin hadiiyat al‑charaab le malikat al‑sama,khalaas kulla cheyy bigi ma fiih wa aniina mutna min al‑harib wa l‑juuʼ. 
Wa l‑awiin gaalan : Wakit aniina niharrugu bakhuur wa nigaddumu hadiiyat charaab le malikat al‑sama,da ma be izin rujaalna walla ?Wa ma be izin rujaalna gaaʼidiin nisawwu kaʼak fi suuritha wa nigaddumu leeha hadiiyat charaab walla ? 
Wa khalaas,Irmiya hajja le kulla l‑chaʼab,awiin wa rujaal,al‑raddo leyah be l‑kalaam da wa gaal :
 Al‑bakhuur al‑awwal intu harragtuuh fi hillaal balad Yahuuza wa fi chawaariʼ Madiinat al‑Khudus,intu wa juduudku wa muluukku wa kubaaraatku wa chaʼab al‑balad,tahsubu Allah ma chaafah wa ma fakkar foogah walla ?
Allah aba ma yahmalah battaan be sabab amalku al‑fasil wa l‑muharramaat al‑sawweetuuhum.Wa fi chaan da,baladku bigat koom hana turaab wa kharaab wa malʼuun wa faadiye min sukkaanha lahaddi l‑yoom.
Wa intu harragtu bakhuur wa aznabtu.Wa ma simiʼtu kalaam Allah wa la tabbagtu churuutah al‑fi l‑Tawraat wa la gawaaniinah wa la wasiiyaatah.Wa fi chaan da bas,al‑fasaala di jaat misil intu gaaʼidiin tichiifuuha al‑yoom. 
Wa battaan Irmiya gaal le kulla l‑chaʼab wa le kulla l‑awiin : Intu kulluku Bani Yahuuza al‑gaaʼidiin fi Masir,asmaʼo kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal :‹ Intu wa awiinku sawweetu be iideeku kulla l‑kalaam al‑gultuuh be khachumku.Wa daahu al‑kalaam al‑gultuuh :“Aniina nihaggugu nazirna al‑aahadna beyah wa niharrugu bakhuur wa nigaddumu hadiiyat charaab le malikat al‑sama.”Khalaas,timmu kalaamku wa haggugu nazirku !› 
Wa Irmiya gaal : Hassaʼ da,intu kulluku,ya Bani Yahuuza al‑gaaʼidiin fi balad Masir,asmaʼo kalaam Allah !Allah gaal :‹ Nahlif be usmi al‑aziim kadar battaan fi Masir naadum min Bani Yahuuza abadan ma yahlif be usmi ana Allah al‑Rabb al‑Hayy.
Daahu ana niraakhibhum ma le kheerhum wa laakin le charruhum.Kulla naas Bani Yahuuza al‑gaaʼidiin fi Masir,ana nijiib fooghum al‑harib wa l‑juuʼ lahaddi nikammilhum.
Wa naas chiyya bas yiʼarrudu min Masir fi chaan al‑harib wa yamchu le balad Yahuuza.Wa laakin kulla l‑faddalo min Bani Yahuuza al‑jo fi Masir le yaskunu foogha yichiifu wa yaʼarfu al‑kalaam al‑yilhaggag,da hanaayi ana walla hanaahum humman. ›
Wa daahu kalaam Allah :‹ Ana niʼaakhibku fi l‑bakaan da wa nantiiku alaama wa be da,akiid taʼarfu kadar kalaami yilhaggag foogku wa tatʼabo.Wa di hi al‑alaama al‑nantiiha leeku. ›
Wa daahu Allah gaal :‹ Ana nisallim Firʼoon Hufraʼ malik Masir le udwaanah al‑yidooru mootah misil sallamt Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil aduuh al‑dawwar mootah.› 
Wa fi l‑sana al‑raabʼe hana hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,Baruuk wileed Nariiya katab fi l‑kitaab al‑malfuuf al‑kalaam al‑gaalah leyah al‑nabi Irmiya.Wa Irmiya hajja leyah wa gaal :
 Ya Baruuk !Daahu Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal foogak :
‹ Inta gult :“Ya khasaarti !Allah zaad leyi hizin fi taʼabi.Iyiit min al‑ganitiin wa ma ligiit raaha.” ›
 Daahu kalaam Allah al‑hajjaah leyi le nuguulah leek.Hu gaal :‹ Ana nakhrib al‑baneetahwa namrug al‑sabbattah.Wa da nisawwiihfi kulla l‑ard.
Wa inta illa tifattich le nafsak faayde kabiire bas !Khalaas,battaan ma tifattich !Achaan daahu ana nijiib al‑fasaalafi kulla makhluug hayy.Wa laakin leek inta,nantiik hayaatakwa tafrah beehafi ayyi bakaan al‑tamchi.› Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah hajja le l‑nabi Irmiya kalaam bukhuss al‑umam.
Wa fi l‑sana al‑raabʼe hana hukum Yahuuyakhim wileed Yuuchiiya malik Yahuuza,al‑deech da gaaʼid fi Karkamiich fi bahar al‑Furaat wa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil haarabah wa annasar foogah.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑bukhuss Masir wa deech Firʼoon Naku malik Masir.Hu gaal :
 Jahhuzu al‑darag kubaar wa dugaagwa yalla le l‑harib !
Chiddu al‑kheel !Wa arkabo,ya l‑furraas !Wa dissu tawaagiiku hana l‑haribwa jahhuzu huraabkuwa albaso duruuʼku. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Maala ana chiftuhum yarjufu ?Humman gabbalo wara wa furraashum anhazamo.Humman arrado,arrado bala gabbiliinwa l‑khoof jaahum min kulla bakaan. 
Al‑ajiil ma yinajji nafsahwa l‑faaris kula ma yanja.Wa fi l‑munchaakh fi khachum bahar al‑Furaat,humman yittartaʼo wa yagaʼo.
Wa yaatu al‑yatlaʼ misil al‑Niil ?Wa yaatu al‑yatraʼ misil al‑buhuur ?
Di Masir tatlaʼ misil al‑Niilwa tatraʼ misil al‑buhuur.Hi tuguul : Ana natlaʼ wa nikhatti al‑ardwa nidammir mudun be sukkaanhum.
Gummu wa ajru,ya l‑kheel !Ya siyaad arabaat al‑harib,suugu misil majaaniin !Amurgu,ya furraas al‑Habacha wa Liibiya al‑chaayliin al‑daragwa furraas Luud al‑yaʼarfu al‑nubbaal. 
Wa laakin al‑yoom,da yoom Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadirwa da yoom kaffiin al‑taar,yoom yichiil al‑taar fi udwaanah.Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑seef yaakul wa yachbaʼ lahamwa yachrab wa yarwa damm.Achaan da dahiiye le Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadirfi balad al‑munchaakh ale bahar al‑Furaat.
Ya Masir al‑misil bineeye udriiye !Yalla gummi amchi le turaab Gilʼaadwa fattichi dawa al‑tamsahe.Wa kan tichiili dawa misil chunu kulama fi dawa al‑yidaawiiki.
Wa l‑umam yasmaʼo be chamaatitkiwa siraakhki yamla al‑ard.Achaan askarki al‑waahid yittartaʼ fi l‑aakharwa yagaʼo humman al‑itneen sawa.
Wa wakit Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja yihaarib balad Masir,daahu kalaam Allah al‑gaalah le l‑nabi Irmiya :
 Khabburu balad Masirwa khalli hillaalha yasmaʼowa humman Migduul wa Mamfiis wa Tahfaniis.Wa guulu leehum :‹ Gummu wa jahhuzu nufuuskuachaan al‑seef gaaʼid yaktul hawaaleeku !
Maala ilaahki wagaʼ,ya Masir ?Maala ilaahki hana l‑toor ma gidir yasbit ?Wa da,achaan Allah ramaah.
Wa Allah tartaʼ katiir minhum wa wagaʼowa l‑murtazakha gaalo ambeenaathum :“Yalla nugummu wa nigabbulu le ahalnawa namchu le baladna al‑wildoona fooghawa niʼarrudu baʼiid min seef al‑adu.”
Wa yinaadu Firʼoon malik Masirbe usum jadiidwa l‑usum da Haraka Kabiire Saakitwa Khalla al‑Fursa Faatat.› 
Wa daahu kalaam al‑malik wa hu Allah al‑Gaadir : Ana nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy !Al‑adu jaayi.Hu tawiil misil jabal Taabuur fi ust al‑jibaalwa kabiir misil jabal al‑Karmal fi khachum al‑bahar.
Ya sukkaan Masir al‑misil bineeye,tabbugu khumaamku le yiwadduuku fi l‑khurba.Achaan hillit Mamfiis takhrabwa kharaabha yikhawwifwa tabga faadiye min sukkaanha.
Wa Masir hi misil al‑ijle al‑samhewa l‑adu yajiiha min munchaakhmisil dubbaan amboojani.
Wa murtazakhatha gaaʼidiin fi usuthamisil al‑ajjaal al‑sumaan.Wa laakin be sumunhum da kula,yiʼarrudu ma yasbutu.Achaan yoom al‑kharaab ja leehumwa wakit ikhaabhum wagaʼ fooghum.
Wa Masir tisaffirmisil al‑daabi al‑muʼarridachaan al‑adu jaayi diddahabe deech kabiir.Wa jaayi foogha be faasmisil gattaaʼiin al‑chadar.
Wa udwaanha yagtaʼo khaabithahatta kan hi dalma kula.Achaan humman katiiriin min saar al‑leelwa abadan ma yinhasbu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Masir al‑misil bineeye yiʼayyubuuhawa yisallumuuha le chaʼab al‑munchaakh. 
Wa Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal : Akiid ana niʼaakhib Ammuun ilaah Tiiba.Wa niʼaakhib Masir wa ilaahaatha wa muluukha.Wa niʼaakhib Firʼoon wa l‑yitwakkalo aleyah.
Ana nisallimhum le l‑yidooru moothum,le Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil wa askarah.Wa laakin baʼadeen yaji wakit al‑foogah Masir yaskunuuha misil zamaan. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa intu,ya zurriiyit abdi Yaakhuub,ma takhaafo !Wa ya Bani Israaʼiil,ma tinbahtu !Akiid ana ninajjiiku min al‑balad al‑baʼiidewa nijiib zurriiyitku min balad al‑khurba.Wa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yajuwa yagoodu fi baladhum be raaha wa amaanwa akiid ma fi naadum yibachtinhum.
Wa intu,ya zurriiyit abdi Yaakhuub,ma takhaafoachaan ana daayman nukuun maʼaaku.Wa ana nidammir marra waahid kulla l‑umamal‑ana chattattuku fi lubbuhum.Wa laakin intu,ma nidammirku marra waahid.Akiid ma najʼalku bariyiinwa laakin niʼaddibku be miiz. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah hajja le l‑nabi Irmiya kalaam bukhuss al‑Filistiyiin wa da gabul Firʼoon ma yahjim madiinat Khazza.
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Chiifu,fi almi yugumm min munchaakhwa l‑almi da yabga misil waadi al‑yisiil.Wa l‑seel yaakul al‑baladwa kulla cheyy al‑fiihawa l‑mudun wa sukkaanhum.Wa l‑naas yikoorukuwa kulla sukkaan al‑balad yasrakho.
Wa min yasmaʼo chiddit harakat rijle al‑kheelwa harakat arabaathum hana harib wa ajalaathum,al‑abbahaat yiʼarrudu yikhallu iyaalhumwa da min chiddit al‑khoof.
Yoom kharaab kulla l‑Filistiyiin jawa da le yidammir ayyi naadumal‑yafzaʼ mudun Suur wa Seeda.Achaan ana Allah nidammir kulla l‑Filistiyiin,humman al‑faddalo min jaziirat Kaftuur.
Naas mudun Khazza zayyano ruuseehum min al‑hizinwa sukkaan Achgaluun kula sakato.Wa intu al‑faddaltu fi l‑sahale,le mata tahzano wa tijarruhu jisimku ?
Intu tuguulu :‹ Ya khasaaritna !Ya seef Allah !Lahaddi mata taktul ma tinjamma ?Adkhul fi beetakwa anjamma ma taktul ! ›
Kikkeef al‑seef da yinjammakan ana Allah bas amartahle yamchi didd sukkaan Achgaluunwa le yaktul sukkaan khachum al‑bahar ? 
Kalaam bukhuss Muwaab.Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal : Ya khasaarit hillit Nabuachaan hi addammarat !Wa hillit Khiryataayim aaybe wa makruubawa l‑hille al‑gawiiye kula aaybe wa mubarjala.
Wa Muwaab battaan ma tukuun balad maʼruufawa didd madiinat Hachbuun,khattato al‑fasaala.Wa gaalo :‹ Yalla namchu !Nuguchchuuha min ust al‑umam. ›Wa inti kula,ya hillit Madmiin,yisakkutuukiwa l‑seef yajri waraaki.
Wa fi hillit Hurunaayim,hiss yasrakh wa yuguul :‹ Damaarwa kharaab kabiir marra waahid ! ›
Muwaab tilkassarwa iyaalha korooraakhum yinsamiʼ.
Achaan be baki,al‑iyaal yatlaʼowa fi taluuʼ Luhiit yabku.Wa wakit yanzulu le hillit Hurunaayim,humman yasrakho min al‑damaarwa yuguulu :
‹ Arrudu wa najju nufuuskuwa abgo misil humaar al‑kadaade ! ›
Ya Muwaab !Inti atwakkaltifi aʼmaalki wa fi khunaakiwa fi chaan da,inti kula tinkarbi.Wa sanamki Kamuuch yiwadduuh fi l‑khurbamaʼa rujaal al‑diin hineeyah wa khaddaamiinah.
Al‑mudammir yadkhul fi kulli hille,ma fi hille tanja minnah.Al‑waadi yiddammar wa l‑sahale takhrabachaan ana Allah bas gultah.
Antuuha le Muwaab janaahele titiir wa tibaʼʼid.Achaan mudunha yakhrabowa yabgo faadiyiin min sukkaanhum.
Malʼuun al‑yisawwi amal Allah be kasalwa malʼuun al‑yamnaʼ seefah min al‑damm. 
 Muwaab gaaʼide fi l‑raaha min subaahamisil al‑khamar al‑gaaʼid fi rindiihwa ma sabbooh fi maaʼuun aakhar.Hi ma waddooha fi l‑khurba.Hi misil al‑khamar al‑taʼamah ma waddarwa riihtah ma albaddalat. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Misil da,yaji yoom waahid al‑foogah ana nirassil naas yusubbuuh fi girab aakhariin wa yifaddu girabbah wa yicharrutuuhum.
Wa fi l‑wakit daak,Muwaab takhjal min sanamha Kamuuch misil Bani Israaʼiil khijlo min sanamhum al‑fi Beet Iil al‑awwal humman aamano beyah. 
 Ya naas Muwaab,kikkeef tagdaro tuguulu :‹ Aniina rujaal fahaliinwa furraas hana harib ? ›
Muwaab takhrab wa hillaalha yahragowa chabaabha al‑adiiliin yaktuluuhum.Wa da kalaam al‑malik wa hu Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa kharaab Muwaab garrab yajiwa fasaalitha jaaye be surʼa.
Wa intu kulluku al‑muhawwigiin Muwaab,abku leeha.Intu kulluku al‑taʼarfuuha,asʼalo wa guulu :‹ Da kikkeef !Asaat gudritha anchaggatwa asaat majdaha alkassarat ? ›
Ya sukkaan hillit Diibuunal‑misil bineeye !Anzulu min charafkuwa duukhu al‑atach.Achaan mudammir Muwaab yahjimku intu kulawa yidammir bakaanaatku al‑gawiyiin.
Wa ya sukkaan hillit Aruuʼir !Agiifu fi l‑tariig wa raakhubu.Wa asʼalo al‑jaariyiin wa l‑muʼarridiinwa guulu :‹ Chunu al‑hasal ? ›
Wa yuruddu wa yuguulu :‹ Muwaab addammarat wa ligat al‑eeb. ›Asrakho wa kooruku wa khabburu waadi Arnuunkadar Muwaab khalaas addammarat. 
Al‑muhaakama jaat fi balad al‑sahale wa jaat fi hillaal Huluun wa Yahaas wa Mifaʼat
wa fi Diibuun wa Nabu wa Beet Diblataayim
wa fi Khiryataayim wa Beet Gamuul wa Beet Maaʼoon
wa fi Kharyuut wa Busra wa fi kulla hillaal balad Muwaab al‑gariibiin wa l‑baʼiidiin.
 Wa garin Muwaab wagaʼwa gudritha waddarat.Wa duraaʼha ankasarwa kalaamha kammal. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Sakkuru Muwaab lahaddi tilmarmakh fi gadiifha wa tabga madhaka achaan hi sawwat nafisha aaliye min Allah.
Wa inti,ya Muwaab,ma dihikti le Bani Israaʼiil walla ?Hal ligiiti Bani Israaʼiil maʼa l‑saraariig walla ?Wa kan la !Maala kulla wakit tihajji beehum wa tihizzi raaski ?
Ya sukkaan Muwaab !Amurgu min al‑mudunwa askunu fi l‑jibaal.Abgo misil al‑hamaamaal‑tisawwi uchchaha fi khachum al‑karkuur.
Aniina simiʼna be istikbaar Muwaab,balad mustakbire misilha ke ma fi.Wa simiʼna battaan hi titkabbar wa tistakbarwa hi tikoolif wa tifaachir.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Ana naʼarif kadar hi tarfaʼ raashawa laakin hi tifaachir saakit fi l‑riihwa kuluufiiyitha kula bala faayde. 
Wa fi chaan da,ana nabkiwa nunuuh le Muwaab kullahawa nagnit fi chaan naas Khiir Haaras.
Ya jineenit al‑inab hana Sibma,nabki leeki ziyaada min bakiiyi le Yaʼziir.Wa furuuʼki faato al‑baharwa lihgo bahar Yaʼziir.Wa laakin al‑mukharrib gamma yagtaʼ inabkiwa yilaggit kichcheebki.
Wa l‑farah wa l‑suruur bigo ma fiihumfi balad Muwaab al‑khadra.Ana waggaft al‑khamar,ma yamrug min al‑assaara.Battaan ma yaʼasuru al‑inabwa yifajjukhuuh be ragraagwa zakhraat al‑farahma yinsamiʼ battaan.
Wa korooraak al‑fazaʼ min madiinat Hachbuun yinsamiʼ lahaddi fi Aliʼaala wa lahaddi fi Yahaas.Wa yinsamiʼ min Suukhar lahaddi Hurunaayim wa lahaddi Aglat Chaliicha.Hatta uyuun almi hana Nimriim kula yaybaso.
 Ana nidammir fi Muwaab al‑naas al‑yigaddumu dahaaya fi l‑bakaan al‑aali wa yiharrugu bakhuur le ilaahaathum. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa battaan galbi yahzan wa yunuuh misil al‑suffaara le Muwaab wa le naas Khiir Haaras achaan al‑khuna al‑lammooha waddarat.
Wa be da,hizno wa zayyano ruuseehum wa gattaʼo duguunhum wa jarraho iideehum wa libso khulgaan al‑hizin.
Wa fi ruuse kulla buyuut Muwaab wa fi kulla chawaariʼha ma fi cheyy aakhar illa l‑nuwaah. Ana kassart Muwaab misil jarr al‑ma yanfaʼ. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Da kikkeef Muwaab addammarat !Iitu wa guulu : Chiifu !Muwaab dangarat raasha min al‑eeb.Wa hi bigat madhaka wa mukhiife le kulla l‑jiiraanha al‑muhawwigiinha. 
Achaan daahu Allah gaal : Aywa !Al‑adu yinrakhi fi Muwaab misil sagural‑jahhaz janaahe le yadrubha.
Hillit Kharyuut yichiiluuhawa bakaanaatha al‑gawiyiin yakurbuuhum.Wa fi l‑yoom da,galib askar Muwaabyabga misil galib al‑mara al‑gaaʼide titaalig.
Wa Muwaab takhrab,ma tabga chaʼabachaan hi sawwat nafishaaaliye min Allah.
Ya sukkaan Muwaab !Al‑khoof wa l‑nugra wa l‑charakyukuunu fi lubbuku.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l‑yiʼarrid min al‑khoofyagaʼ fi l‑nugrawa l‑yidoor yamrug min al‑nugra,al‑charak yakurbah.Achaan da kulla ana bas jibtah fi Muwaab,fi sanit ikhaabha.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l‑yiʼarrudu ma induhum gudrawa yidooru yinjammo fi dull madiinat Hachbuun.Laakin min Hachbuun tamrug naarwa min balad Siihuun,ambalbaala.Wa tahrig Muwaab balad al‑unufmin tarafha lahaddi usutha.
Al‑azaab leeku,ya naas Muwaab !Ya intu chaʼab sanam Kamuuch,tiwadduru.Achaan subyaanku wa banaatkuyakurbuuhum wa yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba.
Wa laakin fi l‑akhiir,nigabbil naas Muwaabal‑waddoohum fi l‑khurba. Wa da kalaam Allah.Wa khalaas,hini bas kammalat muhaakamat Allah le Muwaab.
Kalaam bukhuss Bani Ammuun.Daahu Allah gaal : Israaʼiil ma indah wileed walla ?Hu ma indah wariis walla ?Maala sanam Muulakwaras turaab Gaad ?Wa maala hu sakkan chaʼabahfi mudunha ?
Fi chaan da,yaji yoom waahidal‑foogah ana nijiib korooraak al‑hujuumfi Rabba madiinat Bani Ammuun.Wa da kalaam Allah.Hi takhrab wa tabga koom hana turaabwa l‑hillaal al‑taabʼiin leeha yahrago be naar.Wa fi l‑bakaan da,Bani Israaʼiil yaglaʼomin al‑udwaan al‑galaʼo minhum.Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Ya naas madiinat Hachbuun,ahzano achaan hillit Aay addammarat !Ya sukkaan hillaal Rabba,abku !Albaso khulgaan al‑hizin wa nuuhu !Wa ajru jaay wa jaay fi lubb al‑durdur.Achaan sanamku Muulak yiwadduuh fi l‑khurbamaʼa rujaal al‑diin hineeyah wa khaddaamiinah.
Ya balad Ammuun,maala tafrahe be wudyaanki,wudyaanki al‑yigawwumu intaaj katiir,ya l‑bineeye al‑kaafre !Inti tukhutti amaanki fi khunaakiwa tuguuli :‹ Yaatu yugumm diddi ? ›
Akiid nijiib foogki khoof,al‑yajiiki min kulla bakaan.Wa natrud ayyi waahid beyahwa ma fi naadum al‑yagdar yilimm al‑muʼarridiin.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir.
Wa laakin baʼad da,ana nigabbil Bani Ammuun min al‑khurba. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Kalaam bukhuss balad Adoom.Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Ma fi hikma fi Teemaan walla ?Wa wasiiyat al‑faahimiin waddarat walla ?Wa hikmithum ma tanfaʼ battaan walla ?
Ya sukkaan hillit Dadaan,gabbulu wa arruduwa allabbado fi l‑karaakiir.Achaan ana nijiib al‑kharaab fi Adoom zurriiyit Isuuwakit niʼaakhibhum.
Wa kan gattaaʼiin al‑inab yaju leeku,ma yikhallu waraahum al‑kichcheeb walla ?Wa kan saraariig yaju be leel,ma yichiilu al‑yakfiihum bas walla ?
Wa laakin ana bas niʼarri zurriiyit Isuuwa nakchif sirruhumwa humman ma yagdaro yillabbado.Zurriiytah wa akhwaanah wa jiiraanah,nisallimhum le l‑kharaab.Wa ma yifaddil naadum al‑yuguul :
‹ Khallu leyi ataamaaku nirabbiihumwa khalli araamilku yintaklan aleyi.› 
Achaan daahu Allah gaal : Chiifu,al‑naas al‑ma hakamo leehum be charaab kaas al‑ikhaab,humman chirbooh.Wa intu,ya naas Adoom,najʼalku bariyiin walla ?La !Akiid intu kula tacharbo min al‑kaas da.
Achaan ana nahlif be nafsi,hillit Busra tabga kharaab wa bakaan muhaddam wa yiʼayyubuuha wa yalʼanooha.Wa kulla hillaalha yabgo koom hana turaab ila l‑abad. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Simiʼt khabar jaayi min Allah.Hu rassal rasuul been al‑umam al‑yuguul : Intu kulluku limmu sawa wa taʼaalugummu haarubu balad Adoom. 
 Ya balad Adoom !Daahu ana nisawwiiki umma sakhayre fi ust al‑umamwa kulla l‑naas yahguruuki.
Wa l‑khoof al‑sawweeti le l‑aakhariin,khachchaakiwa istikbaarki kula,ammalki.Ya inti al‑gaaʼide fi karaakiir al‑hujaarwa saakne foog fi l‑jibaal,kan baneeti uchchiki foog min uchch al‑sagur kula,ana ninazzilki. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Adoom takhrab wa ayyi naadum al‑yufuut jambaha yilʼajjab wa yisaffir min al‑damaar al‑foogha.
Wa Allah gaal : Da misil Saduum wa Amuura wa l‑hillaal al‑mujaawiriinhum wakit ana dammartuhum.Wa ma fi naadum yaskun hini fi balad Adoom wa la insaan yagood foogha. 
 Wa misil duud al‑yamrug min khaabat al‑Urdunle yahjim khanam fi marʼa akhdar,ana Allah kula nugumm natrud naas Adoom be khaflawa nisabbit foogha al‑naadum al‑ana azaltah.Yaatu al‑misli ana ?Wa yaatu al‑yagdar yantiini amur ?Wa yaatu al‑malikal‑yagdar yugumm diddi ? 
Wa fi chaan da,asmaʼo al‑kharaaral‑kharrarah Allah didd Adoomwa asmaʼo al‑niiyeal‑chaalha Allah didd sukkaan Teemaan.Akiid yiwaddiihum misil iyaal al‑khanamwa akiid yakhrib marʼaahum.
Wa min harakat wagaʼaanhum,al‑ard tarjifwa siraakhhum yinsamiʼlahaddi fi l‑bahar al‑Ahmar.
Al‑adu yinrakhi fi Busra misil sagur al‑jahhaz janaaheeh le yadrubha.Wa fi l‑yoom da,galib askar Adoom yabga misil galib al‑mara al‑gaaʼide titaalig.
Kalaam bukhuss madiinat Dimachkh. Hillaal Hamaat wa Arfad hammoachaan simʼo khabar cheen.Humman barjalo wa rajafomisil al‑bahar al‑almiih ma haadi.
Wa sukkaan Dimachkh diʼfowa gabbalo le yiʼarruduwa l‑bahiite karabathum.Wa l‑diige wa l‑wajaʼ karaboohummisil al‑mara al‑gaaʼide titaalig.
Maala khallo Dimachkh,hi al‑madiina al‑maʼruufaal‑beeha ana nafrah ?
Wa fi l‑yoom da,subyaanha yidaffugu fi l‑chawaariʼwa rujaalha al‑muhaaribiin yumuutu.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa ninazzil naar fi durdur Dimachkhwa taakul gusuur al‑malik Banhadaad. 
Kalaam bukhuss Khidaar wa mantagat Haasuur al‑haarabaahum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil.Daahu Allah gaal : Gummu ahjumu Khidaar.Aywa,dammuru iyaal al‑sabaah !
Chiilu khiyamhum wa khanamhumwa chiilu sataayirhumwa kulla khumaamhum wa ibilhum.Wa guulu leehum :‹ Al‑mukhiif fi kulla bakaan ! ›
Ya naas Haasuur !Arrudu amchu ajala,allabbado fi l‑karaakiir.Achaan Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabilkharrar didduku kharaarwa khattat didduku khitta. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Gummu ahjumu al‑ummaal‑saakne fi raaha wa amaan.Hi ma indaha hawaadir wa la gufulwa gaaʼide wiheedha taraf.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa yanhabo ibilhumwa bahaayimhum al‑katiiriin yabgo khaniime.Wa l‑yizayyunu chaʼarhum,nichattithum fi l‑riihwa nijiib fooghum al‑kharaabmin kulli jiihe.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Haasuur tabga margad baʼaachiimwa bakaan kharaab ila l‑abad.Wa ma fi naadum yaskun fi l‑balad diwa la insaan yagood foogha. 
Fi bidaayit hukum Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza,Allah hajja le l‑nabi Irmiya kalaam bukhuss balad Ilaam.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Aywa,ana nikassir nubbaal Ilaam,al‑hu asaas gudurtah.
Ana nijiib fi Ilaam adual‑yaji min kulli jiihe misil al‑riih.Wa nichattithum be l‑riih diwa ma fi balad al‑ma yawsalo fooghaal‑naas al‑arrado min Ilaam.
Ana nibarjil naas Ilaam giddaam udwaanhumwa giddaam al‑yidooru moothum.Wa nijiib fooghum al‑fasaalawa khadabi al‑muhrig.Wa nijiib leehum al‑seef yitaaridhumlahaddi nikammilhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana nahkim fi balad Ilaamwa niwaddir malikha wa kubaaraatah.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin fi l‑akhiir,ana nigabbil naas Ilaamal‑waddoohum fi l‑khurba. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑gaalah be waasitat al‑nabi Irmiya.Wa l‑kalaam da bukhuss madiinat Baabil wa kulla ardaha.
 Ballukhu fi ust al‑umam !Khabburu beyahwa arfaʼo al‑alaama.Khabburu beyahwa ma tilabbudu cheyy.Wa guulu :‹ Baabil wagaʼat.Wa ilaahhum Biil ayyaboohwa ilaahhum Marduuk kassarooh.Wa asnaamhum ayyaboohumwa ilaahaathum kassaroohum. ›
Achaan min munchaakh,umma jaat hajamat Baabilwa kharabat al‑balad.Wa naasha wa bahaayimha kulluhum arradowa l‑balad di bigat faadiye min sukkaanha. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Fi ayyaam al‑wakit da,Bani Israaʼiil wa Bani Yahuuza yigabbulu sawawa yaju be bakiyifattuchuuni ana Allah Ilaahhum.
Humman yasʼalo min derib jabal Sahyuunwa yiwajjuhu aleeha.Wa yuguulu :‹ Yalla !Ninrabtu maʼa Allahbe muʼaahada daayme al‑abadan ma tinnasi.› 
 Chaʼabi misil khanam muwaddiriinal‑ruʼyaanhum waddaroohum fi l‑jibaal.Yiliffu beehum min jabal le aakharlahaddi l‑khanam dool nassoohum zariibithum.
Humman misil khanamwa ayyi naadum al‑yalgaahum yaakulhum.Udwaanhum yuguulu :‹ Aniina ma khaatiyiinachaan humman aznabo didd Allah.Wa Allah hu bas bakaan raahithum wa adaalithum,hu al‑juduudhum khatto achamhum foogah.› 
 Yalla !Arrudu min Baabil !Amurgu min balad al‑Baabiliyiin.Wa abgo misil tuyuusal‑maachiin fi raas door al‑khanam.
Achaan ana niharrichmajmuuʼat umam katiiriin,yaju min balad al‑munchaakhle yahjumu Baabil.Wa l‑umam dool yihaarubuuhawa yichiiluuha.Wa nachaachiibhum hineey rujaal furraasal‑nuchchaabhum tihit ke ma yagaʼ.
Wa balad Baabil yichiiluuha misil kasiibewa kulla nahhaabiinha yachbaʼo.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Aywa,intu firihtu wa anbasattu,intu al‑nahabtu chaʼabi al‑misil warasati.Wa nattattu misil al‑ijle fi l‑gechch al‑akhdarwa hanhantu misil al‑kheel al‑induhum gudra.
Wa hassaʼ,baladku al‑misil ammukutakhjal ziyaadawa l‑wildatku,al‑eeb yakrubha.Wa tukuun aakhir al‑umamwa tabga sahara wa ard jafaaf wa kadaade. 
Wa be sabab khadab Allah,baladku takhrabwa tafda min sukkaanha.Wa ayyi naadum al‑yufuut jamb Baabil yilʼajjabwa yisaffir min al‑damaar al‑foogha.
Yalla !Intu siyaad al‑nubbaalgummu le muhaarabat Baabilwa min kulli jiihe,zarruguuha.Ma tifaddulu nuchchaab waahid kulaachaan hi aznabat didd Allah.
Hawwuguuha min kulli jiihewa kooruku korooraak al‑harib diddaha.Wa khalaas,hi tisallim nafishawa gusuurha yidaffuguwa daraadirha yagaʼo.Allah kaffa al‑taar foogha.Intu kula kaffu al‑taarwa sawwu foogha misil hi sawwat.
Wa fi Baabil,aktulu al‑harraatiinwa l‑yagtaʼo be khanaajir fi wakt al‑gatiʼ.Wa wakit seef al‑mudammir yaji,khalli ayyi naadum yigabbil le chaʼabahwa yajri le baladah.
Bani Israaʼiil misil khanamaay al‑muwaddireal‑katalooha al‑diidaan.Wa malik Achuur hu al‑awwal akalhawa Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabilfi l‑akhiir kasar adumha.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal : Akiid ana niʼaakhib malik Baabil wa baladahmisil aakhabt malik Achuur.
Wa ana nigabbil Bani Israaʼiilfi bakaan marʼaahumwa yasraho fi jabal al‑Karmalwa turaab Baachaanwa yachbaʼo fi jibaal Afraayimwa turaab Gilʼaad.
Wa fi ayyaam al‑wakit da,yifattuchu khata Bani Israaʼiil wa ma yalgooh.Wa zanib Bani Yahuuza kula ma yinlagi abadanachaan nakhfir le l‑ana khalleethum faddalo. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Ahjumu turaab Marataayimwa sukkaan Faguud.Haarubuuhum wa dammuruuhumwa sawwu fooghum misil ana amartuku.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Yinsamiʼ korooraak al‑harib fi l‑baladwa yinchaaf damaar kabiir !
Chiifu,Baabil alkassarat wa alfatfatathi al‑misil al‑mitraga al‑darabat kulla l‑ard.Ajab,Baabil khirbat fi ust al‑umam.
Ya Baabil !Ana kajjeet leeki charakwa karabtiki min duun inti taʼarfiih.Ana ligiitki wa karabtikiachaan inti bas gammeeti diddi ana Allah. 
Allah fatah beet al‑silaahwa marag silaah khadabah.Wa misil da bas,Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadirjahhaz khidimtah didd balad Baabil.
 Taʼaalu didd Baabil min aakhir al‑dunyawa aftaho dabangaatha.Wa limmu khaniimitha misil al‑gechchwa dammuru sukkaanhalahaddi waahid kula ma yifaddil minhum.
Aktulu kulla furraasha al‑misil al‑tiiraanwa suuguuhum le l‑moot !Al‑azaab leehum !Yoomhum jawa da wakit ikhaabhum. 
Asmaʼo korooraak al‑muʼarridiinwa l‑jaariyiin min balad Baabil.Fi Sahyuun yiballukhu wa yuguulu : Allah Ilaahna chaal al‑taar,chaal al‑taar le beetah al‑mukhaddas al‑dammarooh ! 
Naadu siyaad al‑nubbaal didd Baabil,kulla l‑yaʼarfu yistaʼmalo al‑nuchchaab.Yukhuttu muʼaskarhum hawaaleehaachaan naadum minha ma yinbalis.Aakhubuuha hasab amalhawa sawwu foogha misil hi sawwat.Achaan hi astakbarat giddaam Allah,giddaam Khudduus Israaʼiil.
 Fi l‑yoom da,subyaanha yidaffugu fi l‑chawaariʼwa rujaalha al‑muhaaribiin yumuutu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Akiid ana nugumm diddiki,ya Baabil al‑mustakbire !Achaan yoomki jawa da l‑wakit al‑niʼaakhibki foogah.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir.
Al‑mustakbire tittartaʼ wa tagaʼwa naadum yarfaʼha ma fiih.Wa ana nigabbid al‑naar fi mudunhawa taakul kulla l‑fi hawaaleeha. 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Bani Israaʼiil wa Bani Yahuuzahumman al‑itneen mazluumiin.Wa l‑naas al‑karaboohum masaajiinabo ma yikhalluuhum.
Wa laakin al‑yafdaahum hu chadiidwa usmah Allah al‑Gaadir.Hu yidaafiʼ leehum misil muhaamiwa yirajjif sukkaan Baabilachaan yijiib al‑salaam fi l‑ard. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Ana nijiib al‑harib didd sukkaan Baabilwa kubaaraathum wa hakiimiinhum.
Wa nijiib al‑harib didd al‑yihajju bala faaydewa yikallumu misil muchootiniin.Wa nijiib al‑harib didd al‑furraaswa yabgo mubarjaliin.
Wa nijiib al‑harib didd kheelhumwa arabaathum hana l‑haribwa didd kulla l‑ajaanib al‑fi lubb deechhumwa humman yabgo misil awiin.Wa nijiib al‑harib didd makhaazinhumwa yanhaboohum.
Wa nijiib al‑jafaaf le buhuur Baabilwa humman yikammulu.Achaan hi balad hint asnaam mukhiifiinal‑yiwadduru raas al‑naas al‑yaʼabuduuhum.
Wa khalaas,al‑gitat wa l‑maraafʼiin yaskunuuhawa l‑naʼaam yudugg dungurah foogha.Wa battaan,ma fi abadannaadum yaskun fi Baabilwa min zurriiye le zurriiye kula,ma talga sukkaan.
Da misil Saduum wa Amuura wa hillaalhumal‑ana al‑Rabb dammartuhum.Wa da kalaam Allah.Ma fi naadum al‑yaskun fi balad Baabilwa la insaan yagood foogha.
Aywa,fi chaʼab jaayi min munchaakhwa umma kabiire wa muluuk chudaadyugummu min aakhir al‑ard.
Wa askarhum musallahiin be nubbaal wa huraabwa humman mukhiifiin ma induhum rahma.Wa harakathum misil mooj al‑baharwa humman raakbiin kheel.Wa yurussu le l‑harib misil raajil waahidle yihaarubuuki,ya Baabil al‑misil bineeye.
Wa wakit malik Baabil simiʼ al‑khabar,iideenah anrakho.Wa l‑khoof wa l‑wajaʼ karaboohmisil al‑mara al‑gaaʼide titaalig. 
Wa Allah gaal : Misil duud al‑yamrugmin khaabat al‑Urdunle yahjim khanam fi marʼa akhdar,ana kula nugummnatrud naas Baabil be khaflawa nisabbit fooghaal‑naadum al‑ana azaltah.Yaatu al‑misli ana ?Wa yaatu al‑yantiini amur ?Wa yaatu al‑malikal‑yagdar yugumm diddi ? 
Wa fi chaan da,asmaʼo al‑kharaaral‑kharrarah Allah didd Baabilwa asmaʼo al‑niiyeal‑chaalha didd al‑Baabiliyiin.Akiid yiwaddiihum misil iyaal al‑khanamwa akiid yakhrib marʼaahum.
Wa min harakat cheeliin Baabil,al‑ard tarjifwa siraakhha yinsamiʼfi ust al‑umam.
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Chiifu,ana nigawwim adu misil riih mudammiredidd Baabil wa didd guluub udwaani.
Wa nirassil didd Baabil ajaanibyikharbuluuha.Fi yoom fasaalitha,yaju leeha min kulli jiihewa yidammuru ardaha. 
Adurbu ayyi waahid min al‑adual‑indah nuchchaab wa laabis dirʼah.Ma tikhallu al‑askar al‑chabaabwa laakin dammuru kulla askar Baabil.
Khalli yagaʼo mutaʼʼaniin fi l‑chawaariʼwa yidaffugu maytiin fi balad Baabil.
Achaan Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadirkaan maʼa Bani Israaʼiil wa Bani Yahuuzahatta kan humman malo baladhum be charrdidd Khudduus Israaʼiil kula.
Arrudu min balad Baabilwa khalli ayyi waahid yinajji nafsah.Ma tumuutu be sabab zanibhaachaan da wakit Allah yichiil taarahwa yijaaziiha hasab al‑waajib leeha.
Baabil awwal hi misil kaas hana dahab fi iid Allah,hi sakkarat kulla l‑ard.Wa l‑umam chirbo min khamarhawa fi chaan da bas,ruuseehum waddaro.
Wa be khafla,Baabil wagaʼat wa alkassarat.Abku leeha wa fattuchu dawawa amsahooh fi uwaarha,akuun tilʼaalaj.
 Aniina dawwarna niʼaaluju Baabilwa laakin hi ma addaawat leena.Yalla nikhalluuha !Ayyi waahid yamchi le baladahachaan ikhaabha lihig lahaddi l‑samawa anrafaʼ lahaddi l‑sahaab.
Allah bayyan adaalitnawa khalaas,taʼaalu nigabbulu.Nikhabburu fi jabal Sahyuunbe kheer Allah Ilaahna. 
Tarrugu nachaachiibkuwa amlo kalootaatku.Allah harrach muluuk Maadi didd Baabilachaan hu kharrar yidammir Baabil.Yichiil foogha al‑taarwa da taar beetah al‑mukhaddas al‑dammarooh.
Arfaʼo raayit al‑hujuum didd durdur Baabilwa chaddudu al‑muraakhaba.Khuttu hurraaswa khuttu naas le yarbutu kamiin.Achaan al‑cheyy al‑kharrarah Allah,hu yisawwiihwa da kharaarah didd sukkaan Baabil.
Inti ya Baabil al‑jamb al‑buhuur,khunaaki katiire.Nihaayitki jaat hasab tamaʼki.
Allah al‑Gaadir halaf be nafsah wa gaal : Ana namlaaki be rujaal katiiriin misil al‑jaraadwa yikooruku fi lubbiki korooraak al‑nasur. 
Allah khalag al‑ard be gudurtahwa sabbat al‑aalam be hikmatahwa falla al‑samaawaat be ilmah.
Wa wakit yaamur,al‑almi yilimm bakaan waahid fi l‑samawa l‑sahaab yatlaʼ min aakhir al‑ardwa l‑barraaga tachlaʼ wa l‑matar yanzilwa makhaazin al‑riih yinfathu.
Wa ayyi naadum mukhaffalma indah maʼrafa.Wa ayyi sayyaakhi hana sanam,al‑eeb yakurbahachaan timsaalah da khachch,ma indah ruuh.
Al‑asnaam zaayliinwa humman amal al‑yijiib al‑chamaate.Wa wakit al‑ikhaab yaji,humman yiddammaro.
Wa Ilaah Yaakhuub ma misilhumachaan hu bas khalag kulla cheyy.Hu azal gabiila waahidele yabgo chaʼabah al‑misil warasatahwa usmah Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa Allah gaal : Inti,ya Baabil !Bigiiti leyi misil asaati al‑nihaarib beeha.Beeki inti,ana darabt al‑umamwa kharabt al‑mamaalik.
Wa beeki inti,ana darabtal‑kheel wa rukkaabhumwa arabaat al‑harib wa siyaadhum.
Wa beeki inti,ana darabtal‑rujaal wa l‑awiinwa l‑kubaar wa l‑dugaagwa l‑subyaan wa l‑banaat.
Wa beeki inti,ana darabtal‑ruʼyaan wa khanamhumwa l‑harraatiin wa tiiraanhumwa l‑hukkaam wa masaaʼiilhum. 
 Wa laakin hassaʼ,chiifu ya Bani Israaʼiil !Ana nijaazi Baabil wa kulla sukkaanhahasab kulla l‑fasaala al‑sawwooha fi Sahyuun.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa akiid ana nugumm diddiki inti,ya Baabil al‑misil jabal al‑kharaab,inti al‑kharabti kulla l‑ard.Ana nimidd iidi le nadrubkiwa nidardigki min ruuse al‑jibaalwa nahrigki be naar.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa battaan ma yamurgu minkiwa la hajar zaawiye wa la hajar asaasachaan tukuuni kharaab ila l‑abad. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Arfaʼo raayit al‑hujuum fi l‑baladwa adurbu al‑buug fi ust al‑umam.Khassusu umam didd Baabilwa harruchu diddaha mamaalik Araraat wa Minni wa Achkanaaz.Kallufu khaayid diddahawa gawwumu diddaha kheel misil al‑jaraad al‑saayir.
Wa khassusu al‑umam didd Baabilwa rassulu diddaha muluuk Maadiwa hukkaamhum wa kulla masaaʼiilhumwa kulla l‑buldaan al‑humman yahkumuuhum.
Al‑ard anhazzat wa rajafatwakit kharaar Allah didd Baabil alhaggag.Wa balad Baabil takhrabwa tabga faadiye min sukkaanha.
Wa l‑askar al‑furraas hana Baabilabo ma yihaarubuwa allabbado fi bakaanaathum al‑gawiyiin.Wa fahaaliiyithum kula waddaratwa humman bigo misil awiin.Wa buyuut Baabil antachchowa biibaanha alkassaro.
Wa yajri mursaal baʼad mursaalwa rasuul wara rasuulle yikhabburu malik Baabilkadar madiintah chaalooha min tarafha le tarafha.
Wa ayyi maʼadd,al‑adu saddaahwa tibin al‑ruhuud tachchoohwa l‑rujaal al‑muhaaribiin anbahato.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal : Baabil al‑misil bineeyetabga yaabse karr misil nagaʼat al‑madagg al‑jahhazooha.Wa baʼad chiyya,wakt al‑gatiʼ yaji. 
 Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil barjalaana wa akalaanawa hu sawwaana misil maaʼuun faadi.Wa zarataana misil al‑khuulwa mala batnah be mukhkhina wa taradaana.
Wa khalli al‑unuf al‑sawwooh leenayukuun fi Baabil ! Wa da kalaam sukkaan Sahyuun. Wa khalli dimmitna tagaʼfi raas sukkaan Baabil ! Wa da kalaam naas Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal : Ana nidaafiʼ leeku misil muhaamiwa nichiil leeku al‑taar.Wa niyabbis bahar Baabilwa nijaffif uyuun almiiha.
Wa Baabil tabga koom hana turaabwa margad hana baʼaachiimwa bakaan kharaab wa bahiitewa tabga faadiye min sukkaanha.
Wa naas Baabil yikirru misil al‑diidaan al‑subyaanwa yaharju misil iyaal al‑duud.
Wa wakit jihmo,ana nijahhiz leehum aazuumawa nisakkirhum lahaddi yafraho.Wa laakin yunuumu noom ila l‑abadwa battaan ma yugummu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa ana niwaddiihummisil al‑khurfaan le l‑juzurwa misil al‑kubaach wa l‑tuyuus. 
Chiifu !Baabilanchaalatwa l‑maʼruufa fi kulla l‑ard anhazamat !Ajab,Baabil khirbat fi ust al‑umam !
Al‑bahar chaal Baabilwa be moojah al‑katiir,khattaaha.
Mudunha khirbowa hi bigat ard jafaaf wa kadaade.Wa di l‑balad al‑ma fi naadum yaskun fooghawa la insaan yiʼaddi beeha.
Wa Allah gaal : Ana nugumm didd sanam Biil fi Baabilwa namrug al‑lugma min khachmah.Wa battaan al‑umam ma yamchu leyahwa durdur Baabil yagaʼ.
Ya chaʼabi !Amurgu min usut Baabilwa khalli ayyi waahid yinajji nafsah,wa yibaʼʼid min al‑khadab al‑muhrig hanaayi Allah.
Wa khalli achamku ma yingatiʼwa ma takhaafomin al‑khabaral‑gaaʼidiin tasmaʼooh fi l‑balad.Achaan al‑sana di,tasmaʼo khabarwa fi l‑sana al‑baʼadha kula,tasmaʼo khabar aakhar.Wa yuguulu yaji unuf fi l‑baladwa malik yugumm didd malik.
Wa fi chaan da,yaji yoom waahidal‑foogah ana niʼaakhib asnaam Baabil.Wa kulla baladha,al‑eeb yakrubhawa janaazaat maytiinha yagaʼo fi lubbaha.
Al‑sama wa l‑ard yizakhrutuwa kulla l‑fiihum yiragrig min al‑farahfi chaan damaar Baabil.Achaan min munchaakhal‑mukharrib yaji leeha. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya maytiin Bani Israaʼiil !Baabil kula waajib tagaʼ.Achaan beeha hi wagaʼo naas maytiinfi ayyi bakaan fi l‑ard.
Yalla,intu al‑nijiitu min al‑moot !Arrudu !Ma tagiifu !Fi l‑khurba,azzakkaro Allahwa khuttu Madiinat al‑Khudus fi guluubku.
Wa Bani Israaʼiil gaalo : Aniina al‑eeb karabaanawakit simiʼna al‑muʼyaarwa l‑khajla dallat ruuseena.Achaan al‑ajaanib dakhalo fi l‑bakaanaathana beet Allah. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Wa fi chaan da,yaji yoom waahidal‑foogah niʼaakhib asnaam Baabilwa fi kulla baladha al‑majruuhiin yaguntu.
Hatta kan Baabil tabga aaliye lahaddi l‑samawa tigawwi bakaanaatha al‑aaliyiin kula,ana nijiib foogha mukharribiin. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa siraakh yinsamiʼ min Baabilwa damaar kabiir yukuun fi balad al‑Baabiliyiin.
Achaan Allah yakhrib Baabilwa yisakkit harakatha.Wa l‑adu yajiiha misil al‑mooj al‑chadiidwa harakatah tinsamiʼ.
Aywa !Kulla l‑mukharribiinjo didd Baabil.Askarha al‑furraas ankarabowa nubbaalhum alkassar.Achaan Allah hu al‑Ilaah al‑yijaaziwa yikaafi ayyi naadum ale hasab al‑waajib leyah.
 Ana nisakkir masaaʼiilha wa hakiimiinhawa hukkaamha wa kubaaraathawa askarha al‑furraas.Wa humman yunuumu ila l‑abadwa battaan ma yugummu. Wa da kalaam al‑malik wa hu Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Daraadir Baabil al‑tukhaanyilhaddamo.Wa biibaanha al‑tuwaal,al‑naar taakulhum.Al‑chuʼuub yiʼayyu nufuushum saakitwa l‑umam yatʼabo le l‑taakulah al‑naar. 
Al‑nabi Irmiya kallam le Saraaya wileed Nariiya wileed Mahsiiya wakit hu maachi Baabil maʼa Sidkhiiya malik Yahuuza fi l‑sana al‑raabʼe hana hukum Sidkhiiya.Wa Saraaya da,hu masʼuul min gasir al‑malik.
Wa Irmiya katab fi kitaab malfuuf kulla l‑fasaala al‑taji le Baabil wa da kulla l‑kalaam al‑maktuub al‑bukhuss Baabil.
Wa Irmiya gaal le Saraaya : Wakit tiwassil fi Baabil,fakkir wa agri be hiss aali kulla l‑kalaam da.
Wa guul :‹ Ya Allah !Inta bas kharrart wa gult al‑bakaan da yiddammar.Wa ma fi naadum yaskun foogah wa la insaan wa la bahaayim.Wa laakin hu yabga kharaab ila l‑abad. ›
Wakit tikammil min giraayit al‑kitaab da,arbut foogah hajar wa armiih fi lubb bahar al‑Furaat.
Wa baʼad da,guul :‹ Baabil kula takhrag misil da wa abadan ma tugumm baʼad al‑fasaala al‑nijiibha foogha.›  Al‑naas yagaʼo. Wa daahu nihaayat kalaam Irmiya.
Sidkhiiya indah 21 sana wakit bigi malik wa hakam 11 sana fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa ammah usumha Hamuutal bineeyit Irmiya min hillit Libna.
Wa Sidkhiiya sawwa al‑fasaala giddaam Allah misil al‑malik Yahuuyakhim sawwaah.
Wa l‑fasaala al‑humman sawwooha fi Madiinat al‑Khudus wa fi balad Yahuuza jaabat khadab Allah.Wa fi chaan da,Allah taradaahum baʼiid minnah.Wa Sidkhiiya atmarrad didd malik Baabil.
Wa fi chaan da,fi l‑yoom al‑aachir hana l‑chahar al‑aachir fi l‑sana al‑taasʼe hana hukum Sidkhiiya,Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil ja be kulla askarah le Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa humman nazalo wa hawwagooha be radmiiye.
Wa l‑madiina di gaʼadat muhaasara lahaddi sanit 11 hana hukum al‑malik Sidkhiiya.
Wa l‑juuʼ bigi chadiid fi l‑madiina wa l‑naas ma induhum cheyy yaakuluuh.Wa fi l‑yoom al‑taasiʼ hana l‑chahar al‑raabiʼ,
gaddo khurma fi durdur al‑madiina.Wa khalaas be l‑leel,malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa kulla askarah marago wa arrado min al‑madiina.Humman marago be l‑derib al‑gaaʼid ambeenaat al‑daraadir al‑itneen hana l‑difaaʼ al‑gariib le jineenit al‑malik hatta kan al‑Baabiliyiin muhawwigiin al‑madiina kula.Wa l‑malik Sidkhiiya wa askarah chaalo al‑derib al‑maachi ale waadi al‑Urdun.
Wa laakin askar Baabil taradooh le l‑malik Sidkhiiya wa lihgooh wa karabooh fi kadaadit Ariiha.Wa kulla askarah arrado khallooh.
Wa askar Baabil karabooh le l‑malik.Wa waddooh fi hillit Ribla fi balad Hamaat giddaam malik Baabil.Wa fi l‑bakaan da,haakamah.
Wa hinaak fi Ribla,malik Baabil dabah awlaad Sidkhiiya giddaamah wa battaan dabah kulla kubaaraat Yahuuza.
Wa baʼad da,malik Baabil gaddad uyuun Sidkhiiya wa janzarah be jinziir hana nahaas matbuug wa waddaah fi Baabil.Wa khattaah fi l‑sijin lahaddi mootah.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑aachir hana l‑chahar al‑khaamis fi sanit 19 hana hukum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas al‑yakhdim le malik Baabil dakhal fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa hu tachcha beet Allah wa gasir al‑malik wa kulla buyuut Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa kulla buyuut al‑masaaʼiil,hu harragaahum be naar.
Wa kulla askar Baabil al‑macho maʼa kabiir al‑hurraas kassaro al‑durdur al‑muhawwig Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas chaal maʼaayah al‑chaʼab al‑faddalo fi l‑madiina wa humman waahidiin min al‑masaakiin wa l‑naas al‑sallamo nufuushum le malik Baabil wa l‑sinaaʼiyiin.Wa hu chaalaahum wa waddaahum fi l‑khurba fi Baabil.
Wa laakin Nabuuzaradaan khalla waahidiin min masaakiin al‑balad le yahartu al‑inab wa l‑ziraaʼa.
Wa askar Baabil kassaro amad al‑nahaas al‑giddaam beet Allah wa l‑hiitaan al‑mutaharrikiin wa l‑hoot al‑kabiir hana nahaas al‑gaaʼid giddaam beet Allah wa waddo kulla l‑nahaas da fi Baabil.
Wa humman chaalo al‑buraam wa l‑feelaat wa l‑sakaakiin wa l‑kiisaan wa l‑kharaariif wa kulla l‑mawaaʼiin al‑sanaʼoohum min nahaas wa astaʼmaloohum le l‑ibaada.
Wa kabiir al‑hurraas chaal al‑mawaaʼiin wa khammaamaat al‑naar wa l‑kiisaan wa l‑buraam wa l‑faanuus wa l‑kharaariif wa l‑taasaat kulluhum min dahab wa fudda.
Wa kan le l‑amad al‑itneen wa l‑hoot al‑kabiir wa l‑atnaachar tiiraan al‑gaaʼidiin tihtah wa l‑hiitaan al‑mutaharrikiin kulluhum ke al‑sanaʼaahum al‑malik Suleymaan le beet Allah,wazin nahaashum ma maʼruuf min al‑katara.
Wa ayyi waahid min al‑amad dool tuulah 18 duraaʼ wa daayiratah 12 duraaʼ wa indah lubb wa tukhnah 4 asaabiʼ.
Wa ayyi amuud da,khatto foogah raas hana nahaas al‑tuulah 5 duraaʼ wa muhawwag be salaasil al‑murassas fooghum rummaan wa kulluhum ke min nahaas.Wa l‑amuud al‑taani,sunʼitah sawa sawa misil al‑amuud al‑awwalaani be rummaanah.
Wa fi 96 rummaan al‑binchaafo fi jawaanibah wa laakin fi daayir al‑salaasil,kulluhum adadhum 100 rummaan.
Wa battaan kabiir al‑hurraas karab Saraaya kabiir rujaal al‑diin wa Safanya raajil al‑diin al‑naayib wa l‑hurraas al‑talaata hana madkhal beet Allah.
Wa min al‑madiina,karab kabiir waahid al‑mukallaf be l‑rujaal al‑muhaaribiin wa sabʼa naas min khaddaamiin al‑malik al‑ligoohum fi lubb al‑madiina.Wa karab battaan al‑kaatib hana khaayid al‑deech,hu al‑mukallaf be jannidiin al‑chaʼab fi l‑askariiye wa 60 raajil min al‑chaʼab al‑gaaʼidiin fi lubb al‑madiina.
Wa Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas karabaahum masaajiin wa waddaahum le malik Baabil fi Ribla.
Wa malik Baabil katalaahum hinaak fi Ribla fi balad Hamaat.Wa be misil da,kulla naas balad Yahuuza waddoohum fi l‑khurba,baʼiid min arduhum.
Wa daahu adad al‑naas al‑waddaahum Nabuukhadnasar malik Baabil fi l‑khurba.Fi l‑sana al‑saabʼe,hu wadda 3 023 Yahuud.
Wa fi sanit 18 hana hukmah,Nabuukhadnasar wadda min Madiinat al‑Khudus 832 naas.
Wa fi sanit 23 hana hukum Nabuukhadnasar,Nabuuzaradaan kabiir al‑hurraas wadda fi l‑khurba 745 Yahuud.Wa be l‑jumla adadhum 4 600 naas.
Wa fi sanit 37 min waddo Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza fi l‑khurba fi Baabil,darrajo Awiil Maruudak malik fi Baabil.Wa fi yoom 25 hana chahri 12 hana l‑sana di,Awiil Maruudak afa Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa talagah min al‑sijin.
Wa l‑malik hajja leyah be kalaam halu wa darrajah fi bakaan aali ziyaada min al‑muluuk al‑aakhariin al‑gaaʼidiin maʼaayah fi Baabil.
Wa malik Baabil khayyar khulgaan Yuyakiin hana l‑sijin wa khallaah yaakul maʼaayah daayman fi dabalaaytah fi kulla muddit hayaatah.
Wa be misil da,fi kulla muddit hayaatah lahaddi mootah,Yuyakiin ligi riise samhe min malik Baabil.
Ya l‑salaam !Al‑madiina amchaʼaban katiirbigat maʼzuulamisil armala ma indaha musaaʼada.Awwal,hi fi l‑umam sayyidawa l‑yoom,bigat khaadim mamluuka.
Hi tabki,tabki tuul al‑leelbe kulla gudrithawa min sudgaanha,ma fi sadiig al‑yisabbirha.Kulla rufgaanha khaanoohawa bigo udwaanha.
Tihit al‑taʼab hana l‑khurba,balad Yahuuza waddooha fi l‑ubuudiiye.Wa aayche fi ust al‑umam bala raahawa udwaanha al‑taaradoohafi l‑derib al‑dayyig zarrooha.
Wa chawaariʼ Sahyuun hiznowa ma fi naas maachiin le l‑iidwa kulla biibaan al‑madiina daffago.Wa rujaal al‑diin hineeha yaguntuwa banaatha al‑udriiyaat haznaanaatwa madiinat Sahyuun gaaʼide fi l‑murr.
Wa khusmaanha bigo siyaadhawa udwaanha gaaʼidiin fi l‑raaha.Wa Allah jaab foogha al‑hizinbe sabab kutur isyaanha.Wa karabo iyaalhawa waddoohum abiid.
Wa madiinat Sahyuun al‑misil bineeyewaddarat kulla charafha.Wa daahu kubaaraatha bigo misil teetalal‑ma ligo bakaan marʼaahumwa arrado bala gudragiddaam tarraadiinhum.
Wa fi ayyaamha hana l‑diige wa l‑taʼab,Madiinat al‑Khudus azzakkarat kulla chahwaathaal‑zamaan gaaʼide tafrah beehum.Wa wakit chaʼabha wagaʼofi iideen khusmaanhum,ma fi naadum al‑yafzaʼhum.Wa khusmaanha chaafoohawa firho be damaarha.
Madiinat al‑Khudus aznabatwa be da,najjasat nafisha.Wa kulla l‑naas al‑zamaan karramooha,hassaʼ nakarooha achaan chaafo ireeha.Wa laakin hi gaaʼide tagnitwa tantiihum daharha.
Wa be najaasitha fi surwaalha,hi ma fakkarat fi mustakhbalha.Wa wagaʼaanha bigi ajiibwa ma fi naadum al‑yisabbirha.Wa Madiinat al‑Khudus gaalat : Ya Allah,chiif taʼabiachaan al‑adu annasar foogi ! 
Wa l‑khasiim khatta iideenahfi kulla ziinat beetha al‑tafrah beeha.Aywa,fi l‑beet al‑mukhaddasdakhalo umam al‑inta Allah gultma yadkhulu fi bakaan jamaaʼtak.
Wa kulla chaʼabha gaaʼidiin yaguntuwakit yifattuchu al‑akil.Wa yibaddulu kulla ziinat buyuuthumal‑yafraho beehabe akil achaan yiʼiichu.Wa Sahyuun gaalat : Ya Allah !Asmaʼwa chiif kikkeef ana mahguura.
Wa leeku intu kullukual‑tiʼaddu be l‑derib da,asmaʼo wa chiifu !Fiyah taʼab ziyaadamin taʼabi al‑ana aayche beyah ?Wa da l‑taʼab al‑jaabah Allahfi yoom khadabah al‑muhrig.
Min al‑sama,hu rassal khadabahmisil naar dakhalat fi udaami.Wa kajja leyi charakwa beyah ramaani.Wa dassaani fi l‑kharaabwa nagnit tuul yoomi.
Hu zaatah chaal zunuubiwa sawwaahum misil daami.Wa rabataahum leyi fi ragabatiwa be da,waddart gudurti.Wa l‑Rabb sallamaani le iid udwaaniwa ma nagdar nugumm min tihithum.
Wa l‑Rabb aba kulla rujaali al‑furraasal‑gaaʼidiin maʼaayiwa jaab diddi deechle yaktul chabaabi.Wa khatta balad Yahuuza al‑misil bineeye udriiyebeen al‑murhaaka wa bittaha le yarhakha.
Wa fi chaan da,ana bakeetwa dumuuʼi jaro wudyaanachaan al‑yisabbirniwa l‑yihayyiini bigi baʼiid minni.Wa iyaali hilkoachaan al‑adu annasar foogi. 
Sahyuun rafaʼat iideenha wa naadatwa laakin ma ligat naadum al‑yisabbirha.Wa Allah anta izin le jiiraan zurriiyit Yaakhuubyabgo udwaanhum.Wa fi uyuunhum,Madiinat al‑Khudusmalaane be l‑najaasa.
Wa Madiinat al‑Khudus gaalat : Allah aadilachaan ana isiit amrah.Asmaʼo,ya kulla l‑chuʼuub,wa chiifu taʼabi.Kulla subyaani wa banaati karaboohumwa waddoohum fi l‑khurba.
Wa ana naadeet sudgaaniwa laakin humman khachchooni.Rujaal al‑diin wa chuyuukhi maatofi l‑madiinawakit humman fattacho al‑akille yiʼiichu beyah wa ma ligooh.
Ya Allah,chiif al‑diige al‑foogi !Nafsi mubarjala wa galbi munjarihachaan ana isiitak isyaan chadiid.Kan maragt fi l‑chaariʼ,al‑moot yilaagiiniwa kan gaʼadt fi l‑beet,al‑seef yagtaʼ ragabati.
Udwaani simʼo ganiitiwa laakin ma fi naadum al‑yisabbirni.Kulluhum simʼo be hizniwa farhaaniin beyah.Wa da kulla inta bas jaʼaltahwa jibt yoom al‑ikhaab al‑inta gataʼtah.Wa khalli udwaani yabgo misli ana !
Jiibhum giddaamakbe kulla l‑fasaala al‑sawwooha.Wa sawwi fooghum misil sawweet foogibe sabab kulla isyaani.Achaan ganiiti bigi katiirwa nafsi bigat mardaane. 
Ya l‑salaam !Fi khadabah,al‑Rabb khatta be l‑dalaammadiinat Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye.Min al‑sama,rama majd Israaʼiil fi l‑ardwa fi yoom khadabah,ma fakkar fi beetah al‑mukhaddas.
Al‑Rabb dammar bala mahannakulla gechch al‑marʼa hana zurriiyit Yaakhuub.Wa fi khadabah,kassar al‑buyuut al‑gawiyiinhana balad Yahuuza al‑misil bineeye.Wa rama al‑mamlaka wa kubaaraatha fi l‑turaabwa ma jaʼalaahum mukhassasiin leyah.
Wa yoom khadabah al‑muhrig,hu dammar kulla khuwwaat Bani Israaʼiil.Wa rafaʼ minhum iidah al‑zeenewa sallamaahum le udwaanhum.Wa gawwam hariige amlahiibakalat kulla hawaale zurriiyit Yaakhuub.
Wa misil adu,jabad nubbaalahwa misil khasiim,be iidah al‑zeenegaaʼid yisawwib fooghum.Hu katal kulla iyaalhumal‑humman ziinat buyuuthum.Wa nazzal khadabah misil naarfi kheemat Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye.
Al‑Rabb bigi misil adu dammar Israaʼiilwa dammar kulla daraadirhawa kharab buyuutha al‑gawiyiin.Wa fi balad Yahuuza al‑misil bineeye,kattar al‑hizin wa l‑nuwaah.
Hu kharab zariibtahmisil zariibe hana jineenewa Allah dammar bakaanahhana l‑malamma.Wa fi Sahyuun,hu nassaahumyoom al‑iid wa yoom al‑sabt.Wa min chiddit khadabah,hu abaahum le l‑muluuk wa rujaal al‑diin.
Wa l‑Rabb aba al‑madbahwa le bakaanah al‑mukhaddas,khallaah.Wa sallam daraadir buyuut al‑gawiyiin hana l‑madiinafi iid al‑adu.Wa ansamaʼat haraka chadiide fi beet Allahmisil al‑haraka al‑chadiide hana yoom al‑iid.
Wa Allah kharraryidammir daraadir madiinat Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye.Hu ma waggaf iidah min al‑damaarlahaddi kulla cheyy khalaas addammar.Wa hu darab al‑bakaan al‑gawi wa l‑daraadirwa kulluhum daffago giddaamah.
Wa biibaan madiinat Sahyuun andafano fi l‑turaabwa hu dammaraahumwa kassar hawaadirhum.Wa l‑malik wa kubaaraatah ankarabofi iideen al‑umam al‑aakhariin.Wa churuut al‑Tawraat waddarowa l‑anbiya kula ma ligo ruʼya min Allah.
Wa madiinat Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye,chuyuukhha gaʼado tihit bala kalaamwa sabbo al‑turaab fi ruuseehumwa libso khulgaan al‑hizin.Wa banaat Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑udriiyaatdangaran ruuseehin ale l‑ard min al‑hizin.
Wa uyuuni dumuuʼhum kammalowa butuuni hirgowa gudurti bigat ma fiihabe sabab al‑damaar al‑lihig ummati al‑misil bitt ammi.Wakit al‑atfaal wa l‑iyaal al‑dugaaggaaʼidiin yakhmaro fi chawaariʼ al‑madiina,
humman yuguulu le ammahaathum : Antuuna akil wa charaab ! Wa yidaffugu fi chawaariʼ al‑madiinamisil almi al‑yajriwa ruuhhum gaaʼide tamrugfi huduun ammahaathum.
Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑misil bineeye,be chunu nichabbihki ?Wa chunu al‑yisaawiiki wa yisabbirki,ya Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye udriiye ?Damaarki bigi wasiiʼ misil al‑baharwa yaatu al‑yagdar yisaaʼidki ?
Be ruʼya saakit,anbiyaaki hajjookiwa ma oorooki be l‑khataal‑inti sawweetiihachaan tutuubiwa ma yiwadduuki fi l‑khurba.Be ruʼya,hajjookiwa be kalaam kidib,khachchooki.
Wa kulla l‑naas al‑faaytiinbe l‑derib jambikiyisaffugu le kharaabki.Aywa,yisaffuru wa yihizzu ruuseehum leeki inti,ya Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑misil bineeye,wa yuguulu : Di bas al‑madiina al‑binaaduuhaAmjamaalan Kaamil ?Di bas al‑bisammuuhaFarah al‑Dunya walla ? 
Kulla udwaanki fataho khuchuumhumwa alkallamo beeki.Humman saffarowa addo chalaaliifhum wa gaalo : Khalaas dammarnaaha !Da bas al‑yoom al‑gaaʼidiin narjoohwa daahu hidirnaah wa chifnaah. 
Allah sawwa hasab hu dawwarahwa haggag kalaamah al‑waaʼad beyah min zamaanwa dammar kulla cheyy bala mahanna.Wa khalla udwaanki yichchammato leekiwa antaahum gudra le yagiifu diddiki.
Sukkaan al‑madiina sarakho le l‑Rabbmin daakhal guluubhum.Ya daraadir Sahyuun !Ya madiinat Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye !Dumuuʼki saalo leel wa nahaarwa bigo misil al‑wudyaan.Ma tanti nafiski raahawa uyuunki kula ma yinjammo.
Yalla gummi wa abkimin bidaayit al‑leellahaddi aakhirah !Wa khalli galibki yingatiʼ misil al‑almigiddaam al‑Rabb.Wa arfaʼe iideenki wa achhade Allahle yinajji iyaalki al‑yumuutu min al‑juuʼfi kulla machbak al‑chawaariʼ.
Asmaʼ wa chiif,ya Allah !Le yaatu inta sawweet al‑masiibe di ?Maala al‑awiin akalan iyaalhinal‑yiriidanhum ?Wa maala kataloohum le rujaal al‑diinwa l‑anbiya fi beetak al‑mukhaddas ?
Wa fi kulla chawaariʼ al‑madiina,mudaffigiin iyaal wa chiyyaab.Wa l‑madiina gaalat : Banaati wa subyaani kataloohumbe l‑seef.Fi yoom zaʼalak,inta Allah dammartwa bala mahanna,inta katalt.
Wa misil yoom al‑iid,inta naadeet kulla udwaani al‑mujaawiriinni.Ya Allah,fi yoom khadabakma fi naja wa la haya.Al‑iyaal al‑ana rabbeethum wa kabbartuhum,al‑adu dammaraahum. 
Wa l‑nabi gaal :Ana al‑raajil al‑icht al‑azaabtihit soot khadab Allah.
Hu taradaani wa waddaanifi l‑dalaam al‑ma indah nuur.
Aywa,kulla yoom yadrubniiddat marraatana wiheedi.
Wa hu dammar laham jildiwa rihik udaami.
Wa sajanaaniwa be l‑murr wa l‑taʼab,hawwagaani.
Wa sakkanaani fi dalaam al‑khaburmisil al‑maato min zamaan.
Wa sadda leyi al‑tariig achaan ma najriwa zaad janaaziiri.
Ana koorakt wa dawwart al‑fazaʼwa laakin hu aba ma simiʼ chihidti.
Be hujaar kubaar,gaffal duruubiwa gamma sadda maraahiili.
Hu bigi leyi misil nimir al‑kaariswa duud mullabbid al‑haaris.
Hu maragaani min duruubiwa gattaʼaani lahamaay lahamaaywa kharabaani.
Wa jabad nubbaalahwa khattaani hadaf le nuchchaabah.
Wa zarrag kulla nachaachiibahwa beehum gaddad sadri.
Ana bigiit madhaka le kulla chaʼabiwa daayman yikhannuwa yichchammato foogi.
Wa hu chabbaʼni be l‑hamdalwa rawaani be maraar al‑sibir.
Wa kassar sunuuni be madkh al‑hashaswa marmakhaani fi l‑rumaad.
Wa baʼʼadaani min al‑salaamawa ana nisiit halaat al‑dunya.
Wa fi chaan da,ana gult : Abadan ma indi mustakhbalwa ma fi cheyy al‑narjaah min Allah. 
Wakit nifakkir fi taʼabi wa haalti fi l‑hamm,da misil maraar al‑sibir wa l‑samm.
Wakit ana nizzakkar tamaam,nafsi tatʼab ziyaada.
Wa laakin fi galbi ana gult : Aywa,indi acham. 
Kheer Allah abadan ma yingatiʼwa rahmatah abadan ma tikammil !
Aywa,hi tiljaddad kulli sabaahwa amaanah yabga ziyaada.
Wa ma faddal leyi illa Allahwa ana nukhutt achami foogah.
Allah hu zeen le l‑yarjaahwa hu adiil le l‑yifattichah.
Wa da sameh kan tarja be huduwa tukhutt achamakfi l‑naja al‑jaaye min Allah.
Sameh le l‑raajilyuduukh al‑taʼab fi subaayah.
Wa waajib yagood wiheedah wa yaskutachaan Allah bas jaʼalah leyah.
Wa l‑yasjud le Allah be galib waahidlaabudda yalga acham.
Yanti chidgah le l‑yadurbahwa yachbaʼ min al‑muʼyaar.
Achaan al‑Rabb ma yaaba al‑insaanila l‑abad.
Hatta kan aakhab kula,yarhamwa da hasab kheerah al‑kabiir.
Achaan hu ma yihibb yitaʼʼib al‑insaanwa la yijiib leyah al‑hizin.
Wakit yiʼazzubukulla masaajiin al‑balad
wa wakit ma yihtarumu huguug al‑insaangiddaam Allah al‑Aali
wa wakit yiʼawwuju al‑chariiʼa,al‑Rabb ma yichiifah walla ?
Yaatu yagdar yikharrirwa tawwaali yukuun ?Al‑Rabb bas ma siid al‑kharaar ?
Wa ma min Allah al‑Aali basyaji al‑kheer wa l‑charr walla ?
Wa maala al‑insaan al‑hayy yachkimin ikhaab zunuubah ?
Khalli nichiifu amalna wa nawzunuuhwa nigabbulu le Allah.
Wa fi nafs al‑wakit,narfaʼo iideennawa nantu guluubna le l‑Rabb al‑gaaʼid fi l‑sama.
Wa nuguulu : Aniina khitiina wa isiinaakwa inta ma khafart leena.
 Wa fi zaʼalak al‑chadiid,inta gammeet diddinawa kataltina bala mahanna.
Wa khatteet beenna wa beenak sahaabachaan salaawaatna ma yawsalook.
Wa inta jaʼaltina misil al‑wasaakha wa l‑afaanabeen al‑chuʼuub. 
Wa kulla udwaanna fataho khuchuumhumwa ayyaroona.
Wa khalaas,wagaʼ foognaal‑ruʼub wa l‑halaakwa l‑damaar wa l‑kharaab.
Dumuuʼi yajru wudyaanfi chaan kharaab ummati al‑misil bitt ammi.
Wa dumuuʼi saalowa abadan ma wagafo
lahaddi Allah min al‑samayanzur wa yichiif.
Wa ma nagdar nichiif al‑cheyyal‑kaan le banaat madiinti.
Al‑bigo udwaani bala janiiyekajjo leyi charakwa misil al‑teer,karabooni.
Wa fi nugra,zagalooniwa khatto hajar min foog leyi.
Wa almi khatta raasilahaddi gult fi nafsi : Ana numuut ! 
Min gaʼar al‑nugra,naadeet usmak,ya Allah.
Wa inta simiʼt hissiwa hassaʼ,asmaʼ darabaan galbiwa munaadaati.
Wakit naadeetak,inta garrabt leyiwa gult leyi : Ma takhaaf ! 
Ya Rabb,inta daafaʼt leyiwa fadeet hayaati.
Inta chift kikkeef zalamooni.Ya Allah,ahkim wa kaafiini daliimti.
Inta chift afkaarhumwa kikkeef alkaffo al‑taar.
Ya Allah,inta simiʼt muʼyaarhumwa chift afkaarhum.
Wa khuchuum udwaaniyilkhaalo tuul al‑yoom diddi.
Kan humman gaaʼidiin tihitwalla waagfiin foog kula,chiifhum !Ana bigiit khineehumhana l‑chamaate.
Ya Allah !Gabbil leehum fi raashumnafs al‑amal al‑sawwooh.
Wa agfil guluubhumwa nazzil laʼanatak fooghum.
Ya Allah,fi khadabak,gumm fooghumwa min tihit samaawaatak,kammilhum.
Ya l‑salaam !Al‑dahab yiwaddir loonah walla ?Wa l‑dahab al‑saafi yilkhayyar walla ?Wa l‑hujaar al‑mukhaddasiinchatto fi machbak al‑chawaariʼ.
Wa iyaal Sahyuun al‑khaaliyiin kulamisil al‑dahab al‑saafi.Wa maala bigo misil jiraar al‑tiineal‑sawwoohum al‑haddaad ?
Hatta al‑baʼaachiim yantu duyuudhumwa yiradduʼu iyaalhum.Wa laakin ummati al‑misil bitt ammima induhum mahannamisil naʼaamaayit al‑sahara.
Al‑atfaal lisneehum yibso min al‑atachwa l‑iyaal talabo akilwa laakin naadum al‑yantiihum ke ma fiih.
Al‑naas al‑awwal akalo akil adiilal‑yoom min al‑juuʼ daffago fi l‑chawaariʼwa l‑awwal ragado fi l‑hariir,al‑yoom ragado fi l‑baʼar.
Wa khata ummati al‑misil bitt ammiakbar min zunuub madiinat Saduumal‑tawwaali addammaratwa ma ligat fazaʼ.
Awwal kubaaraat ummati saafiyiin ziyaada min al‑baradwa ajsaamhum buyud karr min al‑labanwa samhiin misil al‑marajaanwa uruug jisimhum khudur misil al‑yaakhuut.
Wa hassaʼ kamaan,binchaafo zurug kurum misil al‑fahamwa ma binʼarfu fi chawaariʼ al‑madiinawa farwithum laasge fi udaamhumwa yaabse karr misil al‑uud.
Akheer tumuut be l‑seefmin tumuut be l‑juuʼwalla tabtul be bicheech bicheechmin gillit al‑maʼaach.
Wa halaak ummati al‑misil bitt ammilihig lahaddi l‑ammahaat al‑hanuunaatrakkaban iyaalhin wa bigo akilhin.
Wa Allah nazzal kulla zaʼalahwa khadabah al‑muhrig zaadahwa gabbad naar fi Sahyuun akalat asaasha.
Muluuk al‑aalam wa kulla naas al‑dunyaabadan ma yisaddugukadar al‑adu wa l‑khasiimyagdar yadkhul fi biibaan Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa da be sabab zanib al‑anbiyawa khata rujaal al‑diinal‑daffago damm al‑saalihiin fi ust al‑madiina.
Yiddaggacho fi chawaariʼ al‑madiinamisil amyaaniin.Wa munajjasiin be l‑dammhatta khulgaanhum ma yinlamsu min al‑najaasa.
Wa l‑naas biʼiitu wa buguulu : Angarʼu min al‑munajjasiin !Angarʼu !Angarʼu !Ma tilammusuuhum. Humman jaariyiinwa chaattiin fi lubb al‑umamwa laakin al‑aakhariin buguulu : Ma yaskunu fi usutna. 
Allah ma yidoor yichiifhum.Hu baan leehum wa chattataahum.Wa l‑chaʼab kula ma ahtaramo rujaal al‑diinwa ma karramo al‑chuyuukh.
Aniina nisanguʼu wa narfaʼo uyuunna.Min ween al‑fazaʼ yajiina ?Wa fi bakaanna hana l‑haraasa,arrajjeena umma al‑ma najjatna.
Wa udwaanna chaalo deribnalahaddi ma gidirna nuruukhu fi chawaariʼna.Nihaayitna garrabatwa ayyaamna anhasabo fi l‑asaabiʼ.Aywa,nihaayitna garrabat.
Wa udwaanna bigo ajiiliinmin suguura al‑sama.Taaradoona fi l‑jibaalwa karaso leena fi l‑kadaade.
Al‑malik al‑Allah masahah wa darrajah,hu misil ruuhnawa gulna niʼiichu tihtah maʼa l‑umam.Wa laakin al‑adu ramaah fi l‑charakwa karabah.
Aywa,afrahe wa adhake,ya Adoom al‑misil bineeyeal‑saakne fi balad al‑Uus.Inti tacharbe min kaas al‑taʼabwa taskare wa tagoodi aryaane.
Ya Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye,ma indiki khata khalaas.Battaan ma yiwadduuki fi l‑khurba.Wa leeki inti,ya Adoom al‑misil bineeye,Allah yiʼaakhibki be khataakiwa yakchif zunuubki.
Ya Allah,fakkir fi l‑bigi foognawa asmaʼ wa chiif eebna.
Al‑aakhariin chaalo warasat juduudnawa ajnabiyiin sakano fi buyuutna.
Wa bigiina ataama bala abbahaatwa ammahaatna bigo araamil.
Wa be gurus,nachru almi charaabnawa l‑hatab kula,nikaffu tamanah.
Wa l‑yidaayuguuna taʼʼaboonawa gaaʼidiin yitaaruduuna.Iyiina wa jumma ma indina.
Le l‑Masriyiin wa l‑Achuuriyiin,maddeena iideennawa dawwarna minhum maʼaachna.
Wa abbahaatna al‑aznabo kulluhumbigo ma fiihumwa laakin aniina chilnahimil khataahum.
Al‑abiid malako foognawa min iideehum,ma fi naadum al‑yamrugna.
Le nifattuchu al‑akil,nadkhulu fi l‑khutuuramaʼa rabbaatiin al‑duruub fi l‑sahara.
Wa min chiddit al‑juuʼ,wiridna.Jilidna bigi haami misil al‑furun.
Udwaanna ragado be gumaʼa awiin madiinat Sahyuun.Wa fi hillaal balad Yahuuza,banno al‑banaat be gu.
Wa humman allago masaaʼiilna min iideehumwa ma ahtaramo al‑chuyuukh.
Wa l‑chabaab chaaloal‑murhaaka al‑tagiilewa l‑subyaan attartaʼomin tagalat al‑hatab.
Wa l‑chuyuukh ma macho le l‑majlaswa l‑chabaab khallo khineehum.
Wa l‑farah waddar min guluubnawa liʼibna albaddal be hizin.
Wa taajna wagaʼ min raasna.Ya khasaaritna,da achaan aznabna.
Wa fi chaan da bas,guluubna wajaʼoonawa uyuunna ma bichiifu adiil.
Aywa,jabal Sahyuun khiribwa baʼaachiim saakniin foogah.
Ya Allah !Inta maalik ila l‑abadwa archak kula gaaʼidmin zurriiye le zurriiye.
Maala inta nisiitna daayman ?Wa maala khalleetna tuul al‑wakit ?
Ya Allah,akhbalnawa aniina nigabbulu leekwa jaddid gudritnamisil fi l‑zaman al‑faat.
Maala khidibt leena ziyaadawa rafadtina marra waahid ?
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑khaamis hana l‑chahar al‑raabiʼ fi l‑sana al‑talaatiin min umri,ana Hizgiyaal gaaʼid ambeen al‑naas al‑waddoohum fi l‑khurba fi balad Baabil jamb bahar Khaabuur.Wa l‑sama anfatahat wa ana chift ruʼya min al‑Rabb.
Wa da fi l‑yoom al‑khaamis hana l‑chahar da fi l‑sana al‑khaamse min waddo Yuyakiin malik mamlakat Yahuuza fi l‑khurba.
Wa hinaak fi balad Baabil gariib le bahar Khaabuur,Allah hajja leyi ana Hizgiyaal wileed Buuzi raajil al‑diin.Wa hinaak gudrat Allah gaaʼide foogi.
Wa daahu ana chift riih amzoobaʼaane jaaye min munchaakh.Wa jaabat sahaabaay kabiire muhawwaga be deyy al‑tamrug minha barraaga.Wa fi usutha fi cheyy yiraari misil nahaas saafi.
Wa fi lubb al‑sahaabaay,chift cheyy al‑yichaabih arbaʼa makhluugiin wa chakilhum misil chakil al‑insaan.
Wa ayyi makhluug indah arbaʼa wijih wa arbaʼa janaahe.
Wa rijleehum udul wa machchaayaathum misil dalaafe al‑ijil wa yiraaru misil nahaas saafi.
Wa tihit ayyi jinh,fiyah iid misil iid insaan.Ayyi naayit min nawaaytah al‑arbaʼa indah iid wa wijih wa jinh.
Wa ayyi makhluug,janaaheeh yilammusu maʼa janaahe al‑makhluug al‑aakhar.Wa wakit al‑makhluugiin yamchu,ma yinlaftu wa laakin yamchu adiil giddaamhum.
Wa ayyi makhluug indah arbaʼa wijih.Min giddaam,indah wijih hana insaan wa be l‑zeene,indah wijih hana duud wa be l‑isra,indah wijih hana toor wa min wara,indah wijih hana sagur.
Wa dool wujuuhhum.Wa ayyi makhluug indah janaahe itneen mumattatiin foog wa yilammusu maʼa janaahe al‑makhluug al‑aakhar.Wa janaaheeh al‑itneen al‑aakhariin kamaan,yikhatti beehum jismah.
Wa ayyi makhluug yamchi adiil giddaamah wa yamchi ale l‑jiihe al‑yamchi aleeha al‑ruuh.Wa ma yinlafit wakit hu maachi.
Wa l‑makhluugiin dool yichaabuhu jamur hana naar al‑tahrig wa yichaabuhu machaahiib al‑naar.Wa l‑naar di tamchi ambeen al‑makhluugiin dool.Wa l‑naar di tidawwi wa tamrug minha barraaga.
Wa l‑makhluugiin dool yamchu wa yaju be surʼa misil al‑barraaga.
Wakit ana gaaʼid nichiif fi l‑makhluugiin al‑induhum arbaʼa wijih dool,daahu chift jamb ayyi makhluug fiyah ajala fi l‑ard.
Wa l‑ajalaat biraaru misil sanaʼoohum be hajar khaali wa l‑ajalaat al‑arbaʼa dool bichchaabaho.Wa masnuuʼiin misil ajala waahide fi lubb ajala aakhara.
Wa wakit yamchu,yagdaro yamchu fi ayyi jiihe bala ma yinlaftu.
Wa daayir hana ayyi ajala,tuulah foog bikhawwif.Wa ayyi daayir muhawwag be uyuun.
Wa wakit al‑makhluugiin yamchu,al‑ajalaat kula yamchu maʼaahum.Wa wakit al‑makhluugiin yinrafʼu foog min al‑ard,al‑ajalaat kula yinrafʼu.
Wa l‑makhluugiin yamchu ale l‑jiihe al‑yamchi aleeha al‑ruuh wa l‑ajalaat kula yinrafʼu maʼaahum.Achaan ruuh al‑makhluugiin dool gaaʼide fi l‑ajalaat.
Wa wakit al‑makhluugiin yamchu,al‑ajalaat kula yamchu wa wakit yagiifu,al‑ajalaat kula yagiifu wa wakit yinrafʼu min al‑ard,al‑ajalaat kula yinrafʼu maʼaahum achaan ruuh al‑makhluugiin dool gaaʼide fi l‑ajalaat.
Wa min foog le ruuse al‑makhluugiin dool,fi cheyy gawi mafruuch wa hu ajiib,yiraari misil gazzaaz wa gaaʼid min foog le ruuse al‑makhluugiin.
Wa tihit al‑cheyy al‑mafruuch da,ayyi makhluug indah janaahe itneen yilammusu maʼa janaahe al‑makhluug al‑aakhar.Wa janaaheeh al‑itneen al‑aakhariin kamaan,yikhatti beehum jismah.
Wa wakit al‑makhluugiin maachiin,ana gaaʼid nasmaʼ harakat janaaheehum wa da misil harakat matara tagiile wa misil hiss al‑Gaadir wa misil hiss naas katiiriin wa misil harakat deech kabiir.Wa wakit yagiifu,yidallu janaaheehum.
Wa hiss jaayi min foog le l‑cheyy al‑gawi al‑mafruuch al‑gaaʼid min foog le ruuse al‑makhluugiin.
Wa min foog le l‑cheyy al‑gawi al‑mafruuch,fi cheyy yichaabih arch min hajar hana yaakhuut akhdar.Wa foog al‑arch da,fi chakil yichaabih insaan.
