Wa min sulbah lahaddi foog,ana chift kadar yiraari misil nahaas saafi wa muhawwag be naar.Wa min sulbah lahaddi tihit,ana chift deyy hana naar muhawwigah min kulli jiihe.
Wa l‑deyy al‑muhawwigah yichaabih hajjaaz al‑matar al‑yibiin fi l‑sahaab fi yoom al‑matar.Wa majd Allah hu misil ke.Wa wakit ana chiftah,wagaʼt be wijhi fi l‑ard wa simiʼt hiss gaaʼid yihajji.
Wa l‑hiss da gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam !Gumm be tuulak wa ana nihajji leek. 
Wa min hu hajja leyi al‑kalaam da,tawwaali al‑ruuh dakhal foogi wa waggafaani be tuuli wa ana gaaʼid nasmaʼ al‑yihajji leyi.
Wa l‑hiss gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,ana nirassilak le Bani Israaʼiil humman umma aasiye al‑gammat diddi.Humman wa juduudhum atmarrado diddi lahaddi l‑yoom.
Aywa,ana nirassilak le naas al‑wujuuhhum dulum wa guluubhum gawiyiin wa inta guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :
“Humman chaʼab aasiyiin.Kan yasmaʼook walla kan ma yasmaʼook kula,yaʼarfu tamaam kadar fi nabi gaaʼid fi usuthum.” ›
 Asmaʼ,ya ibn Adam,ma takhaaf minhum wa la takhaaf min kalaamhum.Achaan inta gaaʼid fi ust al‑naas al‑yangudu kalaamak wa humman misil chook wa agaarib al‑inta gaaʼid fooghum.Ma takhaaf min kalaamhum wa la min wujuuhhum achaan humman chaʼab aasiyiin.
Wa inta guul leehum kalaami kan yasmaʼooh walla ma yasmaʼooh kula achaan humman aasiyiin.
Ya ibn Adam,asmaʼ al‑nuguulah leek.Ma tabga misil al‑chaʼab al‑aasiyiin dool.Wa aftah khachmak wa aakul al‑cheyy al‑nantiih leek. 
Wa daahu chift iid mamduuda aleyi wa indaha kitaab malfuuf.
Wa fallat al‑kitaab da giddaami wa hu maktuub min jaay wa jaay.Wa maktuub foogah kalaam hana nuwaah wa hizin wa taʼab.
Wa l‑hiss gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,aakulah.Aakul al‑kitaab al‑malfuuf da wa amchi kallim le Bani Israaʼiil. 
Wa khalaas,ana fataht khachmi wa hu akkalaani al‑kitaab al‑malfuuf da.
Wa gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,amla batnak wa achbiʼ nafsak be l‑kitaab al‑malfuuf al‑ana gaaʼid nantiih leek da. Wa ana akaltah wa da bigi leyi halu fi khachmi misil asal.
Wa gaal leyi battaan : Ya ibn Adam,amchi le Bani Israaʼiil wa hajji leehum be kalaami.
Ana ma nirassilak le chaʼab al‑lukhkhithum gawiiye wa kalaamhum ma yinʼarif laakin nirassilak le Bani Israaʼiil.
Ana ma nirassilak le chuʼuub al‑lukhkhithum gawiiye wa kalaamhum ma yinʼarif hatta kan inta ma tafham kalaamhum kula.Kan ana rassaltak kula,akiid humman yasmaʼook.
Wa laakin Bani Israaʼiil ma yidooru yasmaʼook inta achaan humman ma yidooru yasmaʼooni ana.Wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil ruuseehum wa guluubhum kula gawiyiin.
Wa daahu ana nantiik wijih adlam ziyaada min wujuuhhum wa nigawwi raasak ziyaada min ruuseehum.
Wa nisawwi raasak gawi misil al‑maass wa l‑hajar.Ma takhaaf minhum wa la tinbahit giddaamhum achaan humman chaʼab aasiyiin. 
Wa l‑hiss gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,aftah adaanak wa ahfad fi galbak kulla l‑kalaam al‑nuguulah leek.
Yalla !Amchi le l‑naas al‑jaaboohum fi l‑khurba al‑humman iyaal chaʼabak wa hajji leehum.Wa kan yasmaʼook walla ma yasmaʼook kula,inta guul leehum :‹ Daahu kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.› 
Wa khalaas,Ruuh Allah rafaʼaani foog wa ana simiʼt hiss chadiid al‑buguul : Mubaarak majd Allah fi maskanah. 
Wa ana simiʼt harakat janaahe al‑makhluugiin al‑gaaʼidiin yindarbu ambeenaathum wa harakat al‑ajalaat al‑jambuhum wa di haraka chadiide.
Wa l‑ruuh rafaʼaani foog wa waddaani wa ana macheet be khadab chadiid fi nafsi.Wa gudrat Allah gaaʼide foogi be chidde.
Wa be da,ana jiit le l‑naas al‑jaaboohum fi l‑khurba al‑saakniin jamb bahar Khaabuur fi hillit Tall Abiib fi Baabil.Wa hinaak,ana gaʼadt sabʼa yoom mutahayyir fi usuthum.
Wa baʼad al‑sabʼa yoom da,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,ana nukhuttak haras fi Bani Israaʼiil.Kan simiʼt kalaam min khachmi,tihazzirhum beyah.
Wa kan nuguul le l‑aasi hu yumuut wa inta ma tihajji leyah wa la tihazzirah min derbah al‑fasil le hayaatah tanja,al‑aasi da kan yumuut fi khataayah,ana natlub dimmitah minnak.
Wa laakin kan inta hazzart al‑aasi wa hu aba ma yikhalli isyaanah walla derbah al‑fasil,khalaas hu yumuut fi khataayah wa laakin inta najjeet nafsak.
Wa kan naadum saalih gabbal min adaaltah wa gamma yisawwi zulum,ana nukhutt giddaamah hajar wa hu yintagga foogah wa yumuut.Wa kan inta ma hazzartah,khalaas hu yumuut be sabab zanbah wa ma yizzakkaro al‑adaala al‑hu sawwaaha awwal.Wa laakin minnak inta,ana natlub dimmitah.
Wa be l‑aks,kan inta hazzart naadum saalih le ma yaznib wa l‑naadum da ma aznab,khalaas hu yiʼiich achaan inta hazzartah.Wa inta kula najjeet nafsak. 
Wa fi l‑wakit da,gudrat Allah gaaʼide foogi wa hu gaal leyi : Gumm !Amchi al‑waadi wa ana nihajji leek. 
Wa ana gammeet wa macheet al‑waadi wa daahu ana chift majd Allah waagif misil al‑majd al‑ana chiftah fi khachum bahar Khaabuur.Wa khalaas,ana wagaʼt be wijhi fi l‑ard.
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal foogi wa gawwamaani be tuuli.Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal : Taʼaal wa sidd nafsak fi beetak.
Asmaʼ,ya ibn Adam,yijiibu hubaal wa yirabbutuuk wa battaan ma tamrug fi ust al‑naas.
Ana nilassig leek lisaanak fi sugʼak.Tabga abkam wa ma tagdar tuluumhum achaan humman chaʼab aasiyiin.
Wa laakin wakit nikallim leek,ana nufukk khachmak wa inta tihajji leehum wa tuguul :‹ Daahu kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.› Al‑yidoor yasmaʼ,khalli yasmaʼ wa l‑ma yidoor yasmaʼ,khalli ma yasmaʼ achaan humman chaʼab aasiyiin. 
Wa Allah gaal leyi battaan : Asmaʼ,ya ibn Adam,chiil diringeelaay wa khuttaha giddaamak wa arsim foogha suurat Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa fi l‑diringeelaay di,wassif hisaar al‑madiina wa abni diddaha khanaadig wa radmiiye wa khutt muʼaskar giddaamha wa hawwigha be maraadiis al‑yuduggu beehum biibaan al‑madiina.
Wa chiil saaja hint hadiid wa khuttaha beenak wa been al‑madiina misil durdur.Wa wajjih ale l‑madiina wa chiifha.Khalaas hi tilhaasar achaan inta khatteet al‑hisaar giddaamha.Wa di alaama le Bani Israaʼiil.
 Wa argud be l‑isra wa chiil foogak khata Bani Israaʼiil.Wa tichiil khataahum tuul al‑ayyaam al‑inta raagid fooghum be nussak da.
Wa ana nagtaʼ leek adad al‑ayyaam al‑muwaafig le adad al‑siniin hana khataahum.Wa be da,tichiil khata Bani Israaʼiil le muddit 390 yoom.
Wa baʼad tikammil al‑ayyaam dool,battaan targud be l‑zeene wa tichiil foogak khata Bani Yahuuza le muddit 40 yoom.Wa be da,nagtaʼ leek yoom waahid le ayyi sana hana khataahum.
Wa wajjih ale suurat Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑muhaasara wa midd duraaʼak makchuuf wa atnabbaʼ diddaha.
Wa daahu ana nirabbitak be hubaal achaan ma tagdar tichchaglab min nussak al‑waahid ale l‑aakhar lahaddi tikammil ayyaam al‑hisaar.
 Wa chiil gameh ahmar wa gameh abyad wa lubya wa adas wa dura wa gameh hana l‑kadaade wa khuttuhum fi maaʼuun waahid.Wa sawwi minhum khubza al‑taakulha fi muddit al‑ayyaam al‑inta raagid fooghum be nussak wa da le muddit 390 yoom.
Wa aklak al‑taakulah da be miiz misil malyit iid itneen fi l‑yoom wa da bas yabga aklak fi ayyi yoom.
Wa almi charaabak kula be miiz wa da misil rubuʼ kooro fi l‑yoom wa da bas yabga charaabak fi ayyi yoom.
Inta tisawwi kisaar hana gameh abyad al‑tisallilah giddaam kulla l‑naas fi naar al‑mugabbada be huraar hana naas. 
Wa Allah gaal battaan : Aywa,misil da Bani Israaʼiil yaakulu khubzithum al‑munajjasa wakit ana natrudhum wa yamchu fi l‑khurba fi ust al‑umam. 
Wa ana raddeet wa gult : Ya Allah al‑Rabb,be huraar hana naas !Abadan ana ma najjast nafsi min ana sakhayyar.Wa lahaddi l‑yoom,ana wa la akalt rimme wa la jiife hana haywaan mayyit.Wa fi khachmi,ma dakhkhalt laham fatiis. 
Wa hu gaal leyi : Kan ke da,khalaas gabbid naarak be baʼar al‑bagar fi badal huraar al‑naas wa inta sawwi beyah aklak. 
Wa gaal leyi battaan : Ya ibn Adam,ana nigallil al‑maʼaach fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa humman yaakulu al‑khubza be miiz wa hamm wa yacharbo almi kula be miiz wa khoof.
Wa be da,al‑khubza wa l‑almi yabgo ma fiihum.Wa ayyi waahid yahzan wa yabtul be sabab khataahum. 
 Wa inta,ya ibn Adam,chiil seef tariin wa astaʼmalah misil muus wa zayyin beyah raasak wa dignak.Wa baʼad da,chiil miizaan wa awzin suufak wa gassimah ale talaata bakaan.
Wa wakit ayyaam al‑hisaar yikammulu,chiil tilit al‑suuf da wa harrigah fi usut suurat al‑madiina di.Wa l‑tilit,adurbah be seefak wa hawwig beyah suurat al‑madiina.Wa l‑tilit,chattitah fi l‑riih achaan ana natrud chaʼabi be seefi.
Wa laakin chiil chiyya min al‑suuf da wa surrah fi khalagak.
Wa min al‑sarreetah da,chiil suuf chiyya wa harrigah fi l‑naar.Achaan tamrug naar didd kulla Bani Israaʼiil. 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Di bas Madiinat al‑Khudus !Ana khatteetha fi ust al‑umam wa l‑umam dool muhawwigiinha.
Wa sukkaanha iso gawaaniini be fasaala ziyaada min al‑umam wa iso churuuti ziyaada min al‑buldaan al‑muhawwigiinha.Wa da achaan humman rafado gawaaniini wa ma taabaʼo churuuti. 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Intu gammeetu be barjaal ziyaada min al‑umam al‑muhawwigiinku wa ma taabaʼtu churuuti wa la tabbagtu gawaaniini.Wa ma tabbagtu hatta gawaaniin al‑umam al‑muhawwigiinku ! 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Akiid ana kula gammeet diddiki,ya Madiinat al‑Khudus wa nihaakimki giddaam kulla l‑umam.
Wa be sabab kulla l‑haraam al‑sawweetiih,ana nisawwi foogki cheyy al‑abadan ma sawweetah wa abadan ma nisawwiih battaan.
Wa be da fi lubbiki,al‑abbahaat yaakulu iyaalhum wa l‑iyaal yaakulu abbahaathum.Ana nihaakimki wa l‑yifaddulu minki,nichattithum fi l‑riih. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Rabb : Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus,akiid inti najjasti beeti al‑mukhaddas be kulla muharramaatki wa asnaamki.Wa be sabab da,nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,ana kula nuguchchiki wa ma nichiifki be een al‑rahma wa la nihinn foogki.
Wa tilit sukkaanki yumuutu be l‑waba wa l‑juuʼ yikammilhum fi usutki.Wa l‑tilit yumuutu be l‑seef fi hawaaleeki wa l‑tilit nichattithum fi l‑riih wa natrudhum be l‑seef.
Ana ninazzil khadabi didduhum min bidaaytah lahaddi nihaaytah.Wa be da,humman yaʼarfu kadar da,ana Allah bas gultah fi khiirti lahaddi nitimm khadabi al‑chadiid didduhum.
 Wa ana nisawwiiki kharaab wa aaybe giddaam al‑umam al‑muhawwigiinki wa giddaam ayyi naadum al‑yufuut jambiki.
Wa ana nihaakimki be zaʼal wa khadab wa nuluumki luwaama chadiide.Wa l‑umam al‑muhawwigiinki,ya Madiinat al‑Khudus,yichchammato foogki wa yiʼayyuruuki.Wa inti tabge leehum masal mukhiif.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah.
 Wa nizarrig diddiki nachaachiib al‑juuʼ al‑fasil le yidammuruuki wa niziid foogki al‑juuʼ wa nigallil maʼaachki.
Wa nirassil leeki al‑juuʼ wa haywaanaat fasliin yaju yaakulu iyaalki.Wa l‑waba wa l‑unuf yiʼaddu beeki wa nigawwim al‑harib diddiki.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah. 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale jibaal Israaʼiil wa atnabbaʼ didduhum.
Wa guul :‹ Ya jibaal Israaʼiil !Asmaʼo kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb hajja le l‑jibaal wa l‑hujaar wa l‑rujuul wa l‑wudyaan wa gaal :“Daahu ana nijiib leeku al‑harib wa nihaddim bakaanaatku al‑aaliyiin hana ibaadat al‑asnaam.
Wa madaabihku yakhrabo wa makhaabirku yilkassaro wa ana narmi maytiinku giddaam asnaamku.” ›
 Wa ana nukhutt janaazaat Bani Israaʼiil giddaam asnaamku wa nichattit udaamku hawaale madaabihku.
Wa fi ayyi bakaan al‑taskunu foogah,al‑mudun yakhrabo wa l‑bakaanaat al‑aaliyiin yilhaddamo.Wa madaabihku yakhrabo wa yiddammaro wa asnaamku yilkassaro wa yagaʼo tihit wa makhaabirku yilkassaro wa khidmitku tiddammar.
Wa maytiinku yagaʼo fi usutku wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.
 Wa laakin ana nifaddil minku naas hayyiin ma yumuutu fi l‑harib wa nichattithum fi ust al‑umam.
Wa naasku al‑faddalo yizzakkarooni fi ust al‑umam fi l‑bakaan al‑waddoohum foogah fi l‑khurba.Wa ana nibaddil guluubhum al‑beehum baʼʼado minni wa achcharmato wara l‑asnaam wa uyuunhum al‑beehum achcharmato wara asnaamhum.Wa l‑eeb yakrubhum be sabab al‑fasaala al‑sawwooha wa be sabab kulla muharramaathum.
Wa be da,yaʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah wa kan gult nisawwi fooghum al‑fasaala di,da ma kalaam saakit. 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal leyi : Ya Hizgiyaal,adrub kaffeenak wa adrub be rijlak fi l‑turaab wa guul :‹ Ya khasaaritna !› Wa da fi chaan kulla l‑fasaala al‑muharrama al‑sawwooha Bani Israaʼiil.Wa hassaʼ,yumuutu be l‑harib wa l‑juuʼ wa l‑waba.
Wa l‑yamchu baʼiid yumuutu be l‑waba wa l‑gariibiin yumuutu be l‑harib wa l‑faddalo hayyiin yumuutu be l‑juuʼ lahaddi nitammim fooghum khadabi.
Wa be da,yaʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah wakit yichiifu maytiinhum giddaam asnaamhum wa hawaale madaabihhum wa foog ayyi hajar aali wa fi raas ayyi jabal wa tihit ayyi chadara khadra wa ayyi chadara dalma.Wa dool al‑bakaanaat al‑gaddamo fooghum dahaaya le asnaamhum le yardo be riihithum.
Ana nimidd iidi didduhum wa didd ayyi bakaan al‑yaskunu foogah.Wa l‑balad di min al‑sahara lahaddi Dibla,nisawwiiha kharaab wa jafaaf.Wa be da,yaʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah. 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Asmaʼ,ya ibn Adam !Daahu Allah al‑Rabb hajja le sukkaan balad Israaʼiil wa gaal :‹ Di hi al‑nihaaya !Al‑nihaaya taji fi l‑arbaʼa jiihaat hana l‑balad.
Wa hassaʼ,jaat nihaayitku intu.Ana nirassil khadabi didduku wa nihaakimku hasab deribku al‑chiltuuh wa nihammilku natiijat amalku al‑muharram.
Wa ma nichiifku be een al‑rahma wa la nihinn foogku achaan nihammilku natiijat deribku al‑chiltuuh wa kulla amalku al‑muharram yagood fi usutku.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.› 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Masiibe,masiibe al‑ma fi misilha,di hi jaaye !
Al‑nihaaya jaaye !Aywa,al‑nihaaya hi jaaye.Hi gammat didduku wa di hi jaaye !
Wa ikhaabku jaayi,ya sukkaan al‑balad !Wakitku jaayi,al‑yoom garrab wa da yoom hana barjaal wa ma hana farah fi l‑jibaal.
Wa hassaʼ,gariib ninazzil khadabi foogku min bidaaytah lahaddi nihaaytah.Wa nihaakimku hasab deribku al‑chiltuuh wa nihammilku natiijat kulla amalku al‑muharram.
Wa ma nichiifku be een al‑rahma wa la nihinn foogku achaan nihammilku hasab deribku al‑chiltuuh wa kulla amalku al‑muharram yagood fi usutku.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana Allah bas darabtuku.
 Wa daahu al‑yoom,daahu ikhaabku jaayi !Al‑unuf zaad wa l‑istikbaar kitir.
Wa l‑unuf gamma wa bigi asa hint fasaala.Ma fi cheyy yifaddil minhum wa harakathum kula tingatiʼ wa katarathum wa jamaalhum kula yabgo ma fiihum.
Wakitku jaayi,al‑yoom garrab !Khalli al‑yachri ma yafrah wa l‑yibiiʼ ma yahzan achaan al‑khadab al‑chadiid yidammir kulla naas al‑balad.
Wa l‑yibiiʼ ma yigabbil le budaaʼtah hatta kan hu hayy kula.Achaan ruʼyat al‑muhaakama di kula ma tafchul,hi didd kulla naas al‑balad.Wa ayyi naadum yiʼiich fi khataayah wa abadan ma yagdar yinajji nafsah.
Kan yadurbu al‑buug wa yijahhuzu silaahhum kula,naadum waahid kula ma yamchi le l‑harib achaan khadabi yidammir kulla naas al‑balad.
 Barra fi l‑kadaade,harib !Wa daakhal fi l‑madiina,waba wa juuʼ !Ayyi naadum al‑fi l‑kadaade yumuut be l‑harib wa ayyi naadum al‑fi l‑madiina yumuut be l‑waba wa l‑juuʼ.
Wa l‑faddalo minhum yiʼarrudu wa yajru yillabbado fi l‑jibaal.Wa kulluhum yabku be hizin misil gimri al‑waadi be sabab khataahum.
Kulla iideehum yinrakhuwa kulla rikabbuhum yumuuʼu.
Wa yalbaso khulgaan al‑hizinwa khoof chadiid yakrubhum.Wa l‑eeb binchaaf fi wujuuhhumwa kulla ruuseehum,yizayyunuuhum.
Wa yazgulu fuddithum fi l‑chawaariʼwa dahabhum yabga leehum misil najaasa.Dahabhum wa fuddithum ma yinajjuuhumfi yoom khadabi ana Allah.Humman ma yagdaro yarwu nufuushumwa la yamlo butuunhum.Dahabhum wa fuddithum al‑sawwoohum asnaambigo sabab khataahum.
Aywa,awwal humman astakbarobe sabab jamaal ziinithum.Wa be ziinithum,sawwo asnaamhum al‑muharramiinal‑yijiibu leehum al‑karaahiiyewa fi chaan da,nisawwi ziinithum nijse.
Wa nisallimha le l‑ajaanibwa humman yanhabooha.Wa nantiiha khaniime le aasiyiin al‑ardwa ma yajʼalooha.
Wa ana ma niwajjih ale chaʼabiwakit ma yihtarumu beeti al‑khaali leyi.Wa saraariig yadkhulu foogahwa ma yajʼalooh mukhaddas.
Sawwi janaaziir achaan al‑balad malaanebe muhaakamat kattaaliin al‑dimamwa l‑madiina malaane be l‑unuf.
Wa nijiib afsal umamachaan yichiilu buyuuthum.Wa niwaggif istikbaar al‑gawiyiinwa bakaanaathum hana l‑ibaada yinnajjaso.
Wa daahu al‑khoof chadiid jaayiwa humman yifattuchu al‑salaam wa ma yalgooh.
Wa taji masiibe wara masiibewa khabar cheen wara khabar cheen.Kan yifattuchu ruʼya min nabi kula,ma yalgoohawa raajil al‑diinma yiʼallim churuut al‑Tawraatwa l‑chuyuukh kulama induhum choora.
Wa l‑malik yahzanwa l‑cheekh yibarjilwa iideen al‑chaʼab yarjufu.Wa nihaakimhumhasab deribhum al‑chaaloohwa nichaariʼhumhasab al‑chariiʼa al‑sawwooha.Wa be da,yaʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah. 
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑khaamis hana l‑chahar al‑saadis fi l‑sana al‑saadse min waddoona fi l‑khurba,ana gaaʼid fi beeti.Wa fi l‑yoom da,chuyuukh Bani Yahuuza kula gaaʼidiin giddaami wa khalaas,gudrat Allah al‑Rabb nazalat foogi.
Wa tawwaali,ana chift ruʼya wa daahu ana chift cheyy yichaabih insaan.Wa min sulbah lahaddi tihit,hu hana naar.Wa min sulbah lahaddi foog,yiraari misil al‑nahaas al‑saafi.
Wa hu madda misil iid wa karabaani min suuf raasi.Wa l‑ruuh da rafaʼaani foog ambeen al‑sama wa l‑ard.Wa fi l‑ruʼya al‑min al‑Rabb di,hu waddaani fi beet Allah fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa hinaak,hu waddaani fi khachum al‑baab al‑mugaabil munchaakh hana l‑fadaay al‑dakhlaaniiye.Wa da l‑bakaan al‑yinlagi foogah sanam al‑khiira al‑yigawwim khiirat Allah.
Wa tawwaali,baan majd Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil misil al‑ruʼya al‑awwal ana chiftaha fi l‑waadi.
Wa hu gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,arfaʼ raasak wa chiif munchaakh. Wa ana rafaʼt raasi wa chift munchaakh wa daahu chift sanam al‑khiira munchaakh fi khachum al‑baab al‑yiwaddi le l‑madbah.
Wa hu gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,inta chift al‑cheyy al‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuh walla ?Wa chift al‑muharramaat al‑kubaar al‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuhum Bani Israaʼiil le yibaʼʼuduuni min beeti al‑mukhaddas walla ?Wa laakin tichiif muharramaat aakhariin kubaar ziyaada min dool ! 
Wa baʼad da,hu waddaani fi baab al‑fadaay al‑barraaniiye hana beet Allah wa daahu ana chift nugra fi l‑durdur.
Wa hu gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,gidd al‑durdur. Wa ana gaddeet al‑durdur wa khalaas,bigi derib.
Wa hu gaal leyi battaan : Adkhul wa chiif al‑muharramaat al‑fasliin al‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuhum hini ! 
Ana dakhalt wa daahu chift rasim hana kulla l‑zawaahif wa l‑haywaanaat al‑nijsiin marra waahid wa kulla asnaam Bani Israaʼiil marsuumiin fi ayyi bakaan fi l‑durdur.
Wa 70 raajil min chuyuukh Bani Israaʼiil al‑fi usuthum Yazanya wileed Chaafaan waagfiin giddaam al‑asnaam al‑marsuumiin dool.Wa ayyi waahid indah mukhbar fi iidah wa riihit al‑dukhkhaan gaaʼide tatlaʼ.
Wa hu gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,inta chift al‑cheyy al‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuh chuyuukh Bani Israaʼiil fi l‑dalaam,ayyi waahid giddaam sanamah walla ?Wa buguulu :‹ Allah ma yagdar yichiifna !Allah khalla baladna !› 
Wa hu gaal leyi : Laakin tichiif muharramaat aakhariin kubaar ziyaada min dool al‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuhum ! 
Wa hu waddaani fi khachum al‑baab al‑munchaakhi hana beet Allah.Wa fi l‑bakaan da,fi awiin gaaʼidaat tihit yabkan le ilaahhin al‑usmah Tamuuz.
Wa hu gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,inta gaaʼid tichiif walla ?Wa laakin tichiif muharramaat aakhariin kubaar ziyaada min dool ! 
Wa hu waddaani daakhal fi fadaayit beet Allah al‑dakhlaaniiye.Wa daahu fi khachum beet Allah ambeen khurfit al‑madkhal wa l‑madbah,fiyah hawaale 25 raajil.Anto duhuurhum le beet Allah wa wajjaho sabaah ale l‑harraay wa sajado leeha.
Wa hu gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,inta gaaʼid tichiif walla ?Da chiyya !Bani Yahuuza yisawwu muharramaat ziyaada min dool.Yikhaddubuuni wa yamlo al‑balad be l‑unuf wa yiʼayyuruuni muʼyaar khatiir !
Wa ana kula nakhdab didduhum wa ma nichiifhum be een al‑rahma wa la nihinn fooghum.Wa wakit yasrakho leyi,ana ma nasmaʼhum ! 
Wa Allah naada be hiss aali wa gaal : Taʼaalu intu al‑tiʼaakhubu al‑madiina !Wa khalli ayyi waahid yichiil silaahah hana l‑kharaab ! 
Wa daahu ana chift sitte rujaal jaayiin min al‑baab al‑aali al‑mugaabil munchaakh wa ayyi waahid indah silaahah hana l‑kharaab fi iidah.Wa fi usuthum,fiyah raajil waahid laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh wa indah khalam hana kuttaab fi sulbah.Kulluhum jo wa wagafo jamb al‑madbah hana l‑nahaas.
Wa majd Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil al‑gaaʼid min foog le l‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin gamma macha ale atabat al‑beet al‑mukhaddas.Wa naada al‑raajil al‑laabis khalag min gumaach sameh al‑indah khalam hana kuttaab fi sulbah.
Wa Allah gaal leyah : Amchi fi ust Madiinat al‑Khudus wa sawwi alaama fi jabhaat al‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin yaguntu wa yachku be sabab kulla l‑muharramaat al‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuhum fi lubbaha. 
Wa battaan simiʼt Allah gaal le l‑rujaal al‑aakhariin : Amchu wara l‑kaatib fi l‑madiina wa aktulu sukkaanha !Wa khalli ma tichiifuuhum be een al‑rahma wa la tihinnu fooghum.
Kharrubu wa aktulu al‑chiyyaab wa l‑subyaan wa l‑banaat wa l‑atfaal wa l‑awiin.Wa laakin ma tilammusu ayyi naadum al‑indah alaama fi jabhitah.Wa abdo min hini,min beeti al‑mukhaddas. Wa khalaas,bado be l‑katil hana l‑chuyuukh al‑gaaʼidiin giddaam beet Allah.
Wa hu gaal le l‑rujaal : Najjusu beeti wa amlo fadaayaatah be l‑maytiin !Yalla amchu ! Wa humman macho wa katalo naas fi l‑madiina.
Wa wakit gaaʼidiin yaktulu,ana gaaʼid wiheedi.Wa wagaʼt be wijhi fi l‑ard wa sarakht wa gult : Ya Allah Rabbi !Wakit tinazzil khadabak fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,hal tidammir kulla l‑faddalo min Bani Israaʼiil walla ? 
Wa hu gaal leyi : Khata Bani Israaʼiil wa Bani Yahuuza da kabiir marra waahid !Al‑balad anmalat be l‑damm wa l‑madiina anmalat be l‑zulum.Achaan humman gaalo :‹ Allah khalla baladna !Hu ma yagdar yichiifna ! ›
Wa be da,ma nichiifhum be een al‑rahma wa la nihinn fooghum.Wa nihammilhum kulla natiijat amalhum. 
Wa baʼad da,al‑raajil al‑laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh wa indah khalam hana l‑kuttaab fi sulbah gabbal jaab al‑natiija wa gaal : Ana sawweet kulla cheyy hasab amrak. 
Wa daahu ana chift al‑cheyy al‑gawi al‑mafruuch al‑gaaʼid min foog le ruuse al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin.Wa chift cheyy yichaabih arch min hajar hana yaakhuut akhdar.
Wa min al‑arch,Allah hajja wa gaal le l‑raajil al‑laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh : Adkhul fi lubb daayirat al‑ajalaat al‑tihit al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin.Wa amla iideenak jamur min been al‑makhluugiin dool.Wa chattit al‑jamur da fi l‑madiina. Wa ana chift al‑raajil da dakhal.
Wa wakit al‑raajil dakhal,al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin waagfiin wati le beet Allah.Wa sahaabaay malat al‑fadaay al‑dakhlaaniiye.
Wa majd Allah gamma min al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin wa macha ale atabat al‑beet.Wa l‑beet anmala be l‑sahaabaay wa l‑fadaay anmalat be nuur majd Allah.
Wa harakat janaahe al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin ansamaʼat lahaddi fi l‑fadaay al‑barraaniiye wa l‑haraka di misil hiss Allah al‑Gaadir wakit yihajji.
Wa wakit Allah amar al‑raajil al‑laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh wa gaal leyah yichiil jamur min lubb al‑daayira ambeen al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin,al‑raajil macha wagaf jamb al‑ajalaat.
Wa makhluug samaawi waahid madda iidah ale l‑naar ambeen al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin wa khamma jamur wa mala beyah iideen al‑raajil al‑laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh.Wa l‑raajil chaal al‑jamur wa marag.
Wa tihit janaahe al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin,fiyah iid misil iid insaan.
Wa daahu ana chift arbaʼa ajalaat jamb al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin,ayyi ajala jamb makhluug samaawi waahid.Wa l‑ajalaat dool biraaru misil sanaʼoohum be hajar khaali.
Wa l‑ajalaat al‑arbaʼa dool bichchaabaho wa masnuuʼiin misil ajala waahide fi lubb al‑aakhara.
Wa wakit yamchu,yagdaro yamchu fi ayyi jiihe bala ma yinlaftu.Yamchu ale l‑jiihe al‑yiwajjih aleeha al‑raas wa ma yinlaftu.
Wa kulla l‑jilid wa l‑dahar wa l‑iideen wa l‑janaahe hana l‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin wa l‑ajalaat al‑arbaʼa,kulluhum muhawwigiin be uyuun.
Wa simiʼt naado al‑ajalaat dool al‑ajalaat al‑yuduuru.
Wa ayyi makhluug samaawi indah arbaʼa wijih.Al‑wijih al‑waahid hana makhluug samaawi wa l‑wijih al‑waahid hana insaan wa l‑wijih al‑waahid hana duud wa l‑wijih al‑waahid hana sagur.
Wa baʼad da,al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin anrafaʼo foog.Wa dool nafs al‑makhluugiin al‑chiftuhum jamb bahar Khaabuur.
Wa wakit al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin yamchu,al‑ajalaat kula yamchu maʼaahum.Wa wakit al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin yimattutu janaaheehum le yinrafʼu min al‑ard,al‑ajalaat kula ma yinfargu minhum laakin yinrafʼu maʼaahum.
Wa wakit al‑makhluugiin yagiifu,al‑ajalaat kula yagiifu wa wakit yinrafʼu,al‑ajalaat kula yinrafʼu maʼaahum achaan ruuh al‑makhluugiin dool gaaʼide fi l‑ajalaat.
Wa baʼad da,majd Allah gamma min atabat al‑beet wa wagaf min foog le l‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin.
Wa khalaas,ana chift al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin mattato janaaheehum wa anrafaʼo min al‑ard wa macho sawa maʼa l‑ajalaat.Wa majd Allah wagaf fi khachum al‑baab al‑sabhaani hana beet Allah wa majd Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaaʼid min foog le l‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin.
Wa dool al‑makhluugiin al‑chiftuhum tihit Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil fi bahar Khaabuur wa irift kadar dool bas al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin.
Wa l‑arbaʼa makhluugiin samaawiyiin dool,ayyi waahid indah arbaʼa wijih wa arbaʼa janaahe wa tihit janaaheehum,fiyah iid misil iid insaan.
Wa wujuuhhum yichaabuhu wujuuh al‑makhluugiin al‑ana chiftuhum jamb bahar Khaabuur wa dool bas humman.Wa ayyi waahid yamchi adiil giddaamah.
Wa l‑ruuh rafaʼaani foog wa waddaani fi l‑baab al‑sabhaani hana beet Allah al‑mugaabil taluuʼ al‑harraay.Wa fi khachum al‑baab da,ana chift 25 raajil wa fi usuthum,chiif kubaaraat itneen hana l‑chaʼab wa humman Yaazanya wileed Azzuur wa Falatya wileed Banaaya.
Wa Allah gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,dool al‑rujaal al‑yikhattutu al‑zulum wa yiwassu be l‑fasaala fi l‑madiina di.
Wa humman yuguulu :‹ Yoom al‑ikhaab lissaaʼ baʼiid !Khalli nabnu buyuutna.Achaan al‑madiina di aamine misil burma wa aniina misil al‑laham al‑fi lubbaha. ›
Ya ibn Adam !Fi chaan kalaamhum da,atnabbaʼ didduhum !Aywa,atnabbaʼ .
Wa Ruuh Allah nazal foogi wa Allah gaal leyi : Hajji wa guul :‹ Daahu Allah gaal :“Ya Bani Israaʼiil,intu hajjeetu misil da.Wa l‑gaaʼid fi fikirku kula,ana naʼarfah.
Intu kattartu al‑katil fi l‑madiina di wa maleetu chawaariʼha be l‑janaazaat.”› 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Sahiih,al‑madiina di,hi misil burma wa laakin al‑janaazaat al‑daffagtuuhum fi lubbaha,humman bas al‑laham.Wa laakin leeku intu kamaan,ana namrugku minha.
Intu khaayfiin min al‑harib wa be da,ana nijiib leeku al‑harib.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Ana namrugku min al‑madiina wa nisallimku le l‑ajaanib wa niʼaakhibku.
Wa yaktuluuku be l‑seef lahaddi huduud balad Israaʼiil !Niʼaakhibku wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.
La,al‑madiina ma tabga leeku misil burma aamine wa intu ma tabgo misil laham fi lubbaha !Ana niʼaakhibku lahaddi huduud balad Israaʼiil.
Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.Intu ma taabaʼtu churuuti wa la tabbagtu gawaaniini wa laakin tabbagtu aadaat al‑umam al‑muhawwigiinku ! 
Wa wakit gaaʼid nitnabbaʼ,tawwaali Falatya wileed Banaaya maat.Wa ana wagaʼt be wijhi fi l‑ard wa sarakht be hiss aali wa gult : Ya Allah Rabbi,tidoor tikammil al‑faddalo min Bani Israaʼiil walla ? 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus gaaʼidiin yihajju le akhwaanak wa ahalak wa kulla Bani Israaʼiil al‑fi l‑khurba wa yuguulu :‹ Agoodu hinaak baʼiid min Allah.Achaan hassaʼ,al‑balad di antooha leena aniina warasa. ›
 Wa fi chaan da,guul le l‑naas al‑fi l‑khurba :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Hatta kan ana baʼʼadtuku fi l‑umam wa chattattuku fi l‑buldaan kula,hadarati bigat leeku misil beet mukhaddas fi ayyi balad al‑intu macheetu foogha.” ›
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Ana nilimmuku min ust al‑chuʼuub wa najmaʼku min al‑buldaan al‑intu muchattatiin fooghum wa nantiiku battaan balad Israaʼiil.
Wa intu taju foogha wa tibaʼʼudu minha kulla muharramaatha wa ayyi cheyy makruuh.
Wa nantiiku galib waahid wa nukhutt foogku ruuh jadiide.Wa namrug minku galibku al‑gawi misil al‑hajar wa nidiss leeku galib layyin hana insaan
achaan titaabuʼu churuuti wa tahfado gawaaniini wa titabbuguuhum.Wa be da,intu tabgo chaʼabi wa ana nabga Ilaahku.
Wa laakin al‑galibhum marbuut be l‑muharramaat wa ayyi cheyy makruuh,ana nihammilhum natiijat amalhum.”›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa baʼad da,al‑makhluugiin al‑samaawiyiin mattato janaaheehum wa l‑ajalaat kula macho maʼaahum wa majd Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaaʼid min foog leehum.
Wa majd Allah gamma min ust al‑madiina wa macha gaʼad foog fi l‑jabal sabaah le l‑madiina.
Wa fi l‑ruʼya di,Ruuh Allah rafaʼaani wa gabbalaani fi Baabil bakaan al‑naas al‑waddoohum fi l‑khurba.Wa baʼad da,al‑ruʼya al‑ana chiftaha anrafaʼat minni.
Wa ana kallamt le l‑naas al‑waddoohum fi l‑khurba be kulla cheyy al‑Allah wassafah leyi.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,inta gaaʼid fi usut chaʼab aasiyiin !Humman induhum uyuun le l‑choof wa laakin ma yichiifu wa induhum udne le l‑samaʼ wa laakin ma yasmaʼo achaan humman chaʼab aasiyiin.
Asmaʼ,ya ibn Adam,jahhiz khumaamak wa massil nafsak misil yiwadduuk fi l‑khurba wa tabga khariib.Wa sawwi al‑masal da be l‑nahaar giddaamhum.Wakit gaaʼidiin yichiifuuk,gumm min beetak wa massil nafsak misil khariib fi bakaan aakhar.Wa misil da,mumkin yaʼarfu kadar humman chaʼab aasiyiin.
Amrug khumaamak min beetak wa da misil khumaam al‑yiwaddu beyah fi l‑khurba.Wa sawwi al‑masal da be l‑nahaar giddaamhum.Wakit gaaʼidiin yichiifuuk,amrug be makhrib misil tamchi fi l‑khurba.
Wa giddaamhum bas,gidd durdur beetak wa amrug khumaamak be l‑khurma di.
Wa giddaamhum bas,chiilah fi kitfak wa amrug fi l‑dalaam.Wa khatti wijhak le ma tichiif al‑balad achaan ana nidoor nisawwiik masal le Bani Israaʼiil. 
Wa khalaas,ana sawweet misil Allah amaraani.Be nahaar,maragt khumaami min beeti wa da misil khumaami al‑yiwadduuni beyah fi l‑khurba.Wa be makhrib,gaddeet al‑durdur be iidi wa maragt khumaami fi l‑dalaam wa chiltah fi kitfi.Wa ana sawweet kulla l‑masal da giddaamhum.
Wa be fajur,Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,Bani Israaʼiil al‑chaʼab al‑aasiyiin gaalo leek :‹ Inta gaaʼid tisawwi chunu ? ›
Khalaas,guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Al‑muhaakama di jaaye min Allah didd malik Madiinat al‑Khudus wa le kulla Bani Israaʼiil al‑gaaʼidiin foogha.” ›
Wa guul leehum kadar inta bigiit leehum masal wa misil inta massaltah wa sawweetah,yisawwuuh fooghum wa yakurbuuhum wa yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba.
 Al‑malik hana Madiinat al‑Khudus yichiil khumaamah fi kitfah wa yamrug fi l‑dalaam be l‑khurma al‑yigidduuha fi l‑durdur.Wa hu yikhatti wijhah le ma yichiif al‑balad.
Wa ana nukujj leyah charaki wa hu yagaʼ foogah wa nakurbah wa niwaddiih fi balad al‑Baabiliyiin wa laakin hu ma yichiifha.Wa yumuut foogha.
Wa kulla naasah al‑muhawwigiinah wa l‑yiʼaawunuuh wa kulla askarah,nichattithum fi kulli jiihe wa natrudhum be l‑seef.
Wakit nichattithum been al‑umam wa nifarrighum fi ust al‑buldaan,khalaas humman yaʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa nifaddil waahidiin minhum al‑yanjo min al‑harib wa l‑juuʼ wa l‑waba achaan yihajju be kulla muharramaathum le l‑umam al‑yamchu ambeenaathum.Wa be da,khalaas yaʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah. 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,taakul maʼaachak be rajifiin wa tachrab almiik be barjala wa hamm.
Wa tuguul le chaʼab al‑balad :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb hajja le sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑gaaʼidiin fi balad Israaʼiil wa gaal :“Humman yaakulu maʼaachhum be hamm wa yacharbo almiihum be khoof achaan al‑ard takhrab wa tabga faadiye min kulla cheyy al‑foogha be sabab al‑unuf hana kulla sukkaanha.
Wa l‑mudun al‑maskuuniin yakhrabo wa l‑balad kula tabga kharaab.Wa be da,intu taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.”› 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,maala tihajju be l‑masal da al‑bukhuss balad Israaʼiil ?Al‑masal buguul :‹ Al‑ayyaam yutuulu wa ruʼya waahide kula ma tilhaggag. ›
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Ana namnaʼ al‑masal da wa battaan ma yihajju beyah fi Israaʼiil.”Wa laakin antiihum masal jadiid al‑buguul :“Al‑ayyaam yaju ajala wa ayyi ruʼya tilhaggag.
Achaan ma fi battaan ruʼya kidib walla chawwafaan khachch fi lubb Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa ana Allah kan gult chunu kula,yilhaggag bala taʼkhiir.Wa fi wakitku intu,ya l‑chaʼab al‑aasiyiin,ana nihaggig kalaami al‑ana gultah.”›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,daahu Bani Israaʼiil yuguulu :‹ Al‑ruʼya al‑chaafha al‑raajil da ma hana ayyaam gariibiin.Hu yitnabbaʼ le wakit baʼiid. ›
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Ma fi kilme waahide kula min kalaami tiʼakhkhir.Kulla kalaami al‑gultah yilhaggag.”›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,atnabbaʼ didd anbiya Israaʼiil al‑yitnabbaʼo be kidib.Aywa humman al‑yitnabbaʼo hasab kalaam galibhum bas,guul leehum ke :‹ Asmaʼo kalaam Allah.
Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :Al‑azaab le l‑anbiya al‑mataamiis al‑yitaabuʼu afkaarhum bala ma chaafo ruʼya.
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,anbiyaaku bigo misil al‑baʼaachiim fi ust al‑kharaab.
Humman ma saddo al‑khurma wa la bano durdur le Bani Israaʼiil achaan yagdaro yasbutu fi l‑harib fi yoom Allah.
Humman yichiifu ruʼya saakit wa yichawwufu be kidib wa yuguulu :“Da kalaam Allah.”Wa laakin ana Allah ma rassaltuhum.Wa battaan humman yahsubu kadar ana nihaggig kalaamhum !
Ya l‑anbiya !Al‑ruʼya al‑chiftuuha di saakit wa chawwafaanku da kula kidib.Achaan intu tuguulu :“Da kalaam Allah.”Wa laakin ana ma kallamt !› 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Achaan intu hajjeetu saakit wa chawwaftu be kidib,akiid ana nugumm didduku.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa ana narfaʼ iidi didd al‑anbiya al‑yichiifu ruʼya saakit wa yichawwufu be kidib.Humman dool ma yahdaro fi malammat chaʼabi wa asaameehum ma yissajjalo fi kitaab Bani Israaʼiil wa humman ma yigabbulu fi balad Israaʼiil.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah al‑Rabb.
 Wa nisawwi misil da achaan humman waddaro chaʼabi wakit gaalo :‹ Salaam › wa laakin ma fi salaam.Wa da misil chaʼabi induhum durdur muchaggag wa humman yitallusuuh be buhya.
Guul le l‑yitallusuuh be l‑buhya :‹ Durdurku da yagaʼ !Matara chadiide taji wa barad yidaffig wa riih chadiide tichaggigah. ›
Ya l‑anbiya,kan al‑durdur wagaʼ,al‑naas yuguulu leeku :‹ Ween al‑buhya al‑tallastuuh beeha ?› 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Fi khadabi,ana nijiib riih chadiide al‑tichaggig wa fi zaʼali,matara chadiide taji wa barad mudammir yidaffig.
Wa ana nahdim al‑durdur al‑tallastuuh be buhya wa narmiih fi l‑turaab wa asaasah yibiin.Wa l‑durdur da yagaʼ wa yarhakku tihtah.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa ana nihaggig khadabi didd al‑durdur wa l‑naas al‑tallasooh be buhya.Wa nuguul :‹ Battaan ma fi durdur wa l‑naas al‑tallasooh kula ma fiihum !
Wa battaan ma fi anbiya fi Israaʼiil al‑yitnabbaʼo be Madiinat al‑Khudus wa yichawwufu leeha be l‑salaam wa ma fi salaam !›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 Asmaʼ,ya ibn Adam.Wajjih ale awiin chaʼabak al‑gaaʼidaat yitnabbaʼan hasab kalaam guluubhin bas wa atnabbaʼ diddihin.
Wa guul leehin :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Al‑azaab le l‑awiin al‑yikhayyitan chadar fi gitʼe misil waraga le yarbutannah fi iid ayyi naadum.Aywa,al‑azaab leehin al‑yisawwan tarhaat hana sihir le ayyi naadum hasab al‑yakfi leyah wa da le yaakulan ruuh al‑naas.Hal tidooran taakulan ruuh chaʼabi le tiʼiichan beehum walla ?
Wa intan ma ahtaramtanni giddaam chaʼabi wa da le talgan malyit iid hana gameh wa lugma hint khubza.Wakit takdiban le chaʼabi al‑yiriidu yasmaʼo al‑kidib,intan taktulan al‑naas al‑waajib leehum al‑haya wa tikhallan hayyiin al‑naas al‑waajib leehum al‑moot.”› 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Akiid ana nugumm didd waragaatkan hana l‑chadar al‑taakulan beehum ruuh al‑naas.Ana nicharrithum min iideekan wa nikhalli ruuhhum al‑tidooran taakulanha tanja wa tamchi.
Wa nicharrit tarhaat sihirkan wa ninajji chaʼabi min iideekan wa battaan humman ma yagaʼo fi charakkan.Wa be da,taʼarfan kadar ana bas Allah.
Be kidibkan,gataʼtan acham guluub al‑saalihiin wa laakin ana ma dawwart nibarjilhum.Wa lazzeetan al‑aasiyiin achaan ma yigabbulu min deribhum al‑fasil wa yalgo al‑haya.
Wa fi chaan da,battaan intan ma tichiifan ruʼya saakit wa la tichawwifan.Wa ana ninajji chaʼabi min iideekan.Wa be da,taʼarfan kadar ana bas Allah. 
Wa waahidiin min chuyuukh Bani Israaʼiil al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑khurba jo leyi wa gaʼado giddaami.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,al‑rujaal dool galibhum muʼallag fi asnaamhum.Humman khatto giddaamhum cheyy al‑yilizzuhum fi l‑khata.Hal nasmaʼ suʼaalhum walla ?
Wa fi chaan da,guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Ayyi naadum min Bani Israaʼiil al‑galbah muʼallag fi asnaamah wa yukhutt giddaamah cheyy al‑yilizzah fi l‑khata wa baʼad da,yamchi le l‑nabi le yasʼalni,ana Allah bas nurudd leyah.Nurudd leyah hasab katarat asnaamah.
Aywa,nakrub guluub Bani Israaʼiil achaan humman kulluhum abooni be sabab asnaamhum.” ›
 Wa fi chaan da,guul le Bani Israaʼiil :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Taʼaalu gabbulu min asnaamku wa khallu kulla muharramaatku.
Kan naadum min Bani Israaʼiil aw min al‑ajaanib al‑saakniin ambeenaathum yibaʼʼid minni wa yiʼallig galbah fi asnaamah wa yukhutt giddaamah cheyy al‑yilizzah fi l‑khata wa baʼad da,yamchi le l‑nabi le yasʼalni,khalaas al‑naadum da,ana Allah bas nurudd leyah.
Wa l‑naadum da,ana nugumm diddah wa nisawwiih alaama wa masal le l‑naas wa nafsulah min chaʼabi.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.
 ‹ “Wa kan al‑nabi yukhuchch nafsah wa yurudd le l‑naadum da be ayyi kalaam,ana Allah bas khachcheetah le l‑nabi da.Wa ana narfaʼ iidi diddah wa nidammirah min usut chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa l‑nabi wa l‑naas al‑yasmaʼooh yilhammalo natiijat khataahum.Wa khata al‑naas al‑macho saʼalo Allah yabga misil khata al‑nabi.
Wa be da,Bani Israaʼiil ma yiwadduru baʼiid minni wa battaan ma yinnajjaso be isyaanhum.Wa khalaas,humman yabgo chaʼabi wa ana nabga Ilaahhum.”›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,akuun balad waahide tisawwi zanib hana khiyaana diddi wa ana nimidd iidi le nadrubha wa nigallil al‑maʼaach wa nirassil leeha al‑juuʼ le naktul al‑naas wa l‑bahaayim.
Hatta kan al‑rujaal al‑talaata dool Nooh wa Danyaal wa Ayyuub gaaʼidiin fi lubb al‑balad di kula,humman yinajju illa nufuushum bas be adaalithum.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 Wa akuun nirassil haywaanaat fasliin fi l‑balad di achaan yaakulu iyaalha wa l‑balad tabga kharaab wa ma fi naadum yuchuggaha be sabab al‑haywaanaat dool.
Hatta kan al‑rujaal al‑talaata dool gaaʼidiin fi lubb al‑balad di kula,nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,humman ma yinajju wa la bitt wa la walad.Yinajju illa nufuushum bas wa l‑balad di tabga kharaab.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 Wa akuun nijiib al‑harib fi l‑balad di wa nikharrir kadar al‑harib yugumm foogha wa yaktul al‑naas wa l‑bahaayim.
Hatta kan al‑rujaal al‑talaata dool gaaʼidiin fi lubb al‑balad di kula,nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,humman ma yinajju wa la bitt wa la walad.Yinajju illa nufuushum bas.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 Wa akuun nirassil al‑waba fi l‑balad di wa ninazzil foogha khadabi al‑yidaffig dammuhum wa yaktul al‑naas wa l‑bahaayim.
Hatta kan Nooh wa Danyaal wa Ayyuub gaaʼidiin fi lubb al‑balad di kula,nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,humman ma yinajju wa la bitt wa la walad.Yinajju illa nufuushum bas be adaalithum. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Hatta kan rassalt didd Madiinat al‑Khudus ikhaabi al‑arbaʼa al‑chadiid,wa humman al‑harib wa l‑juuʼ wa l‑haywaanaat al‑fasliin wa l‑waba le yaktulu al‑naas wa l‑bahaayim,
daahu fiyah naas waahidiin yifaddulu.Rujaal wa awiin kula,yamurguuhum min al‑madiina wa humman yaju leeku hini fi Baabil.Wa intu zaatku taʼarfu deribhum wa amalhum al‑fasliin.Wa khalaas,tisabburu nufuusku fi chaan al‑fasaala al‑ana jibtaha fi Madiinat al‑Khudus wa kulla l‑ikhaab al‑jibtah foogha.
Wa tisabburu nufuusku wakit taʼarfu deribhum wa amalhum al‑fasliin.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar da ma bala sabab ana haggagt kulla l‑ikhaab da fi l‑madiina. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,hal hatab chadarat al‑inab ahsanmin hatab al‑chadara al‑aakhara ?Walla furuuʼah ahsanmin furuuʼ chadar al‑khaaba ?
Hal hi indaha hatabal‑yagdaro yakhdumu beyah ?Walla yagtaʼo minha chiʼbeal‑yiʼallugu foogha maaʼuun ?
La !Daahu zagalo hatabha fi l‑naar basle taakulah.Baʼad al‑naar akalat al‑tarafeenwa l‑usut kula hirig,hal hi tanfaʼ battaan le ayyi khidme ?
Daahu wakit hi gaaʼide be tammitha,ma khadamo beeha cheyy.Wa baʼad al‑naar akalatha,yakhdumu beeha chunu ? 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Chadarat al‑inabbeen chadar al‑khaaba,ana zagaltaha fi l‑naarwa l‑naar haragatha.Wa be misil da,nahrigsukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Ana nugumm didduhum.Humman yahsubu yamurgu min al‑naarwa laakin al‑naar tahrighum.Wa wakit nugumm didduhum,khalaas taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa ana nisawwi al‑balad di kharaabachaan humman khaanooni. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,arrif le Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑muharramaat al‑hi sawwathum.
Wa guul le Madiinat al‑Khudus :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Gaʼarki wa bakaan wildooki kulla ke fi balad Kanʼaan.Abuuki min gabiilat al‑Amuuriyiin wa ammiki min gabiilat al‑Hittiyiin.
Wa yoom wildooki,ma gataʼo surritki wa la barradooki be almi le tabge nadiife wa la daʼʼakooki be mileh wa la laffooki be farde.
Wa ma fi naadum rahamki wa la hanna foogki.Laakin fi yoom wildooki,zagalooki fi l‑kadaade achaan bigiiti iife.
 ‹ “Wa laakin ana faayit jambiki wa chiftiki mulmarmikhe fi lubb dammiki.Wa be dammiki kula,ana gult leeki waajib tiʼiichi.Aywa,waajib tiʼiichi.
Wa ana gawwamtiki misil nabaat al‑kadaade.Wa inti sabatti wa kibirti wa bigiiti jamiile marra waahid.Wa duyuudki gammo wa suuf jilidki kula gamma wa laakin inti aryaane marra waahid.
Wa baʼad da,ana faayit jambiki battaan wa daahu chift inti tammeeti,aywa,tammeeti le l‑akhiide.Wa ana matteet daayir khalagi foogki wa khatteet ireeki.Wa ana halaft leeki wa karabt raaski wa sawweet maʼaaki muʼaahada wa gult inti hinti.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 ‹ “Wa ana barradtiki wa naddaftiki min dammiki al‑foogki wa baʼad da,massahtiki be dihin muʼattar.
Wa ana labbastiki khulgaan mukallafiin wa naʼaal min farwit ijil al‑bahar wa laffeetki be gumaach kattaan wa khatteetki be hariir.
Wa jammaltiki be ziina,be suure fi iideeki wa kijeel fi ragabatki
wa chinif fi munkharki wa khuruus fi udneeki wa taaj jamiil fi raaski.
Wa ziinitki min dahab wa fudda wa khulgaanki min gumaach kattaan wa hariir wa gitʼe mukallafa.Wa akalti dagiig wa asal wa dihin.Wa inti bigiiti jamiile marra waahid misil malika.
Wa usumki bigi aali fi ust al‑umam achaan jamaalki kaamil be sabab al‑ziina al‑ana jammaltiki beeha.”›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 ‹ “Wa laakin inti atwakkalti ale jamaalki wa ale usumki al‑aali wa achcharmatti.Sawweeti charmatatki maʼa ayyi naadum al‑faayit wa bigiiti hintah.
Wa chilti min khulgaanki al‑mulawwaniin wa jammalti beehum bakaanaat aaliyiin hana ibaada wa achcharmatti fooghum.Wa cheyy misil da abadan ma bigi wa abadan ma yabga battaan !
Wa inti chilti al‑ziina hana l‑dahab wa l‑fudda al‑ana anteethum leeki wa sawweeti beehum asnaam dukuura wa achcharmatti maʼaahum.
Wa chilti khulgaanki al‑mukallafiin wa labbastiihum le l‑asnaam dool wa gaddamti leehum dihni wa bakhuuri.
Wa khubziti al‑anteetha leeki wa l‑dagiig wa l‑dihin wa l‑asal al‑ana akkaltuhum leeki,inti chiltiihum wa gaddamtiihum hadaaya le asnaamki le yardo be riihithum.Wa da bas al‑sawweetiih !Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 ‹ “Wa chilti awlaadki wa banaatki al‑wilidtiihum leyi wa gaddamtiihum dahaaya le l‑asnaam dool le yaakuluuhum.Wa min al‑charmata,ma chibiʼti walla ?
Inti dabahti iyaali wa harragtiihum wa gaddamtiihum le asnaamki.
Wa fi kulla muharramaatki wa charmatatki,ma fakkarti fi ayyaam chabaabki wakit al‑inti aryaane marra waahid wa mulmarmikhe fi dammiki.
 ‹ “Wa baʼad kulla fasaalitki,al‑azaab leeki !Aywa,al‑azaab jaaki !Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa inti baneeti ligdaabe wa sawweeti bakaan aali hana ibaada fi ayyi nagaʼa.
Fi dakhuul ayyi derib,baneeti bakaan aali wa astaʼmalti jamaalki fi l‑amal al‑muharram.Wa gaddamti nafiski le ayyi naadum al‑faayit wa kattarti charmatatki.
Wa achcharmatti maʼa l‑Masriyiin jiiraanki al‑ajsaamhum kubaar wa kattarti charmatatki le tikhaddibiini.
Wa daahu ana rafaʼt iidi diddiki wa gallalt maʼaachki.Wa sallamtiki le udwaanki al‑kirhooki wa l‑eeb karab banaat al‑Filistiyiin kula be sabab fiʼilki al‑cheen.
Wa inti ma chibiʼti min al‑charmata lahaddi achcharmatti maʼa naas balad Achuur.Aywa,achcharmatti maʼaahum wa be da kula,ma chibiʼti.
Wa kattarti charmatatki min balad Kanʼaan lahaddi balad Baabil wa be da kula,inti ma chibiʼti abadan min al‑charmata !
 ‹ “Akiid ma gidirti fi galibki !Sawweeti kulla l‑achya dool wa humman amal hana charmuuta kabiire.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa baneeti ligdaabe fi dakhuul hana kulla l‑duruub wa sawweeti bakaan aali hana ibaada fi ayyi nagaʼa.Wa ma chilti taman charmatatki misil al‑charaamiit al‑aakharaat.
La !Inti misil mara zaaniye al‑tifattich rujaal aakhariin bala raajilha !
Fi l‑aade,yantu hadaaya le l‑charaamiit.Wa laakin inti anteeti hadaaya le kulla sudgaanki !Aywa,inti kaffeetiihum le yaju leeki min ayyi bakaan wa yichcharmato maʼaaki.
Fi charmatatki,inti ma sawweeti misil al‑awiin al‑aakharaat.Ma fattachooki inti laakin inti bas kaffeetiihum !Sawweeti al‑aks !”› 
Wa fi chaan da,asmaʼe kalaam Allah,ya l‑charmuuta !
Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Chahwaatki ziyaada fi ayyi wakit wa kachafti ireeki wakit gaaʼide tichcharmate maʼa sudgaanki wa maʼa kulla asnaamki al‑muharramiin.Hatta damm iyaalki kula anteetiih leehum.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nilimm kulla sudgaanki al‑ajabtiihum wa kulla l‑habbeetiihum wa kulla l‑kirihtiihum.Aywa,ana nilimmuhum min ayyi jiihe diddiki.Wa giddaamhum,nakchif ireeki wa humman yichiifuuki aryaane.
Wa nihaakimki hukum al‑awiin al‑zannaayaat wa kattaalaat al‑dimam.Wa min chiddit khadabi wa khiirti,nikhattiiki be damm.
Wa nisallimki le sudgaanki wa humman yidammuru lagaadiibki wa yahdumu bakaanaatki al‑aaliyiin hana l‑ibaada.Wa yisillu minki khulgaanki wa yanhabo ziinitki al‑khaaliye wa yikhalluuki aryaane marra waahid.
Wa yigawwumu al‑mujtamaʼ diddiki wa yarjumuuki wa yigattuʼu laham jilidki be l‑seef.
Wa yiharrugu buyuutki wa yichaaruʼuuki giddaam awiin katiiraat.Wa ana niwaggif charmatatki wa battaan ma tagdare tikaffi sudgaanki.
 Wa nitimm khadabi foogki.Wa baʼad da,nibaʼʼid minki khiirti wa nabga haadi wa battaan ma nakhdab.
Achaan inti ma fakkarti ayyaam chabaabki wa gammeeti diddi be kulla fiʼilki al‑cheen da.Wa khalaas,daahu ana nihammilki natiijat amalki.Inti sawweeti muharramaatki wa zidti fooghum fiʼilki al‑cheen ! Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 Chiifi !Yadurbu foogki masal al‑buguul :‹ Al‑bineeye misil ammaha. ›
Inti bineeyit al‑mara al‑kirhat raajilha wa iyaalha.Wa inti akhut al‑akhwaat al‑kirhan rujaalhin wa iyaalhin.Aywa,ammiki min gabiilat al‑Hittiyiin wa abuuki min gabiilat al‑Amuuriyiin.
Wa akhutki al‑kabiire hi madiinat al‑Saamira al‑gaaʼide munchaakh minki maʼa banaatha.Wa tariiditki hillit Saduum al‑gaaʼide junuub minki maʼa banaatha.
Inti ma chilti derib akhwaatki bas wa la sawweeti muharramaat misilhin.La,da inti chifti chiyya leeki !Inti hilikti ziyaada minhin be kulla fiʼilki al‑cheen. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Rabb : Nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy !Saduum akhutki wa banaatha ma sawwan fiʼil cheen ziyaada min al‑inti wa banaatki sawweetannah.
Wa daahu khata akhutki Saduum.Hi mustakbire wa chabʼaane be l‑akil wa ma indaha hamm wa gaaʼide fi l‑raaha,hi wa banaatha.Wa laakin hinna ma saaʼadan ayyi naadum miskiin wa la daʼiif.
Hinna bigan mustakbiraat wa sawwan al‑cheyy al‑ana jaʼaltah muharram.Wa ana dammartihin wakit chift al‑cheyy da.
Wa l‑Saamira ma sawwat nuss zunuubki kula wa inti kattarti muharramaatki ziyaada min hineeha.Wa sawweeti akhwaatki misil awiin saalhaat be kulla muharramaatki al‑inti sawweetiihum !
Wa hassaʼ da,alhammale eebki.Wa inti sawweeti akhwaatki misil awiin saalhaat wa da be sabab zunuubki al‑muharramiin ziyaada min hineehin.Hinna bigan saalhaat ziyaada minki.Dangiri raaski wa alhammale eebki achaan akhwaatki saalhaat ziyaada minki.
 Yoom waahid,ana nikhayyir leehin haalithin.Aywa,nikhayyir haalit Saduum wa banaatha wa l‑Saamira wa banaatha.Wa nikhayyir haalitki inti kula maʼaahin.
Fi l‑yoom da,tilhammale eebki wa takhjale fi kulla cheyy al‑sawweetiih wa da yisabbirhin.
Wa akhutki Saduum wa banaatha yigabbilan fi haalithin al‑zamaan.Wa akhutki al‑Saamira wa banaatha yigabbilan fi haalithin al‑zamaan.Wa inti wa banaatki kula tigabbilan fi haalitkan al‑zamaan.
Wa fi wakit istikbaarki,inti chammatti fi akhutki Saduum.
Wa da gubbaal fasaalitki ma tibiin.Wa hassaʼ da,doorki ja.Banaat al‑Araamiyiin wa kulla jaaraathin yiʼayyibanki wa banaat al‑Filistiyiin yahgiranki min kulla jiihe.
Wa inti tilhammale natiijat fiʼilki al‑cheen wa muharramaatki. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Inti gataʼti haliifitki wa nagadti muʼaahadatki maʼaayi.Wa hassaʼ,ana nisawwi foogki misil inti sawweeti foogi.
Wa ana nifakkir fi muʼaahadati al‑sawweetha maʼaaki fi ayyaam chabaabki wa nisabbit maʼaaki muʼaahadati al‑daayme.
Wa tifakkiri fi amalki wa l‑eeb yakrubki wakit tigaabili akhutki al‑kabiire maʼa akhutki al‑sakhayre.Wa ana nantiihin leeki misil banaat wa laakin ma yichaarikan fi l‑muʼaahada.
Wa nisabbit muʼaahadati maʼaaki.Wa be da,taʼarfi kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa wakit tifakkiri fi l‑faat,al‑eeb yakrubki wa battaan ma tagdare tufukki khachumki achaan inti waddarti charafki.Wa laakin ana nakhfir leeki kulla cheyy al‑sawweetiih. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,hajji hijjeeye wa adrub masal le Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Fiyah sagur waahid kabiiral‑janaaheeh kubaarwa riichah tuwaalwa suufah katiir wa mulawwan.Wa l‑sagur da,macha jibaal Lubnaanwa chaal raas chadarat al‑arz.
Aywa,hu gataʼ firiʼwa waddaah fi balad Kanʼaanwa khattaah fi madiinat al‑tujjaar.
Wa chaal habba waahide min al‑balad kulawa teerabha fi zereʼ le tugummmisil chadarat ganajamb almi al‑katiir.
Wa l‑habba di gammatwa bigat chadarat inab al‑gaaʼide tasrah.Wa furuuʼha maddathum le l‑sagur dawa uruugha gaaʼidiin tihtah.Wa hi bigat chadarat inabwa sawwat furuuʼwa gawwamat warag.
 ‹ “Wa laakin fiyah sagur aakhar kabiiral‑janaaheeh kubaar wa riichah katiir.Wa daahu chadarat al‑inab diwajjahat uruugha ale l‑sagur al‑aakhar dawa maddat furuuʼha aleyah.Hi dawwarat hu yazgiihabarra min al‑bakaan al‑magganooha foogah.
Wa da bakaan adiilwa jamb almi katiir.Magganooha le tisawwi furuuʼwa talda fawaakihwa tabga chadarat inab aziime.”› 
 Wa guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Hal chadarat al‑inab di tanjah walla ?La !Al‑sagur al‑awwalaani yamlutha be uruughawa fawaakihha kula yagtaʼhum.Wa hi tamrad wa taybaswa kulla bizritha tumuut.Wa da ma be iid gawiiyewa la be deech kabiirkadar yamultuuha be uruugha.
Wa kan magganooha battaan,hal hi tanjah walla ?Wa kan riih al‑sabaah tihijjaha,hi taybas marra waahid,aywa,taybas fi l‑bakaan al‑magganooha foogah.”› 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Guul le l‑chaʼab al‑aasiyiin dool :‹ Ma iriftu maʼana al‑masal da walla ?Daahu al‑tafsiir.Malik Baabil ja fi Madiinat al‑Khudus wa karab malikha wa kubaaraatha wa waddaahum maʼaayah fi Baabil.
Wa darraj waahid min zurriiyit al‑muluuk fi mamlakat Yahuuza wa sawwa maʼaayah muʼaahada wa hallafah.Wa chaal kubaaraat al‑balad wa waddaahum fi l‑khurba
achaan al‑mamlaka tagood sakhayre wa ma tagdar tittawwar wa tahfad muʼaahadatah le tasbit.
 ‹ Wa laakin al‑malik da atmarrad didd malik Baabil.Hu rassal naasah le Masir achaan yantuuh kheel wa askar katiiriin.Hal malik misil da yanjah walla ?Hal naadum al‑sawwa muʼaamara misil di yanja walla ?Hal hu al‑nagad al‑alaakha di yanja walla ?
Nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,akiid al‑malik da yumuut fi Baabil balad al‑malik al‑darrajah achaan hu gataʼ haliiftah wa nagad alaakhtah.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa kan malik Masir yantiih deech kabiir wa askar katiiriin kula,da ma yisaaʼidah fi l‑harib wakit askar Baabil yilimmu turaab wa yabnu radmiiye le l‑hisaar le yaktulu naas katiiriin.
Al‑malik da gataʼ haliiftah wa nagad muʼaahadatah al‑hu mada foogha wa sawwa kulla l‑cheyy da.Wa be da,hu ma yanja.› 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy !Al‑haliife al‑hu sawwaaha giddaami,hu gataʼha wa muʼaahadati kula,hu nagadha.Wa ana niʼaakhibah be sabab fiʼilah.
Wa ana nukujj leyah charaki wa nakurbah.Wa niwaddiih Baabil wa hinaak nihaakimah fi chaan al‑khiyaana al‑hu sawwaaha diddi.
Wa l‑muʼarridiin min kulla askarah yumuutu be l‑seef wa l‑faddalo yichittu fi l‑riih.Wa be da,intu taʼarfu kadar da,ana Allah bas gultah. 
Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Ana zaati nichiil firiʼmin raas chadarat al‑arz al‑tawiilewa nimagginah.Min furuuʼah foog,nagtaʼ firiʼ latiifwa ana zaati nimagginahfi jabal tawiil wa aali.
Nimagginah fi jabal aali fi balad Israaʼiilwa hu yisawwi furuuʼwa yalda fawaakihwa yabga chadarat arz aziime.Wa ayyi nafar hana tuyuuryaskunu fooghawa yaskunu fi dull furuuʼha.
Wa be da,kulla chadar al‑kadaade yaʼarifkadar ana Allah.Nisakhkhir al‑chadara al‑aaliyewa niʼalli al‑chadara al‑sakhayre.Niyabbis al‑chadara al‑khadrawa nikhaddir al‑chadara al‑yaabse.Wa da,ana Allah bas gultahwa nihaggigah. 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Maala tihajju be l‑masal da al‑bukhuss balad Israaʼiil :‹ Kan al‑abbahaat akalo al‑inab al‑akhdar,sunuun iyaalhum yakhdaro › ?
Ana nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,akiid intu ma tadurbu al‑masal da battaan fi Israaʼiil.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Aywa,hayaat al‑insaan hinti ana.Wa misil da,hayaat al‑abu wa hayaat al‑wileed,humman al‑itneen kula hineeyi ana.Wa l‑yisawwi zanib,hu bas al‑yumuut.
 Akuun fiyah raajil saalih al‑yisawwi al‑hagg wa l‑adaala.
Hu ma yarfaʼ uyuunah ale asnaam Bani Israaʼiil wa la yaakul min dahaayaahum fi ruuse al‑jibaal.Wa hu ma yinajjis marit jaarah wa la yigarrib le l‑mara fi wakit heedha.
Wa ma yidaayig naadum wa laakin yigabbil al‑damaana al‑karabha fi deen le siidha wa ma yasrig.Wa yigassim aklah maʼa l‑jiiʼaan wa yanti khalag le l‑aryaan.
Wa hu ma yanti deen be riba wa la yichiil faayde.Wa yibaʼʼid min al‑zulum wa yichaariʼ be l‑hagg been al‑naas.
Hu yitaabiʼ churuuti wa yahfad gawaaniini wa yisawwi al‑hagg.Hu da raajil saalih wa akiid yahya.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 Wa akuun al‑raajil al‑saalih da yijiib wileed sarraag al‑yidaffig al‑damm wa yisawwi ayyi cheyy fasil misil da.
Abuuh ma sawwa amal misil da wa laakin al‑wileed yaakul min dahaaya al‑asnaam fi ruuse al‑jibaal wa yinajjis marit jaarah.
Hu yidaayig al‑miskiin wa l‑daʼiif wa yasrig wa ma yigabbil al‑damaana al‑karabha fi deen le siidha.Wa yarfaʼ uyuunah le l‑asnaam wa yisawwi al‑muharramaat.
Wa yanti deen be riba wa yichiil faayde.Hal hu da yahya walla ?La !Hu sawwa kulla l‑muharramaat dool.Akiid yumuut wa hu bas masʼuul min mootah.
 Wa akuun al‑wileed da yakbur wa yijiib wileed wa l‑wileed da yichiif kulla l‑zunuub al‑abuuh sawwaahum.Hu yichiifhum wa laakin ma yisawwi misilhum.
Hu ma yarfaʼ uyuunah ale asnaam Bani Israaʼiil wa la yaakul min dahaayaahum fi ruuse al‑jibaal.Wa hu ma yinajjis marit jaarah
wa ma yidaayig naadum wa yigabbil al‑damaana al‑karabha fi deen le siidha wa ma yasrig.Wa yigassim aklah maʼa l‑jiiʼaan wa yanti khalag le l‑aryaan.
Wa hu yibaʼʼid min al‑zulum wa ma yanti deen be riba wa ma yichiil faayde.Hu yahfad gawaaniini wa yitaabiʼ churuuti.Wa akiid hu da yahya,ma yumuut be sabab al‑khata al‑abuuh sawwaah.
Wa laakin abuuh sawwa zulum wa sarag akhuuh wa ma sawwa adiil fi usut chaʼabah wa daahu yumuut be sabab khataaya hu zaatah.
 Wa intu tuguulu :‹ Maala al‑wileed ma yilhammal khata abuuh ?› Da fi chaan al‑wileed da sawwa al‑hagg wa l‑adaala wa hafad gawaaniini wa tabbagaahum.Wa akiid hu da yahya.
Wa l‑insaan al‑yaznib,hu bas al‑yumuut.Al‑wileed ma yilhammal khata abuuh wa l‑abu ma yilhammal khata wileedah.Wa l‑aadil yalga natiijat adaaltah wa l‑aasi yalga natiijat isyaanah.
 Wa kan al‑aasi yutuub min kulla zunuubah al‑sawwaahum wa yahfad kulla churuuti wa yisawwi al‑hagg wa l‑adaala,akiid hu da yahya ma yumuut.
Wa ana ma nizzakkar kulla isyaanah al‑sawwaah.Wa be sabab adaaltah al‑sawwaaha,hu yahya.
Hal nafrah be moot al‑aasi walla ?Wa kan yigabbil min derbah al‑fasil da,ma yahya walla ?Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa laakin kan al‑saalih yikhalli adaaltah wa yisawwi al‑zulum wa yisawwi kulla l‑muharramaat al‑sawwaahum al‑aasi,hal yahya walla ?Wa kulla l‑adaala al‑sawwaaha awwal,ma yizzakkarooha battaan.Hu yumuut be sabab al‑khiyaana wa l‑zunuub al‑sawwaahum.
 Wa laakin intu tuguulu :‹ Al‑cheyy al‑Rabb gaaʼid yisawwi da ma adiil !› Asmaʼo,ya Bani Israaʼiil.Hal al‑cheyy al‑ana gaaʼid nisawwi da ma adiil walla ?Al‑cheyy al‑intu gaaʼidiin tisawwuuh da bas ma adiil.
Kan al‑saalih yikhalli adaaltah wa yisawwi al‑zulum,hu yumuut.Be sabab al‑zulum al‑sawwaah bas,hu yumuut.
Wa laakin kan al‑aasi yikhalli isyaanah al‑gaaʼid yisawwiih wa yisawwi al‑hagg wa l‑adaala,hu da yinajji nafsah wa yahya.
Wa kan hu irif wa taab min al‑isyaan al‑sawwaah,akiid hu yahya wa ma yumuut.
Wa laakin intu Bani Israaʼiil tuguulu :‹ Al‑cheyy al‑Rabb gaaʼid yisawwi da ma adiil.› Ya Bani Israaʼiil !Hal al‑cheyy al‑ana gaaʼid nisawwi da,ma adiil walla ?Al‑cheyy al‑intu gaaʼidiin tisawwuuh da bas ma adiil.
 Wa fi chaan da,ana nihaakim ayyi waahid min Bani Israaʼiil hasab derbah al‑chaalah.Gabbulu !Tuubu min kulla isyaanku wa ayyi cheyy al‑yilizzuku fi l‑khata.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Khallu minku isyaanku wa khayyuru galibku be galib jadiid wa khayyuru ruuhku be ruuh jadiide.Maala tumuutu,ya Bani Israaʼiil ?
Ana ma nafrah be moot hana ayyi naadum.Tuubu wa be da,tahyo ! Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Allah gaal leyi nikhanni nuwaah al‑hizin le muluuk Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa nuguul : Ammak ma duudaay walla ?Hi raagde fi ust al‑diidaan.Wa fi lubb furuukh al‑diidaan,hi tirabbi iyaalha.
Hi rabbat waahid min iyaalhawa hu kibir wa bigi malik al‑diidaan.Wa hu allam kikkeef yicharrit seedtahwa yaakul al‑naas.
Wa l‑umam simʼo beyahwa ramooh fi nugrithum.Aywa,karaboohwa waddooh be zumaam fi balad Masir.
 Wakit al‑duudaay chaafatah,achamha angataʼ.Wa hi chaalat aakhar min iyaalhawa sawwatah malik al‑diidaan.
Wa hu macha fi ust al‑diidaanwa bigi malikhum.Wa allam kikkeef yicharrit seedtahwa akal al‑naas.
Hu dammar gusuurhum al‑gawiyiinwa kharab mudunhum.Wa l‑balad gaʼadat kharaab min sukkaanhabe sabab hiss gargaraanah.
Wa l‑umam al‑hawaaleeyahjo min wulaayaathum.Wa gammo diddahwa kajjo leyah charakwa hu wagaʼ fi nugrithumwa karabooh.
Wa be zumaam,khattooh fi lubb gafaswa waddooh le malik Baabil.Wa dassooh fi lubb sijinachaan hissah battaan ma yinsamiʼfi jibaal Bani Israaʼiil. 
 Ammak misil chadarat al‑inabal‑magganooha fi khachum al‑almi.Hi wildat fawaakihwa indaha waragachaan al‑almi katiir.
Wa furuuʼha induhum gudrale yabgo isay le l‑muluuk.Hi kibrat wa bigat tawiilemin kulla l‑chadar al‑aakhar.Wa tinchaaf fi chaan tuulhawa katarat waragha.
Laakin hi mallatooha be khadabwa ramooha fi l‑ard.Wa riih al‑sabaah yabbasat fawaakihhawa humman daffago.Wa furuuʼha al‑induhum gudra yibsowa l‑naar akalathum.
Wa hassaʼ,magganooha fi l‑sahara,fi ard jafaaf wa atach.
Maragat naar min dumburhawa akalat al‑furuuʼ wa l‑fawaakih.Wa battaan ma fi furuuʼal‑induhum gudra le yabgo isay le l‑muluuk. Wa da khine yikhannuuh misil nuwaah al‑hizin.
Wa fi yoom achara hana l‑chahar al‑khaamis hana l‑sana al‑saabʼe min waddoona fi l‑khurba,waahidiin min chuyuukh Bani Israaʼiil jo leyi le yasʼalo Allah.Wa wakit jo wa gaʼado giddaami,
Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,hajji le chuyuukh Bani Israaʼiil wa guul leehum :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Jiitu le tasʼalooni walla ?Nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,ana ma narda intu tasʼalooni.”›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 Ya ibn Adam,maala ma tihaakimhum ?Aywa,haakimhum wa arrifhum muharramaat juduudhum.
Wa guul leehum :Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :‹ Fi yoom ana azalt Bani Israaʼiil,ana halaft le zurriiyit Yaakhuub wa arraft nafsi leehum fi balad Masir.Wa halaft leehum wa gult :“Ana Allah Ilaahku.”
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ana halaft leehum kadar namrughum min balad Masir wa niwaddiihum ale l‑balad al‑ana azaltaha leehum.Wa l‑balad di malaane be l‑laban wa l‑asal wa jamiile min kulla l‑buldaan.
Wa gult leehum :“Khalli ayyi naadum yazgul al‑asnaam al‑muharramaat hana Masir al‑yaʼajubuuh wa ma yinnajjas beehum achaan ana bas Allah Ilaahku.”
 ‹ Wa laakin juduudku isooni wa ma dawwaro yasmaʼooni.Wa ma fi naadum minhum al‑zagal al‑asnaam al‑muharramaat hana Masir al‑yaʼajubuuh wa la khallaahum.Wa ana gult :“Ninazzil khadabi fooghum min bidaaytah lahaddi nihaaytah fi usut balad Masir.”
Wa laakin fi chaan ihtiraam usmi giddaam al‑umam al‑humman saakniin fi usuthum,ana ma nazzalt khadabi fooghum.Wa ana arraft leehum nafsi giddaam al‑umam dool wakit maragtuhum min balad Masir.
 ‹ Aywa,ana maragtuhum min balad Masir wa waddeethum fi l‑sahara.
Wa anteethum churuuti wa arraftuhum gawaaniini al‑beehum yalgo al‑haya kan yitabbuguuhum.
Wa battaan anteethum yoomi hana l‑sabt le yabga alaama beeni wa beenhum.Wa be da,yaʼarfu kadar ana Allah bas khassastuhum.
Wa laakin Bani Israaʼiil isooni fi l‑sahara.Wa humman ma taabaʼo churuuti wa abo gawaaniini al‑beehum yalgo al‑haya kan yitabbuguuhum.Wa daayman ma ahtaramo yoomi hana l‑sabt.Wa battaan ana gult :“Ninazzil fooghum khadabi fi l‑sahara wa nikammilhum.”
Wa laakin fi chaan ihtiraam usmi giddaam al‑umam,ana ma nazzalt khadabi fooghum.Wa ana maragtuhum min balad Masir giddaam al‑umam dool.
Wa laakin ana halaft leehum fi l‑sahara kadar ma niwaddiihum fi l‑balad al‑ana azaltaha leehum.Wa l‑balad di malaane be l‑laban wa l‑asal wa jamiile min kulla l‑buldaan.
Achaan humman abo gawaaniini wa ma taabaʼo churuuti wa ma ahtaramo yoomi hana l‑sabt achaan guluubhum taabaʼo asnaamhum.
Wa be da kula,ana chiftuhum be een al‑rahma wa ma halaktuhum wa la dammartuhum fi l‑sahara.
 ‹ Wa fi l‑sahara,ana gult le iyaalhum :“Ma tamchu hasab wasiiyat abbahaatku wa la tahfado gawaaniinhum wa la tinajjusu nufuusku be asnaamhum.
Ana bas Allah Ilaahku !Taabuʼu churuuti wa ahfado gawaaniini wa tabbuguuhum.
Wa ajʼalo yoomi hana l‑sabt mukhaddas achaan hu alaama beeni wa beenku.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahku.”
 ‹ Wa laakin iyaalhum isooni wa ma taabaʼo churuuti wa la hafado gawaaniini al‑beehum yalgo al‑haya kan yitabbuguuhum.Wa humman ma ahtaramo yoomi hana l‑sabt.Wa fi chaan da,ana gult :“Ninazzil fooghum khadabi fi l‑sahara wa nikammilhum.”
Wa laakin fi chaan ihtiraam usmi giddaam al‑umam,ana ma nazzalt khadabi fooghum.Wa ana maragtuhum min balad Masir giddaam al‑umam dool.
Wa battaan ana halaft leehum fi l‑sahara kadar nichattithum been al‑umam wa nifarrighum fi ust al‑buldaan.
Achaan humman ma tabbago gawaaniini wa abo churuuti wa ma ahtaramo yoomi hana l‑sabt achaan khatto uyuunhum fi asnaam abbahaathum.
Wa be sabab da,ana zaati anteethum churuut al‑ma adiiliin wa gawaaniin al‑beehum al‑naadum ma yalga al‑haya.
Wa khalleethum annajjaso be gaddimiin dahaayaahum hana kulla awlaad al‑bikir.Wa da le yinbahtu wa yaʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah. ›
 Wa fi chaan da,ya ibn Adam,hajji le Bani Israaʼiil wa guul leehum :Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :‹ Daayman juduudku ayyarooni be sabab khiyaanithum leyi.
Ana waddeethum fi l‑balad al‑halaft wa gult nantiiha leehum.Wa wakit humman chaafo ayyi jabal aali wa ayyi chadara khadra,gaddamo fi l‑bakaan da dahaayaahum.Wa khaddabooni be hadaayaahum wa be l‑bakhuur al‑riihtah taʼajib wa be hadaayaahum hana l‑charaab al‑gaddamoohum fi l‑bakaan da.
Wa ana gult leehum :“Chunu al‑bakaan al‑aali al‑tamchu leyah da ?”Wa sammooh al‑bakaan da,al‑bakaan al‑aali hana l‑ibaada lahaddi l‑yoom. ›
 Wa fi chaan da,guul le Bani Israaʼiil :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Intu najjastu nufuusku wakit taabaʼtu derib juduudku wa achcharmattu wara muharramaathum wa isiitu.
Wa wakit intu tijiibu hadaayaaku wa wakit tiharrugu iyaalku fi l‑naar,intu gaaʼidiin tinajjusu nufuusku be kulla asnaamku lahaddi l‑yoom.Wa be da,ana ma narda tasʼalooni,ya Bani Israaʼiil !Nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,ana ma narda intu tasʼalooni.”Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 ‹ Intu fakkartu wa gultu :“Aniina nidooru nabgo misil umam wa gabaayil hana buldaan aakhariin.Nidooru naʼabudu leena asnaam hana hatab wa hajar misilhum.”Wa laakin da ma yabga !
Nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,ana nahkimku be iid chadiide wa be duraaʼ gawi wa ninazzil khadabi foogku.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa be iid chadiide wa duraaʼ gawi wa nazziliin khadabi,ana namrugku min ust al‑umam wa nilimmuku min al‑buldaan al‑intu muchattatiin fooghum.
Wa ana niwaddiiku fi l‑sahara taraf min al‑umam al‑aakhariin.Wa hinaak nigaabilku wijih be wijih wa nihaakimku.
Misil ana haakamt juduudku fi saharat balad Masir,be misil da bas nihaakimku intu kula.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa ana nukhuttuku tihit asaati wa tikarrumu al‑muʼaahada al‑tarbutni maʼaaku.
Wa nafrug minku al‑naas al‑gammo diddi wa isooni.Namrughum min al‑balad al‑humman gaaʼidiin foogha ajaanib wa laakin ma yadkhulu fi balad Israaʼiil.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah. ›
 Wa leeku intu,ya Bani Israaʼiil,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :‹ Khalli ayyi naadum yamchi yaʼabud asnaamah !Wa laakin baʼad da,khalli ayyi naadum yasmaʼni.Wa tihtarumu usmi al‑mukhaddas wa battaan ma tigaddumu hadaayaaku le asnaamku.
Achaan fi jabali al‑mukhaddas wa da jabal Israaʼiil al‑aali,kulluku Bani Israaʼiil wa kulla naas al‑balad taʼabuduuni.Wa fi l‑bakaan da bas,ana nakhbal zakaatku wa ahsan hadaayaaku wa kulla cheyy al‑tikhassusuuh leyi.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa wakit namrugku min ust al‑umam wa nilimmuku min al‑buldaan al‑intu muchattatiin fooghum,tabgo misil riihe haluuwe al‑ana narda beeha.Wa beeku intu,ana niwassif khadaasti giddaam al‑umam.
Wa wakit nigabbilku fi balad Israaʼiil,fi l‑balad al‑ana halaft wa gult nantiiha le juduudku,khalaas taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa hinaak,tizzakkaro duruubku wa kulla amalku al‑najjastu beehum nufuusku.Wa l‑eeb yakrubku be sabab kulla l‑fasaala al‑sawweetuuha.
Ya Bani Israaʼiil !Ana nisawwi al‑cheyy da ma fi chaan deribku wa amalku al‑fasliin wa laakin fi chaan charaf usmi.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale l‑wati wa kallim diddah wa atnabbaʼ didd khaabat al‑wati.
Wa guul le khaabat al‑wati :‹ Asmaʼe kalaam Allah !Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Akiid nigabbid naar fi lubbiki al‑taakul kulla l‑chadar,al‑akhdar wa l‑yaabis kula.Wa ambalbaalitha haamiye,abadan ma tumuut.Wa taakul ayyi cheyy min al‑wati lahaddi l‑munchaakh.
Wa be da,kulla l‑naas yaʼarfu kadar ana Allah bas gabbadt al‑naar di wa hi abadan ma tumuut.”› 
Wa ana Hizgiyaal gult : Ya Allah Rabbi !Humman yihajju foogi wa yuguulu :‹ Hu yihajji be amsaal bas !› 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,wajjih ale Madiinat al‑Khudus wa kallim didd al‑bakaanaat al‑mukhaddasiin wa atnabbaʼ didd balad Israaʼiil.
Wa guul le balad Israaʼiil :‹ Daahu Allah gaal :“Akiid nugumm diddiki wa nisill seefi min beetah wa naktul al‑saalih wa l‑aasi kula.
Aywa,naktul al‑saalih wa l‑aasi.Wa be sabab da bas,nisill seefi min beetah wa naktul kulla l‑naas min al‑wati lahaddi l‑munchaakh.
Wa be da,ayyi naadum yaʼarif kadar ana Allah bas salleet seefi min beetah wa battaan ma nigabbilah.” ›
 Wa inta,ya ibn Adam,agnit wa dangir.Aywa,be hizin agnit giddaamhum.
Akuun yuguulu leek :‹ Maalak tagnit ?› Wa inta tuguul leehum :‹ Be sabab al‑khabar al‑jaayi,kulla l‑guluub yingatʼu wa kulla l‑iide yinrakhu wa kulla l‑uguul yibarjulu wa kulla l‑rikab yumuuʼu misil almi.Wa l‑khabar da jaayi wa yilhaggag.›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,atnabbaʼ wa guul :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Al‑seef !Al‑seef !Hu mutarrag wa majli.
Mutarrag le l‑katilwa majli le yiraari misil al‑barraaga.Ma tafrah,ya wileedi.Ikhaab al‑seef jaayiachaan inta abeet ikhaab al‑asa.
Anto al‑seef le l‑yajliihwa le l‑yakurbuuh be l‑iid.Tarragooh wa jaloohwa antooh le l‑yaktul.
 ‹ “Ya ibn Adam,koorik wa abki be hizinachaan al‑seef da marag didd chaʼabiwa didd kulla muluuk Bani Israaʼiil.Ramoohum fi l‑seef maʼa chaʼabiwa fi chaan da,hizz raasak.
Aywa,Allah gaaʼid yijarrib chaʼabah.Wa kan asaat al‑muluk al‑hagaroohabigat ma fiiha,chunu yukuun ?Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 ‹ “Ya ibn Adam,atnabbaʼwa adrub iideenakachaan al‑seef yadrubmarrateen aw talaata.Wa da l‑seef al‑yaktul.Aywa,da l‑seef al‑yaktul katiirwa yaktul al‑naas fi kulla bakaan.
Fi chaan al‑seef da,guluubhum yingatʼuwa rijleehum yittartaʼo.Fi kulla biibaanhum,ana khatteet al‑seef al‑yakhrib.Wa hu yiraari misil al‑barraagawa majli le l‑harib.
Ya l‑seef al‑tariin,adrub ale l‑zeene wa adrub ale l‑israwa fi ayyi bakaan al‑tiwajjih.
Ana kula nadrub iideeniwa nakhdab aakhir khadabwa da,ana Allah bas gultah.”› 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Asmaʼ,ya ibn Adam,arsim duruub itneen le seef malik Baabil wakit yamrug min baladah.Wa fi ayyi derib,khutt alaama al‑tiwassif al‑hille al‑yamchi leeha al‑derib.
Wa l‑derib al‑waahid yiwaddi al‑seef le Rabba madiinat Bani Ammuun.Wa l‑derib al‑aakhar yiwaddiih le Madiinat al‑Khudus hi al‑madiina al‑gawiiye fi balad Yahuuza.
Achaan malik Baabil gaaʼid fi machbak al‑duruub al‑itneen dool le yichawwif.Wa yihizz al‑nachaachiib wa yasʼal al‑asnaam wa yakchif al‑kibde.
Wa fi iidah al‑zeene,fi uud al‑yiwassif kadar amʼiyeedaat wagaʼat fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa fi chaan da,yijiibu murdaas kabiir wa yikooruku le l‑katil wa yarfaʼo hissuhum le l‑harba.Wa yuduggu biibaan al‑madiina be l‑murdaas al‑kabiir da wa yilimmu turaab wa yabnu radmiiye.
Sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus yahsubu kadar amʼiyeedaat di khachch achaan halafo leehum be l‑amaan.Wa laakin malik Baabil yizakkirhum khataahum wa yaji yakrubhum. 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Intu zakkartuuni khataaku.Wakit isyaanku anchaaf,intu wassaftu zunuubku wa kulla amalku.Wa fi chaan da,yakurbuuku be gu.
Ya inta malik Bani Israaʼiil !Ya inta kattaal al‑dimam wa kaafir !Yoomak garrab wa wakit ikhaabak ja.
Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :‹ Khalli yamurgu minnah al‑kadmuul wa yisillu minnah al‑taaj.Kulla cheyy yikhayyir,al‑miskiin yarfaʼooh wa l‑gawi yinazzuluuh.
Kharaab,kharaab !Nisawwi kharaab al‑abadan ma bigi mislah !Wa da,lahaddi yaji siid al‑chariiʼa al‑ana nantiiha leyah. ›
 Wa inta ya ibn Adam,atnabbaʼ wa guul :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb hajja kalaam yukhuss Bani Ammuun wa eebhum.Hu gaal :“Al‑seef !Al‑seef !Hu masluul le l‑dabih wa majli le l‑harib wa yiraari misil al‑barraaga.
Wa wakit gaaʼidiin yichiifu leeku ruʼya saakit wa yichawwufu leeku be kidib,al‑seef yagtaʼ rigaab al‑fasliin humman al‑yoomhum garrab wa wakit ikhaabhum ja.
Gabbulu al‑seef fi beetah !Ana niʼaakhibku fi l‑bakaan al‑khalagooku foogah,fi l‑balad al‑foogha gaʼarku.
Wa ninazzil khadabi foogku wa nanfukh foogku naar khadabi wa nisallimku fi iid al‑naas al‑haarriin al‑yaʼarfu yisawwu al‑kharaab.
Wa intu tabgo hagg al‑naar wa dammuku yidaffig fi ust al‑balad wa battaan ma yizzakkarooku.”› Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah. 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,maala ma tihaakimha ?Aywa,haakim al‑madiina al‑malaane be l‑damm wa arrifha kulla muharramaatha.
Wa guul :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :“Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus !Inti tidaffigi al‑damm fi lubbiki le tigarribi wakitki hana l‑ikhaab.Wa tisawwi asnaam le tinajjisi nafiski.
Wakit daffagti al‑damm da,bigiiti khaatiye.Wa wakit sawweeti al‑asnaam dool,bigiiti nijse.Wa garrabti wakitki hana l‑ikhaab wa jiiti fi nihaayat siniinki.Wa fi chaan da,nisawwiiki aaybe giddaam al‑umam wa chimmeete giddaam kulla l‑buldaan.
Al‑naas al‑gariibiin wa l‑baʼiidiin kula yichchammato foogki achaan usumki annajjas wa barjaalki kitir.
 ‹ “Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus,daahu muluuk Bani Israaʼiil al‑fi lubbiki,ayyi waahid yaktul dimme hasab gudurtah.
Wa fi lubbiki,yalʼano al‑amm wa l‑abu.Wa fiiki,yidaayugu al‑ajnabi wa yazulmu al‑atiim wa l‑armala.
Wa inti hagarti kulla cheyy mukhaddas hanaayi wa ma ahtaramti yoomi hana l‑sabt.
Wa fi lubbiki,fiyah naas al‑yangulu al‑kalaam le yaktulu dimme.Wa fiiki,yaakulu min dahaaya al‑asnaam fi ruuse al‑jibaal.Wa fi usutki,yisawwu fiʼil cheen.
Wa fi lubbiki,yakchufu ire al‑abu.Wa fiiki,yarugdu be gu maʼa mara al‑indaha heed.
Fi lubbiki,naadum waahid yisawwi al‑haraam maʼa marit jaarah wa naadum aakhar yinajjis marit wileedah be fiʼil cheen wa naadum aakhar yargud be gu maʼa akhtah bitt abuuh.
Wa fi lubbiki,yichiilu ujra le yaktulu dimme wa yichiilu al‑riba wa l‑faayde wa yidaayugu al‑naas wa ana kamaan,nisooni.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 ‹ “Ya sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus,daahu ana rafaʼt iidi didduku be sabab al‑maal al‑haraam al‑chiltuuh wa l‑dimme al‑kataltuuha fi lubb al‑madiina di.
Wa hal guluubku yasbutu wa iideeku yalgo al‑gudra fi l‑yoom al‑ana nugumm didduku walla ?Wa da,ana Allah bas gultah wa nihaggigah.
Wa ana nichattitku been al‑umam wa nifarrigku fi ust al‑buldaan wa nitahhirku min najaasitku.
Wa intu be nufuusku tiwadduru ihtiraamku giddaam al‑umam.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah.”› 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,Bani Israaʼiil bigo misil wasakh al‑fudda.Kulluhum misil al‑nahaas wa l‑tuuta wa l‑hadiid wa l‑hadiid al‑azrag al‑faddalo wasakh fi ust al‑naar. 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Achaan kulluku bigiitu wasakh,daahu ana nilimmuku fi ust Madiinat al‑Khudus
misil yilimmu al‑fudda wa l‑nahaas wa l‑hadiid wa l‑hadiid al‑azrag wa l‑tuuta fi l‑naar wa yanfukhu al‑naar le yagtaʼoohum.Wa be misil da fi zaʼali wa khadabi,ana nilimmuku wa nidissuku fi l‑naar wa nagtaʼku.
Wa ana nilimmuku fi lubb Madiinat al‑Khudus wa nanfukh foogku naar khadabi wa nagtaʼku.
Wa misil al‑fudda tingatiʼ fi lubb al‑naar,be misil da intu kula tingatʼu fi lubb Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa be da,intu taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah wa nazzalt khadabi foogku. 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,guul le Madiinat al‑Khudus kadar hi ard al‑ma taahire.Fi yoom al‑khadab,ma sabba foogha matar.
Wa anbiyaaha gaaʼidiin yilʼaamaro fi usutha.Misil duud al‑katal seedtah wa gaaʼid yikirr,al‑naas yaktulu dimme wa yanhabo al‑khuna wa l‑achya al‑khaaliyiin wa yikatturu al‑araamil fi ust al‑madiina.
Rujaal al‑diin ma tabbago churuuti al‑fi l‑Tawraat wa ma ahtaramo kulla cheyy mukhaddas hanaayi.Wa ma farrago been al‑mukhaddas wa l‑ma mukhaddas.Wa ma allamo al‑naas al‑faraga been al‑halaal wa l‑ma haraam.Wa abo ma yikarrumu yoomi hana l‑sabt wa ma jaʼalooni mukhaddas fi usuthum.
 Wa l‑hukkaam fi lubb al‑madiina misil maraafʼiin al‑katalo seedithum.Humman jaahiziin le yaktulu dimme wa yidammuru al‑naas fi chaan faaydithum.
Wa anbiyaahum yilabbudu khataayaahum marra waahid misil tallasoohum be buhya !Wa yichiifu ruʼya saakit wa yichawwufu be kidib wa yuguulu :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal.› Wa laakin Allah ma gaal cheyy !
Wa chaʼab al‑balad yasurgu wa yazulmu al‑taʼbaaniin wa l‑masaakiin.Wa l‑ajnabi,yazulmuuh bala hagg.
 Wa ana fattacht naadum fi usuthum al‑yabni leehum durdur wa yagiif fi khurmit al‑durdur giddaami achaan ma nidammir al‑balad.Wa laakin ma ligiitah.
Wa khalaas,ana ninazzil zaʼali fooghum.Wa nidammirhum be naar khadabi wa nihammilhum kulla natiijat amalhum. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Ya ibn Adam,fiyah awiin itneen banaat amm.
Hinna achcharmatan fi balad Masir.Aywa,min subaahin bas hinna achcharmatan.Wa hinaak,allammaso suduurhin wa liʼibo be duyuudhin wakit hinna banaat.
Wa usum al‑kabiire Uhuula wa hi timassil madiinat al‑Saamira.Wa akhutha usumha Uhuuliiba wa hi timassil Madiinat al‑Khudus.Hinna hineeyi ana wa jaaban leyi awlaad wa banaat.
 Wa Uhuula hi hinti wa laakin machat achcharmatat.Hi indaha chahwa le sudgaanha rujaal Achuur jiiraanha
al‑laabsiin khulgaan khaaliyiin loonhum zahri.Wa humman hukkaam wa kubaaraat wa kulluhum subyaan al‑yaʼajubu al‑een wa siyaad kheel.
Wa hi achcharmatat maʼa kulla l‑kubaaraat al‑muhimmiin hana balad Achuur.Wa hi taabaʼat chahwitha wa najjasat nafisha maʼa kulla asnaamhum.
Wa hi ma khallat charmatatha al‑badatha fi Masir wakit liʼibo be duyuudha wakit hi bineeye wa ragado maʼaaha fi subaaha wa tammamo chahwithum.
Wa fi chaan da,ana sallamtaha le sudgaanha min balad Achuur al‑leehum hi indaha chahwa.
Humman sallabooha wa khallooha aryaane.Wa chaalo awlaadha wa banaatha.Wa hi kamaan,katalooha be l‑seef wa ikhaab chadiid bigi foogha.Wa hi bigat masal le l‑awiin.
 Wa akhutha Uhuuliiba chaafat kulla l‑cheyy da.Wa laakin be da kula,chahwitha wa charmatatha bigo ziyaada min hana akhutha.
Wa hi indaha chahwa le rujaal Achuur al‑humman hukkaam wa kubaaraat wa jiiraanha al‑laabsiin khulgaan samhiin.Wa kulluhum siyaad kheel wa subyaan yaʼajubu al‑een.
Wa ana chiftaha kadar hi annajjasat wa hinna al‑itneen kullihin taabaʼan nafs al‑derib.
 Wa battaan Uhuuliiba zaadat fi charmatatha !Fi durdur,hi chaafat suwar hana rujaal Baabil marsuumiin be buhya hamra.
Ayyi waahid sulbah marbuut be hizaam wa raasah indah kadmuul.Wa kulluhum yichaabuhu kubaaraat al‑askar min Baabil,balad al‑wildoohum foogha.
Wa min chaafathum bas,chahwitha karabatha !Wa hi rassalat leehum mursaal fi Baabil le yinaadiihum leeha.
Wa khalaas,al‑Baabiliyiin jo leeha wa ragado fi furaachha hana l‑hubb wa najjasooha be charmatathum.Wa hi annajjasat maʼaahum wa baʼad da,hi baʼʼadat nafisha minhum.
 Wa wassafat charmatatha wa kachafat ireeha giddaam kulla l‑naas.Wa ana baʼʼadt nafsi minha misil baʼʼadt nafsi min akhutha.
Wa hi kattarat charmatatha le tizzakkar ayyaam subaaha wakit achcharmatat fi balad Masir.
Wa hi indaha chahwa le l‑mufsidiin al‑induhum dakar misil dakar al‑humaar wa maniihum misil mani al‑juwaad !
 Ya Uhuuliiba,inti gabbalti le fiʼilki al‑cheen hana subaaki wakit al‑Masriyiin allammaso suduurki wa liʼibo be duyuudki wakit inti sabiiye.
Wa fi chaan da,ya Uhuuliiba,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal :‹ Akiid nigawwim sudgaanki diddiki,humman nafs al‑naas al‑baʼʼadti nafiski minhum.Wa ana nijiibhum diddiki min kulla bakaan.
Wa nijiib kulla rujaal balad Baabil min hillaal Faguud wa Chuuʼa wa Khuuʼa.Wa maʼaahum yaju kulla rujaal balad Achuur,humman al‑subyaan al‑yaʼajubu al‑een wa kulluhum kubaaraat wa hukkaam wa kubaaraat askar wa ajaawiid wa siyaad kheel.
Wa yaju diddiki be arabaat al‑harib wa kaarrooyaat wa askar katiiriin be darag kubaar wa dugaag wa tawaagi hana harib wa yihaasuruuki.Wa ana nantiihum izin le yihaakumuuki hasab chariiʼithum.
Wa ana ninazzil khadab khiirti foogki wa fi chaan da,humman yiʼaakhubuuki be zaʼal chadiid.Yagtaʼo munkharki wa udneeki wa l‑yifaddulu min zurriiyitki yumuutu fi l‑harib.Wa humman yichiilu awlaadki wa banaatki wa l‑yifaddulu min zurriiyitki,al‑naar taakulhum.
Wa humman yisallubuuki wa yichiilu ziinitki.
Wa khalaas,ana niwaggif fiʼilki al‑cheen wa l‑charmata al‑badeetiiha fi Masir.Wa battaan ma tiwajjihi aleehum wa la tizzakkare balad Masir battaan.› 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Ana nisallimki le l‑naas al‑inti kirihtiihum wa le l‑naas al‑inti baʼʼadti nafiski minhum.
Wa humman yiʼaakhubuuki be karaahiiye wa yichiilu kulla khumaamki wa yisallubuuki wa yikhalluuki aryaane wa yakchufu ireeki wa fiʼilki al‑cheen hana l‑charmata.
Wa yiʼaakhubuuki misil da achaan inti achcharmatti wakit taabaʼti al‑umam wa najjasti nafiski be asnaamhum.
Wa inti taabaʼti derib akhutki wa be da,inti kula tacharbe min kaas ikhaabi misilha. 
Daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Inti tacharbe min kaas akhutkial‑hu khariig wa wasiiʼ.Wa da yijiib leeki dihik wa chamaateachaan al‑kaas da malaan.
Taskare wa tahzaneachaan al‑kaas da malaanbe kharaab wa damaarwa da kaas akhutkimadiinat al‑Saamira.
Laakin inti tacharbeeh wa tikammiliihwa tikassiriih be sunuunki.Wa be chigaffah,tijarrihi duyuudki.Wa da,ana bas gultah. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Achaan inti nisiitiini wa anteetiini daharki,hassaʼ da alhammale natiijat fiʼilki al‑cheen wa charmatatki. 
Wa Allah gaal leyi : Ya ibn Adam,maala ma tihaakim Uhuula wa Uhuuliiba ?Aywa,haakimhin wa arrifhin be muharramaathin.
Achaan hinna zanan wa katalan dimme.Wa hinna sawwan zina maʼa asnaamhin wa iyaalhin al‑wildanhum leyi,gaddamanhum dahiiye muharraga le l‑asnaam le yaakuluuhum.
Wa ziyaada min da,fi nafs al‑yoom hinna najjasan beeti al‑mukhaddas wa ma ahtaraman yoomi hana l‑sabt.
Wa wakit dabahan iyaalhin le asnaamhin,fi nafs al‑yoom da,dakhalan fi beeti al‑mukhaddas wa ma ahtaramannah.Wa da bas al‑cheyy al‑sawwannah fi lubb beeti.
 Wa battaan rassalan yifattichan rujaal al‑yaju min baʼiid.Wa min ligo al‑mursaal,al‑rujaal dool jo leehin.Wa hinna albarradan wa alkahhalan wa aljammalan leehum be ziinithin.
Wa machan gaʼadan fi sariir jamiil wa giddaamah tarabeeza mujahhaza al‑foogha bakhuuri wa dihni.
Wa min bakaanhin,ansamaʼat haraka hint jamaaʼa al‑ma induhum hamm.Wa maʼaahum rujaal katiiriin al‑jaaboohum min al‑sahara.Wa humman dasso suure fi iide ayyi waahide wa khatto leeha taaj jamiil fi raasha.
 Wa khalaas,ana gult :‹ Kikkeef al‑awiin al‑ajjazan fi l‑zina yichcharmatan battaan !Aywa,hinna charaamiit !
