Wa malik Suuriya yigabbil fi baladah be kasiibe katiire.Wa wakit mugabbil,yisawwi kulla cheyy fasil al‑galbah yidoorah fi l‑chaʼab al‑induhum muʼaahada mukhaddasa maʼa Allah.Wa khalaas,yiwassil baladah.
 Wa fi l‑wakit al‑muhaddad,malik Suuriya battaan yugumm didd malik Masir wa laakin da ma yabga leyah misil awwal.
Wa wakit naas yaju diddah min al‑kharib be sufun,hu achamah yingatiʼ wa yiʼarrid.Wa wakit mugabbil,yugumm didd al‑chaʼab al‑induhum muʼaahada mukhaddasa maʼa Allah.Wa l‑yaabo al‑muʼaahada kamaan,hu yistafig maʼaahum.
Hu yirassil askarah wa humman ma yihtarumu al‑beet al‑mukhaddas al‑gawi.Yamnaʼo al‑dahiiye al‑yigaddumuuha kulla yoom wa yisawwu al‑haraam al‑yijiib al‑kharaab.
Wa l‑malik zaatah be kalaam khachch yilizz naas waahidiin le yaabo al‑muʼaahada al‑induhum maʼa Allah.Wa laakin al‑naas al‑yaʼarfu Ilaahhum yugummu be chidde wa yasbutu.
 Wa l‑naas al‑induhum hikma yifahhumu katiiriin min naashum.Wa laakin fi muddit chuhuur,siyaad al‑hikma dool yaktuluuhum be l‑seef aw yiharruguuhum be naar aw yidissuuhum fi l‑sijin aw yichiilu maalhum.
Wa fi wakt al‑taʼab da,ma yalgo musaaʼada adiile wa l‑naas al‑yindammo maʼaahum kula munaafikhiin.
Wa l‑naas al‑induhum hikma,katiiriin minhum yumuutu wa moothum da yitahhir al‑chaʼab wa yisaffiihum wa yijahhizhum le l‑wakit al‑akhiir al‑muhaddad.
 Wa malik Suuriya yisawwi kulla cheyy al‑galbah bidoorah wa yistakbar.Wa hu yichiif nafsah aali min kulla l‑ilaahaat wa yuguul kalaam kufur didd Allah Ilaah al‑ilaahaat.Wa hu yanjah fi kulla cheyy al‑yisawwiih lahaddi khadab Allah yanzil foogah wa yitimm waktah achaan akiid Allah yihaggig kalaamah.
Wa l‑malik da ma indah haaje be ilaahaat juduudah wa la be l‑ilaah al‑yaʼabudannah al‑awiin wa la be ayyi ilaah aakhar achaan hu yichiif nafsah aali min kulla cheyy.
Wa fi badalhum,hu yaʼabud al‑ilaah al‑yahmi al‑mudun al‑gawiyiin wa da ilaah al‑juduudah abadan ma yaʼarfuuh.Wa hu yigaddim le l‑ilaah da dahab wa fudda wa hujaar khaaliyiin wa achya aakhariin khaaliyiin.
Wa be musaaʼadat al‑ilaah da,hu yugumm didd al‑mudun al‑gawiyiin.Wa yanti charaf le kulla l‑naas al‑yikarrumu al‑ilaah da wa yisawwiihum kubaaraat fi naas katiiriin.Wa yigassim leehum ziraaʼa le yachkurhum.
 Wa fi l‑wakit al‑akhiir,malik Masir yugumm le l‑harib wa laakin malik Suuriya yahjimah be khuwwa kabiire,be arabaat harib wa siyaad kheel wa sufun katiiriin.Wa misil al‑seel,hu yadkhul fi kulla l‑buldaan.
Hu yadkhul fi l‑balad al‑jamiila wa yaktul naas katiiriin.Wa laakin sukkaan Adoom wa Muwaab wa kubaaraat Bani Ammuun yanjo minnah.
Wa hu yistaʼmar buldaan katiiriin wa balad Masir kula ma tanja minnah.
Wa hu yichiil kulla maal Masir,al‑dahab wa l‑fudda wa l‑achya al‑khaaliyiin.Wa l‑Liibiyiin wa l‑Habachiyiin kula yitaabuʼuuh.
Wa laakin al‑akhbaar al‑yaju leyah min al‑sabaah wa l‑munchaakh yibarjuluuh wa be zaʼal chadiid,hu yugumm wa yakhrib wa yaktul naas katiiriin.
Wa hu yutugg kheemaatah al‑malakiiye ambeen al‑bahar wa l‑jabal al‑mukhaddas al‑gaaʼid fi l‑balad al‑jamiila.Wa baʼad da,taji nihaaytah wa ma fi naadum al‑yisaaʼidah. 
Wa hu gaal battaan le Danyaal : Fi l‑wakit da,yugumm Mikaayiil al‑mukallaf be chaʼabak.Wa da yabga fi wakit hana taʼab al‑abadan ma bigi mislah min al‑umma di gaaʼide lahaddi l‑wakit da.Wa be da kula,yanja ayyi waahid min chaʼabak al‑usmah maktuub fi kitaab al‑haya.
Wa katiiriin min al‑naas al‑maytiin yabʼaso wa waahidiin minhum yalgo al‑haya al‑abadiiye wa waahidiin yalgo al‑eeb wa l‑ihaana ila l‑abad.
Wa l‑naas al‑induhum hikma yidawwu misil deyy al‑nahaar achaan allamo al‑adaala le naas katiiriin.Wa humman yabgo misil nujuum al‑sama al‑yidawwu daayman.
 Wa laakin inta,ya Danyaal,al‑kalaam da sirr,ahfadah.Wa khutt fi l‑kitaab da khitim achaan ma yaftahooh abadan lahaddi l‑wakit al‑akhiir yitimm.Wa achaan da,naas katiiriin yifattuchuuh jaay wa jaay le yiziidu maʼrafathum. 
Wa ana Danyaal fi l‑ruʼya di chift itneen aakhariin,al‑waahid waagif be hini wa l‑aakhar waagif be hinaak le l‑bahar.
Wa waahid minhum saʼal al‑raajil al‑laabis khalag hana gumaach sameh al‑gaaʼid foog min almi al‑bahar wa gaal : Mata yaji akhiir al‑ajaayib dool ? 
Wa l‑naadum al‑laabis al‑khalag hana gumaach sameh al‑gaaʼid foog min almi al‑bahar da rafaʼ iideenah al‑itneen ale l‑sama wa gaal : Nahlif be usum Allah al‑Hayy al‑Daayim,akhiir al‑achya dool fi talaata sana wa nuss.Wa da,baʼad tiddammar gudrat al‑chaʼab al‑saalihiin hana Allah. 
Wa ana simiʼt kalaamah wa laakin ma fihimt maʼanaatah wa gult : Ya sayyidi,kikkeef tukuun nihaayat al‑ajaayib dool ? 
Wa hu gaal leyi : Ya Danyaal,al‑kalaam da khalliih achaan hu sirr wa makhtuum ma yaftahooh lahaddi l‑wakit al‑akhiir.
Wa naas katiiriin al‑taʼab yitahhirhum wa yisaffiihum wa yinaddifhum.Wa l‑induhum hikma yafhamo.Wa laakin al‑aasiyiin yisawwu al‑charr wa waahid minhum kula ma yafham.
Wa min wakit manaʼo al‑dahiiye al‑yigaddumuuha kulla yoom wa gammo sawwo al‑haraam al‑yijiib al‑kharaab,induhum 1 290 yoom.
Wa mabruuk le l‑naadum al‑yasbur lahaddi 1 335 yoom.
Wa kan leek inta,ya Danyaal,asbur lahaddi tumuut.Wa fi l‑akhiir,tugumm wa talga ajrak. 
Daahu kalaam Allah al‑gaalah le Huuchaʼ wileed Biiri.Wa da fi ayyaam hukum Uzziiya wa Yuutaam wa Ahaaz wa Hizkhiiya muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza wa fi ayyaam hukum Yarubaʼaam wileed Yahuʼaach malik mamlakat Israaʼiil.
Daahu bidaayit kalaam Allah al‑gaalah be waasitat al‑nabi Huuchaʼ.Allah gaal le Huuchaʼ : Amchi aakhud leek mara charmuutawa alda minha iyaal zina.Achaan naas al‑balad achcharmato maʼa l‑asnaamwa abooni ana Allah. 
Wa khalaas,Huuchaʼ macha akhad Guumar bineeyit Diblaayim wa hi bigat khalbaane wa wildat leyah wileed.
Wa Allah gaal le Huuchaʼ : Sammi wileedak Yazraʼiilachaan baʼad wakit chiyya,ana natlub min zurriiyit Yaahual‑damm al‑jidduhum Yaahudaffagah fi waadi Yazraʼiil.Wa nuguchch mamlakat Israaʼiil.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,naksir nubbaal deech Israaʼiilfi waadi Yazraʼiil. 
Wa marit Huuchaʼ battaan bigat khalbaane wa wildat bineeye.Wa Allah gaal le Huuchaʼ : Sammi bineeytak Ma Narhamhaachaan battaan ana ma narham Bani Israaʼiilwa ma nakhfir leehum abadan.
Laakin narham Bani Yahuuzawa ana Allah Ilaahhum,ninajjiihum.Aywa,ninajjiihum bala nubbaal wa la seef wa la haribwa bala kheel wa la siyaad kheel. 
Wa marit Huuchaʼ faradat Ma Narhamha.Wa baʼad da,battaan bigat khalbaane wa wildat wileed.
Wa Allah gaal : Sammi wileedak Ma Chaʼabiachaan intu ma chaʼabiwa ana kula ma Ilaahku. 
Adad Bani Israaʼiil yabga misil ramla hana khachum al‑baharal‑ma tinwazin wa la tinhasib.Wa fi l‑bakaan al‑awwal Allah gaal foogah : Intu ma chaʼabi ,fi nafs al‑bakaan,hu yuguul leehum : Intu iyaali ana Allah al‑Hayy. 
Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israaʼiil yilimmu sawawa yidarruju naadum waahid kabiir fooghum.Wa yaktaro fi arduhumfi yoom kabiir al‑binaaduuh Yazraʼiil(maʼanaatah Allah yazraʼ).
Guulu le akhwaanku : Intu chaʼabi. Wa guulu le akhwaatku : Narhamhin. 
 Achku ammuku Israaʼiil.Aywa,achkuuha !Achaan battaan hi ma martiwa ana kula ma raajilha.Khalli hi tamrug alaamaat charmatatha min wijihhawa alaamaat zinaaha min been duyuudha.
Kan ma maragathum,ana nisallibha wa tagood aryaanewa nikhalliiha misil wildooha.Nisawwiiha misil saharawa misil ard jafaafwa naktulha be l‑atach.
Wa iyaalha ma narhamhumachaan humman iyaal zina.
Ammuhum achcharmatat.Aywa,hi al‑wildathum alkhattat be l‑eebwakit gaalat :‹ Ana najri wara sudgaanial‑yantuuni akil wa almiwa suuf khanam wa gumaachwa dihin wa charaab. ›
Wa fi chaan da,daahu ana nukhutt chook fi deribhawa nisiddah be durdurwa ma talga derib battaan.
Hi tajri wara sudgaanhawa laakin ma talhaghum.Hi tifattichhumwa ma talgaahum.Wa hi tuguul :‹ Ana nigabbil le raajli al‑awwalachaan ana murtaaha maʼaayah ziyaada min hassaʼ. ›
 Wa hi ma irfat kadar da ana bas al‑gaaʼid nantiihaal‑gameh wa l‑khamar wa l‑dihin.Ana kattart al‑fudda wa l‑dahabwa laakin hi astaʼmalathum le ibaadat Baʼal.
Wa fi chaan da,ana naji wa nichiilgamhi fi wakt al‑gatiʼwa khamari fi wakt al‑darat.Wa naglaʼ minha suuf al‑khanam wa l‑gumaachal‑taksi beehum nafisha min al‑ire.
Hassaʼ,nakchif eebha giddaam sudgaanhawa ma fi al‑yinajjiiha min iidi.
Wa niwaggif farahha hana ayyi iidwa hana awwal yoom fi kulli chaharwa hana kulli yoom sabtwa hana kulli aazuuma.
Wa nakhrib jineenaat inabhawa chadar tiinhaal‑be sababhum hi gaalat :‹ Dool hadaaya al‑antoohum leyi sudgaani. ›Ana nisawwiihum kadaadeal‑yartaʼo foogha al‑haywaanaat.
Ana niʼaakhibha be sabab al‑ayyaamal‑hi harragat fooghum bakhuur le asnaam Baʼal.Hi aljammalat be chinifha wa ziinithawa jarat wara sudgaanhawa khalaas,nisatni. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa be da kula,nihajji le Israaʼiil be kalaam haluwa niwaddiiha fi l‑kadaadewa nikallim leeha be hubb.
Hinaak,nigabbil leehajineenaatha hana l‑inabwa waadi Akuural‑hu waadi al‑fasaalayabga leeha baabal‑yaji beyah al‑acham.Hinaak,hi titaabiʼnimisil fi ayyaam subaahawa misil fi wakit hi maragat min balad Masir. 
Daahu kalaam Allah : Fi l‑yoom da,inti tinaadiini raajilkiwa battaan ma tinaadiini Baʼal siidki.
Ana namrug min khachumki usum asnaam Baʼalwa battaan ma tinaadi usumhum.
Fi l‑yoom da,nisawwi le chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil alaakhamaʼa haywaanaat al‑kadaadewa tuyuur al‑sama wa zawaahif al‑ard.Wa fi l‑balad,nikassir al‑nubbaal wa l‑seefwa niwaggif al‑haribachaan chaʼabi yunuumu be amaan.
Ya Israaʼiil,nakrub raaskiwa inti tabge misil marti ila l‑abad.Nakrub raaski be l‑adaala wa l‑haggwa be l‑kheer wa l‑rahma.
Wa nakrub raaski be sidikhwa inti taʼarfi kadar ana bas Allah.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ana nakhbal talab al‑samawa l‑sama takhbal talab al‑ard.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l‑ard takhbal talab al‑gamehwa chadar al‑inab wa l‑zaytuun.Wa humman yakhbalo talab waadi Yazraʼiilal‑bakaan al‑ana Allah nazraʼ foogah.
Wa nazraʼ leyi ziraaʼa fi l‑ardwa narham al‑umma al‑naadooha Ma Narhamha.Wa nuguul leehum al‑naadoohum Ma Chaʼabi :‹ Intu chaʼabi ›wa humman yuguulu leyi :‹ Inta Ilaahna.› 
Wa Allah gaal leyi : Amchi hibb battaan martak al‑zaaniye al‑tihibb raajil aakhar.Wa da misil hubbi ana Allah le Bani Israaʼiil hatta kan humman macho le ilaahaat aakhariin kula wa habbo abbuud al‑inab al‑gaddamooh le l‑ilaahaat dool. 
Khalaas,ana macheet fadeet marti be 15 hajar fudda wa 4 chuwaal hana gameh abyad.
Wa gult leeha : Agoodi daayman leyi ana wiheedi.Ma tichcharmate wa la tamchi le raajil aakhar.Wa ana kula ma nigarrib leeki. 
Wa misil da,Bani Israaʼiil yagoodu mudda tawiile bala malik wa bala kabiir wa bala dahiiye wa bala hujaar al‑khazzoohum le l‑ibaada wa bala farmala hana raajil al‑diin wa bala asnaam.
Wa baʼad da,Bani Israaʼiil yigabbulu yitaabuʼu Allah Ilaahhum wa malikhum al‑min zurriiyit Dawuud.Wa fi aakhir al‑wakit,yakhaafo min Allah wa yalgo kheerah.
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,asmaʼo kalaam Allah !Hu gaal : Ana Allah nachki sukkaan al‑balad diachaan ma fi amaan wa ma fi rahmawa ma fi maʼrafat Allah fi l‑balad.
Foogha illa l‑laʼana wa l‑kidibwa l‑katil wa l‑sirge wa l‑zina.Yisawwu unufwa yidaffugu damm wara damm.
Fi chaan da,al‑ard taybaswa sukkaanha yiʼayyusuwa maʼaahum haywaanaat al‑kadaadewa tuyuur al‑samawa hatta huut al‑bahar kula yabga ma fi.
 Angarʼu !Khalli naadum ma yachki kulla l‑naaswa ma yuluumhum.Ana nachkiiku intu bas,ya rujaal al‑diin !
Intu tittartaʼo be l‑nahaarwa l‑nabi al‑maʼaaku kula yittartaʼ be l‑leel.Wa ana nidammir ammuku Israaʼiil.
Chaʼabi addammaroachaan ma induhum al‑maʼrafa.Achaan intu abeetu al‑maʼrafa,ana kula naabaakuwa intu ma tabgo leyi rujaal diin.Wa misil intu nisiitu churuutial‑fi l‑Tawraat hanaayi ana Ilaahku,ana kula nansa iyaalku.
 Wa rujaal al‑diin kulluhum aznabo diddiwa be da,ana nibaddil charafhum be ihaana.
Yiʼiichu be laham dahaaya kaffaarat al‑zanib hana chaʼabiwa fi chaan da,humman garmaaniin le zunuubhum.
Al‑chaʼab wa rujaal al‑diin yukuunu sawa sawa.Niʼaakhibhum hasab deribhum al‑chaaloohwa nikaafiihum hasab amalhum.
Humman yaakulu wa laakin ma yachbaʼowa yazno wa laakin ma yaldo iyaalachaan humman aboma chaalo derbi ana Allah.
 Al‑zina wa l‑mariise wa l‑khamaryiliffu ruuseehum.
Chaʼabi yasʼalo sanamhum hana l‑hatab.Aywa,yahsubu uudhum yurudd leehum !Achaan ruuh al‑charmata waddarhumwa l‑charmata baʼʼadathum minni ana Ilaahhum.
Fi ruuse al‑jibaal,yigaddumu dahaaya le ilaahaathumwa fi l‑hujaar,yiharrugu leehum bakhuur.Wa yaʼabudu tihit chadar al‑balluutwa l‑lubna wa l‑butumachaan dulluhum baarid.Ya chaʼabi,be sabab da,banaatku yabgan charaamiitwa awiin awlaadku yabgan zaaniyaat.
 Ana ma niʼaakhib banaatkube sabab charmatathinwa la niʼaakhib awiin awlaadkube sabab zinaahin.Achaan rujaal al‑diin zaathumyinfardu be l‑charaamiitwa yilgaasamo akil al‑dahaayamaʼa l‑zannaayaat al‑mukhassasaat.Al‑chaʼab al‑ma yafhamoyiwadduru nufuushum. 
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,kan intu achcharmattu kula,khalli Bani Yahuuza ma yakhto !Ma tamchu le bakaan al‑ibaada fi Gilgaalwa la tatlaʼo ale Beet Iil al‑faslewa ma tahalfu be Allah al‑Hayy.
Aywa,Bani Israaʼiil harraanmisil al‑bagarawa be da,kikkeef Allah yagdar yisarrihhummisil khanam fi marʼa akhdar ?
Naas Afraayim anrabato ziyaada maʼa l‑asnaamwa be da,khalliihum bas !
Wakit sakarhum kammal,yugummu yichcharmatowa kubaaraathum yihibbu al‑ihaana.
Khalaas,al‑riih tichiilhum fi janaaheehawa dahaayaahum yijiibu leehum al‑eeb.
 Ya rujaal al‑diin,asmaʼo al‑kalaam da !Ya Bani Israaʼiil,khuttu baalku !Ya naas beet al‑malik,khuttu adaanku !Al‑chariiʼa di muwajjihe leeku intuachaan fi Misfa,kajjeetu charak le chaʼabiwa fi jabal Taabuur,khatteetu leehum amkajjaama.
Aywa,intu nakattu nugra kabiire le naas Chittiimwa laakin ana niʼaddibku kulluku.
Ana naʼarif tamaam gabiilat Afraayim,aywa,Bani Israaʼiil ma mulabbadiin leyi.Ya naas Afraayim,intu achcharmattu,aywa,Bani Israaʼiil annajjaso. 
Wa amalhum al‑hawaanma yikhalliihum yigabbulu le Ilaahhumachaan ruuh al‑charmata gaaʼide fi guluubhumwa humman ma yaʼarfu Allah.
Istikbaar Bani Israaʼiil yachhad fooghum.Bani Israaʼiil wa naas Afraayimyittartaʼo fi chaan khataahumwa Bani Yahuuza kulayittartaʼo maʼaahum.
Yamchu yigaddumubagarhum wa khanamhum dahaayale yifattuchu Allahwa laakin ma yalgoohachaan hu khallaahum khalaas.
Humman khaano Allahachaan wildo iyaal zina.Wa fi wakit gisayyir bas,yiddammaro,humman wa arduhum.
Allah gaal : Adurbu al‑buug fi Gibeeʼawa adurbu al‑burunji fi l‑Raama.Iitu le Beet Iil al‑faslewa chiifu waraaku,ya naas Banyaamiin !
Fi yoom al‑ikhaab,naas Afraayim yakhrabo.Wa l‑khabar al‑niballikhah leeku,ya gabaayil Israaʼiil,hu khabar akiid.
Kubaaraat Yahuuzamisil naas al‑yihawwulu al‑kalanki.Ana ninazzil khadabi fooghummisil almi al‑seel.
Zalamo naas Afraayimwa awwajo chariiʼithumachaan humman yiriidu yajruwara l‑riih.
Wa ana nabga misil arda le naas Afraayimwa misil suusa le Bani Yahuuza.
Naas Afraayim chaafo maradhumwa Bani Yahuuza chaafo uwaarhum.Wa dawwaro musaaʼada min balad Achuurwa rassalo naas le l‑malik al‑kabiir.Laakin al‑malik da ma yagdar yachfiihumwa ma yagdar yidaawi uwaarhum.
Achaan ana nabga misil duud didd naas Afraayimwa misil farkh al‑duud didd Bani Yahuuza.Ana bas nadrubhum wa nicharrithumwa nukurruhum wa niwaddiihumwa ma fi naadum al‑yinajjiihum minni.
Ana namrug wa nigabbil fi bakaanilahaddi yiʼtarufu be khataahumwa yiwajjuhu aleyi.Wa fi diigithum di,yifattuchuuni. 
 Taʼaalu nigabbulu le Allahachaan hu bas al‑jarahnawa hu bas al‑yachfiina.Hu bas al‑darabaanawa hu bas al‑yidaawi uwaarna.
Baʼad yoomeen,hu yantiina al‑haya.Aywa,fi l‑yoom al‑taalit,yigawwimna wa niʼiichu giddaamah.
Khalli nitaabuʼu Allah le naʼarfuuh.Jaytah muʼakkada misil nuur al‑sabaahwa hu yajiina misil matar,misil matar al‑richaach al‑yazgi al‑ard. 
 Ya naas gabiilat Afraayim,nisawwi leeku chunu ?Ya Bani Yahuuza,nisawwi leeku chunu ?Mahabbitku misil sahaab al‑fajur al‑yufuutwa misil karany al‑sabaah al‑ma yitawwil.
Achaan da,ana darabtuku be l‑anbiyawa kataltuku be kalaamiwa nuur chariiʼti nawwarkumisil nuur al‑sabaah.
Wa mahabbitku nidoorhaziyaada min al‑dahaaya.Wa kan taʼarfuuni,da akheer leyimin al‑dahaaya al‑muharragiin.
 Nagado al‑muʼaahada fi hillit Adamachaan fi l‑bakaan da,khaanooni.
Wa Gilʼaad hillit al‑fasliinmulattakha be l‑damm.
Wa majmuuʼat rujaal al‑diinbigo misil rabbaatiin al‑duruub.Yaktulu naas fi derib hillit Chakiim.Aywa,gaaʼidiin yisawwu fiʼil cheen.
 Fi usut Bani Israaʼiil,ana chift fadiihe.Fi lubbuhum,naas Afraayim achcharmatoaywa,Bani Israaʼiil annajjaso.
Wa intu kula,ya Bani Yahuuza,talgo ikhaabi misil intaaj ziraaʼitku !  Wakit nigabbil chaʼabi min al‑khurba
wa wakit nidoor nachfi Bani Israaʼiil,khata Afraayim wa fasaalit al‑Saamira yibiinuachaan fiʼilhum kulla khachch.Al‑sarraag yadkhul fi l‑buyuutwa rabbaatiin al‑duruub yagoodu fi l‑chawaariʼ.
Humman ma yahsubukadar ana nizzakkar kulla fasaalithum.Hassaʼ aʼmaalhum hawwagoohumwa gaaʼidiin giddaami daayman.
Be fasaalithum,yifarruhu al‑malikwa be kidibhum,yifarruhu al‑kubaaraat.
Humman kulluhum zannaayiinwa chahwithum misil furun mugabbad.Siid al‑furun ma yiraakhibahmin ajjan dagiigahlahaddi ajiinah yugumm.
Wa fi yoom iid malikna,al‑kubaaraat yamrado min sakar al‑khamarwa l‑malik yimidd iidah le l‑chammaatiin.
Wakit yigarrubu leyah,guluubhum misil furun mugabbadfi muʼaamarathum al‑yugummu beeha.Fi tuul al‑leel,zaʼalhum yargudwa be fajur,yugumm misil naar ambalbaala.
Kulluhum haamiyiin misil al‑furunwa yaakulu hukkaamhum.Kulla muluukhum yagaʼowa minhum ma fi waahid al‑yinaadiini.
 Wa naas gabiilat Afraayim yikhalbutumaʼa chuʼuub aakhariin al‑ma yaʼarfu Allah.Aywa,naas Afraayim ma naafʼiinmisil kaʼak al‑ma chaglabooh.
Al‑ajaanib dool kammalo gudrithumwa humman ma yaʼarfuuh.Abchiyyeeb ja leehumwa humman ma yaʼarfuuh.
Istikbaar Bani Israaʼiil yachhad fooghum.Laakin ma gabbalo le Allah Ilaahhumwa la fattachooh.
 Naas Afraayim bigo mukhaffaliinmisil hamaam al‑ma indah raas.Humman yinaadu Masir le tafzaʼhumwa yajru wara Achuur le tidaafiʼ leehum.
Wakit yamchu,ana nazgul fooghum charakiwa misil teer al‑sama,nakrubhum.Wa niʼaakhibhumhasab al‑balaakh al‑simʼooh fi malammithum.
 Al‑azaab leehum achaan arrado minni !Al‑damaar leehum achaan atmarrado diddi !Ana chilt niiye le nafdaahumwa laakin humman gaalo foogi kalaam kidib.
Humman ma yasrakho leyi min daakhal guluubhumwakit yabku be hizin fi furaachhum.Yijarruhu nufuushumwa yinaadu ilaahaathumle yantuuhum al‑gameh wa l‑khamarwa laakin yibaʼʼudu minni ana.
Wa ana bas addabtuhumwa gawweet duraaʼhumwa laakin humman yichiilu niiyit al‑fasaala diddi.
Humman yigabbuluwa laakin ma aleyi ana Allah al‑Aali.Humman misil nubbaal aʼwajwa kubaaraathum yumuutu be l‑seefbe sabab lisaanhum al‑tariin diddi.Wa daahu fi balad Masir,al‑naas yichchammato fooghum. 
 Adurbu al‑buugwa jahhuzu nufuusku !Al‑adu yanzil misil al‑sagurfi chaʼabi ana Allah.Achaan humman nagado muʼaahadatiwa iso churuuti hana l‑Tawraat.
Humman yasrakho leyi wa yuguulu :‹ Ilaahna,aniina naʼarfuukachaan aniina chaʼabak Bani Israaʼiil ! ›
Wa laakin Bani Israaʼiil abo al‑kheerwa hassaʼ aduuhum yitaaridhum.
Humman darrajo muluuk bala izniwa kubaaraat bala muwaafagati.Be fuddithum wa dahabhum,humman sanaʼo leehum asnaamwa da yisabbib damaarhum.
Ya naas madiinat al‑Saamira,khallu sanamku al‑hu ijil hana dahab !Ana khidibt ziyaada didduku.Intu ma bariyiin !Wa tagoodu misil ke lahaddi mata ?
Ijilku da minku intu Bani Israaʼiil baswa insaan bas sanaʼah.Hu ma Ilaah !Wa fi chaan da,ijil al‑Saamira yilkassar.
Intu zaraʼtu al‑riihwa khalaas,tagtaʼo amzoobaʼaane.Al‑gameh bala ganduulma yanti dagiigwa kan anta dagiig kula,al‑ajaanib bas yaakuluuh.
 Bani Israaʼiil akaloohum.Wa hassaʼ gaaʼidiin fi ust al‑umammisil maaʼuun al‑ma yanfaʼ.
Wa wakit macho ale Achuur,bigo misil humaar al‑kadaade al‑aayich wiheedah.Aywa,gabiilat Afraayim gaaʼide wiheedhahatta kan kaffat ujra le sudgaanha kula.
Kan ajjarat al‑umam le yidaafuʼu leeha kula,ana nilimmuhum kulluhum.Wa baʼad wakit chiyya,humman yatʼabotihit zulum hana akbar malik.
Naas Afraayim kattaro al‑madaabihle dahaaya hana kaffaarat al‑zanib.Wa laakin al‑madaabih doolsabbabo leehum al‑zanib.
Wa kan naktib leehumchuruuti hana l‑Tawraat alif marra kula,humman yichiifuuhum misil cheyy ajnabi.
Humman yigaddumuuhum leyi dahaayawa yaakulu al‑lahamwa laakin ana Allah ma nakhbal dahaayaahum.Nizzakkar khataahumwa niʼaakhibhum be sabab zunuubhum.Khalli yigabbulu Masir !
Bani Israaʼiil niso khaalighumwa bano leehum gusuur.Wa Bani Yahuuzakattaro al‑mudun al‑gawiyiin.Laakin ana nirassil naar fi mudunhumwa hi taakul gusuurhum. 
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,ma tafraho wa tinbastumisil al‑chuʼuub al‑aakhariin.Achaan intu baʼʼadtu min Ilaahku wa achcharmattuwa habbeetu ujrat al‑charmataal‑ligiituuha fi kulla madaggaat al‑gameh.
Laakin al‑madagg wa l‑assaara ma yirabbuukuwa kan tukhuttu achamku fi l‑khamar kula,ma talgooh.
Naas Afraayim ma yaskunu battaanfi balad Allah.Humman yigabbulu Masirwa fi balad Achuur kula,yaakulu akil nijis.
Battaan ma yigaddumu khamar hadiiyat charaab le Allahwa hu ma yakhbal dahaayaahum.Wa da yabga leehum misil akil hana hizinwa l‑yaakuluuh,kulluhum yabgo nijsiin.Akilhum yamla butuunhum baswa laakin ma yagdaro yigaddumuuh fi beet Allah.
Wa yisawwu chunufi l‑yoom al‑muhaddad,fi yoom iid Allah ?
Hatta kan arrado min al‑damaar kula,balad Masir tajmaʼhumwa hillit Mamfiis tadfinhum.Al‑chook yisidd kanzuhum hana l‑fuddawa l‑haskaniit yugumm fi khiyamhum.
Yoom al‑ikhaab jawa yoom al‑Hisaab wassal.Khalli Bani Israaʼiil yaʼarfuuh !Humman gaalo : Al‑nabi munaafikhwa l‑naadum al‑nazal foogah Ruuh Allah da,muchootin. Khataayaahum bigo katiiriinwa adaawithum bigat chadiide.
Al‑nabi al‑gaaʼid maʼa Ilaahi,hu misil muraakhib fi naas Afraayim.Wa laakin yukujju leyah charak fi kulla duruubahwa yiwajjuhuuh be l‑adaawa fi beet Ilaahah.
Wa humman sawwo al‑fasaadmisil zamaan naas Gibeeʼasawwooh.Wa Allah yizzakkar khataahumwa yiʼaakhibhum be sabab zunuubhum.
 Zamaan,ana ligiit Bani Israaʼiilmisil inab laziiz fi l‑sahara.Wa chift juduudhum haluwiinmisil fawaakih al‑awwal fi chadarat al‑tiin.Wa laakin wakit humman wislo fi Baʼal Faʼuur,abado al‑sanam al‑yijiib al‑eeb.Wa bigo makruuhiinmisil al‑sanam al‑muharram al‑abadooh.
Wa charaf Afraayimyabga misil teer wa yitiir.Ma fi battaan waaluudawa la khalaba wa la himil.
Wa kan rabbo iyaal kula,ana naktulhum gabul ma yabgo kubaar.Aywa,al‑azaab leehumwakit nibaʼʼid minhum !
Zamaan wakit chift gabiilat Afraayim,hi tichaabih nakhalaay al‑magganooha fi marʼa akhdar.Wa laakin hassaʼ,gabiilat Afraayim tamrug iyaalha le l‑katil. 
Ya Allah,tantiihum chunu ?Antiihum rihim al‑ma yakrubwa duyuud al‑ma yiradduʼu !
 Kulla fasaalithum baanat fi hillit Gilgaalwa fi l‑bakaan da bas,ana kirihtuhum.Wa be sabab amalhum al‑fasil,ana natrudhum min beeti.Wa battaan ma nihibbuhumachaan kulla kubaaraathum haraamiyiin.
Naas Afraayim kataloohumwa uruughum yibso khalaaswa battaan ma yijiibu iyaal.Wa kan wildo kula,ana naktul iyaalhum al‑khaaliyiin leehum. 
Ilaahi yarfudhumachaan humman ma simʼoohwa yiʼiiru fi ust al‑umam.
Bani Israaʼiil wildo ziyaadamisil chadarat inab al‑talda katiir.Wa laakin wakit iyaalhum kitro,humman kattaro madaabih le ilaahaathum.Wa wakit arduhum bigat jamiile,jammalo al‑hujaar al‑khazzoohum le l‑ibaada.
Guluubhum bigo itneen itneenwa hassaʼ yikaffu taman khataahum.Allah zaatah yihaddim madaabihhumwa yarmi hujaarhum al‑khazzoohum le l‑ibaada.
Wa hassaʼ humman yuguulu : Aniina ma indina malikachaan ma khufna min Allah.Wa kan indina malik kula,yisawwi leena chunu ? 
Humman yuguulu kalaam saakitwa yahalfu be kidibwa yisawwu alaakhaat ma induhum faayde.Wa yajʼalo al‑adaalamisil bizre al‑musammamafi l‑zereʼ al‑mahruut.
Wa sukkaan al‑Saamira yarjufufi chaan sanamhum hana l‑ijilfi hillit Beet Iil al‑fasle.Chaʼabha yahzano be sabab ijilhumwa rujaal diinhum kula yarjufuachaan yiwaddu majd sanamhum fi l‑khurba.
Wa sanamhum hana l‑ijil da,yiwadduuh balad Achuurhadiiye le l‑malik al‑kabiir.Wa gabiilat Afraayim talga al‑ihaana,aywa,Bani Israaʼiil yalgo al‑eebfi chaan achamhum fi l‑sanam da.
Madiinat al‑Saamira tiddammarwa malikha yabga misil gechchaay aayme fi l‑bahar.
Wa l‑bakaanaat al‑aaliyiin hana l‑fasaalaal‑yaznubu fooghum Bani Israaʼiil yiddammaro.Al‑haskaniit wa l‑chookyugummu fi madaabihhum.Wa l‑naas yuguulu : Khalli al‑jibaal yagaʼo foognawa khalli al‑hujaar yadfunuuna. 
 Wa min ayyaam Gibeeʼa,Bani Israaʼiil aznabowa humman ma khayyaro haalhum.Fi Gibeeʼa,waajib al‑harib yalhag al‑mujrimiin
wa ana niʼaakhibhum misil nidoorah.Wa chuʼuub katiiriin yugummu didduhumwa yijanzuruuhum fi chaan khataahum al‑itneen.
Gabiilat Afraayim misil bagara muʼaddabaal‑tihibb tifajjikh al‑maʼaachfi l‑madagg le tuduggah.Wa wakit naji,nukhutt uud al‑harraatafi ragabatha al‑jamiile.Wa gabiilat Afraayim tukurr al‑harraatawa Bani Yahuuza yahartuwa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yichaglubu al‑ard.
Azraʼo al‑adaala wa agtaʼo al‑mahabbawa addulu leeku zereʼ jadiid.Hassaʼ waajib titaabuʼu Allahlahaddi hu yijiib foogku al‑adaalamisil al‑matara.
Laakin intu zaraʼtu al‑charrwa gataʼtu al‑fasaalawa akaltu min natiijat al‑kidib.Intu atwakkaltu ale gudritkuwa ale katarat askarku.
Wa khalaas,yinsamiʼ korooraak harib fi lubb chaʼabkuwa kulla mudunku al‑gawiyiin yakhrabomisil yoom al‑khaayid Chalmaankharab hillit Beet Arbiilwa rihik al‑ammahaat wa iyaalhin.
Wa da bas al‑yisawwuuh leeku intu naas Beet Iilachaan intu sawweetu al‑fasaala al‑ma indaha hadd.Wa yoom waahid fi wakt al‑chagaag,malik Israaʼiil yiddammar marra waahid. 
 Wakit Bani Israaʼiil misil sabi,ana habbeetahwa min Masir,ana naadeet ibni.
Laakin fi kulli wakit kan ana naadeet chaʼabi,humman yibaʼʼudu minni.Yigaddumu dahaaya le ilaah Baʼalwa yiharrugu bakhuur le l‑asnaam.
Wa ana kamaan karabt naas Afraayimmin iideehum wa daadeethum.Laakin humman ma irfokadar ana bas rayyastuhum.
Ana waddeethum be tariiga insaaniiyewa be alaakha hint mahabba.Ana bigiit leehum misil al‑yahdin al‑sakhiirwa yilimmah fi sadrah.Ana maddeet iidiwa akkaltuhum.
 Humman battaan ma yigabbulu Masirwa laakin malik Achuur bas yihaakimhumachaan humman aboma yigabbulu leyi ana.
Al‑harib yadkhul fi mudunhumwa yidammir biibaanhum al‑gawiyiinwa yaktulhum be sabab muʼaamarathum.
Chaʼabi anrabato fi kufurhum.Naadoohum le yichiifu aleyi foogwa laakin waahid minhum kula ma rafaʼ raasah. 
 Ya Afraayim,kikkeef nikhalliik ?Ya Israaʼiil,kikkeef nisallimak le l‑adu ?Hal nidammirakmisil dammart hillaal Adma wa Sabuuyiimwalla ?Ana alhayyartwa galbi hanna foogku marra waahid.
Ana ma ninazzil foogku khadabi al‑muhrigwa ma nigabbil le nidammir Afraayimachaan ana al‑Rabb,ma insaani.Ana al‑Khudduus wa gaaʼid fi usutkuwa ma naji leeku be khadab.
 Naas al‑fi l‑khurba yugummu yitaabuʼuuniwakit ana Allah nikirr misil al‑duud.Aywa,ana nahrij wa iyaali yarjufuwa yaju min khaadi le l‑bahar.
Yarjufu wa yaju min Masir misil al‑tuyuurwa yigabbulu min balad Achuur misil al‑hamaamwa ana nisakkinhum fi buyuuthum. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Gabiilat Afraayim hawwagatni be kidib,aywa,Bani Israaʼiil hawwagatni be khachch.Wa laakin Bani Yahuuza yamchu waraayiwa induhum amaan leyi ana al‑Khudduus. 
Gabiilat Afraayim tarwa be riihwa tajri wara riih al‑sabaah.Kulla yoom hi tikattir al‑kidibwa l‑damaar.Tisawwi alaakha maʼa Achuurwa tantiih dihin le Masir fi badal al‑salaam.
Allah yijiib Bani Yahuuza fi l‑chariiʼaachaan yiʼaakhib zurriiyit Yaakhuub hasab deribhumwa yikaafiihum hasab amalhum.
Hatta fi batun ammah kula,Yaakhuub khachcha chig toomah.Wa wakit bigi raajil,hu saaraʼ maʼa l‑Rabb.
Aywa,Yaakhuub saaraʼ maʼa malak al‑Rabbwa gidir foogah.Wa baʼad da,hu bakawa chahad al‑malak le yihinn foogah.Aywa,fi Beet Iilhu ligi Allahwa fi l‑bakaan da bas,Allah hajja leyah.
Wa da Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir,Allah hu usmah al‑beyah nazkuruuh !
Wa intu zurriiyit Yaakhuub,waajib tigabbulu le Ilaahkuwa tahfado al‑rahma wa l‑adaalawa daayman tukhuttu achamku fi Ilaahku.
Wa gabiilat Afraayim misil al‑taajiral‑indah fi iidah miizaan makhchuuchwa yihibb yazlum al‑aakhariin.
Wa naas Afraayim gaalo : Be sahiih,aniina bigiina khaniyiinwa ligiina maal katiir be khidmit duraaʼna bas.Wa ma yalgo foognaayyi khata al‑yabga zanib. 
 Wa ana Allah Ilaahkumin maragtuku min balad Masir.Nisakkinku battaan fi khiyammisil fi ayyaam kheemat al‑ijtimaaʼ.
Wa fi l‑wakit daak,ana kallamt le l‑anbiyawa kattart leehum al‑ruʼya.Wa hassaʼ be waasitat al‑anbiya,nikallim leehum be masal. 
Akiid,chaʼab Gilʼaad fasliinwa ma induhum faaydeachaan yigaddumu tiiraan dahaaya fi Gilgaal.Wa be da,madaabihhum yilhaddamowa yabgo koom hana turaabfi l‑zereʼ al‑mahruut.
Zamaan,jiddina Yaakhuub arradle balad Araam.Aywa,jiddina Israaʼiil bigi khaddaamle yalga mara.Le yalga mara,bigi raaʼi hana khanam.
Wa baʼadeen be waasitat nabi,Allah marag Bani Israaʼiil min Masir.Wa be waasitat nabi,hu hafadaahum.
Wa laakin naas Afraayimkhaddabo Allah khadab chadiid.Wa khalaas,Ilaahhum yarmi fi raashumal‑damm al‑humman daffagoohwa yigabbil fooghum kulla eebhum.
Wakit naas Afraayim hajjo,al‑khoof bigi chadiid fi balad Israaʼiil.Wa laakin humman bigo khaatiyiinachaan abado ilaah Baʼalwa maato be sababah.
Wa ya hassaʼ kula,gaaʼidiin yiziidu fi zunuubhumachaan sanaʼo leehum sanam be fuddithum.Aywa hasab ilimhum,sawwo leehum asnaamal‑daggaahum sinaaʼi maʼruuf.Wa l‑naas yuguulu : Gaddumu leehum dahaaya ! Chiifu !Al‑naas doolyihibbu asnaam al‑ajjaal !
Wa be sabab da,humman yabgomisil sahaab al‑fajur al‑yufuutwa misil karany al‑sabaah al‑ma yitawwil.Yabgo misil uttaab al‑madagg al‑tichiilah al‑riihwa misil al‑dukhkhaan al‑yamrug min al‑chubbaak.
 Ana Allah Ilaahkumin maragtuku min balad Masir.Ma waajib taʼarfu ilaah aakhar balaayi anawa ma fi munajji illa ana.
Ana iriftuku fi l‑sahara,fi balad al‑yabaas.
Ana sarrahtuku fi marʼa adiilwa intu riwiitu wa chibiʼtu.Wa min chibiʼtu,al‑istikbaar dakhal fi guluubkuwa be da,intu nisiituuni.
Wa khalaas,ana nabga leeku misil duudwa misil nimir kaaris fi l‑derib.
Nahjimku misil marfaʼiin al‑waddar iyaalahwa nuchugg suduurku.Fi l‑bakaan da,naakulku misil mart al‑duudwa haywaanaat al‑kadaade al‑khatiiriin yicharrutuuku.
 Ya Bani Israaʼiil,addammartuachaan gammeetu diddi ana al‑nafzaʼku.
Wa hassaʼ da,ween malikku ?Khalli yafzaʼku fi kulla hillaalku !Wa ween hukkaamku al‑be sababhum gultu :‹ Antiina malik wa masaaʼiil.›
Fi zaʼali,ana darrajt leeku malikwa fi khadabi,ana nazzaltah.
 Khata naas Afraayim musajjalwa zunuubhum maktuubiin.
Wa wajaʼ yaji leehummisil wajaʼ al‑talaga.Wa humman misil wileedal‑ma indah hikma.Fi wakit al‑waaluuda,ma yamrug min batun ammah !
Hal ninajjiihum min al‑khabur ?Hal nafdaahum min al‑moot ?Ya l‑moot,ween wabaak ?Ya l‑khabur,ween kharaabak ?Battaan ma nichiifhumbe een al‑rahma.
Wa kan naas Afraayim zaadofi ust akhwaanhum,riih al‑sabaah tajiwa riih min Allah tugumm min al‑sahara.Hi tiyabbis wudyaanhumwa tijaffif een almiihum.Al‑makhaazin,yanhaboohumwa khumaamhum al‑khaali,yichiiluuh.
Naas madiinat al‑Saamira khaatiyiinachaan iso Ilaahhum.Yaktuluuhum fi l‑haribwa yarhako iyaalhumwa yuchuggu butuun awiinhum al‑khalbaanaat. 
Gabbulu le Allah Ilaahku,ya Bani Israaʼiil,achaan khataaku bas ramaaku !
Jahhuzu kalaamkuwa gabbulu le Allah guulu : Akhfir kulla khataanawa fi badal dahaaya al‑tiiraan,akhbal kalaam khuchuumna.
Balad Achuur ma tagdar tinajjiinawa aniina ma nitwakkaloale kheel al‑harib kula.Battaan ma nuguulu :‹ Ya ilaahna ›le l‑sanam al‑sanaʼnaah be iideenna.Beek inta bas,ya Rabb,al‑atiim yalga al‑mahanna ! 
 Ana nachfiihum min marad al‑kufurwa nihibbuhum be niiye waahideachaan khadabi wagaf minhum.
Ana nabga misil matar le Bani Israaʼiilwa humman yinawwuru misil al‑sitteeb.Yidissu uruughum misil chadar Lubnaan
wa furuuʼhum yutuulu.Wa yabgo jamiiliin misil chadarat al‑zaytuunwa riihithum haluuwe misil riihit arz Lubnaan.
Wa Bani Israaʼiil yigabbulu leyiwa yagoodu fi dulli.Yiteerubu al‑gamehwa yinawwuru misil al‑inab.Wa naas yihajju beehummisil al‑khamar al‑laziiz hana Lubnaan.
Ya naas Afraayim !Hal fi chabah beeni ana wa l‑asnaam ?Ana bas nakhbalkuwa niraakhib foogku.Wa ana misil chadarat al‑sarwi al‑khadrawa minni ana bas,talgo intaaj. 
Khalli al‑hakiim yafham al‑achya doolwa khalli al‑faahim yaʼarifhum.Achaan derib Allah adiil al‑foogahal‑saalihiin yuruukhuwa l‑aasiyiin yittartaʼo.
Daahu kalaam Allah al‑gaalah le Yuwiil wileed Fatuwiil.
Asmaʼo,ya l‑chuyuukh,khuttu adaanku kulluku,ya sukkaan al‑balad !Cheyy misil da awwal kaan fi zamanku walla ?Aw kaan fi wakit abbahaatku ?
Hajju beyah le iyaalkuwa iyaalku yihajju beyah le iyaalhumwa iyaalhum yihajju beyah le zurriiyithum.
Al‑faddalatah ambukbuk,al‑jaraad akalahwa l‑faddalah al‑jaraad,amkachool akalatahwa l‑faddalatah amkachool,saar al‑leel akalah.
Ya l‑sakkaara,gummu wa abku !Ya charraabiin al‑khamar,abku be hizinachaan al‑khamar angataʼ minku.
Hacharaat gammomisil askar didd baladiwa humman gawiyiinwa ma yinhasbu min al‑katara.Wa sunuunhum misil sunuun al‑duudwa fawaatirhum misil fawaatir mart al‑duud.
Wa humman dammaro jineenit inabiwa kassaro chadar tiini.Wa marago girfah wa ramoohwa yabbaso furuuʼah.
Abku misil mara sabiiyeal‑rabatat chuwaal misil farde min al‑hizinachaan tabki le raajilha hana chabaabha.
Hadaaya al‑dagiig wa hadaaya al‑charaab,ma yigaddumuuhum battaan fi beet Allahwa rujaal al‑diin khaddaamiin Allah hizno.
Wa l‑ziraaʼa addammaratwa l‑ard yibsat misil mara haznaane.Achaan al‑gameh addammarwa l‑khamar kammalwa l‑dihin bigi ma fiih.
Ahzano,ya l‑harraatiin !Wa abku,ya siyaad jineenaat al‑inab !Achaan ma tagtaʼo al‑gameh al‑ahmarwa lammiin al‑gameh al‑abyad bigi ma fiih.
Wa jineenaat al‑inab yibsowa chadar al‑tiin jaffa.Wa kulla chadar al‑yanti iyaal yibisaywa,al‑rummaan wa l‑nakhal wa l‑tuffaah.Wa l‑farah waddar min guluub al‑naas.
Ya rujaal al‑diin,albaso khulgaan al‑hizin wa nuuhuwa abku,ya intu al‑khaddaamiin fi l‑madbah.Taʼaalu ahzano tuul al‑leel be khulgaan al‑hizin,ya khaddaamiin Ilaahi.Hadaaya al‑dagiig wa hadaaya al‑charaabma yigaddumuuhum battaan fi beet Allah Ilaahku.
Khassusu yoom hana siyaamwa kharruru malamma khaassa.Limmu al‑chuyuukhwa kulla sukkaan al‑baladfi beet Allah Ilaahkuwa kooruku leyah.
Ya l‑salaam !Kikkeef al‑yoom da !Yoom Allah garrabwa da jaayi min al‑Gaadir be damaar.
Wa min giddaamna,al‑maʼaach angataʼwa min beet Allah,al‑farha wa l‑suruur angataʼo.
Al‑teeraab yibis fi lubb al‑ardwa l‑dabangaat alhaddamo.Wa l‑makhaazin fidoachaan al‑maʼaach yibis.
Asmaʼo,al‑bahaayim gaaʼidiin yaguntuwa l‑bagar aayriin fi ayyi bakaan.Achaan ma induhum gechchwa l‑khanam kula taʼbaaniin.
Nasrakh leek inta,ya Allah,achaan al‑naar akalat gechch al‑kadaadewa l‑hariige akalat kulla chadar al‑khala.
Wa haywaanaat al‑kadaade kulawajjaho leekachaan kulla l‑ruhuud yibsowa l‑naar akalat gechch al‑kadaade.
Adurbu al‑buug fi Sahyuunwa iitu fi jabal Allah al‑mukhaddas.Wa khalli kulla sukkaan al‑balad yarjufuachaan yoom Allah jaayi wa garrab.
Da yoom hana dalaam azrag kurumwa yoom hana sahaab adlam marra waahid.Daahu deech kabiir wa gawi jaayi,misil nuur al‑sabaah al‑talaʼ fi l‑jibaal.Abadan ma chaafo misilhumfi l‑zurriiye al‑faatat wa la fi l‑zurriiye al‑taji.
Giddaamhum,naar taakulwa waraahum,hariige tahrig.Al‑balad giddaamhummisil jineenit Adinwa laakin waraahum,kadaade kharaabwa cheyy yanja minhum ke ma fiih.
Wa humman bichaabuhu al‑kheelwa jarraayiin misil naas al‑yigallubu.
Wa harakathum misil harakat arabaat al‑haribal‑yinattutu fi ruuse al‑jibaal.Wa misil harakat lahiib al‑naaral‑tahrig al‑gechch,wa misil askar chudaadrasso le l‑harib.
Giddaamhum,al‑chaʼab yarjufuwa kulla wujuuhhum yabgo dulum min al‑khoof.
Askarhum yajru misil al‑furraaswa yatlaʼo al‑daraadir misil muhaaribiin.Ayyi waahid chaayil derbahwa abadan ma yikiss min tariigah.
Wa ma fi waahid yatruch akhuuh,ayyi waahid maachi adiil fi derbah.Wa hatta kan yizarruguuhum be nachaachiib kula,ma yichattutu.
Yanzulu fi l‑madiinawa yatlaʼo fi l‑daraadir.Yadkhulu al‑buyuutwa yadkhulu be l‑chabaabiik misil saraariig.
Giddaamhum,al‑ard tinhazzawa l‑sama tarjif.Al‑harraay wa l‑gamar yidallumuwa l‑nujuum yiwadduru nuurhum.
Allah yarfaʼ hissah giddaam deechahwa askarah kubaar wa chudaad yitabbugu kalaamah.Yoom Allah aziimwa mukhiif marra waahid.Yaatu yagdar yahmalah ?
 Wa hassaʼ,gabbulu leyibe kulla guluubku,be baki wa siyaam wa nuwaah. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ma ticharrutu khulgaanku baswa laakin tuubu min daakhal galibkuwa gabbulu le Allah Ilaahku.Achaan hu al‑Rahmaan al‑Rahiimwa l‑Sabuur wa l‑Muhibbwa yikhalli al‑khadabal‑awwal hu kharrar yinazzilah foogku.
Akuun yikhalli khadabahwa yibaarikku battaan.Wa battaan intu tigaddumu le Allah Ilaahkuhadaaya hana dagiigwa hadaaya hana charaab.
Adurbu al‑buug fi Sahyuunwa khassusu yoom hana siyaamwa kharruru malamma khaassa.
Limmu al‑chaʼabwa khassusu malamma.Ajmaʼo al‑chiyyaabwa limmu al‑iyaalhatta al‑atfaal al‑bardaʼo.Wa khalli al‑ariis yamrug min beetahwa l‑aruus min khurfitha.
Wa khalli rujaal al‑diin yabkubeen khurfit al‑madkhal wa l‑madbah.Aywa,khaddaamiin Allah yuguulu : Ya Allah,hinn fi chaʼabak !Humman al‑misil warasatak,ma tiʼayyibhumwa la tikhalli al‑umam yichchammato fooghum.Maala fi ust al‑chuʼuub al‑aakhariin yuguulu :‹ Ween Ilaahhum ?› 
Allah yihibb baladah ziyaadawa yihinn fi chaʼabah.
Wa Allah yurudd le chaʼabah wa yuguul : Daahu ana nirassil leeku gamehwa khamar wa dihin.Intu tachbaʼo minhumwa battaan ma niʼayyibku giddaam al‑umam.
Al‑udwaan al‑yaju min al‑munchaakh,nibaʼʼidhum minkuwa niwaddiihum fi ard jafaafwa kharaab.Awwalhum narmiih fi l‑bahar al‑Mayyit fi l‑sabaahwa aakhirhum fi l‑bahar al‑Abyad fi l‑kharib.Afanat janaazaathum tinchammawa l‑hawa yiʼaffinachaan ana Allah sawweet achya kubaar. 
Ya l‑ard,ma takhaafe,afrahe wa anbasti.Achaan Allah yisawwi achya kubaar.
Ya haywaanaat al‑kadaade,ma takhaafoachaan gechch al‑kadaade yikhaddir.Al‑chadar yisawwu iyaalwa l‑inab wa l‑tiin yantu intaajhum.
Ya naas Sahyuun,afraho wa anbastu be Allah Ilaahku.Achaan yinazzil matar awwal al‑khariif al‑waajib leekuwa yinazzil leeku matar al‑richaachwa matar al‑khariif misil zamaan.
Al‑madagg yinmali be gamehwa l‑assaara tinmali be khamar jadiid wa dihin.
 Ana Allah nikaffiiku intaaj al‑siniin al‑faatowakit rassalt leeku deech kabiir hana hacharaat.Wa humman ambukbuk wa l‑jaraadwa amkachool wa saar al‑leel.
Wa intu taakulu wa tachbaʼowa tahmudu usmi ana Allah Ilaahku.Ana sawweet leeku ajaayibwa chaʼabi abadan ma yalgo eeb.
Wa taʼarfu kadar ana gaaʼid fi usutku,ya Bani Israaʼiil.Wa ana bas Allah Ilaahku,ma fi Ilaah balaayi.Wa chaʼabi abadan ma yalgo eeb. 
 Wa baʼad da,ana ninazzil Ruuhifi kulla l‑naas.Awlaadku wa banaatku yitnabbaʼowa chiyyaabku yahlamo be hilimwa subyaanku yichiifu ruʼya.
Wa fi l‑zaman da,al‑abiid wa l‑khadiim kulaninazzil Ruuhi fooghum.
Wa nisawwi ajaayib fi l‑sama wa fi l‑ardwa l‑naas yichiifu damm wa naar wa dukhkhaan azrag.
Wa l‑harraay tabga zargawa l‑gamar yabga ahmar misil al‑damm.Wa da gubbaal yoom Allah ma yajiwa hu yoom aziim wa mukhiif.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yadʼi be usum Allah yanjaachaan fi jabal Sahyuun wa fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,yifaddulu naas misil Allah gaalah.Wa l‑yinaadiihum Allah,yukuunu been al‑naas al‑yanjo. 
 Aywa,akiid fi ayyaam al‑wakit da,ana nigabbil naas balad Yahuuzawa Madiinat al‑Khudus min al‑khurba.
Wa nilimm kulla l‑umamwa niwaddiihum fi l‑waadi al‑usmah Yahuuchafat(maʼanaatah Allah yihaakim).Wa fi l‑bakaan da,nihaakimhumfi chaan kulla cheyy al‑sawwoohle Bani Israaʼiil,chaʼabi al‑misil warasati.Achaan chattatoohum fi lubb al‑umamwa algaasamo baladi ambeenaathum.
Humman algaasamo chaʼabibe amʼiyeedaatwa baaʼo al‑awlaadle yikaffu al‑azabaatwa baaʼo al‑banaatle yacharbo khamar.
 Wa intu kula,ya Suur wa Seedawa kulla mudiiriiyaat al‑Filistiyiin.Tidooru minni chunu ?Tidooru tilkaffo foogi al‑taar walla ?Kan tilkaffo foogi al‑taar,nugumm be surʼa diddukuwa nigabbil taarku fi raasku.
Intu chiltu fudditi wa dahabiwa kanzi al‑khaali dammeetuuh fi gusuurku.
Wa intu biʼtu naas Yahuuzawa Madiinat al‑Khudus le l‑Yuunaaniyiinachaan tibaʼʼuduuhum min baladhum.
Wa laakin daahu ana ninaadiihummin al‑bakaan al‑biʼtuuhum foogahwa ana nigabbil taarku fi raasku.
Wa ana nibiiʼ awlaadku wa banaatkule Bani Yahuuzawa humman yibiiʼuuhumle naas balad Sabaal‑humman umma baʼiide. Aywa,da kalaam Allah al‑hu gaalah.
Ballukhu le l‑umam wa guulu : Khassusu deech le l‑haribwa gawwumu al‑furraas.Khalli kulla l‑rujaal al‑muhaaribiinyindammo wa yamchu.
Wa jaraariiku dugguuhum suyuufwa khanaajirku dugguuhum huraab.Wa l‑daʼiif,khalli yuguul :‹ Ana bigiit faaris ! ›
Taʼaalu ajala,ya kulla l‑umam al‑mujaawiriin.Limmu hini. Ya Allah !Inta kula naadi furraasak !
Wa Allah gaal : Khalli al‑umam yugummuwa yamchu ale waadi Yahuuchafat.Achaan hinaak ana nihaakimkulla l‑umam al‑mujaawiriin.
Middu khanaajirku wa agtaʼoohummisil al‑harraati yagtaʼ intaajah fi wakt al‑gatiʼ.Fajjukhuuhum misil naas al‑yifajjukhu al‑inabwakit al‑assaara anmalat.Aywa,fasaalithum katiiremisil mawaaʼiin malaaniin be asiir al‑inab. 
Daahu aalaaf al‑naas,katiiriin marra waahid fi waadi al‑kharaar.Yoom Allah garrabfi waadi al‑kharaar.
Al‑harraay wa l‑gamar yidallumuwa l‑nujuum yiwadduru nuurhum.
Min Sahyuun,Allah yahrijwa min Madiinat al‑Khudus hissah yinsamiʼwa l‑sama wa l‑ard yarjufu.Wa laakin Allah hu maljaʼ le chaʼabahwa maskan gawi le Bani Israaʼiil.
 Wa be da,intu taʼarfu kadar ana bas Allah Ilaahkual‑gaaʼid fi Sahyuun jabali al‑mukhaddas.Madiinat al‑Khudus tabga bakaan mukhaddaswa battaan ajaanib ma yadkhulu foogha. 
 Fi l‑yoom da,asiir al‑inab yinaggit min al‑jibaalwa laban yisiil min al‑hujaarwa almi yajri fi kulla wudyaan Yahuuza.Wa een almi tisiil min beet Allahwa tusubb fi waadi Chittiim.
Wa Masir tabga kharaabwa Adoom tabga sahara kharaabbe sabab al‑unuf al‑sawwooh le Bani Yahuuzawakit daffago damm al‑bari fi arduhum.
Wa laakin Yahuuza yaskunuuha ila l‑abadwa Madiinat al‑Khudus yaskunuuha min zurriiye le zurriiye.
Aywa,ana najʼalhum bariyiinmisil awwal jaʼaltuhum ma bariyiin.Wa ana Allah naskun fi Sahyuun ! 
Daahu al‑kalaam al‑bukhuss Bani Israaʼiil al‑ja le Amuus fi ruʼya.Wa Amuus da waahid min ruʼyaan al‑khanam hana hillit Takhuuʼa.Wa l‑ruʼya di bigat fi ayyaam hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza wa fi ayyaam hukum Yarubaʼaam wileed Yahuʼaach malik mamlakat Israaʼiil.Wa da be santeen gabul al‑zilzaal.
Wa Amuus gaal : Min Sahyuun,Allah khidib ziyaada.Wa min Madiinat al‑Khudus,hissah ansamaʼ misil gargaraan al‑duud.Wa kulla marʼa al‑ruʼyaan jaffawa raas jabal al‑Karmal yibis. 
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Be sabab naas madiinat Dimachkhiso talaata wa arbaʼa marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial‑kharaar al‑chiltah didduhum.Achaan sawwo sukkaan Gilʼaad misil ganaadiilal‑daggoohum be mudgaaga hana hadiid.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi gasir al‑malik Hazayiilal‑taakul kulla gusuur al‑malik Banhadaad.
Wa nikassir haadir baab madiinat Dimachkhwa nuguchch al‑haakim min waadi Awanwa l‑kaarib asaat al‑muluk min Beet Adin.Wa chaʼab balad Araamyiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba fi Khiir. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Be sabab naas madiinat Khazzaiso talaata wa arbaʼa marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial‑kharaar al‑chiltah didduhum.Achaan waddo kulla l‑chaʼab fi l‑khurbawa sallamoohum le naas balad Adoom.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi daraadir Khazzaal‑taakul kulla gusuurha.
Wa nuguchch al‑haakim min madiinat Achduudwa l‑kaarib asaat al‑muluk min Achgaluun.Wa nadrub madiinat Akhruunwa nidammir al‑faddalo min al‑Filistiyiin. Wa da,Allah al‑Rabb bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Be sabab naas madiinat Suuriso talaata wa arbaʼa marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial‑kharaar al‑chiltah didduhum.Achaan sallamo kulla l‑chaʼabmisil abiid le naas balad Adoomwa ma fakkaro fi l‑alaakha al‑akhawiiyeal‑ambeenaathum.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi daraadir Suural‑taakul kulla gusuurha. 
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Be sabab naas balad Adoomiso talaata wa arbaʼa marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial‑kharaar al‑chiltah didduhum.Achaan macho be zaʼal wara akhwaanhumwa kataloohum be l‑seef bala mahanna.Wa achaan zaʼalhum didd akhwaanhumma wagafwa karabo leehum al‑adaawafi galibhum le mudda tawiile.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi mantagat Teemaanal‑taakul kulla gusuur hillit Busra. 
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Be sabab naas Bani Ammuuniso talaata wa arbaʼa marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial‑kharaar al‑chiltah didduhum.Achaan fi Gilʼaad chaggo butuun al‑awiin al‑khalbaanaatle yiwassuʼu arduhum.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi daraadir madiinat Rabbaal‑taakul kulla gusuurhabe korooraak fi yoom al‑haribwa be amzoobaʼaanefi yoom hana riih chadiide.
Wa malikha wa kubaaraatah yakurbuuhumwa kulluhum yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Be sabab naas balad Muwaabiso talaata wa arbaʼa marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial‑kharaar al‑chiltah didduhum.Achaan harrago udaam malik Adoomlahaddi bigo rumaad.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi balad Muwaabal‑taakul kulla gusuur madiinat Kharyuut.Wa kulla naas balad Muwaab yumuutufi ust al‑harakawa korooraak al‑haribwa hiss al‑buug.
Wa ana nuguchch malik Muwaab min usuthumwa kulla kubaaraatah naktulhum maʼaayah. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Be sabab Bani Yahuuzaiso talaata wa arbaʼa marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial‑kharaar al‑chiltah didduhum.Achaan abo churuut al‑Tawraatwa ma yahfado gawaaniini.Wa taabaʼo al‑kidib wa waddarowa da l‑kidib al‑abbahaathum taabaʼooh.
Wa fi chaan da,ana ninazzil naarfi balad Yahuuzaal‑taakul kulla gusuur Madiinat al‑Khudus. 
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Be sabab Bani Israaʼiiliso talaata wa arbaʼa marraat,ana abadan ma nikhallial‑kharaar al‑chiltah didduhum.Achaan baaʼo al‑saalih be sileeyaatwa l‑fagraan be niʼeelaat.
Wa yidissu ruuse al‑daʼiifiin fi l‑turaabwa yazulmu al‑masaakiin fi l‑chariiʼa.Al‑walad wa abuuh yamchu le mara waahidewa be da,ma yihtarumu usmi al‑mukhaddas.
Wa yarugdu jamb ayyi madbahfi l‑khulgaan al‑dammanoohum leehum.Wa l‑khamar al‑chaalooh fi l‑hukum,yacharbooh fi beeti ana Ilaahhum.
Wa ana bas al‑zamaan dammart al‑Amuuriyiinfi chaan Bani Israaʼiil.Wa l‑Amuuriyiin dooltuwaal misil chadar al‑arzwa chudaad misil chadar al‑balluut.Wa ana dammartuhum misil al‑chadarmin furuuʼah lahaddi uruugah.
 Wa ana bas al‑zamaan maragtuku min balad Masirwa gudtuku muddit 40 sana fi l‑saharale taglaʼo balad al‑Amuuriyiin.
Wa ana azalt waahidiin min iyaalkule yabgo anbiyawa waahidiin min subyaankule yikhassusuuhum leyi be nazir.Wa da sahiih walla kidib,ya Bani Israaʼiil ?Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa laakin charrabtu al‑khamarle l‑mukhassasiin be l‑nazirwa gultu le l‑anbiya :‹ Ma titnabbaʼo ! ›
Wa be da,ana narhakkumisil rahiik al‑kaarroal‑chaayil maʼaach tagiil.
Wa be da,al‑jarraay rijlah ma tinajjiihwa l‑gaadir gudurtah ma tanfaʼahwa l‑fahal kula ma yinajji nafsah.
Wa siid al‑nubbaal ma yagdar yasbitwa l‑ajiil ma yasbugwa siid al‑juwaad kula ma yinajji nafsah.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑fahal min al‑rujaal kula yiʼarrid aryaan. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,asmaʼo kalaam Allahal‑gaalah didduku,didduku intu al‑gabaayilal‑maragaaku min balad Masir :
 Ana azaltuku intu wiheedkumin usut kulla gabaayil al‑ard.Wa fi chaan da,ana niʼaakhibkube sabab kulla khataayaaku. 
Rujaal itneen yagdaro yamchu sawakan ma astafago walla ?
Al‑duud yagdar yikirr fi l‑khaabakan ma katal walla ?Wald al‑duud hissah yinsamiʼ fi nugurtahkan ma ligi akil walla ?
Al‑teer yagdar yagaʼ fi l‑charakkan ma chattato leyah akil walla ?Al‑charak yagdar yamrug min al‑ardkan ma karab seedtah walla ?
Kan al‑buug baka fi lubb al‑hille,sukkaanha ma yibarjulu walla ?Kan cheyy fasil ja fi l‑hille,ma Allah bas jaʼalah walla ?
Wa misil da,Allah al‑Rabb ma yisawwi ayyi cheyykan ma bayyan sirrah le abiidah al‑anbiya.
Al‑duud kan karra,yaatu al‑ma yakhaaf ?Allah al‑Rabb kan kallam,yaatu al‑ma yiballikh kalaamah ?
 Iitu fi gusuur madiinat Achduudwa fi gusuur balad Masir wa guulu :‹ Limmu fi jibaal al‑Saamirawa chiifu al‑barjaal al‑katiir al‑fi lubbahawa l‑zulum al‑gaaʼid foogha. ›
Wa da kalaam Allah.Chaʼabi ma yaʼarfu yisawwu al‑haggwa yakhzunu fi gusuurhum kulla cheyyal‑chaalo be unuf wa nahib. 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Ya l‑Saamira,al‑adu yihaasirkiwa yidammir gudritki wa yanhab gusuurki. 
Daahu Allah gaal : Misil al‑raaʼi yikhallismin khachum al‑duudrijileen aw nuss adaan,be misil da,yakhlasoBani Israaʼiil al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑Saamira,al‑murtaahiin fi saraayirhumwa l‑jaalsiin fi busaataathum.
Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir.Asmaʼo wa hazzuruzurriiyit Yaakhuub !
Yoom niʼaakhib Bani Israaʼiil be zunuubhum,niʼaakhib madaabih Beet Iilwa nikassir guruun al‑madbahwa narmiihum fi l‑turaab.
Wa nidammir buyuut al‑khaniyiinal‑yinjammo fooghum fi l‑chite wa l‑seef.Wa l‑buyuut al‑mujammaliin be l‑aaj kula,nidammirhumwa buyuut katiiriin yabgo ma fiihum. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Asmaʼan,ya l‑awiinal‑gaaʼidaat fi jibaal madiinat al‑Saamira !Intan misil bagaral‑yasraho fi marʼa Baachaan.Intan tazulman al‑masaakiinwa titaʼʼiban al‑fagraaniin.Wa taamuran siyaad buyuutkanwa tuguulan : Jiib leyi nachrab ! 
Wa khalaas,Allah al‑Rabb halafbe usmah al‑Khudduus wa gaal : Yaji leekan yoom waahid al‑foogahyakurbuukan misil huut be jambaatwa iyaalkan yatʼanoohum be kookaab.
Wa ayyi waahide tamrug be khurmit al‑durdurwa yiwadduuha ale jabal Harmuun. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa kan abeetu kalaami ana Allah,khalaas amchu Beet Iilwa aʼasowa amchu Gilgaal wa ziidu isyaanku.Wa kulli sabaah,gaddumu dahaayaakuwa ayyi talaata yoom,antu uchuurku.
Wa harrugu khubza bala tawwaara hadiiyat chukurwa faachuru be l‑hadaayaal‑tigaddumuuhum le Allah be niiyitku.Wa da bas al‑cheyy al‑yaʼajibku intu,ya Bani Israaʼiil. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
 Ana jibt leeku al‑juuʼfi kulla mudunku wa buyuutku.Ma fi cheyy al‑tidissuuh fi khuchuumkuwa be da kula,ma tubtu. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa fi wakt al‑iine bas,ana manaʼt minku al‑matar.Wa nazzalt al‑matara fi hille waahidewa fi hille aakhara kamaan,ana ma nazzaltaha.Wa nazzalt al‑matara fi zereʼ waahidwa zereʼ aakhar yibis.
Wa naas mudun itneen aw talaatamacho le madiina waahidele yacharbo almi.Laakin ma ligo almi al‑yarwiihumwa be da kula,ma tubtu. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa ana nazzalt waba al‑yabaaswa battaan affant nabaataatku.Wa l‑jaraad akal jineenaatkuwa inabku wa tiinku wa zaytuunkuwa be da kula,ma tubtu. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa nazzalt foogku al‑wabamisil ana nazzaltah fi balad Masir.Wa subyaanku maato fi l‑haribwa kheelku kula anchaalo.Wa chammeetu afanat al‑janaazaatfi muʼaskaraatkuwa be da kula,ma tubtu. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa dammartukumisil dammart hillaal Saduum wa Amuurawa damaarhum da ja minni ana Ilaahhum.Wa bigiitu misil al‑muchhaabal‑maragooh min al‑naarwa be da kula,ma tubtu. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa da kulla nisawwiih foogku,ya Bani Israaʼiil,wa misil da bas,nisawwiih foogku.Jahhuzu nufuusku le mugaabalati ana Ilaahku,ya Bani Israaʼiil ! 
Chiifu Allah basal‑khalag al‑jibaal wa l‑riih.Hu bas al‑bayyan le l‑insaanal‑cheyy al‑hu yidoor yisawwiih.Wa hu bas al‑sawwa al‑nuur dalaamwa hu bas al‑yahkim fi kulla l‑ard.Wa hu bas usmah Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir.
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,asmaʼo al‑kalaam al‑ana nabki wa nunuuh beyah.
 Bani Israaʼiil al‑misil bineeye udriiye,hi wagaʼat ma tagdar tugumm abadan.Hi anbatahat fi ardahawa yaatu al‑yarfaʼha ? 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Rabb gaal : Bani Israaʼiil yamurgu min al‑madiina le l‑haribwa laakin yakhsaro.Kan marago alif,yigabbulu miya baswa kan marago miya,yigabbulu achara bas ! 
Wa daahu Allah gaal le Bani Israaʼiil : Fattuchuuniwa talgo al‑haya.
Wa laakin ma tifattuchuuni fi Beet Iilwa la tamchu fi Gilgaalwa la tiwajjuhu ale Biir Sabʼa.Achaan naas Gilgaal,yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurbawa Beet Iil tabga kharaab. 
Fattuchu Allahwa talgo al‑haya.Wa kan abeetu kamaan,tiddammaro misil akalatku naar,ya zurriiyit Yuusuf.Al‑naar taakul Beet Iilwa ma fi al‑yagdar yaktulha.
Wa l‑hagg,sawweetuuh murr misil al‑hamdalwa l‑adaala,zagaltuuha fi l‑turaab.
Wa Allah bas al‑khalagnujuum al‑Tureyyawa l‑Sabi al‑Makhmi.Wa hu bas al‑sawwa al‑dalaam fajurwa l‑nahaar leel.Wa hu yitalliʼ almi al‑buhuurwa yazgi beyah al‑ardwa hu bas usmah Allah.
Hu yidammir al‑muluukwa yakhrib mudunhum al‑gawiyiin.
Intu tabkhudu al‑chaahidal‑yuguul al‑sahiih fi l‑chariiʼawa tajʼal al‑naadum al‑yuguul al‑sahiihmisil muharram.
Intu titaʼʼubu al‑daʼiifwa be gu,tichiilu gamhah.Wa achaan da,al‑buyuut al‑samhiinhana l‑hajar al‑baneetuuhumabadan ma taskunu fooghum.Wa chadar al‑inab al‑zaraʼtuuhabadan ma tacharbo min khamarah.
Ana aalim be kulla khataayaakuwa zunuubku al‑katiiriin.Tazulmu al‑saalih wa tichiilu al‑rachwawa tadharo al‑fagri min haggah fi l‑chariiʼa.
Wa fi l‑wakit da,al‑aagil yaskutachaan da wakt al‑diige.
Ma tisawwu al‑charr.Sawwu al‑kheer le tahyo.Wa be da,Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadiryukuun maʼaaku misil intu gultuuh.
Akraho al‑charr wa hibbu al‑kheerwa ansuru al‑hagg fi l‑chariiʼa.Wa be da,akuun Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadiryihinn fi l‑faddalo min zurriiyit Yuusuf.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah al‑Ilaah hu al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir gaal : Fi kulla bakaan,al‑naas yunuuhuwa fi kulla l‑chawaariʼ,yabku wa yuguulu :‹ Ya khasaaritna,ya khasaaritna ! ›Wa yinaadu al‑masaakiin le l‑hizinwa l‑nawwaahiin le yunuuhu.
Wa l‑nuwaah yabga fi kulla jineenaat al‑inabwakit nuchugg fi usutku wa niʼaakhibku. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Al‑azaab le l‑naasal‑yitmanno jayyit yoom Allah.Yoom Allah da indah leeku chunu ?Fi l‑yoom da,ma talgo nuur illa l‑dalaam.
Da misil naadum muʼarrid min duudwa wagaʼ fi maraafʼiin.Wa wakit dakhal beetah,arrakkaz be iidah fi l‑durdurwa addaah daabi.
Wa yoom Allah da yoom dalaamwa dalaamah chadiidma indah nuur.Wa akiid da yoom azrag kurum,ma indah ayyi deyy.
 Ana Allah nakrah wa naaba kulli iidal‑tiʼayyuduuh leyi.Wa ma narda beyahkan tilimmu wa tiʼayyuduuh.
Hatta kan gaddamtu leyi dahaaya muharragiinwa hadaaya hana dagiig kula,ma nakhbalhum.Wa kan gaddamtu leyi dahaaya salaamamin ajjaalku al‑sumaan kula,ma najʼalhum.
Baʼʼudu minni harakat khineeku hana l‑chukurwa ma nidoor nasmaʼ daribiin jigindiiyitku.
Wa laakin khalli al‑hagg yisiilmisil al‑seelwa l‑adaala tajrimisil al‑waadi al‑ma yagiif.
Ya Bani Israaʼiil,fi muddit 40 sana fi l‑sahara,gaddamtu dahaaya wa hadaaya leyi ana walla ?
Wa hassaʼ,chiltu sanamku Sukkuut al‑gultu malikkuwa ilaahku najmat Kiyuunal‑intu sanaʼtuuhum le nufuusku.
Wa be sabab da,niwaddiiku fi l‑khurbakhaadi le madiinat Dimachkh. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah wa usmah Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir.
Al‑azaab leeku intual‑gaaʼidiin murtaahiin fi jabal Sahyuunwa l‑gaaʼidiin be amaan fi jabal al‑Saamira.Intu tahsubu nufuusku ahsan naas fi ahsan ummawa kulla Bani Israaʼiil yaju leeku intu.
Amchu le hillit Kalnawa chiifu al‑bigi fooghawa minha fuutule madiinat Hamaat al‑kabiirewa battaan amchuGaat madiinat al‑Filistiyiin.Hal mamaalikhum akheermin mamlakatku walla ?Wa arduhum akbarmin arduku walla ?
Wa wakit intu tahsubu yoom al‑diige baʼiid bilheen,be da,intu tigarrubu yoom al‑unuf leeku.
Intu raagdiin fi saraayiral‑mujammaliin be aajwa gaaʼidiin murtaahiinfi furaachku.Wa taakulu laham al‑kubchaanwa l‑ajjaal al‑maʼzuuliin min al‑zariibe.
Wa tikhannu maʼa l‑jigindiiyele tibaazu Dawuudwa tasnaʼo le nufuusku aalaat hana khine.
Wa tacharbo al‑khamar be kharaariifwa tusubbu ahsan itir.Wa laakin ma gaaʼidiin tahzanole damaar zurriiyit Yuusuf.
Wa achaan da,hassaʼ tabgo awwal naasal‑yakurbuuhum wa yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba.Wa l‑raaha al‑intu aaychiin foogha dikula tabga ma fiiha.
Allah al‑Rabb halaf be nafsahwa daahu kalaam Allah : Ana Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadirnakrah istikbaar Bani Israaʼiil.Wa nabkhud gusuurhumwa nisallim madiinithumwa kulla cheyy al‑indaha le aduuhum.
Wa kan achara naas gaaʼidiin fi beet waahid,kulluhum yumuutu.
Wa l‑gariib le l‑maytiinyamchi yichiil al‑janaazaatle yahrighum barra min al‑beet.Wa yuguul le l‑naadum al‑faddaldaakhal fi lubb al‑beet :‹ Naadum maʼaak fi walla ? ›Wa hu yuguul :‹ La ! ›Wa l‑gariib yuguul :‹ Askut !Ma tinaadi usum Allah.› 
Wa khalaas,daahu amur Allah.Al‑buyuut al‑kubaar yiddammarowa l‑dugaag yilkassaro.
Wa hal al‑kheelyagdaro yajru fi raas al‑hajar walla ?Wa hal al‑tiiraanyagdaro yajbudu al‑harraata fi raas al‑hajar walla ?Wa maala baddaltu al‑adaala be l‑sammwa sawweetu al‑hagg murr misil al‑hamdal ?
Wa intu tafraho achaan nasartu fi hillit Luudabaar wa tuguulu : Be gudritna bas,chilna hillit Garnaayim. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Ilaah al‑Gaadir : Ya Bani Israaʼiil,ana nirassil leeku umma tidaayigku min khachum hillit Labu Hamaat fi l‑munchaakh lahaddi waadi al‑Urdun fi l‑wati. 
Daahu al‑cheyy al‑Allah al‑Rabb wassafah leyi ana Amuus.Allah gaaʼid yijahhiz jaraad wakit al‑kichcheeb bada yamrug wa da baʼad al‑ganaadiil al‑awwal gataʼoohum le l‑malik.
Wa wakit al‑jaraad ja akal kulla l‑khadaar hana l‑balad,ana gult : Ya Allah al‑Rabb,min fadlak akhfir !Zurriiyit Yaakhuub ma yagdaro yahmaloohachaan humman daʼiifiin. 
Wa khalaas,Allah afaahum wa gaal : Al‑cheyy da ma yukuun. 
Wa daahu al‑cheyy al‑wassafah leyi Allah al‑Rabb.Hu amar al‑naar tanzil le yiʼaakhib beeha al‑naas.Wa tiyabbis al‑almi al‑fi tihit al‑ard wa taakul kulla ard Israaʼiil.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,ana gult : Ya Allah al‑Rabb,min fadlak al‑cheyy da waggifah !Zurriiyit Yaakhuub ma yagdaro yahmaloohachaan humman daʼiifiin. 
Wa khalaas,Allah al‑Rabb afaahum wa gaal : Al‑cheyy da ma yukuun. 
Wa daahu ana chift battaan fi l‑ruʼya al‑Rabb waagif jamb durdur wa fi iidah indah habil al‑yigaawusu beyah al‑buna.
Wa Allah gaal leyi : Chift chunu,ya Amuus ? Wa ana gult : Habil al‑yigaawusu beyah. Wa l‑Rabb gaal leyi : Daahu chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil humman misil al‑durdur al‑aʼwaj be fiʼilhum al‑cheen.Wa achaan da,battaan ma nakhfir leehum.
Ana nihaddim al‑bakaanaat al‑aaliyiin hana ibaadat zurriiyit Ishaakh wa nikassir madaabih Bani Israaʼiil wa nigawwim harib didd aayilat al‑malik Yarubaʼaam. 
Wa fiyah raajil diin waahid min hillit Beet Iil usmah Amasya.Wa l‑raajil da rassal le Yarubaʼaam malik mamlakat Israaʼiil wa gaal leyah : Amuus gaaʼid yiharrich al‑chaʼab achaan ma yitaabuʼuuk.Wa Bani Israaʼiil ma yagdaro yahmalo kulla l‑kalaam al‑hu gaaʼid yuguulah.
Achaan Amuus gaal :‹ Al‑malik Yarubaʼaam,udwaanah yaktuluuh !Wa Bani Israaʼiil kula,yakurbuuhum wa yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba baʼiid min baladhum.› 
Wa khalaas,Amasya gaal le Amuus : Gumm,ya chawwaafi !Gabbil amchi le balad Yahuuza wa hinaak abga nabi wa talga rizgak.
Wa laakin ma titnabbaʼ battaan fi Beet Iil achaan da bakaan al‑ibaada hana l‑malik. 
Wa Amuus radda le Amasya wa gaal : Ana wa la nabi wa la wileed nabi.Ana raaʼi wa harraati hana tiin.
Laakin Allah bas naadaani wakit ana gaaʼid nasrah be khanami wa gaal leyi :‹ Amchi atnabbaʼ le chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil. ›
Wa hassaʼ da,ya Amasya,asmaʼ kalaam Allah.Inta gult leyi ana ma nitnabbaʼ fi Bani Israaʼiil wa la nihajji le zurriiyit Ishaakh.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal :‹ Martak tabga charmuuta fi lubb al‑hillewa awlaadak wa banaatak yaktuluuhum be l‑seef.Wa yichiilu ardakwa yigassumu ziraaʼtak le udwaanak.Wa inta kamaan tumuutfi balad al‑kuffaarwa Bani Israaʼiil yakurbuuhumwa yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba.› 
Daahu al‑cheyy al‑Allah al‑Rabb wassafah leyi ana Amuus fi l‑ruʼya.Ana chift guffa malaane be fawaakih najiidiin.
Wa Allah gaal : Chift chunu,ya Amuus ? Wa ana gult : Chift guffa malaane fawaakih najiidiin. Wa Allah gaal leyi : Misil al‑fawaakih al‑nijdo,chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil kulawakithum tamma le l‑ikhaabwa ana battaan ma nakhfir leehum.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,khine fi gasir al‑malik yikhayyir yabga nuwaah.Wa fi ayyi bakaan,janaazaat mudaffigiinbala haraka. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb.
Asmaʼo,ya intu al‑tazulmu al‑masaakiinwa min al‑balad,taturdu al‑taʼbaaniin.
Intu tuguulu fi nufuusku : Le mata yikammil al‑iidhana awwal yoom fi l‑chaharachaan nibiiʼu gamehna ?Wa mata yikammil yoom al‑sabtachaan nufukku dabangaatnawa nibiiʼu khumaamna ?Nikiilu be mikyaal sakhayyarwa niziidu tamanahwa nukhuchchu be miizaan al‑ma adiil.
Wa nachru al‑miskiin be sileeyaatwa l‑fagraan be niʼeelaatwa nibiiʼu kanfuut al‑gameh. 
Wa Allah halaf be l‑baladal‑farhaaniin beeha zurriiyit Yaakhuub wa gaal : Ana abadan ma nansa amalku al‑cheenal‑gaaʼidiin tisawwuuh.
Wa be sabab da,al‑balad ma tarjif walla ?Wa kulla sukkaanhama yabgo haznaaniin walla ?Al‑balad tatlaʼ kullahamisil bahar hana Masirwa tatmi wa tanzilmisil seel al‑Niil. 
Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Rabb : Fi l‑yoom da be duhur,al‑wata tabga dalmawa be nahaar bas,al‑wata tabga leel fi kulla l‑balad.
Wa ayyi iid al‑tiʼayyuduuh,nibaddilah be hizinwa kulla khineeku yabga nuwaah.Wa kulluku talbaso khulgaan al‑hizinwa tizayyunu ruuseeku.Da yabga misil hizinhana moot al‑wileed al‑wahiidwa fi l‑akhiir,yabga yoom hana hizin chadiid. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Rabb : Yaji yoom waahid al‑foogahnijiib al‑juuʼ fi kulla l‑balad.Wa da ma juuʼ hana akilwa la atach le l‑almilaakin da juuʼ wa atachle kalaami ana Allah.
Wa intu tiʼiiru min bahar le aakharwa min munchaakh le sabaahwa tifattuchu kalaam Allahwa laakin be da kula,ma talgooh.
Fi l‑yoom da,al‑banaat wa l‑subyaanyumuutu min al‑atach.
Naas waahidiin yahalfube sanam madiinat al‑Saamira wa yuguulu :‹ Yiʼiich ilaahki,ya hillit Daan !Wa yiʼiich ilaahki,ya hillit Biir Sabʼa ! ›Wa l‑naas dool yahlako marra waahidwa battaan ma yugummu. 
Daahu ana Amuus chift al‑Rabb waagif jamb al‑madbah wa hu gaal : Adurbu ruuse amad beet Allahwa gaʼarah yarjifwa yagaʼ fi raas kulla l‑naaswa humman yumuutu.Wa zurriiyithum kamaanyaktuluuhum be l‑seefwa naadum waahidma yiʼarrid wa la yifaddil.
Wa kan dakhalo fi l‑khabur kula,nimarrighumwa kan talaʼo fi l‑sama kula,ninazzilhum.
Wa kan allabbadofi raas jabal al‑Karmal kula,nifattichhum wa nakrubhum.Wa kan tamaso fi gaʼar al‑baharle yillabbado minni kula,naamur daabi al‑bahar yiʼaddiihum.
Wa kan aduuhum yiwaddiihum abiid kula,ana naamur yaktulhum kulluhum be l‑seef.Wa ana gaaʼid niraakhib fooghumwa da ma le l‑kheerlaakin le l‑charr. 
Kan Allah al‑Rabb al‑Gaadir yalmas al‑ard,hi tarjif wa sukkaanha yahzano.Wa hi tatlaʼ kullahamisil bahar hana Masirwa tatmi wa tanzilmisil seel al‑Niil.
Hu bana beetah aali fi l‑samawa khatta asaasah fi l‑ard.Wa hu yitalliʼ almi al‑buhuurwa yazgi beyah al‑ard.Wa hu bas usmah Allah.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Ya Bani Israaʼiil,intu tahsubu nufuusku muhimmiin leyiziyaada min al‑Habachiyiin walla ?Ma ana bas al‑maragt Bani Israaʼiil min balad Masirwa l‑Filistiyiin min Kaftuurwa l‑Araamiyiin min Khiir walla ?
Asmaʼo !Ana Allah al‑Rabb niraakhib foogku,intu mamlakat al‑muznibiin,wa nuguchchuku min wijh al‑ard.Wa laakin be da kula,ma nuguchch zurriiyit Yaakhuub marra waahid.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa daahu ana naamurwa nikharbil Bani Israaʼiilmin ambeen kulla l‑umam.Wa da misil yikharbuluuhum be tabagwa habbaay waahide kula ma tagaʼ fi l‑ard.
Wa kulla l‑muznibiin min chaʼabiyumuutu fi l‑harib.Dool humman al‑yuguulu :‹ Al‑masiibe di ma talhagnawa abadan ma tawsalna !› 
 Wa fi l‑yoom da,nabni min jadiidmadiinat Dawuud al‑mukassara.Wa nikaddik nugaarhawa niʼaddil daraadirhawa hi tabga misil awwal.
Wa Bani Israaʼiil yichiilual‑faddal min ard Adoomwa min kulla l‑umamal‑ana naadeethum be usmi. Wa da kalaam Allah wa hu yihaggig kalaamah.
 Wa daahu yaji yoom waahid al‑foogahal‑harraati yaji wara l‑yagtaʼwa l‑yagtaʼ al‑inab yaji wara l‑yiteeribah.Wa l‑khamar yisiil be kataramisil almi al‑yanzil min al‑hajar.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa nigabbil chaʼabi Bani Israaʼiil min al‑khurbawa yabnu hillaalhum al‑mukassariinwa yaskunu fooghum.Wa yazraʼo jineenaathum hana l‑inabwa yacharbo min khamarhum.Wa yimaggunu jineenaathumwa yaakulu fawaakihhum.
Wa nisabbithum fi arduhumwa ma yaturduuhum battaanmin arduhum al‑ana anteetha leehum. Wa da,Allah Ilaahku bas gaalah.
Ruʼyat Ubadya.Daahu kalaam Allah al‑Rabb didd chaʼab Adoom.Simiʼna khabar jaayi min Allah,hu rassal rasuul been al‑umam le yuguul : Yalla gummu !Gummu haarubu balad Adoom ! 
 Ya chaʼab Adoom,daahu ana nisawwiiku umma sakhayrewa fi ust al‑umam,yahguruuku ziyaada.
Wa istikbaarku bas khachchaaku,ya intu al‑gaaʼidiin fi karaakiir al‑hujaar.Taskunu fi l‑bakaanaat al‑aaliyiinwa tuguulu fi nufuusku :‹ Yaatu yinazzilna tihit ? ›
Wa hatta kan titiiru misil al‑suguurawa tabnu uchchuku been al‑nujuum kula,min hinaak ana ninazzilku.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa kan saraariig aw nahhaabiin yajuuku be l‑leel,humman ma yichiilu al‑yakfiihum bas walla ?Wa kan gattaaʼiin al‑inab yaju leeku,ma yikhallu waraahum al‑kichcheeb walla ?
Ya zurriiyit Isuu,udwaanku yifattuchuukuwa yakchufu kanzuku.
Kulla l‑rujaal al‑induku maʼaahum alaakhayaturduuku khaadi le huduudku.Wa l‑rujaal al‑induku maʼaahum salaamyukhuchchuuku wa yahkumu foogku.Wa rufgaanku al‑akalo akilkuyukujju leeku charak tihit rijleeku.Wa yuguulu :‹ Humman dool ma induhum agul ! ›
Fi l‑yoom da bas,ana nidammir kulla l‑ulama al‑fi Adoomwa l‑faahimiin al‑fi jibaal zurriiyit Isuu.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya hillit Teemaan,furraaski yinbahtuwa be da,al‑adu yaktul ayyi naadumal‑gaaʼid fi jibaal zurriiyit Isuu. 
 Wa be sabab al‑unuf al‑sawweetuuhle akhwaanku zurriiyit Yaakhuub,al‑eeb yikhattiikuwa tiddammaro ila l‑abad.
Achaan fi yoom diigithum,intu wagaftu baʼiidwakit al‑ajaanib nahabo khunaahumwa l‑udwaan dakhalo biibaan al‑madiinawa sawwo amʼiyeedaat le yilgaasamo Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa fi l‑yoom da,intu kula bigiitu waahidiin min udwaanhum.
Ma waajib tafrahofi yoom damaar akhwaanku,fi yoom masiibithum.Wa ma waajib tafrahobe sabab Bani Yahuuzafi yoom addammaro.Wa ma waajib tatulgu lisaankufi yoom diigithum.
Wa ma waajib tadkhulu madiinat chaʼabifi yoom kharaabhumwa la tafraho be fasaalithumfi yoom kharaabhumwa la tanhabo khunaahumfi yoom kharaabhum.
Wa ma waajib tagoodufi machbak al‑duruuble taktulu al‑muʼarridiin minhumwa tisallumu al‑faddalo hayyiinfi yoom diigithum.
Achaan al‑yoom al‑Allah yihaakim foogah kulla l‑umamjaayi gariib.Misil sawweet,yisawwu foogak.Wa amalak al‑sawweetah,yigabbil leek fi raasak. 
 Ya Bani Yahuuza,misil chiribtu min kaas khadabifi jabali al‑mukhaddas,kulla l‑umam yacharbo minnah daayman.Humman yarwo min kaas khadabimisil al‑sakkaara yarwo min al‑mariisewa yabgo misil abadan ma khalagoohum.
Wa laakin chaʼab Allah al‑faddaloyaljaʼo fi jabal Sahyuunwa l‑bakaan da battaan yabga mukhaddas.Wa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yaglaʼo arduhummin al‑naas al‑galaʼooha minhum.
Wa zurriiyit Yaakhuub yabgo misil naarwa zurriiyit Yuusuf yabgo misil ambalbaala.Wa laakin zurriiyit Isuu yabgo misil gechchwa l‑naar tutuchchuhum wa tahrighum.Wa naadum waahid kula min zurriiyit Isuuma yifaddil hayyachaan da kalaam Allahal‑hu gaalah. 
Wa fi l‑junuub,Bani Yahuuza yaglaʼo jibaal zurriiyit Isuu wa fi sahalat Chafiila,yaglaʼo balad al‑Filistiyiin.Wa yaglaʼo turaab gabiilat Afraayim wa turaab madiinat al‑Saamira.Wa naas gabiilat Banyaamiin yaglaʼo Gilʼaad.
Wa Bani Israaʼiil al‑gabbalo min al‑khurba yaglaʼo balad Kanʼaan lahaddi Sarafa.Wa sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑gabbalo min al‑khurba fi Safaarad yaglaʼo mudun al‑junuub.
Wa l‑munajjiyiin yatlaʼo jabal Sahyuun wa yahkumu jibaal zurriiyit Isuu.Wa l‑muluk yukuun le Allah !
Yoom waahid,Allah hajja le Yuunus wileed Amittaay wa gaal :
 Gumm amchi fi Niinawa,al‑madiina al‑kabiire di.Wa khabbir naas al‑madiina kadar al‑fasaala al‑humman gaaʼidiin yisawwuuha di,ana chiftaha.Khalli yingarʼu ! 
Khalaas,Yuunus gamma arrad wa aba ma yichiil derib hana Niinawa laakin chaal derib hana hillit Tarchiich achaan yidoor yajri min Allah.Wa wisil fi hillit Yaafa fi khachum al‑bahar al‑Abyad al‑Mutawassit wa ligi safiina maache Tarchiich.Khalaas kaffa ujurtah wa rikib maʼa khaddaamiin al‑safiina le yamchi Tarchiich,baʼiid min Allah.
Wa wakit maachiin fi l‑bahar da,Allah rassal riih chadiide wa challaal chadiid gamma lahaddi yidoor yikassir al‑safiina.
Wa khaddaamiin al‑safiina khaafo bilheen wa ayyi waahid minhum gamma yasrakh le ilaahah achaan yinajjiihum.Wa daffago al‑khumaam al‑fi l‑safiina fi l‑bahar achaan tabga khafiife.Wa Yuunus kamaan dalla tihit fi lubb al‑safiina ragad wa naayim noom chadiid.
Wa masʼuul al‑safiina ja gaal leyah : Haay da !Maalak naayim ?Gumm asʼal ilaahak !Akuun yifakkir foogna wa yinajjiina min al‑moot. 
Wa khaddaamiin al‑safiina gaalo ambeenaathum : Taʼaalu nisawwu amʼiyeedaat achaan naʼarfu yaatu al‑jaab leena al‑masiibe di. Khalaas sawwo amʼiyeedaat wa wagaʼ fi Yuunus.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,humman gaalo leyah : Ooriina chunu al‑jaab leena al‑masiibe di.Inta jaayi min ween ?Wa jiit tisawwi chunu ?Wa baladak ween wa nafarak chunu ? 
Wa Yuunus radda leehum wa gaal : Ana Ibraani wa naʼabud Allah Rabb al‑samaawaat,al‑khalag al‑ard wa l‑bahar.
Wa ana muʼarrid min Allah. Wa wakit humman simʼo kalaamah da,khaafo khoof chadiid.Wa gaalo leyah : Maala sawweet cheyy misil da ? 
Wa l‑challaal gaaʼid yatlaʼ be ziyaada.Wa gaalo leyah : Hassaʼ da,nisawwu leek chunu achaan al‑challaal yagiif leena ? 
Wa Yuunus gaal leehum : Chiiluuni wa azguluuni fi l‑bahar wa l‑challaal yagiif leeku.Achaan ana naʼarif kadar al‑riih al‑chadiide di jaat fi chaani ana bas. 
Wa laakin khaddaamiin al‑safiina haawalo yigabbulu al‑safiina fi khachum al‑bahar.Wa ma gidro achaan al‑challaal gaaʼid yatlaʼ be ziyaada.
Wa gammo yachhado Allah wa gaalo : Ya Allah !Ma tahlikna fi chaan al‑raajil da wa ma tukhutt foogna dimmit bari.Ya Allah !Inta sawweet al‑cheyy al‑tidoorah. 
Khalaas,chaalo Yuunus wa zagalooh fi l‑bahar wa tawwaali al‑challaal wagaf.
Wa l‑khaddaamiin khaafo khoof chadiid min Allah wa gaddamo leyah dahiiye wa aahado Allah achaan yaʼabuduuh be ziyaada.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,Allah rassal huutaay kabiire zaratat Yuunus.Wa khalaas,Yuunus gaʼad fi batun al‑huutaay talaata yoom wa talaata leele.
Wa fi batun al‑huutaay,Yuunus gamma yisalli le Allah Ilaahah.
Wa gaal : Ya Allah !Fi taʼabi,ana bakeet leekwa inta najjeetni.Wa fi l‑moot,ana sarakht leekwa inta simiʼt hissi.
Wakit inta zagaltinifi lubb al‑bahar,fi l‑almi al‑khariig,al‑challaal tammasaaniwa l‑mooj zarataani.
Wa ana hasabt nafsi matruudbaʼiid minnak,ya Rabb,wa laakin battaan namchinichiif beetak al‑mukhaddas.
Wa l‑bahar zarataaniwa almi al‑khariig akalaaniwa l‑gechch lawlaw leyi fi raasi.
Wa ana nazalt fi gaʼar al‑hajar,ansajant fi l‑sijinal‑baabah ansadda foogi ila l‑abad.Laakin,ya Allah Ilaahi,inta maragtini min almi al‑khariigwa najjeet hayaati min al‑moot.
Wa wakit ruuhi tidoor tamrug,ana alfakkartak,inta Allah.Wa salaati al‑wajjahtaha leekwislat leek fi beetak al‑mukhaddas.
Wa laakin al‑naas al‑yaʼabudu al‑asnaamma yalgo rahma minnak.
Wa kan leyi ana,nachkurakwa nigaddim leek dahiiyewa nitimm nazri al‑aahadtak beyah.Ya Allah !Inta bas al‑tinajji al‑naas. 
Wa khalaas,Allah amar al‑huutaay achaan tigaddif Yuunus wa hi gaddafatah fi khachum al‑bahar.
Wa Allah hajja le Yuunus taani marra wa gaal :
 Gumm amchi fi Niinawa,al‑madiina al‑kabiire.Wa khabbir naasha be l‑kalaam al‑nuguulah leek. 
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,khalaas Yuunus gamma macha Niinawa misil Allah amarah beyah.Wa Niinawa hi madiina kabiire bilheen wa naadum ma yagdar yuchuggaha illa fi talaata yoom.
Wa Yuunus wassal fi Niinawa wa indah yoom tamaam raayikh wa yuguul : Baʼad arbaʼiin yoom,Niinawa tiddammar ! 
Wa khalaas,naas Niinawa aamano be kalaam al‑Rabb al‑gaalah leehum Yuunus.Wa kharraro ayyaam hana siyaam wa libso khulgaan al‑tooba min al‑khani lahaddi l‑fagri.
Wa l‑malik,min simiʼ al‑khabar da,tawwaali gamma min kursi haggah wa salla khalagah hana l‑muluuk wa libis khalag al‑tooba wa gaʼad fi l‑rumaad.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,al‑malik marag kharaar fi Niinawa al‑buguul : Be izni ana al‑malik wa wuzaraayi,mamnuuʼ le l‑naas wa l‑bahaayim kan bagar walla khanam kula ma yaakulu wa la yasraho wa la yacharbo cheyy.
Wa waajib al‑naas yalbaso khulgaan al‑tooba wa yilabbusu al‑bahaayim kula.Wa ayyi waahid yachhad al‑Rabb be chidde wa yikhalli minnah amalah al‑fasil wa l‑unuf al‑gaaʼid yisawwiih.
Wa be da,akuun al‑Rabb yikhalli khadabah wa yarfaʼah minnina wa khalaas,ma numuutu. 
Wa l‑Rabb chaaf naas Niinawa gammo yisawwu misil ke wa khallo minhum amalhum al‑fasil.Wa khalaas,hu kula khalla khadabah al‑awwal kharrar yinazzilah fooghum.
Wa wakit Yuunus irif kadar Allah khalla khadabah da,ziʼil zaʼal chadiid.
Wa salla le Allah wa gaal : Ajab,ya Allah.Da ma al‑cheyy al‑ana gultah wakit ana lissaaʼni fi baladi walla ?Achaan da bas ana arradt le namchi Tarchiich.Ya Allah,naʼarif kadar inta al‑Rahmaan al‑Rahiim wa l‑Sabuur wa l‑Muhibb ziyaada wa tikhalli al‑khadab al‑awwal kharrart tinazzilah fi l‑naas.
Ya Allah,hassaʼ da khalaas.Chiil ruuhi.Al‑moot akheer leyi min al‑haya. 
Wa Allah gaal leyah : Inta da !Indak hagg tazʼal walla ? 
Wa Yuunus marag min Niinawa wa macha gaʼad sabaah min al‑madiina.Wa sawwa leyah ligdaabe wa gaʼad foogha fi l‑dull achaan yichiif al‑cheyy al‑yabga fi l‑madiina di.
Wa Allah al‑Rabb gawwam chideere achaan tisawwi dull le Yuunus wa tifarrihah min zaʼalah.Wa khalaas,Yuunus firih farha chadiide be l‑chideere di.
Wa laakin ambaakir be fajur badri,al‑Rabb rassal duudaay akalat al‑chideere di wa hi yibsat.
Wa wakit al‑harraay talaʼat,al‑Rabb rassal riih haamiye min al‑sabaah.Wa l‑harraay taggat Yuunus fi raasah lahaddi yidoor yakhmar.Wa dawwar yumuut wa gaal : Al‑moot akheer leyi min al‑haya. 
Wa l‑Rabb gaal le Yuunus : Inta indak hagg tazʼal fi chaan al‑chideere di walla ? Wa Yuunus radda leyah wa gaal : Aywa,indi hagg nazʼal lahaddi nidoor al‑moot. 
Wa laakin Allah gaal leyah : Asmaʼ.Inta hanneet fi l‑chideere al‑ma maggantaha wa la tiʼibt foogha.Hi gammat fi yoom waahid wa maatat fi l‑yoom al‑taani.
Chiif naas hana Niinawa,al‑madiina al‑kabiire,al‑indaha ziyaada min 120 000 naas al‑ma yaʼarfu zeen wa la fasil.Wa indaha bahaayim katiiriin kula.Kikkeef ana ma nihinn fooghum ? 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑gaalah fi ruʼya le Miikha al‑min hillit Muurachat al‑bukhuss mudun al‑Saamira wa Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa da fi ayyaam hukum Yuutaam wa Ahaaz wa Hizkhiiya muluuk mamlakat Yahuuza.
Asmaʼo,ya kulla l‑chuʼuub !Asmaʼe,ya l‑ardwa kulla cheyy al‑foogki.Allah al‑Rabb yachhad didduku.Aywa,al‑Rabb yuluumku min beetah al‑mukhaddas.
Daahu Allah maarig min bakaanahwa yanzil wa yamchifi l‑bakaanaat al‑aaliyiin hana l‑ard.
Wa l‑jibaal yumuuʼu tihtahwa hujaar khuchuum al‑wudyaan yingatʼumisil al‑chamʼe fi l‑naarwa misil almi al‑sabbooh fi dilleeye.
Wa da kulla fi chaan isyaan zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa fi chaan zunuub Bani Israaʼiil.Wa yaatu al‑lazza zurriiyit Yaakhuubfi l‑isyaan ?Di ma madiinat al‑Saamira walla ?Wa yaatu al‑harrach Bani Yahuuzale yaʼabudu ilaahaat fi l‑bakaanaat al‑aaliyiin ?Di ma Madiinat al‑Khudus walla ?
Wa Allah gaal : Al‑Saamira nisawwiiha koom hana turaabwa kadaade al‑yazraʼo foogha jineenaat al‑inab.Wa l‑hujaar al‑banooha beehum,nidaffighum fi l‑waadiwa asaasha,nikhalliih yibiin.
Wa kulla asnaamha yilkassarowa kulla maal beethum,niharrigah be naar.Wa nikharrib kulla asnaamhaachaan hi sanaʼathumbe maal ujrat charmatatha.Wa hassaʼ be hadiid al‑asnaam doolyiʼajjuru charaamiit aakharaat. 
Wa fi chaan da,ana Miikha nahzanwa nabki be hizinwa namchi bala niʼle wa aryaan.Wa nabki misil al‑baʼachoomwa nikirr misil al‑naʼaam.
Marad al‑Saamira ma indah ilaajwa hu lihig lahaddi balad Yahuuza.Wa lihig biibaan madiinat chaʼabiaywa,lihig usut Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Ma tikhabburu udwaanna fi Gaatwa ma tabku giddaamhum.Wa fi Beet Afrah,almarmakho fi l‑ajaaj min al‑hizin.
Wa sukkaan Chaafiir,yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurbafi l‑eeb wa l‑ire.Wa sukkaan Sanaan yakhaafo,ma yamurgu min hillithum.Naas Beet Isaal yabku min al‑hizinwa ma yafzaʼooku.
Wa sukkaan Maruut yakhaafo min kheerhum yiwaddirachaan al‑charr nazal min Allahwa wassal biibaan Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Ya sukkaan Lakiich,arbutu arabaat al‑haribfi l‑kheelachaan intu lazzeetu fi l‑zanibSahyuun al‑misil bineeyewa fiiku anlaga isyaan Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa fi chaan da,waajib intu tinfargumin Muurachat Gaat.Wa hillit Akziib takdib,ma tijiib fazaʼ le muluuk Israaʼiil.
Ya sukkaan Mariicha,nijiib leeku battaan naadum yichiil baladku.Wa kubaaraat Bani Israaʼiil al‑induhum charafyiʼarrudu wa yillabbado fi Adullaam.
Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑misil mara,agtaʼe chaʼarki wa zayyini raaskiachaan iyaalki al‑tihibbiihum.Abge muwalliʼe misil al‑sagurachaan yiwaddu iyaalki fi l‑khurba baʼiid minki.
Al‑azaab le l‑yanwu al‑fasaalawa yikhattutu al‑charr be l‑leel !Be fajur,yugummu yisawwu khittithumachaan induhum al‑gudra le yisawwuuha.
Humman yatmaʼo fi ziraaʼat al‑aakhariinwa yaglaʼoohumwa yitmanno al‑buyuut wa yichiiluuhum.Yazulmu al‑naas wa aayilaathumwa rujaal wa warasathum.
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal : Chiifu,ana nanwi al‑fasaala le gabiilitku diwa intu ma tagdaro tinajju nufuusku.Ma tagdaro turuukhu raasku marfuuʼachaan da wakt al‑fasaala. 
Wa fi l‑yoom da,yadurbu foogku masalwa yunuuhu nuwaah wa yuguulu : Kammaloona wa kharaboona !Allah baddal ard warasatna be balad al‑khurba.Wa galaʼ minnina ardinawa gassam warasatna le udwaanna. 
Wa fi chaan da,kan jamaaʼat Allahyigaawusu al‑ard battaan,ma fi naadum minku al‑yalga gisim.
Wa naas waahidiin gaalo leyi : Ma titnabbaʼ misil da !Ma tuguul kadar nalgo al‑eeb.La !Waddiriin al‑charaf ma yabga. 
Ya zurriiyit Yaakhuub,da bingaal walla ?Hal sabur Allah kammal walla ?Wa misil da bas,hu yugumm walla ?Wa kalaami ma yijiib al‑kheerle l‑naadum al‑yamchi adiil walla ?
Lahaddi hassaʼ,intu chaʼabi bigiitu udwaan Allah.Al‑naas al‑yigabbulu min al‑haribwa yahsubu induhum amaan,intu tisillu khulgaanhum.
Wa le awiin chaʼabi,taturduuhinayyi waahide min beetha al‑tiriidah.Wa ayyi wakit,taglaʼo min iyaalhinal‑charaf al‑Allah antaahum.
Yalla gummu amchu !Al‑balad di battaanma indaha leeku raahaachaan be najaasitku,jibtu foogha al‑damaarwa da damaar kaamil marra waahid !
Wa kan naadum yajri wara l‑riihwa yitnabbaʼ be kidib wa yuguul : Ana nitnabbaʼ leeku be khamar wa mariise ,da bas al‑nabi al‑waajib leeku intu al‑chaʼab da !
Wa Allah gaal : Akiid ana nilimmuku kulluku,ya zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa najmaʼku kulluku al‑faddaltumin Bani Israaʼiil.Wa nijiibku sawa misil khanam fi l‑zariibewa misil door fi ust al‑marʼa.Wa tabgo majmuuʼa kabiireal‑indaha haraka.
Wa l‑yufukk leeku al‑khurmayamchi giddaamku.Intu tufukku al‑khurmawa tufuutu be l‑baabwa tamurgu beyah.Wa malikku yamchi giddaamku.Aywa,ana Allah ale raasku. 
Wa ana Miikha gult : Asmaʼo,ya kubaaraat zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa hukkaam Bani Israaʼiil.Ma intu basal‑waajib taʼarfu al‑adaala walla ?
Wa laakin intu takraho al‑kheerwa tihibbu al‑charr.Taslakho farwit al‑naas min jisimhumwa tagtaʼo lahamhumwa tikhallu illa udaamhum.
Intu taakulu laham chaʼabiwa taslakho farwithumwa tikassuru udaamhum.Wa tigattuʼu laham chaʼabimisil tusubbuuh fi burmawa tirakkubuuh fi kalool. 
Wa khalaas,al‑zaalimiin dool yasʼalo Allahwa laakin hu ma yurudd leehum.Fi l‑wakit da,hu ma yiwajjih aleehumachaan humman sawwo amal fasil.
Wa daahu Allah gaal kalaam didd al‑anbiya al‑yiwadduru chaʼabah : Kan sunuunhum ligo chokhol yaakuluuh,humman yuguulu :‹ Salaam,Salaam ! ›Wa laakin kan naadum ma dassa leehum cheyy fi khachumhum,yinaadu diddah be l‑harib !
Wa fi chaan da,intu al‑anbiya,yabga leeku leel bala ruʼya.Wa yabga leeku dalaam,ma tagdaro tichawwufu.Wa l‑harraay tagaʼ leeku,ya l‑anbiya,wa l‑yoom yidallim leeku. 
Aywa,al‑yichiifu ruʼya yalgo al‑eebwa l‑chawwaafiin yalgo al‑chamaate.Wa humman yikhattu wujuuhhumachaan al‑Rabb ma radda leehum.
Wa laakin ana malaan be gudraachaan Ruuh Allah nazal foogi.Wa indi al‑adaala wa l‑fahaaliiyele nikhabbir zurriiyit Yaakhuub be isyaanhumwa Bani Israaʼiil be zanibhum.
Asmaʼo al‑kalaam da,ya kubaaraat zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa ya hukkaam Bani Israaʼiil.Intu tiharrumu al‑adaalawa tiʼawwuju ayyi cheyy al‑adiil.
Baneetu Sahyuun be dammwa Madiinat al‑Khudus be zulum.
Wa l‑gudiya yagtaʼo chariiʼa be l‑rachwawa rujaal al‑diin yiʼallumu kalaam Allah le yalgo faaydewa l‑anbiya yitnabbaʼo le yalgo fudda.Humman yitwakkalo ale Allah wa yuguulu : Allah ma gaaʼid fi usutna walla ?Al‑fasaala abadan ma talhagna ! 
Wa fi chaan da,be sababku intu,Sahyuun yahartuuha misil zereʼwa Madiinat al‑Khudus tabga koom hana turaabwa raas jabal beet Allah yabga khaaba.
Wa fi aakhir al‑wakit,jabal beet Allah yasbit fi ruuse al‑jibaalwa yabga aali min kulla l‑hujaar.Wa l‑chuʼuub yaju leyah be kataramisil almi al‑jaari.
Wa umam katiiriin yaju wa yuguulu : Taʼaalu natlaʼo fi jabal Allah,fi beet Ilaah Yaakhuub.Hu yiʼallimna derbahwa aniina namchu foogah. Achaan min Sahyuunyamurgu churuut al‑Tawraatwa min Madiinat al‑Khudusyamrug kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah yabga gaadibeen chuʼuub katiiriinwa yihaakim umam gawiyiinhatta kan baʼiidiin kula.Humman yuduggu suyuufhum jaraariwa yuduggu huraabhum khanaajir.Wa umma ma tarfaʼ suyuufha le ummawa ma fi tadriib le l‑harib battaan.
Wa ayyi naadum yagoodfi jineentah hana l‑inabwa tihit chadaratah hana l‑tiin.Wa ma fi naadum yibachtinahachaan Allah al‑Gaadir bas kharrarah.
Kulla l‑chuʼuub doolyitaabuʼu ilaahaathum.Wa aniina kamaannitaabuʼu Allah Ilaahnadaayman wa ila l‑abad.
Daahu kalaam Allah : Fi l‑yoom da,nilimm al‑maʼduuriinwa najmaʼ al‑muchattatiinwa nilimm al‑ana aakhabtuhum.
Wa min al‑maʼduuriin,nisawwi waahidiin yifadduluwa min al‑muchattatiin,nisawwi umma gawiiye.Wa fi jabal Sahyuun,ana Allah nabga malikhummin hassaʼ wa ila l‑abad.
Ya jabal Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye,inta tiraakhib chaʼabak min foogmisil gasir al‑hurraas hana l‑khanam.Sultitak al‑awwal tigabbil leekwa battaan Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑misil bineeyetabga aasimat mamlaka.
