Hassaʼ,maala tiʼawwi ?Achaan ma fi malik foogki walla ?Wa maala al‑wajaʼ karabkimisil al‑mara al‑gaaʼide titaalig ?Achaan mustachaarki waddar walla ?
Attanne min al‑wajaʼ,ya Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye.Aywa,attanne misil al‑maraal‑gaaʼide titaalig.Achaan hassaʼ,inti tamurgi min al‑madiinawa tamchi taskuni fi l‑kadaadewa tisaafiri lahaddi Baabil.Wa hinaak inti tanje,hinaak Allah yafdaaki min iid udwaanki.
Wa hassaʼ,askar hana umam katiiriinlammo wa gammo diddiki.Humman buguulu : Khalli tagood fi l‑najaasa.Wa khalli uyuunna yichiifu damaar Sahyuun ! 
Al‑naas dool ma yaʼarfu fikir Allahwa la yafhamo niiytah.Wa hu lammaahum sawamisil rubta hana ganaadiil fi l‑madagg.
 Gummi duggi al‑ganaadiil,ya Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye.Nisawwiiki misil toor al‑guruunah hana hadiidwa dalaafeeyah hana nahaas.Wa be da,inti tarhake chuʼuub katiiriinwa tikhassisi khaniimithum leyi ana Allahwa khunaahum leyi ana siid al‑ard. 
Wa hassaʼ da,ya sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus,jarruhu nufuusku min al‑hizin.Haasaro madiinitkuwa be l‑isay darabo wijih haakim Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Allah gaal : Inti,ya Beet Laham Afraata,inti sakhayre le tinhasbiambeen aayilaat Yahuuza.Wa laakin naadum waahid yamrug minkial‑yahkim be usmi fi Bani Israaʼiil.Wa gaʼarah jaayi min baʼiidmin al‑zaman al‑gadiim. 
Wa Allah yikhalli chaʼabahle wakit chiyyalahaddi l‑mara al‑khalbaanetalda wileedha.Wa akhwaanna al‑faddalo fi l‑khurbayigabbulu min hinaakwa yilimmu maʼa Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa hu yugummwa yuguudhum misil raaʼibe gudrat Allahwa be azamat usum Allah Ilaahah.Wa chaʼabah yaskunu be amaanachaan gudurtah tilwassaʼlahaddi aakhir al‑ard.
Wa hu zaatah yijiib al‑salaam.Wakit askar balad Achuur yahjumu baladnawa yadkhulu fi gusuurna,aniina nigawwumu didduhumsabʼa kubaaraatwa tamaane chuyuukh chaʼab.
Wa humman yahkumu balad Achuur be l‑seefwa balad Nimruud be l‑huraab.Wa l‑haakim al‑Allah yirassilahyinajjiina min iid al‑Achuuriyiinwakit yahjumu baladnawa yadkhulu ardina.
Wa l‑faddalo min zurriiyit Yaakhuubyukuunu fi usut chuʼuub katiiriin.Yabgo misil matara al‑jaaye min Allahwa misil karany fi l‑gechch.Ma yarjo cheyy min naadumwa la yukhuttu achamhum fi insaan.
Wa l‑faddalo min zurriiyit Yaakhuubyukuunu been al‑umamfi usut chuʼuub katiiriin.Yabgo misil duudambeen haywaanaat al‑khaabawa misil farkh al‑duudambeen door al‑khanam.Wa fi ayyi bakaan al‑yamchi,yaktul wa yicharritwa ma fi naadum al‑yikhallis minnah.
Ya l‑faddalo min zurriiyit Yaakhuub,arfaʼo iideeku didd khusmaankuwa dammuru kulla udwaanku.
Daahu kalaam Allah : Fi l‑yoom da,nidammir kheelku min usutkuwa nikassir arabaatku hana l‑harib.
Wa nidammir mudun baladkuwa nihaddim kulla bakaanaatku al‑gawiyiin.
Wa nidammir sihirku al‑fi iidkuwa ma yukuun fi usutku al‑yihajji be ilim al‑kheeb.
Wa nidammir min usutku asnaamkuwa l‑hujaar al‑khazzeetuuhum le l‑ibaadawa abadan ma tasjudu le cheyy al‑sawweetuuh be iidku.
Wa nimallit min usutku al‑iidaanal‑khazzeetuuhum le ibaadat Achiirawa nidammir mudunku.
Wa be khadab wa zaʼal,nichiil al‑taar fi l‑umamal‑abo ma yasmaʼooni. 
Asmaʼo al‑kalaam al‑yuguulah leyi Allah : Gumm sawwi chariiʼa giddaam al‑hujaarwa khalli al‑jibaal yasmaʼo hissak.
Ya l‑jibaal !Asmaʼo chakwat Allah !Intu ya asaas al‑ard al‑gawi,khuttu baalku !Allah yijiib chaʼabah fi l‑chariiʼawa yuluum Bani Israaʼiil. 
Wa Allah gaal : Ana sawweet leeku chunu,ya chaʼabi ?Wa kikkeef ana ayyeetku ?Ruddu leyi !
Wa da achaan ana maragtukumin balad Masir walla ?Achaan fadeetkumin al‑ubuudiiye walla ?Achaan rassalt Muusa wa Haaruun wa Mariyamle yuguuduuku walla ?
Ya chaʼabi !Azzakkaro muʼaamarat Balaakh malik Muwaab diddukuwa kikkeef Balʼaam wileed Baʼuurradda leyahwa gaal nisawwi leeku illa l‑kheer.Azzakkaro kikkeef gammeetumin Chittiim sabaah bahar al‑Urdunwa wassaltu fi arduku fi Gilgaal.Wa be da,taʼarfu adaalit Allah. 
Be chunu nigarrib le Allah ?Be chunu nigarrib le l‑Ilaah al‑Aali ?Hal nigarrib leyah be ajjaal awlaad sanaal‑nigaddimhum dahaaya muharragiin walla ?
Hal Allah yakhbal dahaayahana aalaaf al‑kubchaan ?Walla yakhbal hadaayahana dihin katiir misil almi al‑waadi ?Hal nigaddim wileedi al‑bikirfi chaan isyaani ?Walla nigaddim wileed sulbifi chaan zanbi ?
Ya Bani Adam,Allah khabbarakbe l‑cheyy al‑adiilwa be l‑cheyy al‑hu yidoorah minnak.Sawwi al‑adaala wa hibb al‑kheerwa maskin nafsakwa amchi adiil giddaam Ilaahak.
Daahu Allah gaaʼid yinaadi sukkaan al‑madiinawa yinajji al‑yakhaafo minnah : Asmaʼo,ya naas gabiilat Yahuuzaal‑lammiin fi l‑madiina.
Fi maal hawaan gaaʼid fi beet al‑aasi.Naas yistaʼmalo mikyaal makhchuuch al‑yikhaddibni.Hal nikhassid be l‑haraam da walla ?
Hal nibarri siid al‑miizaan al‑ma adiil ?Walla nibarri al‑naadum al‑yikiilbe kooro hana khachch ?
Fi l‑madiina,fiyah naas khaniyiinmalaaniin be l‑unuf.Wa sukkaanha yihajju be l‑kidibwa lisaanhum yikallim be l‑khachch.
Wa fi chaan da,ana darabtuku be maradwa kharrabtuku be sabab zunuubku.
Intu taakulu wa ma tachbaʼowa l‑juuʼ yaskun fi butuunku.Intu takhzunuwa ma tagdaro tahfadooh adiil.Wa l‑hafadtuuh kula,ana nisallimah le l‑harib.
Intu tazraʼowa ma tagtaʼo.Wa tarhako al‑zaytuunwa ma tilmassaho be dihnah.Wa tarhako al‑inabwa ma tacharbo min khamarah.
Wa intu titaabuʼu al‑aade al‑fasle hana l‑malik Umriwa l‑amal al‑hawaan hana aayilat malik Akhaabwa turuukhu hasab khittithum.Wa fi chaan da,ana nisallim madiinitku le l‑kharaabwa sukkaanha yabgo chimmeetewa yiʼayyubuuku misil yiʼayyubu kulla chaʼabi. 
Ya khasaarti !Ana bigiit misil naadumal‑yagtaʼ al‑kichcheebwa l‑yilaggit al‑fadle hana l‑inab.Wa daahu ma faddal anguud naakulahwa la tiin al‑niriidah.
Wa ma fi battaan raajil waahid saalih fi l‑baladwa la raajil adiil been al‑naas.Humman kulluhum yakursu le yidaffugu al‑dammwa ayyi waahid yukujj charak le akhuuh.
Wa iideehum nachiitiinle yisawwu al‑fasaala.Al‑masʼuul yatlub hadiiyewa l‑gaadi yichiil al‑rachwa.Wa l‑gaadir yuguul ayyi cheyy al‑hu yidoorahwa kulluhum mulʼaamiriin sawa.
Hatta al‑adiil minhum kulamisil al‑haskaniitwa l‑saalih minhummisil zariibit al‑chook.Wa da l‑yoom al‑khabbarooku beyahmuraakhibiinku al‑anbiya.Aywa,ikhaabku jawa da yoom hana barjaal.
Ma tisaddugu gariibiinkuwa la tiʼaamunu rufgaanku.Wa giddaam awiinku al‑yarugdan fi hudunku,angarʼu,fakkuru fi lisaanku.
Achaan al‑wileed yahgir abuuhwa l‑bineeye tugumm didd ammahawa marit al‑wileed tugumm didd nasiibitha.Ayyi naadum,naas beetah al‑halaalahyabgo leyah adu.
Wa laakin ana kamaan niwajjih le Allahwa narja al‑Ilaah al‑yinajjiiniwa hu Ilaahi al‑yasmaʼni.
Ma tichchammat leyi,ya aduuyi.Kan ana wagaʼt kula,nugumm.Wa kan ana gaaʼid fi l‑dalaam kula,Allah hu nuuri.
Waajib nahmal khadab Allahachaan ana aznabt diddahlahaddi l‑wakit al‑hu yidaafiʼ leyi fi chariiʼtiwa yisabbit huguugi.Wa hu yamrugni fi l‑nuurwa ana nichiif adaaltah.
Wa udwaani yichiifu najaatiwa l‑eeb yikhattiihumachaan humman gaalo leyi : Ween Allah Ilaahak ? Wa fi chaan da,nichiifhum be uyuuniwa yagaʼo wa yifajjukhuuhummisil tiine fi l‑chaariʼ.
Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus,yaji yoom al‑yabnu foogah daraadirkiwa fi l‑yoom da,yiwassuʼu huduudki.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,yaju leeki naasmin Achuur fi l‑sabaahwa min Masir fi l‑junuubwa min khachum al‑Niil wa bahar al‑Furaatwa min khuchuum al‑buhuur wa mantagat al‑jibaal.
Wa l‑ard tabga kharaab be sabab sukkaanhawa da be sabab natiijat amalhum al‑fasil.
Ya Rabb,guud chaʼabak al‑misil warasatakmisil raaʼi yuguud khanamah be duglah.Humman gaaʼidiin wiheedhumfi l‑khaaba muhawwaga be jineenaat inab.Khalliihum yasraho misil zamaan fi marʼa Baachaanwa fi bakaan hana sarha fi Gilʼaad.
 Misil ayyaam al‑intu maragtu min balad Masir,ana battaan niwassifku ajaayib. 
Wa wakit al‑umam yichiifu al‑cheyy da,hatta kan induhum gudra kula,al‑eeb yikhattiihum.Humman yukhuttu iideehum fi khuchuumhumwa udneehum ma yasmaʼo battaan.
Humman yalhaso al‑ajaaj misil al‑dabiibwa misil kulla zawaahif al‑ard.Yarjufu wakit yamurgu min maljaʼhumwa yaju leek inta Allah Ilaahna.Yibarjulu wa yakhaafo minnak.
Yaatu ilaah mislak inta,ya Allah ?Inta al‑takhfir al‑khatawa tahmal isyaan al‑naas al‑faddalomin chaʼabak al‑misil warasatak.Khadabak ma yagood daaymanachaan inta tihibb al‑kheer.
Wa battaan tarhamnawa tamha khataayaana.Inta tarmi kulla zunuubnafi l‑bahar al‑khariig.
Wa tiwassif amaanak le zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa kheerak le iyaal Ibraahiimmisil inta zamaan halaft beyah le abbahaatna.
Daahu kitaab ruʼyat Naahuum al‑min hillit Alikhuuch.Wa di muhaakamat madiinat Niinawa.
Allah hu khayyuur.Aywa,ma yidoor yaʼabudu ilaah aakhar balaayahwa yichiil al‑taar.Aywa,Allah hu al‑yichiil al‑taarwa siid al‑khadab al‑chadiid.Hu yichiil al‑taar fi khusmaanahwa yakhdab le udwaanah.
Allah hu al‑Sabuurwa l‑Aziim wa l‑Gaadir.Wa laakin le l‑muznib,ma yajʼalah bari.Wa yisawwi derbah fi riih amzoobaʼaanewa l‑sahaab da ajaajah al‑hu yigawwimah.
Hu yugumm didd al‑bahar wa yijaffifahwa almi al‑wudyaan kula yikammilah.Wa maraaʼi Baachaan wa jabal al‑Karmal yaybasowa l‑zuhuur fi jibaal Lubnaan yidaffugu.
Al‑jibaal yarjufu giddaamahwa l‑hujaar yumuuʼu.Wa giddaamah,al‑ard tizzalzalwa kulla sukkaanha yifatfutu.
Wa yaatu yagdar yahmal zaʼalah ?Wa min chiddit khadabah,yaatu yagdar yagiif giddaamah ?Khadabah yinsabba misil al‑naarhatta al‑jibaal yichchaggago giddaamah.
Allah hu al‑Rahiimwa hu al‑maljaʼ fi yoom al‑diigewa yahfad al‑naas al‑yaljaʼo leyah.
Misil seel,yijiib damaar kaamil fi bakaan udwaanahwa yitaaridhum lahaddi fi dalaam al‑khubuur.
Ya sukkaan Niinawa,maala chiltu niiye fasle didd Allah ?Hu yijiib foogku damaar kaamilal‑battaan ma yitanni be diige aakhara.
Intu misil al‑chook al‑chaabikwa misil al‑sakkaara al‑sikro.Al‑naar taakulhum be l‑kaamilmisil al‑gechch al‑yaabis.
Wa minku intu bas marag naadumal‑khattat al‑fasaala didd Allahwa mustachaar al‑ma naafiʼ.
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Ya chaʼab balad Yahuuza,kan udwaanku lammo wa kitro kula,yangusu wa yikammulu.Wa kan awwal ana daayagtuku kulabattaan ma nidaayigku.
Wa hassaʼ namrugku min iid udwaanku al‑gawiiyewa nigattiʼ guyuudku. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah didduku,ya sukkaan Niinawa : Abadan ma talgo zurriiyetichiil usumku.Wa fi buyuutku hana l‑ibaada,ana nikassir asnaamkuhana l‑hatab wa l‑hadiid.Wa nijahhiz khubuurkuachaan giddaami ana,intu battaan ma tanfaʼo. 
Ya chaʼab Yahuuza,daahu fi l‑jibaalnaadum maachi be rijileenahwa yibachchir wa yiballikh al‑salaam.Ayyudu wa haggugu nazirkuachaan aduuku al‑ma naafiʼma yuchugg baladku battaan.Wa khalaas,kalaamah kammal !
Ya sukkaan Niinawa,fi muhaajimiin jaayiin leeku !Aharsu bakaanku al‑gawiwa raakhubu fi l‑duruub.Arbutu sulubkuwa abgo gawiyiin le l‑harib.
Hatta kan al‑mukharribiin kharrabo zurriiyit Yaakhuubwa dammaro chadarhum kula,Allah yigabbil leehum charafhummisil yigabbil charaf Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa darag furraasah al‑adumamsuuh be buhya hamrawa askarah laabsiin khulgaan humur.Wa wakit jaahiziin le l‑harib,arabaatah yamurgu charaarwa l‑huraab yinhazzo.
Wa arabaat al‑harib yajru fi l‑chawaariʼ be chiddewa jaariyiin fi ust al‑madiinamisil deyy al‑barraaga al‑tachlaʼ.
Wa malik Niinawa naada khuyyaadahwa laakin humman yittartaʼo fi machiihum.Yajru le l‑durdurwa yijahhuzu nufuushum le yahmuuh.
Tawwaali,al‑sadd al‑laazmiin beyah almi al‑bahar ankasarwa gasir al‑malik wagaʼ.
Wa l‑malika sallabooha wa chaaloohawa khaddaamaatha kaarbaat duyuudhinwa yunuuhan hissihin misil al‑hamaam.
Wa Niinawa bigatmisil khazzaan almi al‑yinaggitwa sukkaanha arradomisil almi al‑jaari.Wakit yuguulu leehum : Agiifu !Agiifu  kula,ma fi naadum minhum yinlafit.
Anhabo al‑fuddawa anhabo al‑dahab !Khuna al‑madiina abadan ma yikammilwa khumaamha al‑khaali kula katiir.
Niinawa bigat nagaʼa faadiyewa kharaab.Wa naasha guluubhum angataʼowa rijleehum barado.Wa butuunhum kula yarjufuwa wujuuhhum bigo dulum.
Wa ween marbat al‑diidaanwa margad iyaalhum ?Kan al‑duud wa martah marago kula,naadum ma yibachtin iyaalhum.
Al‑duud yagnus le iyaalahwa yakhnig le martah.Wa yamla marbatah be l‑seed al‑hu katalahwa be l‑rimam al‑hu charrataahum.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir : Akiid nugumm diddiki,ya madiinat Niinawa.Aywa,arabaatki hana l‑harib,nisawwiihum rumaad.Wa furraaski al‑misil al‑diidaan,al‑seef yaktulhum.Wa ana niwaggif ganiiski fi l‑baladwa hiss rusulki battaan ma yinsamiʼ. 
Al‑azaab le madiinat al‑damm.Hi kullaha ke malaane be kidib wa nahibwa daayman al‑dimme waagʼe foogha.
Wa fi l‑madiina,yinsamiʼ hiss al‑sootwa harakat dawaraan al‑ajalaatWa l‑kheel yigallubuwa arabaat al‑harib yinattutu.
Wa siyaad al‑kheel yahjumuwa l‑suyuuf yaburguwa l‑huraab yiraaru.Wa l‑majruuhiin katiiriinwa l‑jisas ma induhum hisaabwa l‑maytiin bala adadlahaddi l‑naas yittartaʼo fi l‑janaazaat.
Madiinat Niinawa achcharmatat misil charmuutawa hi sitt al‑jamaal wa sitt al‑sihir.Hi abbadat al‑umam be charmatathawa abbadat al‑gabaayil be sihirha.
Daahu kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir : Akiid ana nugumm diddikiwa narfaʼ khalagkiwa nukhuttah leeki fi wijihki.Wa niwassif ireeki le l‑umamwa eebki le l‑mamaalik.
Wa nukhutt leeki fi raaski kulla muharramaatkiwa niʼayyibkiwa nisawwiiki masal le l‑aakhariin.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yichiifkiyajri minki baʼiid wa yuguul :‹ Niinawa khirbat.Yaatu al‑yihinn foogha ?Wa min ween nalga naasal‑yisabburuuha ?› 
Ya Niinawa,tahsibi nafiskiakheer min madiinat Tiibaal‑fi balad Masir walla ?Hi gaaʼide ambeenaat rujuul al‑Niilwa almi haayigha.Wa bahar haamiiha wa bahar durdurha.Wa be da kula,hi ma nijat.
Balad al‑Habacha wa balad Masir,dool khuwwitha al‑abadan ma tikammil.Wa balad Fuut wa balad Liibiya kulafazaʼha.
Wa laakin madiinat Tiiba kula chaaloohawa waddo sukkaanha fi l‑khurba.Wa atfaalha kataloohumfi kulla chawaariʼha.Wa le siyaad al‑charaf hana l‑madiina,al‑udwaan gassamoohum be amʼiyeedaatle yisawwuuhum abiid.Wa kubaaraat Tiiba kulajanzaroohum.
Aywa,ya Niinawa,inti taskare min al‑taʼab wa tillabbadewa tifattichi bakaan al‑taljaʼe foogahmin udwaanki.
Ya madiinat Niinawa,kulla bakaanaatki al‑gawiyiinmisil al‑tiin al‑najiid.Kan al‑riih tihizzah,yagaʼ fi khachum al‑jiiʼaan.
Chiifi askarki !Bigo fi usutki daʼiifiin misil al‑awiin.Wa biibaanki anfataho marra waahid le udwaankiwa l‑naar akalat hawaadirhum.
Amle khazzaanaatki almigubbaal ma yihaasuruukuwa chaddidi bakaanaatki al‑gawiyiin.Wa chiili tiine wa ajjiniihawa sallili leeki diringeel.
Wa be da kula,al‑naar taakulkiwa l‑seef yiwaddirki.Wa l‑udwaan yaakuluukimisil al‑jaraad yaakul al‑zereʼ.Ya Niinawa,sukkaanki bigo katiiriin misil jaraadaywa,katiiriin misil saar al‑leel.
Wa kattarti adad tujjaarkiziyaada min nujuum al‑sama.Wa laakin hassaʼ,humman misil jaraadyifattuhu janaaheehumwa yitiiru khalaas.
Wa hurraaski misil jaraadwa khuyyaadki misil sahaabaayit saar al‑leelal‑yanzil fi l‑zaraayib fi wakt al‑barid.Wa laakin wakit al‑harraay tatlaʼ,yiʼarrid wa ma yaʼarfu ween hu macha.
Ya malik balad Achuur,furraasak sakatowa masaaʼiilak al‑misil ruʼyaan maato.Wa chaʼabak chatto fi l‑jibaal misil al‑khanamwa ma fi raaʼi al‑yilimmuhum.
Wa jiraahak ma yilʼaalajwa da jiraah al‑yaktul.Wa kulla l‑naas al‑simʼo khabarak,yisaffugu wa yafraho.Achaan kulla l‑naas daakho fasaaltakal‑ma indaha hadd.
Daahu kalaam al‑muhaakama al‑ja le l‑nabi Habaguug fi ruʼya.
Ya Allah,ana koorakt leekwa mata inta tasmaʼni ?Wa ana sarakht leek min al‑unufwa mata inta tinajjiini ?
Maala tiwassifni al‑fasaalawa l‑taʼab ?Wa hal tichiif al‑kharaab wa l‑unufal‑gaaʼidiin daayman giddaami ?Wa l‑machaakil wa l‑huraaj kula zaado.
Wa achaan da,ma tabbago churuut al‑Tawraatwa l‑adaala abadan ma tinchaaf.Wa l‑aasi gidir fi l‑saalihwa achaan da bas,al‑chariiʼa bigat ooja.
 Ya chaʼabi,chiifu been al‑umamwa alʼajjabo wa akhaafo.Achaan fi wakitku da,ana nisawwi foogku cheyywa kan hajjooku beyah,ma tisadduguuh.
Daahu ana nigawwim askar Baabilwa humman naas galibhum murrwa ma induhum sabur.Yamchu fi kulla bakaan fi l‑ardwa yaglaʼo buyuut al‑ma hineehum.
Humman naas chudaad wa bikhawwufu.Yukhuttu chariiʼithumwa yikabburu nufuushum.
Kheelhum ajiiliin misil al‑numuurawa sariiʼiin misil maraafʼiin al‑makhrib.Wa siyaad al‑kheel dooljaayiin min baʼiid.Yitiiru misil al‑sagural‑yidoor yadrub seedtah.
Kulla l‑chaʼab maattiin rigaabhum giddaamwa jaariyiin le l‑unuf.Wa yakurbu naas abiidwa yilimmuuhum katiiriin misil al‑ramla.
Wa yahguru al‑muluukwa yichchammato le l‑hukkaam.Wa yadhako le l‑mudun al‑gawiyiinwa yihawwuguuhum be radmiiyewa yichiiluuhum.
Wa yaju wa yufuutumisil al‑riih.Fi khataahum,yichiifu khuwwithummisil ilaahhum. 
Wa min zamaan,inta bas ma Allah Ilaahi al‑Khudduus ?Achaan da,aniina ma numuutu.Ya Allah,inta kallaft al‑askar doolle yihaakumuuna.Ya jabalna al‑yahmiina,inta bas jibtuhum le yiʼaakhubuuna.
Wa laakin inta khudduus !Ma tagdar tichiif al‑charrwa la tahmal tichiif al‑taʼab yaji fi chaʼabak.Wa maala inta tichiifal‑khaayniin dool ?Wa maala taskutwakit al‑chariir yazrut al‑saalihal‑hu akheer minnah ?
Inta sawweet Bani Adammisil huut al‑baharwa misil al‑zawaahif al‑ma induhum siid.
Wa l‑adu yarmiihum fi charakahwa yamrughum kulluhum be l‑jambaatwa yilimmuhum fi chabakatah.Wa khalaas,yafrahwa yinbasit.
Wa fi chaan da,hu dabah dahiiye le charakahwa harrag bakhuur le chabakatah.Achaan beehum bas,hu kabbar gismahwa kattar maʼaachah.
Wa be da,yamrug seefah min beetahwa yaktul al‑umam bala mahanna ila l‑abad.
Fi bakaan al‑haraasa,ana niraakhib,wa nagiif fi l‑durdur be tuuli.Wa nichiif chunu al‑yuguulah Allah leyiwa kikkeef hu yurudd fi chakwiti.
Wa Allah radda leyi wa gaal : Aktib al‑ruʼya diwa waddihha fi liihaanakachaan yagruuha be suhuula.
Achaan al‑ruʼya di,al‑wakit al‑muhaddad leeha lissaaʼ ma ja.Wa laakin akiid hi taji fi wakitha !Abadan ma takdib.Wa kan akhkharat kula,arjaahaachaan akiid hi taji bala taʼkhiir.
Al‑fachchaar ma yuguud nafsah adiilwa laakin be iimaanah,al‑saalih yahya.
Sahiih,al‑khuna tukhuunwa l‑raajil al‑mutakabbir ma yagood saakit.Hu yaftah khachmah misil al‑khaburwa ma yachbaʼ misil al‑moot.Wa hu lamma kulla l‑umam aleyahwa khatta kulla l‑chuʼuub tihtah.
Wa kulla l‑naas doolma yadurbu beyah masal walla ?Wa ma yichchammato leyah walla ? Wa yuguulu : Al‑azaab le l‑yakhni nafsahbe khumaam al‑ma haggah.Wa da yagood lahaddi mata ?Wa be da,hu yiziid al‑duyuun fi raasah.
Wa fajʼatan,al‑naas al‑inta galaʼt maalhumyugummu min noomhum wa yirajjufuukwa inta tabga khaniime fi iideehum.
Wa misil inta nahabt umam katiiriin,al‑chuʼuub al‑faddalo kulluhum yanhabook.Wa da,achaan inta katalt dimmewa jibt al‑unuf fi l‑baladwa fi l‑hillaal wa kulla sukkaanhum.
 Al‑azaab le l‑yaksab maal haraamwa yijiibah le aayiltah.Wa yabni beetah misil uchch foogachaan yinajji nafsah min iid al‑chariir.
Inta dammart chuʼuub katiiriinwa be da,jibt al‑eeb fi aayiltakwa jibt al‑zanib le nafsak
lahaddi l‑hujaar min daakhil al‑durduryasrakho wa yachkuwa l‑maraadiis hana raas al‑beet kulayuruddu leehum.
 Al‑azaab le l‑yabni madiina be katil al‑dimamwa yiʼassis hille be zulum !
Al‑umam yakhdumu ziyaadale l‑cheyy al‑taakulah al‑naar.Wa l‑chuʼuub yiʼayyu nufuushumfi l‑cheyy al‑ma indah faayde.Wa da ma min Allah al‑Gaadir walla ?
Achaan al‑ard tinmalibe maʼrafat majd Allahmisil al‑bahar yinmali be almi.
 Al‑azaab le l‑yazgi jaarah charaab mukhalbat be sammwa yisakkir al‑aakhariin achaan yichiif ireehum.
Wa inta tachbaʼ be l‑eeb fi badal al‑charafwa khalaas,tachrab wa tagood aryaan !Aywa,tachrab min kaas al‑khadabal‑fi iid Allah al‑zeenewa l‑eeb yikhatti charafak.
Achaan al‑unuf al‑sawweetah fi Lubnaanyalhagak.Wa damaarak le l‑bahaayimyijiib leek al‑ruʼub.Achaan inta katalt dimmewa sawweet al‑unuf fi l‑baladwa fi l‑hillaal wa kulla sukkaanhum.
Al‑sanam al‑yanjurah al‑najjaaryanfaʼ chunu ?Wa l‑timsaal hana l‑hadiid al‑masbuubyiʼallim illa l‑kidib.Wa maala al‑insaan yiʼaamin be asnaam bukumal‑hu sawwaahum be iidah ?
 Al‑azaab le l‑yuguul le l‑hatab :‹ Gumm min al‑noom ! ›Wa le l‑yuguul le l‑hajar al‑abkam :‹ Gumm wa hajji ! ›Humman dool ma yiʼallumu cheyy.Sahiih,humman mujammaliinbe dahab wa fuddawa laakin ma induhum ruuh.
Wa Allah kamaan gaaʼidfi beetah al‑mukhaddas.Khalli kulla sukkaan al‑ardyaskutu giddaamah. 
Di salaat al‑nabi Habaguug wa hi khine chakwa.
Ya Allah,ana simiʼt beekwa khuft.Ya Allah,sawwi fiʼilak fi tuul al‑siniinwa arrifna beyah fi tuul al‑ayyaam.Wa fi wakit khadabak kula,arhamna.
Wa l‑Rabb ja min balad Teemaan.Aywa,al‑Khudduus ja min jabal Faaraan.Wagfa.Majdah mala al‑samaawaatwa chukrah khatta al‑ard.
Wa deyyah hu nuur chadiidwa barraaga tabrug marrateen min iidahwa da bas bakaan mullabbid izzah.
Al‑waba maachi giddaamahwa l‑marad mulaggit derbah.
Hu wagaf wa l‑ard anhazzatwa hu chaaf wa l‑umam rajjafo.Al‑jibaal al‑gadiimiin alfatfatowa l‑hujaar al‑daaymiin alkassarowa l‑duruub al‑daaymiin hineeyah hu.
Wa ana chift furgaan chaʼab Kuchaanbigo ma fiihum.Wa sataayir khiyam balad Midyaananhazzo giddaamah.
Ya Allah,wakit rikibt kheelakwa arabaatak hana l‑nasur,khidibt khadab chadiiddidd al‑rujuul walla ?Zaʼalak didd al‑rujuulwa khadabak didd al‑bahar walla ?
Inta salleet nubbaalak wa nachaachiibakwa da l‑kalaam al‑inta halaft beyah.Wagfa.Wa chaggagt al‑ardwa l‑rujuul marago.
Wa l‑jibaal chaafookwa rajafo.Wa l‑matar sabba almi katiirlahaddi hiss al‑bahar al‑khariig ansamaʼwa hu haaj wa talaʼ lahaddi foog.
Wa min nuur nachaachiibakwa baragaan haribtak,al‑harraay wa l‑gamarwagafo bakaan waahid.
Wa be khadab,inta raayikh fi l‑ardwa be zaʼal,inta fajjakht al‑umam.
Wa inta maragt le tinajji chaʼabakwa tinajji al‑naadum al‑inta masahtahwa darrajtah malik.Wa dammart beet al‑chariir.Aywa,hu anhadam min raasah lahaddi asaasah.Wagfa.
Wa inta taʼʼant kubaaraat al‑adube nachaachiibhum halaalhum fi ruuseehumwakit humman jaayiin be surʼa misil al‑riihle yichattutuuna be korooraak hana farah.Wa da misil yaakuluuna be achiir,aniina al‑masaakiin.
Wa inta fakkeet derib le kheelak fi lubb al‑baharwa fi ust al‑mooj al‑chadiid.
Min ana simiʼt be jaytak,galbi rajafwa min simiʼt hissak,chalaaliifi rajafowa udaami maaʼo.Wa ana wagaft bakaan waahidwa gaaʼid narjif.Wa hassaʼ,narja yoom al‑diigeal‑yaji foog aduuna.
Hatta kan al‑tiin ma yinawwirwa chadar al‑inab ma yaldawa l‑zaytuun ma yugummwa l‑zereʼ ma yigawwim maʼaachwa l‑khanam yabgo ma fiihum fi l‑zariibewa l‑bagar yabgo ma fiihum fi l‑door,
be da kula,ana ninbasit be Allahwa nafrah be Ilaahi al‑yinajjiini.
Allah hu Rabbi wa gudurtiwa hu sawwa rijileeni khufaafmisil rijle al‑khazaala.Wa hu gaaʼid yuguudniwa fi l‑bakaan al‑aali,yiwaddiini.Wasiiye le kabiir al‑khannaayiin :Le yikhannuuh be jigindiiye.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑gaalah le Safanya wileed Kuuchi wileed Gadaalya wileed Amarya wileed Hizkhiiya.Wa da fi ayyaam hukum Yuuchiiya wileed Aamuun malik mamlakat Yahuuza.
Daahu kalaam Allah : Akiid nuguchch kulla cheyymin wijh al‑ard.
Nuguchch al‑naas wa l‑bahaayimwa nuguchch tuyuur al‑sama wa huut al‑baharwa kulla cheyy al‑yarmi al‑aasiyiin fi isyaanhum.Wa nikammil al‑naasmin wijh al‑ard. Wa da kalaam Allah.
 Wa nimidd iidi didd balad Yahuuzawa didd kulla sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa nikammil min al‑bakaan daal‑faddal min al‑naas al‑yaʼabudu ilaah Baʼalwa khaddaamiinah wa rujaal diinah kula.
Wa nuguchch al‑naas al‑yasjudufi ruuse buyuuthum le khuwwaat al‑sama.Wa nuguchch al‑yasjudu leyi ana Allahwa yahalfu be usmiwa battaan yahalfu be usum sanam Muulak kula.
Wa nuguchch al‑yikhalluuni ana Allahwa l‑ma yitaabuʼuuni wa la yasʼalo minni. 
Askutu giddaam Allah al‑Rabbachaan yoom Allah garrab.Allah jahhaz dahiiyewa khassas maʼzuumiinah.
Wa Allah gaal : Fi yoom al‑dahiiye di,ana niʼaakhib al‑kubaaraatwa iyaal al‑malikwa kulla l‑naas al‑yalbaso khulgaan al‑ajaanible yitaabuʼu aadaathum.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ana niʼaakhib ayyi waahidal‑yunutt atabat al‑baabhana beet ilaahah le yicharrifah.Wa humman al‑naas al‑yamlo beet ilaahhumbe l‑unuf wa l‑khachch.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,yinsamiʼ baki jamb baab al‑Huutwa siraakh fi l‑haara al‑jadiidewa harakat damaar kabiir fi l‑jibaal.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Abku be hizin,ya sukkaan haarat al‑suug,achaan kulla l‑tujjaar yiddammarowa kulla l‑yawzunu al‑fudda yikammulu.
Wa fi l‑wakit da,ana nifattich fi lubb Madiinat al‑Khudus be faanuus.Wa niʼaakhib kulla l‑rujaal al‑gaaʼidiin fi zunuubhummisil al‑khamar al‑gaaʼid fi rindiih.Humman yuguulu fi guluubhum :‹ Allah ma yisawwi cheyywa la kheer wa la charr. ›
Wa khalaas,khunaahum yabga khaniimewa buyuuthum yabgo kharaab.Humman yabnu buyuutwa laakin ma yaskunu fooghum.Wa yimaggunu jineenaat inabwa laakin ma yacharbo min khamarhum. 
Al‑yoom al‑kabiir hana Allah garrab.Hu garrab wa jaayi be surʼa.Wakit harakat yoom Allah tinsamiʼ,al‑furraas kula yasrakho be chidde.
Wa l‑yoom da,yoom hana khadabwa yoom hana diige wa taʼab.Hu yoom hana kharaab wa damaarwa yoom hana dalaam azrag kurumwa yoom hana sahaab adlam marra waahid.
Wa da yoom darabaan al‑buugwa korooraak al‑haribdidd al‑mudun al‑gawiyiinwa bakaanaathum hana l‑muraakhaba.
 Wa ana nidiss al‑naas fi l‑diigewa humman yuruukhu misil amyaaniinachaan humman aznabo diddi ana Allah.Wa dammuhum yidaffigmisil almi fi l‑turaabwa janaazaathum yichchattatomisil al‑baʼar. 
Wa la fuddithum wa la dahabhumyagdaro yinajjiihummin yoom khadab Allah.Wa be naar khiirtah,kulla l‑ard tahrag.Aywa,al‑damaar da yabga chadiidlahaddi yikammil kulla sukkaan al‑ard.
Limmu wa fakkuru,ya naas al‑umma al‑ma taʼarfu eebku.
Gabul ma tabgo misil al‑uttaabal‑chaayle al‑riihwa gabul khadab Allah al‑muhrigma yalhagkuwa gabul ma yaji al‑yoomal‑yanzil foogah khadab Allah,
gummu fattuchu Allah,intu kulluku masaakiin al‑ardal‑gaaʼidiin titabbugu gawaaniinah al‑hu khattaahum.Fattuchu al‑adaalawa maskunu nufuusku !Wa be da,mumkin tanjofi yoom khadab Allah.
Madiinat Khazza takhrabwa hillit Achgaluun tiddammar.Wa sukkaan Achduud yaturduuhum gaaylewa madiinat Akhruun tabga ma fiiha.
Al‑azaab le sukkaan khachum al‑baharwa le l‑umma al‑jaaye min jaziirat Kiriit !Daahu kalaam Allah didduku : Ya Kanʼaan,ard al‑Filistiyiin,ana nidammirkiwa tabge faadiye min sukkaanki.
Wa khachum al‑bahar yabgakadaade bakaan hana sarhawa biyaar le l‑ruʼyaanwa zaraayib le l‑khanam.
Wa l‑mantaga di tabga hintal‑naas al‑faddalo min Bani Yahuuza.Humman yasraho fooghawa be achiiye,yinjammo fi buyuut Achgaluun.Achaan ana Allah Ilaahhum nugumm fi chaanhumwa nigabbilhum min balad al‑khurba. 
 Ana simiʼt muʼyaar Muwaabwa chamaatat Bani Ammuunal‑gaaʼidiin yiʼayyuru beyah chaʼabiwa yiwassuʼu arduhum fi turaab chaʼabi.
Wa fi chaan da,ana nahlif be usmi al‑Hayy,Muwaab tiddammar misil Saduumwa Ammuun takhrab misil Amuura.Yabgo bakaan haskaniitwa nugra hint milehwa kharaab ila l‑abad.Wa l‑faddalo min chaʼabi yanhaboohumwa l‑baagyiin min ummati yaglaʼo baladhum. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa daahu al‑yalgooh fi chaan istikbaarhum achaan humman ayyaro chaʼab Allah al‑Gaadir wa wassaʼo arduhum fi turaabhum.
Allah yikhawwifhum wa yidammir kulla ilaahaat al‑ard.Wa kulla l‑umam al‑baʼiidiin yasjudu giddaamah,ayyi umma fi baladha.
 Wa intu kula,ya l‑Habachiyiin,seefi yaktulku. 
Allah yarfaʼ iidah didd balad al‑munchaakhwa yidammir balad Achuur.Madiinat Niinawa tabga ard kharbaanewa jafaaf misil al‑sahara.
Wa fi usutha,yunuumu al‑bahaayimwa ayyi nafar hana haywaanaat.Amʼakk wa amguggum yunuumu fi ruuse amadhawa hissuhum yinsamiʼ fi l‑chubbaak.Wa min baab ayyi beet,al‑damaar yinchaafwa hatab al‑arz al‑jammalo beyah buyuuthum daffag.
Wa awwal,di madiinat al‑farahal‑gaaʼide be amaan.Wa hi gaalat fi nafisha : Ana bas al‑jamiilewa ma fi balaayi. Hassaʼ chiifu !Hi bigat kharaabwa margad haywaanaat.Ayyi waahid al‑yufuut jambahayisaffir wa yihizz raasah min al‑ajab.
Al‑azaab le l‑madiina al‑malaane be l‑zulum !Hi muʼaaride wa nijse.
Hi ma simʼat kalaam Allahwa ma khassadat be l‑adab.Hi ma atwakkalat ale Allahwa ma garrabat le Ilaahha.
Wa fi usutha,kubaaraatha misil al‑diidaan al‑yikirruwa gudiyaaha misil maraafʼiin al‑leelal‑ma yikhallu cheyy le l‑fajur.
Wa anbiyaaha mustakbiriin wa khaayniinwa rujaal diinha ma yihtarumu al‑mukhaddaswa yugummu be unuf didd churuut al‑Tawraat.
Wa laakin Allah lissaaʼ gaaʼid fi l‑madiina,hu aadil wa ma yisawwi zulum.Wa kulli sabaah,hu yiwassif chariiʼtahwa abadan ma yikhalliiha.Wa laakin al‑mujrimma yaʼarif al‑eeb.
Wa Allah gaal : Ana kammalt al‑umamwa dammart bakaanaathum hana l‑muraakhaba.Ana kharabt chawaariʼhumwa ma fi naadum al‑yufuut beehum.Wa dammart mudunhumwa bigo faadiyiin min sukkaanhum.
Wa ana gult :‹ Akuun al‑madiina di takhaaf minniwa tikhassid be l‑adab.Wa be da,ana ma nikammilhawa la niʼaakhibha. ›Wa laakin sukkaanha yibakkurule yisawwu al‑charr. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Fi chaan da,arjooni !Yoom waahid,nugumm le l‑khaniime.Achaan kharrart nilimm al‑umamwa najmaʼ al‑mamaalik.Wa ninazzil fooghum zaʼaliwa kulla khadabi al‑muhrig.Achaan be naar khiirti,kulla l‑ard tahrag. 
 Wa khalaas,nitahhir lisaan al‑chuʼuubachaan kulluhum yinaadu be usmi ana Allahwa yaʼabuduuni be galib waahid.
Hatta min khaadi le buhuur balad al‑Habacha,al‑naas yaju yaʼabuduuni.Aywa,al‑naas al‑ana chattattuhumyijiibu leyi hadaaya. 
 Ya chaʼabi,fi l‑yoom dama talgo ayyi eeb be sabab kulla aʼmaalkual‑beehum isiituuni.Achaan fi l‑wakit da,namrug min usutku al‑kuluufiyiinwa ma tistakbaro fi jabali al‑mukhaddas.
Wa ana nifaddil fi usutkunaas masaakiin wa fagraaniinwa humman yaljaʼo tihit usum Allah.
Wa l‑faddalo min Bani Israaʼiilma yisawwu zulumwa ma yuguulu kalaam kidibwa ma yinlagi fi khuchuumhum kalaam khachch.Wa laakin humman yaakulu wa yunuumu be amaanwa ma fi naadum yibachtinhum. 
Zakhriti,ya Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye !Asrakhe be farah,ya Israaʼiil !Afrahe wa anbasti be kulla galibki,ya Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑misil bineeye !
Allah rafaʼ al‑ikhaab minkiwa tarad udwaanki.Wa Allah malik Israaʼiilhu zaatah gaaʼid fi usutkiwa battaan ma takhaafe min al‑fasaala.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,yuguulu le Madiinat al‑Khudus : Ma takhaafe,ya Sahyuun,wa ma taksale.
Allah Ilaahki gaaʼid fi usutkimisil faaris al‑yinajjiiki.Hu farhaan beekiwa fi chaan hubbah,hu yijaddidkiwa hu yafrah beeki farah chadiid. 
Wa Allah gaal : Ya chaʼabi,ana nilimm al‑naas al‑ma gidro ayyado maʼaakuwa l‑baʼiidiin minkuwa namrug eebhumal‑bigi leehum tagiil.
Fi l‑wakit da,akiid nugumm didd kulla l‑yitaʼʼubuukuwa ninajji maʼduuriinkuwa nilimm naasku al‑chattatoohum.Nicharrifku wa usumku yabga taaliʼfi kulla l‑buldaan al‑fooghum ligiitu al‑eeb.
Fi l‑yoom da,ana nigabbilkuwa fi l‑wakit da,nilimmuku sawa.Chiifu !Nigabbilku min al‑khurbawa usumku yabga taaliʼwa nicharrifkufi ust kulla chuʼuub al‑ard. Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Fi l‑yoom al‑awwal hana l‑chahar al‑saadis fi l‑sana al‑taaniye hana hukum al‑malik Daariyuus,Allah hajja be waasitat al‑nabi Haggaay le Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil wa le Yachuuʼ wileed Yuusaadikh.Wa Zarubaabil da hu haakim balad Yahuuza.Wa Yachuuʼ kamaan hu kabiir rujaal al‑diin.
Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Al‑chaʼab da gaalo kadar al‑wakit al‑yabnu foogah beet Allah battaan da lissaaʼ ma ja. 
Wa khalaas,Allah hajja leehum battaan be waasitat al‑nabi Haggaay wa gaal :
 Hassaʼ,intu taskunu fi buyuut al‑jammaltuuhum be hatab wa laakin beet Allah gaaʼid mudammar.Da adiil walla ? 
Wa hassaʼ,daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Fakkuru fi haalitku.
Intu teerabtu katiir wa ligiitu chiyyawa akaltu wa ma chibiʼtu.Wa chiribtu wa ma riwiituwa libistu wa gaaʼidiin bardaaniin.Wa da misil ujritkudasseetuuha fi jeeb magduud. 
Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Fakkuru fi haalitku.
Atlaʼo fi l‑jabal wa jiibu hatab wa abnu beyah beeti battaan.Wa be da,ana nafrah beyah wa nibayyin foogah majdi.Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
Intu gaaʼidiin tarjo intaaj katiir wa laakin ligiitu chiyya bas.Intu waddeetuuh fi buyuutku wa laakin ana nafakht foogah wa chattattah.Wa da fi chaan chunu ?Da fi chaan beeti gaaʼid mudammar wa laakin intu ankarabtu ayyi waahid fi bani beetah.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa fi chaan da,al‑sama ma nazzalat matar wa l‑ard ma antat intaaj.
Ana jibt al‑jafaaf fi l‑ard wa fi l‑jibaal wa fi l‑ziraaʼa wa fi jineenaat al‑inab wa fi chadar al‑zaytuun wa fi kulla intaaj al‑ard.Wa l‑naas wa l‑bahaayim ma ligo natiijat khidmithum. 
Wa khalaas,Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil wa Yachuuʼ wileed Yuusaadikh kabiir rujaal al‑diin wa kulla l‑faddalo min al‑chaʼab,kulluhum simʼo kalaam Allah Ilaahhum wa kalaam al‑nabi Haggaay al‑rassalah leehum Allah Ilaahhum.Wa l‑chaʼab khaafo min Allah.
Wa Haggaay rasuul Allah hajja le l‑chaʼab hasab al‑kalaam al‑rassalah beyah Allah wa gaal : Daahu kalaam Allah :‹ Ana maʼaaku.› 
Wa Allah chajjaʼ Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil haakim balad Yahuuza wa Yachuuʼ wileed Yuusaadikh kabiir rujaal al‑diin wa kulla l‑faddalo min al‑chaʼab.Wa humman jo wa gammo yakhdumu fi beet Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaahhum
fi yoom 24 hana l‑chahar al‑saadis fi l‑sana al‑taaniye hana hukum al‑malik Daariyuus.
Wa fi yoom 21 hana l‑chahar al‑saabiʼ,Allah hajja be waasitat al‑nabi Haggaay wa gaal :
 Hajji le Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil haakim balad Yahuuza wa le Yachuuʼ wileed Yuusaadikh kabiir rujaal al‑diin wa le l‑faddalo min al‑chaʼab wa guul :
‹ Yaatu minku intu al‑gaaʼidiin hayyiin al‑yoom chaaf majd al‑beet da zamaan ?Wa keef chiftuuh al‑yoom ?Sahiih al‑beet da ma yaʼajibku ! ›
Wa hassaʼ,daahu kalaam Allah :‹ Ya Zarubaabil wa ya Yachuuʼ wileed Yuusaadikh kabiir rujaal al‑diin wa ya kulla chaʼab al‑balad,chiddu heelku.Wa da kalaam Allah.Gummu le l‑khidme achaan ana maʼaaku !Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa hasab al‑waʼad al‑waaʼadtuku beyah wakit maragtu min balad Masir,ruuhi gaaʼide fi usutku.Ma takhaafo min cheyy !› 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Battaan wakit chiyya,ana nirajjif al‑sama wa l‑ardwa l‑buhuur wa kulla l‑dunya.
Ana nirajjif kulla l‑umamwa l‑khuna hana kulla l‑umamtaji fi l‑bakaan dawa ana namla kulla l‑beet dabe l‑majd.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Achaan kulla l‑fudda hintiwa l‑dahab kula hanaayi ana.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Al‑majd hana l‑beet da yabga ziyaadawa yufuut al‑majd hana l‑beet al‑awwal.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.Wa fi l‑bakaan da bas,ana nisabbit al‑salaam. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa fi yoom 24 hana l‑chahar al‑taasiʼ fi l‑sana al‑taaniye hana hukum Daariyuus,Allah hajja le l‑nabi Haggaay.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Asʼal rujaal al‑diin chunu fikirhum fi l‑gaanuun da.
Kan naadum chaayil laham mukhaddas fi chaarib khalagah wa allammas be chaarib khalagah da laham aw churba aw khamar aw dihin aw ayyi akil aakhar,hal al‑akil da yilkhaddas walla ? Wa rujaal al‑diin gaalo : La.Ma yilkhaddas. 
Wa Haggaay gaal battaan : Akuun naadum annajjas be sabab janaaza.Kan al‑naadum da allammas al‑achya dool,humman yinnajjaso walla ? Wa rujaal al‑diin gaalo : Aywa,yinnajjaso. 
Wa Haggaay radda leehum wa gaal : Daahu kalaam Allah :‹ Al‑chaʼab da wa l‑umma di,kulluhum misil da giddaami ana.Wa kulla khidmit iideehum wa ayyi cheyy al‑yigaddumuuh leyi kula nijis.
Hassaʼ da,fakkuru adiil min al‑yoom le giddaam.Gabul ma khatteetu hajar foog hajar le tabnu beet Allah,
haalitku kikkeef ?Wakit macho yikiilu 20 kooro hana khalla min al‑dabanga,ligo 10 bas.Wa wakit macho yikiilu 50 liitir hana khamar min al‑assaara,ligo 20 bas.
Wa ana darabt ziraaʼitku be l‑jafaaf wa l‑barad wa l‑nada al‑yisoofinha.Wa be da kula,intu ma gabbaltu leyi.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Fakkuru adiil min al‑yoom le giddaam.Al‑yoom da yoom 24 hana l‑chahar al‑taasiʼ,al‑yoom al‑khatto foogah asaas beet Allah.Fakkuruuh adiil.
Awwal ma faddal cheyy fi l‑dabanga wa chadar al‑inab wa l‑tiin wa l‑rummaan wa l‑zaytuun kula ma jaabo cheyy.Wa laakin min al‑yoom da,nibaarikku.› 
Wa fi nafs al‑yoom,Allah hajja battaan le Haggaay wa gaal :
 Guul le Zarubaabil haakim balad Yahuuza :‹ Ana nirajjif al‑sama wa l‑ard.
Wa narmi karaasi al‑mamaalik wa nidammir khuwwaat mamaalik al‑umam.Wa narmi arabaathum hana l‑harib wa l‑raakbiin fooghum.Wa l‑kheel wa l‑raakbiin fooghum,narmiihum tihit.Ayyi waahid yumuut be seef akhuuh.
Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.Wa fi l‑yoom da,ya abdi Zarubaabil wileed Chaltiyiil,ana nichiilak wa nukhuttak misil khitim fi iidi achaan inta bas ana azaltak.›  Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Fi l‑chahar al‑taamin fi l‑sana al‑taaniye hana hukum Daariyuus malik balad Faaris,Allah hajja le l‑nabi Zakariiya wileed Barakya wileed Iddu wa gaal leyah :
 Ana Allah khidibt khadab chadiid didd juduudku.
Hassaʼ da,hajji le Bani Israaʼiil be kalaami ana Allah al‑Gaadir wa guul leehum :‹ Daahu kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir :“Gabbulu leyi wa ana kula nigabbil leeku.”Wa da Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Ma tabgo misil juduudku.Zamaan,al‑anbiya hajjo leehum be kalaami ana Allah al‑Gaadir wa gaalo leehum yigabbulu leyi wa yikhallu deribhum al‑fasil wa amalhum al‑fasil.Wa laakin humman ma khatto baalhum leyi wa la simʼo kalaami.Wa da kalaam Allah.
 ‹ Ween juduudku ?Wa l‑anbiya yiʼiichu ila l‑abad walla ?
Wa laakin kalaami wa churuuti al‑ana amart beehum abiidi al‑anbiya,lihgo juduudku.Wa humman gabbalo leyi wa gaalo :“Allah al‑Gaadir kharrar yiʼaamilna hasab deribna wa amalna.Wa da bas al‑cheyy al‑hu sawwaah.”› 
Wa fi yoom 24 hana chahri 11 al‑usmah Chabaat fi l‑sana al‑taaniye hana hukum Daariyuus,Allah hajja battaan leyi ana al‑nabi Zakariiya wileed Barakya wileed Iddu.
Fi l‑leele di,ana chift ruʼya.Ana chift raajil raakib fi juwaad ahmar wa waagif fi usut chadar al‑waadi.Wa waraayah fi kheel humur wa chugur wa buyud be rukkaabhum.
Wa ana saʼalt al‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi wa gult : Ya siidi,humman dool yaatumman ? Wa l‑malak gaal : Ana niʼooriik humman dool yaatumman. 
Wa l‑raajil al‑waagif fi lubb chadar al‑waadi gaal : Humman dool Allah rassalaahum le yuruukhu kulla l‑ard. 
Wa rukkaab al‑kheel hajjo le malak Allah al‑waagif fi ust al‑chadar wa gaalo leyah : Daahu aniina rukhna kulla l‑ard wa ligiinaaha gaaʼide fi raaha wa jumma. 
Wa malak Allah hajja wa gaal : Ya Allah al‑Gaadir,min muddit 70 sana inta khidibt le Madiinat al‑Khudus wa hillaal balad Yahuuza.Mata tarhamhum ? 
Wa Allah radda le l‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi wa anta radd adiil wa muchajjiʼ.
Wa baʼad da,al‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi gaal : Ballikh !Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal :‹ Ana indi mahabba chadiidele Madiinat al‑Khudus wa jabal Sahyuun.
Wa laakin ana khidibt khadab chadiiddidd al‑umam al‑mustakbiriin wa murtaahiin.Achaan wakit ana khidibt chiyya didd Bani Israaʼiil,al‑umam dool aamaloohum be charr katiir.› 
Wa fi chaan da,daahu Allah gaal : Ana nigabbil le Madiinat al‑Khudusbe mahanna.Wa Madiinat al‑Khudus yigaawusuuha le l‑baniwa beeti yinbani fiiha battaan. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa l‑malak gaal leyi : Battaan ballikh !Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal :‹ Hillaal hanaayi yinmalu battaan be l‑kheerwa nihinn battaan fi Sahyuunwa naʼazil battaan Madiinat al‑Khudus.› 
Wa battaan rafaʼt raasi wa chift ruʼya.Wa daahu chift arbaʼa guruun.
Wa ana saʼalt al‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi wa gult : Humman dool chunu ? Wa hu radda leyi wa gaal : Dool al‑guruun al‑chattato sukkaan balad Yahuuza wa balad Israaʼiil wa Madiinat al‑Khudus. 
Wa baʼad da,Allah chawwafaani arbaʼa haddaad.
Wa ana gult : Humman dool jo bisawwu chunu ? Wa hu gaal leyi : Al‑guruun dool humman bas al‑chattato sukkaan balad Yahuuza lahaddi naadum fiiha ma yagdar yarfaʼ raasah.Wa laakin al‑haddaad dool jo le yirajjufu wa yikassuru guruun al‑umam wa dool al‑umam al‑rafaʼo guruunhum didd balad Yahuuza le yichattutu sukkaanha. 
Wa battaan ana rafaʼt raasi wa chift ruʼya.Wa daahu chift sabi wa indah fi iidah habil al‑yigaawusu beyah.
Wa ana saʼaltah wa gult leyah : Inta maachi ween ? Wa hu gaal leyi : Maachi nigaawis Madiinat al‑Khudus le naʼarif urdaha wa tuulha kam. 
Wa baʼad da,al‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi gamma maachi wa malak aakhar ja laagaah.
Wa l‑malak al‑awwal gaal le l‑aakhar : Ajri hajji le l‑sabi da wa guul leyah :‹ Madiinat al‑Khudus tagood maftuuha bala durdur achaan al‑naas wa l‑bahaayim bigo katiiriin fi usutha. ›
Wa daahu kalaam Allah :‹ Ana zaati nukuun leeha durdur hana naar muhawwigha.Wa fi usutha,nukuun majdaha.› 
Daahu kalaam Allah : Yalla !Yalla !Intu al‑ana chattattuku fi l‑jiihaat al‑arbaʼa,arrudu min balad al‑munchaakh !Wa da kalaam Allah.
Yalla !Ya Sahyuun !Inti al‑saakne fi Baabil al‑misil bineeye,arridi min hinaak ! 
Majd Allah rassalaani ana Zakariiya didd al‑umam al‑nahabooku wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Ayyi naadum al‑yilammiskuda misil limis wald eeni.
Aywa,daahu narfaʼ iidi didduhumhatta abiidhum kula yanhaboohum. Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar Allah al‑Gaadir,hu bas rassalaani.
Daahu kalaam Allah : Zakhriti wa afrahe,ya Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye,achaan daahu ana jaayi naskun fi usutki.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,umam katiiriinyinkarbu foogi ana Allah.Wa yabgo chaʼabi halaali.Wa ana naskun fi usutku. Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar Allah al‑Gaadir,hu bas rassalaani leeku.
Wa balad Yahuuza tabga hint Allah halaalahmisil gismah fi l‑ard al‑mukhaddasawa hu yaʼazil battaan Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Khalli kulla makhluug hayyyaskut giddaam Allahachaan hu maragmin maskanah al‑mukhaddas.
Wa baʼad da,Allah chawwafaani Yachuuʼ kabiir rujaal al‑diin waagif giddaam malak Allah.Wa Ibliis al‑tahhaam waagif be nuss al‑zeene hana Yachuuʼ le yathamah.
Wa malak Allah gaal le Ibliis : Khalli Allah yisakkitak,ya Ibliis !Aywa,khalli Allah yisakkitak,hu al‑azal Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa kan le l‑raajil da,hu ma misil muchhaab al‑chaalooh min al‑naar walla ? 
Wa Yachuuʼ waagif giddaam al‑malak wa laabis khulgaan waskhaaniin.
Wa l‑malak amar wa gaal le l‑waagfiin jambah : Sillu minnah khulgaanah al‑waskhaaniin. Wa baʼad da,gaal le Yachuuʼ : Chiif,ana najjeetak min zanbak.Khalli yilabbusuuk khulgaan hana iid. 
Wa gaal battaan : Khalli yukhuttu fi raasah kadmuul taahir. Wa khalaas,labbasooh khulgaan wa khatto kadmuul taahir fi raasah.Wa malak Allah waagif fi l‑bakaan da.
Wa khalaas,malak Allah kallam le Yachuuʼ wa gaal :
 Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal :‹ Kan tichiil derbiwa tahfad khidimti,inta bas tahkim fi beetiwa tiraakhib fi fadaayti kula.Wa ana nantiik bakaanambeen al‑aakhariin al‑waagfiin hini.› 
 Asmaʼ,ya Yachuuʼ kabiir rujaal al‑diin wa kulla rujaal al‑diin al‑tihtak.Intu zaatku alaama hana l‑cheyy al‑yukuun.Daahu gariib ana nirassil abdi al‑binaaduuh Bizre.
Chiifu al‑hajar al‑khaali al‑khatteetah giddaam Yachuuʼ.Wa fi l‑hajar,fi sabʼa uyuun.Wa daahu ana zaati nanguch foogah nagich.Wa fi yoom waahid bas,nuguchch khata al‑balad di.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ayyi waahid minku yaʼazim jaarah le yagood be l‑salaama fi lubb jineentah hana l‑inab wa l‑tiin. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa l‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi gabbal ja wa gawwamaani misil yigawwumu naadum min al‑noom.
Wa hu gaal leyi : Gaaʼid tichiif chunu ? Wa ana gult : Gaaʼid nichiif faanuus kulla ke hana dahab wa l‑bakaan al‑yusubbu foogah al‑dihin gaaʼid min foog leyah wa indah sabʼa tiyeesaat al‑induhum sabʼa niiraan.
Wa jaay wa jaay le l‑bakaan al‑yusubbu foogah al‑dihin,nichiif chadar itneen hana zaytuun,al‑waahide be l‑zeene wa l‑aakhara be l‑isra. 
Wa ana saʼalt al‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi wa gult : Da maʼanaatah chunu,ya siidi ? 
Wa l‑malak gaal : Al‑cheyy al‑gaaʼid tichiifah da,maʼanaatah ma taʼarfah walla ? Wa ana gult : La,ya siidi. 
Wa khalaas,hu gaal leyi : Allah hajja le Zarubaabil wa gaal :‹ Al‑khidme di ma be khuwwawa la be gudrawa laakin be ruuhi ana.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Inta tahsib nafsak kabiir,ya l‑jabal ?Giddaam Zarubaabil tagaʼwa tabga sahale bas.Wa kan Zarubaabil yijiibaakhir hajar le yabnu beeti,al‑naas yiʼiitu wa yuguulu :“Mabruuk !Mabruuk le l‑hajar !”› 
Wa Allah hajja leyi ana Zakariiya wa gaal :
 Iideen Zarubaabil khatto asaas al‑beet dawa iideenah bas yikammuluuh. Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar Allah al‑Gaadir bas rassalaani leeku.
 Ma tahguru yoom hana bidaaya sakhayre.Tafraho wakit tichiifu fi iid Zarubaabildurdumt al‑hadiid al‑yigaawusu beyah. Wa l‑niiraan al‑sabʼa hana l‑faanuus dool yimassulu uyuun Allah al‑gaaʼidiin yiraakhubu kulla l‑ard.
Wa battaan,ana saʼalt al‑malak wa gult : Chadar al‑zaytuun al‑itneen al‑ana chiftah jaay wa jaay le l‑faanuus be l‑zeene wa l‑isra,maʼanaatah chunu ? 
Wa saʼaltah le taani marra wa gult : Chunu maʼana hana l‑furuuʼ al‑itneen hana chadar al‑zaytuun al‑gaaʼidiin jamb al‑majaari al‑itneen hana l‑dahab al‑yisiil minhum al‑dihin al‑dahbi ? 
Wa hu radda leyi wa gaal : Ma taʼarif maʼanaatah walla ? Wa ana gult : La,ya siidi. 
Wa khalaas,hu gaal leyi : Dool yimassulu al‑rujaal al‑itneen al‑masahoohum be l‑dihin wa khassasoohum le yagiifu giddaam Allah siid kulla l‑ard. 
Wa battaan ana rafaʼt raasi wa chift ruʼya.Wa daahu chift kitaab malfuuf taayir.
Wa l‑malak gaal leyi : Gaaʼid tichiif chunu ? Wa ana gult : Gaaʼid nichiif kitaab taayir tuulah 20 duraaʼ wa urdah 10 duraaʼ. 
Wa khalaas,hu gaal leyi : Fi l‑kitaab da,maktuuba foogah al‑laʼana al‑nazalat fi kulla l‑balad.Wa be nussah al‑waahid,ayyi sarraag yaturduuh wa be nussah al‑aakhar,ayyi naadum al‑yahlif be kidib kula yaturduuh.
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir :‹ Ana nazzalt al‑laʼana di achaan tadkhul wa taskun fi beet al‑sarraag wa fi beet al‑naadum al‑yahlif be usmi be kidib.Wa tidammir al‑beet lahaddi maraadiisah wa asaasah.› 
Wa l‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi gaddam wa gaal leyi : Arfaʼ raasak wa chiif al‑cheyy al‑jaayi da. 
Wa ana saʼaltah wa gult : Da chunu ? Wa hu gaal leyi : Di l‑guffa al‑foogha zunuub hana kulla naas al‑balad. 
Wa tawwaali,tabag hana hadiid anrafaʼ min khachum al‑guffa wa daahu fiyah mara gaaʼide fi lubbaha.
Wa l‑malak gaal : Al‑mara di,hi timassil al‑fasaala. Hu lazzaaha daakhal fi l‑guffa wa sadda khachum al‑guffa be l‑tabag hana l‑hadiid da.
Wa baʼad da,ana rafaʼt raasi wa chift ruʼya.Wa daahu chift awiin itneen jaayaat.Al‑riih gaaʼide tihijj fi janaaheehin wa janaaheehin misil janaahe abunkhanam.Wa hinna chaalan al‑guffa wa taaran beeha ambeen al‑sama wa l‑ard.
Wa ana saʼalt al‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi wa gult : Ween yiwaddan al‑guffa di ? 
Wa hu gaal leyi : Yiwaddanha fi balad Baabil al‑fasle le yabnu leeha beet al‑ibaada.Wa hinaak yisawwu leeha asaas wa yukhuttuuha foogah. 
Wa battaan rafaʼt raasi wa chift ruʼya.Wa daahu chift arbaʼa arabaat hana harib marago min been jibaal itneen hana nahaas.
Al‑araba al‑awwalaaniiye kaarriinha kheel humur wa l‑taaniye kaarriinha kheel zurug.
Wa l‑taalta kaarriinha kheel buyud wa l‑raabʼe kaarriinha kheel rugut wa gaadriin.
Wa ana saʼalt al‑malak al‑gaaʼid yihajji leyi wa gult : Humman dool yimassulu chunu,ya siidi ? 
Wa l‑malak radda leyi wa gaal : Humman dool yimassulu riih al‑sama al‑tusuug ale l‑jiihaat al‑arbaʼa,al‑maarge min hadarat Allah siid kulla l‑ard.
Wa arabat al‑kheel al‑zurug tamchi ale balad al‑munchaakh.Wa l‑kheel al‑buyud yitaabuʼuuhum.Wa l‑kheel al‑rugut kamaan yamchu ale balad al‑junuub.
Wa l‑kheel al‑gaadriin dool marago le yamchu yuruukhu al‑ard.Wa Allah gaal leehum :‹ Amchu ruukhu al‑ard.› Wa humman macho raakho al‑ard. 
Wa baʼad da,Allah naadaani be hiss aali wa gaal : Chiif !Al‑yamchu fi balad al‑munchaakh yihaddu khadabi fi l‑balad di. 
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Akhbal al‑hadaaya al‑jaaboohum Haldaay wa Tuubiiya wa Yadaʼya min al‑naas al‑waddoohum fi l‑khurba.Al‑yoom bas,inta zaatak amchi fi beet Yuuchiiya wileed Safanya achaan al‑talaata rujaal dool dallo hinaak wakit jo min Baabil.
Wa akhbal minhum hadaaya al‑fudda wa l‑dahab wa dugg beehum taaj.Wa khuttah fi raas kabiir rujaal al‑diin Yachuuʼ wileed Yuusaadikh.
 Wa guul le Yachuuʼ :‹ Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal :“Daahu al‑raajil al‑binaaduuh Bizrewa tihit rijileenah yabzur kulla cheyywa hu yabni beet Allah battaan.
Aywa,hu bas yabni beet Allahwa hu bas al‑yalbas khalag al‑mulukwa yagood fi kursiih wa yahkim.Wa raajil al‑diin kulayagood jamb kursiihwa ambeenaathum humman al‑itneenfi muwaafaga kaamile.” ›
 Wa yukhuttu al‑taaj da fi beeti ana Allah wa yizzakkaro beyah Haldaay wa Tuubiiya wa Yadaʼya wa l‑kheer al‑sawwaah wileed Safanya. 
Wa naas baʼiidiin yaju yabnu battaan beet Allah.Wa be da,taʼarfu kadar Allah al‑Gaadir bas rassalaani ana Zakariiya leeku.Wa da yukuun kan intu tasmaʼo adiil kalaam Allah Ilaahku.
Wa fi l‑yoom al‑raabiʼ hana l‑chahar al‑taasiʼ al‑usmah Kislu fi l‑sana al‑raabʼe hana hukum al‑malik Daariyuus,Allah hajja le Zakariiya.
Wa Beet Iil Charaasar khaayid askar al‑malik wa askarah rassalo naas le yachhado Allah.
Wa rassaloohum achaan yasʼalo rujaal al‑diin fi beet Allah al‑Gaadir wa l‑anbiya wa yuguulu : Awwal aniina gaaʼidiin nusuumu wa nabku fi l‑chahar al‑khaamis achaan nizzakkaro damaar hana beet Allah.Wa hassaʼ da,waajib nisawwuuh walla la ? 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Guul le kulla chaʼab al‑balad wa le rujaal al‑diin :‹ Wakit sumtu wa hizintufi l‑chahar al‑khaamis wa l‑saabiʼ,wa da min muddit 70 sana,siyaamku da leyi ana walla ?
Wa wakit akaltu wa chiribtu,ma le nufuusku bas walla ?› 
Allah hajja misil da be waasitat al‑anbiya hana zamaan.Wa da wakit sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus wa hillaalha al‑muhawwigiinha gaaʼidiin fi raaha wa saharat Nagab wa sahalat Chafiila malaaniin be sukkaan.
Wa Allah hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal :‹ Ahkumu be l‑hagg wa l‑adaalawa khalli ayyi waahid yisawwi le akhuuhal‑kheer wa l‑rahma.
Ma tazulmu al‑armala wa la l‑atiimwa la l‑ajnabi wa la l‑miskiin.Wa khalli naadum ma yichiil niiyele yisawwi al‑fasaala le akhuuh.› 
Wa laakin humman abo ma yukhuttu baalhum.Gawwo ruuseehum wa saddo udneehum achaan ma yasmaʼo.
Wa humman gawwo galibhum misil hajar achaan ma yasmaʼo churuut al‑Tawraat wa l‑kalaam al‑Allah al‑Gaadir rassalah leehum be waasitat ruuhah wa be waasitat al‑anbiya hana zamaan.Wa da bas sabab al‑khadab al‑chadiid hana Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Misil ana naadeethum wa humman ma simʼooni,humman kula yinaaduuni wa ana ma nasmaʼhum.
Wa ana chattattuhum ale kulla l‑umam al‑abadan ma yaʼarfuuhum.Wa baʼad chattattuhum,al‑balad khirbat wa ma fi al‑yamchi leeha wa la l‑yaji minha.Wa baladhum al‑samhe di,sawwooha kharaab. 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Indi khiira chadiide le jabal Sahyuunwa nihibbah be mahabba chadiide. Wa da Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa daahu Allah gaal : Ana nigabbil fi jabal Sahyuunwa naskun battaan fi usut Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa Madiinat al‑Khudusyinaaduuha Madiinat al‑Amaan.Wa jabal Allah al‑Gaadiryinaaduuh al‑jabal al‑mukhaddas. 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Al‑chiyyaab wa l‑ajaayiz battaan yagoodufi chawaariʼ Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa ayyi waahid asaatah fi iidahachaan aacho umur tawiil.
Wa chawaariʼ al‑madiinayinmalu be l‑awlaad wa l‑banaatal‑gaaʼidiin yalʼabo fooghum. 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Hassaʼ fi l‑wakit da,intu al‑faddaltu min chaʼabi,tahsubu al‑cheyy da gaasi walla ?Wa laakin ana ma nahsibah gaasi. Wa da kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Aywa,ana ninajji chaʼabimin balad al‑sabaahwa min balad al‑kharib.
Ana nijiibhumwa yaskunu battaanfi usut Madiinat al‑Khudus.Humman yabgo chaʼabiwa ana nabga Ilaahhumbe amaan wa adaala. 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Chiddu heelku !Min wakit khatteetu asaas beet Allah al‑Gaadirle tabnu al‑beet da battaan,gaaʼidiin tasmaʼo kalaam al‑anbiya.
Gabul ma badeetu al‑khidme di,khidmit al‑naas ma indaha faaydewa khidmit al‑bahaayim kula ma indaha natiija.Ma fi amaan le l‑yamchu wa l‑yajuwa da be sabab al‑adu.Wa ana khalleet kulla l‑naasayyi waahid yugumm didd akhuuh. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir. Wa laakin hassaʼ le l‑faddalo min al‑chaʼab,ana ma nabga leehum misil awwal.
Hassaʼ nazraʼ al‑salaamwa jineenit al‑inab taldawa l‑ard tanti intaajhawa l‑sama tinazzil matar.Wa nanti kulla l‑cheyy da misil warasale l‑faddalo min al‑chaʼab.
Ya Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israaʼiil,awwal intu bigiitu laʼana fi ust al‑umam.Wa laakin hassaʼ,ninajjiiku wa tabgo baraka.Ma takhaafo,chiddu heelku ! 
Achaan daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Awwal,ana kharrart nitaʼʼibkuachaan juduudku khaddabooni.Wa fi l‑wakit da,ana ma khalleet kharaari.Wa da Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa hassaʼ,ana khalleet kharaari hana l‑taʼabwa kharrart nisawwi al‑kheerle naas Madiinat al‑Khuduswa le Bani Yahuuzawa be da,ma takhaafo.
Daahu al‑cheyy al‑waajib tisawwuuh.Kallumu ambeenaatku be l‑sahiih.Wa fi chariiʼitku,ahkumu be l‑haggwa be l‑adaala al‑tijiib al‑salaam.
Ma tichiilu niiyele tisawwu al‑fasaala ambeenaatkuwa ma tihibbual‑haliife be kidibachaan kulla l‑achya dool,ana nakrahhum. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa Allah al‑Gaadir hajja leyi wa gaal :
 Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal :‹ Ayyaam al‑siyaamhana l‑chahar al‑raabiʼwa l‑chahar al‑khaamiswa l‑chahar al‑saabiʼwa l‑chahar al‑aachiryabgo le Bani Yahuuza ayyaam iidal‑yiʼayyuduuhum be suruur wa farha.Wa laakin hibbu al‑hagg wa l‑salaam.› 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Battaan yaju chuʼuubwa sukkaan min hillaal katiiriin.
Wa sukkaan hille waahideyamchu le sukkaan hille aakhara.Wa yuguulu :‹ Yalla namchu nachhado Allah.Khalli nifattuchu Allah al‑Gaadir. ›Wa yuruddu leehum wa yuguulu :‹ Aywa,aniina kula namchu ! ›
Wa chuʼuub katiiriin wa umam gawiyiinyaju fi Madiinat al‑Khudusle yifattuchu Allah al‑Gaadirwa yachhadooh. 
Wa daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Fi l‑wakit da,yaju min al‑umam achara rujaal ayyi waahid be lukhkhitah.Wa kulla l‑rujaal dool yakurbu daayir khalag hana waahid min al‑Yahuud wa yachhadooh wa yuguulu leyah :‹ Khalluuna namchu maʼaaku achaan simiʼna kadar al‑Rabb gaaʼid maʼaaku.› 
Al‑muhaakama al‑kallam beeha Allahnazalat fi balad Hadraakwa wagafat fi madiinat Dimachkh.Achaan Allah yichiif kulla Bani Adam,ma gabaayil Bani Israaʼiil bas.
Wa l‑muhaakama di taji le madiinat Hamaatal‑gariib le Dimachkh.Wa taji le mudun Suur wa Seedaal‑sukkaanhum induhum hikma kabiire.
Sukkaan Suur bano leehum himaayewa lammo fudda katiire misil al‑turaabwa dahab katiir misil tiinat al‑chawaariʼ.
Wa daahu al‑Rabb yaglaʼ minhum kulla cheyywa yarmi himaayithum fi l‑baharwa l‑madiina zaatha,al‑naar taakulha.
Madiinat Achgaluun tichiif wa takhaafwa Khazza tittanna ziyaada min al‑wajaʼwa Akhruun achamha yingatiʼ.Wa yaktulu malik Khazzawa Achgaluun ma yaskunuuha battaan.
Wa Allah gaal : Al‑ajaanib yaskunu Achduudwa nidammir istikbaar al‑Filistiyiin.
Namrug min khachumhum al‑laham al‑fatiiswa min sunuunhum al‑laham al‑haraam.Al‑yifaddulu minhumyabgo hineeyi ana Ilaahhumwa yabgo khachum beetambeen Bani Yahuuza.Wa naas Akhruun yindammo le chaʼabimisil al‑Yabuusiyiin.
Wa ana nukhutt muʼaskari jamb ardiwa nahrisha min al‑udwaan al‑maachiin wa l‑jaayiin.Wa ayyi mudaayig ma yaji foogha battaanachaan hassaʼ eeni foogha. 
 Ya Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye,afrahe ziyaada !Iiti be farah,ya Madiinat al‑Khudus al‑misil bineeye !Daahu malikki jaayi leeki.Hu aadil wa munnasir.Hu miskiin wa raakib fi humaar,fi dahach wileed humaara.
Ana nidammir arabaat al‑harib fi turaab Afraayimwa kheel al‑duwaas fi Madiinat al‑Khuduswa nikassir nubbaal al‑harib.Wa l‑malik da yikallimbe l‑salaam le l‑umamwa sultitah tamchi min al‑bahar al‑Mayyitlahaddi l‑bahar al‑Abyadwa min bahar al‑Furaatlahaddi aakhir al‑ard. 
Wa Allah gaal : Be sabab muʼaahadatial‑sawweetha maʼaakube damm al‑dahaaya,ana namrug masaajiinku min al‑sijinal‑bigi leehum misil nugra bala almi.
Ya l‑masaajiin al‑induku acham,gabbulu fi l‑bakaan al‑gawi.Hassaʼ nikhabbirkukadar nikaffiiku taʼabku marrateen.
Bani Yahuuza yabgo leyi nubbaalwa gabiilat Afraayim yabgo leyi nachaachiib.Ya Sahyuun,ana nigawwim rujaalkiwa nisawwiihum misil seef al‑faarisdidd subyaan balad al‑Yuunaan. 
Wa Allah yibiin min foog le chaʼabahwa nuchchaabah yabrug misil barraaga.Allah al‑Rabb yadrub al‑buugwa yaji be riih chadiide min al‑junuub.
Allah al‑Gaadir yahmi chaʼabahwa humman yidammuruwa yakharbu al‑adube hujaar al‑miglaaʼ.Wa yacharbo wa yikoorukumisil sakkaara.Wa yinmalu be damm udwaanhummisil kaas al‑yuruchchu beyah guruun al‑madbah.
Wa Allah Ilaahhum yinajji chaʼabah fi l‑yoom da,misil raaʼi yinajji khanamah.Achaan humman yiraaru fi ardahmisil hujaar khaaliyiin al‑yiraaru fi taaj.
Aywa,humman yafraho ziyaadawa yabgo jamiiliin marra waahid !Wa l‑gameh yiʼakkil al‑subyaanwa l‑khamar al‑jadiid yikabbir al‑banaat.
Asʼalo Allah achaan yinazzil leekumatar al‑richaach fi waktah.Allah bas yikawwin al‑sahaabwa yinazzil matar katiir.Wa le ayyi insaan kula,hu yigawwim maʼaach fi zerʼah.
Laakin kan tasʼalo al‑asnaam,yuruddu be l‑fasaalawa l‑chawwaafiinyihajju be kidib.Hilimhum kula ma sahiihwa yisabburuuku be khachch.Wa fi chaan da,al‑chaʼab aayriin misil al‑khanamwa tiʼibo be sabab ma induhum raaʼi.
 Khadabi yanzil didd ruʼyaanhumwa niʼaakhib kubaaraathum al‑misil tuyuus.Aywa,ana Allah al‑Gaadirnidaafiʼ le Bani Yahuuza al‑misil khanami.Wa ana nisawwiihummisil juwaad aziim fi l‑harib.
Wa min Bani Yahuuza,yamurgu khuyyaadwa humman chudaad misil hajar al‑asaaswa saabtiin misil witid al‑kheemawa gawiyiin misil nubbaal al‑harib.
Humman yihaarubu misil furraasal‑yifajjukhu aduuhum misil tiinat al‑chawaariʼ.Humman yihaarubuachaan ana Allah maʼaahumwa hatta siyaad al‑kheel kula,al‑eeb yikhattiihum.
 Ana nigawwi Bani Yahuuzawa ninajji zurriiyit Yuusuf.Wa nigabbilhum fi baladhumachaan hanneet fooghummisil awwal abadan ma abeethum.Achaan ana Allah Ilaahhumwa nakhbal salaathum.
Naas gabiilat Afraayimyabgo misil furraaswa yinmalu be l‑farahmisil al‑chirbo al‑khamar.Wakit yichiifuuhum,iyaalhum yinbastuwa guluubhum yafrahofi chaan Allah.
Wa ana nisaffir leehum le nilimmuhumachaan ana fadeethum.Humman yaldowa yabgo katiiriin min awwal.
Ana chattattuhum fi ust al‑chuʼuubwa laakin fi l‑bakaan al‑baʼiid kula,yizzakkarooni.Humman yiʼiichu hinaak maʼa iyaalhumwa baʼadeen,yigabbulu fi arduhum.
Ana nigabbilhum min balad Masirwa min balad Achuur,nilimmuhum.Wa nisabbithum fi balad Gilʼaad wa Lubnaanlahaddi al‑ard ma titimmuhum.
Humman yagtaʼo bahar al‑taʼabwa ana Allah nadrub al‑mooj fi ust al‑baharwa kulla almi al‑Niil al‑khariig yikammil.Istikbaar Achuur yiddammarwa asaat muluk Masir tilkassar.
Nichaddid chaʼabi be gudurti ana Allahwa be usmi,yiʼiichu wa yaʼabuduuni. Wa da kalaam Allah.
Ya Lubnaan,aftahe biibaankiwa khalli al‑naar tahrig chadarki hana l‑arz !
Ya chadar al‑sarwi,abku be hizinachaan chadar al‑arz addammarwa l‑kharaab lihig al‑chadar al‑aziimiin dool.Ya chadar al‑balluut hana Baachaan,abku be hizinachaan al‑khaaba al‑dalmawagaʼat fi l‑turaab.
Asmaʼo !Al‑ruʼyaan yabku be hizinachaan bakaanhum al‑aziim khirib.Asmaʼo !Al‑diidaan yikirruachaan khaabat al‑Urdun khirbat.
Wa daahu Allah Ilaahi gaal : Sarrih khanam al‑juzur.
Wa l‑yachru al‑khanam dool yadbahoohum wa ma yandamo leehum.Wa l‑yibiiʼuuhum yuguulu :‹ Baarak Allah !Daahuuni khani !› Wa l‑yasraho beehum kula ma induhum leehum mahanna.
Wa ana kulla battaan ma indi ayyi mahanna le sukkaan al‑balad !Wa daahu ana nisallim ayyi naadum fi iid jaarah wa ayyi naadum fi iid malikah.Wa l‑muluuk yakharbu al‑balad wa laakin ana ma ninajji naadum min iidhum ! Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,ana saraht le l‑tujjaar be khanamhum hana l‑juzur.Wa chilt itneen dugul.Al‑awwalaani sammeetah Rida wa l‑taani sammeetah Wihda.Wa khalaas,saraht be l‑khanam.
Wa fi chahar waahid,ana taradt ruʼyaanhum al‑talaata.Wa fi l‑akhiir,ma gidirt nahmal tujjaar al‑khanam.Wa kan leehum humman kula,bakhadooni.
Wa khalaas,ana gult leehum : Battaan ma nasrah leeku.Khalli al‑yumuutu,yumuutu !Wa l‑yiwadduru,yiwadduru !Wa l‑faddalo kamaan,khalli yilʼaakalo ambeenaathum ! 
Wa ana karabt dugli Rida wa kassartah le nangud al‑muʼaahada al‑sawweetha maʼa kulla l‑chuʼuub.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ana nagadtaha.Wa tujjaar al‑khanam al‑gaaʼidiin yichiifuuni irfo kadar fiʼili da hasab kalaam Allah.
Wa khalaas,ana gult leehum : Kan yaʼajibku,kaffuuni ujurti.Wa kan ma yaʼajibku,khalaas khalluuh. Wa humman wazano leyi ujurti wa kaffooni talaatiin hajar fudda.
Wa Allah gaal leyi : Yichiifu da bas al‑ujra al‑adiil leyi walla ?La !Mustahiil !Azgulha le l‑haddaadi ! Wa ana chilt al‑talaatiin hajar fudda wa zagaltuhum le l‑haddaadi al‑fi beet Allah.
Wa baʼad da,kassart dugli al‑taani Wihda le nangud al‑alaakha ambeen Bani Yahuuza wa Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa Allah gaal leyi : Amchi battaan wa sawwi nafsak misil raaʼi mukhaffal.
Daahu ana nukhutt raaʼi fi l‑balad di.Al‑khanamaay al‑muwaddire,hu ma lammaah beeha.Wa l‑tiwaddir kula,hu ma yifattichha.Wa l‑tinkasir kula,hu ma yiʼaalijha.Wa l‑aafe kula,hu ma yisarrihha.Wa laakin hu yaakul al‑khanam al‑sumaan wa yigattiʼ dalaafeehum.
Al‑azaab le l‑raaʼi al‑ma adiilal‑yikhalli al‑khanam !Khalli al‑seef yadrub iidahwa yigidd eenah al‑zeene !Khalli iidah taybaswa eenah al‑zeene tumuut ! 
Daahu al‑muhaakama al‑kallam beeha Allah fi chaan Bani Israaʼiil.Wa da kalaam Allah al‑falla al‑samaawaat wa assas al‑ard wa khalag al‑ruuh fi daakhal al‑insaan.Wa hu gaal :
 Daahu ana nisawwi Madiinat al‑Khudus misil kaas al‑yisakkir kulla l‑chuʼuub al‑mujaawiriinha.Wa naas Yahuuza kula yabga leehum misil da,wakit yihaasuru Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ana nukhutt Madiinat al‑Khudus giddaam kulla l‑chuʼuub misil hajar kabiir al‑abadan ma yagdaro yarfaʼooh.Wa ayyi naadum al‑yihaawil yarfaʼah,yinjarih.Wa kulla umam al‑ard yilimmu wa yugummu didd al‑hajar da.
 Wa fi l‑yoom da,kulla l‑kheel niliff raashum wa nadrub agul rukkaabhum.Wa laakin le Bani Yahuuza,nukhutt eeni fooghum wa le kulla kheel al‑chuʼuub kamaan,nadrubhum be l‑ama.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa chuyuukh Yahuuza yuguulu fi nufuushum :‹ Sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus ligo gudrithum min Allah al‑Gaadir Ilaahhum. ›
 Wa fi l‑yoom da,ana nisawwi chuyuukh Yahuuza misil kaanuun malaan naar tihit koom hana hatab aw misil naar al‑mugabbide fi rubta hana ganaadiil.Wa humman yaakulu zeene wa isra kulla l‑chuʼuub al‑mujaawiriinhum.Wa laakin sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus yaskunu fi madiinithum.
Wa ana Allah ninajji fi l‑awwal aayilaat Bani Yahuuza.Wa be da,charaf zurriiyit Dawuud wa sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus ma yabga ziyaada min charaf aayilaat Bani Yahuuza.
 Wa fi l‑yoom da,ana Allah nahmi sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus hatta al‑daʼiif minhum kula yabga chadiid misil al‑malik Dawuud.Wa zurriiyit Dawuud yalgo ihtiraam misli ana al‑Rabb wa misil malak Allah al‑maachi giddaamhum.
 Wa fi l‑yoom da,ana nichiil niiye achaan nidammir kulla l‑umam al‑yaju yahjumu Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa ninazzil fi zurriiyit Dawuud wa fi sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus ruuh hana rahma wa duʼa.Wa yichiifu aleyi ana al‑humman taʼanooni be amalhum al‑cheen al‑misil harba.Humman yahzano leyah misil hizin al‑wileed al‑wahiid wa yabku leyah misil baki le l‑wileed al‑bikir.
 Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑hizin yabga chadiid fi Madiinat al‑Khudus misil hizin Haddaad Rimmuun fi kadaadit Magiddu.
Wa l‑balad tahzan,ayyi khachum beet wiheedah.Khachum beet zurriiyit Dawuud yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.Khachum beet zurriiyit Naataan yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.
Khachum beet zurriiyit Laawi yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.Khachum beet Chimʼi yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin.
Wa kulla khuchuum buyuut al‑aakhariin yahzano wiheedhumwa awiinhum wiheedhin. 
 Wa fi l‑yoom da,tamrug een almi al‑tikhassil zurriiyit Dawuud wa sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudus min zunuubhum wa najaasithum. 
Wa daahu kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir : Fi l‑yoom da,ana nuguchch min al‑balad asaame al‑asnaam wa battaan ma yihajju beehum abadan.Wa natrud min al‑balad al‑anbiya al‑yihajju be khachch wa ruuh al‑munajjasa.
Wa kan naadum gaaʼid yitnabbaʼ be khachch,khalaas abuuh wa ammah al‑wildooh yuguulu leyah :‹ Waajib tumuut achaan inta gaaʼid tuguul kalaam khachch be usum Allah.› Wa khalaas,abuuh wa ammah al‑wildooh,yatʼanooh wakit hu gaaʼid yitnabbaʼ.
 Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑eeb yakrub ayyi nabi be sabab ruʼyitah wakit hu gaaʼid yitnabbaʼ.Wa be da,battaan ma yalbas khalag al‑nabi le yukhuchch al‑naas.
Wa ayyi waahid yuguul :‹ Ana ma nabi,ana harraati bas.Achaan charooni misil abid wakit ana sabi. ›
Wa laakin yuguulu leyah :‹ Chunu juruuh al‑nabi al‑fi sadrak dool ?› Wa hu yurudd :‹ Ana ligiit al‑juruuh dool fi beet rufgaani bas.› 
Daahu kalaam Allah al‑Gaadir : Ya seef,gumm didd raaʼiiyi.Aywa,gumm didd gariibi !Adrub al‑raaʼi wa l‑khanam yichittuwa nadrub hatta al‑dugaag kula.
Wa khalaas fi kulla l‑balad,al‑itneen tilit min al‑naasyinfaslu wa yumuutuwa laakin al‑tilit al‑waahidyifaddil.Wa da kalaam Allah.
Wa l‑tilit al‑faddal da,nukhuttah fi l‑naarwa nisaffiih misil yisaffu al‑fuddawa nakchifah misil yakchufu al‑dahab.Wa humman yinaadu usmiwa ana nurudd leehum.Wa ana nuguul leehum :‹ Intu tabgo chaʼabi. ›Wa humman yuguulu :‹ Allah bas yabga Ilaahna.› 
Daahu yoom Allah yaji fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Yanhabooha wa yilgaasamo al‑khaniime fi lubbaha
Ana nilimm kulla l‑umam fi Madiinat al‑Khudus le yihaarubuuha.Wa yichiilu al‑madiina wa yanhabo al‑buyuut wa yarugdu maʼa l‑awiin be gu.Wa nuss sukkaan al‑madiina yiwadduuhum fi l‑khurba wa laakin al‑faddalo kamaan yikhalluuhum fi l‑madiina.
Wa baʼad da,Allah yugumm wa yihaarib al‑umam dool misil hu haarab fi ayyaam al‑harib al‑faato.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,Allah yagiif fi jabal al‑Zaytuun sabaah le Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa jabal al‑Zaytuun yinchagga min usut min al‑sabaah lahaddi l‑kharib wa yabga waadi kabiir ziyaada.Wa nuss al‑jabal yikaskis ale l‑munchaakh wa nussah al‑aakhar yikaskis ale l‑wati.
Wa khalaas,intu tiʼarrudu be l‑waadi ambeenaat al‑jibaal dool achaan al‑waadi yiwassil lahaddi Asal.Wa tiʼarrudu misil arradtu min al‑zilzaal fi ayyaam hukum Uzziiya malik mamlakat Yahuuza.Wa baʼad da,Allah Ilaahi yaji maʼa kulla saalihiinah.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,ma fi nuur wa la barid wa la talaj.
Wa da yukuun yoom waahid wa Allah bas yaʼarif al‑yoom da.Wa foogah ma fi nahaar wa la leel.Fi l‑makhrib kula,al‑deyy yidawwi.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,almi saafi yajri min Madiinat al‑Khudus.Nussah yajri ale l‑bahar al‑Mayyit fi l‑sabaah wa nussah yajri ale l‑bahar al‑Abyad fi l‑kharib.Wa yajri misil da fi wakt al‑khariif wa l‑chite.
Wa khalaas,Allah yiwassif kadar hu malik foog kulla l‑ard.Wa fi l‑yoom da,al‑naas yaʼarfu kadar Allah hu waahid wa usmah kula waahid bas.
Wa kulla l‑balad tikhayyir wa tabga mustawiye wa khadra min Gabaʼ fi l‑munchaakh lahaddi Rimmuun junuub Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa laakin Madiinat al‑Khudus tukuun fi l‑aali fi bakaanha.Wa huduudha yamchu min baab Banyaamiin lahaddi l‑baab al‑Gadiim wa lahaddi baab al‑Rukun.Wa yamchu min beet al‑muraakhaba hana Hananiil lahaddi assaaraat al‑inab hana l‑malik.
Wa yaskunuuha wa abadan ma yikhassusuuha le l‑damaar battaan.Wa Madiinat al‑Khudus tagood be amaan.
Wa daahu al‑waba al‑Allah yadrub beyah kulla l‑chuʼuub al‑haarabo Madiinat al‑Khudus.Hu yiʼaffin jisimhum wakit humman waagfiin be tuulhum.Wa uyuunhum yiʼaffunu fi lubb nugaarhum wa lisneehum yiʼaffunu fi lubb khuchuumhum.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,Allah yibarjil al‑chuʼuub dool marra waahid.Ayyi waahid yakrub akhuuh wa yiddaawaso ambeenaathum.
Wa Bani Yahuuza kula yihaarubu fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa khalaas,yilimmu be katara al‑khuna hana kulla l‑umam al‑mujaawiriinhum misil al‑dahab wa l‑fudda wa l‑khulgaan.
Wa nafs al‑waba da yadrub hatta l‑kheel wa l‑bikhaal wa l‑jumaal wa l‑hamiir wa kulla l‑bahaayim al‑gaaʼidiin fi muʼaskar al‑adu.
Wa khalaas,kulla l‑naas al‑faddalo hayyiin min al‑umam al‑gammo didd Madiinat al‑Khudus yamchu ayyi sana yasjudu giddaam al‑malik wa hu Allah al‑Gaadir.Wa yiʼayyudu iid al‑Lagaadiib.
Wa laakin gabaayil al‑ard al‑ma yamchu Madiinat al‑Khudus le yasjudu giddaam al‑malik wa hu Allah al‑Gaadir,al‑matar ma yanzil leehum.
Wa kan gabaayil Masir ma yamchu,khalaas Allah yadrubhum be nafs al‑waba al‑darab beyah al‑umam al‑abo ma yamchu yiʼayyudu iid al‑Lagaadiib.
Wa da bas yabga al‑ikhaab le Masir wa le kulla l‑umam al‑abo ma yamchu yiʼayyudu iid al‑Lagaadiib.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,jursaan al‑kheel kula yaktubu fooghum : Khaass le Allah. Wa hatta al‑buraam al‑fi beet Allah kula yabgo mukhassasiin misil al‑kiisaan al‑yuruchchu beehum damm al‑dahaaya al‑yukhuttuuhum giddaam al‑madbah.
Wa ayyi burma fi Madiinat al‑Khudus wa balad Yahuuza tabga mukhassasa le Allah al‑Gaadir.Wa l‑naas al‑yaju yigaddumu dahaaya,yagdaro yirakkubu dahaayaahum fi ayyi waahide min al‑buraam dool.Wa fi l‑yoom da,battaan ma fi tujjaar fi lubb beet Allah al‑Gaadir.
Di hi al‑muhaakama al‑kallam beeha Allah le Bani Israaʼiil be waasitat al‑nabi Malaakhi.
Allah gaal : Ana nihibbuku. Wa laakin intu gultu : Kikkeef naʼarfu kadar inta tihibbina ? Wa daahu kalaam Allah : Sahiih,Isuu akhu jidduku Yaakhuub.Wa laakin ana habbeet Yaakhuub
wa abeet Isuu.Ana sallamt jibaal zurriiyit Isuu le l‑kharaab wa ard warasatah sawweetha kadaade le l‑baʼaachiim. 
Akuun zurriiytah naas Adoom yuguulu : Sahiih,baladna addammarat wa laakin aniina nigabbulu nabnuuha battaan. Daahu Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Khalli humman yabnuuha !Ana nidammirha battaan.Wa yisammuuha balad al‑Fasaala wa chaʼabha yisammuuhum al‑Chaʼab al‑Allah Yakhdab aleehum Daayman.
Wa intu tichiifu be uyuunku wa tuguulu :‹ Allah kabiir wa yahkim lahaddi khaadi min huduud balad Israaʼiil kula.› 
 Al‑walad yikarrim abuuhwa l‑abid yihtarim siidah.Wa kan ana abu,ween al‑karam al‑waajib leyi ?Wa kan ana siid,ween al‑ihtiraam al‑waajib leyi ?Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.Ya rujaal al‑diin,intu hagartu usmi.Wa be da kula,intu gultu :‹ Kikkeef hagarna usmak ? ›
Wa gaddamtu akil nijis fi madbahi.Wa be da kula,intu gultu :‹ Kikkeef aniina najjasnaah ? ›Wa da achaan madbahi ana Allah,jaʼaltuuh mahguur.
Wa kan bahiime amyaanetigaddumuuha dahiiye,da ma fasil walla ?Wa kan bahiime arja aw mardaanetigaddumuuha dahiiye,da ma fasil walla ?Khalaas,gaddumuuha le haakimku !Hal hu yarda beeku walla ?Hal hu yakhbalku walla ?Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa hassaʼ da,dawwartu ridaayi ana al‑Rabbachaan narhamku.Wa laakin al‑dahaaya al‑nijsiin dool,intu bas gaddamtuuhum.Wa misil da,ana nakhbalku walla ?Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Akheer tisiddu biibaan beetiachaan ma tigabbudu naar fi madbahile tigaddumu dahaaya bala faayde !Ana ma narda beekuwa ma nakhbal min iideeku ayyi dahiiye. Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
 Min bakaan taluuʼ al‑harraay lahaddi bakaan waguuʼha,usmi kabiir fi ust al‑umam.Wa fi ayyi bakaan,yiharrugu leyi bakhuur wa yijiibu dahiiye taahire achaan usmi kabiir fi ust al‑umam.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa laakin intu ma ahtaramtuuni,wakit jaʼaltu madbahi ana al‑Rabb nijis wa l‑akil al‑foogah kulla mahguur.
Wa battaan intu gultu :‹ Chiifu al‑bachtana di !› Wa hagartuuni ana Allah.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.Wa tijiibu bahaayim al‑saragtuuhum aw uruj aw mardaaniin wa tigaddumuuhum leyi dahaaya.Humman dool nakhbalhum min iideeku walla ? Wa da,Allah bas gaalah.
 Malʼuun al‑khachchaach al‑indah dakar saalim fi doorah wa le yitimm waʼadah,yadbah le l‑Rabb bahiime maʼduura.Ana malik kabiir wa kulla l‑umam yakhaafo minni ! Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
 Wa hassaʼ da,ya rujaal al‑diin,ana nihazzirku.
Wa kan ma tasmaʼooni wa la tizzakkarooni fi guluubku le timajjudu usmi,ana nalʼanku wa najʼal barakaatku laʼana.Aywa,najʼal barakaatku laʼana achaan intu ma karramtuuni fi guluubku.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa daahu nihazzir zurriiyitku wa nadrubku be baʼar fi wujuuhku wa da l‑baʼar hana dahaaya aʼyaadku.Wa yidaffuguuku barra maʼa l‑baʼar da !
 Khalaas,aʼarfu kadar ana hazzartuku le nisabbit muʼaahadati maʼa zurriiyit Laawi.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa muʼaahadati maʼa l‑Laawiyiin,hi hint haya wa salaam.Wa ana anteetha leehum achaan yakhaafo minni.Aywa,humman khaafo minni wa rajafo giddaami.
Wa khuchuumhum kallamo be wasaaya al‑hagg wa lisaanhum ma hajja kalaam fasil.Wa humman macho maʼaayi be l‑salaam wa l‑adaala wa gabbalo naas katiiriin min al‑zanib.
 Wa ayyi raajil diin,waajib lisaanah yahfad al‑maʼrafa wa min khachmah,al‑chaʼab yasmaʼo churuut al‑Tawraat achaan hu rasuul Allah al‑Gaadir.
Wa laakin intu tarraftu min derbi wa waddartu naas katiiriin be taʼliimku.Wa nagadtu muʼaahadati maʼa l‑Laawiyiin.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa khalaas,ana kula nisawwiiku mahguuriin wa makruuhiin giddaam kulla l‑chaʼab achaan intu ma titaabuʼu derbi wa tidangusu al‑chariiʼa. 
Aniina kullina,abuuna ma waahid walla ?Wa Ilaah waahid bas ma khalagaana walla ?Wa maala al‑waahid yukhuun al‑aakhar wa ma nihtarumu muʼaahadat Allah maʼa abbahaatna ?
Bani Yahuuza nagado al‑muʼaahada wa sawwo al‑haraam fi Israaʼiil wa fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.Achaan humman ma ahtaramo al‑bakaan al‑mukhaddas al‑Allah yiriidah wa akhado awiin al‑yaʼabudan ilaahaat aakhariin.
Ayyi naadum al‑yisawwi misil da,Allah yafsulah wa yamurgah min mujtamaʼ zurriiyit Yaakhuub hatta kan hu yigaddim dahaaya le Allah al‑Gaadir kula.
Wa daahu al‑cheyy al‑taani al‑gaaʼidiin tisawwuuh.Be dumuuʼku tamlo madbah Allah.Tabku wa taguntu achaan hu ma gaaʼid yifakkir fi dahaayaaku wa ma yakhbalhum abadan min iideeku.
Wa intu gultu : Maala ma yakhbal dahaayaana ? Wa da achaan Allah chaahid beenak wa been marit chabaabak al‑inta khuntaha.Hi martak al‑muraafgeek wa indak maʼaaha muʼaahada gawiiye.
Ma fi naadum indah agul al‑yisawwi al‑cheyy da.Wa waajib naadum yisawwi chunu ?Yifattich yalda iyaal fi lubb chaʼab al‑Rabb.Angarʼu !Ma tukhuunu awiin chabaabku.
Wa Allah Ilaah Bani Israaʼiil gaal : Ana nakrah al‑talaag.Achaan kan naadum tallag martah da misil sawwa unuf wa mala khalagah be damm.Angarʼu !Ma tisawwu al‑khiyaana. Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa zaʼʼaltu Allah be kalaamku al‑katiir.Wa intu gultu : Kikkeef zaʼʼalnaah be kalaamna ? Wa zaʼʼaltuuh be kalaamku al‑buguul : Ayyi naadum kan yisawwi fasil,da adiil giddaam Allah wa l‑naas al‑misil dool bas Allah yiriidhum ! Wa battaan gultu : Al‑Ilaah al‑yahkim be l‑adaala da gaaʼid yisawwi chunu ? 
Wa Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Daahu nirassil rasuuli wa hu yiʼaddil al‑derib giddaami.Wa tawwaali,al‑Rabb al‑intu gaaʼidiin tifattuchu be acham yadkhul fi beetah al‑mukhaddas.Daahu jaayi rasuul al‑muʼaahada al‑gaaʼidiin tarjooh. 
Yaatu yagdar yahmal yoom jaytah ?Wa yaatu yagdar yagiif be tuulah wakit yibiin ?Achaan hu misil naaral‑tagtaʼ al‑hadiid le yisaffuuhwa hu misil al‑saabuunal‑yikhassil nadiif.
Hu misil al‑sayyaakhial‑yagtaʼ wa yisaffi al‑fudda.Yitahhir al‑Laawiyiinmisil yisaffi al‑fudda wa l‑dahab.Wa humman yabgo hineey Allahwa yigaddumu leyah dahaaya be l‑adaala.
Wa khalaas,Allah yarda be dahaayahana naas balad Yahuuzawa sukkaan Madiinat al‑Khudusmisil fi l‑ayyaam al‑faatowa l‑siniin al‑zamaan.
 Wa ana nigarrib leeku le l‑chariiʼa.Wa tawwaali,nachhad fi l‑sahhaariin wa l‑zannaayiin wa l‑yahalfu be kidib wa l‑yazulmu al‑khaddaam wa l‑armala wa l‑atiim wa l‑yakhto fi l‑ajnabi.Wa humman dool kulluhum ma yakhaafo minni. Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
 Ana Allah ma nikhayyir.Wa be da,intu kula ya zurriiyit Yaakhuub,ma tikammulu.
Min wakit abbahaatku,intu baʼʼadtu min churuuti wa ma tabbagtuuhum.Gabbulu leyi wa ana kula nigabbil leeku. Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.Wa intu gultu : Kikkeef nigabbulu leek ? 
Wa Allah gaal : Hal insaani yagdar yukhuchch al‑Rabb walla ?Wa laakin intu khachcheetuuni wa gultu :‹ Kikkeef aniina khachcheenaak ? › Wa da achaan ma kaffeetu al‑uchuur wa l‑zaka.
Wa be da,intu gaaʼidiin tihit al‑laʼana achaan khachcheetuuni ana,intu kulla l‑umma.
Wa jiibu al‑uchuur tamaamiin fi makhazan beeti achaan akil katiir yinlagi fi l‑beet da.Wa be da,jarrubuuni wa chiifu kikkeef naftah leeku biibaan al‑sama wa ninazzil leeku al‑baraka al‑ma indaha hadd. Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
 Wa fi chaanku,ana nidammir al‑hacharaat wa abadan ma yaakulu intaaj arduku wa jineenaat inabku kula yantu intaajhum.Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa kulla l‑umam yinaaduuku al‑mubaarakiin achaan intu taskunu fi balad al‑farah. Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
Wa Allah gaal : Kalaamku diddi bigi chadiid. Wa laakin intu gultu : Chunu al‑kalaam al‑gulna diddak ? 
Wa intu gultu battaan : Ibaadat al‑Rabb ma indaha faayde.Chunu naksabooh kan nitabbugu wasiiyaatah wa nuruukhu be hizin giddaam Allah al‑Gaadir ?
Wa hassaʼ,aniina ninaadu al‑mustakbiriin bas al‑mubaarakiin.Aywa,al‑yisawwu al‑fasaala yanjaho.Humman jarrabo al‑Rabb wa be da kula,cheyy ma ja leehum. 
Wa fi l‑wakit da,al‑naas al‑yakhaafo min Allah hajjo ambeenaathum.Wa Allah simiʼ kalaamhum adiil.Wa giddaamah,katabo fi kitaab al‑zikra asaame hana l‑naas al‑yakhaafo min Allah wa yikarrumu usmah.
Wa Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Fi l‑yoom al‑nugumm foogah,humman yabgo hineeyi ana halaali.Wa nihinn fooghum misil naadum yihinn fi wileedah al‑yakhdim leyah.
Wa be misil da,tichiifu min jadiid al‑faraga been al‑saalih wa l‑aasi wa been al‑yaʼabud al‑Rabb wa l‑ma yaʼabudah. 
Wa Allah al‑Gaadir gaal : Daahu al‑yoom da jaayihaami misil al‑furun.Wa kulla l‑mustakbiriin wa l‑aasiyiinyabgo misil al‑gechch.Wa l‑yoom al‑jaayi da yahrighumwa la yikhalli leehum irig wa la firiʼ.
Wa laakin leeku intu al‑khaayfiin minni,adaalti tatlaʼ leeku misil al‑harraaywa deyyaha yijiib al‑chifa.Wa intu tamurgu wa tinattutumisil ajjaal marago min zariibithum.
Fi l‑yoom al‑nugumm foogah,intu tifajjukhu al‑aasiyiinwa yabgo misil rumaad tihit rijleeku. Wa da,Allah al‑Gaadir bas gaalah.
 Azzakkaro kitaab al‑Tawraatal‑anteetah le abdi Muusa fi jabal Huuriib.Wa le kulla Bani Israaʼiil,anteethum gawaaniin wa churuut.
 Daahu ana nirassil leeku al‑nabi Iliyaaswa da gubbaal yoom Allah ma yajiwa l‑yoom da aziim wa mukhiif.
Wa hu yijiib al‑salaambeen al‑abbahaat wa iyaalhumwa been al‑iyaal wa abbahaathum.Wa misil da,ma naji nidammir al‑balad. Allah hu al‑Rahmaan wa l‑Rahiim wa wassaf rahmatah le kulla l‑naas be jayyit Isa al‑Masiih (salaamahu aleyna).Wa Allah yihaasib kulla l‑naas wa hu bas al‑yagdar yantiihum al‑naja.Wa l‑hamdulillah,Allah rassal Isa al‑Masiih fi l‑dunya achaan yaftah le l‑naas derib al‑khufraan wa l‑naja.Hu sawwa al‑suluh been al‑muznibiin wa Allah.Wa be l‑Masiih,Allah yantiihum haya abadiiye.Wa fi l‑haya di,al‑naas yadkhulu fi alaakha jadiide maʼa Allah wa yaʼarfu mahabbitah al‑kabiire.Wa l‑kitaab da usmah al‑Ahad al‑Jadiid maʼanaatah al‑muʼaahada al‑jadiide.Wa battaan maʼruuf be Injiil al‑Masiih.Al‑kilme Injiil jaat min al‑lukhkha al‑yuunaaniiye wa maʼanaatha al‑bichaara yaʼni al‑khabar al‑halu.Wa l‑khabar al‑halu al‑fi l‑kitaab da bukhuss al‑rahma al‑Allah rassalaaha fi l‑Masiih le kulla l‑naas.Wa l‑Injiil da hu kalaam Allah.Fi guluub al‑rusul,Allah nazzal al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus achaan yaktubu kalaamah be iznah wa be gudurtah.Wa l‑kitaab da tarjamooh be kalaam arab daariji achaan al‑naas yafhamooh wa yalgo minnah faayde.Tarjamooh min al‑lukhkha al‑asliiye wa hi al‑lukhkha al‑yuunaaniiye.Kan ma fihimnaah,abadan ma nalgo minnah faayde.Wa kan fihimnaah wa ma tabbagnaah,al‑kalaam da yachhad foogna fi yoom al‑Hisaab.Wa Allah yidoor al‑naas yitarjumu kalaamah achaan kulla l‑naas yafhamooh wa yitaabuʼuuh wa yalgo minnah baraka.Allah hu akbar !Al‑Ahad al‑Jadiid indah arbaʼa juzu.Al‑juzu al‑awwal yihajji be taariikh al‑Masiih fi l‑ard wa taʼliimah wa ajaaybah wa mootah fi l‑saliib wa buʼaasah al‑majiid.Al‑juzu da mukawwan min 4 kutub.Al‑kitaab al‑awwal da binaaduuh Kitaab Matta min Injiil al‑Masiih.Wa naas katiiriin yinaaduuh Injiil Matta laakin be l‑sahiih al‑Injiil da ma hana Matta.Hu hana l‑Masiih wa tilmiizah Matta katab al‑kitaab bas be izin Allah wa be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa baʼad al‑kitaab da,talgo al‑kutub al‑kataboohum Markhus wa Luukha wa Yuuhanna.Wa l‑juzu al‑taani usmah kitaab Aʼmaal al‑Rusul.Wa l‑rusul dool,humman al‑rujaal al‑Isa al‑Masiih jaʼalaahum rusulah wa rassalaahum achaan yiballukhu al‑bichaara le kulla l‑umam.Wa kitaab Aʼmaal al‑Rusul da yiʼooriina kikkeef humman bado khidmithum wa kikkeef al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus gaaʼid maʼaahum wa yakhdim beehum.Wa l‑juzu al‑taalit indah 21 jawaab.Wa l‑kalaam al‑gaaʼid fi lubbuhum,hu al‑taʼliim al‑rassalooh rusul al‑Masiih le l‑muʼminiin.Al‑rusul katabo al‑jawaabaat dool be izin Allah wa be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa l‑rusul dool humman Buulus wa Yaakhuub wa Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa Yahuuza.Wa be rahmat Allah,ayyi muʼmin yalga faayde kabiire min al‑jawaabaat dool.Wa l‑juzu al‑raabiʼ wa l‑akhiir hana l‑Ahad al‑Jadiid,usmah kitaab al‑Ruʼya.Wa di l‑ruʼya al‑Allah wassafha le l‑rasuul Yuuhanna achaan yaktibha.Wa kitaab al‑Ruʼya da yihajji katiir be haal al‑muʼminiin wa taʼabhum fi kumaalit al‑dunya.Wa naas katiiriin yasʼalo wa yuguulu : Isa al‑Masiih da,hu yaatu ?Hal al‑Injiil al‑Allah antaana yuguul Isa al‑Masiih hu Ibn Allah ? Wa l‑suʼaal da muhimm.Isa al‑Masiih indah asaame katiiriin wa ayyi usum indah maʼana muhimm le l‑naas wa kulla l‑asaame dool ma induhum eeb.Wa l‑Injiil yuguul Isa hu Ibn Ibraahiim wa Ibn Dawuud wa Ibn al‑Insaan wa Ibn Allah.Wa battaan usmah Kalimat Allah wa Hamal Allah wa Raajil al‑Diin al‑Kabiir wa Nuur al‑Aalam wa l‑Munajji wa indah asaame aakhariin kula.Be kalaam ibraani lukhkhat al‑Yahuud,usum Isa da Yachuuʼ wa maʼanaatah Allah yinajji.Wa kan naadum yidoor yafham maʼana al‑asaame dool wa yaʼarif al‑Masiih hu yaatu,khalli yagri al‑Injiil be galib faatih.Wa Allah yarhamah wa yiwassifah al‑hagg wa yiwassifah kikkeef yalga al‑baraka al‑Allah yantiiha be l‑Masiih.Aamiin.Al‑hamdulillah,al‑Injiil be l‑lukhkha al‑asliiye mawjuud lahaddi al‑yoom.Wa be da,al‑naas yagdaro yagru al‑kalaam al‑asli wa yitarjumuuh be lukhkhaathum.Wa l‑suura di tiwassif nuskha min kitaab 2 Kuruntus be l‑lukhkha al‑asliiye hana l‑Ahad al‑Jadiid yaʼni be kalaam yuunaani.Wa l‑nuskha di gadiime,indaha hawaale 200 sana baʼad waaluudit Isa al‑Masiih.
Daahu gurma hana juduud Isa al‑Masiih ibn Dawuud ibn Ibraahiim.
