 Haay !Ya Isa min al‑Naasira,tidoor minnina chunu ?Jiit hini achaan tahlikna walla ?Ana naʼarfak.Inta bas al‑Khudduus al‑Allah rassalah. 
Laakin Isa kachcha leyah wa gaal : Askut wa amrug minnah ! Wa l‑cheetaan rama al‑naadum fi ust al‑naas.Wa khalaas marag minnah.Wa l‑naadum da,ma ligi ayyi wajaʼ.
Wa kulla l‑naas alʼajjabo bilheen wa gaalo ambeenaathum : Al‑muʼallim da kalaamah da kikkeef ?Indah sulta wa gudra lahaddi yaamur al‑chawaatiin wa yamurgu min al‑muchootiniin ! 
Wa khabarah chattat fi kulla l‑daar di.
Wa Isa marag min beet al‑sala wa macha fi beet Simʼaan.Wa nasiibtah le Simʼaan indaha wirde chadiide.Wa saʼalo Isa le yachfiiha.
Wa hu macha wagaf fi jamb al‑bakaan al‑hi raagde foogah wa kachcha le l‑wirde wa l‑wirde khallatha.Wa tawwaali hi gammat wa dayyafathum.
Wa fi l‑makhrib,kulla l‑naas al‑induhum naadum mardaan kan indah ayyi marad,jaabooh le Isa.Wa hu khatta iidah foog ayyi mardaan wa chafaah.
Wa chawaatiin marago min naas katiiriin wa aato wa gaalo : Inta Ibn Allah. Laakin hu kachcha leehum wa daharaahum ma yihajju achaan humman yaʼarfu kadar hu al‑Masiih.
Wa wakit al‑wata asbahat,hu marag wa macha fi bakaan ma indah naas.Wa l‑naas fattachooh wa jo leyah wa dawwaro yadharooh ma yamchi yikhalliihum.
Laakin hu gaal leehum : Waajib niballikh bichaarat mamlakat Allah fi hillaal aakhariin kula.Fi chaan da bas Allah rassalaani. 
Wa hu raayikh fi daar al‑Yahuudiiya wa gaaʼid yibachchir al‑naas fi buyuut al‑sala.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaaʼid jamb bahar al‑Jaliil.Wa l‑naas al‑yidooru yasmaʼo kalaam Allah bigo katiiriin marra waahid lahaddi gaaʼidiin yaʼasuruuh.
Wa chaaf maraakib itneen gaaʼidiin fi khachum al‑bahar.Al‑hawwaatiin nazalo minhum le yikhassulu churukkaahum.
Wa Isa rikib fi markaba waahide wa hi hana Simʼaan.Wa talab min Simʼaan yilizzaha chiyya min khachum al‑bahar.Wa gaʼad tihit fi l‑markaba wa bada yiʼallim al‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin fi khachum al‑bahar.
Wa wakit Isa kammal kalaamah,hu hajja le Simʼaan wa gaal : Waddi al‑markaba fi ust al‑bahar wa oori naasak yazgulu al‑charak fi l‑almi le yakurbu huut. 
Wa Simʼaan radda leyah wa gaal : Ya Sayyidna,tiʼibna tuul al‑leel wa ma karabna cheyy.Laakin nazgul al‑charak kan inta tidoorah. 
Wa wakit zagalo charakhum,karabo huut katiir bilheen lahaddi l‑charak yidoor yingatiʼ min al‑tagala.
Wa sawwo ichaara le rufgaanhum al‑fi l‑markaba al‑aakhara achaan yiʼaawunuuhum.Wa jo malo al‑maraakib al‑itneen lahaddi l‑maraakib yidooru yakhtusu.
Wa wakit Simʼaan Butrus chaaf al‑cheyy al‑bigi da,hu sajad giddaam rijileen Isa wa gaal : Ya Rabb,kiss minni baʼiid !Achaan ana naadum muznib. 
Wa hajja misil da achaan hu wa kulla jamaaʼtah fi l‑markaba alʼajjabo bilheen min al‑huut al‑katiir al‑karabooh.
Wa rufgaanah le Simʼaan,Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna awlaad Zabadi,kula alʼajjabo maʼaayah.Wa Isa gaal le Simʼaan : Ma takhaaf.Awwal inta gaaʼid takrub al‑huut wa laakin min al‑yoom takrub al‑naas le tijiibhum leyi. 
Wa min gabbalo maraakibhum fi khachum al‑bahar,humman khallo kulla cheyy wa gammo taabaʼo Isa.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaaʼid fi hille waahide wa raajil waahid indah jidaam ja leyah.Wa l‑raajil da indah jidaamcheen.Wa wakit chaaf Isa,hu sajad giddaamah wa gaal : Ya sayyidna,kan tidoor tachfiini akiid inta tagdar wa ana nabga taahir. 
Wa Isa madda iidah wa limis al‑raajil al‑indah jidaam wa gaal : Nidoor nachfiik.Abga taahir. Wa tawwaali bigi taahir min al‑jidaam.
Wa Isa amarah wa gaal leyah : Ma tiʼoori naadum.Amchi wassif nafsak le raajil al‑diin wa gaddim dahiiye le Allah misil al‑nabi Muusa amaraana beeha.Wa misil da,al‑naas yaʼarfu kadar inta ligiit al‑aafe wa bigiit taahir. 
Laakin be da,khabarah chattat be ziyaada fi l‑naas.Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid laammiin foogah achaan yidooru yasmaʼo kalaamah wa hu yachfi amraadhum.
Laakin Isa gamma wiheedah misil fi aadtah wa macha fi l‑khala achaan yisalli.
Wa yoom aakhar,Isa gaaʼid yiʼallim al‑naas.Wa fi l‑bakaan da,fi naas katiiriin gaaʼidiin maʼaayah min tariigat al‑Fariiziiya wa min al‑muʼallimiin fi l‑Tawraat.Wa humman jo min ayyi hille al‑fi daar al‑Jaliil wa l‑Yahuudiiya wa min Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa gudrat Allah gaaʼide foogah achaan yachfi al‑mardaaniin.
Wa rujaal waahidiin jo wa humman chaayliin naadum mukarsah fi furaachah.Wa dawwaro yadkhulu beyah daakhal wa yukhuttuuh giddaam Isa.
Laakin ma irfo kikkeef yidakhkhulu al‑naadum da le Isa,be sabab al‑naas al‑katiiriin al‑saddo leehum al‑derib.Wa achaan da,rikbo fi raas al‑beet wa gaddooh be foog.Wa dallo al‑mukarsah be furaachah fi ust al‑naas wa khattooh giddaam Isa.
Wakit Isa chaaf iimaanhum,hajja le l‑raajil al‑mukarsah wa gaal : Ya akhuuyi,zunuubak ankhafaro. 
Wa l‑ulama wa l‑Fariiziyiin bado yihajju fi guluubhum wa yuguulu : Haay !Da yaatu al‑gaaʼid yihajji be kalaam kufur da ?Al‑insaan ma yagdar yakhfir zunuub al‑insaan,illa Allah ! 
Wa Isa irif al‑kalaam al‑fi guluubhum.Wa radda leehum wa gaal : Maala tifakkuru fi guluubku ?
Weenu al‑hayyin nuguulah ?Nuguul :‹ Zunuubak ankhafaro ›,walla nuguul :‹ Gumm wa ruukh › ?
Wa laakin nidoor intu taʼarfu kadar ana,Ibn al‑Insaan,indi sulta fi l‑ard achaan nakhfir le l‑naas zunuubhum. Wa gaal le l‑mukarsah : Nuguul leek,gumm !Chiil furaachak wa amchi beetak ! 
Wa tawwaali al‑mukarsah gamma giddaamhum wa chaal furaachah al‑raagid foogah wa macha beetah.Wa fi l‑derib,hu gaaʼid yachkur Allah.
Wa kulluhum alʼajjabo marra waahid wa gammo yachkuru Allah.Wa l‑khoof karabaahum wa gaalo : Al‑yoom chifna cheyy ajiib ! 
Wa baʼad da,Isa marag.Wa chaaf naadum waahid usmah Laawi al‑yilimm al‑daraayib.Wa gaaʼid yakhdim fi maktab al‑daraayib.Wa Isa gaal leyah : Taʼaal taabiʼni. 
Wa khalaas Laawi khalla kulla cheyy wa gamma taabaʼah.
Wa Laawi sawwa leyah aazuuma kabiire fi beetah.Wa fi naas katiiriin al‑yilimmu al‑daraayib wa naas aakhariin jo wa gaaʼidiin yaakulu maʼaayah.
Wa l‑Fariiziyiin wa ulamaahum harajo talaamiiz Isa wa gaalo : Maala taakulu wa tacharbo maʼa naas al‑daraayib wa l‑muznibiin ? 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Al‑naas al‑taybiin ma hawjaaniin daktoor,illa l‑mardaaniin bas.
Ana ma jiit achaan ninaadi al‑saalihiin,laakin jiit le ninaadi al‑muznibiin le l‑tooba. 
Wa gaalo leyah : Talaamiiz Yahya wa talaamiiz al‑Fariiziyiin yusuumu wa yisallu katiir.Laakin talaamiizak inta gaaʼidiin yaakulu wa yacharbo. 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Kan naas gaaʼidiin fi iris wa l‑ariis maʼaahum,tidooru humman yusuumu walla ?
Wa laakin yoom waahid yaji,al‑ariis yichiiluuh minhum wa khalaas fi l‑wakit daak,yusuumu. 
Wa battaan hu hajja leehum be masal wa gaal : Ma fi naadum al‑yachrut gitʼe min khalag jadiid achaan yargaʼ beeha khalag gadiim.Achaan kan yisawwi misil da,hu yitallif al‑khalag al‑jadiid wa l‑gitʼe al‑chaalaaha min al‑jadiid ma tiwaafig maʼa l‑gadiim.
 Wa ma fi naadum yusubb khamar jadiid fi girbe gadiime.Kan yisawwi misil da,al‑khamar al‑jadiid yuchugg al‑girbe wa l‑khamar yidaffig wa l‑girbe tatlaf.
Laakin waajib yusubbu khamar jadiid fi girbe jadiide.
Wa baʼad naadum chirib al‑khamar al‑gadiim hu ma yidoor yachrab al‑jadiid,achaan hu yuguul al‑khamar al‑gadiim bas adiil. 
Yoom waahid,Isa raayikh fi ust al‑ziraaʼa wa da yoom al‑sabt.Wa talaamiizah gammo yagtaʼo ganaadiil al‑gameh wa yafurkuuhum fi iideehum wa yaakuluuh.
Laakin Fariiziyiin waahidiin gaalo : Maala intu tisawwu al‑khidme al‑ma halaala fi yoom al‑sabt ? 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Ma gareetu al‑Kitaab walla ?Nisiitu al‑cheyy al‑Dawuud wa jamaaʼtah sawwooh wakit al‑juuʼ sawwaahum walla ?
Hu dakhal fi beet Allah wa akal al‑khubza al‑gaddamooha al‑naas le Allah.Wa da ma halaal le ayyi naadum illa le rujaal al‑diin.Wa Dawuud zaatah akal wa anta minha le jamaaʼtah kula. 
Wa Isa gaal : Ibn al‑Insaan hu Rabb yoom al‑sabt wa ana bas hu. 
Wa fi yoom sabt aakhar,Isa dakhal fi beet al‑sala wa gaaʼid yiʼallim al‑naas.Wa fiyah naadum waahid iidah al‑zeene mayte gaaʼid daakhal.
Wa l‑Fariiziyiin wa l‑ulama khatto baalhum le Isa.Yidooru yaʼarfu kan hu yachfiih fi yoom al‑sabt walla la,achaan yalgo fursa le yukhuttu foogah tuhma.
Laakin hu irif fikirhum.Wa hajja le l‑raajil al‑iidah mayte wa gaal : Gumm foog giddaam al‑naas. Wa l‑raajil gamma wagaf giddaamhum.
Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal : Nasʼalku cheyy waahid.Chunu al‑halaal fi yoom al‑sabt ?Al‑kheer walla l‑charr ?Halaal leena ninajju al‑naas walla nahalkuuhum ? 
Wa Isa allaffat achaan yichiifhum kulluhum fi uyuunhum.Wa hajja le l‑raajil wa gaal : Midd iidak. Wa l‑raajil maddaaha wa khalaas iidah achchaafat.
Laakin al‑Fariiziyiin wa l‑ulama ziʼilo zaʼal chadiid.Wa gammo yichchaawaro ambeenaathum fi l‑cheyy al‑yagdaro yisawwuuh le Isa.
Wa fi l‑wakit da,Isa marag wa talaʼ fi hajar achaan yisalli.Wa tuul al‑leel hu gaaʼid yisalli le Allah.
Wa wakit al‑wata asbahat,hu naada talaamiizah wa azal minhum 12 wa sammaahum rusul.
Wa humman Simʼaan al‑Isa sammaah Butrus wa Andareeyas akhuuh le Simʼaan wa Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna wa Filibbus wa Bartulma
wa Matta wa Tuuma wa Yaakhuub wileed Halfa wa Simʼaan al‑binaaduuh al‑Sawri
wa Yahuuza wileed Yaakhuub wa Yahuuza al‑Iskhariyooti al‑baʼadeen yukhuun Isa.
Wa hu nazal maʼaahum min al‑hajar wa wagaf fi bakaan wasiiʼ.Wa talaamiiz katiiriin gaaʼidiin maʼaayah.Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid jo min kulla daar al‑Yahuudiiya wa min madiinat al‑Khudus wa min al‑hillaal al‑jamb al‑bahar gariib le Suur wa Seeda.
Wa l‑naas dool jo achaan yasmaʼo kalaamah wa hu yachfi amraadhum.Wa l‑naas al‑induhum chawaatiin kula,hu daawaahum.
Wa kulla l‑naas dawwaro yalmasooh achaan al‑gudra al‑tamrug minnah tachfiihum kulluhum.
Wa Isa rafaʼ raasah chaaf talaamiizah wa gaal : Mabruuk leeku intu al‑masaakiinachaan mamlakat Allah hintuku.
Mabruuk leeku intu al‑hassaʼ jiiʼaaniinachaan baʼadeen tachbaʼo.Mabruuk leeku intu al‑tabku min al‑nadaamaachaan baʼadeen tadhako min al‑farah.
Mabruuk leeku intukan al‑naas yakrahookuwa yaabooku wa yiʼayyuruukuwa yitallufu usumku be sababi ana,Ibn al‑Insaan.
Fi l‑yoom daak,anbastu wa nattutu min al‑farhaachaan nuguul leeku ajurku fi l‑sama kabiir bilheen.Ma tanso kadar zamaan juduudhumsawwo nafs al‑cheyy le l‑anbiya al‑faato.
 Laakin al‑azaab yarjaaku intu siyaad al‑maalachaan kulla l‑raaha al‑talgooha ligiituuha khalaas.
Wa l‑azaab yarjaaku intu al‑chabʼaaniinachaan baʼadeen tabgo jiiʼaaniin.Wa l‑azaab yarjaaku intu al‑gaaʼidiin tadhakoachaan baʼadeen tabku wa tahzano min al‑nadaama.
Wa l‑azaab yarjaaku intukan kulla l‑naas yachkuruuku.Ma tanso kadar zamaan al‑naaschakaroohum le l‑kaddaabiin al‑sawwo nufuushum anbiya. 
Wa Isa gaal battaan : Wa laakin ana nuguul leeku intu al‑tasmaʼo kalaami,hibbu aduuku wa sawwu al‑kheer le l‑naas al‑yakrahooku.
Wa baaruku al‑naas al‑yalʼanooku wa asʼalo Allah be l‑kheer fi chaan al‑naas al‑yitaʼʼubuuku.
Kan naadum daggaak fi chidgak al‑waahide,antiih al‑aakhara kula.Wa kan naadum yidoor yichiil jallaabiiytak,khalaas khalli yichiil jawwaaniiytak kula.
Anti le ayyi naadum al‑yasʼal minnak cheyy wa l‑naadum al‑chaal minnak khumaamak ma tasʼalah minnah.
Wa sawwu le l‑naas al‑cheyy al‑intu zaatku tidooru al‑naas yisawwuuh leeku.
 Wa kan tihibbu al‑naas al‑yihibbuuku bas,ween al‑kheer al‑sawweetuuh ?Al‑muznibiin zaathum yihibbu al‑yihibbuuhum.
Wa kan intu tisawwu al‑kheer le l‑naas al‑yisawwu leeku al‑kheer,ween al‑baraka ?Al‑muznibiin yisawwu nafs al‑cheyy.
Wa kan tidayyunu al‑naas al‑induku fooghum achaan le yigabbulu leeku gurusku,ween al‑kheer al‑sawweetuuh ?Al‑muznibiin zaathum yidayyunu akhwaanhum al‑muznibiin al‑yagdaro yikaffuuhum.
 Laakin hibbu udwaanku wa sawwu leehum al‑kheer wa dayyunuuhum wa ma tarjo minhum cheyy wa khalaas talgo ajur kabiir.Wa misil da,tabgo iyaal Allah al‑Aali.Hu yisawwi zeen le l‑naas al‑fasliin al‑ma yachkuruuh.
Arhamo al‑naas misil abuuku Allah rahiim le l‑naas.
 Ma tihaakumu al‑naas achaan Allah ma yihaakimku intu.Ma tajʼalo al‑naas khaatiyiin achaan Allah ma yajʼalku intu khaatiyiin.Saamuhu al‑naas wa Allah yisaamihku.
Antu le l‑naas wa Allah yantiiku.Yantiiku be iid wasiiʼe fi iideeku wa yukuun wazin adiil wa kiyaala lahaddi yidaffig.Allah yikiil leeku be nafs al‑mikyaal al‑intu tikiilu beyah le l‑naas. 
Wa Isa hajja leehum battaan be masal wa gaal : Naadum amyaan yagdar yuguud naadum amyaan walla ?Kulluhum ma yagaʼo fi nugra walla ?
Al‑tilmiiz ma akbar min sayyidah laakin wakit allamah kulla cheyy,al‑tilmiiz yabga misil sayyidah.
Kikkeef tichiif gechchaay fi een akhuuk wa laakin ma tichiif al‑uud al‑kabiir al‑gaaʼid fi eenak inta ?
Walla kikkeef tuguul le akhuuk ‹ Khalliini nisill al‑gechchaay min eenak › wa inta zaatak ma chift al‑uud al‑gaaʼid fi eenak ?Ya munaafikh !Awwal ke sill al‑uud al‑fi eenak wa misil da tichiif adiil wa khalaas tagdar tisill al‑gechchaay al‑fi een akhuuk.
 Ma fi chadara adiile al‑talda iyaal fasliin.Wa battaan ma fi chadara fasle al‑talda iyaal adiiliin.
Achaan al‑naas yaʼarfu ayyi chadara min iyaalha.Ma yalgo iyaal jimmeez fi l‑chadara al‑indaha chook.Wa ma yilaggutu inab min andireesa.
 Al‑galib hu misil makhazan.Wa l‑naadum al‑adiil yudumm kalaam adiil fi galbah wa l‑kalaam al‑yamrug minnah adiil.Wa l‑naadum al‑fasil yudumm kalaam fasil fi galbah wa l‑kalaam al‑yamrug minnah fasil.Achaan al‑cheyy al‑galib al‑naadum malaan beyah,da bas al‑yamrug min khachmah wakit yihajji.
 Kikkeef tinaaduuni :‹ Ya sayyidna,Ya sayyidna › kan ma tisawwu al‑cheyy al‑nuguulah leeku ?
Ayyi naadum al‑yaji leyi wa yasmaʼ kalaami wa yitaabiʼah,ana niʼooriiku be l‑cheyy al‑hu yichaabihah.
Hu misil naadum waahid al‑bana beet.Awwal nakat fi l‑turaab achaan yukhutt asaas al‑beet fi l‑hajar al‑gaaʼid tihit.Wa almi al‑waadi saal wa darab al‑beet wa l‑beet ma anhazza achaan hu mabni adiil.
Wa laakin al‑naadum al‑yasmaʼ kalaami wa ma yitabbigah,hu yabga misil al‑naadum al‑bana beetah fi l‑turaab bala asaas.Wa almi al‑waadi darabah wa ajala ke al‑beet wagaʼ wa tilif marra waahid. 
Wa baʼad Isa gaal kulla l‑kalaam da le l‑naas,hu macha fi hillit Kafar Naahuum.
Wa fi naadum ajnabi hinaak wa hu kabiir askar al‑Roomaaniyiin wa hu indah abid waahid mardaan gariib yumuut.Wa kabiir al‑askar yiriidah le abdah bilheen.
Wa wakit simiʼ khabar hana Isa,hu rassal leyah naas min chuyuukh al‑Yahuud achaan yatulbu minnah yaji yachfi abdah.
Wa macho le Isa wa chahadooh bilheen wa gaalo : Al‑ajnabi da,indah hagg tisawwi leyah al‑cheyy al‑talabah minnak.
Achaan hu yihibb chaʼabna wa bana leena beet al‑sala. 
Wa Isa macha maʼaahum.Wa wakit hu garrab le l‑beet,al‑askari rassal leyah rufgaanah achaan yihajju leyah.Wa gaalo : Ya sayyidna,anjamma ma titaʼʼib nafsak.Ana ma indi hagg le tadkhul fi beeti.
Achaan da bas,ana zaati khijilt wa ma macheet leek.Wa laakin guul kilme waahide bas wa khaddaami yalga al‑aafe.
Achaan ana kula indi kabiir min foog leyi al‑nitabbig amrah.Wa ana kula masʼuul fi naas al‑tihit minni al‑yitabbugu amri.Wa kan nuguul le waahid ‹ Amchi ›,hu yamchi.Wa kan nuguul le naadum aakhar ‹ Taʼaal ›,hu yaji.Wa kan nuguul le abdi ‹ Sawwi ke ›,hu yisawwiih. 
Wa wakit Isa simiʼ kalaamah,hu alʼajjab bilheen wa anlafat le l‑naas al‑jaayiin waraayah wa gaal : Nuguul leeku ma ligiit naadum waahid min Bani Israaʼiil al‑indah iimaan chadiid misil iimaan al‑naadum da ! 
Wa khalaas wakit al‑murassaliin gabbalo fi l‑beet,chaafo al‑abid ligi al‑aafe.
Wa baʼadeen Isa macha le hille waahide usumha Naayin.Wa talaamiizah maʼaayah wa naas katiiriin maachiin waraayah.
Wa wakit garrab le baab al‑hille,hu chaaf naadum mayyit wa l‑naas maachiin yadfunuuh.Wa l‑mayyit hu wileed waahid fi ammah wa hi mara armala.Wa naas katiiriin min al‑hille maachiin maʼaaha.
Wa wakit al‑Rabb Isa chaafaaha,galbah hanna leeha wa gaal : Ma tabki. 
Wa macha le l‑mayyit wa limis al‑barangaal wa l‑naas al‑chaayliinah wagafo.Wa Isa gaal : Ya wileedi,nuguul leek gumm ! 
Wa l‑mayyit gamma wa hajja.Wa Isa antaah le ammah.
Wa l‑khoof dakhal le kulla l‑naas wa humman majjado Allah wa gaalo : Nabi kabiir ja fi usutna !Allah bayyan gudurtah le chaʼabah ! 
Wa fi kulla daar al‑Yahuudiiya wa fi kulla l‑buldaan al‑mujaawiriin,al‑naas simʼo khabar hana l‑cheyy al‑Isa sawwaah.
Wa talaamiiz Yahya macho le sayyidhum wa oorooh be kulla cheyy al‑Isa gaaʼid yisawwiih.
Wa Yahya naada talaamiiz itneen wa rassalaahum le l‑Rabb Isa achaan yuguulu leyah : Inta bas al‑naadum al‑yaji walla waajib narjo naadum aakhar battaan ? 
Wa macho le Isa wa gaalo : Yahya al‑Mukhattis rassalaana achaan nasʼalook ‹ Inta bas al‑naadum al‑yaji walla waajib narjo naadum aakhar battaan ?› 
Wa fi l‑wakit da bas,Isa chafa naas katiiriin min al‑mardaaniin wa l‑taʼbaaniin wa l‑muchootiniin.Wa fattah uyuun amyaaniin katiiriin.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Amchu wa ooru Yahya be kulla cheyy al‑chiftuuh wa simiʼtuuh.Al‑amyaaniin gaaʼidiin yichiifu wa l‑uruj yuruukhu wa l‑induhum jidaam yalgo al‑aafe wa l‑tarchaaniin yasmaʼo wa l‑maytiin yabʼaso wa l‑masaakiin gaaʼidiin yasmaʼo al‑bichaara.
Wa mabruuk le l‑naadum al‑ma yikhalli iimaanah beyi. 
Wa wakit murassaliin Yahya maachiin,Isa bada yihajji fi Yahya le l‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin maʼaayah wa gaal : Wakit Yahya gaaʼid fi l‑kadaade,intu maragtu leyah.Wa dawwartu tichiifu chunu ?Dawwartu tichiifu ageegaay bas al‑riih tihizzaha walla ?
Kan ma ke,dawwartu tichiifu chunu ?Naadum laabis khulgaan samhiin walla ?La.Achaan al‑naas al‑laabsiin khulgaan samhiin wa l‑aaychiin fi bakaan halu gaaʼidiin fi gusuur al‑muluuk.
Zeen.Maragtu achaan tichiifu chunu ?Achaan tichiifu nabi ?Aywa,wa nuguul leeku chiftu naadum akbar min nabi.
Da bas hu al‑be sababah al‑Kitaab yuguul :﴾‍Daahu nirassil rasuuli giddaamak wa hu yiʼaddil leek al‑derib.‍﴿
Wa nuguul leeku ma fi naadum mawluud min mara akbar min Yahya al‑Mukhattis.Wa laakin al‑naadum al‑sakhayyar fi mamlakat Allah akbar minnah.
 Wa kulla l‑naas simʼo kalaam Yahya wa maʼaahum naas al‑jamaarik kula.Wa taabo min zunuubhum wa khallo Yahya yikhattishum wa misil da,akkado kadar fikir Allah adiil.
Wa laakin al‑Fariiziyiin wa ulama al‑Tawraat abo ma khallo Yahya yikhattishum.Wa be misil da,ma khiblo al‑niiye al‑Allah indah leehum.
 Wa nuguul chunu fi l‑naas hana l‑wakit al‑haali da ?Bichaabuhu chunu ?Humman misil iyaal dugaag laammiin fi l‑door wa yinaadu rufgaanhum wa yuguulu :
‹ Aniina darabna leeku al‑suffaara laakin intu ma liʼibtu.Aniina khanneena khine hana l‑moot laakin intu ma bakeetu. ›
Achaan Yahya al‑Mukhattis ja leeku wa hu ma yaakul akil wa ma bachrab khamar wa gultu hu muchootin.
Wa baʼadeen ana,Ibn al‑Insaan,jiit leeku wa ana naakul wa nachrab wa tuguulu :‹ Hu akkaal wa sakkaari wa bigi rafiig le naas al‑jamaarik wa l‑muznibiin. ›
Laakin hikmat Allah al‑sahiihe tinchaaf fi amal kulla l‑naas al‑yitaabuʼuuha. 
Wa naadum waahid min al‑Fariiziyiin azam Isa yaakul maʼaayah.Wa Isa dakhal fi beet al‑Fariizi wa antaka.
Wa fi mara waahide muznibe maʼruufa fi l‑hille.Wa wakit hi simʼat kadar Isa azamooh fi beet al‑Fariizi,hi gammat chaalat maaʼuun hana hajar malaan itir wa machat leyah.
Wa wagafat wara Isa jamb rijileenah.Wa hi gaaʼide tabki wa badat tibill rijileenah be dumuuʼha wa tuguchchuhum be chaʼarha.Wa gaaʼide tihibb rijileenah wa tamsah fooghum al‑itir.
Wa l‑Fariizi al‑azamah fi beetah chaaf al‑cheyy al‑hi gaaʼide tisawwiih wa fi galbah gaal :Kan sahiih al‑naadum da nabi,akiid hu yaʼarif al‑mara al‑gaaʼide tilammisah di yaati wa yaʼarif haalha al‑cheene achaan hi muznibe.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Ya Simʼaan.Nidoor nuguul leek kalaam waahid. Wa l‑Fariizi radda leyah wa gaal : Naʼam,ya muʼallim.Alfaddal.Hajji ! 
Wa Isa gaal : Yoom min al‑ayyaam,fi naadum waahid al‑yidayyin al‑naas wa indah deen foog naaseen.Wa l‑waahid deenah 500 diinaar wa l‑taani deenah 50 diinaar.
Ma gidro yikaffuuh leyah.Wa khalaas hu saamahaahum marra waahid.Wa nasʼalak yaatu min al‑naaseen dool yihibbah be ziyaada ? 
Wa Simʼaan radda leyah wa gaal : Fi fikri ana,nuguul al‑naadum al‑saamaho leyah al‑deen al‑katiir yihibbah be ziyaada. Wa Isa gaal : Fikrak sahiih. 
Wa Isa anlafat le l‑mara wa hajja le Simʼaan wa gaal : Al‑mara di chiftaha walla ?Ana dakhalt fi beetak wa inta ma anteetni almi achaan nikhassil rijileeni laakin hi ballat rijileeni be dumuuʼha wa gachchathum be chaʼarha.
Wa inta ma sallamtini be hubb wa laakin min ana dakhalt fi beetak hi gaaʼide tihibb rijileeni.
Wa inta ma anteetni dihin achaan namsah beyah raasi laakin hi masahat itir fi rijileeni.
Wa nuguul leek,da yiwassif kadar zunuubha al‑katiiriin saamahoohum leeha.Wa achaan da,hi tihibb katiir.Laakin al‑naadum al‑saamaho leyah chiyya,yihibb chiyya. 
Wa Isa gaal leeha : Akiid zunuubki ankhafaro. 
Wa l‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin yaakulu maʼaayah gammo yuguulu ambeenaathum : Haay !Da yaatu al‑yisaamih al‑muznibiin  ?
Wa Isa hajja le l‑mara battaan wa gaal : Be sabab iimaanki nijiiti.Amchi be salaam. 
Wa baʼad da,Isa gamma yuruukh fi l‑mudun wa l‑hillaal.Wa gaaʼid yiballikh le l‑naas be bichaarat mamlakat Allah.Wa l‑rusul al‑atnaachar maachiin maʼaayah.
Wa maʼaayah fi awiin al‑Isa chafaahin.Waahidaat awwal mardaanaat wa waahidaat awwal muchootinaat misil Mariyam al‑Magdaliiye al‑tarad minha sabʼa chawaatiin
wa Jaana marit Khuuza wakiil hana Hiruudus al‑muhaafiz wa Suuzaana wa awiin aakharaat katiiraat.Wa l‑awiin deel gaaʼidaat yisaaʼidan jamaaʼat Isa be maalhin halaalhin.
Wa naas katiiriin marra waahid jaayiin leyah min ayyi hille wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal :
 Yoom min al‑ayyaam,fi harraati waahid marag macha fi l‑zereʼ achaan yiteerib.Wa wakit hu gaaʼid yichattit teeraabah,teeraab waahid wagaʼ fi l‑derib.Wa l‑naas fajjakhooh wa tuyuur al‑sama jo akalooh.
Wa teeraab aakhar wagaʼ fi bakaan hajar wa l‑bizre yibsat achaan ma ligat almi.
Wa teeraab aakhar wagaʼ fi ust al‑chook wa l‑bizre gammat sawa maʼa l‑chook wa l‑chook khanagaaha.
Wa teeraab aakhar wagaʼ fi turaab adiil wa l‑bizre gammat wa wildat iyaal katiir.Wa kulli ganduul indah 100 habba. Wa wakit gaal al‑kalaam da khalaas,hu naada al‑jamaaʼa wa gaal : Ayyi naadum al‑indah adaan le l‑samaʼ,khalli yasmaʼ ! 
Wa talaamiizah saʼalooh min maʼana hana l‑masal da.
Wa Isa gaal : Allah antaaku maʼrafat sirr mamlakat Allah laakin nihajji le l‑naas al‑aakhariin be amsaal.Wa be misil da,induhum uyuun wa laakin ma yichiifu wa yasmaʼo al‑kalaam wa laakin ma yafhamooh.
 Wa nifassir leeku al‑masal.Al‑teeraab yimassil kalaam Allah.
Wa l‑teeraab al‑wagaʼ fi l‑derib yimassil al‑naas al‑yasmaʼo kalaam Allah laakin Ibliis yaji yichiilah min guluubhum achaan ma yiʼaamunu wa yanjo.
Wa l‑teeraab al‑wagaʼ fi bakaan hajar yimassil al‑naas al‑yasmaʼo al‑kalaam wa yakhbalooh be farha laakin yiʼaamunu le wakit chiyya bas.Wa humman misil bizrit al‑gameh al‑ma indaha uruug.Wa fi wakit al‑tajriba,yikhallu derib Allah.
Wa l‑teeraab al‑wagaʼ fi ust al‑chook yimassil al‑naas al‑yasmaʼo kalaam Allah wa laakin machaakil al‑dunya wa reedithum le l‑maal wa chahwaat al‑haya yaktulu kalaam Allah al‑fi guluubhum.Wa be da,kalaam Allah ma yijiib natiija.
Wa l‑teeraab al‑wagaʼ fi l‑turaab al‑adiil yimassil al‑naas al‑yasmaʼo kalaam Allah wa yakurbuuh be hagg wa galib adiil.Wa yasburu wa yijiibu natiija adiile.
 Wa ma fi naadum yiʼoogid faanuus wa yikhattiih be maaʼuun wa la yukhuttah tihit al‑sariir.Wa laakin yukhuttah fi bakaan foog achaan al‑naas al‑yadkhulu fi l‑beet yichiifu al‑deyy.
Achaan ma fi cheyy mulabbad al‑baʼadeen ma yinchaaf.Wa ma fi ayyi sirr al‑ma yinʼarif wa baʼadeen yinkachif.
Achaan da,khuttu baalku wa asmaʼo adiil.Achaan yantu al‑naadum al‑indah.Wa laakin al‑naadum al‑ma indah,al‑chiyya al‑hu indah kula,yichiiluuh minnah. 
Wa amm Isa wa akhwaanah jo leyah.Dawwaro yichiifuuh laakin ma gidro yigarrubu leyah achaan katarat al‑naas saddat leehum al‑derib.
Wa l‑naas oorooh wa gaalo : Ammak wa akhwaanak gaaʼidiin barra wa yidooru yichiifuuk. 
Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal : Al‑naas al‑yasmaʼo kalaam Allah wa yitabbuguuh,humman bas ammi wa akhwaani. 
Wa yoom waahid,Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal : Taʼaalu nagtaʼo al‑bahar. Wa rikib fi markaba maʼa talaamiizah wa macho.
Wa wakit maachiin,Isa naam fi l‑markaba.Wa be khafla,riih chadiide marra waahid saagat fi l‑bahar wa gawwamat al‑challaal.Wa l‑markaba gaaʼide tinmali almi wa humman fi khatar.
Wa l‑talaamiiz macho le Isa wa gawwamooh min al‑noom wa gaalo : Ya sayyidna !Ya sayyidna !Aniina mutna ! Wa Isa gamma wa kachcha le l‑riih wa l‑challaal al‑chadiid.Wa khalaas,al‑riih wa l‑challaal wagafo.Wa l‑wata bigat haadiye.
Wa hajja leehum wa gaal : Ween iimaanku ? Wa humman khaafo khoof chadiid wa alʼajjabo marra waahid wa gaalo ambeenaathum : Al‑naadum da yaatu ?Hu amar al‑riih wa l‑almi wa humman simʼo kalaamah ! 
Wa khalaas,gataʼo al‑bahar wa wassalo fi balad al‑Garaasiyiin al‑gaaʼide mugaabile daar al‑Jaliil.
Wa wakit Isa nazal min al‑markaba,naadum waahid muchootin min al‑hille ja laagaah.Wa min mudda tawiile hu ma laabis khalag wa la saakin fi beet.Hu saakin fi l‑khubuur.
Wa hu chaaf Isa wa aat wa sajad giddaamah.Wa be hiss aali hu gaal : Ya Isa Ibn Allah al‑Aali !Inta tidoor minni chunu ?Nachhadak ma tiʼazzibni. 
Wa gaal al‑kalaam da achaan awwal Isa amar al‑cheetaan al‑gaaʼid foogah le yamrug minnah.Wa l‑naadum da,marra katiir al‑cheetaan yugumm leyah.Wa awwal rabatooh wa janzarooh laakin hu gataʼ ayyi rubaat.Wa l‑cheetaan saagah fi l‑khala.
Wa Isa saʼalah wa gaal : Usmak yaatu ? Wa hu gaal : Ana usmi Deech .Wa hu gaal deech achaan chawaatiin katiiriin dakhalo foogah.
Wa l‑chawaatiin chahado Isa achaan ma yirassilhum fi bakaan al‑azaab.
Wa fi taraf al‑hajar,khanaaziir katiiriin gaaʼidiin yasraho.Wa l‑chawaatiin chahado Isa achaan yikhalliihum yadkhulu fi l‑khanaaziir dool.Wa hu antaahum izin.
Wa l‑chawaatiin marago min al‑naadum da wa dakhalo fi l‑khanaaziir.Wa l‑khanaaziir kulluhum jaro min taraf al‑hajar wa wagaʼo fi l‑bahar wa khalaas,almi akalaahum.
Wa wakit ruʼyaan al‑khanaaziir chaafo al‑cheyy al‑bigi da,gammo arrado wa macho khabbaro beyah kulla l‑naas al‑fi l‑hille wa fi l‑furgaan.
Wa be l‑khabar da,al‑naas marago min al‑hille achaan yichiifu al‑cheyy al‑bigi.Wa jo le Isa wa chaafo al‑naadum al‑marago minnah al‑chawaatiin.Wa hu gaaʼid tihit yasmaʼ kalaam Isa,laabis khulgaan wa aglah foogah.Wa khaafo marra waahid.
Wa l‑naas al‑chaafo al‑cheyy da khabbaro al‑naas al‑aakhariin be kikkeef al‑naadum al‑awwal muchootin ligi al‑aafe.
Wa kulla l‑naas hana balad al‑Garaasiyiin chahado Isa le yibaʼʼid minhum achaan humman khaayfiin khoof chadiid.Wa khalaas,hu rikib fi l‑markaba le yigabbil daar al‑Jaliil.
Wa gubbaal Isa ma yamchi,al‑naadum al‑marago minnah al‑chawaatiin chahad Isa achaan yamchi maʼaayah.Laakin Isa rassalah fi hillitah wa gaal :
 Gabbil beetak wa oori naasak be kulla cheyy al‑Allah sawwaah leek. Wa khalaas,gamma macha wa ballakh kulla naas hillitah be kulla cheyy al‑Isa sawwaah leyah.
Wa Isa gabbal fi daar al‑Jaliil wa kulla l‑naas gaaʼidiin yarjooh wa laagooh be farah.
Wa naadum waahid usmah Jaayrus ja wa hu masʼuul fi beet al‑sala.Wa hu sajad giddaam Isa wa chahadah le yaji fi beetah
achaan indah bineeye waahide bas wa umurha misil 12 sana wa hi gariib tumuut.Wa Isa gamma wa macha maʼaayah.Wa fi naas katiiriin fi l‑derib lahaddi gaaʼidiin yaʼasuruuh.
Wa fi ust al‑naas fi mara taʼbaane.Wa min 12 sana,dammaha gaaʼid yidaffig minha.Wa dafaʼat kulla maalha le l‑dakaatiir wa laakin ma fi naadum gidir yidaawiiha.
Wa hi garrabat le Isa min wara wa maddat iidha wa limsat taraf khalagah.Wa tawwaali dammaha wagaf.
Wa Isa gaal : Yaatu limisni ? Wa kulla l‑naas nakaro.Wa Butrus gaal : Sayyidna,fi naas katiiriin muhawwigiinak wa gaaʼidiin yaʼasuruuk. 
Wa Isa gaal : Naadum waahid limisni.Hasseet fi gudra maragat minni. 
Wa khalaas,al‑mara irfat kadar hi ma tagdar tilabbid nafisha wa jaat le Isa wa gaaʼide tarjif min al‑khoof.Wa sajadat giddaamah wa oorat Isa giddaam kulla l‑naas be sabab lammisiinha.Wa ooratah be kikkeef hi ligat al‑aafe tawwaali.
Wa Isa gaal leeha : Ya bineeyti,iimaanki beyi najjaaki.Amchi be salaam. 
Wa wakit hu gaaʼid yihajji leeha,naadum waahid ja min beet al‑masʼuul hana beet al‑sala wa gaal : Bineeytak maatat khalaas.Khalli al‑muʼallim yinjamma. 
Wa laakin wakit Isa simiʼ al‑kalaam da,hajja le l‑masʼuul wa gaal : Ma takhaaf.Aamin beyi bas wa hi tanja. 
Wa wakit Isa wisil fi beet al‑masʼuul,hu ma khalla ayyi naadum yadkhul maʼaayah daakhal illa Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa Yaakhuub wa abu al‑bineeye wa ammaha.
Wa fi l‑beet,kulla l‑naas gaaʼidiin yabku haznaaniin leeha.Wa Isa gaal leehum : Ma tabku !Hi ma maatat.Hi naayme bas. 
Wa dihko leyah be chamaate achaan irfo hi mayte.
Laakin hu karab iidha wa hajja leeha be hiss aali wa gaal : Ya bitti,gummi ! 
Wa ruuhha gabbalat leeha wa ajala ke hi gammat.Wa Isa amaraahum achaan yantuuha akil.
Wa waaldeenha alʼajjabo.Wa Isa amaraahum achaan ma yiʼooru naadum be l‑cheyy al‑bigi.
Wa Isa naada talaamiizah al‑atnaachar wa antaahum sulta wa gudra achaan yaturdu ayyi cheetaan wa yachfu al‑mardaaniin.
Wa rassalaahum le yibachchuru al‑naas be mamlakat Allah wa yachfu al‑mardaaniin.
Wa gaal leehum : Ma tichiilu maʼaaku cheyy le l‑safar wa la asa wa la mukhla wa la akil wa la gurus.Wa ma tichiilu maʼaaku khulgaan hana khiyaar.
Wa ayyi beet al‑tidallu foogah,agoodu foogah lahaddi tamurgu min al‑hille.
Wa ayyi bakaan al‑ma yakhbalooku foogah,amurgu minnah wa hittu al‑ajaaj min rijleeku wa da yabga leeku chahaada. 
Wa khalaas,humman gammo yuruukhu fi kulla l‑hillaal wa yiballukhu al‑bichaara fi ayyi bakaan wa yachfu al‑mardaaniin.
Wa Hiruudus muhaafiz daar al‑Jaliil simiʼ khabar hana kulla cheyy al‑Isa gaaʼid yisawwiih wa hu alʼajjab bilheen.Achaan naas waahidiin gaaʼidiin yuguulu Yahya baʼas min ust al‑maytiin.
Wa aakhariin gaaʼidiin yuguulu al‑nabi Iliyaas baan wa aakhariin battaan yuguulu naadum min anbiya al‑zamaan baʼas.
Wa Hiruudus gaal : Yahya da,ana gataʼt raasah.Wa laakin da yaatu al‑ana nasmaʼ minnah khabar misil da ? Wa hu dawwar yichiif Isa.
Wa l‑rusul gabbalo le Isa wa khabbarooh be kulla cheyy al‑sawwooh.Wa hu chaalaahum maʼaayah.Wa Isa wa talaamiizah gammo macho wiheedhum fi hillit Beet Seeda.
Wa naas katiiriin simʼo al‑khabar wa macho waraayah.Wa hu laagaahum adiil wa hajja leehum be mamlakat Allah wa chafa ayyi naadum al‑yidoor hu yachfiih.
Wa l‑makhrib garrabat wa l‑rusul al‑atnaachar jo leyah wa gaalo : Khalli al‑naas yamchu fi l‑hillaal wa l‑furgaan al‑mujaawiriin le yalgo bakaan yarugdu foogah wa yalgo akil.Achaan al‑bakaan al‑aniina gaaʼidiin foogah da khala. 
Laakin Isa radda leehum wa gaal : La.Intu bas antuuhum akil. Wa humman gaalo leyah : Indina khamsa khubza wa huut itneen bas.Battaan inta tidoor aniina namchu nachru akil le kulla l‑naas dool walla ? 
Wa fi maʼaahum gariib 5 000 rujaal.Wa Isa gaal le talaamiizah : Gaʼʼuduuhum khamsiin khamsiin. 
Wa humman gaʼʼado al‑naas misil hu gaalah leehum.
Wa Isa chaal al‑khubza al‑khamsa wa l‑huut al‑itneen.Wa rafaʼ raasah ale l‑sama wa chakar Allah.Wa kassar al‑khubza wa l‑huut wa antaahum le talaamiizah achaan yigassumuuhum le l‑naas.
Wa kulla l‑naas akalo lahaddi chibʼo.Wa khalaas al‑talaamiiz lammo al‑akil al‑faddal wa malo beyah 12 guffa.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaaʼid yisalli wiheedah.Wa talaamiizah maʼaayah.Wa Isa saʼalaahum wa gaal : Al‑naas gaaʼidiin yuguulu ana yaatu ? 
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo : Naas waahidiin yuguulu inta Yahya al‑Mukhattis.Wa naas aakhariin yuguulu inta al‑nabi Iliyaas wa naas aakhariin battaan yuguulu kadar inta naadum waahid min al‑anbiya al‑faato wa baʼast min ust al‑maytiin. 
Wa battaan saʼalaahum wa gaal : Wa laakin intu,tuguulu chunu ?Tuguulu ana yaatu ? Wa Butrus radda leyah wa gaal : Inta al‑Masiih al‑Allah rassalah. 
Laakin Isa amaraahum wa hazzaraahum be tahziir chadiid achaan ma yiʼooru beyah ayyi naadum.
Wa gaal : Akiid,Ibn al‑Insaan yatʼab taʼab chadiid.Al‑chuyuukh wa kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin wa l‑ulama yaabooh.Wa Ibn al‑Insaan yaktuluuh wa Allah yabʼasah min ust al‑maytiin fi l‑yoom al‑taalit. 
Wa Isa gaal leehum kulluhum : Kan ayyi naadum yidoor yitaabiʼni,khalli yichiif nafsah rakhiise leyah wa yilhammal taʼab al‑saliib kulla yoom wa yitaabiʼni le l‑moot.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yidoor yinajji nafsah,yiwaddirha.Laakin ayyi naadum al‑yiwaddir nafsah fi chaani ana,hu da yanja.
Chunu al‑faayde kan naadum ribih kulla l‑maal al‑fi l‑dunya wa laakin waddar nafsah aw hilik ?
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yankurni be sabab al‑eeb al‑yalga min al‑naas,ana Ibn al‑Insaan nankurah wakit nigabbil be gudurti al‑majiide wa be gudra al‑majiide hana abuuyi Allah wa malaaʼikatah al‑mukhaddasiin.
Wa nuguul leeku al‑hagg,fi naas waahidiin al‑gaaʼidiin hini ma yumuutu gubbaal ma yichiifu mamlakat Allah. 
Wa baʼad gariib tamaane yoom min Isa gaal al‑kalaam da,hu talaʼ fi raas hajar achaan yisalli.Wa chaal maʼaayah Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa Yaakhuub.
Wa wakit hu gaaʼid yisalli,wijhah alkhayyar giddaamhum wa khalagah bigi abyad karr misil nuur chadiid.
Wa daahu !Naaseen baano wa bado yihajju maʼaayah wa humman al‑nabi Muusa wa l‑nabi Iliyaas.
Wa baano fi nuur majiid wa gaaʼidiin yihajju leyah be marigiinah min al‑dunya al‑yitimm fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa awwal Butrus wa rufgaanah,al‑noom chaalaahum laakin gammo min al‑noom wa chaafo Isa fi nuur majiid wa l‑rujaal al‑itneen al‑waagfiin maʼaayah.
Wa wakit al‑rujaal al‑itneen dool dawwaro yinfargu min Isa,Butrus hajja leyah wa gaal : Sayyidna,bigi leena sameh kadar aniina gaaʼidiin hini.Khalliina nisawwu lagaadiib talaata,waahide leek wa waahide le Muusa wa waahide le Iliyaas. Wa hajja wa ma fakkar fi kalaamah.
Wa wakit gaaʼid yihajji al‑kalaam da,sahaabaay waahide jaat khattathum.Wa humman khaafo bilheen.
Wa hiss min lubb al‑sahaabaay ansamaʼ wa gaal : Da bas Ibni wa ana azaltah.Asmaʼo kalaamah. 
Wa wakit al‑hiss da kammal khalaas,chaafo Isa gaaʼid wiheedah.Wa talaamiizah gaʼado saakit.Wa fi l‑wakit daak,ma ooro naadum be l‑cheyy al‑chaafooh.
Wa ambaakir,dallo min al‑hajar wa naas katiiriin laagoohum.
Wa naadum waahid fi ust al‑naas aat le Isa wa gaal : Ya sayyidna !Nachhadak achaan taji tichiif wileedi.Hu wileedi al‑wahiid.Aakhar ma indi.
Wa fi cheetaan waahid al‑daayman yakurbah.Ajala ke yaji foogah wa l‑wileed yasrakh wa amfitfit tarmiih lahaddi rikhwe tamrug min khachmah.Al‑cheetaan ma yikhalliih,illa yitaʼʼibah chadiid wa gaaʼid yiʼazzibah bilheen.
Wa ana chahadt talaamiizak achaan yaturdu minnah al‑cheetaan wa laakin humman ma gidro. 
Wa Isa gaal : Ya l‑naas al‑uwuj wa ma induku iimaan !Lahaddi mata nagood maʼaaku wa nilhammalku ?Jiib wileedak hini ! 
Wa wakit al‑wileed gaaʼid yigarrib le Isa,al‑cheetaan ramaah tihit wa sawwa leyah amfitfit.Laakin Isa kachcha le l‑cheetaan wa chafa al‑wileed wa gabbalah le abuuh.
Wa kulla l‑naas alʼajjabo bilheen le gudrat Allah al‑majiide.Wa laakin wakit kulla l‑naas gaaʼidiin yihajju be kulla l‑ajaayib al‑Isa gaaʼid yisawwiihum,hu hajja le talaamiizah
wa gaal : Asmaʼo kalaami wa akurbuuh fi guluubku.Baʼad chiyya,Allah yisallim Ibn al‑Insaan le l‑naas. 
Laakin ma fihmo kalaamah.Maʼana kalaamah mulabbad leehum lahaddi ma irfooh.Wa ma saʼalooh minnah achaan humman khaayfiin.
Wa talaamiiz Isa bado yilkhaalato ambeenaathum fi yaatu minhum al‑yabga kabiir.
Wa Isa irif fikir guluubhum wa jaab leehum wileed sakhayyar wa waggafah fi jambah.
Wa gaal leehum : Al‑naadum al‑yakhbal al‑wileed da be usmi,hu yakhbalni ana.Wa l‑yakhbalni yakhbal al‑rassalaani.Achaan al‑naadum al‑sakhayyar minku kulluku,hu bas al‑kabiir. 
Wa Yuuhanna radda leyah wa gaal : Sayyidna,chifna naadum waahid al‑gaaʼid yatrud al‑chawaatiin be usmak.Wa dawwarna nadharooh achaan hu ma gaaʼid yitaabiʼak maʼaana. 
Wa Isa gaal : Ma tadharooh.Achaan al‑naadum al‑ma yidaawisku hu yisaaʼidku. 
Wa l‑wakit al‑yinrafiʼ foogah Isa fi l‑sama garrab.Wa achaan da,hu kharrar wa chaal niiye le yiwajjih ale Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa rassal murassaliin giddaamah achaan yijahhuzu leyah kulla cheyy.Wa dakhalo fi hille waahide wa hi hille hana Saamiriyiin.
Laakin naasha abooh le Isa achaan hu muwajjih ale Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wakit talaamiizah Yaakhuub wa Yuuhanna chaafo kadar al‑naas dool abooh le Isa,humman gaalo : Ya sayyidna,ninaadu naar tanzil min al‑sama taakulhum walla ? 
Laakin Isa anlafat leehum wa harajaahum.
Wa macho fi hille aakhara.
Wa wakit Isa wa jamaaʼtah maachiin fi l‑derib,naadum waahid ja hajja leyah wa gaal : Nitaabiʼak fi ayyi bakaan al‑tamchi foogah. 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Al‑baʼachoom indah nugra wa l‑teer indah uchch wa laakin Ibn al‑Insaan ma indah bakaan yargud foogah. 
Wa Isa naada naadum aakhar wa gaal : Taʼaal taabiʼni. Laakin al‑naadum radda leyah wa gaal : Sayyidna,antiini izin achaan nadfin abuuyi gubbaal ma nitaabiʼak. 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Khalli al‑maytiin yadfunu maytiinhum.Laakin inta da,amchi ballikh bichaarat mamlakat Allah. 
Wa battaan naadum aakhar gaal : Ya l‑sayyid,ana nidoor nitaabiʼak.Laakin awwal ke antiini izin achaan nigabbil fi beeti nisallim ahali. 
Wa Isa gaal leyah : Kan naadum bada yakhdim be l‑harraata wa yichiif waraayah,hu ma jaahiz le mamlakat Allah. 
Wa baʼadeen al‑Rabb Isa azal min talaamiizah sabʼiin wa tineen naadum wa rassalaahum itneen itneen giddaamah fi ayyi bakaan al‑hu yidoor yamchi leyah.
Wa gaal leehum : Al‑naas misil zereʼ kabiir wa khallitah nijdat khalaas wa laakin al‑yakhdumu foogah chiyya.Achaan da,asʼalo siid al‑zereʼ achaan yirassil khaddaamiinah yilimmu khallitah.
Wa khalaas amchu.Nirassilku fi usuthum wa tabgo misil sukhlaan fi ust al‑maraafʼiin.
Wa fi l‑derib,ma tichiilu juzlaan wa la mukhla wa la naʼaal.Ma tagiifu le tisallumu ayyi naadum fi l‑derib.
 Wa gubbaal ma tadkhulu fi ayyi beet,guulu :‹ Khalli al‑salaam yaji fi l‑beet da. ›
Wa kan naadum al‑yiriid al‑salaam gaaʼid foogah,salaamku yagood foogah.Laakin kan ma fi naadum al‑yiriid al‑salaam,khallu salaamku yigabbil leeku.
Wa agoodu fi beet waahid wa ma tamchu beet aakhar.Aakulu wa acharbo ayyi cheyy al‑yidayyufuuku beyah achaan ujrat al‑naadum al‑yakhdim waajbe leyah.Ma tihawwulu min beet le beet fi hille waahide.
 Wa kan tadkhulu fi ayyi hille wa naasha yakhbalooku,aakulu al‑akil al‑yidayyufuuku beyah
wa achfu al‑mardaaniin al‑gaaʼidiin foogha.Wa guulu leehum :‹ Mamlakat Allah garrabat leeku. ›
Wa laakin kan tadkhulu fi hille wa naasha ma yakhbalooku,amchu fi chawaariʼha wa guulu :
‹ Ajaaj hillitku al‑mulassag fi rijleena kula,nihittuuh minnina wa di chahaaditna foogku.Laakin aʼarfu adiil kadar mamlakat Allah garrabat. ›
Nuguul leeku al‑azaab al‑yaji foog naas al‑hille di fi yoom al‑Hisaab yabga ziyaada min al‑azaab al‑yaji foog naas hillit Saduum. 
 Al‑azaab yarjaaki,ya hillit Kuuraziin.Al‑azaab yarjaaki,ya hillit Beet Seeda.Kan awwal naadum sawwa al‑ajaayib dool fi mudun al‑kuffaar Suur wa Seeda,naashum yutuubu min zunuubhum min zamaan wa yalbaso khulgaan al‑hizin wa yagoodu fi rumaad wa yutuubu.
Aywa,al‑azaab al‑yaji foog naasku fi yoom al‑Hisaab yabga ziyaada min al‑azaab al‑yaji foog naas Suur wa Seeda.
Wa inti hillit Kafar Naahuum,fi fikirki tarfaʼe raaski lahaddi l‑sama walla ?Be l‑aks,tinrami fi l‑haawiye ! 
Wa Isa gaal le l‑talaamiiz : Ayyi naadum al‑simiʼ kalaamku,simiʼ kalaami.Wa l‑abaaku,abaani.Wa l‑abaani,aba Allah al‑rassalaani. 
Wa l‑talaamiiz al‑sabʼiin wa tineen al‑Isa rassalaahum gabbalo leyah farhaaniin bilheen.Wa gaalo : Ya sayyidna !Al‑chawaatiin zaathum yasmaʼo kalaamna kan amarnaahum be usmak inta. 
Wa Isa gaal leehum : Aywa,wakit intu gaaʼidiin fi l‑khidme di,ana chift Ibliis wagaʼ ajala misil soot yagaʼ min al‑sama.
Ana anteetku gudra achaan tifajjukhu al‑dabiib wa l‑agaarib.Wa anteetku gudra lahaddi tinnasru fi kulla gudrat Ibliis al‑adu.Ma fi cheyy al‑yitaʼʼibku.
Sahiih,al‑chawaatiin simʼo kalaamku laakin ma tafraho be l‑kalaam da.Akheer tafraho kadar Allah sajjal asaameeku fi kitaabah fi l‑sama. 
Wa fi l‑wakit da,Isa malaan be l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus wa farhaan bilheen wa gaal : Chukran,ya abuuyi Rabb al‑samaawaat wa l‑ard,achaan inta labbadt kalaamak da min al‑hakiimiin wa min al‑ulama wa wassaftah le l‑naas al‑juhhaal marra waahid.Aywa,ya abuuyi,achaan da bas al‑cheyy al‑inta raadi beyah.
Abuuyi Allah wakkalaani be kulla cheyy.Ma fi naadum al‑yaʼarif Ibn Allah.Illa abuuh yaʼarfah.Wa ma fi naadum al‑yaʼarif Allah illa Ibn Allah wa l‑naadum al‑Ibn Allah yidoor yiwassif leyah abuuh. 
Wa anlafat le talaamiizah wa hajja leehum wiheedhum wa gaal : Mabruuk leeku fi chaan al‑cheyy al‑intu tichiifuuh.
Achaan nuguul leeku naas katiiriin min al‑anbiya wa l‑muluuk dawwaro bilheen yichiifu al‑cheyy al‑intu gaaʼidiin tichiifuuh,laakin ma chaafooh.Wa dawwaro yasmaʼo al‑kalaam al‑intu gaaʼidiin tasmaʼooh wa ma simʼooh. 
Wa naadum waahid aalim fi l‑Tawraat gamma achaan yijarrib Isa wa gaal : Ya l‑muʼallim,chunu al‑cheyy al‑waajib nisawwiih le nawris al‑haya al‑abadiiye ? 
Wa Isa gaal leyah : Chunu al‑maktuub fi l‑Tawraat ?Gareet foogah chunu ? 
Wa l‑aalim radda leyah wa gaal : Al‑Kitaab yuguul :﴾‍Waajib tihibb Allah Rabbak be kulla galbak wa be kulla nafsak wa be kulla gudurtak wa be kulla fikrak‍﴿wa battaan :﴾‍Hibb akhuuk misil tihibb nafsak.‍﴿
Wa Isa gaal : Kalaamak sahiih.Sawwi misil gultah wa talga al‑haya. 
Wa laakin al‑aalim dawwar yiwassif kadar hu indah hagg wa gaal leyah : Yaatu min al‑naas akhuuyi ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Yoom min al‑ayyaam,fi naadum waahid maachi min Madiinat al‑Khudus le hillit Ariiha.Wa tawwaali,rabbaatiin al‑duruub gammo hajamooh.Daggooh wa sallabooh wa faato.Wa khallooh majruuh ambeen al‑haya wa l‑moot.
 Wa baʼadeen fi naadum waahid maachi fi l‑derib da wa hu raajil diin.Wa wakit hu chaaf al‑naadum al‑taʼbaan,hu baaraah wa faat giddaam.
Wa naadum aakhar ja wa hu min al‑Laawiyiin al‑yakhdumu fi beet Allah.Hu ja fi l‑bakaan da wa chaaf al‑taʼbaan wa hu kula baaraah wa faat giddaam.
 Laakin musaafir waahid ja fi l‑bakaan al‑naadum gaaʼid foogah da wa hu min al‑Saamiriyiin.Wa l‑ajnabi da chaafah wa hanna foogah.
Wa macha leyah wa sabba dihin wa khamar fi awaawiirah wa rabataahum wa rakkabah fi humaarah.Wa waddaah fi beet hana diifaan wa rayyasah.
Wa ambaakir,hu marag gurus min juzlaanah wa antaah le siid al‑beet wa gaal leyah :‹ Rayyisah wa kan khisirt ziyaada,nantiik wakit nigabbil leek.› 
Wa Isa saʼal al‑aalim wa gaal : Min al‑naas al‑talaata dool,yaatu al‑sawwa nafsah akhu le l‑naadum al‑hajamooh rabbaatiin al‑duruub ? 
Wa l‑aalim radda leyah wa gaal : Al‑naadum al‑sawwa leyah al‑rahma. Wa khalaas Isa gaal leyah : Gumm sawwi nafs al‑cheyy mislah. 
Wa Isa wa jamaaʼtah maachiin giddaam wa dakhalo fi hille waahide.Wa fi mara usumha Marsa wa hi faddalathum fi beetha.
Wa indaha akhut usumha Mariyam.Wa Mariyam gaʼadat gariib le l‑Rabb Isa achaan tasmaʼ taʼliimah.
Laakin Marsa gaaʼide takhdim leehum wa hi machkhuula bilheen wa ma tagdar tasmaʼ kalaamah.Wa machat le Isa wa gaalat : Ya sayyidna,akhti di khallatni nisawwi kulla l‑khidme di wiheedi.Da adiil walla ?Khalaas,guul leeha khalli tiʼaawinni ! 
Laakin al‑Rabb Isa radda leeha wa gaal : Marsa,ya Marsa.Inti di,galibki muʼallag wa inti tihimmi le chakhala katiire.
Cheyy waahid bas waajib wa Mariyam azalat al‑cheyy al‑adiil.Wa ma yinrafiʼ minha. 
Wa Isa gaaʼid yisalli fi bakaan waahid.Wa wakit hu kammal salaatah,waahid min talaamiizah hajja leyah wa gaal : Sayyidna,allimna nisallu misil Yahya allam talaamiizah yisallu. 
Wa Isa gaal leehum : Wakit tisallu,guulu :‹ Ya Abuuna,khalli yaʼarfu kadar usmak khudduus.Khalli mamlakatak taji.
Antiina al‑akilal‑yitimmina kulla yoom.
Saamih leena zunuubnamisil aniina gaaʼidiin nisaamuhukulla l‑naas al‑khito foogna.Ma tidissina fi l‑tajriba.› 
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal : Nasʼalku cheyy waahid.Kan naadum minku indah rafiig wa hu yamchi leyah fi ust al‑leel,yinaadiih wa yuguul :‹ Ya akhuuyi,antiini talaata khubza.
Nidoorhum achaan rafiig waahid musaafir jaani wa ma indi cheyy nidayyifah beyah. ›
Hal akhuuk al‑saʼaltah da yurudd leek min daakhal wa yuguul :‹ Khalliini nunuum !Al‑baab masduud wa iyaali maʼaayi naaymiin.Ma nagdar nugumm leek wa la nantiik cheyy.› Da yabga walla ?
Wa nuguul leeku kan akhuuk da ma yidoor yugumm yantiik cheyy fi chaan inta rafiigah kula,akiid hu yugumm yantiik kulla cheyy al‑tidoorah fi chaan inta bachtantah.
 Wa nuguul leeku asʼalo Allah wa hu yantiiku.Fattuchu wa talgo.Duggu baab Allah wa yinfatih leeku.
Achaan kulla naadum al‑yasʼal da,Allah yantiih.Wa ayyi naadum al‑yifattich,yalga.Wa ayyi naadum al‑yudugg baab Allah,al‑baab yinfatih leyah.
 Wa kan naadum minku abu iyaal wa wileedah yatlub minnah huutaay,yantiih daabi fi badal al‑huutaay walla ?
Walla kan yatlub minnah beed jidaad,yantiih agrab walla ?Abadan.
Intu al‑muznibiin kula taʼarfu kikkeef tantu chokhol sameh le iyaalku.Wa laakin abuuku Allah akheer ziyaada minku.Wa hu yanti al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus le l‑naas al‑yasʼalooh. 
Wa yoom waahid,Isa yidoor yatrud cheetaan min naadum waahid al‑bigi abkam be sabab al‑cheetaan da.Wa l‑cheetaan marag wa l‑abkam hajja.Wa kulla l‑naas alʼajjabo bilheen.
Laakin naas waahidiin gaalo : Al‑naadum da yatrud al‑chawaatiin be gudrat Ibliis kabiir al‑chawaatiin. 
Wa naas aakhariin dawwaro yijarrubuuh wa talabo minnah yantiihum daliil al‑yiwassif kadar gudurtah di jaaye min al‑sama.
Wa hu irif fikirhum wa gaal leehum : Ayyi mamlaka kan naasha yiddaawaso ambeenaathum takhrab.Wa buyuutha yidaffugu al‑waahid fi l‑aakhar.
Wa tuguulu ana natrud al‑chawaatiin be gudrat Ibliis.Wa laakin kan Ibliis yidaawis nafsah,kikkeef mamlakatah tagdar tagood saabte ?
Wa kan sahiih ana gaaʼid natrud al‑chawaatiin be gudrat Ibliis,naasku yaturduuhum be gudrat yaatu ?Wa misil da,naasku bas al‑yisabbutu foogku al‑tuhma.
Wa kan ana taradt al‑chawaatiin be gudrat Allah zaatah,khalaas mamlakat Allah gaabalatku.
Kan raajil gawi gaaʼid yahris gasrah be silaahah kulla ke,misil da kulla khumaamah gaaʼid be l‑salaam.
Laakin kan naadum gawi minnah yaji yahjimah,hu yakhlibah wa yichiil minnah silaahah al‑awwal kulla achamah gaaʼid foogah.Wa khalaas yigassim al‑khumaam le jamaaʼtah.
 Ayyi naadum al‑ma maʼaayi,aduuyi.Wa ayyi naadum al‑ma yilimm al‑naas maʼaayi,yichattithum. 
Wa Isa gaal battaan : Wakit cheetaan yamrug min naadum muchootin,al‑cheetaan da yamchi misil naadum muwaddir fi l‑sahara.Wa yifattich bakaan yinjamma foogah wa ma yalgaah.Wa yuguul :‹ Khalaas,nigabbil fi l‑beet al‑maragt minnah. ›
Wa yigabbil le l‑naadum da wa yalgaah misil beet nadiif wa mufarrach.
Wa l‑cheetaan yamchi yijiib maʼaayah sabʼa chawaatiin fasliin minnah ziyaada wa kulluhum yindasso wa yaskunu fi l‑naadum da wa khalaas,haalit al‑naadum da tabga hawaane min awwal. 
Wa wakit hu gaaʼid yihajji le l‑naas,mara waahide fi usuthum naadat wa gaalat : Mabruuk le l‑mara al‑wildatak wa rabbatak. 
Laakin Isa gaal : Akheer tuguuli mabruuk le l‑naas al‑yasmaʼo kalaam Allah wa yitaabuʼuuh. 
Wa adad al‑naas al‑yidooru yasmaʼo kalaam Isa gaaʼid yiziid.Wa hu bada yuguul : Naas al‑wakit da fasliin wa yatulbu minni daliil achaan yiʼaamunu beyi.Wa Allah ma yantiihum daliil illa l‑daliil hana l‑nabi Yuunus.
Misil Yuunus bigi alaama le naas madiinat Niinawa,ana Ibn al‑Insaan kula nabga alaama le l‑naas al‑fi wakitna da.
Wa fi yoom al‑Hisaab,malikat al‑watitugumm sawa maʼa l‑naas al‑fi wakitna da.Wa hi tisabbit fooghum al‑tuhma achaan jaat min aakhir al‑ard le tasmaʼ kalaam al‑malik Suleymaan al‑hakiim.Wa l‑yihajji leeku hassaʼ akbar min Suleymaan wa laakin intu ma tubtu.
Fi yoom al‑Hisaab,naas Niinawa yugummu sawa maʼa l‑naas al‑fi wakitna da wa yisabbutu fooghum tuhma achaan naas Niinawa taabo min zunuubhum wakit Yuunus ballakh leehum kalaam Allah.Wa l‑yihajji leeku hassaʼ akbar min Yuunus wa laakin intu ma tubtu.
 Wa ma fi naadum al‑yiʼoogid faanuus wa yilabbidah walla yikhattiih be maaʼuun.Hu yukhuttah fi bakaan foog achaan al‑naas al‑yadkhulu fi l‑beet yichiifu al‑deyy.
 Wa l‑een hi misil faanuus jildak.Kan eenak taybe,kulla jildak gaaʼid fi l‑nuur.Wa laakin kan eenak talfaane,jildak yinmali dalaam.
Achaan da,khutt baalak.Ma tikhalli al‑nuur al‑indak yabga adlam.
Kan kulla jildak anmala nuur wa ma indah dalaam fi ayyi bakaan,yabga leek misil faanuus yidawwi deyy tamaam. 
Wa wakit Isa kammal al‑kalaam da,Fariizi waahid azamah achaan yaakul fi beetah.Wa Isa macha fi beetah wa gaʼad le l‑akil.
Wa Isa ma khassal iideenah le yabgo taahiriin gubbaal ma yaakul wa l‑Fariizi chaafah wa alʼajjab minnah bilheen.
Wa l‑Rabb Isa gaal leyah : Intu al‑Fariiziyiin wakit tilwaddo,da yabga misil tikhassulu al‑kaas wa l‑sufra min barra bas.Laakin fi guluubku daakhal intu malaaniin min al‑sirge wa l‑fasaala.
Ya l‑juhhaal,intu ma taʼarfu kadar Allah al‑khalag al‑nuss al‑barraani khalag al‑nuss al‑dakhlaani kula ?
Antu al‑khumaam al‑gaaʼid daakhal fi sufritku wa khalli yabga sadakha le l‑masaakiin wa kulla cheyy yabga leeku taahir.
 Ya l‑Fariiziyiin,al‑azaab yarjaaku achaan intu munkaribiin fi l‑uchur lahaddi tantu le Allah min al‑naʼnaaʼ wa l‑kammuun wa ayyi nabaat hana l‑haraar al‑yugumm fi hoochku.Wa laakin intu nisiitu al‑adaala wa mahabbat Allah !Awwal cheyy,waajib tisawwu al‑achya al‑muhimmiin dool wa battaan ma tanso kalaam al‑uchur.
 Ya l‑Fariiziyiin,al‑azaab yarjaaku achaan tiriidu tagoodu fi l‑saff al‑awwal fi buyuut al‑sala wa intu farhaaniin kan al‑naas yisallumuuku be ihtiraam fi l‑suug.
Al‑azaab yarjaaku achaan intu misil al‑khubuur al‑ma induhum wasim wa l‑naas raaykhiin fooghum wa ma yaʼarfu kadar humman khubuur.Al‑najaasa al‑gaaʼide fiiku daakhal al‑naas ma yaʼarfuuha. 
Wa waahid min ulama al‑Tawraat radda leyah wa gaal : Ya l‑sayyid,be kalaamak da ayyartina aniina kula. 
Wa Isa gaal : Al‑azaab yarjaaku intu al‑ulama kula !Be taʼliimku tisawwu al‑diin tagiil le l‑naas lahaddi bufuut raashum wa abadan ma tidooru tiʼaawunuuhum hatta be cheyy sakhayyar kula.
Al‑azaab yarjaaku achaan intu gaaʼidiin tabnu khubuur al‑anbiya al‑juduudku aboohum wa kataloohum.
Wa misil da,intu gaaʼidiin tachhado kadar tikhassudu be l‑cheyy al‑juduudku sawwooh.Aywa,achaan humman bas al‑kataloohum wa intu bas al‑tabnu khubuurhum.
Wa fi chaan da,Allah wassaf hikmatah wakit gaal :‹ Nirassil leehum anbiya wa rusul.Waahidiin minhum yaktuluuhum wa waahidiin minhum yitaʼʼubuuhum. ›
Wa khalaas kulla l‑anbiya al‑kataloohum fi ayyi zaman,dimmithum taji fi raas hana l‑naas al‑fi wakitna da.
Aywa,nuguul leeku min dimmit Haabiil wileed Adamlahaddi dimmit Zakariiyaal‑katalooh been beet Allah wa l‑madbah,dimmithum kulluhum taji fi raas al‑naas al‑fi wakitna da.
 Ya intu al‑ulama,al‑azaab yarjaaku achaan chiltu muftaah al‑ilim.Intu zaatku ma andasseetu wa battaan al‑naas al‑yidooru yindasso,intu dahartuuhum minnah. 
Wakit Isa gamma macha min hinaak,al‑ulama wa l‑Fariiziyiin bado yikhaalufuuh be chidde wa yasʼalooh suʼaal katiir
achaan yalgo fursa le yakurbuuh be kalaamah al‑yuguulah.
Wa adad al‑naas al‑jaayiin le Isa zaad bilheen wa bigo acharaat al‑aalaaf lahaddi gaaʼidiin yilʼaasaro.Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah awwal wa gaal : Angarʼu min tawwaarit al‑Fariiziyiin achaan ma tabgo misilhum.Al‑nifaakh gaaʼid fooghum misil al‑tawwaara gaaʼide fi l‑khubza.
Wa ma fi cheyy mulabbad al‑baʼadeen ma yinkachif wa ma fi sirr al‑baʼadeen ma yinʼarif.
Achaan da,ayyi kalaam al‑gultuuh fi l‑leel,yinsamiʼ fi l‑nahaar.Wa l‑kalaam al‑hajjeetuuh be achiir daakhal fi l‑beet,yiballukhuuh barra fi l‑chawaariʼ.
 Ya rufgaani,niʼooriiku ma takhaafo min al‑naas al‑yagdaro yaktuluuku wa laakin ma yagdaro yisawwu leeku ziyaada min da.
Niʼooriiku yaatu al‑waajib takhaafo minnah.Akhaafo min Allah.Hu yagdar yaktulku wa battaan indah gudra achaan yarmiiku fi Jahannam.Aywa,hu bas al‑waajib takhaafo minnah.
 Taʼarfu kadar yibiiʼu khamsa tuyuur dugaag be riyaaleen.Wa laakin nuguul leeku kadar Allah ma yansa ayyi waahid minhum.
Wa intu kula,Allah gaaʼid yifakkir foogku wa yaʼarif adad suuf raasku.Ayyi waahid minku muhimm ziyaada le Allah min tuyuur katiiriin.Wa khalaas,ma takhaafo min al‑naas.
 Wa ana,Ibn al‑Insaan,nuguul leeku kadar ayyi naadum al‑yachhad leyi giddaam al‑naas,ana nachhad leyah giddaam malaaʼikat Allah.
Wa laakin ayyi naadum al‑yankurni giddaam al‑naas,ana kula nankurah giddaam malaaʼikat Allah.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yuguul kalaam didd Ibn al‑Insaan,Allah yakhfir leyah.Wa laakin Allah ma yakhfir le l‑naadum al‑yihajji kalaam kufur fi l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
 Wa wakit yakurbuuku wa yiwadduuku giddaam masaaʼiil buyuut al‑sala wa giddaam al‑kubaaraat wa l‑hukkaam,ma tihimmu le l‑kalaam al‑tuguuluuh wa la kikkeef turuddu leehum.
Achaan fi l‑wakit daak,al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yiʼallimku al‑kalaam al‑waajib tuguuluuh. 
Wa naadum waahid fi ust al‑naas al‑maachiin wara Isa naadaah wa gaal : Sayyidna,ajburah le akhuuyi achaan yigassim maʼaayi warasatna. 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Ya raajil !Fi fikrak Allah jaʼalaani foogku achaan nagtaʼ leeku al‑chariiʼa wa nifarrigku walla ? 
Wa Isa hajja le l‑naas wa gaal : Angarʼu wa awʼu baalku min ayyi cheyy hana tamaʼ.Achaan hayaat al‑insaan ma tamchi hasab katarat maalah. 
Wa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal : Yoom min al‑ayyaam,fi naadum khani wa ziraaʼtah wildat leyah khalla katiire bilheen.
Wa saʼal nafsah wa gaal :‹ Ha.Nisawwi chunu ?Ma faddal leyi bakaan nakhzin foogah khalliti. ›
Wa gaal :‹ Khalaas.Naʼarif al‑cheyy al‑nisawwiih.Nikassir dabangaati wa nisawwi fi badalhum dabangaat kubaar minhum.Wa fooghum nusubb kulla khalliti wa kulla khumaami.
Wa nihajji le nafsi wa nuguul :“Ya nafsi !Indiki maal katiir madmuum al‑yitawwil siniin.Ninjamma bas wa naakul wa nachrab wa nafrah.” ›
Wa laakin Allah naadaah wa gaal :‹ Ya l‑jaahil !Fi l‑leele di bas,nichiil ruuhak.Wa l‑khumaam al‑jahhaztah le nafsak da,yabga hana yaatu ?› 
Wa Isa gaal battaan : Wa yabga misil da le ayyi insaan al‑yudumm maal le nafsah wa laakin ma indah kanz giddaam Allah. 
Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal : Fi chaan da,nuguul leeku ma tihimmu le hayaatku fi chaan al‑akil wa la le jisimku fi chaan al‑khulgaan.
Achaan al‑haya muhimme min al‑akil wa l‑jisim muhimm min al‑khulgaan.
Fakkuru fi l‑khuraab.Hu ma yiteerib wa la yagtaʼ khalla wa ma indah dabanga wa la makhazan wa laakin Allah yiʼayyichah.Wa akiid intu muhimmiin le Allah ziyaada min al‑tuyuur.
 Wa kan naadum minku yihimm katiir,al‑hamm da ma yagdar yiziid umrah be saaʼa waahide kula.
Wa kan intu ma tagdaro tisawwu cheyy sakhayyar misil da,maala tihimmu le cheyy aakhar ?
 Chiifu al‑nuwwaar wa fakkuru kikkeef yugumm.Ma yakhdim wa ma yisawwi kiswe.Wa laakin nuguul leeku akiid al‑malik Suleymaan zaatah fi darajatah al‑kabiire abadan ma libis khalag jamiil misil jamaal al‑nuwwaar da.
Wa kan Allah yilabbis al‑gechch be l‑nuwwaar misil da wa l‑gechch da gaaʼid al‑yoom wa ambaakir yazguluuh fi naar al‑furun,akiid be ziyaada hu yilabbisku intu.Chiddu heelku intu al‑iimaanku lissaaʼ daʼiif.
 Wa be misil da,ma tasʼalo nufuusku fi l‑cheyy al‑taakuluuh wa tacharbooh wa ma tihimmu leyah.
Kulla l‑naas al‑ma muʼminiin khaattiin baalhum fi l‑achya dool wa abuuku Allah yaʼarif kadar intu tidooruuhum.
Wa khalaas,khuttu baalku fi mamlakat Allah bas wa Allah yantiiku al‑achya dool.
 Ya khineemaati,ma takhaafo.Abuuku Allah indah niiye yantiiku al‑mamlaka.
Biiʼu khumaamku wa antuuh sadakha le l‑masaakiin.Wa be da,tisawwu le nufuusku juzlaan al‑abadan ma yatlaf.Wa khalaas,tudummu maalku fi bakaan Allah fi l‑samaawaat.Al‑maal da ma yafchul.Wa l‑saraariig ma yigarrubu leyah wa l‑arda ma taakulah.
Achaan al‑bakaan al‑maalak gaaʼid foogah,da bas al‑bakaan al‑galbak gaaʼid foogah.
 Agoodu jaahiziin le l‑khidme salabaaku marbuutiin wa fawaaniisku muwalliʼiin.
Abgo misil abiid fi beet siidhum al‑gaaʼidiin yarjooh.Siidhum yigabbil min aazuumit al‑iris.Wa humman yagoodu jaahiziin achaan yufukku leyah al‑derib be surʼa wakit hu yaji yudugg al‑baab.
Mabruuk le l‑abiid al‑siidhum yalgaahum waaʼiyiin wakit hu yaji.Nuguul leeku al‑hagg,siidhum zaatah yarbut sulbah wa yigaʼʼidhum giddaam al‑sufra wa yantiihum al‑akil.
Mabruuk le l‑abiid dool kan siidhum yaji fi lubb al‑leel walla be waradde wa yalgaahum jaahiziin.
 Wa be masal aakhar,aʼarfu kadar kan awwal siid al‑beet irif fi l‑saaʼa kam fi l‑leel al‑sarraag yaji,hu ma yikhalli al‑sarraag yadkhul fi beetah.
Wa khalaas intu kula agoodu jaahiziin achaan ana Ibn al‑Insaan nigabbil fi yoom waahid al‑ma tarjooni foogah. 
Wa Butrus saʼalah wa gaal : Ya sayyidna !Inta gult al‑masal da leena aniina bas walla le kulla l‑naas ? 
Wa l‑Rabb Isa gaal : Yaatu minku al‑yabga misil al‑wakiil al‑amiin wa l‑faahim ?Siidah yikallifah fi kulla abiidah achaan yantiihum al‑akil fi waktah.
Mabruuk le l‑abid da kan siidah yaji min al‑safar wa yalgaah yakhdim khidimtah.
Be l‑sahiih,nuguul leeku hu yidarrij al‑abid da masʼuul fi kulla cheyy al‑indah.
Wa laakin akuun al‑abid da yuguul fi galbah :‹ Ha !Siidi yitawwil wa ma yaji ajala.› Wa achaan da,hu yugumm yudugg al‑abiid wa l‑khadiim wa yabda yaakul wa yachrab wa yaskar.
Akiid siid al‑abid da yaji fi yoom waahid al‑abid ma jaahiz yilaagiih wa fi saaʼa al‑hu ma yaʼarifha.Wa siidah yiʼaakhibah wa yukhuttah maʼa l‑aasiyiin.
 Wa l‑abid al‑irif al‑cheyy al‑siidah yidoorah wa ma jaahiz le jaytah wa ma sawwa al‑cheyy al‑siidah yidoorah,al‑abid da yafurchuuh farich chadiid.
Wa laakin al‑abid al‑ma irif al‑cheyy al‑siidah yidoorah,wa sawwa cheyy al‑waajib yafurchuuh be sababah,al‑abid da yafurchuuh chiyya bas.Wa ayyi naadum al‑ligi katiir,yatulbu minnah katiir.Wa ayyi naadum al‑kallafooh be cheyy ziyaada,yatulbu minnah ziyaada.
 Ana jiit achaan nusubb naar fi l‑ard wa nitmanna bilheen kadar al‑naar di oogadooha khalaas.
Wa fi khattisiin chadiid al‑waajib yikhattusuuni beyah wa galbi muʼallag bilheen lahaddi l‑khattisiin da yitimm.
Wa fi fikirku ana jiit achaan nijiib al‑salaam fi l‑ard walla ?La,ma ke.Nuguul leeku ana jibt al‑furga.
Achaan min al‑yoom wa giddaam,al‑beet al‑indah khamsa naas,al‑talaata yikhaalufu al‑itneen wa l‑itneen yikhaalufu al‑talaata.
Yilkhaalafo ambeenaathum.Al‑raajil yikhaalif wileedah wa l‑wileed yikhaalif abuuh wa l‑mara tikhaalif bineeyitha wa l‑bineeye tikhaalif ammaha.Wa amm al‑raajil tikhaalif marit wileedha wa l‑mara tikhaalif amm raajilha. 
Wa Isa hajja battaan le l‑naas al‑katiiriin al‑jo leyah wa gaal : Kan tichiifu al‑sahaab jaayi min al‑kharib,ajala ke tuguulu almi yusubb wa khalaas almi yusubb.
Wa kan tichiifu al‑riih tusuug min al‑wati,tuguulu al‑wata tabga haamiye bilheen wa khalaas al‑wata tabga haamiye.
Ya munaafikhiin !Taʼarfu kikkeef tafhamo alaamaat hana l‑ard wa l‑sama.Wa kikkeef ma tagdaro tafhamo alaamaat al‑zaman al‑haadir ?
 Maala ma tagdaro timayyuzu al‑cheyy al‑waajib tisawwuuh ?
Kan intu maachiin fi bakaan al‑gaadi,jaahid achaan tissaamaho maʼa khasiimak wakit intu lissaaʼ fi l‑derib.Wa da kan ma tidoor hu yusuugak le l‑gaadi wa l‑gaadi yisallimak le l‑askar wa l‑askar yidissuuk fi l‑sijin.
Nuguul leek inta ma tamrug illa kan kaffeet kulla l‑gurus al‑yidooruuh minnak. 
Wa fi l‑wakit da bas,naas waahidiin jo le Isa wa oorooh be khabar al‑naas min daar al‑Jaliil.Al‑naas dool,Bilaatus katalaahum fi beet Allah wa khalbat dammuhum maʼa damm dahaayaahum.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Be sabab moothum al‑cheen da,fi fikirku al‑Jaliiliyiin dool muznibiin ziyaada min al‑naas al‑aakhariin al‑min daar al‑Jaliil walla ?
Nuguul leeku la.Wa kan intu ma tutuubu min zunuubku,kulluku tahlako misilhum.
Wa simiʼtu khabar hana l‑naas al‑tamaantaachar al‑gasir Silwaam wagaʼ fooghum wa katalaahum.Wa fi fikirku,humman khaatiyiin ziyaada min kulla l‑naas al‑aakhariin al‑saakniin fi Madiinat al‑Khudus walla ?
Nuguul leeku la.Wa kan intu ma tutuubu min zunuubku,kulluku tahlako misilhum. 
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal : Naadum waahid indah jineene hana inab wa chadarat tiinkula gaaʼide foogha.Wa macha leeha wa fattach foogha tiin wa ma ligi cheyy.
Wa hajja le l‑khaddaam al‑masʼuul fi l‑jineene wa gaal :‹ Chiif !Min talaata sana ana gaaʼid naji nifattich iyaal min al‑chadara di wa ma ligiit foogha cheyy.Maala nikhalliiha tafsid al‑turaab ?Agtaʼha ! ›
Wa l‑khaddaam radda leyah wa gaal :‹ Ya sayyidi !Khalliiha tagood sana waahide battaan.Wa ana nahfir al‑turaab al‑jaay wa jaay leeha wa niziid leeha baʼar.
Akuun fi l‑sana al‑jaaye talda iyaal.Wa kan ma wildat,khalaas agtaʼha.› 
Yoom al‑sabt Isa gaaʼid yiʼallim al‑naas fi beet al‑sala.
Wa fi mara waahide taʼbaane.Cheetaan waahid darabaaha wa min 18 sana,daharha mukanjar wa ma tagdar tinʼadil.
Wa Isa chaafaaha wa naadaaha.Wa gaal leeha : Ya mara zeene.Khalaas,ligiiti al‑aafe.Inti ma marbuuta battaan. 
Wa khatta iideenah foogha wa ajala ke hi mattatat daharha adiil wa chakarat Allah.
Laakin masʼuul hana beet al‑sala ziʼil achaan Isa chafaaha fi yoom al‑sabt.Wa hajja le l‑naas wa gaal : Fi l‑usbuuʼ induku sitte ayyaam le l‑khidme.Khalli taju fi l‑ayyaam dool achaan talgo al‑aafe laakin ma fi yoom al‑sabt. 
Wa l‑Rabb Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Ya l‑munaafikhiin !Fi yoom al‑sabt,akiid ayyi naadum minku yihill toorah walla humaarah min chaaytah wa yiwaddiih le yazgiih almi.
Wa l‑mara di,hi min awlaad Ibraahiim wa l‑Cheetaan rabatha.Wa min 18 sana hi marbuuta.Wa kikkeef ma waajib nihillaha min rubaatha fi yoom al‑sabt ? 
Wa be kalaamah da,al‑eeb dakhal le kulla l‑naas al‑dawwaro yadharooh.Wa kulla l‑naas firho be kulla l‑amal al‑majiid al‑Isa gaaʼid yisawwiih.
Wa battaan Isa gaal : Mamlakat Allah hi kikkeef ?Hi tichaabih chunu ?
Hi sakhayre misil habbit al‑khardal.Wa raajil waahid chaalha wa teerabaaha fi jineentah.Wa hi bazarat wa bigat kabiire misil chadara.Wa tuyuur al‑sama jo wa bano uchuuchhum fi furuuʼha. 
Wa battaan Isa gaal : Nuguul mamlakat Allah tichaabih misil chunu ?
Mamlakat Allah tichaabih misil al‑tawwaara.Wa mara waahide chaalatha wa sabbatha daakhal fi lubb talaata kooro hana dagiig.Wa baʼadeen al‑tawwaara gawwamat al‑ajiine kullaha ke. 
Wa wakit Isa musaafir le Madiinat al‑Khudus,gaaʼid yiʼallim al‑naas fi l‑mudun wa l‑hillaal al‑fi derbah.
Wa naadum waahid saʼalah wa gaal : Ya sayyidna,al‑naas al‑yanjo chiyya walla ? Wa Isa hajja le l‑naas wa gaal :
 Jaahudu le tadkhulu be derib al‑dayyig achaan nuguul leeku baʼadeen naas katiiriin yidooru yadkhulu wa ma yagdaro.
Kan siid al‑beet gamma sadda al‑derib wa intu waagfiin barra,tugummu tuduggu al‑baab wa tuguulu :‹ Sayyidna,aftah leena.› Wa hu yurudd leeku wa yuguul :‹ Ma naʼarifku.Intu ke min ween ? ›
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,intu tuguulu :‹ Aniina akalna wa chiribna maʼaak.Wa inta allamt al‑naas fi chawaariʼna. ›
Laakin hu yuguul :‹ Nuguul leeku ma naʼarif intu yaatumman.Yalla kissu minni baʼiid,intu al‑fasliin ! ›
 Wa fi l‑bakaan da,tabku wa tiʼaddu sunuunku min al‑nadaama achaan tichiifu Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub wa kulla l‑anbiya yadkhulu fi mamlakat Allah wa intu kamaan matruudiin minha.
Wa l‑naas yaju min sabaah wa kharib wa min munchaakh wa wati wa yadkhulu yilʼachcho fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa khalaas al‑naas al‑wara yabgo giddaam wa l‑naas al‑giddaam yabgo wara. 
Wa fi l‑wakit da,naas waahidiin min al‑Fariiziyiin jo le Isa wa gaalo : Yalla,amchi min al‑bakaan da.Hiruudus yidoor yaktulak tara ! 
Wa radda leehum wa gaal : Amchu le l‑baʼachoom da wa guulu leyah :‹ Asmaʼ.Al‑yoom ana natrud al‑chawaatiin wa nachfi al‑mardaaniin wa ambaakir nisawwi nafs al‑cheyy.Fi l‑yoom al‑taalit hatta nikammil khidimti. ›
Aywa,al‑yoom wa ambaakir wa ambukra waajib namchi giddaam achaan ma waajib le ayyi nabi yumuut,illa fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
 Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus !Ya Madiinat al‑Khudus !Ya kattaaliin al‑anbiya !Intu al‑tarjumu al‑naas al‑Allah yirassilhum leeku.Kam marra dawwart nilimm iyaalku misil al‑jidaade tilimm iyaalha tihit janaaheeha.Laakin intu abeetu.
Chiifu yikhallu beetku yaabis.Wa khalaas nuguul leeku ma tichiifuuni battaan lahaddi tuguulu :﴾‍Mabruuk le l‑naadum al‑jaayi be usum Allah.‍﴿
Wa yoom waahid,naadum min kubaaraat al‑Fariiziyiin azam Isa achaan yaakul maʼaayah wa Isa macha leyah fi beetah.Wa da yoom al‑sabt wa l‑diifaan al‑aakhariin khatto baalhum fi Isa achaan yichiifu chunu al‑cheyy al‑yisawwiih.
Wa hinaak giddaamah fi naadum muwarrim.
Wa Isa saʼal ulama al‑Tawraat wa l‑Fariiziyiin wa gaal : Fi yoom al‑sabt,halaal leena nachfu al‑mardaaniin walla ? 
Wa ma gaalo leyah cheyy.Wa hu karab iid al‑mardaan wa chafaah wa khallaah macha.
Wa Isa saʼalaahum battaan wa gaal : Kan naadum minku indah wileed walla toor al‑wagaʼ fi biir fi yoom al‑sabt,yisawwi chunu ?Ma yamurgah ajala walla ? 
Wa ma gidro yuruddu leyah fi l‑kalaam da.
Wa Isa chaaf kadar ayyi deef dawwar yagood fi l‑bakaan al‑kubaaraat yagoodu foogah.Wa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal :
 Kan naadum yaʼazimak fi aazuumit al‑iris,ma tukhutt nafsak fi bakaan al‑kubaaraat.Akuun azamo deef kabiir minnak.
Wa l‑naadum al‑azamaaku yaji leek wa yuguul :‹ Khalli al‑raajil da yagood fi bakaanak.› Wa khalaas al‑eeb yakurbak wa tugumm tamchi fi l‑bakaan al‑wara.
 Laakin kan yaʼazumuuk,amchi agood fi l‑bakaan al‑wara.Wa fi l‑haala di,wakit siid al‑beet yaji leek,hu yuguul :‹ Ya rafiigi,taʼaal giddaam.› Wa misil da hu yicharrifak giddaam kulla l‑naas al‑maʼaak fi l‑aazuuma.
Achaan ayyi naadum al‑yisawwi nafsah kabiir,Allah yisawwiih sakhayyar.Wa l‑naadum al‑yisawwi nafsah sakhayyar,Allah yisawwiih kabiir. 
Wa Isa hajja le l‑naadum al‑azamah fi beetah wa gaal : Kan tisawwi aazuuma walla hafla,ma taʼazim rufgaanak wa la akhwaanak wa la naas gabiiltak wa la jiiraanak siyaad al‑maal.Achaan kan taʼazim al‑naas dool,akuun humman yaʼazumuuk fi aazuumithum wa da bas yabga leek ajrak.
Laakin wakit tisawwi aazuuma,aʼazim al‑masaakiin wa l‑maʼduuriin wa l‑uruj wa l‑amyaaniin achaan yaakulu maʼaak.
Wa Allah yibaarikak achaan humman ma yagdaro yigabbulu leek cheyy.Wa Allah yiʼaajirak wakit buʼaas al‑saalihiin. 
Wa naadum waahid al‑gaaʼid yaakul maʼaayah simiʼ al‑kalaam da wa hajja le Isa wa gaal : Mabruuk le l‑naas al‑yilʼachcho fi aazuuma hana mamlakat Allah ! 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Yoom min al‑ayyaam,fi naadum waahid sawwa aazuuma kabiire bilheen wa azam foogha naas katiiriin.
Wa wakit al‑aazuuma tamma,hu rassal abdah le l‑naas al‑maʼzuumiin achaan yuguul :‹ Khalaas,taʼaalu !Kulla cheyy jaahiz leeku. ›
Wa laakin kulluhum talabo minnah yisaamihhum achaan ma yaju.Al‑naadum al‑awwal gaal :‹ Hassaʼ bas biʼt zereʼ wa waajib namchi nichiifah.Natlub minnak tisaamihni.Ana ma naji. ›
Wa naadum aakhar gaal :‹ Ana biʼt achara tiiraan achaan yakhdumu be harraataati wa ana maachi nijarribhum.Achaan da,natlub minnak tisaamihni.Ana ma naji. ›
Wa naadum aakhar gaal :‹ Akhadt mara wa achaan da ma nagdar naji. ›
 Wa l‑abid gabbal le siidah wa ooraah be kalaamhum.Wa siid al‑beet da ziʼil zaʼal chadiid wa gaal le abdah :‹ Yalla,amchi ajala ajala fi chawaariʼ al‑madiina wa fi kulla duruubha wa jiib fi beeti al‑masaakiin wa l‑maʼduuriin wa l‑amyaaniin wa l‑uruj. ›
Wa baʼad chiyya,al‑abid gaal leyah :‹ Ya siidi,ana sawweet misil inta amartini beyah wa l‑bakaan lissaaʼ faddal. ›
Wa siidah radda leyah wa gaal :‹ Amchi barra min al‑madiina fi duruub al‑kadaade wa aʼasirhum le l‑naas achaan yaju fi l‑aazuuma lahaddi beeti yinmali.
Wa nuguul leeku ma fi naadum waahid min al‑naas al‑awwal azamtuhum yaakul cheyy min aazuumti.› 
Wa naas katiiriin bilheen maachiin maʼa Isa.Wa hu anlafat leehum wa gaal :
 Kan naadum yidoor yabga tilmiizi,waajib yiriidni ziyaada min abuuh wa ammah wa martah wa iyaalah wa akhwaanah wa akhwaatah.Waajib yiriidni ziyaada min nafsah kula.
Wa kan naadum aba ma yilhammal taʼab al‑saliib wa ma yitaabiʼni le l‑moot,ma yagdar yabga tilmiizi.
 Kan naadum minku yidoor yabni gasir,yisawwi chunu ?Awwal cheyy,hu yagood tihit wa yisawwi al‑hisaab achaan yaʼarif kan indah gurus al‑waajib le yikammil al‑buna.
Hu ma yidoor yukhutt asaas al‑gasir kan ma yagdar yikammilah achaan kulla l‑naas al‑yichiifuuh,yichchammato leyah.
Yuguulu :‹ Al‑naadum da bada yabni laakin ma gidir yikammilah. ›
 Wa kan naadum malik wa yidoor yidaawis malik aakhar,yisawwi chunu ?Awwal cheyy,hu yifakkir adiil.Hu yidoor yaʼarif kan be askarah al‑achara alif hu yagdar yidaawis al‑malik al‑indah ichriin alif askar.
Wa kan ma yagdar,hu yirassil naadum achaan yimassilah wakit al‑adu lissaaʼ gaaʼid baʼiid achaan yisawwi maʼaayah suluh.
Wa be misil da,kan ayyi naadum minku ma yikhalli minnah kulla cheyy al‑indah,hu ma yagdar yabga tilmiizi.
 Taʼarfu kadar al‑mileh adiil.Laakin kan taʼaamah bigi ma fiih,chunu yigabbilah ?
Al‑mileh al‑misil da ma indah faayde wa la le l‑turaab wa la le l‑baʼar.Wa khalaas,al‑naas yidaffuguuh barra.Ayyi naadum al‑indah adaan le l‑samaʼ,khalli yasmaʼ ! 
Wa l‑naas al‑yilimmu al‑miiri wa muznibiin aakhariin jaayiin le Isa achaan yasmaʼo kalaamah.
Wa l‑Fariiziyiin wa l‑ulama gammo yihajju ambeenaathum wa yachku minnah wa gaalo : Al‑naadum da yakhbal al‑muznibiin wa yaakul maʼaahum. 
Wa Isa hajja leehum be masal wa gaal :
 Kan raajil minku indah miya khanam wa waddar waahide minhum,hu yisawwi chunu ?Hu yikhalli al‑tisʼa wa tisʼiin fi l‑kadaade wa yamchi yifattich al‑muwaddire lahaddi yalgaaha.
Wa wakit ligiiha khalaas,hu yukhuttaha fi kataafeeh wa yichiilha be farah.
Wa wakit yaji beetah,hu yinaadi rufgaanah wa jiiraanah wa yuguul leehum :‹ Afraho maʼaayi achaan ana ligiit khanamaayti al‑muwaddire. ›
Wa nuguul leeku yabga misil da fi l‑sama kula.Malaaʼikat Allah yafraho be l‑muznib al‑waahid al‑taab min zunuubah ziyaada min yafraho be l‑saalihiin al‑tisʼa wa tisʼiin al‑ma waajib leehum al‑tooba.
 Wa mara waahide indaha achara hajar fudda wa kan waddarat waahid minhum,hi tisawwi chunu ?Hi tiwalliʼ al‑faanuus wa tuguchch al‑beet wa tifattichah marra waahid lahaddi talgaah.
Wa wakit ligatah khalaas,hi tinaadi rafiigaatha wa jaaraatha wa tuguul leehum :‹ Afraho maʼaayi achaan ana ligiit al‑hajar fudda al‑awwal waddartah. ›
Wa nuguul leeku malaaʼikat Allah yafraho be farha misil da kan muznib waahid yutuub min zunuubah. 
Wa Isa gaal : Fiyah raajil waahid indah awlaad itneen.
Wa yoom waahid,al‑sakhayyar gaal le abuuh :‹ Ya abuuyi,antiini warasati.› Khalaas abuuh gamma gassam maalah le awlaadah al‑itneen.
Wa baʼad ayyaam,al‑wileed al‑sakhayyar baaʼ kulla cheyy al‑abu antaah wa saafar baʼiid le balad aakhara.Wa fi l‑balad di,bigi faasid wa tallaf kulla gursah.
 Wa wakit gursah kammal khalaas,juuʼ chadiid dakhal fi l‑balad di wa l‑wileed ma indah cheyy.
Wa macha yakhdim le raajil waahid min al‑balad di.Wa l‑raajil da chaalah le yirayyis khanaaziirah.
Wa l‑wileed taʼbaan lahaddi yidoor yaakul akil al‑khanaaziir.Wa naadum ma antaah cheyy.
 Khalaas gamma yifakkir ke wa gaal :‹ Fi beet abuuyi kulla l‑khaddaamiin chabʼaaniin lahaddi l‑akil yifaddil.Wa hini ana mayyit min al‑juuʼ.
Hassaʼ da,khalli nigabbil fi beet abuuyi wa nuguul leyah :“Ya abuuyi,ana sawweet khata le Allah wa khata leek inta.
Wa hassaʼ da,ma waajib battaan tajʼalni misil wileedak.Laakin ajʼalni misil waahid min khaddaamiinak.” ›
 Wa gamma maachi beet abuuh.Wa wakit al‑wileed lissaaʼ jaayi fi l‑derib,abuuh chaafah min baʼiid wa hanna foogah bilheen.Wa jara laagaah wa hadanah wa habbaah.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,al‑wileed gaal le abuuh :‹ Ya abuuyi,ana sawweet khata le Allah wa khata leek inta.Wa hassaʼ da,ma waajib battaan tajʼalni wileedak. ›
 Laakin abuuh naada abiidah wa gaal :‹ Ajala,jiibu leyah ajmal khalag wa labbusuuh leyah.Wa dissu leyah khaatim fi iidah wa naʼaal fi rijileenah.
Wa jiibu al‑ijil al‑samiin wa adbahooh.Khalli naakulu wa nafraho !
Aywa,wileedi da,hu awwal jaʼaltah mayyit wa hassaʼ hu hayy.Hu waddar wa ana ligiitah.› Wa khalaas gammo yafraho.
 Wa fi l‑wakit da,al‑wileed al‑kabiir gaaʼid yakhdim fi l‑zereʼ.Wakit mugabbil,ja gariib le l‑beet wa simiʼ haraka hana nuggaara.
Wa naada khaddaam waahid wa saʼalah chunu al‑kaan.
Wa l‑khaddaam radda leyah wa gaal :‹ Akhuuk bas gabbal.Wa abuuk dabah leyah al‑ijil al‑samiin achaan ligi akhuuk tayyib. ›
 Wa khalaas al‑wileed al‑kabiir ziʼil,ma yidoor yadkhul fi l‑beet.Wa abuuh marag leyah wa talab minnah achaan yadkhul.
Laakin hu aba wa gaal le abuuh :‹ Asmaʼ.Tawwal ana gaaʼid nakhdim leek misil abid.Abadan ana ke ma khaalaft kalaamak.Wa be da kula,inta abadan ma dabaht leyi khanamaay sakhayre achaan nafrah maʼa rufgaani.
Wa laakin wileedak da tallaf kulla gursak maʼa l‑charaamiit wa wakit hu ja,inta dabaht leyah al‑ijil al‑samiin ! ›
 Wa abuuh gaal leyah :‹ Ya wileedi,inta gaaʼid maʼaayi daayman.Wa kulla cheyy al‑haggi,da hanaak inta.
Laakin waajib nafraho be l‑farha di achaan akhuuk da,awwal jaʼalnaah mayyit wa daahu hu hayy.Wa awwal hu waddar wa khalaas ligiinaah aafe.› 
Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah battaan wa gaal : Yoom min al‑ayyaam,fi naadum siid al‑maal indah wakiil.Wa simiʼ khabar fi wakiilah yuguulu hu yitallif maalah.
Wa naada al‑wakiil wa gaal :‹ Da chunu al‑simiʼtah foogak ?Gabbil leyi makaatiib al‑hisaab.Ma nidoor inta tabga battaan wakiili. ›
 Wa l‑wakiil hajja le nafsah wa gaal :‹ Nisawwi chunu wakit sayyidi yichiil minni al‑wakaala ?Ma nagdar nahrit achaan ma indi gudra.Wa ma nidoor nachhad al‑naas achaan al‑eeb.
Khalaas naʼarif al‑cheyy al‑nisawwiih al‑be sababah al‑naas yakhbalooni fi buyuuthum wakit yamrugni min al‑wakaala. ›
 Wa hu naada al‑naas al‑sayyidah indah fooghum deen wa hajja leehum waahid baʼad waahid.Wa le l‑naadum al‑awwal gaal :‹ Waajib tikaffi kam le sayyidi ? ›
Wa radda leyah wa gaal :‹ 100 baakha hana dihin.› Wa l‑wakiil gaal :‹ Chiil al‑maktuub wa agood tihit wa ajala aktib 50 baakha. ›
Wa baʼad da,hajja le naadum aakhar wa saʼalah :‹ Waajib tikaffi kam ?› Wa hu gaal :‹ 100 chuwaal hana gameh.› Wa gaal leyah :‹ Chiil al‑maktuub wa aktib 80 chuwaal. ›
 Wa wakit siid al‑maal irif al‑cheyy al‑wakiilah al‑khaayin sawwaah,hu khassad be najaadtah.Achaan naas hana l‑dunya al‑dalma di faahimiin ziyaada min naas al‑nuur wa yaʼarfu kikkeef yalgo al‑cheyy al‑yidooruuh min al‑naas al‑misilhum.
Wa nuguul leeku,be maal al‑dunya di aksabo le nufuusku rufgaan.Wa misil da wakit maal al‑dunya yikammil leeku khalaas,Allah yakhbalku fi maskanah al‑abadi.
 Akiid,kan naadum amiin wakit hu masʼuul fi cheyy chiyya,hu yukuun amiin battaan wakit hu masʼuul fi cheyy katiir.Wa kan naadum khaayin wakit hu masʼuul fi chiyya,hu yabga khaayin battaan wakit hu masʼuul fi katiir.
Wa kan awwal intu ma amiiniin fi maal hana l‑dunya di,kikkeef Allah yikallifku be chokhol indah khiima ziyaada minnah ?
Wa kan awwal intu ma amiiniin fi l‑khumaam al‑intu wakkalooku foogah,kikkeef Allah yantiiku cheyy al‑yabga halaalku ?
Ma fi abid al‑yagdar yakhdim le siyaad itneen achaan hu yakrah al‑waahid wa yiriid al‑taani walla yihibbah le l‑awwal be kulla galbah wa yahgir al‑aakhar.Wa intu kamaan ma tagdaro tabgo abiid le Allah wa abiid le l‑maal. 
Al‑Fariiziyiin simʼo al‑kalaam da wa achchammato le Isa achaan humman yihibbu al‑maal.
Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal : Intu tisawwu nufuusku saalihiin giddaam al‑naas wa laakin ma tagdaro tukhuchchu Allah wa hu yaʼarif guluubku.Aywa,al‑cheyy al‑naas yachkuruuku foogah da,Allah yajʼalah haraam.
 Wa ballakho leeku kalaam Allah fi l‑Tawraat wa kutub al‑anbiya lahaddi Yahya ja.Wa min Yahya ja,niballukhu bichaarat mamlakat Allah wa ayyi naadum yijaahid achaan yadkhul fiiha be chidde.
Wa wagaʼaan al‑sama wa l‑ard yabga hayyin min nugta waahide hana l‑Tawraat tingachcha.
Wa kulli naadum al‑yitallig martah achaan yaakhud mara aakhara,hu zaani.Wa l‑naadum al‑yaakhud al‑mara al‑mutallaga,hu kula zaani. 
Wa battaan,Isa gaal : Yoom min al‑ayyaam,fi naadum khani marra waahid.Wa hu laabis khulgaan khaaliyiin bilheen wa kulla yoom hu yafrah wa yaakul akil halu marra waahid.
Wa naas khatto naadum miskiin usmah Laʼaazar fi khachum beetah wa jildah kula awaawiir.
Wa hu garmaan yaakul min al‑akil al‑yidaffig min sufrat al‑khani.Wa l‑kulaab yaju wa yalhaso awaawiirah.
 Wa l‑miskiin da maat wa l‑malaaʼika chaalooh wa gaʼʼadooh jamb al‑nabi Ibraahiim.Wa l‑khani kula maat wa dafanooh.
Wa fi l‑haawiye,hu gaaʼid fi azaab chadiid.Wa rafaʼ raasah wa chaaf Ibraahiim fi bakaan baʼiid minnah wa Laʼaazar maʼaayah.
Wa sarakh leyah wa gaal :‹ Abuuna Ibraahiim,arhamni !Rassil leyi Laʼaazar.Khalli yibill raas usbaʼah fi almi baarid wa yibarrid beyah lisaani.Achaan ana fi azaab chadiid fi amlahiib di. ›
 Wa Ibraahiim gaal :‹ La,ya wileedi.Fakkir fi kikkeef icht fi l‑dunya.Awwal inta icht fi l‑halu wa Laʼaazar aach fi l‑taʼab.Wa laakin hassaʼ hu indah raaha hini wa inta indak azaab.
Wa battaan fi haawiye kabiire bilheen beenna wa beenku.Wa achaan da,al‑naas al‑yidooru yugummu min hini yamchu leeku ma yagdaro.Wa ma fi naadum al‑yagdar yugumm min hinaak wa yaji leena hini. ›
 Wa l‑khani gaal :‹ Abba,natlub minnak tirassil Laʼaazar le beet abuuyi.
Hinaak indi khamsa akhwaan.Khalli yihazzirhum achaan ma yaju fi bakaan al‑azaab da,misli ana. ›
Wa Ibraahiim radda leyah wa gaal :‹ Induhum kalaam Muusa wa kalaam al‑anbiya.Khalli yasmaʼooh. ›
Wa l‑khani radda leyah wa gaal :‹ La,ya abba Ibraahiim !Ma tuguul ke.Kan naadum yabʼas min ust al‑maytiin wa yamchi leehum,akiid yutuubu min zunuubhum. ›
 Wa Ibraahiim gaal :‹ Kan ma yidooru yasmaʼo kalaam Muusa wa l‑anbiya,akiid naadum al‑baʼas min ust al‑maytiin kula ma yagdar yijiibhum fi l‑derib al‑adiil.› 
Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal : Laabudda achya waahidiin yabgo wa be sababhum naas waahidiin yamurgu min al‑derib.Wa laakin al‑azaab yarja al‑naadum al‑yisabbib al‑achya dool.
Aywa,kan naadum yitallif iimaan hana waahid min al‑muʼminiin al‑dugaag dool,al‑azaab al‑yarjaah yabga chadiid lahaddi akheer leyah kan rabato murhaaka fi ragabatah wa zagalooh fi lubb al‑bahar.
Achaan da,khuttu baalku fi nufuusku. Kan akhuuk khiti,aharjah.Wa kan hu nidim fi l‑cheyy al‑sawwaah,saamihah.
Kan fi l‑yoom al‑waahid hu yakhta foogak sabʼa marraat wa yigabbil leek sabʼa marraat wa yuguul :‹ Ana tubt min al‑khata da ›,waajib tisaamihah. 
Wa l‑rusul hajjo le l‑Rabb Isa wa gaalo : Ziid leena al‑iimaan. 
Wa l‑Rabb Isa gaal : Kan iimaanku sakhayyar misil habbat al‑kireeb kula,tagdaro taamuru al‑chadara al‑kabiire di wa tuguulu :‹ Gummi min hini wa maggini nafiski fi l‑bahar › wa hi tasmaʼ kalaamku.
 Ayyi naadum minku yisawwi chunu kan indah abid al‑gaaʼid yahrit leyah walla yasrah ?Wakit abdah yigabbil min al‑kadaade,hal siidah yuguul :‹ Taʼaal aakul maʼaayi › ?
La,ma ke.Yuguul :‹ Khayyir khalagak wa jahhiz leyi al‑acha.Wa akhdim leyi lahaddi naakul wa nachrab.Wa baʼad da bas,inta kula taakul wa tachrab. ›
Hal hu yachkur abdah fi chaan hu sawwa al‑khidme al‑amarah beeha walla ?La.
Wa nafs al‑cheyy intu kula.Wakit sawweetu kulla cheyy al‑Allah amaraaku beyah,waajib tuguulu :‹ Aniina abiid bas wa ma sawweena ziyaada min al‑khidme al‑waajib nisawwuuha.› 
Wa wakit Isa musaafir le Madiinat al‑Khudus,hu faat be l‑huduud al‑been daar al‑Saamira wa daar al‑Jaliil.
Wa dakhal fi hille waahide wa achara rujaal al‑induhum jidaam gaabalooh.Wa humman wagafo baʼiid minnah chiyya.
Wa sarakho leyah wa gaalo : Ya Isa !Ya sayyidna !Arhamna. 
Wa Isa chaafaahum wa gaal : Amchu wassufu nufuusku le raajil al‑diin. Wa macho.Wa wakit humman fi l‑derib,ligo al‑aafe wa bigo taahiriin.
Wa wakit waahid minhum irif kadar hu ligi al‑aafe,gabbal le Isa wa gamma yachkur Allah be hiss aali.
Wa sajad giddaam Isa wa chakarah.Wa l‑naadum al‑gabbal da,hu Saamiri.
Wa Isa gaal : Al‑naas al‑ligo al‑aafe ma achara walla ?Ween al‑tisʼa ?
Ma fi naadum aakhar al‑yidoor yachkur Allah,illa l‑ajnabi da walla ? 
Wa gaal le l‑Saamiri : Gumm foog wa amchi fi derbak.Ligiit al‑aafe be sabab iimaanak. 
Wa yoom waahid,al‑Fariiziyiin saʼalo Isa fi jayyit mamlakat Allah.Wa hu radda leehum wa gaal : Mamlakat Allah ma taji be alaamaat al‑tichiifuuhum.
Wa l‑naas ma yuguulu :‹ Chiifu,hi gammat hini › walla ‹ Hi hinaak ›.Nuguul leeku mamlakat Allah gaaʼide ambeenaatku khalaas. 
Wa Isa hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal : Yaji wakit tabgo garmaaniin le tichiifu yoom waahid min ayyaam Ibn al‑Insaan wa laakin ma tichiifuuh.
Wa yuguulu leeku :‹ Chiifu hu hini › walla ‹ Chiifu hu hinaak › laakin ma tamchu maʼaahum.Ma titaabuʼuuhum.
Akiid al‑barraaga tabrug fi l‑sama min al‑nuss al‑waahid wa tinchaaf lahaddi fi l‑nuss al‑aakhar wa jayyit Ibn al‑Insaan kula tabga misil da wakit yigabbil.
Laakin awwal mukhaddar le Ibn al‑Insaan yatʼab taʼab chadiid wa l‑naas al‑fi wakitna da yaabooh.
 Wa haalat al‑naas fi yoom jayyit Ibn al‑Insaan tabga sawa sawa misil haalat al‑naas fi zaman Nooh.
Humman gaaʼidiin yaakulu wa yacharbo wa l‑rujaal yaakhudu awiin wa l‑awiin yaakhudan rujaal lahaddi l‑yoom al‑Nooh dakhal fi l‑safiina.Wa khalaas al‑almi ja wa akal kulla l‑naas.
 Wa bigi misil da fi zaman Luut kula.Al‑naas gaaʼidiin yaakulu wa yacharbo wa yibiiʼu wa yachru wa yimaggunu chadar wa yabnu buyuut.
Laakin yoom al‑Luut marag min hillit Saduum,Allah nazzal fooghum naar wa kibriit wa dammaraahum marra waahid.
Wa yabga misil da wakit Allah yibayyin Ibn al‑Insaan.
 Fi l‑yoom da,ayyi naadum al‑gaaʼid yinjamma fi raas beetah wa khumaamah daakhal fi l‑beet,khalli yajri,ma yidalli yichiilah.Wa battaan ayyi naadum al‑yakhdim fi l‑zereʼ,khalli yajri,ma yigabbil beetah.
Fakkuru fi marit Luut.
Ayyi naadum al‑yifattich yinajji nafsah,yiwaddirha.Laakin al‑naadum al‑ma yifakkir fi nafsah,yanja.
Nuguul leeku kadar fi l‑leele diik,fi naaseen fi sariir waahid,al‑waahid yinrafiʼ wa l‑aakhar ma yinrafiʼ.
Wa fi awiin itneen gaaʼidaat sawa yarhakan khalla,al‑waahide tinrafiʼ wa l‑aakhara ma tinrafiʼ.
Wa fi rujaal itneen gaaʼidiin yakhdumu fi nafs al‑zereʼ,al‑waahid yinrafiʼ wa l‑aakhar ma yinrafiʼ.
