Wa l‑kubaaraat raddo leyah wa gaalo : Haay !Inta kula min daar al‑Jaliil walla ?Kan tagri al‑Kitaab adiil ke wa tichiif ma fi nabi yaji min daar al‑Jaliil. 
Wa khalaas,kulluhum chatto wa ayyi waahid macha le beetah.
Wa laakin Isa macha fi jabal al‑Zaytuun.
Wa be fajur,hu macha fi fadaayit beet Allah wa kulla l‑naas jo leyah wa hu gaʼad tihit wa bada yiʼallimhum.
Wa l‑ulama wa l‑Fariiziyiin jo leyah wa jaabo mara waahide al‑karabooha gaaʼide tazna.Wa waggafooha giddaamhum.
Wa hajjo le Isa wa gaalo : Ya l‑muʼallim,al‑mara di karabooha gaaʼide tazna.
Wa fi l‑Tawraat,Muusa amar wa gaal ayyi mara kan zanat waajib yarjumuuha.Wa inta,tuguul chunu ? 
Humman gaalo al‑kalaam da achaan yijarrubuuh.Dawwaro yalgo sabab achaan yathamooh beyah.Laakin Isa dangar wa bada yaktib be usbaʼah fi l‑turaab.
Wa saʼalooh suʼaal katiir wa baʼadeen hu rafaʼ raasah wa radda leehum wa gaal : Ayyi naadum minku al‑abadan ma aznab,khalli yazgul al‑hajar al‑awwalaani. 
Wa dangar battaan wa katab be usbaʼah fi l‑turaab.
Wa wakit simʼo kalaamah da,khalaas kulluhum chatto minnah.Awwal al‑kubaar wa waraahum al‑sukhaar lahaddi faddal Isa wiheedah wa l‑mara waagfe giddaamah.
Wa Isa rafaʼ raasah wa saʼal al‑mara wa gaal : Mara zeene,ween humman ?Ma fi naadum yidoor yiʼaakhibki walla ? 
Wa hi gaalat : La,ya l‑sayyid.Naadum ma fiih. Wa Isa gaal leeha : Ana kula ma niʼaakhibki.Khalaas,amchi.Wa min al‑yoom ma taznibi battaan. 
Wa battaan Isa hajja le l‑naas wa gaal : Ana nuur al‑aalam.Ayyi naadum al‑yitaabiʼni abadan ma yagood fi l‑dalaam.Hu yiʼiich fi l‑nuur al‑yantiih al‑haya. 
Wa l‑Fariiziyiin hajjo leyah wa gaalo : Inta gaaʼid tachhad le nafsak wa misil da,chahaadtak di ma indaha faayde. 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Kan nachhad le nafsi kula,chahaadti indaha faayde achaan ana naʼarif al‑bakaan al‑ana jiit minnah wa l‑namchi leyah.Laakin intu ma taʼarfu al‑bakaan al‑ana jiit minnah wa la l‑bakaan al‑namchi leyah.
Intu tihaasubu al‑naas be fikir insaani.Ana ma gaaʼid nihaasib ayyi naadum.
Wa laakin kan ana nihaasib al‑naas kula,nihaasib be adaala achaan ana ma nihaasib wiheedi.Abuuyi Allah al‑rassalaani,hu maʼaayi.
Wa kitaabku al‑Tawraat buguul chahaadat naaseen indaha sabaat.
Ana gaaʼid nachhad le nafsi wa l‑chaahid al‑taani al‑gaaʼid yachhad leyi,hu abuuyi al‑rassalaani. 
Wa gammo saʼalooh wa gaalo : Abuuk ween ? Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Ma taʼarfuuni wa ma taʼarfu abuuyi.Kan awwal iriftuuni,taʼarfu abuuyi kula. 
Wa Isa gaal al‑kalaam da wakit hu gaaʼid yiʼallim al‑naas fi fadaayit beet Allah jamb sanduug al‑maal.Wa ma karabooh achaan al‑wakit al‑Allah gataʼah leyah lissaaʼ ma ja.
Wa Isa hajja leehum battaan wa gaal : Ana namchi wa intu tifattuchuuni wa laakin tumuutu be zunuubku.Al‑bakaan al‑namchi leyah,intu ma tagdaro tamchu leyah. 
Wa l‑Yahuud gammo yihajju ambeenaathum wa gaalo : Hu gaal ma nagdaro namchu fi l‑bakaan al‑hu yamchi foogah.Hu yidoor yaktul nafsah walla ? 
Wa Isa gaal leehum : Intu min naas al‑ard wa ana min al‑sama.Intu naas al‑dunya di wa ana ma minha.
Wa gult leeku tumuutu be zunuubku.Akiid,tumuutu be zunuubku kan ma tiʼaamunu kadar ana bas hu. 
Wa achaan da,saʼalooh wa gaalo : Inta yaatu ? Wa Isa gaal : Ana misil ooreetku beyah min al‑bidaaya.
Indi kalaam katiir al‑nagdar nuguulah foogku wa beyah nahkim foogku.Wa laakin al‑rassalaani saadikh wa l‑kalaam al‑antaani,da bas al‑kalaam al‑nuguulah le naas al‑dunya. 
Wa ma fihmo kadar hu gaaʼid yihajji leehum be Allah abuuh.
Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal : Wakit tarfaʼo Ibn al‑Insaan foog,taʼarfu kadar ana bas hu.Wa taʼarfu ana ma nisawwi cheyy wiheedi laakin al‑kalaam al‑abuuyi ooraani,da bas al‑kalaam al‑nuguulah leeku.
Wa l‑rassalaani gaaʼid maʼaayi.Hu ma khallaani wiheedi achaan nisawwi daayman kulla cheyy al‑hu yarda beyah. 
Wa wakit Isa gaaʼid yuguul al‑kalaam da,naas katiiriin aamano beyah.
Wa Isa hajja le l‑Yahuud al‑aamano beyah wa gaal : Kan tagoodu saabtiin fi kalaami,intu tabgo talaamiizi be l‑sahiih.
Wa misil da,taʼarfu al‑hagg wa l‑hagg yiharrirku min al‑ubuudiiye. 
Wa l‑Fariiziyiin raddo leyah wa gaalo : Haay !Aniina min zurriiyit Ibraahiim wa abadan ma fi naadum abbadaana.Kikkeef tuguul nabgo hurriin ? 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,ayyi naadum al‑gaaʼid yaznib,hu bigi be sababah abid.
Wa l‑abid ma yagood daayman fi beet siidah.Illa wileed siid al‑beet yagood daayman.
Wa kan Ibn Allah yiharrirku min al‑ubuudiiye,intu tabgo hurriin marra waahid.
Irift kadar intu min zurriiyit Ibraahiim laakin tidooru taktuluuni achaan fi guluubku ma tidooru kalaami.
Ana nihajji leeku fi l‑cheyy al‑chiftah wakit ana gaaʼid maʼa abuuyi wa laakin intu gaaʼidiin tisawwu al‑cheyy al‑abuuku ooraaku beyah. 
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo : Ibraahiim hu abuuna. Wa Isa gaal : Kan sahiih intu iyaal Ibraahiim,intu tisawwu al‑cheyy al‑Ibraahiim sawwaah.
Wa laakin intu tidooru taktuluuni wa ana jiit leeku achaan niʼooriiku al‑hagg al‑Allah antaani.Da ma al‑cheyy al‑Ibraahiim sawwaah.
Intu gaaʼidiin tisawwu al‑cheyy al‑abuuku yisawwiih ! Wa gaalo : La.Aniina ma furuukh.Indina abu waahid bas wa hu Allah. 
Wa Isa gaal : Kan sahiih Allah abuuku,intu tihibbuuni achaan ana jiit minnah leeku.Ana ma jiit be niiyti ana bas,laakin Allah rassalaani.
Maala ma fihimtu kalaami ?Intu ma fihimtuuh achaan intu ma tagdaro tasmaʼo taʼliimi.
Abuuku hu Ibliis wa intu iyaalah wa tidooru tisawwu al‑cheyy al‑hu yidoorah.Hu kattaal dimam min al‑bidaaya wa abadan ma dawwar al‑hagg achaan fi galbah,al‑hagg ma fiih.Kalaam al‑kidib bigi leyah lukhkhitah achaan hu kaddaab wa kulla l‑kalaam al‑kidib,hu abuuh.
Wa ana gaaʼid niʼooriiku al‑hagg wa achaan da bas intu ma tiʼaamunu beyi.
Tuguulu ana muznib laakin abadan ma tisabbutu tuhmitku.Kan ana nuguul leeku al‑hagg,maalku ma tiʼaamunu beyi ?
Kan naadum min Allah,hu yidoor yasmaʼ kalaam Allah.Laakin intu ma tasmaʼo kalaam Allah achaan intu ma minnah. 
Wa l‑Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo : Kalaamna foogak sahiih !Inta min daar al‑Saamira wa inta muchootin ! 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : La,ana ma muchootin.Ana gaaʼid nikarrim abuuyi wa laakin intu gaaʼidiin tiʼayyubuuni.
Ana ma nidoor al‑naas yicharrufuuni.Al‑yicharrifni,gaaʼid wa hu al‑yihaakim.
Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,ayyi naadum al‑yitaabiʼ kalaami adiil,ma yumuut abadan. 
Wa l‑Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo : Khalaas !Hassaʼ irifna inta muchootin !Ibraahiim wa l‑anbiya maato wa laakin inta tuguul ayyi naadum al‑yitaabiʼ kalaamak ma yumuut abadan.
Tuguul inta akbar min abuuna Ibraahiim walla ?Hu maat.Wa l‑anbiya maato.Tuguul inta yaatu ? 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Kan nicharrif nafsi,da ma yanfaʼ.Abuuyi hu al‑yicharrifni wa intu tuguulu hu ilaahku.
Wa laakin intu abadan ma iriftuuh.Ana naʼarfah.Kan nuguul ana ma naʼarfah,ana nabga kaddaab misilku.Wa laakin ana naʼarfah wa nitaabiʼ kalaamah.
Abuuku Ibraahiim farhaan achaan irif hu yichiif jayti.Wa chaafaaha wa firih. 
Wa l‑Yahuud gaalo leyah : Haay !Lissaaʼ ma indak 50 sana wa tuguul chift Ibraahiim ? 
Wa Isa gaal leehum : Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,gubbaal ma wildo Ibraahiim,ana hu al‑Hayy ! 
Wa battaan chaalo hujaar wa dawwaro yarjumuuh wa laakin hu allabbad minhum wa marag min beet Allah.
Wa yoom waahid,Isa gaaʼid yuruukh wa chaaf naadum waahid mawluud amyaan.
Wa talaamiizah saʼalooh wa gaalo : Sayyidna,al‑naadum da wildooh amyaan be sabab zunuub yaatu ?Be sabab zunuubah hu walla zunuub waaldeenah ? 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Hu amyaan ma be sabab zunuubah wa la zunuub waaldeenah.Hu bigi misil da achaan amal Allah yibiin foogah.
Wakit al‑wata lissaaʼ nahaar,waajib nisawwu al‑amal hana Allah al‑rassalaani.Al‑leel yaji wa be l‑leel,ma fi naadum yagdar yakhdim.
Wakit ana gaaʼid fi l‑aalam,ana nuur al‑aalam. 
Wa wakit Isa gaal al‑kalaam da,hu bazzakh fi l‑turaab wa ajjan tiine be buzaakhah wa masahha fi uyuun al‑amyaan.
Wa gaal leyah : Amchi khassil wijhak fi birkit Silwaam. Wa khalaas,al‑amyaan macha wa khassal wijhah wa gabbal yichiif.Wa l‑usum Silwaam maʼanaatah al‑mursaal.
Wa jiiraanah wa l‑naas al‑chaafooh wakit hu lissaaʼ gaaʼid yasʼal sadakha,assaaʼalo ambeenaathum wa gaalo : Da ma al‑naadum al‑awwal gaaʼid fi l‑chaariʼ yasʼal sadakha walla ? 
Wa naas waahidiin gaalo : Aywa,da hu. Wa naas aakhariin gaalo : La,da ma hu.Da naadum aakhar yichaabihah bas. Wa l‑naadum zaatah gaal : Ana bas hu ! 
Wa saʼalooh wa gaalo : Kan sahiih inta hu,kikkeef uyuunak anfataho ? 
Wa radda leehum wa gaal : Al‑raajil al‑usmah Isa ajjan tiine wa masahha fi uyuuni wa gaal leyi :‹ Amchi le Silwaam wa khassil wijhak.› Ana macheet wa khassalt wa khalaas gaaʼid nichiif ! 
Wa saʼalooh wa gaalo : Ween al‑naadum da ? Wa gaal leehum : Da ma naʼarfah. 
Wa waddo al‑amyaan al‑fatahooh le l‑Fariiziyiin.
Wa l‑yoom al‑Isa ajjan foogah al‑tiine wa fattah uyuun al‑amyaan da yoom al‑sabt.
Achaan da,al‑Fariiziyiin kula saʼalooh wa gaalo : Uyuunak anfataho kikkeef ? Wa radda leehum wa gaal : Hu massah uyuuni be l‑tiine wa ana khassalt wijhi wa khalaas ana chift. 
Wa Fariiziyiin waahidiin gammo yuguulu : Al‑naadum al‑sawwa al‑cheyy da,hu ma min Allah achaan hu ma yitaabiʼ churuut hana yoom al‑sabt. Laakin waahidiin gaalo : Naadum kan muznib,kikkeef yisawwi ajaayib misil da ? Wa be misil da,al‑Fariiziyiin ankhalafo.
Wa battaan,saʼalo al‑amyaan wa gaalo : Al‑naadum al‑fatah leek uyuunak da,inta tuguul foogah chunu ? Wa l‑amyaan radda leehum wa gaal : Hu nabi. 
Wa l‑Yahuud ma saddago kadar hu awwal amyaan wa hassaʼ gaaʼid yichiif,lahaddi naado waaldeenah.
Wa saʼalo waaldeenah wa gaalo : Sahiih,da wileedku ?Wa awwal mawluud amyaan walla ?Wa kan da sahiih,kikkeef hassaʼ yichiif ? 
Wa waaldeenah raddo leehum wa gaalo : Naʼarfu da wileedna wa naʼarfu hu mawluud amyaan.
Laakin kikkeef hu yichiif wa yaatu al‑fattah leyah uyuunah,da ma naʼarfuuh.Hu raajil aagil.Asʼalooh,hu yihajji be nafsah ! 
Wa waaldeenah hajjo misil da achaan humman khaayfiin min kubaaraat al‑Yahuud.Wa l‑kubaaraat awwal astafago ambeenaathum le yaturdu min beet al‑sala ayyi naadum al‑yuguul Isa hu al‑Masiih.
Wa achaan da,waaldeenah gaalo : Hu raajil aagil.Asʼalooh hu. 
Wa marra taaniye,naado al‑amyaan al‑fatahooh wa gaalo : Ahlif be Allah !Aniina naʼarfu kadar al‑naadum da muznib. 
Wa radda leehum wa gaal : Kan hu muznib walla ma muznib,da ma naʼarfah.Cheyy waahid bas naʼarfah.Awwal ana amyaan wa hassaʼ ana gaaʼid nichiif ! 
Wa saʼalooh wa gaalo : Hu sawwa leek chunu ?Fatah uyuunak kikkeef ? 
Wa radda leehum wa gaal : Awwal ana ooreetku,laakin intu ma dawwartu tasmaʼo kalaami.Maala tidooru niʼooriiku marra taaniye ?Intu kula tidooru tabgo talaamiizah walla ? 
Wa gammo ayyarooh wa gaalo : Inta bas tilmiizah !Aniina talaamiiz Muusa !
Naʼarfu Allah kallam le Muusa wa laakin al‑naadum da,ma naʼarfu hu min ween. 
Wa l‑raajil radda leehum wa gaal : Kalaamku ajiib !Hu fatah leyi uyuuni wa laakin intu ma taʼarfu min ween hu jaayi.
Kullina naʼarfu Allah ma yasmaʼ duʼa hana l‑muznibiin.Allah yasmaʼ duʼa hana l‑naadum al‑saalih al‑gaaʼid yisawwi al‑cheyy al‑hu yidoorah.
Min bidaayit al‑dunya,abadan ma simiʼna be ayyi naadum al‑fatah uyuun hana naadum mawluud amyaan.
Kan al‑naadum da ma jaay min Allah,hu ma yagdar yisawwi cheyy. 
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo : Inta wildook wa rabbook fi zunuub.Ma tagdar tiʼallimna cheyy ! Wa khalaas,taradooh min beet al‑sala.
Wa wakit Isa simiʼ al‑naadum al‑awwal amyaan taradooh,hu macha ligiih.Wa gaal leyah : Inta muʼmin be Ibn al‑Insaan walla ? 
Wa l‑naadum gaal : Ya l‑sayyid,hu yaatu ?Ooriini achaan niʼaamin beyah. 
Wa Isa gaal leyah : Inta chiftah wa hu al‑naadum al‑gaaʼid yihajji leek. 
Wa l‑naadum gaal : Ya Rabb,ana muʼmin beek. Wa sajad leyah.
Wa Isa gaal : Ana jiit fi l‑dunya le nijiib al‑hisaab achaan al‑naas al‑amyaaniin yichiifu wa l‑naas al‑yichiifu yabgo amyaaniin. 
Wa waahidiin min al‑Fariiziyiin gaaʼidiin maʼaayah wa simʼo al‑kalaam da wa gaalo : Tuguul aniina amyaaniin walla ? 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Kan sahiih intu amyaaniin,intu ma khaatiyiin.Laakin gultu :‹ Intu tichiifu ›,wa achaan da al‑khata yagood foogku. 
 Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,kan al‑khanam gaaʼidiin fi l‑zariibe wa naadum ma yidoor yadkhul be l‑derib wa laakin natta fi l‑zariibe be bakaan aakhar,hu da sarraag wa mujrim.
Wa l‑naadum al‑yadkhul fi l‑zariibe be l‑derib,hu bas raaʼi al‑khanam.
Wa l‑haras yaftah leyah al‑derib tawwaali wa l‑khanam yaʼarfu hissah.Wa l‑raaʼi yinaadi khanamah al‑halaalah.Hu yinaadi ayyi waahide be usumha wa humman yamurgu waraayah.
Wa wakit marag kulla l‑khanam khalaas,hu yigaddim leehum.Wa l‑khanam yaʼarfu hissah wa achaan da yitaabuʼuuh.
Al‑khanam abadan ma yitaabuʼu al‑naadum al‑ma yaʼarfuuh wa yajru minnah achaan ma yaʼarfu hissah. 
Isa hajja leehum be l‑masal da wa laakin ma fihmo kalaamah.
Wa achaan da,Isa hajja leehum battaan wa gaal : Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,ana derib al‑khanam.
Ayyi naadum al‑ja gubbaali wa sawwa nafsah al‑raaʼi al‑sahiih,hu sarraag wa mujrim.Wa laakin al‑khanam ma simʼo hissah.
Ana al‑derib.Ayyi naadum al‑yadkhul beyi,yanja wa yabga misil al‑khanamaay al‑tadkhul wa tamrug tasrah fi l‑gechch al‑akhdar.
Al‑sarraag ma yaji fi ust al‑khanam illa le yasrighum wa yadbahhum wa yahlikhum.Wa laakin ana jiit achaan humman yalgo al‑haya wa nantiihum al‑haya al‑afdal.
 Ana al‑raaʼi al‑adiil.Al‑raaʼi al‑adiil hu al‑naadum al‑yafda khanamah be hayaatah.
Al‑khaddaam al‑yasrah be l‑khanam achaan yalga gurus bas,hu ma al‑raaʼi al‑sahiih wa l‑khanam ma haggah halaalah.Wa kan yichiif al‑marfaʼiin jaayi,hu yajri minnah wa yikhalli al‑khanam wiheedhum.Wa l‑marfaʼiin yakhtif khanamaay min usuthum wa yichattithum.
Wa l‑khaddaam yakhdim achaan al‑gurus bas,hu ma lammaah be l‑khanam.
 Ana al‑raaʼi al‑adiil.Naʼarif khanami wa humman kula yaʼarfuuni
misil abuuyi yaʼarifni wa ana naʼarif abuuyi.Wa ana nafda al‑khanam be hayaati.
Indi khanam aakhariin al‑ma min al‑zariibe di.Humman kula waajib niwaddiihum.Humman yasmaʼo hissi wa kulla l‑khanam yabgo door waahid tihit raaʼi waahid.
 Abuuyi yihibbini achaan nanti hayaati le nichiilha baʼadeen.
Ma fi naadum yagdar yichiil ruuhi laakin ana nantiiha be niiyti.Indi gudra achaan nanti ruuhi wa indi gudra nichiilha battaan.Da bas al‑cheyy al‑abuuyi amaraani beyah. 
Wa l‑Yahuud simʼo kalaamah wa battaan ankhalafo.
Katiiriin minhum gaaʼidiin yuguulu : Hu muchootin.Aglah laffa khalaas !Maalku tasmaʼo kalaamah ? 
Wa waahidiin yuguulu : Kalaamah ma kalaam hana naadum al‑indah cheetaan.Hal cheetaan yagdar yifattih uyuun hana naadum amyaan walla ? 
Wa fi l‑chite,ayyado al‑iid hana Tajdiid beet Allah fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa Isa gaaʼid yuruukh fi fadaayit beet Allah fi bakaan usmah raakuubat Suleymaan.
Wa l‑Yahuud lammo katiiriin jambah.Wa saʼalooh wa gaalo : Tiʼallig guluubna lahaddi mata ?Kan sahiih inta al‑Masiih,khalaas ooriina be kalaam waadih. 
Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Awwal ooreetku wa intu ma aamantu.Al‑ajaayib al‑nisawwiihum be usum abuuyi yachhado leyi.
Laakin intu ma aamantu beyi achaan intu ma khanami.
Khanami yasmaʼo hissi wa ana naʼarifhum wa humman yitaabuʼuuni.
Nantiihum al‑haya al‑abadiiye wa abadan ma yiwadduru.Naadum ma yagdar yakhtifhum min iideeni.
Abuuyi antaahum leyi wa hu akbar.Wa min iideen abuuyi,ma fi naadum yagdar yakhtif cheyy.
Ana wa abuuyi waahid. 
Wa l‑Yahuud chaalo battaan hujaar wa dawwaro yarjumuuh.
Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal : Ana sawweet giddaamku hasanaat katiiriin jaayiin min abuuyi.Ween hi al‑hasana al‑be sababha tidooru tarjumuuni ? 
Wa l‑Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo : Ma nidooru narjumuuk be sabab hasana.Narjumuuk achaan inta muchrik.Inta insaani bas wa sawweet nafsak Allah ! 
Wa Isa gaal : Akiid,taʼarfu al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi kitaabku al‑Tawraat kadar Allah gaal :﴾‍Ana gult leeku intu ilaahaat.‍﴿
Wa Kitaab Allah daayman sahiih.Allah gaal :‹ Intu ilaahaat › le l‑naas al‑kalaam Allah ja leehum.
Wa ana bas al‑Allah khaddasah wa rassalah fi l‑dunya.Wa be misil da,maala tuguulu ana muchrik kan gult leeku ana Ibn Allah ?
Kan ana ma nisawwi amal Allah,khalaas ma tiʼaamunu beyi.
Kan intu ma tidooru tiʼaamunu beyi kula,aamunu be l‑amal al‑ana gaaʼid nisawwiih.Be misil da,taʼarfu wa tafhamo kadar abuuyi gaaʼid foogi wa ana gaaʼid fi abuuyi. 
Wa battaan dawwaro yakurbuuh wa laakin hu anbalas minhum.
Wa Isa gabbal fi l‑nuss al‑khaadi le bahar al‑Urdun wa ja fi l‑bakaan al‑Yahya awwal khattas foogah al‑naas.Wa gaʼad hinaak.
Wa naas katiiriin jo leyah wa hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo : Yahya ma sawwa ayyi ajab wa laakin kulla cheyy al‑Yahya gaalah fi l‑naadum da sahiih. 
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,naas katiiriin aamano beyah.
Wa fiyah naadum waahid mardaan.Usmah Laʼaazar wa hu saakin fi hillit Beet Anya wa di hille hana Mariyam wa akhutha Marsa.
Wa Mariyam di,hi al‑mara al‑masahat al‑Rabb Isa be itir wa gachchat rijileenah be chaʼarha.Wa akhuuha Laʼaazar mardaan.
Achaan da,al‑akhwaat rassalan le Isa wa gaalan : Ya sayyidna,al‑naadum al‑tihibbah mardaan. 
Wa Isa simiʼ al‑kalaam da wa gaal : Al‑marad da ma yikammil be l‑moot laakin be sababah al‑naas yimajjudu Allah.Wa be sababah Ibn Allah kula yimajjuduuh. 
Wa Marsa wa akhutha Mariyam wa akhuuhum Laʼaazar humman rufgaan Isa wa hu yihibbuhum.
Wa min Isa simiʼ khabar hana marad Laʼaazar,hu gaʼad battaan yoomeen fi l‑bakaan al‑hu gaaʼid foogah.
Wa baʼad al‑yoomeen dool,hu hajja le talaamiizah wa gaal : Namchu nigabbulu fi daar al‑Yahuudiiya. 
Wa talaamiizah raddo leyah wa gaalo : Sayyidna,awwal al‑Yahuud dawwaro yarjumuuk.Wa battaan tidoor tigabbil fi bakaanhum walla ? 
Wa Isa gaal leehum : Al‑nahaar ma indah 12 saaʼa walla ?Kan naadum raayikh fi l‑nahaar,hu ma yagaʼ achaan deyy hana l‑dunya gaaʼid wa hu yichiif beyah.
Wa laakin kan naadum raayikh fi l‑leel,hu yagaʼ achaan ma indah deyy. 
Wa hu radda leehum be l‑kalaam da wa battaan hajja leehum wa gaal : Rafiigna Laʼaazar naam khalaas laakin namchi leyah nigawwimah. 
Wa talaamiizah gaalo : Sayyidna,kan hu naayim,da sameh.Hu yalga al‑aafe. 
Wa fi fikir al‑talaamiiz,Isa hajja leehum be l‑noom bas laakin Isa hajja be l‑moot.
Wa khalaas,Isa ooraahum be kalaam waadih wa gaal : Laʼaazar maat.
Ana ma kunt hinaak.Wa ana farhaan fi chaanku achaan be misil da,tiʼaamunu beyi.Khalaas,gummu namchu leyah. 
Wa Tuuma al‑yinaaduuh Chigg al‑Toom hajja le l‑talaamiiz wa gaal : Khalaas,namchu maʼaayah wa numuutu maʼaayah. 
Wa wakit Isa wisil fi hillit Beet Anya,oorooh Laʼaazar gaaʼid fi l‑khabur min muddit arbaʼa yoom.
Wa l‑hille gaaʼide misil talaata kiilomitir bas min Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa Yahuud katiiriin jo min al‑madiina le yikalwudu le Marsa wa Mariyam fi akhuuhin.
Wa wakit Marsa simʼat Isa jaayi,hi gammat wa maragat achaan tilaagiih.Wa Mariyam gaʼadat fi l‑beet.
Wa Marsa gaalat leyah : Sayyidna,kan awwal inta haadir,akhuuyi ma yumuut.
Laakin hassaʼ kula naʼarif kadar ayyi cheyy al‑tasʼalah min Allah,hu yantiik. 
Wa Isa gaal leeha : Akhuuki yugumm. 
Wa Marsa gaalat leyah : Naʼarif kadar hu yabʼas maʼa l‑maytiin fi l‑buʼaas al‑yabga fi yoom al‑akhiir. 
Wa Isa gaal leeha : Ana al‑buʼaas wa l‑haya.Ayyi naadum muʼmin beyi,kan yumuut kula,hu yahya.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑aayich muʼmin beyi,abadan ma yumuut.Kalaami da,inti muʼmine beyah walla ? 
Wa hi gaalat leyah : Aywa,sayyidna,ana muʼmine beek.Inta al‑Masiih Ibn Allah.Inta hu al‑laabudda yaji fi l‑dunya. 
Wa hi gaalat al‑kalaam da wa gammat machat le akhutha Mariyam wa hajjat leeha be hiss tihit wa gaalat : Al‑muʼallim ja wa gaaʼid yinaadiiki. 
Wakit Mariyam simʼat kalaamha,hi gammat ajala wa machat leyah.
Wa Isa lissaaʼ ma dakhal fi l‑hille wa gaaʼid fi l‑bakaan al‑Marsa laagatah foogah.
Wa wakit al‑Yahuud al‑gaaʼidiin maʼa Mariyam fi l‑beet chaafooha gammat maragat ajala,humman taabaʼooha.Fi fikirhum,hi tidoor tamchi le l‑khabur achaan tabki hinaak.
Wa Mariyam jaat fi l‑bakaan al‑Isa gaaʼid foogah wa wakit chaafatah,hi wagaʼat giddaamah wa gaalat : Sayyidna,kan awwal inta haadir,akhuuyi ma yumuut. 
Wa wakit Isa chaaf dumuuʼha wa dumuuʼ al‑Yahuud al‑maʼaaha,hu hizin marra waahid wa barjal.
Wa saʼalaahum wa gaal : Ween al‑bakaan al‑dafanooh foogah ? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo : Taʼaal sayyidna,chiif. 
Wa Isa baka.
Wa achaan da,al‑Yahuud al‑jo fi l‑maytam gaalo : Chiifuuh.Hu yihibbah le Laʼaazar bilheen. 
Wa laakin naas waahidiin gaalo : Haay !Da bas al‑naadum al‑fatah uyuun al‑amyaan.Kikkeef ma gidir yadhar al‑moot min al‑naadum da ? 
Wa Isa hizin marra waahid battaan wa ja le l‑khabur.Wa l‑khabur hu karkuur wa saddooh be hajar kabiir.
Wa Isa gaal : Lizzu al‑hajar min khachum al‑khabur. Laakin Marsa akhut al‑marhuum gaalat : Sayyidna,hu mayyit min arbaʼa yoom wa akiid al‑janaaza affanat. 
Wa Isa gaal leeha : Ana ma ooreetki walla ?Kan tiʼaamini,tichiifi gudrat Allah al‑majiide. 
Wa lazzo al‑hajar.Wa Isa rafaʼ raasah wa gaal : Abuuyi,nachkurak achaan inta simiʼt hissi.
Ana irift inta daayman tasmaʼ hissi wa laakin gult al‑kalaam da achaan al‑naas al‑haadiriin yiʼaamunu kadar inta bas rassaltini. 
Wa wakit hu gaal al‑kalaam da khalaas,hajja be hiss aali wa gaal : Ya Laʼaazar,amrug ! 
Wa l‑mayyit marag.Iideenah wa rijileenah malfuufiin be l‑gabag al‑kaffanooh beyah wa mindiil marbuut fi wijhah.Wa Isa amaraahum le l‑naas wa gaal : Fartugu minnah al‑kafan wa khalluuh yamchi. 
Wa be misil da,naas katiiriin min al‑Yahuud al‑jo yikalwudu le Mariyam chaafo al‑ajab al‑Isa sawwaah wa aamano beyah.
Wa laakin waahidiin minhum macho le l‑Fariiziyiin wa ooroohum be l‑cheyy al‑Isa sawwaah.
Wa achaan da,kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Fariiziyiin naado naas hana l‑majlas al‑kabiir yilimmu.Wa assaaʼalo ambeenaathum wa gaalo : Nisawwu chunu ?Al‑naadum da gaaʼid yisawwi ajaayib katiiriin.
Kan ma nadharooh min al‑cheyy al‑gaaʼid yisawwiih,kulla l‑naas yiʼaamunu beyah wa l‑Roomaaniyiin yaju wa yidammuru beetna al‑mukhaddas wa yichattutu chaʼabna. 
Wa naadum waahid minhum usmah Gayaafa wa fi l‑sana di,hu kabiir rujaal al‑diin.Wa hu hajja leehum wa gaal : Intu ma taʼarfu cheyy.
Ma fihimtu kadar akheer leeku kan naadum waahid yumuut le l‑chaʼab wa be misil da,kulla l‑umma ma tiwaddir. 
Wa kalaamah da ma jaay min nafsah.Hu kabiir rujaal al‑diin fi l‑sana di wa achaan da,hu atnabbaʼ wa gaal Isa yumuut le l‑umma.
Wa da ma le ummat al‑Yahuud wiheedha.Da yabga le kulla iyaal Allah al‑muchattatiin le yilimmuuhum umma waahide.
Wa min al‑yoom da,bado yichchaawaro ambeenaathum achaan yaktulu Isa.
Wa achaan da,hu waggaf ruwaakhtah fi ust al‑Yahuud.Wa gamma min hinaak wa macha fi hille waahide jamb al‑sahara al‑usumha Afraayim wa gaʼad hinaak maʼa talaamiizah.
Wa iid al‑Yahuud al‑binaaduuh iid al‑Fisha garrab.Wa naas katiiriin gammo min hillaalhum wa macho fi Madiinat al‑Khudus achaan yitahhuru nufuushum gubbaal al‑iid.
Wa l‑naas dawwaro yichiifu Isa.Wa fi fadaayit beet Allah gaaʼidiin yissaaʼalo ambeenaathum wa yuguulu : Fikirku chunu ?Hu yaji hini fi l‑iid walla ? 
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Fariiziyiin amaroohum le l‑naas wa gaalo leehum kan naadum yaʼarif al‑bakaan al‑Isa gaaʼid foogah,waajib yaji yiʼooriihum achaan yakurbuuh.
Wa sitte yoom gubbaal iid al‑Fisha,Isa ja fi hillit Beet Anya.Wa da l‑bakaan al‑Laʼaazar saakin foogah,hu al‑naadum al‑Isa gawwamah min al‑moot.
Wa hassalo le Isa acha.Wa Laʼaazar waahid min al‑naas al‑yaakulu maʼaayah wa Marsa faddalathum.
Wa Mariyam jaat wa jaabat nuss liitir hana itir asli wa khaali bilheen al‑usmah naardiin.Wa sabbat al‑itir fi rijileen Isa wa gachchathum be chaʼarha.Wa riihit al‑itir saddat al‑beet marra waahid.
Wa laakin tilmiiz waahid gamma hajja wa hu Yahuuza al‑Iskhariyooti al‑baʼad ayyaam yukhuun Isa.Wa hu gaal :
 Maala ma baaʼo al‑itir da ?Akuun yalgo minnah 300 diinaar achaan yantuuh le l‑masaakiin. 
Wa Yahuuza ma gaal al‑kalaam da achaan hu hanuun le l‑masaakiin laakin achaan hu sarraag.Hu masʼuul fi sanduug hana gurushum wa gaaʼid yichiil min al‑gurus.
Wa Isa gaal : Ma tahrijha.Hi sabbat al‑itir fi jismi achaan tijahhizni le l‑khabur.
Al‑masaakiin gaaʼidiin maʼaaku daayman wa laakin ana kamaan ma nagood maʼaaku daayman. 
Wa l‑Yahuud al‑fi Madiinat al‑Khudus simʼo Isa gaaʼid fi hillit Beet Anya wa naas katiiriin marago leyah.Ma macho yichiifu Isa bas laakin dawwaro yichiifu Laʼaazar kula achaan hu al‑naadum al‑Isa gawwamah min al‑moot.
Wa achaan da,kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin chaalo niiye le yaktulu Laʼaazar kula.
Achaan be sabab Laʼaazar,Yahuud katiiriin gaaʼidiin yikissu minhum wa yiʼaamunu be Isa.
Wa naas katiiriin jo fi Madiinat al‑Khudus achaan yiʼayyudu.Wa humman simʼo khabar Isa yidoor yaji fi l‑madiina.
Wa gataʼo firiʼ min nakhal wa macho beyah achaan yilaaguuh.Wa gaalo be hiss aali : Al‑hamdulillah !﴾‍Mabruuk le l‑naadum al‑jaayi be usum Allah !‍﴿Mabruuk le malik Israaʼiil ! 
Wa Isa chaal humaar wa rikib foogah.Wa da bigi misil awwal maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :
﴾‍Ya Sahyuun al‑misil bineeye,ma takhaafe.Daahu malikki jaayi leekiraakib fi dahach wileed humaara.‍﴿
Wa talaamiizah awwal ma fihmo al‑cheyy al‑bigi da.Wa laakin wakit Allah rafaʼ Isa fi majdah,humman fakkaro wa irfo kadar al‑naas sawwo leyah al‑cheyy al‑maktuub fi l‑Kitaab.
Wa l‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin maʼa Isa yoom hu naada Laʼaazar min al‑khabur wa gawwamah,humman hajjo le l‑naas al‑aakhariin wa chahado leyah.
Wa l‑naas al‑jo fi Madiinat al‑Khudus simʼo khabar al‑ajab da wa gammo macho laagooh.
Wa l‑Fariiziyiin hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo : Chiifu,ma nagdaro nisawwu cheyy.Kulla l‑naas gammo taabaʼooh. 
Wa fiyah Yuunaaniyiin waahidiin fi ust al‑naas al‑jo fi Madiinat al‑Khudus achaan yaʼabudu Allah fi wakit al‑iid.
Wa l‑Yuunaaniyiin jo le Filibbus al‑tilmiiz al‑min hillit Beet Seeda fi daar al‑Jaliil wa gaddamo leyah talab.Wa gaalo : Ya l‑sayyid,nidooru nichiifu Isa. 
Wa Filibbus gamma oora Andareeyas.Wa Andareeyas wa Filibbus macho wa ooro Isa.
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Khalaas,al‑wakit al‑Allah gataʼah le Ibn al‑Insaan tamma.Wa hassaʼ Allah yarfaʼah fi majdah.
Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,kan habba hana teeraab al‑gameh ma tagaʼ fi l‑turaab wa ma tumuut,hi tagood habba waahide bas.Wa laakin kan hi tumuut,talda iyaal katiir.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yihibb hayaatah yiwaddirha.Wa l‑yakrah hayaatah fi l‑dunya,yalga al‑haya al‑abadiiye.
Kan naadum yidoor yakhdim leyi,waajib yitaabiʼni.Wa fi l‑bakaan al‑ana nagood foogah,khaddaami kula yagood foogah.Wa ayyi naadum al‑yakhdim leyi,Abuuyi yicharrifah.
 Wa hassaʼ galbi muʼallag wa nuguul chunu ?Hal nuguul :‹ Ya Abuuyi,al‑wakit tamma.Najjiini minnah › ?La,da ma nuguulah.Ana jiit fi chaan al‑wakit da bas.
Akheer nuguul :‹ Ya Abuuyi,majjid usmak !› Wa hiss Allah ansamaʼ min al‑sama wa gaal : Ana majjadtah wa nimajjidah battaan. 
Wa l‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑bakaan da simʼo al‑hiss wa gaalo : Da dagdaag. Wa naas waahidiin gaalo : Waahid min al‑malaaʼika hajja leyah. 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Al‑hiss da ansamaʼ ma le faayditi ana laakin le faayditku intu.
Hassaʼ bas al‑ikhaab yaji fi l‑dunya.Wa hassaʼ bas yintarid Ibliis sultaan al‑dunya.
Wa ana,wakit yarfaʼooni foog min al‑ard,nilimm kulla l‑naas aleyi. 
Wa Isa gaal al‑kalaam da achaan yiʼooriihum be kikkeef hu yumuut.
Wa l‑naas al‑haadiriin raddo leyah wa gaalo : Allamoona min kitaab al‑Tawraat kadar al‑Masiih yagood ila l‑abad.Wa be da,maalak gult Ibn al‑Insaan laabudda yarfaʼooh ?Wa Ibn al‑Insaan da,hu yaatu ? 
Wa Isa gaal leehum : Al‑nuur yagood maʼaaku wakit chiyya bas.Ruukhu fi l‑nuur achaan al‑dalaam ma yinnasir foogku.Al‑naadum al‑yuruukh fi l‑dalaam ma yaʼarif al‑bakaan al‑hu maachi leyah.
Wakit al‑nuur lissaaʼ maʼaaku,aamunu be l‑nuur.Wa be misil da,tabgo ahal al‑nuur. Wa baʼad Isa gaal al‑kalaam da,hu macha wa allabbad minhum.
Isa sawwa ajaayib katiiriin fi ust al‑Yahuud wa laakin be da kula,humman ma aamano beyah.
Wa be misil da,kalaam al‑nabi Ichaʼya tamma.Hu gaal :﴾‍Ya Allah,yaatu al‑aaman be khabarna ?Wa gudrat Allah baanat le yaatu ?‍﴿
Wa l‑Yahuud ma gidro yiʼaamunu beyah achaan Ichaʼya kula gaal :
﴾‍Allah ama uyuunhum wa gawwa guluubhum achaan ma yichiifu be uyuunhum wa ma yafhamo be guluubhum.Wa be da,ma yutuubu achaan nachfiihum.‍﴿
Wa Ichaʼya gaal al‑kalaam da achaan hu chaaf majd al‑Masiih wa hajja beyah.
Wa fi l‑wakit da kula,naas katiiriin min al‑kubaaraat aamano be Isa.Wa laakin ma gaalo cheyy giddaam al‑naas achaan humman khaayfiin min al‑Fariiziyiin.Humman ma dawwaro al‑Fariiziyiin yaturduuhum min buyuut al‑sala
achaan dawwaro rida al‑naas ziyaada min rida Allah.
Wa Isa hajja be hiss aali wa gaal : Ayyi naadum al‑muʼmin beyi,hu ma muʼmin beyi ana bas laakin hu muʼmin be Allah al‑rassalaani kula.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yichiifni,yichiif al‑rassalaani kula.
Ana jiit fi l‑dunya misil nuur achaan ayyi naadum al‑yiʼaamin beyi ma yagood fi l‑dalaam.
 Kan naadum yasmaʼ kalaami wa ma yitaabiʼah,ana zaati ma nihaakimah achaan ana ma jiit le nihaakim naas al‑dunya laakin jiit le ninajji naas al‑dunya.
Al‑naadum al‑yaabaani wa ma yitaabiʼ kalaami indah gaadi al‑yihaakimah.Al‑kalaam al‑ana gultah yijiib foogah al‑hukum fi l‑yoom al‑akhiir.
Wa yabga misil da,achaan ana ma kallamt hasab raayi ana bas.Abuuyi Allah rassalaani be wasiiytah wa ooraani kulla l‑kalaam al‑waajib nuguulah.
Wa ana naʼarif kadar wasiiyat Allah tanti al‑haya al‑abadiiye.Wa achaan da,ana nuguul al‑kalaam al‑abuuyi ooraani beyah. 
Wa gubbaal iid al‑Fisha ma yabda,Isa irif kadar waktah tamma wa laabudda yamrug min al‑dunya wa yigabbil le abuuh.Wa min al‑bidaaya,hu yihibb naasah al‑gaaʼidiin fi l‑dunya wa yihibbuhum hubb chadiid.
Wa Isa wa talaamiizah gaaʼidiin fi l‑acha.Wa fi l‑wakit da,khalaas Ibliis dassa niiyit al‑khiyaana fi galib Yahuuza wileed Simʼaan al‑Iskhariyooti achaan yukhuun Isa.
Wa Isa yaʼarif kadar hu ja min Allah wa yigabbil le Allah wa yaʼarif kadar abuuh antaah gudra fi kulla cheyy.
Wa wakit gaaʼidiin yaakulu,Isa gamma foog wa salla khalagah al‑barraani wa chaal al‑gitʼe al‑buguchchu beeha wa rabat beeha sulbah.
Wa sabba almi fi maaʼuun wa bada yikhassil rijle talaamiizah.Wa gachchaahum be l‑gitʼe al‑rabat beeha sulbah.
Wa ja le Simʼaan Butrus.Wa Simʼaan Butrus gaal : Sayyidna,tidoor tikhassil rijileeni walla ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Inta lissaaʼ ma fihimt al‑cheyy al‑ana gaaʼid nisawwiih laakin baʼadeen tafhamah. 
Wa Simʼaan Butrus gaal : Abadan ma tikhassil rijileeni ! Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Kan ana ma nikhassilak,inta ma indak hagg maʼaayi. 
Wa Simʼaan Butrus gaal : Sayyidna,kan yabga misil da,ma tikhassil rijileeni bas.Khassil iideeni wa raasi kula ! 
Wa Isa gaal : Kan naadum albarrad khalaas,al‑khasuul ma waajib leyah illa fi rijileenah.Hu nadiif marra waahid.Wa intu nudaaf laakin ma kulluku. 
Wa Isa irif al‑naadum al‑yidoor yukhuunah wa achaan da gaal : Ma kulluku nudaaf. 
Wa wakit Isa khassal rijleehum khalaas,hu libis khalagah wa gabbal fi bakaanah wa hajja leehum wa gaal : Taʼarfu al‑cheyy al‑ana sawweetah leeku walla ?
Intu tuguulu ana muʼallimku wa sayyidku wa kalaamku sahiih.
Wa kan ana sayyidku wa muʼallimku wa ana khassalt rijleeku,waajib ayyi waahid minku yikhassil rijle al‑aakhariin.
Al‑cheyy al‑ana sawweetah da masal leeku achaan intu kula tisawwu misil ana sawweetah leeku.
Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,al‑abid ma akbar min siidah wa l‑mursaal ma akbar min al‑rassalah.
Wa khalaas,taʼarfu al‑kalaam da wa mabruuk leeku kan tisawwuuh.
 Wa l‑kalaam al‑gultah da,ma leeku intu kulluku.Naʼarif al‑naas al‑ana azaltuhum.Wa laakin al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Kitaab laabudda yitimm.Maktuub :﴾‍Al‑yaakul maʼaayi khubziti,hu angalab diddi.‍﴿
Niʼooriiku hassaʼ be l‑cheyy al‑yidoor yabga gubbaal ma yabga.Achaan da,wakit bigi khalaas,intu tiʼaamunu beyi kadar ana hu.
Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,ayyi naadum al‑yakhbal mursaali,yakhbalni ana.Wa l‑naadum al‑yakhbalni ana,yakhbal Allah al‑rassalaani. 
Wa wakit Isa gaal al‑kalaam da,hu hizin marra waahid.Wa hajja leehum wa gaal : Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,naadum waahid minku yukhuunni. 
Wa l‑talaamiiz alʼajjabo wa ma irfo al‑naadum al‑minhum al‑Isa hajja beyah.Wa kulluhum gaaʼidiin yichchaawafo ambeenaathum.
Wa naadum waahid min talaamiizah muntaki jamb Isa fi nussah al‑zeenaay wa hu al‑tilmiiz al‑Isa yihibbah bilheen.
Wa Simʼaan Butrus sawwa leyah ichaara achaan yasʼal Isa yaatu al‑naadum al‑hajja beyah.
Wa l‑tilmiiz takka wara lahaddi lihig sadur Isa wa saʼalah wa gaal : Sayyidna,hajjeet be yaatu ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Chiif,nichiil lugma wa nimallihha wa nantiiha le naadum waahid.Wa da bas hu. Wa chaal lugma wa mallahaaha wa antaaha le Yahuuza wileed Simʼaan al‑Iskhariyooti.
Wa Yahuuza chaal al‑lugma wa khalaas Ibliis dakhal fi galbah.Wa Isa hajja leyah wa gaal : Al‑cheyy al‑tidoor tisawwiih,sawwiih ajala. 
Wa kulluhum al‑gaaʼidiin yaakulu simʼo al‑kalaam al‑Isa gaalah le Yahuuza,laakin ma irfo maʼanaatah.
Yahuuza hu masʼuul hana sanduug al‑gurus wa fi fikir waahidiin,Isa gaal leyah khalli yamchi yachri al‑khumaam al‑waajib le l‑iid.Wa fi fikir waahidiin,Isa gaal leyah khalli yamchi yanti sadakha le l‑masaakiin.
Wa Yahuuza chaal al‑lugma wa tawwaali marag.Wa l‑leel gaaʼid wa l‑wata dalma.
Wa wakit Yahuuza marag khalaas,Isa hajja leehum wa gaal : Hassaʼ majd Ibn al‑Insaan yibiin.Wa beyah hu,majd Allah yibiin.
Wa kan beyah hu majd Allah yibiin,akiid Allah yimajjid Ibn al‑Insaan maʼaayah wa yimajjidah tawwaali.
 Ya iyaali,ana nagood maʼaaku wakit chiyya bas.Intu tifattuchuuni wa laakin nuguul leeku nafs al‑kalaam al‑gultah le l‑Yahuud.Al‑bakaan al‑namchi leyah intu ma tagdaro tamchu leyah.
Wa nantiiku wasiiye jadiide wa l‑wasiiye hi arraayado ambeenaatku.Arraayado misil ana niriidku.
Wa misil da bas,kulla l‑naas yaʼarfu intu talaamiizi kan intu tirraayado ambeenaatku. 
Wa Simʼaan Butrus gaal : Sayyidna,inta maachi ween ? Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Hassaʼ inta ma tagdar titaabiʼni fi l‑bakaan al‑ana namchi leyah.Laakin fi wakit aakhar,tagdar titaabiʼni. 
Wa Butrus saʼalah wa gaal : Sayyidna,maala ma nagdar nitaabiʼak hassaʼ ?Ana jaahiz nitaabiʼak lahaddi nafdaak be ruuhi ! 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Hal sahiih tidoor tafdaani be ruuhak walla ?Asmaʼ nuguul leek al‑hagg,gubbaal al‑diik ma yiʼooʼi,inta tankurni talaata marraat. 
Wa Isa gaal battaan : Ma tibarjulu.Aamunu be Allah wa aamunu beyi.
Fiyah buyuut katiiriin fi beet abuuyi.Wa kan ma ke,ana ma nuguul leeku namchi nihassil leeku bakaan.
Wa wakit macheet hassalt leeku bakaan,nigabbil niwaddiiku hinaak achaan tagoodu maʼaayi.Wa be misil da,tagoodu fi l‑bakaan al‑ana gaaʼid foogah.
Wa intu taʼarfu derib hana l‑bakaan al‑namchi leyah. 
Wa Tuuma saʼalah wa gaal : Sayyidna,ma naʼarfu al‑bakaan al‑tamchi leyah.Kikkeef naʼarfu derbah ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Ana bas al‑derib wa l‑hagg wa l‑haya.Ma fi naadum yamchi le Allah illa beyi ana.
Kan iriftuuni,akiid taʼarfu abuuyi Allah kula.Wa min hassaʼ iriftuuh wa chiftuuh khalaas. 
Wa Filibbus gaal : Sayyidna,khalliina nichiifu abuuk wa abadan ma nasʼalo cheyy aakhar. 
Wa Isa gaal leyah : Filibbus,ana tawwalt maʼaaku.Kikkeef ma iriftini ?Ayyi naadum al‑chaafaani,hu chaaf abuuyi khalaas.Kikkeef tuguul :‹ Khalliina nichiifu abuuk ? ›
Lissaaʼ ma aamant kadar ana fi abuuyi wa abuuyi fiyi walla ?Al‑kalaam al‑nuguulah leeku ma jaayi minni bas.Abuuyi mawjuud fiyi wa hu yisawwi amalah.
Aamunu kadar ana mawjuud fi abuuyi wa abuuyi mawjuud fiyi.Wa kan ma tiʼaamunu be kalaami kula,fakkuru fi l‑aʼmaal al‑sawweethum wa aamunu beyi be sababhum. 
 Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,ayyi naadum al‑yiʼaamin beyi,hu kula yisawwi al‑aʼmaal al‑ana nisawwiihum.Aywa hu yisawwi aʼmaal kubaar ziyaada achaan ana nigabbil le abuuyi.
Wa ayyi cheyy al‑tasʼalooh be usmi,ana nisawwiih achaan majd abuuyi yibiin ziyaada foogi ana Ibnah.
Aywa,ayyi cheyy al‑tasʼalooh be usmi,nisawwiih.
 Kan tihibbuuni,intu titaabuʼu al‑wasaaya al‑anteethum leeku.
Wa ana nasʼal abuuyi wa hu yantiiku Muʼaawin aakhar fi badali.Wa l‑Muʼaawin yagood maʼaaku daayman.
Wa hu Ruuh al‑Hagg.Naas al‑dunya ma yagdaro yakhbalooh achaan humman ma yichiifuuh wa ma yaʼarfuuh.Wa laakin intu taʼarfuuh achaan hu gaaʼid maʼaaku wa baʼadeen yagood fiiku.
 Ana ma nikhalliiku ataama.Ana naji leeku battaan.
Baʼad wakit chiyya bas,naas al‑dunya ma yichiifuuni battaan.Laakin intu tichiifuuni.Ana nahya wa achaan da,intu kula tahyo.
Wa fi l‑yoom da,taʼarfu kadar ana gaaʼid fi abuuyi wa intu gaaʼidiin fiyi wa ana gaaʼid fiiku.
Ayyi naadum al‑simiʼ al‑wasaaya al‑ana anteethum wa gaaʼid yitaabiʼhum,da bas al‑naadum al‑yihibbini.Wa kan naadum yihibbini,abuuyi Allah yihibbah wa ana kula nihibbah wa naji leyah wa nibayyin nafsi leyah. 
Wa tilmiiz waahid usmah Yahuuza wa hu ma Yahuuza al‑Iskhariyooti.Wa hu saʼal Isa wa gaal : Sayyidna,kikkeef tibayyin nafsak leena wa ma le naas al‑dunya ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Kan naadum yihibbini hu yitaabiʼ kalaami.Wa abuuyi yihibbah wa aniina naju leyah wa naskunu maʼaayah.
Wa l‑naadum al‑ma yihibbini,ma yitaabiʼ kalaami.Al‑kalaam al‑tasmaʼooh min khachmi ma hanaayi.Al‑kalaam da jaayi min abuuyi al‑rassalaani.
Ana gult al‑kalaam da wakit ana lissaaʼ gaaʼid maʼaaku.
Laakin al‑Muʼaawin yaji wa hu al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa abuuyi yirassilah leeku be usmi.Wa hu yiʼallimku kulla cheyy wa yifakkirku kulla l‑kalaam al‑ana gultah leeku.
 Nikhalliiku be salaam.Nantiiku salaam hanaayi.Ana nantiiku ma misil naas al‑dunya yantuuku.Ma tibarjulu wa ma takhaafo.
Intu simiʼtu ana gult namchi wa nigabbil leeku.Kan tihibbuuni,tafraho maʼaayi achaan abuuyi akbar minni wa ana namchi leyah.
Wa khalaas ana ooreetku be l‑cheyy al‑gariib yabga.Wa hajjeet beyah gubbaal ma yabga achaan wakit bigi khalaas,intu tiʼaamunu beyi.
 Wa nihajji maʼaaku chiyya bas achaan Ibliis sultaan al‑dunya jaayi.Hu ma yagdar yisawwi leyi cheyy,
laakin ana nisawwi kulla cheyy al‑abuuyi amaraani beyah.Achaan kulla naas al‑dunya yaʼarfu ana nihibb abuuyi.Yalla !Gummu wa namchu. 
 Ana bas chadarat al‑inab al‑sahiihe wa abuuyi hu siid al‑jineene.
Ayyi firiʼ al‑ma gaaʼid yalda,hu yamurgah minni.Wa ayyi firiʼ al‑gaaʼid yalda,hu yibarbirah achaan yabga nadiif wa yalda ziyaada.
Wa intu bigiitu nudaaf khalaas be gudrat al‑kalaam al‑ana gultah leeku.
Agoodu saabtiin fiyi wa ana nagood saabit fiiku.Al‑firiʼ ma yagdar yalda wiheedah.Al‑firiʼ yalda achaan gaaʼid saabit fi l‑chadara.Wa intu kula ma tagdaro tisawwu al‑cheyy al‑Allah yidoorah,illa kan intu tagoodu saabtiin fiyi.
 Ana chadarat al‑inab wa intu al‑furuuʼ.Kan naadum gaaʼid saabit fiyi,ana nagood saabit fiyah wa hu yabga misil al‑firiʼ al‑yalda katiir.Intu ma tagdaro tisawwu cheyy illa beyi.
Kan naadum ma gaaʼid saabit fiyi,hu misil firiʼ al‑yamurguuh min al‑chadara wa yazguluuh wa yaybas.Wa l‑furuuʼ dool,yilimmuuhum wa yazguluuhum fi l‑naar wa yiharruguuhum.
Kan intu tagoodu saabtiin fiyi wa kalaami yagood saabit fi guluubku,asʼalo min Allah ayyi cheyy al‑tidooruuh wa Allah yisawwiih leeku.
Wa majd abuuyi yibiin ziyaada wakit intu tabgo misil furuuʼ al‑yaldo iyaal katiir.Wa be da,tiwassufu nufuusku kadar intu talaamiizi.
 Misil abuuyi habbaani,ana kula habbeetku.Agoodu saabtiin fi mahabbiti.
Kan intu titaabuʼu al‑wasaaya al‑anteethum leeku,intu tabgo saabtiin fi mahabbiti misil ana saabit fi mahabbat abuuyi achaan ana taabaʼt wasiiyaatah.
Ana gult leeku al‑kalaam da achaan farhiti talhagku wa tabgo farhaaniin marra waahid.
 Wa l‑wasiiye al‑nantiiha leeku di hi,waajib tirraayado ambeenaatku misil ana niriidku.
Wa ma fi mahabba kabiire min mahabbat al‑naadum al‑yihibb rufgaanah lahaddi yafdaahum be ruuhah.
Wa intu rufgaani kan titaabuʼu al‑wasaaya al‑anteethum leeku.
Ana ma nuguul battaan intu khaddaamiini achaan al‑khaddaam ma yaʼarif kulla cheyy al‑sayyidah gaaʼid yisawwiih.Ninaadiiku rufgaani achaan ana ooreetku be kulla cheyy al‑simiʼtah min abuuyi.
Intu ma azaltuuni.Ana bas azaltuku wa rassaltuku achaan tabgo misil chadara taldo fawaakih,wa fawaakihku yagoodu ila l‑abad.Wa ayyi cheyy al‑tasʼalooh min abuuyi be usmi,hu yantiiku.
Wa di hi al‑wasiiye al‑nantiiha leeku.Arraayado ambeenaatku.
 Kan naas al‑dunya yakrahooku,aʼarfu kadar kirhooni ana gubbaal.
Kan intu min al‑dunya,naas al‑dunya yihibbuuku achaan intu naashum.Laakin hassaʼ intu ma min al‑dunya achaan ana azaltuku min usut naas al‑dunya le tabgo naasi.Wa achaan da,naas al‑dunya yakrahooku.
Fakkuru fi l‑kalaam al‑ana gultah leeku.Ana gult al‑abid ma akbar min siidah.Wa kan taʼʼabooni ana,yitaʼʼubuuku intu kula.Wa kan khiblo kalaami,yakhbalo kalaamku intu kula.
Yitaʼʼubuuku intu be sabab usmi achaan ma irfo Allah al‑rassalaani.
Awwal kan ma jiit kallamt leehum,humman ma yabgo khaatiyiin.Laakin khalaas,ana kallamt leehum wa l‑khata saabit fooghum.
Ayyi naadum al‑yakrahni,yakrah abuuyi kula.
Awwal kan ana ma sawweet fi usuthum amal al‑naadum aakhar abadan ma sawwaah,humman ma yabgo muznibiin.Laakin hassaʼ chaafo al‑ajaayib wa kirhooni wa kirho abuuyi.
Wa be misil da,al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Tawraat al‑humman yagruuh bigi fooghum sahiih.Maktuub :﴾‍Kirhooni bala sabab.‍﴿
 Laakin al‑Muʼaawin yaji.Ana nirassilah leeku min bakaan abuuyi wa hu Ruuh al‑Hagg al‑naazil min Allah.Wa wakit hu yaji,hu yachhad leyi
wa intu kula tachhado leyi achaan intu gaaʼidiin maʼaayi min al‑bidaaya. 
 Ana gult leeku kulla l‑kalaam da achaan ma tamurgu min al‑derib al‑adiil.
Yaturduuku min buyuut al‑sala.Wa yaji wakit waahid ayyi naadum al‑yaktulku yifakkir hu gaaʼid yakhdim le Allah.
Yakrahooku misil da achaan ma irfo abuuyi Allah wa ma irfooni ana kula.
Laakin gult leeku al‑kalaam da achaan wakit al‑taʼab yaji foogku,tifakkuru wa taʼarfu kadar ana ooreetku beyah.Wa ana ma ooreetku min al‑bidaaya be l‑taʼab al‑yajiiku achaan awwal ana gaaʼid maʼaaku.
 Wa hassaʼ ana nigabbil le Allah al‑rassalaani wa ma fi naadum minku yasʼalni wa yuguul :‹ Inta maachi ween ? ›
Intu haznaaniin bilheen achaan ana hajjeet leeku be l‑kalaam da.
Laakin nuguul leeku al‑hagg,yabga leeku akheer kan namchi.Kan ana ma namchi,al‑Muʼaawin ma yaji leeku.Laakin kan ana macheet khalaas,nirassilah leeku.
Wa wakit hu yaji,hu yiʼarrif le naas al‑dunya zunuubhum wa yiʼarrifhum al‑haal al‑saalhe wa l‑hisaab.
Hu yiʼarrifhum al‑zanib achaan ma aamano beyi.
Hu yiʼarrifhum al‑haal al‑saalhe achaan ana namchi le abuuyi wa ma tichiifuuni.
Hu yiʼarrifhum al‑hisaab achaan Allah haasab Ibliis sultaan al‑dunya khalaas.
 Indi kalaam ziyaada nidoor nuguulah leeku laakin hassaʼ intu ma tagdaro tahmalooh.
Wakit Ruuh al‑Hagg yajiiku,hu yuguudku fi l‑hagg al‑kaamil.Al‑kalaam al‑yuguulah ma jaayi minnah bas laakin hu yuguul kulla cheyy al‑yasmaʼah wa yiʼooriiku be l‑cheyy al‑lissaaʼ ma bigi.
Hu yimajjidni yichiil min kalaami wa yiʼooriiku beyah.
Kulla cheyy hana abuuyi hanaayi.Wa achaan da,gult leeku hu yichiil min kalaami wa yiʼooriiku beyah.
Baʼad chiyya bas,ma tichiifuuni wa baʼad chiyya battaan,tichiifuuni. 
Wa waahidiin min talaamiizah hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo : Maala gaal :‹ Baʼad chiyya bas,ma tichiifuuni.Wa baʼad chiyya battaan,tichiifuuni.› Wa maala gaal :‹ Achaan nigabbil le abuuyi.› Chunu maʼana al‑kalaam da ? 
Wa gaalo : Al‑kalaam ‹ baʼad chiyya ›,da maʼanaatah chunu ?Ma fihimna kalaamah. 
Wa Isa irif kadar dawwaro yasʼalooh.Wa saʼalaahum wa gaal : Hal intu gaaʼidiin tichchaawaro ambeenaatku fi kalaami walla ?Hal fihimtu kalaami :‹ Baʼad chiyya bas,ma tichiifuuni wa baʼad chiyya battaan,tichiifuuni › ?
Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,intu tabku wa tahzano wa naas al‑dunya yafraho.Sahiih,intu tahzano laakin al‑farha tibaddil leeku al‑hizin.
 Kan mara khalbaane wa wakt al‑waaluuda ja,hi tatʼab taʼab chadiid.Wa wakit wildat sakhiirha khalaas,hi farhaane wa tansa al‑taʼab achaan jaabat naadum fi l‑dunya.
Wa yabga leeku misil da.Hassaʼ tatʼabo laakin ana nigabbil battaan nichiifku wa intu tafraho farha chadiide wa ma fi naadum yichiil minku al‑farha di.
 Wa fi l‑yoom al‑yaji da,intu ma tasʼalooni cheyy.Asmaʼo nuguul leeku al‑hagg,ayyi cheyy al‑tasʼalooh min abuuyi be usmi,hu yantiiku.
Lahaddi al‑yoom,intu ma saʼaltu cheyy min Allah be usmi.Asʼalooh wa hu yantiiku achaan tafraho farha chadiide.
 Ana hajjeet leeku be amsaal laakin fi l‑wakit al‑yaji,ma nihajji leeku battaan be amsaal laakin niʼooriiku be abuuyi be kalaam waadih.
Wa fi l‑wakit al‑yaji,tasʼalo Allah be usmi.Ana ma nuguul kadar ana nasʼal abuuyi fi chaanku.
Abuuyi zaatah yihibbuku achaan intu habbeetuuni wa aamantu kadar ana jiit min Allah.
Ana jiit min abuuyi wa dakhalt fi l‑dunya.Wa hassaʼ namrug min al‑dunya wa nigabbil le abuuyi. 
Wa talaamiizah gaalo : Khalaas hassaʼ da hajjeet be kalaam waadih wa ma be amsaal.
Hassaʼ naʼarfu inta taʼarif kulla cheyy wa kan naadum ma yasʼalak kula,inta taʼarif suʼaalah.Wa achaan da,aniina niʼaamunu kadar inta jiit min Allah. 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Hassaʼ tuguulu aamantu walla ?
Laakin wakit waahid yaji wa hassaʼ al‑wakit da ja khalaas.Wa fi l‑wakit da bas,yichattutuuku ayyi waahid yamchi le beetah.Intu tikhalluuni wiheedi.Laakin be l‑sahiih,ana ma wiheedi achaan abuuyi gaaʼid maʼaayi.
Ana gult leeku kulla l‑kalaam da,achaan talgo al‑salaam beyi ana.Akiid,fi l‑dunya intu tatʼabo.Laakin chiddu heelku achaan ana annasart fi l‑dunya. 
Wa wakit Isa gaal kulla l‑kalaam da khalaas,hu rafaʼ raasah wa chaaf foog fi l‑sama wa gaal : Ya Abuuyi,al‑wakit ja.Anti majd leyi ana Ibnak achaan ana Ibnak nimajjidak.
Misil inta anteetni sulta fi kulla l‑naas,ana nanti al‑haya al‑abadiiye le kulla l‑naas al‑inta anteethum leyi.
Wa l‑haya al‑abadiiye hi,yaʼarfuuk inta Allah al‑Waahid al‑sahiih wa yaʼarfu Isa al‑Masiih al‑inta rassaltah.
Ana kammalt al‑amal al‑inta kallaftini beyah wa be da,ana majjadtak fi l‑ard.
Wa hassaʼ,ya Abuuyi,antiini majd fi jambak wa da nafs al‑majd al‑indi jambak gabul bidaayit al‑dunya.
 Ana arraft usmak le l‑naas al‑inta naadeethum min usut naas al‑dunya achaan tantiihum leyi.Awwal humman hineeyak wa kallaftini beehum wa humman taabaʼo kalaamak.
Wa hassaʼ yaʼarfu kadar kulla cheyy al‑inta anteetni ja minnak
achaan ana anteethum al‑kalaam al‑inta anteetni.Wa humman khiblooh wa yaʼarfu akiid ana jiit minnak wa aamano kadar inta rassaltini.
 Wa ana nasʼalak leehum.Ana ma nasʼalak le naas al‑dunya laakin le l‑naas al‑inta kallaftini beehum achaan humman hineeyak.
Wa kulla l‑naas al‑hineeyak,humman hineeyi.Wa fiihum humman,yibiin majdi.
Ana ma nagood fi l‑dunya laakin humman gaaʼidiin fi l‑dunya wa ana namchi leek.Ya Abuuyi al‑Khudduus,ahfadhum be usmak al‑anteetni,achaan humman yabgo waahid misil inta wa ana waahid.
Wakit ana gaaʼid maʼaahum ana hafadtuhum be usmak,al‑usum al‑inta anteetni.Ana harastuhum wa ma fi naadum minhum hilik,illa l‑naadum al‑laabudda yahlak achaan al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Kitaab yitimm.
 Wa hassaʼ namchi leek.Wa wakit ana lissaaʼ fi l‑dunya,nuguul al‑kalaam da achaan humman yafraho farha chadiide misil ana nafrah.
Ana ooreet naasi be kalaamak wa naas al‑dunya kirhoohum achaan naasi ma hana l‑dunya misil ana kula ma hana l‑dunya.
Ana ma nasʼalak achaan tamrughum min al‑dunya.Nasʼalak achaan tahfadhum min Ibliis al‑chariir.
Humman ma naas hana l‑dunya misil ana kula ma hana l‑dunya.
Khalli al‑hagg yisawwiihum khaassiin leek.Kalaamak bas al‑hagg.
Ana rassaltuhum fi l‑dunya misil inta awwal rassaltini fi l‑dunya.
Wa fi chaanhum ana nikhassis nafsi achaan humman kula yabgo khaassiin leek be l‑sahiih.
 Ana ma gaaʼid nasʼalak le talaamiizi wiheedhum.Laakin ana nasʼalak le l‑naas al‑yasmaʼo kalaamhum wa yiʼaamunu beyi.
Ya Abuuyi,ana gaaʼid nasʼalak leehum achaan kulluhum yabgo waahid misil inta fiyi wa ana fiik.Khalli humman kula yabgo waahid maʼaana achaan kulla naas al‑dunya yiʼaamunu kadar inta rassaltini.
 Al‑majd al‑inta anteetah leyi,ana anteetah leehum achaan humman yabgo waahid misil inta wa ana waahid
yaʼni ana fiihum wa inta fiyi.Khalli wihdathum tukuun kaamile wa be da,kulla l‑naas yaʼarfu kadar inta rassaltini wa tihibbuhum misil tihibbini.
 Ya Abuuyi,nidoor kadar al‑naas al‑anteethum leyi yagoodu maʼaayi fi l‑bakaan al‑ana nagood foogah.Achaan hinaak yichiifu al‑majd al‑inta anteetni.Wa da be sabab mahabbitak leyi min gubbaal bidaayit al‑dunya.
Ya Abuuyi al‑aadil,naas al‑dunya ma irfook.Laakin ana iriftak wa l‑naas dool yaʼarfu kadar inta rassaltini.
Ana arraftuhum be usmak wa niʼarrifhum beyah ziyaada achaan mahabbitak leyi tabga fiihum humman kula wa ana zaati nukuun fiihum. 
Wa wakit Isa kammal al‑duʼa da,hu gamma maʼa talaamiizah wa gataʼo waadi Khidruun.Wa jo le jineene waahide wa dakhalo fiiha.
Wa Yahuuza al‑naadum al‑yukhuun Isa kula yaʼarif al‑bakaan da achaan Isa lamma foogah maʼa talaamiizah iddat marraat.
Wa Yahuuza ja fi l‑jineene maʼa askar Roomaaniyiin wa l‑hurraas al‑rassaloohum kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin wa l‑Fariiziyiin.Wa humman musallahiin wa chaayliin fawaaniis wa machaahiib yidawwu beehum.
Wa Isa irif kulla cheyy al‑yabga foogah wa macha leehum wa gaal : Tifattuchu yaatu ? 
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo : Nifattuchu Isa al‑min hillit al‑Naasira. Wa Isa gaal : Ana bas hu. Wa Yahuuza al‑khaayin gaaʼid fi usuthum.
Wa wakit Isa gaal : Ana bas hu ,humman kasso minnah wara wa wagaʼo fi l‑turaab.
Wa marra taaniye,hu saʼalaahum wa gaal : Tifattuchu yaatu ? Wa gaalo : Isa al‑min hillit al‑Naasira. 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Awwal ooreetku ana bas hu.Wa khalaas kan tidooruuni,khallu al‑naas al‑maʼaayi yamchu. 
Wa hu gaal al‑kalaam da achaan al‑kalaam al‑gaalah min awwal yitimm.Awwal hu gaal : Min al‑naas al‑inta anteetni,ma fi naadum waddar. 
Wa Simʼaan Butrus indah seef wa sallaah wa darab beyah abid kabiir rujaal al‑diin wa gataʼ adaanah al‑zeene.Wa usum al‑abid da Malkhus.
Wa Isa hajja le Butrus wa gaal : Dakhkhil seefak fi beetah.Maala ma nachrab min kaas al‑taʼab al‑abuuyi antaani ? 
Wa l‑askar maʼa kabiirhum wa l‑hurraas al‑rassaloohum kubaaraat al‑Yahuud karabo Isa wa rabbatooh.
Wa awwal cheyy,waddooh le Hanaan.Wa hu abu marit Gayaafa wa Gayaafa da kabiir rujaal al‑diin fi l‑sana di.
Wa Gayaafa da,hu bas al‑naadum al‑gaal le kubaaraat al‑Yahuud akheer leehum kan naadum waahid yumuut le l‑chaʼab.
Wa Simʼaan Butrus wa tilmiiz aakhar macho wara Isa.Wa l‑tilmiiz al‑aakhar maʼruuf le kabiir rujaal al‑diin wa achaan da,gidir dakhal fi fadaayit al‑beet maʼa Isa.
Wa Butrus wagaf barra fi khachum al‑beet.Wa l‑tilmiiz al‑maʼruuf le kabiir rujaal al‑diin marag le l‑khaddaama al‑masʼuula fi l‑baab wa hajja leeha wa wadda Butrus daakhal.
Wa l‑khaddaama saʼalatah le Butrus wa gaalat : Inta kula tilmiiz hana l‑raajil da ? Wa Butrus gaal : La,la. 
Al‑wata baarde.Wa l‑khaddaamiin wa l‑hurraas oogado naar fi kaanuun achaan yiddaffo.Wa Butrus gaaʼid yiddaffa maʼaahum.
Wa kabiir rujaal al‑diin gamma saʼal Isa min talaamiizah wa min taʼaaliimah.
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Ana hajjeet giddaam kulla l‑naas.Min al‑awwal,allamt al‑naas fi buyuut al‑sala wa fi beet Allah wa fi l‑bakaanaat al‑kulla l‑Yahuud yilimmu fooghum.Ma gult cheyy be achiir.
Maala tasʼalni ?Al‑naas al‑simʼo kalaami,asʼalhum min al‑kalaam al‑ana gultah leehum.Humman yaʼarfu al‑kalaam al‑ana gultah. 
Wa wakit gaal al‑kalaam da,waahid min al‑hurraas al‑waagfiin jambah chaddagah wa gaal : Kikkeef turudd le kabiir rujaal al‑diin be misil da ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Kan kalaami kidib,achhad fi l‑kidib.Laakin kan kalaami sahiih,maala darabtini ? 
Wa Hanaan wadda Isa murabbat le Gayaafa kabiir rujaal al‑diin.
Wa Simʼaan Butrus waagif yiddaffa fi l‑naar.Wa gaalo leyah : Inta kula ma waahid min talaamiizah ? Wa hu nakar wa gaal : La,ana ma tilmiizah. 
Wa waahid min khaddaamiin kabiir rujaal al‑diin hajja leyah.Wa hu akhu hana l‑naadum al‑Butrus gataʼ adaanah.Wa hu saʼal Butrus wa gaal : Ana ma chiftak maʼaayah fi l‑jineene walla ? 
Wa Butrus nakar battaan wa tawwaali al‑diik ooʼa.
Wa marago Isa min beet Gayaafa wa waddooh fi gasir al‑waali.Al‑wata bigat fajur.Al‑kubaaraat zaathum ma dakhalo fi gasir al‑waali al‑Roomaani achaan da yoom al‑iid.Wa kan dakhalo fi beet naadum ma Yahuudi,yinajjusu nufuushum wa ma yagdaro yaakulu acha iid al‑Fisha.
Wa achaan da,Bilaatus al‑waali marag leehum wa gaal : Chunu al‑tuhma al‑khatteetuuha fi l‑naadum da ? 
Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo : Al‑naadum da kan ma mujrim,ma nisallumuuh leek. 
Wa Bilaatus gaal : Chiiluuh wa chaaruʼuuh hasab gaanuunku. Wa l‑Yahuud gaalo : Gaanuunak ma yasmah leena achaan nahkumu le ayyi naadum be l‑moot. 
Be misil da,al‑kalaam al‑Isa gaalah fi l‑tariiga al‑yumuut beehabada yilhaggag.
Wa Bilaatus gabbal fi gasrah wa naada Isa.Wa saʼalah wa gaal : Inta malik al‑Yahuud walla ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Al‑suʼaal da,suʼaalak inta walla ?Walla suʼaal hana naas aakhariin ? 
Wa Bilaatus radda leyah wa gaal : Haay !Ana Yahuudi walla ?Gabiiltak inta bas wa kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin sallamook leyi.Chunu al‑cheyy al‑inta sawweetah ? 
Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Mamlakati ma mamlaka hana l‑dunya.Kan mamlakati hana l‑dunya,khaddaamiini yugummu yidaawusu achaan al‑Yahuud ma yakurbuuni.Wa laakin mulki ma jaayi min al‑dunya. 
Wa Bilaatus gaal : Ha,inta malik ? Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Misil inta gultah.Wa be l‑sahiih,fi chaan da bas ana mawluud wa jiit fi l‑dunya,achaan nachhad le l‑hagg.Ayyi naadum al‑yiriid al‑hagg yasmaʼ kalaami. 
Wa Bilaatus gaal : Chunu al‑hagg ? Wa wakit gaal al‑kalaam da,Bilaatus marag le l‑Yahuud wa gaal leehum : Ana ma ligiit foog al‑naadum da ayyi jariime.
Laakin fi aaditku waajib natlig masjuun waahid fi iid al‑Fisha.Tidooru natlig leeku malik al‑Yahuud walla ? 
Wa aato be hiss chadiid wa gaalo : La,ma hu !Atlig leena Baraabaas ! Wa Baraabaas da,hu sawri.
Wa Bilaatus wadda Isa daakhal wa amar askarah achaan yajluduuh.
Wa wakit jaladooh khalaas,al‑askar sawwo leyah taaj hana chook madfuur wa khattooh fi raasah wa labbasooh khalag loonah garadi misil khalag al‑malik.
Wa yaju giddaamah wa yuguulu : Salaam aleek,ya malik al‑Yahuud ! Wa gaaʼidiin yudugguuh amkufuuf.
Wa Bilaatus marag battaan.Wa hajja le l‑naas wa gaal : Chiifuuh,namurgah leeku achaan taʼarfu ana ma ligiit foogah jariime. 
Wa Isa marag laabis al‑taaj al‑sawwooh min al‑chook wa l‑khalag al‑garadi.Wa Bilaatus hajja leehum wa gaal : Daahu al‑raajil. 
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin wa khaddaamiinhum chaafooh wa aato foogah wa gaalo : Aktulah fi l‑saliib !Aktulah fi l‑saliib ! Wa Bilaatus gaal : Intu bas chiiluuh wa aktuluuh fi l‑saliib.Kan leyi ana,ma ligiit foogah khata al‑waajib leyah al‑moot. 
Wa laakin al‑Yahuud raddo leyah wa gaalo : Indina gaanuun wa hasab al‑gaanuun da,hu waajib yumuut achaan hu sawwa nafsah Ibn Allah. 
Wa wakit Bilaatus simiʼ al‑kalaam da,khoof chadiid karabah be ziyaada.
Wa Bilaatus gabbal fi gasrah wa saʼal Isa wa gaal : Inta jiit min ween ? Wa laakin Isa ma radda leyah.
Wa achaan da,Bilaatus gaal : Ma tidoor tihajji leyi walla ?Inta ma fihimt indi sulta foogak wa ana nagdar natilgak aw naktulak fi l‑saliib walla ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Inta ma indak sulta foogi illa l‑sulta al‑Allah antaaha leek.Wa achaan da,al‑naadum al‑sallamaani leek hu khaati minnak ziyaada. 
Wa wakit Bilaatus simiʼ al‑kalaam da,hu dawwar yatlig Isa laakin al‑Yahuud raddo leyah be hiss aali wa gaalo : Kan tatlig al‑naadum da,inta ma tiriid sultaan al‑Roomaaniyiin !Kan naadum yisawwi nafsah malik,hu yisawwi nafsah adu le sultaan al‑Roomaaniyiin. 
Wakit Bilaatus simiʼ al‑kalaam da,hu marag Isa wa gaʼad fi kursi al‑chariiʼa al‑gaaʼid fi l‑fadaay al‑muʼaddala be hujaar wa be kalaam ibraani usumha Gabbaasa.
Wa l‑yoom da,yoom al‑yijahhuzu foogah iid al‑Fisha wa l‑wata gaayle.Wa Bilaatus hajja le l‑Yahuud wa gaal : Chiifuuh,daahu malikku ! 
Wa aato wa gaalo : Aktulah !Aktulah !Aktulah fi l‑saliib ! Wa Bilaatus saʼalaahum wa gaal : Tidooru ana naktul malikku fi saliib walla ? Wa kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin raddo leyah wa gaalo : Ma indina malik illa sultaan al‑Roomaaniyiin. 
Wa khalaas,Bilaatus sallam Isa le l‑askar achaan yaktuluuh fi l‑saliib.Wa gammo chaalooh.
Wa Isa chaayil al‑saliib al‑dawwaro yaktuluuh foogah.Wa waddooh fi bakaan waahid usmah Bakaan al‑Jumjuma wa be kalaam ibraani usmah Juljusa.
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,taggo Isa fi l‑saliib wa taggo maʼaayah naaseen,waahid taggooh fi saliib be nussah al‑zeenaay wa l‑taani fi saliib aakhar be nussah al‑israay.Wa hu fi usuthum.
Wa Bilaatus khatta maktuub waahid fi raas al‑saliib.Wa l‑kalaam al‑maktuub foogah yuguul : Isa min al‑Naasira,malik al‑Yahuud. 
Wa salabo Isa gariib le l‑madiina wa achaan da,Yahuud katiiriin garo al‑kalaam al‑maktuub da.Wa katabooh be kalaam ibraani wa kalaam laatiini wa kalaam yuunaani.
Wa kubaaraat rujaal al‑diin hajjo le Bilaatus wa gaalo : Ma taktib :‹ Malik al‑Yahuud.› Laakin aktib :‹ Al‑naadum da gaal hu malik al‑Yahuud.› 
Wa Bilaatus radda leehum wa gaal : Al‑kalaam al‑katabtah ma nikhayyirah. 
Wa wakit al‑askar al‑arbaʼa salabo Isa khalaas,humman chaalo khulgaanah wa gassamoohum ambeenaathum.Wa jawwaaniiytah bas faddalat.Wa l‑jawwaaniiye hi kullaha matruura wa ma indaha khiyaate.
Wa achaan da,hajjo ambeenaathum wa gaalo : Ma nicharrutuuha.Nisawwu amʼiyeedaat wa l‑naadum al‑wagaʼat fi gismah yichiilha. Wa be misil da,kalaam al‑Kitaab tamma al‑buguul :﴾‍Humman gassamo khulgaani ambeenaathum wa sawwo amʼiyeedaat le lubaasi.‍﴿Wa da bas al‑cheyy al‑sawwooh al‑askar.
Wa fiyah awiin waagfaat gariib le l‑saliib al‑Isa gaaʼid foogah.Wa hinna ammah Mariyam wa khaaltah wa Mariyam marit Kuluuba wa Mariyam al‑Magdaliiye.
Wa Isa chaaf ammah wa chaaf al‑tilmiiz al‑hu yihibbah waagif gariib leeha.Wa hajja le ammah wa gaal : Mara zeene chiifiih,da wileedki. 
Wa hajja le tilmiizah wa gaal : Chiifha,di ammak. Wa l‑tilmiiz waddaaha fi beetah wa min al‑yoom da,hi sakanat maʼaayah.
Wa Isa irif kulla cheyy kammal.Wa hu hajja battaan achaan al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi sababah fi l‑Kitaab yitimm.Wa hu gaal : Ana atchaan. 
Wa fi l‑bakaan da,fi maaʼuun malaan be charaab haamud.Wa ballo gitʼe fi l‑charaab al‑haamud da wa chaʼagooha fi raas ageegaay hana zuufa wa rafaʼooha foog gariib le khachum Isa.
Wa Isa chirib min al‑charaab al‑haamud da wa gaal : Kulla cheyy tamma khalaas. Wa dangar raasah wa anta al‑ruuh.
Wa da l‑yoom al‑yijahhuzu foogah le yoom al‑sabt.Wa ambaakir,yoom kabiir fi l‑iid.Wa l‑Yahuud ma dawwaro al‑janaazaat dool yagoodu fi l‑saliib fi yoom al‑sabt.Wa achaan da,talabo min Bilaatus yikassuru rijileen al‑masluubiin achaan yumuutu ajala wa khalaas al‑janaazaat yidalluuhum.
Wa l‑askar jo le awwal naadum al‑salabooh maʼa Isa wa kassaro rijileenah wa sawwo nafs al‑cheyy le l‑taani.
Wa laakin wakit jo le Isa,chaafo hu mayyit khalaas.Wa achaan da ma kassaro rijileenah.
Laakin askari waahid taʼanah fi naaytah be harba wa tawwaali daffag minnah damm wa almi.
Al‑chaafah be eenah chaahid leyah wa chahaadtah sahiihe wa hu yaʼarif kalaamah sahiih wa hu yachhad achaan intu kula tiʼaamunu.
Wa l‑cheyy da bigi achaan kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Kitaab waajib yitimm.Wa l‑kalaam da buguul :﴾‍Waahid min udaamah kula ma yinkasir.‍﴿
Wa l‑Kitaab kula buguul :﴾‍Yichiifu al‑naadum al‑taʼanooh.‍﴿
Wa baʼad da,Yuusuf al‑min hillit al‑Raama macha le Bilaatus wa talab minnah janaazit Isa.Hu tilmiiz Isa wa laakin gaaʼid yitaabiʼah be sirr achaan hu khaayif min al‑Yahuud.Wa Bilaatus antaah izin wa Yuusuf macha chaal al‑janaaza.
Wa Nigudiimus al‑naadum al‑yoom waahid macha hajja maʼa Isa be l‑leel,hu kula macha maʼaayah wa jaab 30 kiilo hana dihin al‑mukhalbat be sibir wa be riihe usumha uud.
Wa chaalo janaazit Isa wa ballo gabag tawiil fi l‑dihin da wa laffo beyah al‑janaaza.Wa be misil da,kaffanooh hasab aadaat al‑Yahuud.
Wa fiyah jineene gariib le l‑bakaan al‑salabo foogah Isa.Wa fi l‑jineene fi khaburjadiid gaaʼid wa lissaaʼ ma dafano foogah naadum.
Wa l‑khabur da gariib.Wa l‑yoom al‑Yahuud yijahhuzu foogah le yoom al‑sabt gariib yikammil.Wa achaan da,dafano Isa fi l‑bakaan da.
Wa awwal yoom al‑subuuʼ wakit al‑wata lissaaʼ dalma,Mariyam al‑Magdaliiye gammat machat le l‑khabur wa chaafat kadar al‑hajar al‑kabiir al‑saddo beyah al‑khabur ma gaaʼid fi bakaanah.
Wa hi gammat jarat le Simʼaan Butrus wa le l‑tilmiiz al‑aakhar,al‑Isa yihibbah bilheen,wa gaalat leehum : Sayyidna chaalooh min al‑khabur wa ma naʼarfu al‑bakaan al‑waddooh foogah ! 
Wa Butrus wa l‑tilmiiz al‑aakhar marago wa chaalo al‑derib al‑maachi le l‑khabur.
Wa humman jaariyiin wa laakin al‑tilmiiz al‑aakhar sabagah le Butrus wa lihig al‑khabur gubbaalah.
Wa dangar taawag fi l‑khabur daakhal wa chaaf al‑kafan laakin hu ma andassa.
Wa Simʼaan Butrus wisil waraayah wa andassa tawwaali fi l‑khabur.Wa chaaf al‑kafan.
Wa l‑mindiil al‑rabato beyah raas Isa ma gaaʼid maʼa l‑kafan wa laakin gaaʼid fi bakaan wiheedah mutabbag adiil.
Wa l‑tilmiiz al‑aakhar al‑lihig al‑khabur gubbaal Butrus,hu kula andassa daakhal wa chaaf al‑khumaam wa aaman.
Laakin humman lissaaʼ ma fihmo min al‑Kitaab kadar Isa laabudda yabʼas min ust al‑maytiin.
Wa l‑talaamiiz gabbalo fi buyuuthum.
Wa laakin Mariyam waagfe jamb khachum al‑khabur wa gaaʼide tabki.Wa wakit gaaʼide tabki,hi dangarat wa taawagat fi l‑khabur daakhal.
Wa chaafat malaaʼika itneen khulgaanhum buyud.Humman gaaʼidiin tihit fi l‑bakaan al‑awwal janaazit Isa raagde foogah,waahid fi bakaan raasah wa waahid fi bakaan rijileenah.
Wa hajjo leeha wa gaalo : Mara zeene,maalki tabki ? Wa hi raddat leehum wa gaalat : Ana gaaʼide nabki achaan chaalo sayyidi wa ma naʼarif al‑bakaan al‑waddooh foogah. 
Wa baʼad hi gaalat al‑kalaam da,hi anlafatat wa chaafat Isa waagif waraaha wa laakin ma irfat kadar da Isa.
Wa Isa hajja leeha wa gaal : Mara zeene,maala tabki ?Tifattichi yaatu ? Wa fi fikirha,hu al‑khaddaam al‑yakhdim fi l‑jineene wa raddat leyah wa gaalat : Al‑sayyid,kan inta chiltah,ooriini al‑bakaan al‑khatteetah foogah wa ana niwaddiih fi bakaan aakhar. 
Wa Isa hajja leeha wa gaal : Mariyam. Wa anlafatat chaafatah adiil wa gaalat : Ya rabbunaay ! Wa da,maʼanaatah  ya muʼallim  be kalaam ibraani.
Wa Isa hajja leeha wa gaal : Ma takurbiini.Ana lissaaʼ ma talaʼt le Allah abuuyi.Amchi le akhwaani wa ooriihum ana taaliʼ le abuuyi wa abuuku wa le Ilaahi wa Ilaahku. 
Wa Mariyam al‑Magdaliiye machat le talaamiizah wa gaalat : Ana chift sayyidna ! Wa oorathum be kulla cheyy al‑hu gaalah leeha.
Wa fi nafs al‑yoom,yaʼni yoom al‑ahad,fi l‑achiiye al‑talaamiiz laammiin fi bakaan waahid wa l‑biibaan mugaffaliin achaan humman khaayfiin min al‑Yahuud.Wa Isa ja wa wagaf fi usuthum wa gaal : Al‑salaam aleekum ! 
Wa baʼad hu sallamaahum,hu wassafaahum iideenah wa naaytah.Wa wakit al‑talaamiiz chaafo sayyidhum,humman firho farha chadiide.
Wa Isa hajja leehum battaan wa gaal : Al‑salaam aleekum.Misil abuuyi rassalaani,ana kula nirassilku. 
Wa baʼad hu gaal al‑kalaam da,hu nafakh fooghum wa gaal : Akhbalo al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Al‑naadum al‑intu tisaamuhu leyah zunuubah,Allah yakhfir leyah.Wa l‑naadum al‑intu ma tisaamuhu leyah zunuubah,Allah ma yakhfir leyah. 
Wa Tuuma hu waahid min al‑talaamiiz al‑atnaachar wa usmah al‑aakhar Chigg al‑Toom.Wa hu ma gaaʼid maʼaahum wakit Isa ja fi usuthum.
Wa l‑talaamiiz al‑aakhariin oorooh beyah wa gaalo : Aniina chifna sayyidna ! Wa laakin hu radda leehum wa gaal : Kan ana ma chift be eeni bakaan al‑musmaar fi iideenah wa kan ma khatteet usbaʼi fi bakaan al‑musmaar wa kan ma limistah fi naaytah be iidi,abadan ma niʼaamin ! 
Wa baʼad usbuuʼ,talaamiiz Isa lammo battaan fi nafs al‑beet wa Tuuma maʼaahum.Wa l‑biibaan mugaffaliin wa laakin Isa ja wa baan fi usuthum.Wa Isa sallamaahum wa gaal : Al‑salaam aleekum. 
Wa hajja le Tuuma wa gaal : Khutt usbaʼak hini wa chiif iideeni.Midd iidak wa almasni fi naayti.Khalli minnak al‑chakak wa aamin ! 
Wa Tuuma radda leyah wa gaal : Inta Rabbi.Inta Ilaahi ! 
Wa Isa gaal : Inta aamant achaan chiftini.Mabruuk le l‑naas al‑yiʼaamunu beyi kan ma chaafooni kula. 
Wa wakit Isa gaaʼid maʼa talaamiizah,hu sawwa ajaayib katiiriin al‑ma maktuubiin fi l‑kitaab da.
Laakin al‑kalaam al‑maktuub hini ankatab achaan intu tisaddugu kadar Isa hu al‑Masiih wa Ibn Allah wa tiʼaamunu beyah wa talgo be usmah al‑haya al‑abadiiye.
Wa baʼadeen Isa baan battaan le talaamiizah jamb bahar Tibiriyaas.Wa daahu kikkeef hu baan leehum.
Yoom waahid,Simʼaan Butrus wa Tuuma al‑binaaduuh Chigg al‑Toom wa Natanaayil al‑min hillit Kaana fi daar al‑Jaliil wa awlaad Zabadi wa talaamiiz itneen aakhariin gaaʼidiin fi bakaan waahid.
Wa Simʼaan Butrus hajja leehum wa gaal : Ana namchi nihawwit. Wa gaalo leyah : Namchu maʼaak. Wa marago wa rikbo fi l‑markaba wa laakin tuul al‑leel ma karabo cheyy.
Wa fajur badri,Isa ja wagaf fi khachum al‑bahar wa l‑talaamiiz ma irfooh kadar da Isa.
Wa Isa saʼalaahum wa gaal : Ya l‑awlaad,karabtu huut walla ? Wa raddo leyah wa gaalo : La,ma karabna. 
Wa gaal leehum : Azgulu charakku fi l‑nuss al‑zeenaay hana l‑markaba wa takurbu huut. Wa zagalo charakhum wa karabo huut katiir lahaddi ma gidro karrooh foog fi l‑markaba.
Wa l‑tilmiiz al‑Isa yihibbah hajja le Butrus wa gaal : Da Rabbina ! Wa wakit Simʼaan Butrus simiʼ kadar da al‑Rabb,hu gamma rabat khalagah fi sulbah achaan hu awwal sallaah le l‑khidme wa natta fi l‑bahar.
Wa l‑talaamiiz al‑aakhariin jo waraayah be l‑markaba wa gaaʼidiin yukurru al‑charak al‑malaan huut.Humman ma baʼiid min khachum al‑bahar illa misil 200 duraaʼ.
Wa wakit marago min al‑markaba khalaas,chaafo kaanuun malaan jamur wa huutaay foogah wa khubza.
Wa Isa hajja leehum wa gaal : Jiibu waahidiin min al‑huut al‑dahaaba karabtuuhum. 
Wa Simʼaan Butrus gamma wa karra al‑charak fi khachum al‑bahar wa l‑charak malaan huut kubaar.Wa adadah 153.Al‑huut katiir bilheen wa laakin al‑charak ma angataʼ.
Wa Isa naada al‑talaamiiz wa gaal : Taʼaalu afturu. Ma fi naadum minhum haawal yasʼalah wa yuguul : Inta yaatu ? Achaan fi guluubhum,irfo da al‑Rabb Isa.
Wa Isa gamma chaal al‑khubza wa antaahum minha wa sawwa nafs al‑cheyy be l‑huut.
Wa di taalit marra Isa baan le talaamiizah min hu baʼas min ust al‑maytiin.
Wa wakit fataro khalaas,Isa saʼal Simʼaan Butrus wa gaal : Simʼaan wileed Yuuhanna,tihibbini mahabba chadiide ziyaada min al‑aakhariin walla ? Wa Simʼaan Butrus radda leyah wa gaal : Aywa sayyidna,taʼarif nihibbak. Wa Isa gaal leyah : Asrah be humlaani. 
Wa marra taaniye saʼalah wa gaal : Simʼaan wileed Yuuhanna,tihibbini mahabba chadiide walla ? Wa Simʼaan Butrus radda leyah wa gaal : Aywa sayyidna,taʼarif nihibbak. Wa Isa gaal leyah : Asrah be khanami. 
Wa marra taalta Isa saʼalah wa gaal : Simʼaan wileed Yuuhanna,tihibbini walla ? Wa bigi le Simʼaan Butrus gaasi bilheen achaan talaata marraat Isa saʼalah wa gaal : Tihibbini walla ? Wa Butrus radda leyah wa gaal : Sayyidna,taʼarif kulla cheyy.Wa taʼarif nihibbak. Wa Isa gaal leyah : Asrah be khanami.
Asmaʼ nuguul leek al‑hagg,wakit inta sakhayyar,inta rabatt sulbak wa macheet misil dawwartah.Laakin wakit tabga kabiir,timidd iideenak wa naadum aakhar yarbutak wa yiwaddiik fi bakaan al‑inta ma tidoor tamchi foogah. 
Wa Isa gaal al‑kalaam da achaan yiʼoori Butrus be tariiga al‑beeha yumuut wa yimajjid Allah.Wa baʼad da,Isa gaal : Taabiʼni. 
Wa Butrus anlafat wa chaaf waraahum al‑tilmiiz al‑Isa yihibbah.Wa da bas al‑tilmiiz al‑takka wara lahaddi lihig sadur Isa wakit gaaʼidiin yilʼachcho wa gaal : Sayyidna,yaatu al‑naadum al‑yidoor yukhuunak ? 
Wa Butrus chaaf Isa wa gaal : Ya sayyidna,tuguul chunu fi l‑naadum da ? 
Wa Isa radda leyah wa gaal : Kan ana nidoor hu yagood lahaddi nigabbil kula,da ma lammaak.Inta taabiʼni bas ! 
Wa min al‑yoom da,naas gaalo al‑tilmiiz da ma yumuut.Wa l‑kalaam da chattat fi ust al‑akhwaan.Laakin Isa ma gaal le Butrus kadar al‑tilmiiz al‑aakhar ma yumuut.Hu gaal : Kan nidoor hu yagood lahaddi nigabbil kula,da ma lammaak. 
Wa da bas al‑tilmiiz al‑gaaʼid yachhad le Isa fi l‑kalaam da.Wa hu bas al‑katab kulla l‑kalaam fi l‑Kitaab da wa naʼarfu chahaadtah sahiihe.
Wa Isa sawwa achya ziyaada ma maktuubiin fi l‑kitaab da.Wa fi fikri ana,kan dawwaro yaktubu kulla l‑achya dool,al‑dunya kullaha ke ma tagdar tichiil al‑kutub al‑yaktubuuhum.
Ya l‑sayyid Saawufiilus,fi l‑kitaab al‑awwal al‑ana katabtah leek,ooreetak be kulla cheyy al‑Isa bada yisawwiih wa be kulla cheyy al‑allamah min bidaayit khidimtah
lahaddi l‑yoom al‑Allah rafaʼah fi l‑samaawaat.Wa gubbaal Allah ma yarfaʼah,Isa hajja le l‑naas al‑azalaahum le yabgo rusul wa amaraahum be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Baʼad mootah,Isa sabbat leehum be dalaayil katiiriin kadar hu hayy.Wa gaaʼid yibiin leehum fi muddit arbaʼiin yoom wa yikallim leehum be mamlakat Allah.
Wa wakit hu gaaʼid maʼaahum hu gaal : Ma tamurgu min Madiinat al‑Khudus.Arjo lahaddi abuuku Allah yantiiku al‑baraka al‑hu waaʼadaaku beeha wa ana zaati ooreetku beeha.
Yahya khattas al‑naas fi l‑almi wa laakin baʼad ayyaam bas,Allah yikhattisku be l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus. 
Wa wakit al‑rusul gaaʼidiin maʼa Isa,humman saʼalooh wa gaalo : Ya Rabbina,da bas al‑wakit al‑tidoor tiʼassis battaan mamlakat Israaʼiil walla ? 
Wa Isa radda leehum wa gaal : Abuuku Allah bas nazzam al‑awkaat be sultitah wa ma antaaku izin achaan taʼarfuuhum.
Wa laakin wakit al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yanzil foogku,talgo gudra achaan tachhado leyi fi Madiinat al‑Khudus wa fi kulla daar al‑Yahuudiiya wa fi daar al‑Saamira wa lahaddi aakhir al‑ard. 
Wa baʼad Isa gaal al‑kalaam da,anrafaʼ fi l‑sama wa humman chaayfiin Isa taaliʼ wa sahaab daaragah minhum.
Wa wakit humman gaaʼidiin yisanguʼu foog fi l‑sama wa Isa maachi minhum,rujaal itneen khulgaanhum buyud baano jambuhum
wa gaalo : Ya rujaal daar al‑Jaliil,maalku intu waagfiin tisanguʼu foog fi l‑sama ?Chiftu Isa taaliʼ minku wa faat fi l‑sama.Wa be nafs al‑tariiga di,hu yigabbil min al‑sama fi l‑ard ! 
Wa da bigi fi hajar usmah jabal al‑Zaytuun misil kiilomitir waahid min Madiinat al‑Khudus.Wa baʼad da,al‑rusul dallo min al‑hajar wa gabbalo fi l‑madiina.
Wa l‑rusul gabbalo fi l‑madiina wa dakhalo fi l‑beet wa talaʼo fi l‑gasir al‑gaaʼidiin foogah.Wa l‑naas dool,humman Butrus wa Yuuhanna wa Yaakhuub wa Andareeyas wa Filibbus wa Tuuma wa Bartulma wa Matta wa Yaakhuub wileed Halfa wa Simʼaan al‑Sawri wa Yahuuza wileed Yaakhuub.
Wa kulluhum gaaʼidiin yilimmu daayman wa yisallu be niiye waahide wa awiin waahidaat kula gaaʼidaat yilimman maʼaahum wa Mariyam amm Isa wa akhwaanah.
Wa yoom waahid,Butrus gamma fi ust al‑akhwaan.Adadhum misil 120 naadum.Wa hu kallam leehum wa gaal :
 Ya l‑akhwaan,al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Kitaab,waajib yitimm.Zamaan,al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus kallam be waasitat al‑nabi Dawuud fi Yahuuza.Hu al‑wadda al‑naas le Isa achaan yakurbuuh.
Wa Yahuuza da,hu waahid minnina wa sawwa maʼaana nafs al‑khidme. 
Wa Yahuuza chaal al‑gurus al‑awwal saʼalah min al‑kubaaraat achaan yukhuun Isa wa chara beyah zereʼ.Wa fi l‑zereʼ da,hu wagaʼ wa batnah anchaggat wa kulla masaariinah daffago.
Wa kulla naas Madiinat al‑Khudus irfo al‑cheyy al‑bigi lahaddi sammo al‑zereʼ be kalaamhum Hakhil Damma,maʼanaatah zereʼ al‑damm.
Wa Butrus gaal : Al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Zabuur buguul :﴾‍Khalli beetah yakhrab wa naadum ma yaskun foogah.‍﴿Wa battaan maktuub :﴾‍Khalli naadum aakhar yibaddilah.‍﴿
Wa achaan da,waajib leena naʼazulu naadum waahid min al‑rujaal al‑gaaʼidiin maʼaana fi kulla l‑wakit al‑Rabbina Isa gaaʼid maʼaana,
min Yahya khattasah fi almi lahaddi l‑yoom al‑Allah rafaʼah minnina wa chaalah fi l‑sama.Wa l‑naadum al‑naʼazuluuh yabga chaahid maʼaana fi buʼaas Isa. 
Wa gaddamo rujaal itneen.Wa l‑waahid hu Yuusuf Baar Saaba al‑usmah al‑aakhar Yustus wa l‑taani hu Mattiyaas.
Wa daʼo wa gaalo : Ya Rabbina,inta taʼarif guluub kulla l‑naas.Wassif leena yaatu min al‑rujaal al‑itneen dool al‑inta azaltah.
Hu yabga rasuul wa yichiil khidmit Yahuuza al‑khallaaha wa faat macha le l‑bakaan al‑waajib leyah. 
Wa sawwo leehum amʼiyeedaat wa wagaʼ fi Mattiyaas.Wa Mattiyaas lamma maʼa l‑rusul al‑ihdaachar.
Wa fi yoom hana iid al‑Khamsiin,kulla l‑akhwaan gaaʼidiin sawa laammiin fi bakaan waahid.
Wa fajʼatan min al‑sama,ansamaʼ hiss chadiid misil riih chadiide gaaʼide tanfukh wa mala al‑beet al‑humman gaaʼidiin foogah.
Wa chaafo cheyy yichaabih lisne al‑naar chattato wa nazalo fi ayyi waahid minhum.
Wa ayyi naadum anmala be l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus wa gamma yihajji be lukhkha aakhara be gudrat al‑Ruuh da.
Wa fi l‑wakit da,Madiinat al‑Khudus malaane be Yahuud takhiyiin al‑jo min kulla buldaan al‑dunya.
Wa naas katiiriin simʼo al‑haraka wa lammo fi l‑bakaan al‑akhwaan gaaʼidiin foogah.Wa alʼajjabo marra waahid achaan ayyi naadum simiʼ kalaamhum be lukhkhitah.
Wa barjalo bilheen wa alʼajjabo marra waahid.Wa gammo yihajju ambeenaathum wa yuguulu : Al‑naas al‑yihajju dool ma min daar al‑Jaliil walla ?
Kikkeef ayyi waahid minnina simiʼ humman yikallumu be lukhkhitna ?
Wa fi naas usutna min buldaan katiiriin misil al‑Fartiya wa l‑Maadi wa Ilaam.Wa fi sukkaan hana balad been al‑Nahreen wa naas min daar al‑Yahuudiiya wa min Kabbaduukiiya wa Buntus wa Aasiya
wa Firigiiya wa Bamfiiliya wa Masir wa min taraf Liibiya gariib le hillit al‑Khayrawaan.Wa fi diifaan katiiriin jo min madiinat Rooma
wa fi naas Yahuud wa fi naas aakhariin dakhalo fi diin al‑Yahuud.Wa fi naas waahidiin min jaziirat Kiriit wa min daar al‑Arab.Wa aniina kullina gaaʼidiin nasmaʼoohum yihajju be lukhkhitna be l‑ajaayib al‑kubaar al‑Allah sawwaahum. 
Wa kulluhum alʼajjabo wa barjalo wa gaaʼidiin yissaaʼalo ambeenaathum wa yuguulu : Al‑cheyy al‑gaaʼid yabga da,maʼanaatah chunu ? 
Wa laakin naas waahidiin yichchammato le l‑muʼminiin wa yuguulu : Humman sakraaniin. 
Butrus gamma maʼa l‑rusul al‑ihdaachar.Wa hu kallam le l‑naas be hiss chadiid wa gaal : Ya akhwaani al‑Yahuud wa kulla l‑diifaan al‑gaaʼidiin fi Madiinat al‑Khudus,asmaʼo kalaami wa nifassir leeku al‑cheyy al‑bigi.
Intu gultu al‑naas dool sakraaniin.Wa da ma sahiih.Yaatu al‑yaskar fi l‑saaʼa tisʼa hana l‑fajur ?
Wa laakin al‑cheyy al‑simiʼtuuh da,hu al‑cheyy al‑nabi Yuwiil kallam beyah.
Hu gaal :﴾‍Fi l‑zaman al‑akhiir,ana ninazzil Ruuhi fi kulla l‑naas.Wa da bas kalaam Allah.Awlaadku wa banaatku yitnabbaʼowa subyaanku yichiifu ruʼyawa chiyyaabku yahlamo be hilim.
Wa fi l‑zaman da,abiidi wa khadiimi kulaninazzil fooghum Ruuhiwa yitnabbaʼo.
Wa nisawwi ajaayib foog fi l‑samawa alaamaat tihit fi l‑ard.Wa l‑naas yichiifu dammwa naar wa dukhkhaan azrag.
Wa l‑harraay tabga zargawa l‑gamar yabga ahmar misil al‑damm.Wa da gubbaal yoom Allah ma yajiwa hu yoom aziim wa majiid.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yadʼibe usum Allah yanja.‍﴿
 Ya Bani Israaʼiil,asmaʼo kalaami !Allah wassaf leeku sultit Isa al‑min al‑Naasira.Achaan beyah hu Allah sawwa aʼmaal kubaar wa ajaayib wa alaamaat fi usutku.Wa intu zaatku taʼarfuuh adiil.
Wa min awwal,Allah irif al‑cheyy al‑yabga.Wa be niiytah al‑saabte,Allah sallam leeku Isa.Wa intu astafagtu maʼa l‑naas al‑fasliin le taktuluuh fi l‑saliib.
Wa laakin Allah baʼasah min ust al‑maytiin wa dammar taʼab al‑moot achaan ma mumkin al‑moot yinnasir foogah.
Wa l‑nabi Dawuud hajja beyah fi l‑Kitaab wa gaal :﴾‍Chift Allah daayman giddaami.Achaan hu gaaʼid be zeenaayti,ana ma nittartaʼ.
Wa fi chaan da,galbi yafrahwa lisaani yikhanni be farah.Wa jismi yargud be acham
achaan inta ma tikhalliini fi ust al‑maytiin.La,inta ma tikhalli janaazit abdak al‑Khudduustabga turaab.
Inta arraftini derib al‑hayawa tantiini farah be katara fi hadaratak.‍﴿
 Ya l‑akhwaan,khalli niʼooriiku be kalaam waadih kadar jiddina Dawuud maat wa dafanooh wa khaburah gaaʼid fi hillitna lahaddi l‑yoom.
Dawuud kaan nabi.Wa hu irif kadar Allah halaf leyah wa gaal kadar hu yukhutt waahid min zurriiytah fi kursi al‑malik.
Wa Dawuud chaaf buʼaas al‑Masiih min zamaan wa akkadah wa gaal kadar Allah ma yikhalli al‑Masiih fi ust al‑maytiin wa la yikhalli janaaztah tabga turaab.
 Wa Isa da,Allah baʼasah wa aniina chifnaah wa kullina chuhuud leyah.
Wa Allah rafaʼ Isa wa gaʼʼadah fi jambah fi nussah al‑zeenaay.Hassaʼ Allah abuuh antaah al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus al‑waaʼadaana beyah min zamaan wa Isa nazzalah foogna.Wa be misil da bas,al‑cheyy al‑intu gaaʼidiin tichiifuuh wa tasmaʼooh bigi.
Wa Dawuud da,hu ma anrafaʼ fi l‑sama.Hu al‑naadum al‑gaal :‹ Allah hajja le siidi al‑malik wa gaal :﴾‍Agood be nussi al‑zeenaay
lahaddi nukhutt udwaanak tihit rijileenak.‍﴿›
 Khalaas,khalli ayyi naadum min Bani Israaʼiil yaʼarif bala chakak kadar Isa al‑intu kataltuuh fi l‑saliib,Allah jaʼalah siidku al‑Masiih ! 
Wa wakit al‑naas simʼo al‑kalaam da,galibhum anjarah marra waahid wa saʼalo Butrus wa l‑rusul al‑aakhariin wa gaalo : Ya akhwaanna,waajib nisawwu chunu ? 
Wa Butrus radda leehum wa gaal : Tuubu min zunuubku wa ayyi waahid minku yikhattusuuh be usum Isa al‑Masiih.Wa Allah yakhfir leeku zunuubku wa yantiiku al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Achaan Allah gaal hu yanti al‑baraka di leeku wa le iyaalku wa le kulla l‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin fi bakaan baʼiid,aywa le ayyi naadum al‑Rabbina Allah yinaadiih. 
Wa Butrus gaaʼid yachhad le Isa giddaam al‑naas wa hajja leehum kalaam katiir achaan yijiibhum fi l‑derib.Hu gaal : Tuubu wa tanjo.Ma titaabuʼu naas wakitna al‑muwaddiriin dool. 
Wa l‑naas al‑aamano be kalaamah khattasoohum.Wa fi l‑yoom da,adad al‑naas al‑aamano wa l‑lammo maʼa l‑muʼminiin 3 000 naadum.
Wa be niiye waahide kulla l‑muʼminiin gammo yinkarbu fi taʼliim al‑rusul wa l‑haya al‑akhawiiye wa acha al‑Masiih wa l‑salaawaat.
Wa Allah anta ajaayib wa alaamaat katiiriin le l‑rusul wa khoof dakhal fi guluub al‑naas kulluhum.
Wa kulla l‑muʼminiin induhum niiye waahide wa ayyi naadum yajʼal maalah misil maal al‑akhwaan.
Wa gaaʼidiin yibiiʼu arduhum wa khumaamhum le yantu gurus le ayyi naadum hasab al‑hu hawjaan leyah.
Wa kulla yoom,gaaʼidiin yilimmu fi beet Allah wa yilʼachcho sawa fi buyuuthum be farah wa galib mukhlis.
Wa gaaʼidiin yachkuru Allah wa kulla l‑naas radyaaniin beehum.Wa kulla yoom,al‑Rabb gaaʼid yiziid adad al‑muʼminiin wa yinajji naas ziyaada.
Wa yoom waahid,Butrus wa Yuuhanna maachiin fi beet Allah achaan yisallu sala hana l‑saaʼa talaata.
Wa naadum waahid gaaʼid jamb baab hana beet Allah al‑usmah al‑baab al‑Jamiil.Wa min wildooh,hu maʼduur.Wa kulla yoom akhwaanah yiwadduuh wa yukhuttuuh hinaak achaan yihajjir wa yalga sadakha min al‑naas al‑yindasso fi beet Allah.
Wa wakit hu chaaf Butrus wa Yuuhanna jaayiin yadkhulu,hu saʼal minhum sadakha.
Wa wagafo wa chaafooh adiil wa Butrus gaal leyah : Hammirna adiil ! 
Wa hu chaafaahum wa fi fikrah,humman yidooru yantuuh sadakha.
Wa Butrus gaal : Ma indi fudda wa ma indi dahab laakin nantiik al‑cheyy al‑indi.Be usum Isa al‑Masiih al‑min al‑Naasira,nuguul leek gumm wa ruukh ! 
Wa Butrus karabah min iidah al‑zeene wa saaʼadah le yugumm.Wa tawwaali ke,hu ligi gudra wa rijileenah alfartago wa bigo saabtiin.
Wa natta foog wa gamma yuruukh wa dakhal maʼaahum fi beet Allah.Wa gaaʼid yuruukh wa yinattit wa yachkur Allah.
Wa kulla l‑naas hinaak chaafooh raayikh wa yachkur Allah.
Wa irfo da bas al‑maʼduur al‑yihajjir kulla yoom fi l‑baab al‑Jamiil hana beet Allah.Wa alʼajjabo marra waahid wa khaafo min al‑cheyy al‑bigi.
Wa Butrus wa Yuuhanna jo fi bakaan waahid fi fadaayit beet Allah al‑usmah raakuubat Suleymaan wa l‑raajil gaaʼid yamsukhum wa naas katiiriin lammo fooghum wa alʼajjabo marra waahid.
Butrus chaaf kulla l‑naas al‑laammiin wa hajja leehum wa gaal : Ya Bani Israaʼiil,maalku ajjabtu fi l‑cheyy da ?Wa maalku tihammuruuna ?Fi fikirku,al‑raajil da gamma raakh be gudritna aniina ?Walla achaan aniina saalihiin ziyaada walla ?
Allah Rabb juduudna Ibraahiim wa Ishaakh wa Yaakhuub rafaʼ abdah Isa wa khattaah fi majdah.Wa da bas al‑naadum al‑intu sallamtuuh le l‑moot.Giddaam Bilaatus nakartuuh wakit hu dawwar yatilgah.
Intu abeetu ma dawwartu al‑naadum al‑saalih wa khudduus.Wa talabtu min al‑waali yatlig leeku kattaal al‑dimam fi badalah.
Wa khalaas,kataltu al‑naadum al‑yantiiku al‑haya.Wa laakin Allah baʼasah min ust al‑maytiin wa aniina chuhuud le buʼaasah.
Wa be sabab iimaanna be usum Isa,al‑raajil al‑tichiifuuh wa l‑taʼarfuuh da ligi gudra.Wa fi chaan al‑iimaan be usum Isa bas,hu ligi al‑aafe marra waahid wa kulluku chiftuuh be uyuunku.
 Ya akhwaani,ana naʼarif intu wa kubaaraatku abeetu al‑Masiih achaan ma iriftuuh.
Min zamaan,Allah kallam be waasitat kulla l‑anbiya wa gaal kadar al‑Masiih yatʼab wa khalaas da bas al‑cheyy al‑bigi.
Wa hassaʼ tuubu wa gabbulu le Allah achaan hu yamha zunuubku !
Wa Allah yantiiku salaam fi guluubku wa yirassil leeku marra taaniye Isa al‑hu azalah leeku gubbaal wa hu al‑Masiih.
Waajib yagood fi l‑sama lahaddi yoom al‑foogah Allah yijaddid kulla cheyy.Wa da misil hu gaalah min zamaan be waasitat al‑anbiya al‑saalihiin al‑rassalaahum.
Wa l‑nabi Muusa gaal :﴾‍Allah Ilaahku yigawwim leeku min akhwaanku nabi misli ana.Asmaʼo kalaamah wa sawwu kulla cheyy al‑yuguulah leeku.‍﴿
﴾‍Wa ayyi naadum al‑ma yasmaʼ kalaamah,waajib yafsuluuh min chaʼab Allah wa yahlak.‍﴿
 Be misil da,kulla l‑anbiya hajjo be wakitna da,min al‑nabi Samuwiil wa kulla l‑anbiya al‑jo waraayah.
Wa intu iyaal al‑anbiya dool wa ahal al‑muʼaahada al‑Rabbuku Allah sawwaaha maʼa juduudku wakit hu gaal le Ibraahiim :﴾‍Be zurriiytak bas nibaarik kulla l‑umam fi kulla l‑ard.‍﴿
Wa Allah rassal abdah Isa leeku intu awwal,gubbaal al‑umam al‑aakhariin,achaan yibaarikku wa yigabbil ayyi waahid min al‑derib al‑fasil. 
Wa wakit Butrus wa Yuuhanna gaaʼidiin yihajju le l‑naas al‑laammiin,rujaal al‑diin wa naas min al‑Sadduukhiyiin wa kabiir al‑askar hurraas beet Allah jo leehum.
Wa humman zaʼlaaniin achaan al‑rusul gaaʼidiin yiʼallumu al‑naas.Wa yuguulu Isa baʼas min ust al‑maytiin wa be da,akiid al‑naas kula yabʼaso.
