Ruuh Allah al‑baʼas Isa min ust al‑maytiin saakin fiiku.Wa misil da,akiid Allah al‑baʼas al‑Masiih min ust al‑maytiin kula yanti al‑haya le ajsaamku al‑yumuutu,be Ruuhah al‑saakin fiiku.
Khalaas ya akhwaani,be sabab al‑rahma al‑kabiire di,fi waajib foogna wa l‑waajib da ma bukhuss al‑tabiiʼa al‑insaaniiye.Ma waajib titaabuʼu fikir al‑insaan.
Kan tiʼiichu be gudrat al‑insaan,tumuutu.Laakin kan tahyo be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus,taktulu al‑zunuub al‑fi ajsaamku.
Achaan al‑naas al‑yuguudhum Ruuh Allah,humman bas awlaad Allah.
Wa Allah nazzal foogku Ruuhah ma achaan yisawwiiku abiid al‑aaychiin battaan be l‑khoof.La.Al‑Ruuh al‑nazzalah foogku,hu al‑Ruuh al‑yisawwiiku iyaal Allah.Wa be sabab al‑Ruuh da,kullina ninaaduuh be hiss aali : Abba,abuuna ! 
Al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus zaatah yachhad fi nufuusna kadar aniina iyaal Allah.
Wa kan aniina iyaalah,aniina kula misil wurraasah.Aniina wurraas Allah,aywa,wurraasah maʼa l‑Masiih.Achaan kan natʼabo maʼa l‑Masiih,nadkhulu maʼa l‑Masiih fi majdah kula.
Taʼab hana wakitna da,nahsibah chiyya wakit nifakkir fi l‑majd al‑Allah yibayyinah leena baʼadeen.
Yoom waahid,Allah yibayyin majd awlaadah.Wa kulla cheyy al‑Allah khalagah gaaʼid yitmanna jayyit al‑yoom da bilheen.
Achaan al‑khaliige zaatha fachalat,ma be niiyitha laakin be niiyit Allah al‑fachchalaaha.Wa be da kula,hi gaaʼide tarja be acham.
Wa yoom waahid,al‑khaliige zaatha tabga hurra min ubuudiiyit al‑damaar.Wa khalaas,hi tichaarik fi l‑hurriiye al‑majiide hana iyaal Allah.
Naʼarfu kadar lahaddi l‑yoom al‑khaliige kullaha gaaʼide tatʼab be taʼab misil wajaʼ al‑talaga.
Wa l‑khaliige ma tatʼab wiheedha.Aniina indina al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus wa da misil awwal intaaj al‑Allah antaah leena.Wa aniina kula naguntu fi daakhilna achaan narjo Allah yikammil amalah foogna wa yisawwiina iyaalah wakit yafda ajsaamna.
Wa Allah antaana al‑acham da,wakit najjaana.Wa kan naadum buguul hu yarja cheyy waahid wa laakin ligiih khalaas,da ma al‑raja.Yaatu al‑yarja al‑cheyy al‑ligiih khalaas ?
Laakin kan narjo cheyy waahid lissaaʼ baʼiid chiyya ma binchaaf,narjooh be l‑sabur.
Wa misil da,al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus kula yiʼaawinna achaan aniina daʼiifiin.Ma naʼarfu kikkeef waajib nisallu laakin al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yisalli leena be ganitiin al‑ma bingaal.
Wa Allah al‑yichiif guluub al‑naas,yaʼarif niiyit al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus achaan al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yilwassat le l‑saalihiin hasab al‑yidoorah Allah.
Wa naʼarfu kadar fi kulla cheyy,Allah yisawwi al‑kheer le l‑naas al‑yihibbuuh wa humman al‑naas al‑Allah naadaahum fi derbah le yitabbugu khittitah.
Achaan al‑naas al‑Allah irifaahum min awwal,hu chaal niiye achaan yisawwiihum yichaabuhu Ibnah Isa al‑Masiih wa misil da,Ibnah Isa al‑Masiih yukuun al‑bikir wa maʼaayah akhwaan katiiriin.
Wa l‑naas al‑Allah azalaahum,hu naadaahum.Wa l‑naas al‑naadaahum dool,hu sawwaahum saalihiin.Wa l‑sawwaahum saalihiin dool,hu antaahum majdah.
Wa khalaas baʼad kulla l‑kalaam da,nuguulu chunu ?Kan Allah maʼaana,ma fi al‑yugumm diddina.
Allah ma aba ma yantiina Ibnah al‑waahid,laakin sallamah le l‑moot fi chaanna kullina.Wa hu al‑antaana Ibnah ma yantiina kulla cheyy maʼa Ibnah walla ?
Yaatu al‑yatham al‑naas al‑Allah azalaahum ?Ma fi !Allah ma yathamhum.Hu bas al‑yibarriihum.
Yaatu al‑yiʼaakhibhum ?Ma fi !Al‑Masiih Isa ma yiʼaakhibhum.Be l‑aks,hu bas al‑maat fi chaanna.Wa ziyaada min da,hu baʼas wa gaaʼid jamb Allah fi nussah al‑zeenaay wa bigi leena wasiit.
Chunu al‑yagdar yafrugna min mahabbat al‑Masiih leena ?Ma fi !Wa la l‑taʼab wa la l‑diige wa la l‑azaab wa la l‑juuʼ wa la l‑ire wa la l‑khutuura wa la l‑moot.
Wa maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Fi chaanak inta,yaktuluuna kulla yoom wa yajʼaloona misil khanam al‑juzur.‍﴿
Wa laakin kulla l‑suʼuubaat dool,aniina ninnasru fooghum nasur kabiir be l‑Masiih al‑yihibbina.
Wa nuguul leeku akiid,ma fi cheyy al‑yagdar yafrugna min mahabbat Allah leena.Wa la l‑moot wa la l‑haya,wa la l‑malaaʼika wa la kubaaraat al‑chawaatiin wa la cheyy hana l‑zaman al‑haadir wa la cheyy hana l‑zaman al‑jaayi
wa la l‑khuwwaat al‑foog wa la l‑khuwwaat al‑tihit wa la ayyi makhluug,abadan ma fi cheyy yafrugna min mahabbat Allah leena al‑gaaʼide fi l‑Masiih Isa Rabbina.
Nuguul leeku al‑hagg be usum al‑Masiih wa kalaami ma kidib.Wa galbi yachhad leyi maʼa l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus kadar kalaami sahiih.
Ana haznaan bilheen wa galbi daayman boojaʼni.
Ana nitmanna Allah yalʼanni wa yafrugni ana zaati min al‑Masiih,kan be da naas gabiilti yanjo achaan humman akhwaani.
Humman Bani Israaʼiil,al‑chaʼab al‑Allah azalaahum le yabgo iyaalah wa jahhaz leehum al‑majd.Wa sawwa maʼaahum muʼaahadaat wa nazzal leehum al‑Tawraat wa antaahum al‑ibaada.Wa leehum humman,antaahum al‑wuʼuud
wa l‑juduud al‑awwalaaniyiin.Wa l‑Masiih zaatah mawluud insaan minhum wa hu al‑Rabb foog kulla cheyy wa l‑chukur waajib le Allah ila l‑abad.Aamiin.
Ma tukhuttu fi uguulku kadar waʼad Allah al‑antaah le Bani Israaʼiil fachal.Achaan Bani Israaʼiil ma kulluhum chaʼab Allah.
Wa zamaan kula,Allah ma hasab kulla iyaal Ibraahiim zurriiytah,laakin gaal :﴾‍Min Ishaakh bas talga zurriiye al‑binaaduuha be usmak.‍﴿
Wa min al‑kalaam da,al‑naas al‑jo min sulub Ibraahiim ma yahsubuuhum kulluhum iyaal Allah.Illa l‑naas al‑wildoohum hasab waʼad Allah,humman dool bas yahsubuuhum zurriiytah.
Achaan Allah waaʼad Ibraahiim be l‑kalaam al‑buguul :﴾‍Fi l‑sana al‑jaaye fi nafs al‑wakit,ana naji wa nalga martak Saara wildat leek wileed.‍﴿
Wa ziyaada min al‑kalaam da,fakkuru fi Rifga kula.Hi bigat khalbaane wa iyaalha induhum abu waahid wa hu jiddina Ishaakh.
Laakin gubbaal al‑tiimaan ma yaldoohum wa gubbaal humman ma yisawwu cheyy wa la zeen wa la fasil,Allah chaal niiye wa azal waahid minhum achaan niiyit Allah titimm be l‑ikhtiyaar.
Hu yinaadi al‑naas hasab niiytah wa ma hasab al‑cheyy al‑yisawwuuh.Wa khalaas gaal le Rifga :﴾‍Al‑kabiir yakhdim le l‑sakhayyar.‍﴿
Wa l‑Kitaab zaatah buguul :﴾‍Ana habbeet Yaakhuub wa abeet Isuu.‍﴿
Wa fi l‑kalaam da,nuguulu chunu ?Nuguulu Allah hu zaalim walla ?Abadan,ma ke !
Achaan Allah gaal le Muusa :﴾‍Ana nihinn ayyi naadum al‑nidoor nihinnah wa narham ayyi naadum al‑nidoor narhamah.‍﴿
Wa be misil da kan Allah azal naadum,da ma achaan niiyit al‑naadum wa ma achaan al‑cheyy al‑naadum sawwaah.Allah azalah achaan hu dawwar yarhamah bas.
Wa fi l‑Kitaab,Allah buguul le Firʼoon :﴾‍Ana sawweetak naadum kabiir achaan chilt niiye le niwassif foogak gudurti wa yihajju be usmi fi kulla l‑ard.‍﴿
Wa min al‑kalaam da,naʼarfu kadar Allah yarham al‑naadum al‑yidoor yarhamah wa yigawwi raas al‑naadum al‑yidoor yigawwi raasah.
Wa tasʼalni tuguul : Kan Allah yisawwi misil da,maala hu yuluum ayyi naadum ?Ween al‑naadum al‑yadhar niiyit Allah ? 
Laakin inta yaatu,ya insaan ?Fi fikrak tagdar tuluum Allah walla ?Kan usta sanaʼ chokhol waahid,hal al‑chokhol al‑sanaʼah da indah hagg yuguul : Maala sanaʼtini misil da ? 
Al‑haddaadi ma indah hagg foog al‑tiine walla ?Min koom waahid hana tiine,hu yudugg maaʼuun le amal khaass wa maaʼuun taani le amal aadi.Wa fi l‑masal da,al‑haddaadi hu Allah wa l‑mawaaʼiin humman al‑naas.
Wa tuguul chunu kan Allah dawwar yibayyin khadabah wa gudurtah fi l‑mawaaʼiin al‑hu khadbaan fooghum al‑jaahiziin le l‑halaak wa laakin tawwal himilaahum be sabur ?
Wa Allah himilaahum tawwal achaan dawwar yibayyin kutur kheerah al‑majiid le mawaaʼiin aakhariin al‑hu yidoor yarhamhum wa jahhazaahum le yadkhulu fi majdah.
Wa dool aniina al‑Allah naadaana,ma min ust al‑Yahuud bas laakin min kulla l‑umam.
Wa da yiwaafig maʼa l‑kalaam al‑gaalah fi kitaab al‑nabi Huuchaʼ.Gaal :﴾‍Al‑naas al‑awwal ma chaʼabi,ninaadiihum chaʼabi wa l‑chaʼab al‑awwal ma habbeethum,nuguul leehum : Ya l‑mahbuubiin.‍﴿
Wa gaal battaan :﴾‍Fi l‑bakaan al‑awwal Allah gaal foogah : Intu ma chaʼabi ,fi nafs al‑bakaan hu yuguul leehum : Intu iyaali ana Allah al‑Hayy.‍﴿
Wa laakin fi Bani Israaʼiil al‑nabi Ichaʼya hajja be hiss aali wa gaal :﴾‍Kan Bani Israaʼiil bigo katiiriin misil ramla hana khachum al‑bahar kula,chiyya minhum bas yanjo.
Achaan kharaar al‑damaar marag wa Allah yitabbigah ajala fi kulla l‑balad.‍﴿
Wa yabga misil Ichaʼya gaal yabga.Hu gaal :﴾‍Kan awwal Allah al‑Gaadir ma khalla leena zurriiye,aniina niddammaro misil naas Saduum wa nahlako misil naas Amuura.‍﴿
Fi kulla l‑kalaam da,nuguulu chunu ?Al‑naas al‑ma Yahuud ma jaahado le yabgo saalihiin wa laakin bigo saalihiin.Wa bigo saalihiin be derib al‑iimaan.
Wa Bani Israaʼiil taabaʼo churuut al‑Tawraat wa jaahado beehum le yabgo saalihiin laakin fachalo.
Wa da maala ?Achaan ma taabaʼo derib al‑iimaan.Wa fi fikirhum,humman yabgo saalihiin be sabab al‑amal al‑yisawwuuh.Wa khalaas,humman antaggo fi l‑hajar al‑yarmiihum.
Wa achaan da bas al‑Kitaab buguul :﴾‍Asmaʼo,ana nukhutt hajar fi Sahyuun.Be sababah,al‑naas yintaggo wa yagaʼo.Laakin ayyi naadum al‑yiʼaamin beyah abadan ma yakhjal.‍﴿
Ya akhwaani fi l‑Masiih,nitmanna be kulla galbi kadar akhwaani al‑Yahuud yanjo wa da l‑cheyy al‑ana daayman natulbah min Allah.
Ana nachhad leehum kadar humman munkaribiin fi ibaadat Allah laakin fiyah cheyy waahid ma yaʼarfuuh.
Humman ma yaʼarfu kikkeef Allah yisawwi al‑naas saalihiin wa khalaas yidooru yabgo saalihiin be juhudhum.Wa abo ma yakhbalo al‑derib al‑Allah fatahah le l‑naas al‑beyah yabgo saalihiin.
Achaan al‑Masiih ja wa tamma churuut al‑Tawraat wa be l‑Masiih kulla l‑naas yabgo saalihiin,kan yiʼaamunu beyah.
Wa fi l‑Kitaab,Muusa fassar leena kikkeef al‑naas yabgo saalihiin be churuut al‑Tawraat.Hu gaal :﴾‍Al‑naadum al‑yitabbig kulla l‑churuut dool yahya beehum.‍﴿
Laakin hu gaal battaan kikkeef al‑naas yabgo saalihiin be l‑iimaan.Maktuub :﴾‍Ma tuguul fi galbak,yaatu al‑yatlaʼ fi l‑sama ?‍﴿Yaʼni yinazzil al‑Masiih.
Wa battaan maktuub :﴾‍Ma tuguul yaatu al‑yanzil fi l‑haawiye ?‍﴿Yaʼni yamrug al‑Masiih min ust al‑maytiin.
Laakin al‑cheyy al‑buguulah chunu ?Buguul :﴾‍Al‑kalaam gaaʼid gariib leek.Hu fi khachmak wa fi galbak.‍﴿Wa l‑kalaam da,hu kalaam al‑iimaan al‑niballukhuuh leeku.
Kan be khachmak tachhad le Isa wa tuguul hu al‑Rabb wa fi galbak tiʼaamin kadar Allah baʼasah min ust al‑maytiin,be misil da tanja khalaas.
Achaan be sabab al‑iimaan al‑gaaʼid fi l‑galib,Allah yajʼal al‑naadum saalih wa be sabab chahaadat khachmah,Allah yinajjiih.
Al‑Kitaab buguul :﴾‍Ayyi naadum al‑yiʼaamin beyah abadan ma yakhjal.‍﴿
Wa da bigi sawa sawa le l‑Yahuud wa le l‑ma Yahuud achaan al‑Rabb al‑waahid,hu Rabb kulla l‑naas wa hu kariim le ayyi naadum al‑yadʼi be usmah.
Achaan maktuub :﴾‍Ayyi naadum al‑yadʼi be usum Allah yanja.‍﴿
Wa kikkeef yadʼu be l‑Rabb,kan ma aamano beyah ?Wa kikkeef yiʼaamunu be l‑Rabb,kan ma simʼo beyah ?Wa kikkeef yasmaʼo beyah,kan ma fi naadum ballakh leehum al‑bichaara ?
Wa kikkeef yiballukhu leehum al‑bichaara,kan ma rassaloohum ?Achaan da,al‑Kitaab buguul :﴾‍Marhaban be jayyit al‑mursaal al‑yiballikh al‑bichaara.‍﴿
Wa laakin ma kulla l‑naas khiblo al‑bichaara.Achaan da,al‑nabi Ichaʼya gaal :﴾‍Ya Allah,yaatu al‑aaman be khabarna ?‍﴿
Khalaas,al‑naas ma yabgo muʼminiin be l‑Masiih illa kan yasmaʼo al‑bichaara wa ma yasmaʼo al‑bichaara illa kan naadum yiballikhha leehum.
Laakin nasʼal cheyy waahid.Sahiih,al‑Yahuud lissaaʼ ma simʼo al‑bichaara di walla ?La,humman simʼooha.Al‑Kitaab buguul :﴾‍Hissuhum ansamaʼ fi kulla l‑ard,aywa kalaamhum lahaddi aakhir al‑dunya.‍﴿
Wa battaan nasʼal,Bani Israaʼiil ma fihmo al‑kalaam walla ?Awwal be khachum Muusa,Allah gaal :﴾‍Nisawwiiku hasuudiin be l‑chaʼab al‑ma tammo umma wa nizaʼʼilku be umma jaahle.‍﴿
Wa l‑nabi Ichaʼya gamma hajja kalaam Allah leehum bala chakak wa gaal :﴾‍Al‑naas al‑ligooni,humman ma al‑naas al‑fattachooni.Wa bayyant nafsi le naas al‑ma naadooni.‍﴿
Laakin fi Bani Israaʼiil,hu gaal :﴾‍Kulla yoom ana maddeet iideeni le chaʼab aasiyiin wa raashum gawi.‍﴿
Wa achaan da,ana nasʼal suʼaal.Allah aba chaʼabah Bani Israaʼiil marra waahid walla ?La,abadan.Ana zaati min Bani Israaʼiil wa min zurriiyit Ibraahiim wa min gabiilat Banyaamiin.
Allah ma aba chaʼabah al‑azalaahum min awwal.Walla nisiitu al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Kitaab al‑bukhuss al‑nabi Iliyaas ?Fi bakaan waahid,hu hajja le Allah wa chaka min Bani Israaʼiil
wa gaal :﴾‍Ya Allah,humman katalo al‑anbiya al‑rassaltuhum wa kassaro kulla madaabhak.Wa ana faddalt wiheedi wa humman yifattuchuuni le yaktuluuni.‍﴿
Wa laakin Allah radda leyah kikkeef ?Hu gaal :﴾‍Ana hafadt minhum 7 000 naas al‑abadan ma sajado giddaam ilaah Baʼal.‍﴿
Wa l‑cheyy al‑gaaʼid yabga hassaʼ,hu misil al‑cheyy al‑bigi fi l‑wakit daak.Faddalo naas chiyya bas al‑yitaabuʼu Allah wa humman al‑naas al‑Allah azalaahum be niʼmatah.
Wa kan di niʼma,da ma bigi be sabab ayyi cheyy al‑humman sawwooh.Achaan kan Allah azal al‑naas be sabab al‑cheyy al‑sawwooh,al‑niʼma ma tabga niʼma.
Wa da kikkeef ?Bani Israaʼiil ma ligo al‑cheyy al‑talabooh min Allah.Illa l‑naas al‑Allah azalaahum bas ligooh.Wa l‑aakhariin ruuseehum bigo gawiyiin.
Achaan da,maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Allah nazzal fooghum ruuh hana noom wa uyuunhum ma yichiifu wa udneehum ma yasmaʼo lahaddi l‑yoom.‍﴿
Wa l‑nabi Dawuud gaal :﴾‍Khalli dabalaayithum tabga leehumamkajjaama wa charak giddaamhum.Khalli barakaathum yabgo leehumchokhol al‑yintaggo foogah wa ikhaab.
Khalli uyuunhum yitoochuchuwa battaan ma yichiifuwa daayman aksir duhuurhum.‍﴿
Achaan da nasʼal.Humman wagaʼo marra waahid lahaddi battaan ma yugummu walla ?La,abadan.Humman wagaʼo wa be khataahum da,najaat Allah lihgat al‑naas al‑ma Yahuud achaan yisawwi al‑Yahuud yahsuduuhum.
Wa kan khata al‑Yahuud sabbab baraka kabiire le naas al‑dunya wa maskanat al‑Yahuud sabbabat baraka kabiire le l‑naas al‑ma Yahuud,akiid wakit al‑Yahuud yigabbulu marra waahid fi l‑derib,da yabga leena baraka kabiire be ziyaada.
Ya l‑naas al‑ma Yahuud,ana gaaʼid nihajji leeku.Ana al‑rasuul al‑murassal le l‑naas al‑ma Yahuud wa ana farhaan bilheen be khidimti
achaan akuun nisawwi akhwaani al‑Yahuud yahsuduuku wa akuun be misil da,ninajji waahidiin minhum.
Wakit Allah aba al‑Yahuud,naas al‑dunya ligo salaam maʼa Allah.Wa kan bigi misil da,yabga kikkeef wakit Allah yakhbal al‑Yahuud battaan ?Da yijiib buʼaas al‑maytiin.
Kan al‑intaaj al‑awwal hu khaass le Allah,al‑ajiin al‑yisawwuuh minha kula khaass le Allah.Wa kan khassaso uruug al‑chadara le Allah,furuuʼha kula khaassiin le Allah.
Wa misil da,zurriiyit Ibraahiim misil chadarat al‑zaytuun wa furuuʼ waahidiin gataʼoohum minha.Wa inta al‑ma Yahuudi,inta misil firiʼ hana l‑zaytuun al‑bandar.Wa chaalook wa lassagook fi l‑chadara al‑fi l‑jineene fi badal al‑furuuʼ al‑gataʼoohum.Wa misil da,inta kula tiʼiich min al‑uruug al‑adiiliin maʼa l‑furuuʼ al‑faddalo.
Wa be misil da,waajib inta ma tifaachir fi l‑furuuʼ al‑gataʼoohum.Wa kan tidoor tifaachir kamaan,fakkir kadar inta ma gaaʼid tiʼayyich al‑uruug laakin al‑uruug gaaʼidiin yiʼayyuchuuk inta.
Akuun tuguul : Al‑furuuʼ dool,gataʼoohum achaan siid al‑jineene dawwar yilassigni ana fi l‑chadara fi badalhum. 
Kalaamak da sahiih.Laakin ma tansa gataʼoohum achaan humman ma aamano wa inta gaaʼid fi bakaanhum be sabab iimaanak bas.Ma tistakbar.Angariʼ !
Kan Allah ma afa furuuʼ al‑chadara,hu ma yaʼafaak inta kula.
Fakkir fi mahannat Allah wa fakkir fi hukmah al‑gawi kula.Hukmah gawi fi l‑naas al‑marago min al‑derib,laakin hu hanuun leek bilheen kan tagood saabit fi ihsaanah.Wa kan ma tagood saabit,inta kula yagtaʼook.
Wa Bani Israaʼiil kula,kan yikhallu gillit iimaanhum,Allah yigabbilhum battaan fi bakaanhum al‑awwal gaaʼidiin foogah achaan Allah gaadir yisawwiih.
Wa be da,inta firiʼ min al‑bandar.Wa Allah gataʼak minnah wa lassagaak fi chadarat al‑zaytuun al‑magganha.Wa da ma bakaanak al‑waajib leek.Achaan da,yabga hayyin le Allah yigabbil al‑furuuʼ al‑gataʼaahum wa yilassighum battaan fi l‑bakaan al‑waajib leehum.
Ya akhwaani,nidoor niʼooriiku be sirr waahid al‑Allah bayyanah leyi.Niʼooriiku beyah achaan kan fihimtuuh adiil,ma tistakbaro fi afkaarku.Waahidiin min Bani Israaʼiil bigo aasiyiin wa ma yiʼaamunu be Isa al‑Masiih.Wa isyaanhum da yuduum lahaddi adad al‑muʼminiin min al‑umam yalhag al‑adad al‑Allah yidoorah.
Wa be misil da,Bani Israaʼiil kulluhum ke yanjo khalaas.Achaan da,maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Al‑yafdaahum yaji min Sahyuun wa yigabbil zurriiyit Yaakhuub min isyaanhum.
Wa misil ana gult fi l‑muʼaahada al‑sawweetha maʼaahum,ana nuguchch zunuubhum.‍﴿
Fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss bichaarat al‑Masiih,Bani Israaʼiil bigo adu Allah wa min isyaanhum,intu ligiitu faayde.Laakin fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss ikhtiyaar Allah,humman mahbuubiin be sabab juduudhum.
Achaan kan Allah anta naadum atiiye,hu ma yandam leeha.Wa kan naada naadum,ma yibattil munaadaatah.
Intu al‑ma Yahuud awwal aasiyiin laakin hassaʼ Allah rahamaaku be sabab isyaan Bani Israaʼiil.
Wa hassaʼ Bani Israaʼiil bigo aasiyiin wa be l‑rahma al‑Allah rahamaaku beeha,humman kula yalgo rahma.
Fi nizaam Allah kulla l‑umam marbuutiin fi isyaanhum achaan fi l‑akhiir,Allah yarham kulla l‑umam sawa sawa.
Al‑hamdulillah al‑Aliim wa l‑Hakiim.Hikmatah wa ilmah abadan ma induhum hadd !Hikmat hukmah nafhamo minha illa chiyya.Wa nizaamah ajiib lahaddi ma yilfassar.
Achaan da,al‑Kitaab buguul :﴾‍Yaatu irif afkaar Allah wa bigi leyah siid choortah ?
Yaatu dayyan Allah cheyy al‑waajib yigabbilah leyah !‍﴿
Achaan kulla cheyy jaayi min Allah wa mawjuud beyah hu wa leyah hu.Wa l‑hamdulillah ila l‑abad.Aamiin.
Ya akhwaani,niwassiiku be sabab rahmat Allah al‑ligiituuha,ayyi waahid minku yigaddim jismah le Allah dahiiye hayye wa mukhaddasa al‑Allah yarda beeha.Wa di hi ibaaditku al‑waajbe.
Aabo ma titaabuʼu fikir naas al‑dunya laakin khalli Allah yikhayyirku wa yantiiku agul jadiid al‑beyah tagdaro timayyuzu al‑cheyy al‑Allah yidoorah wa taʼarfu al‑cheyy al‑adiil wa l‑cheyy al‑Allah yarda beyah wa l‑cheyy al‑tamaam.
Wa be l‑niʼma al‑Allah antaaha leyi,niwassi ayyi waahid minku ma yistakbar.Khalli ayyi waahid ma yinkhachcha laakin yichiif nafsah hasab gudrat al‑iimaan al‑Allah antaah leyah.
Chiifu,ayyi waahid minnina indah fi jismah aʼda katiiriin wa kulla udu ma yisawwi nafs al‑khidme.
Be misil da,aniina naas katiiriin laakin bigiina misil jisim waahid fi l‑Masiih.Wa ayyi waahid minnina,hu udu fi l‑jisim da wa bigi akhu le l‑aakhariin kulluhum.
Indina ataaya chig chig hasab niʼmat Allah.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yihajji kalaam naazil min Allah,khalli yihajji hasab al‑iimaan.
Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yakhdim fi ust al‑akhwaan,khalli yakhdim.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yiʼallim al‑naas,khalli yiʼallimhum.
Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yichajjiʼ al‑akhwaan,khalli yichajjiʼhum.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yanti,khalli yanti be juud.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yuguud akhwaanah,khalli yukhutt baalah wa yuguudhum adiil.Wa kan Allah anta naadum gudra le yihinn fi l‑naas,khalli yihinn fooghum be farah.
Hibbu ayyi naadum be mahabba sahiihe.Akraho al‑charr marra waahid wa akurbu al‑kheer gawi.
Arraayado ambeenaatku misil akhwaan wa khalli ayyi waahid yichiil niiye achaan yihibb akhuuh be ihtiraam.
Taabuʼu Rabbina be niiye waahide wa bala kasal.Ankarbu fi khidmit al‑Rabb.
Afraho achaan induku acham fi Rabbina.Asburu fi l‑taʼab wa sallu daayman bala kasal.
Saaʼudu al‑saalihiin al‑muhtaajiin wa dayyufu be farah al‑diifaan al‑yajuuku.
Baaruku al‑naas al‑yitaʼʼubuuku.Aywa,baarukuuhum wa ma talʼanoohum.
Afraho maʼa l‑farhaaniin wa ahzano maʼa l‑haznaaniin.
Astafugu ambeenaatku wa khalli ayyi waahid ma yajʼal nafsah kabiir laakin khalli yajʼal nafsah sakhayyar.Ma tisawwu nufuusku induku irfe katiire.
Kan naadum sawwa foogku cheyy fasil,ma tisawwu foogah cheyy fasil.Fakkuru wa sawwu al‑cheyy al‑kulla l‑naas yardo beyah.
Jaahudu be ayyi daliil achaan tiʼiichu be salaam maʼa kulla l‑naas.
Ya l‑mahbuubiin,ma tichiilu al‑taar.Khallu khadab Allah yichiil leeku al‑taar achaan maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Al‑taar hanaayi.Ana bas al‑nichiilah.‍﴿Da bas kalaam Allah.
Akheer kan titaabuʼu al‑kalaam al‑buguul :﴾‍Kan aduuk jiiʼaan,antiih yaakul.Wa kan hu atchaan,antiih yachrab.Kan tisawwi misil da,al‑eeb yakurbah wa yabga misil jamur al‑sabbooh fi raasah.‍﴿
Ma tikhallu al‑charr yinnasir foogku laakin annasuru fi l‑charr be l‑kheer.
Khalli ayyi naadum yasmaʼ kalaam al‑hakuuma achaan ma fi hakuuma illa be izin Allah wa ayyi hakuuma al‑gaaʼide,Allah assasaaha.
Achaan da,ayyi naadum al‑yikhaalif al‑hakuuma,yikhaalif al‑cheyy al‑Allah assasah.Wa l‑naadum al‑yikhaalif,hukum Allah yanzil foogah.
Achaan al‑naadum al‑haalah adiile ma yakhaaf min al‑hukkaam illa l‑naadum al‑haalah fasle,hu yakhaaf minhum.Kan tidoor ma takhaaf min al‑haakim,khalaas sawwi al‑kheer wa l‑haakim yachkurak.
Al‑haakim hu khaddaam Allah le kheerak.Laakin kan inta mujrim,laabudda takhaaf minnah achaan al‑haakim indah al‑seef wa ma yichiilah saakit.Hu khaddaam Allah achaan yinazzil khadab Allah fi l‑mujrim.
Fi chaan da,waajib tasmaʼo kalaam al‑hakuuma.Wa da ma le takhaafo min khadab Allah bas laakin le talgo niiye mukhlisa.
Wa achaan da,waajib tikaffu al‑miiri kula.Al‑hukkaam humman khaddaamiin Allah wa yichtakhulu be l‑khidme al‑antaaha leehum di.
Antu ayyi naadum al‑cheyy al‑waajib leyah.Wa l‑naadum al‑waajib leyah tikaffu al‑miiri,kaffuuh leyah.Wa l‑naadum al‑waajib leyah tikaffu jamaarik,kaffuuh leyah.Wa l‑naadum al‑waajib leyah ihtiraam,ahtarumuuh.Wa l‑naadum al‑waajib leyah al‑ikraam,karrumuuh.
Ma tikhallu al‑deen yagood foogku.Deen waahid bas gaaʼid foogku wa hu al‑mahabba ambeenaatku.Wa l‑naadum al‑yihibb akhuuh,hu tabbag churuut al‑Tawraat khalaas.
Achaan al‑wasaaya buguulu :﴾‍Ma tazna wa ma taktul dimme wa ma tasrig wa ma tatmaʼ‍﴿wa wasaaya aakhariin kula.Wa kulla l‑wasaaya dool,zibdithum hi al‑wasiiye al‑tuguul :﴾‍Hibb akhuuk misil tihibb nafsak.‍﴿
Al‑naadum al‑yihibb akhuuh abadan ma yisawwi leyah cheyy fasil.Wa be misil da,al‑naadum al‑yihibb al‑naas yitabbig churuut al‑Tawraat be sahiih.
Wa khalaas,taʼarfu al‑wakit al‑aniina gaaʼidiin foogah.Al‑wakit tamma khalaas.Wa hassaʼ,waajib tugummu min noomku achaan yoom al‑naja gariib leena min wakit aniina aamanna.
Al‑leel gariib yikammil wa l‑nahaar jaayi gariib.Khalaas,waajib nikhallu minnina kulla fiʼil al‑dalaam wa nijahhuzu nufuusna achaan niʼiichu fi l‑nuur.
Khalli haalna tukuun haal hana iyaal al‑nuur.Wa khalli ma namchu fi l‑safaaha wa l‑sakar,wa la fi l‑zina wa l‑fasaad,wa la fi l‑duwaas wa l‑husud.
Wa fi badal al‑zunuub dool,arbutu sulubku wa khuttu fi uguulku intu khaddaamiin le Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih.Wa aabo ma tichtakhulu be chahwaat al‑insaan.
Akhbalo al‑muʼmin al‑daʼiif fi iimaanah wa ma tikhaalutuuh fi fikrah.
Hasab iimaan naas waahidiin,kulla nafar hana akil halaal.Wa laakin al‑naas al‑iimaanhum daʼiif yaakulu illa l‑khadaar.
Al‑naadum al‑yaakul ayyi nafar hana akil,ma waajib yahgir al‑muʼmin al‑yaakul illa l‑khadaar.Wa l‑yaakul illa l‑khadaar,ma waajib yuluum al‑naadum al‑yaakul kulla cheyy.Achaan akhuuk da,Allah khibilah khalaas.
Inta yaatu al‑tuluum al‑khaddaam al‑inta ma siidah ?Siidah bas yuguul kan yanjah aw yafchul.Wa akiid hu yanjah achaan Rabbina bas yinajjihah.
Wa fi fikir naas waahidiin,fiyah yoom waahid muhimm ziyaada min al‑ayyaam al‑aakhariin.Wa fi fikir naas aakhariin,kulla l‑ayyaam sawa sawa.Khalli ayyi naadum yukuun muʼakkid min nafsah.
Al‑naadum al‑yikhassis yoom waahid yikhassisah fi chaan Allah.Wa l‑naadum al‑yaakul kulla nafar hana akil yaakulah fi chaan Allah wa yachkurah fi chaanah.Wa l‑naadum al‑yaakul illa l‑khadaar yaaba ma yaakulah fi chaan Allah wa hu kula yachkurah.
Ma fi naadum minnina yiʼiich fi chaan nafsah bas wa ma fi naadum minnina yumuut fi chaan nafsah bas.
Kan niʼiichu,niʼiichu fi chaan Rabbina wa kan numuutu,numuutu kula fi chaan Rabbina.Wa misil da,kan aniina hayyiin walla maytiin kula,aniina hana Rabbina.
Fi chaan da bas,al‑Masiih maat wa baʼas achaan yabga Rabb al‑hayyiin wa Rabb al‑maytiin.
Wa inta,maala gaaʼid tuluum akhuuk ?Wa inta,maala gaaʼid tahgir akhuuk ?Ayyi waahid minnina yagiif giddaam kursi Allah fi yoom al‑Hisaab.
Achaan da maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Allah gaal : Ana halaft be nafsi kadar kulla rukba tabruk giddaami wa ayyi lisaan yachhad kadar ana Allah.‍﴿
Wa be misil da fi yoom al‑Hisaab,ayyi waahid minnina masʼuul giddaam Allah fi l‑cheyy al‑hu sawwaah.
Achaan da,khalliina ma nuluumu akhwaanna.Akheer nichiilu niiye achaan abadan ma nisawwu cheyy al‑yiwaddi akhuuna le l‑zanib,lahaddi yamurgah min al‑derib.
Achaan al‑Rabb Isa maʼaayi,ana muʼakkid kadar kulla nafar hana akil halaal fi zaatah.Laakin al‑akil yabga haraam le l‑naadum al‑fi fikrah al‑akil da haraam.
Kan al‑akil al‑taakulah yisabbib le akhuuk muchkila,inta ma maachi fi derib al‑mahabba.Ma tikhalli aklak yisabbib halaak le akhuuk al‑Isa al‑Masiih maat fi chaanah.
Ya akhwaani,ma tikhallu al‑cheyy al‑adiil leeku yanti fursa le yuguulu foogku kalaam fasil.
Achaan al‑muhimm fi mamlakat Allah ma al‑akil wa l‑charaab,laakin hu al‑adaala wa l‑salaam wa l‑farha fi l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Al‑naadum al‑yitaabiʼ al‑Masiih misil da,Allah yarda beyah wa l‑naas kula yikarrumuuh.
Be misil da,khalli nijaahudu achaan nisawwu al‑cheyy al‑yisabbit al‑salaam ambeenaatna wa l‑yigawwiina kullina.
Ma titallif amal Allah be sabab al‑akil.Sahiih,ayyi nafar hana akil halaal fi zaatah.Laakin ayyi akil al‑taakulah al‑yiwaddi akhuuk fi l‑zanib,da haraam leek.
Kan ma taakul al‑laham wa ma tachrab al‑khamar wa kan taaba ayyi cheyy al‑yiwaddi akhuuk fi l‑zanib,khalaas misil da inta gaaʼid tisawwi al‑cheyy al‑adiil.
Al‑cheyy al‑tiʼaamin beyah fi l‑kalaam da,khalli yabga beenak wa been Allah.Mabruuk le l‑naadum al‑gaaʼid yisawwi al‑cheyy al‑nafsah tarda beyah wa ma yuluum nafsah be sababah.
Wa ayyi naadum al‑yichakkik fi galbah fi l‑cheyy al‑gaaʼid yaakulah,Allah yuluumah achaan ma gaaʼid yitaabiʼ iimaanah.Ayyi cheyy al‑ma nisawwuuh be l‑iimaan,hu zanib.
Laakin aniina al‑gawiyiin fi l‑iimaan,waajib nahmalo akhwaanna al‑ma gawiyiin fi l‑iimaan.Wa ma waajib nisawwu al‑cheyy al‑yaʼajibna aniina bas.
Khalli ayyi naadum minnina yisawwi al‑cheyy al‑yaʼajib akhuuh wa da,le kheerah wa le yigawwiih fi l‑iimaan.
Achaan al‑Masiih zaatah ma chaal al‑derib al‑yaʼajib nafsah,laakin maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Al‑yiʼayyuruuk,muʼyaarhum wagaʼ foogi ana kula.‍﴿
Kulla cheyy al‑katabooh fi l‑zaman al‑faat ankatab le yiʼallimna.Achaan be l‑sabur wa l‑chajaaʼa al‑allamnaahum min al‑kutub,namchu giddaam be acham.
Allah yanti al‑sabur wa l‑chajaaʼa wa khalli yantiiku kulluku fikir waahid le titaabuʼu derib al‑Masiih Isa
lahaddi kulluku timajjudu Allah abu Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih be niiye waahide wa be hiss waahid.
Khalaas,akhbalo kulla muʼmin be l‑Masiih misil al‑Masiih khibilaaku.Wa be misil da,timajjudu Allah.
Wa fi chaan da,nuguul leeku kadar al‑Masiih bigi khaddaam le l‑Yahuud achaan yiwassif kadar Allah saadikh wa yitimm al‑cheyy al‑waaʼad beyah juduudhum.
Wa ja achaan al‑naas al‑ma Yahuud kula yachkuru Allah fi chaan rahmatah.Maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Be sabab da,ya Allah,fi ust al‑umam nachkurak wa be khine,namdah usmak.‍﴿
Wa battaan buguul :﴾‍Ya l‑umam,afraho maʼa chaʼab Allah.‍﴿
Wa battaan buguul :﴾‍Ya kulla l‑umam,ahmudu Allah !Ya kulla l‑chuʼuub,majjuduuh !‍﴿
Wa l‑nabi Ichaʼya gaal :﴾‍Min zurriiyit Yassayaji naadum wa yabga malik fi kulla l‑umam.Wa l‑chuʼuub al‑aakhariin yukhuttu achamhum foogah.‍﴿
Wa Allah al‑antaaku acham yantiiku al‑farha wa l‑salaam fi l‑iimaan achaan achamku foogah yiziid be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Ya akhwaani,ana be nafsi muʼakkid kadar intu malaaniin be l‑kheer wa be l‑ilim wa gaadriin tilwaaso ambeenaatku.
Laakin fi achya waahidiin katabt leeku be kalaam gawi chiyya achaan dawwart nizakkirku beehum.Wa gidirt katabt misil da be sabab al‑niʼma al‑Allah antaaha leyi
le nabga khaddaam le l‑Masiih Isa.Wa khidimti hi ballikhiin bichaarat Allah le l‑umam al‑ma Yahuud.Ana nabga misil raajil diin wakit niballikh bichaarat Allah le l‑umam al‑ma Yahuud le yabgo misil dahiiye al‑Allah yarda beeha.Wa l‑dahiiye di tabga khaassa le Allah be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Wa achaan da,nilfachchar be kulla l‑khidme al‑sawweetha le Allah be l‑Masiih Isa.
Wa abadan ma nidoor nihajji be ayyi khidme illa l‑khidme al‑Isa al‑Masiih sawwaaha beyi achaan al‑umam yitiiʼu Allah.Hu khadam be kalaam wa be fiʼil
wa be gudrat al‑ajaayib wa l‑alaamaat wa be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa misil da,ana ballakht bichaarat al‑Masiih le l‑naas fi kulli bakaan min Madiinat al‑Khudus lahaddi balad Illirkuun.
Wa indi niiye daayman achaan niballikh al‑bichaara fi ayyi bakaan al‑lissaaʼ ma ballakho foogah usum al‑Masiih.Ma nidoor nabni fi asaas al‑khattaah naadum aakhar.
Nidoor nitaabiʼ al‑kalaam al‑maktuub al‑buguul :﴾‍Al‑naas al‑ma hajjoohum beyah yichiifuuh.Wa l‑ma simʼo beyah yafhamooh.‍﴿
Wa iddat marraat,haawalt najiiku wa ma gidirt achaan khidimti di daharatni.
Laakin hassaʼ ma faddal leyi bakaan fi l‑manaatig dool al‑nibachchir foogah.Wa min siniin katiiriin,nidoor najiiku.
Wa khalaas,nagdar nakhchaaku wakit namchi Isbaaniya.In cha Allah,najiiku wa nagood maʼaaku ayyaam wa da yabga leyi halu.Wa baʼad da,tisaaʼuduuni achaan nisaafir giddaam.
Laakin hassaʼ da,ana maachi Madiinat al‑Khudus achaan nisaaʼid al‑saalihiin.
Achaan al‑muʼminiin al‑fi Magiduuniya wa l‑Yuunaan chaalo niiye ambeenaathum achaan yirassulu musaaʼada le l‑masaakiin al‑gaaʼidiin ambeen al‑saalihiin fi Madiinat al‑Khudus.
Wa chaalo al‑niiye di be farah.Wa da misil deen fooghum achaan awwal al‑Yahuud gassamo barakaathum al‑ligoohum min Allah maʼa l‑ma Yahuud.Wa hassaʼ al‑ma Yahuud waajib leehum yisaaʼudu al‑Yahuud be l‑barakaat al‑ardiiye al‑ligoohum.
Wa wakit al‑khidme di tikammil wa ana anteethum kulla cheyy al‑lammooh leehum,nichiil derib hana Isbaaniya wa nakhchaaku fi Rooma.
Wa naʼarif kadar wakit nalhag bakaanku da,najiiku malaan be barakat al‑Masiih al‑khaassa leeku.
Wa hassaʼ ya akhwaani,natlub minku be usum Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih wa be mahabbat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus achaan intu tasʼalo Allah maʼaayi be chidde.
Asʼalo leyi Allah achaan yafzaʼni min al‑Yahuud al‑ma Masiihiyiin fi daar al‑Yahuudiiya.Wa asʼalo achaan al‑saalihiin al‑fi Madiinat al‑Khudus yardo be l‑musaaʼada al‑nijiibha leehum.
Wa misil da,in cha Allah najiiku be farah wa ninjamma maʼaaku chiyya.
Allah Rabb al‑salaam yukuun maʼaaku kulluku.Aamiin.
Nigaddim leeku akhutna Fiiba.Hi khaddaama fi jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin al‑gaaʼidiin fi hillit Kankhiriiya.
Akhbalooha be usum al‑Rabb wa dayyufuuha be l‑diife al‑waajbe le l‑naas al‑saalihiin.Saaʼuduuha fi ayyi cheyy al‑hi tidoorah minku achaan hi zaatha saaʼadat naas katiiriin wa saaʼadatni ana kula.
Wa sallumu Biriskiilawa Akiila al‑khadamo maʼaayi sawa le l‑Masiih Isa.
Wa humman dakhalo fi khutuura chadiide achaan yinajjuuni min al‑moot.Wa kulla jamaaʼaat al‑muʼminiin al‑gaaʼidiin fi ust al‑naas al‑ma Yahuud gaaʼidiin yachkuruuhum maʼaayi.
Wa sallumu jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin al‑yilimmu fi beethum.Wa sallumu habiibi Abinaatus.Hu awwal naadum al‑aaman be l‑Masiih fi balad Aasiya.
Wa sallumu Mariyam al‑khadamat leeku katiir.
Wa sallumu ahali Andaruuniki wa Yuuniya al‑gaʼadna sawa maʼaahum fi l‑sijin.Kulla l‑rusul yaʼarfuuhum wa yikarrumuuhum.Humman muʼminiin be l‑Masiih gubbaali ana.
Wa sallumu Amfilaawus,hu habiibi fi l‑Rabb.
Wa sallumu Urbaan al‑yakhdim misilna le l‑Masiih wa habiibi Istakhi.
Wa sallumu Afaliis al‑wassaf sabaatah fi l‑Masiih.Wa sallumu al‑akhwaan fi beet Aristubuul.
Wa sallumu akhuuyi Hiruudiyun.Wa sallumu naas Rabbina al‑gaaʼidiin fi beet Narkiis.
Wa sallumu al‑akhwaat Tarfiina wa Tarfuusa al‑yakhdiman katiir le l‑Rabb.Wa sallumu akhti al‑niriidha Farsiiya al‑khadamat katiir bilheen le l‑Rabb.
Wa sallumu Ruufus,hu al‑azalah al‑Rabb.Wa sallumu ammah.Hi bigat misil ammi.
Wa sallumu Sinkiraat wa Filikhuun wa Harmiis wa Batruub wa Harmaas wa kulla l‑akhwaan al‑maʼaahum.
Wa sallumu Filuluukh wa Juuliya wa Niiri wa akhtah wa Uluumba wa kulla l‑saalihiin al‑gaaʼidiin maʼaahum.
Wa assaalamo ambeenaatku be salaam al‑saalihiin.Kulla jamaaʼaat al‑muʼminiin be l‑Masiih yisallumuuku.
Ya akhwaani,niwassiiku be cheyy waahid.Angarʼu min al‑naas al‑yiʼallumuuku be taʼliim chig min al‑taʼliim al‑simiʼtuuh awwal.Al‑naas dool yifarrugu al‑muʼminiin be kalaamhum wa yitallufu iimaanhum.Kissu minhum baʼiid.
Al‑naas al‑misil dool ma yakhdumu le Rabbina al‑Masiih laakin yakhdumu le butuunhum bas.Yihajju le l‑naas be kalaam halu wa yachkuruuhum katiir achaan yukhuchchu al‑naas al‑induhum ilim chiyya bas.
Wa leeku intu,kulla l‑naas yaʼarfu intu simiʼtu bichaarat al‑Masiih wa taabaʼtuuha.Wa fi chaanku,ana farhaan laakin nidoor intu tabgo faahimiin fi l‑kheer wa bariyiin min al‑charr.
Wa Allah Rabb al‑salaam ma yiʼakhkhir yarhak Ibliis tihit rijleeku.Aleekum rahmat Rabbina Isa.
Wa akhuuyi Timuutaawus al‑yakhdim maʼaayi sawa yisallimku.Wa ahali Luukiyus wa Yaasuun wa Suubaatar kula yisallumuuku.
Wa ana Tartiiyus al‑gaaʼid naktib kalaam Buulus fi l‑jawaab da,nisallimku be usum al‑Rabb.
Wa Khaayus yisallimku.Hu siid al‑beet al‑ana muddayyif foogah.Wa beetah hu al‑bakaan al‑yilimmu foogah jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin.Wa Rastus wakiil sanduug hana maal al‑hille wa akhuuna Kawaartus yisallumuuku.
Aleeku kulluku niʼmat Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih.Aamiin.
Wa khalaas nachkuru Allah !Achaan hu yagdar yigawwiiku fi l‑iimaan be bichaarat al‑Masiih al‑nijiibha leeku wakit niballikh be Isa al‑Masiih.Wa be l‑bichaara di,Allah yiʼarrif al‑sirr al‑mulabbad min al‑zaman al‑faat.
Wa laakin hassaʼ bayyanah khalaas be kutub al‑anbiya le kulla l‑umam al‑ma Yahuud.Wa Allah al‑Hayy ila l‑abad anta al‑amur da achaan kulla l‑chaʼab yiʼaamunu beyah wa yitaabuʼu kalaamah.
Wa l‑hamd waajib le Allah al‑Waahid al‑Hakiim,be usum Isa al‑Masiih ila l‑abad.Aamiin.
Jawaab minni ana Buulus al‑Allah naadaani achaan nabga be iznah rasuul hana Isa al‑Masiih.Wa daahu naktib leeku maʼa akhuuna Suustaan.
Wa nisallumuuku intu jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin hana Allah al‑gaaʼidiin fi hillit Kuruntus,intu al‑Allah khassasaaku be alaakhitku maʼa l‑Masiih Isa.Allah naadaaku fi derbah achaan tabgo khaassiin sawa maʼa kulla l‑naas al‑yadʼu fi ayyi bakaan be usum Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih wa hu Rabbuhum wa Rabbina.
Aleekum al‑salaam wa l‑rahma min Allah abuuna wa Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih.
Nachkur Allah daayman fi chaanku wa fi chaan al‑rahma al‑hu antaaku be alaakhitku maʼa l‑Masiih Isa.
Wa be alaakhitku maʼaayah,Allah baarakaaku wa antaaku kulla cheyy wa antaaku kulla maʼrafat al‑kalaam wa kulla l‑ilim.
Wa misil da,Allah sabbat ambeenaatku chahaaditna al‑chahadna beeha le l‑Masiih.
Wa fi chaan da bas,ma fi ayyi baraka min barakaat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus al‑gassarat leeku,intu al‑gaaʼidiin tarjo al‑yoom al‑Allah yibayyin foogah Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih.
Al‑Masiih yahfadku lahaddi fi l‑aakhira.Achaan da,fi yoom jayyit Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih,tukuunu bala eeb.
Allah hu saadikh fi waʼadah.Wa hu bas al‑naadaaku achaan tadkhulu fi l‑alaakha al‑induku maʼa Ibnah Isa al‑Masiih Rabbina.
Ya akhwaani,ana niwassiiku be usum Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih achaan kalaamku yabga waahid lahaddi ma tingasmu.Wa khalli galibku yabga waahid wa fikirku yabga waahid.
Ya akhwaani,ana gult al‑kalaam da achaan naas waahidiin min beet akhutku Khuluwa oorooni kadar intu gaaʼidiin tilkhaalato ambeenaatku.
Wa ayyi naadum minku gaaʼid yuguul : Ana naadum hana Buulus  aw  Ana hana Abuluus  aw  Ana hana Butrus  aw  Ana hana l‑Masiih. 
Haay !Al‑Masiih da waahid walla mugassam ?Buulus da maat fi l‑saliib fi chaanku walla ?Wa khattasooku be usum Buulus walla ?Akiid,la !
Wa ana ma khattast ayyi naadum minku illa Kiriisbus wa Khaayus.Wa achaan da,nuguul al‑hamdulillah.
Wa be da,ma fi naadum al‑yagdar yuguul hu khattasooh be usmi ana.
Aywa,ana khattast naas beet Istifaan kula.Laakin ma naʼarif kan fi naadum aakhar ambeenaatku ana khattastah.
Wa l‑Masiih rassalaani ma achaan nikhattis al‑naas laakin achaan niballikh leehum bichaartah.Wa ma niballikhha misil al‑ulama al‑yiballukhu fikirhum be kalaam halu.Niballikh moot al‑Masiih fi l‑saliib achaan al‑saliib kula indah gudra al‑khaassa beyah.
Sahiih,al‑naas al‑muwaddiriin yuguulu kadar kalaamna fi l‑saliib kalaam baatil.Laakin leena aniina al‑Allah gaaʼid yinajjiina,kalaam hana l‑saliib indah gudrat Allah.
Wa fakkuru fi l‑kalaam al‑Allah gaalah fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Hikmat al‑hukama niwaddirha wa fihim al‑faahimiin yabga ma fiih.‍﴿
Wa hassaʼ da,ween al‑hakiim ?Ween al‑aalim ?Ween al‑mutakallim al‑yiriiduuh naas al‑dunya ?Khalaas,Allah wassaf kadar hikmat naas al‑dunya baatle.
Achaan Allah sawwa kulla cheyy hasab hikmatah wa laakin naas al‑dunya ma aʼtarafo beyah.Wa khalaas Allah chaal niiye achaan yinajji al‑naas al‑yiʼaamunu beyah be tariig al‑bichaara,hatta kan naas al‑dunya yichiifuuh kalaam baatil kula.
Aywa,al‑Yahuud yidooru yichiifu al‑alaama al‑tabga leehum daliil wa l‑Yuunaaniyiin yifattuchu al‑hagg be hikmat al‑dunya
laakin aniina niballukhu le kulla l‑naas be l‑Masiih al‑katalooh fi l‑saliib.Wa l‑kalaam da yizaʼʼil al‑Yahuud wa hu kalaam baatil le l‑Yuunaaniyiin.
Laakin le kulla l‑naas al‑Allah naadaahum fi derbah,kan min al‑Yahuud walla min al‑Yuunaaniyiin kula,al‑Masiih hu gudrat Allah wa hikmat Allah.
Wa l‑naas yuguulu hikmat Allah baatle.Laakin hikmat Allah ziyaada marra waahid min hikmithum.Wa yuguulu gudrat Allah hi daʼiife,laakin gudrat Allah ziyaada min gudrat al‑naas.
Wa be kalaam aakhar,ya akhwaani,fakkuru fi haalitku hi kikkeef gubbaal Allah ma naadaaku fi derbah.Awwal da,naas chiyya minku induhum hikma wa chiyya minku induhum gudra wa chiyya minku iyaal kubaaraat.
Laakin al‑naas al‑juhhaal hasab naas al‑dunya,humman dool bas Allah azalaahum achaan yijiib al‑eeb fi l‑hukama.Wa l‑naas al‑ma induhum gudra hasab naas al‑dunya,humman dool Allah azalaahum achaan yijiib al‑eeb fi l‑gaadriin.
Aywa,Allah azal al‑naas al‑masaakiin wa l‑mahguuriin wa l‑ma induhum faayde hasab naas al‑dunya,achaan yibattil faaydit al‑naas al‑yuguulu humman bas induhum faayde.
Wa khalaas,ma fi insaan indah hagg yisawwi nafsah kabiir giddaam Allah.
Wa Allah bas al‑antaaku al‑alaakha al‑induku maʼa l‑Masiih Isa.Wa be l‑Masiih bas,nalgo hikmat Allah.Wa be l‑Masiih bas,Allah jaʼalaana saalihiin wa khassasaana wa fadaana.
Wa achaan da,khalli nitaabuʼu al‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Khalli naadum ma yisawwi nafsah kabiir.Akheer yuguul Allah bas kabiir.‍﴿
Ya akhwaani,wakit ana macheet leeku,ballakht leeku sirr Allah al‑awwal al‑naas ma irfooh.Laakin ma ballakhtah be kalaam saʼab ziyaada wa ma hajjeet leeku misil aalim kabiir.
Wa chilt niiye achaan nikallim leeku misil ma naʼarif cheyy illa Isa al‑Masiih wa mootah fi l‑saliib.
Wa ana faagid al‑gudra wakit ana gaaʼid maʼaaku wa khaayif bilheen.
Wa kallamt leeku be taʼliim hayyin wa ma jibtuku fi l‑derib be kalaam al‑yiraddiiku wa la be hikmat insaani wa laakin kallamt leeku be kalaam al‑indah gudra al‑jaayi min al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Wa misil da,iimaanku ma yilʼassas fi hikmat insaan laakin fi gudrat Allah.
Wa laakin kan aniina gaaʼidiin maʼa muʼminiin kubaar fi l‑iimaan,nikallumu leehum be hikma adiile.Wa l‑hikma di ma tichaabih hikmat naas al‑dunya wa la hikmat kubaaraat naas al‑dunya al‑laabudda yabgo ma fiihum.
Wa niʼarrufu al‑naas be hikmat Allah al‑hi sirr mulabbad al‑ma irfooh.Wa gubbaal bidaayit al‑dunya,Allah kharrar be l‑hikma di yiwaddiina fi majdah.
Wa ma fi naadum min kubaaraat al‑dunya di fihim hikmat Allah.Kan awwal fihmooha,ma yaktulu Rabbina al‑majiid fi l‑saliib.
Wa khalaas,da muwaafig maʼa l‑kalaam al‑maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Al‑cheyy al‑Allah jahhazah le l‑naas al‑yihibbuuh,ma chaafatah een wa la simʼatah adaan wa la fakkar foogah insaan.‍﴿
Laakin al‑cheyy da,Allah wassafah leena be l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Achaan al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yichiif kulla cheyy wa yaʼarif fikir Allah wa asraarah.
Akiid,al‑naas ma yaʼarfu afkaar naadum illa l‑naadum zaatah yaʼarif afkaarah.Wa misil da,ma fi naadum yaʼarif afkaar Allah,illa Ruuh Allah yaʼarif afkaar Allah.
Wa Allah antaana al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus wa l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus da ma jaayi min al‑dunya.Hu Ruuh Allah al‑naazil leena achaan naʼarfu al‑rahma al‑Allah antaaha leena.
Wa aniina nikallumu be l‑barakaat dool le l‑naas.Wa ma nihajju beehum be l‑kalaam al‑allamnaah min al‑hikma al‑insaaniiye.La.Nihajju be l‑kalaam al‑allamah leena al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa nifassuru taʼliim al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus le l‑naas al‑induhum al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Wa l‑insaani al‑tabiiʼi ma yakhbal kalaam hana Ruuh Allah.Fi fikrah,kalaam al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus baatil wa hu ma yafhamah.Achaan naadum ma yafhamah illa be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Wa l‑naadum al‑indah al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus,hu yihaasib kulla cheyy laakin ma fi naadum al‑indah hagg yihaasibah.
Achaan maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Yaatu irif afkaar Allah wa bigi leyah siid choortah ?‍﴿Wa laakin aniina fikirna wa fikir al‑Masiih,waahid.
Ya akhwaani,wakit ana maʼaaku ma gidirt nihajji leeku misil intu naas al‑induhum al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Laakin intu induku fikir hana naas al‑dunya.Wa fi derib al‑Masiih intu misil atfaal.
Achaan da bas,ana allamtuku be taʼliim hayyin misil ridaaʼat al‑laban wa ma be taʼliim gawi misil madikhiin al‑asab achaan intu ma gidirtu takhbalo taʼliim gawi.Ya hassaʼ,intu ma tagdaro.
Intu gaaʼidiin titaabuʼu fikir hana naas al‑dunya wa ma fikir Allah.Intu gaaʼidiin tilhaasado wa tihaaruju ambeenaatku.Wa be da,fikirku bigi fikir hana naas al‑dunya wa haalku misil haal al‑naas !
Achaan naadum waahid buguul : Ana hana Buulus  wa naadum aakhar buguul : Ana hana Abuluus. Wa kan tihajju misil ke khalaas,intu misil naas al‑dunya.
Wa Abuluus hu yaatu ?Wa ana Buulus kula yaatu ?Aniina khaddaamiin bas wa be sabab kalaamna intu aamantu.Ayyi waahid minnina sawwa al‑khidme al‑Rabbina kallafah beeha.
Intu misil jineene wa ana teerabt foogha kalaam Allah wa Abuluus zagaaha laakin Allah bas gawwam al‑bizre.
Wa be da,al‑yiteerib ma muhimm wa l‑yazgi ma muhimm illa Allah al‑yigawwim al‑bizre bas muhimm.
Wa l‑yiteerib wa l‑yazgi humman sawa sawa wa ayyi waahid yalga ujurtah hasab khidimtah.
Wa khalaas,aniina akhwaan fi khidmit Allah wa intu bigiitu jineene hana Allah.Aw be masal aakhar,intu bigiitu al‑beet al‑Allah gaaʼid yabniih.
Wa ana misil bannaay al‑yaʼarif khidimtah wa be l‑rahma al‑Allah antaani,ana khatteet asaas al‑beet wa naadum aakhar ja bana foogah.Wa ayyi naadum al‑yabni foogah waajib yukhutt baalah fi khidimtah.
Naadum ma yagdar yukhutt asaas aakhar min al‑asaas al‑gaaʼid khalaas wa l‑asaas da hu Isa al‑Masiih.
Wa hassaʼ ayyi naadum yabni foog al‑asaas da.Wa waahidiin yabnu foogah be dahab walla be fudda walla be hajar khaali wa waahidiin yabnu be hatab walla be gechch walla be ageeg.
Wa l‑khidme al‑ayyi naadum khadamha tinʼarif achaan yoom al‑Hisaab yiwassifha be naar.Wa l‑naar tijarrib khidmit ayyi naadum kan adiile walla ma adiile.
Wa kan naadum bana foog al‑asaas wa l‑naar ma akalat khidimtah,al‑naadum da yalga ajur.
Wa kan naadum bana foog al‑asaas wa l‑naar akalat khidimtah,khalaas khidimtah talaʼat khasaara laakin hu zaatah yanja.Wa hu yanja misil naadum al‑fazaʼooh min ust al‑naar.
Intu nisiitu walla ?Intu zaatku beet Allah.Ruuh Allah saakin foogku.
Kan naadum yidammir beet Allah,al‑naadum da Allah yidammirah.Achaan beet Allah hu mukhaddas.Wa intu bas al‑beet da.
Khalli naadum ma yukhuchch nafsah.Ayyi naadum minku al‑yuguul hu indah hikma adiile wa hikmatah hi hikmat naas al‑dunya,khalli yabga jaahil achaan yalga al‑hikma al‑sahiihe.
Achaan hikmat naas al‑dunya baatle giddaam Allah.Wa maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Allah yarmi al‑hakiimiin fi charak najaadithum.‍﴿
Wa maktuub battaan :﴾‍Allah yaʼarif kadar afkaar al‑hakiimiin ma induhum faayde.‍﴿
Achaan da,ma tistakbaro fi ayyi insaan.Achaan kulla cheyy hanaaku.
Aywa,Buulus wa Abuluus wa Butrus kulluhum hineeku intu.Wa l‑dunya wa l‑haya wa l‑moot wa l‑wakit al‑haali wa l‑wakit al‑jaayi,kulluhum hineeku.
Wa intu hana l‑Masiih wa l‑Masiih hu hana Allah.
Wa leyi ana wa akhwaani,waajib tahsubuuna khaddaamiin al‑Masiih masʼuuliin min ballikhiin sirr Allah al‑awwal al‑naas ma irfooh.
Wa l‑cheyy al‑waajib le ayyi naadum al‑masʼuul,hu al‑sidikh.
Wa kan leyi ana,ma lammaani kan intu tihaasubu khidimti walla kan ayyi insaan yihaasibni.Ana kula ma nihaasib nafsi.
Galbi gaaʼid yuguul ana ma indi eeb laakin da wiheedah ma yisabbit kadar ana bari.Al‑gaaʼid yihaasibni,hu Rabbina Isa.
Be misil da,ma tihaasubu khidmit ayyi naadum gubbaal yoom al‑Hisaab.Fi l‑yoom da,Rabbina yaji wa yibayyin kulla cheyy al‑mulabbad fi l‑dalaam wa yakchif niiyit al‑naas al‑gaaʼide fi guluubhum.Wa ayyi naadum yalga rida,ma min al‑naas laakin min Allah.
Ya akhwaani,ana tabbagt kalaami da fi l‑cheyy al‑yukhussini ana wa Abuluus achaan intu talgo minnah faayde.Wa be da,nidoor intu taʼarfu maʼana al‑masal al‑maʼruuf al‑buguul : Khalli naadum ma yamrug min derib al‑Kitaab. Ma tistakbaro battaan fi l‑naadum al‑waahid wa tahguru al‑aakhar.
Wa nuguul le ayyi waahid,yaatu al‑sawwaak akheer min akhuuk ?Al‑cheyy al‑indak da,hu min Allah.Wa kan Allah bas antaah leek,maala tistakbar beyah misil inta ma ligiitah minnah hu ?
Wa khalaas,tifakkuru intu chabʼaaniin wa bigiitu khaniyiin be l‑iimaan wa khalleetuuna wara wa tifakkuru gaʼadtu khalaas fi karaasiiku le tamulku.Nitmanna kadar intu tamulku be sahiih achaan nichaaruku maʼaaku fi l‑muluk.
Wa gult al‑kalaam da achaan fi fikri,Allah khattaana aniina rusul al‑Masiih fi l‑bakaan tihit marra waahid.Aniina bigiina misil masaajiin al‑hakamo leehum be l‑moot wa maragoohum giddaam kulla l‑dunya wa kulla naasha wa kulla l‑malaaʼika al‑gaaʼidiin yichiifu taʼabna.
Wa be sabab alaakhitna maʼa l‑Masiih,al‑naas hasaboona juhhaal.Wa laakin intu tuguulu intu aagliin be alaakhitku maʼa l‑Masiih.Intu tifakkuru kadar aniina daʼiifiin wa intu gaadriin.Intu mukarramiin laakin aniina mahguuriin.
Ya hassaʼ aniina jiiʼaaniin wa atchaaniin.Ma indina khulgaan.Yudugguuna wa yaturduuna min ayyi bakaan.
Wa nakhdumu be duraaʼna achaan niʼiichu.Wakit al‑naas yiʼayyuruuna,aniina nibaarukuuhum.Wakit yitaʼʼubuuna,aniina nasburu.
Wa wakit yihajju leena kalaam murr,aniina nuruddu leehum be nafas baarid.Wa aniina bigiina misil afana al‑kulla naas yakrahooha wa misil wasakh al‑yidaffuguuh barra.
Ana ma katabt al‑kalaam da le niʼayyibku.Laakin katabtah le nihazzirku achaan intu misil iyaali al‑nihibbuku.
Akuun induku naas katiiriin al‑yidooru yirabbuuku fi derib al‑Masiih laakin ma induku abbahaat katiiriin.Aywa,ana wiheedi bigiit abuuku achaan ana ballakht leeku bichaarat al‑Masiih wa beyi ana bas,intu dakhaltu fi alaakhitku maʼa l‑Masiih Isa.
Achaan da nichajjiʼku.Taabuʼu derbi ana.
Wa fi chaan da bas,ana rassalt leeku Timuutaawus al‑bigi leyi wileedi mahbuub wa amiin fi l‑Rabb.Hu yizakkirku be hayaati fi derib Isa al‑Masiih wa di bas al‑haya al‑niʼallimha le ummat al‑Masiih fi ayyi bakaan.
Waahidiin minku bigo mustakbiriin.Akuun fi fikirhum ana abadan ma namchi leeku.
Laakin kan Rabbina gaal aamiin,namchi leeku gariib.Wa fi l‑yoom da,naʼarif al‑mustakbiriin dool.Ma nidoor nasmaʼ kalaamhum.Nidoor nichiif gudrithum bas.
Achaan mamlakat Allah ma mabniiye be kalaam al‑naas.La !Hi mabniiye be gudrat Allah.
Wa tidooru chunu ?Tidooru najiiku be asa walla najiiku be mahabba wa nafas baarid ?
Simiʼt kalaam ajiib bilheen foogku.Yuguulu naadum minku gaaʼid yisawwi zina al‑naas al‑ma muʼminiin kula ma yisawwuuh.Yuguulu naadum waahid gaaʼid yazna marit abuuh.
Kikkeef bigiitu mustakbiriin ?Akheer tahzano hizin chadiid.Wa l‑naadum al‑sawwa al‑zanib da,waajib taturduuh min usutku.
Wa kan leyi ana,sahiih ana gaaʼid fi bakaan baʼiid minku laakin ana maʼaaku be l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa ana haakamt al‑naadum da khalaas misil ana be nafsi gaaʼid fi usutku.
Wa wakit intu laammiin be usum Rabbina Isa wa hasseetu kadar ana gaaʼid maʼaaku be ruuhi wa gudrat Rabbina Isa maʼaaku,
waajib tisallumu al‑naadum da le l‑Cheetaan achaan tabiiʼtah al‑insaaniiye tiddammar wa hu zaatah yanja fi yoom jayyit Rabbina Isa.
Sawweetu nufuusku kubaar wa da ma adiil.Hal nisiitu kadar tawwaara chiyya bas tigawwim kulla l‑ajiin walla ?
Amurgu minku al‑naadum al‑gaaʼid yaznib da,achaan tabgo battaan misil ajiin jadiid al‑ma indah tawwaara.Wa aniina bigiina naas judaad achaan al‑Masiih maat misil hamal al‑dabahooh zamaan fi l‑Fisha al‑awwal.
Achaan da,khalliina nabgo misil al‑naas al‑yiʼayyudu iid al‑Fisha al‑baakulu al‑khubza al‑jadiide al‑ma indaha tawwaara.Wa l‑khubza al‑gadiime al‑indaha tawwaara tiwassif al‑fasaala wa l‑zunuub.Wa l‑khubza al‑jadiide al‑ma indaha tawwaara tiwassif al‑niiye al‑mukhlisa wa l‑hagg.
Wa fakkuru fi l‑kalaam al‑katabtah leeku fi jawaabi al‑awwal.Ana gult angarʼu min al‑zannaayiin wa kissu minhum baʼiid.
Wa maʼana al‑kalaam da ma bukhuss al‑naas al‑zannaayiin al‑ma muʼminiin wa la l‑tammaaʼiin wa la l‑sarraagiin wa la aabidiin al‑asnaam.Achaan ma tagdaro tikissu min al‑naas dool illa kan tamurgu min al‑dunya marra waahid.
La.Fi badalah,ana katabt leeku achaan tikissu min ayyi naadum al‑buguul hu akhuuku muʼmin wa laakin hu zannaay walla tammaaʼ walla aabid asnaam walla nammaam walla sakkaari walla sarraag.Aywa,al‑naadum al‑misil da ma taakulu maʼaayah kula.
Ana ma indi hagg nihaasib al‑naas al‑barra min ummat al‑Masiih.Wa laakin akhwaanku al‑muʼminiin al‑fi usutku waajib intu tihaasubuuhum.
Al‑naas al‑barra dool,Allah yihaasibhum.Wa laakin kan leeku intu,maktuub :﴾‍Aturdu al‑chariir min usutku.‍﴿
Wa kan naadum minku mazluum fi akhuuh al‑muʼmin,maala yiwaddiih le l‑muznibiin achaan yagtaʼo leyah al‑chariiʼa ?Akheer kan yikhalli al‑saalihiin yagtaʼo leyah al‑chariiʼa wa yihaasubu al‑zaalim.
Nisiitu kadar aniina al‑saalihiin nihaakumu al‑dunya walla ?Wa kan baʼadeen intu tihaakumu al‑dunya,kikkeef ma tagdaro tihaakumu fi muchkila sakhayre kula ?
Nisiitu kadar aniina nihaakumu al‑malaaʼika walla ?Wa kan misil da,akiid nagdaro nihaakumu fi machaakil akhwaanna fi l‑dunya kula.
Wa kan induku machaakil ambeenaatku,maala tigaddumuuhum le l‑naas al‑ma muhimmiin fi jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin ?
Wa da eeb foogku.Ma fi naadum minku indah hikma achaan yahkim ambeenaat akhwaanah walla ?
Laakin intu gaaʼidiin tikhallu al‑muʼmin yachki akhuuh giddaam al‑hukkaam,hatta kan al‑hukkaam dool ma muʼminiin kula.
Kan waddeetu akhuuku fi l‑mahkama,intu fachaltu khalaas.Akheer takhbalo al‑zulum wa tasburu foogah.Akheer tikhallu naadum yasrig minku.
Laakin be l‑aks,intu zaatku gaaʼidiin tazulmu akhwaanku wa tasurgu khumaamhum be khachch !
Nisiitu kadar al‑muznibiin ma yawrusu mamlakat Allah walla ?Ma tukhuchchu nufuusku.Kan naadum faasikh walla aabid asnaam walla zannaay walla chamrookha walla luuti
walla sarraag walla tammaaʼ walla sakkaari walla nammaam walla nahhaab ma indah warasa fi mamlakat Allah.
Wa naas waahidiin minku awwal gaaʼidiin yisawwu al‑zunuub dool.Laakin Allah khassalaaku wa sawwaaku khaassiin leyah wa jaʼalaaku saalihiin be usum Rabbina Isa al‑Masiih wa be gudrat Ruuh Allah Ilaahna.
Intu gultu : Kulla cheyy halaal leyi. Wa laakin ana nuguul ma kulla cheyy indah faayde.Aywa,intu gultu : Kulla cheyy halaal leyi. Wa laakin ana nuguul abadan ma nikhassid kadar ayyi cheyy yiʼabbidni.
Wa gultu : Al‑batun gaaʼide le l‑akil wa l‑akil gaaʼid le l‑batun. Aywa,fi l‑akhiir Allah yidammir al‑akil wa l‑batun sawa.Wa laakin al‑jisim ma gaaʼid le l‑zina.Al‑jisim gaaʼid fi chaan Rabbina Isa wa Rabbina baʼas fi chaan al‑jisim.
Wa Allah baʼas Rabbina wa be nafs al‑gudra yabʼasna aniina kula.
Ma iriftu kadar hassaʼ jisim al‑muʼmin udu min jisim al‑Masiih walla ?Wa kan misil da,hal niwaddi jismi al‑hassaʼ udu min jisim al‑Masiih wa nantiih le mara charmuuta ?Abadan.
Ma iriftu kadar al‑naadum al‑yilimm maʼa l‑charmuuta yabga maʼaaha jisim waahid ?Maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Al‑naaseen yabgo jisim waahid.‍﴿
Wa laakin al‑yinrabit maʼa Rabbina al‑Masiih yabga maʼaayah ruuh waahide.
Khalaas,baʼʼudu min al‑zina.Kulla l‑zunuub al‑aakhariin al‑yisawwiihum al‑insaan ma yilammusu al‑jisim,laakin al‑zannaay hu bas yudurr jismah.
Ma iriftu kadar al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus gaaʼid fiiku walla ?Wa be da,jisimku hu beet al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus al‑Allah antaah leeku wa gaaʼid fiiku.Intu ma hana nufuusku.Intu hana Allah.
Hu fadaaku be taman khaali.Achaan da,khalli kulla cheyy al‑tisawwu be jisimku yimajjid Allah.
Wa hassaʼ da,nurudd leeku fi l‑kalaam al‑saʼaltuuni minnah.Wa katabtu gultu : Akheer le l‑raajil kan ma yargud maʼa mara. 
Laakin muchkilat al‑zina gaaʼide wa tidoor takrubku.Achaan da,akheer ayyi raajil indah martah halaalah wa ayyi mara indaha raajilha halaalha.
Waajib al‑raajil al‑maakhid yanti nafsah le martah wa l‑mara al‑maakhde tanti nafisha le raajilha.
Al‑mara ma tagdar tisawwi misil tidoorah be jisimha achaan raajilha bas indah hagg foogah.Wa misil da,al‑raajil kula ma yagdar yisawwi misil yidoorah be jismah achaan martah bas indaha hagg foogah.
Khalli al‑raajil ma yaaba martah wa l‑mara ma taaba raajilha.Laakin kan tidooru tiwaggufu al‑alaakha al‑jinsiiya ambeenaatku le mudda muhaddada,masalan wakit tinkarbu fi l‑sala,awwalan ke astafugu foogah sawa.Wa wakit al‑mudda di kammalat,limmu battaan.Wa gult al‑kalaam da achaan kan ma tagdaro talzamo chahwaatku,akuun Ibliis yilizzuku fi l‑zanib.
Al‑waggafaan al‑misil da,ma amartuku beyah laakin kan tidooru tisawwuuh,ma indah eeb.
Sahiih,fi fikri akheer kan kulli naadum yukuun misli ana al‑ma maakhid.Laakin ayyi naadum indah al‑atiiye al‑Allah antaaha leyah.Wa le l‑waahid,atiiye waahide wa le l‑aakhar,atiiye chig.
Wa fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss al‑rujaal al‑hassaʼ ma induhum awiin wa l‑awiin al‑araamil,nuguul akheer kan yagoodu bala akhiide misli ana.
Laakin kan ma yagdaro yalzamo chahwaathum,akheer yaakhudu.Kan yaakhudu,da akheer min al‑chahwa taakulhum misil al‑naar.
Wa kan le l‑naas al‑maakhdiin,nantiihum wasiiye.Wa l‑wasiiye di ma minni ana laakin min Rabbina Isa.Waajib al‑mara al‑maakhde ma titallig raajilha.
Wa kan hi tallagatah,waajib tagood bala akhiide aw tigabbil raajilha.Wa khalli al‑raajil al‑maakhid ma yitallig martah.
Wa le l‑aakhariin,indi wasiiye.Wa l‑wasiiye di ma min Rabbina,hi minni ana.Kan ayyi muʼmin indah mara ma muʼmine wa martah tikhassid tagood maʼaayah,ma waajib hu yitalligha.
Wa kan mara minku indaha raajil ma muʼmin wa raajilha yikhassid yagood maʼaaha,ma waajib hi titalligah.
Achaan al‑raajil al‑ma muʼmin bigi khaass le Allah be sabab iimaan martah wa l‑mara al‑ma muʼmine bigat khaassa le Allah be sabab iimaan raajilha.Wa kan ma ke,iyaalhum yukuunu ma khaassiin le Allah.Wa laakin be l‑sahiih,humman khaassiin le Allah.
Wa laakin kan al‑naadum al‑ma muʼmin yidoor al‑talaag,khalli yisawwiih.Kan sawwaah,al‑muʼmin kan raajil walla mara kula,ma marbuut.Laakin intu Allah naadaaku achaan tiʼiichu be l‑salaam.
Intu ma taʼarfu al‑cheyy al‑yabga.Ya l‑mara,akuun raajilki yanja be sababki.Ya l‑raajil,akuun martak tanja be sababak.
Daahu al‑kalaam al‑muhimm.Khalli ayyi muʼmin yagood fi l‑haala al‑Rabbina jaʼalaaha leyah.Wa di l‑haala al‑hu gaaʼid foogha wakit Allah naadaah fi l‑iimaan.Di bas al‑wasiiye al‑niʼallimha le ummat al‑Masiih fi ayyi bakaan.
Masalan,kan naadum mutahhar gubbaal Allah ma naadaah fi derbah,khalli ma yisawwi cheyy le yibattil al‑tahuura.Wa l‑naadum al‑ma mutahhar gubbaal Allah ma naadaah,khalli ma yitahhuruuh.
Kan naadum mutahhar walla ma mutahhar kula,da ma muhimm.Laakin al‑muhimm,al‑naadum yitaabiʼ wasaaya Allah.
Khalli ayyi naadum yagood fi l‑haala al‑hu gaaʼid foogha gubbaal Allah ma naadaah.
Kan inta abid gubbaal Allah ma naadaak,ma tikhalli al‑ubuudiiye tizaʼʼilak.Laakin kan yantuuk fursa tabga hurr,khassid tawwaali.
Wa ana gult leek ma tazʼal achaan al‑abid al‑Allah naadaah fi derib Rabbina bigi khaddaam hurr hana Rabbina.Wa nafs al‑cheyy le l‑naadum al‑awwal hurr gubbaal Allah ma naadaah,hu bigi abd al‑Masiih.
Allah fadaaku be taman khaali wa achaan da,ma tabgo abiid le l‑naas.
Ya akhwaani,zibdit al‑kalaam da,khalli ayyi naadum yagood fi l‑haala al‑gaaʼid foogha wakit Allah naadaah wa khalli yagood foogha fi alaakha maʼa Allah.
Wa fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss al‑naas al‑lissaaʼ ma akhado,ma indi wasiiye min Rabbina.Laakin Allah rahamaani wa jaʼalaani naadum saadikh wa achaan da nuguul leeku fikri.
Hassaʼ haaliiyan intu gaaʼidiin fi taʼab chadiid.Achaan da,fi fikri akheer kan ayyi naadum ma yikhayyir haaltah.
Kan naadum indah mara,khalli ma yitalligha.Kan naadum ma indah mara,khalli ma yaakhud.
Wa kan sabi yaakhud,da ma khata.Wa kan bineeye taakhud,da ma khata.Laakin fi l‑dunya di,al‑maakhdiin yatʼabo ziyaada wa leeku intu nidoor ninajjiiku min al‑taʼab da.
Wa gult al‑kalaam da achaan al‑zaman al‑aniina gaaʼidiin foogah da,Allah haddadah.Wa min hassaʼ le giddaam,khalli al‑raajil al‑indah mara ma yinkarib ziyaada fi martah.
Wa khalli al‑haznaaniin ma yinkarbu fi hizinhum.Wa khalli al‑farhaaniin ma yinkarbu fi farhithum.Wa khalli al‑naas al‑yachru ma yinkarbu fi cheyy al‑charooh.
Wa khalli al‑naas al‑induhum muʼaamala maʼa naas al‑dunya ma yichtakhulu beeha.Akiid,nizaam al‑dunya al‑haali da gaaʼid yikammil.
Wa nidoor al‑hamm ma yakrubku.Al‑muʼmin al‑ma indah mara gaaʼid yinkarib fi khidmit Rabbina wa fi rida Rabbina.
Laakin al‑muʼmin al‑indah mara gaaʼid yinkarib fi khidmit al‑dunya di,maʼanaatah hu yidoor yiraddi martah
wa misil da,hu indah khidme itneen.Wa l‑mara aw al‑bineeye al‑muʼmine al‑ma maakhde gaaʼide tinkarib fi khidmit Rabbina achaan tabga saalhe fi jisimha wa fi fikirha.Laakin al‑muʼmine al‑maakhde tinkarib fi khidmit al‑dunya di,maʼanaatah hi tidoor tiraddi raajilha.
Wa gult al‑kalaam da le faayditku.Ma nidoor nukhutt leeku huduud.Gult al‑kalaam da achaan niwassifku kikkeef titaabuʼu derib Rabbina be niiye waahide wa takhdumu leyah be galib waahid.
Kan ayyi naadum minku karab raas bineeye wa akhkhar mawʼid al‑cheeliin wa hu fakkar kadar al‑taʼkhiir da bigi gaasi le l‑bineeye aw yidoor yichiilha achaan chahwatah bigat chadiide,khalaas khalli yichiilha.Khalli yilʼaakhado.Da ma khata.
Laakin al‑raajil al‑indah niiye saabte fi galbah wa ma jabarooh wa lazam chahwatah tamaam wa chaal kharaar fi galbah achaan yiʼakhkhir mawʼid al‑cheeliin da,hu sawwa cheyy adiil.
Wa be misil da,al‑yichiil al‑bineeye al‑karab raasha yisawwi cheyy adiil wa l‑ma yichiilha yisawwi akheer.
Wa l‑muʼmine al‑maakhde marbuuta maʼa raajilha lahaddi mootah.Wa kan raajilha maat,hi indaha hagg achaan taakhud ayyi naadum al‑tiriidah kan hu kula yitaabiʼ derib Rabbina Isa.
Laakin kan leyi ana,yabga leeha akheer kan ma taakhud battaan.Wa fi fikri ana,Ruuh Allah gaaʼid foogi wa fi kalaami.
Wa ana nurudd leeku fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss al‑laham al‑gaddamooh dahiiye le l‑asnaam.Al‑kalaam al‑intu gultuuh : Aniina al‑muʼminiin kullina indina ilim ,da maʼruuf.Laakin nuguul leeku al‑ilim yisabbib al‑istikbaar wa l‑mahabba tigawwi al‑khuuwa.
Kan naadum aarif hu aarif,hu lissaaʼ ma irif misil waajib yaʼarif.
Laakin kan naadum yihibb Allah,al‑naadum da Allah yaʼarfah.
Wa fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss akil al‑laham al‑gaddamooh dahiiye le l‑asnaam,akiid aniina naʼarfu kadar al‑sanam,hu yimassil ilaah al‑ma mawjuud fi l‑dunya.Wa naʼarfu kadar ma fi ilaah illa Allah al‑Waahid.
Wa akiid,al‑naas yuguulu fi ilaahaat fi l‑samaawaat wa l‑ard.Wa be l‑sahiih,al‑naas yuguulu fi ilaahaat wa arbaab katiiriin.
Wa laakin leena aniina al‑muʼminiin,Allah waahid bas.Wa hu abuuna al‑khalag kulla cheyy wa aniina nahyo leyah hu.Wa l‑Rabb waahid bas wa hu Isa al‑Masiih wa beyah hu kulla cheyy mawjuud wa beyah hu aniina hayyiin.
Laakin naas waahidiin ma karabo al‑ilim da adiil.Wa akhwaan waahidiin fi aadithum gubbaal ma aamano,gaaʼidiin yaʼabudu al‑asnaam.Wa fi fikirhum kan yaakulu al‑laham da,yichaaruku battaan fi l‑ibaada di.Wa kan akalo,yinnajjaso achaan iimaanhum lissaaʼ ma gawi.
Wa sahiih,al‑akil ma yiziid leena rida Allah.Kan ma naakuluuh,ma nakhsaro cheyy giddaam Allah.Wa kan naakuluuh kamaan,ma nalgo minnah faayde giddaam Allah.
Laakin angarʼu !Le l‑muʼmin al‑iimaanah ma gawi,ma tikhallu hurriiyitku di tamurgah min al‑derib.
Achaan inta tuguul inta naadum aalim wa kan naadum iimaanah ma gawi yichiifak inta gaaʼid taakul fi beet al‑asnaam,akuun hu kula yaakul al‑laham al‑gaddamooh dahiiye le l‑asnaam.Wa khalaas al‑eeb yakurbah.
Wa misil da,inta taabaʼt ilmak wa laakin tallaft beyah akhuuk al‑Rabbina al‑Masiih maat fi chaanah.
Wa be misil da,intu takhto fi akhwaanku wa tijiibu al‑eeb fi l‑akhwaan al‑iimaanhum ma gawi wa khalaas khitiitu fi l‑Masiih.
Achaan da,kan al‑laham al‑naakulah yamrug akhuuyi min al‑derib,ana abadan ma naakul al‑laham battaan.Achaan ma nidoor akhuuyi yamrug min al‑derib be sababi ana.
Ana ma naadum hurr walla ?Ana ma rasuul al‑Masiih walla ?Ana ma chift Isa Rabbina walla ?Wa taʼarfu kadar be khidimti ana bas,intu aamantu be Rabbina.
Kan fi fikir al‑naas al‑aakhariin ana ma rasuul kula,akiid leeku intu ana rasuul achaan al‑alaakha al‑induku maʼa Rabbina hi zaatha al‑daliil al‑yisabbit kadar ana rasuul be l‑sahiih.
Wa misil da bas,ana gaaʼid nidaafiʼ le nafsi giddaam al‑naas al‑yuluumuuni.
Hal ma indina hagg nichiilu minku akil wa charaab walla ?
Hal ma indina hagg nichiilu zooja muʼmine le tiraafigna fi safarna walla ?Da bas al‑cheyy al‑gaaʼidiin yisawwuuh al‑rusul al‑aakhariin wa akhwaan Rabbina Isa wa Butrus kula.
Ana wa Barnaaba niʼiichu be khidmit duraaʼna.Hal aniina wiheedna bas ma indina hagg nichiilu maʼaachna min al‑muʼminiin walla ?
Ween al‑askari al‑yikaffi nafsah ?Ween al‑naadum al‑yimaggin jineene hana inab wa ma yaakul min fawaakihha ?Ween al‑raaʼi al‑yasrah be l‑khanam wa ma yachrab labanhum ?
Wa l‑kalaam da ma hasab aadaat al‑naas bas.Al‑Tawraat kula buguul nafs al‑cheyy.
Masalan,maktuub fi Tawraat Muusa :﴾‍Wakit al‑toor gaaʼid yifajjikh leek al‑khalla fi l‑madagg,ma tarbut khachmah.Khalli yaakul.‍﴿Hal al‑tiiraan bas Allah yihimm beehum walla ?
Akiid,Allah gaal al‑kalaam da fi chaanna aniina kula.Aywa,al‑kalaam da maktuub le faayditna.Wa da misil al‑harraati al‑yahrit fi l‑zereʼ wa l‑naadum al‑yudugg al‑khalla fi l‑madagg yakhdumu be acham achaan yalgo cheyy min al‑khalla di.
Kan aniina zaraʼna foogku cheyy jaayi min Allah wa natulbu minku cheyy hana l‑dunya,hal natulbu minku ziyaada min al‑waajib walla ?Abadan.
Wa kan fi naas aakhariin induhum hagg yichiilu minku,aniina kula indina hagg ziyaada.Laakin aniina ma chilna cheyy al‑indina foogah hagg.La.Be sabur tiʼibna katiir achaan al‑taʼab akheer leena min nisawwu ayyi cheyy al‑yisidd al‑derib le ballikhiin bichaarat al‑Masiih.
Akiid,taʼarfu kadar al‑naas al‑yakhdumu fi beet al‑ibaada yalgo maʼaachhum min beet al‑ibaada wa l‑naas al‑yigaddumu dahaaya fi l‑madbah yaakulu min al‑laham.
Wa misil da,Rabbina Isa amar wa gaal kadar al‑naas al‑khidmithum ballikhiin bichaarat al‑Masiih,humman yalgo minha maʼaachhum.
Laakin al‑cheyy al‑indi foogah hagg le nichiilah,ana abadan ma chiltah.Wa hassaʼ da,ana ma gaaʼid naktib al‑kalaam da le nalga minku cheyy.Akheer leyi numuut !Achaan al‑cheyy al‑narfaʼ beyah raasi giddaam ayyi naadum,ma nikhalli naadum yichiilah minni.
Sahiih,ana gaaʼid niballikh bichaarat al‑Masiih laakin da ma yantiini sabab le nistakbar beyah.La !Al‑ballikhiin da,Allah amaraani beyah.Al‑azaab leyi kan ana ma niballikh al‑bichaara di.
Kan nisawwi al‑khidme di achaan ana nidoorha bas,al‑ujra waajbe leyi.Laakin ana ma azalt al‑khidme di be niiyti.Allah bas kallafaani beeha.
Wa be misil da,ujurti chunu ?Kan al‑naas al‑niballikh leehum al‑bichaara ma yikaffu cheyy achaan ana abeet ma nichiil al‑indi foogah hagg min ballikhiin al‑bichaara,khalaas di bas ujurti.Wa ana farhaan bilheen.
Sahiih,ana hurr wa ana ma abid hana ayyi naadum.Laakin ana jaʼalt nafsi misil abid hana kulla l‑naas le nijiib naas ziyaada fi derib al‑naja.
Kan ana gaaʼid fi ust al‑Yahuud,ana nitaabiʼ aadaat al‑Yahuud le nijiibhum fi derib al‑naja.Aywa,kan ana gaaʼid ambeenaat al‑naas al‑yitaabuʼu churuut al‑Tawraat,ana kula nabga misil naadum yitaabiʼ churuut al‑Tawraat.Wa be l‑sahiih,ana ma tihit churuut al‑Tawraat laakin nidoor nijiib al‑naas al‑gaaʼidiin tihit churuut al‑Tawraat fi derib al‑naja.
Wa kan ana gaaʼid maʼa l‑naas al‑ma Yahuud,maʼanaatah al‑ma tihit churuut al‑Tawraat,ana nisawwi nafsi misilhum humman al‑ma gaaʼidiin tihit churuut al‑Tawraat le nijiibhum fi derib al‑naja le l‑naas al‑ma tihit churuut al‑Tawraat.Wa be l‑sahiih,ana ma abeet churuut Allah achaan ana gaaʼid nitaabiʼ churuut al‑Masiih.
Wa kan ana gaaʼid maʼa l‑naas al‑ma induhum gudra,ana kula nisawwi nafsi naadum al‑ma indah gudra le nijiib al‑ma induhum gudra fi derib al‑naja.Ana nisawwi nafsi misil ayyi naadum fi ayyi haal le ninajji waahidiin minhum be ayyi daliil.
Wa khalaas,da kulla ke nisawwiih fi chaan ballikhiin bichaarat al‑Masiih le nichaarik fi barakaatha.
Taʼarfu kadar fi l‑sabag,kulla l‑naas yajru laakin waahid minhum bas yalga al‑jaaʼiza.Chiilu al‑masal da wa jaahudu fi derib al‑iimaan achaan talgo jaaʼiza.
Wa naʼarfu kan naadum riyaadi,hu yisabbit nafsah fi ayyi haal wa yijaahid.Wa l‑jaaʼiza al‑hu yidoor yalgaaha di,hi tatlaf ajala.Laakin aniina nijaahudu achaan nalgo al‑jaaʼiza al‑abadan ma tatlaf.
Achaan da,fi derib al‑iimaan ana jaari giddaam be niiye waahide.Nisawwi nafsi misil al‑mulaakim al‑chadiid wa ma nadrub fi l‑riih saakit.
Aywa,ana niwallif jismi al‑taʼab le nissaytar foogah.Achaan kan ma nissaytar fi nafsi,akuun ninaadi al‑naas fi derib al‑naja laakin fi l‑akhiir,ana zaati yadharooni min al‑jaaʼiza.
Ya akhwaani,nidoor intu taʼarfu maʼana al‑cheyy al‑bigi fi zaman Muusa.Fi l‑wakit daak,kulla juduudna kaano tihit al‑sahaabaay wa kulluhum chaggo al‑bahar.
Wa kulluhum bigo chaʼab Muusa be khattisiin fi l‑sahaabaay wa l‑bahar.
Wa kulluhum akalo al‑akil al‑waahid al‑Allah antaah leehum.
Wa kulluhum chirbo nafs al‑charaab al‑Allah antaahum.Aywa Allah antaahum almi min al‑hajar.Wa l‑hajar da,macha maʼaahum wa hu al‑Masiih.
Wa laakin naʼarfu kadar fi l‑akhiir Allah ma ridi be katiiriin minhum.Wa achaan da,katiiriin minhum maato fi l‑sahara.
Wa da kulla ke bigi achaan yabga leena masal.Wa khalli ma nabgo misilhum achaan humman habbo al‑charr.
Waahidiin minhum bigo aabidiin asnaam wa ma waajib tabgo misilhum.Wa maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Al‑chaʼab gaʼado achaan yaakulu wa yacharbo wa gammo yalʼabo.‍﴿
Waajib ma nazno misil waahidiin minhum zano.Wa fi yoom waahid bas,23 000 naas maato.
Wa ma waajib nijarrubu al‑Masiih misilhum.Waahidiin minhum jarrabooh wa l‑dabiib jo dammaroohum.
Wa ma waajib nachku le Allah.Waahidiin minhum chako wa khalaas,malak al‑moot ja dammaraahum.
Wa da kulla ke ja fooghum achaan yabga leena masal wa ankatab achaan yiʼallimna aniina al‑aaychiin fi l‑zaman al‑akhiir.
Wa fi chaan da,khalli kulli naadum al‑yuguul hu saabit fi l‑iimaan yingariʼ achaan ma yamrug min al‑derib.
Ma fi tajriba jaat foogku al‑ma jaat fi kulla l‑naas.Wa Allah hu saadikh wa be l‑tajriba di,hu yaftah leeku derib achaan tamurgu beyah wa yantiiku al‑gudra achaan tasburu fi l‑tajriba di.
Ya akhwaani al‑nihibbuku,fakkuru fi kulla l‑kalaam da wa angarʼu min ibaadat al‑asnaam.
Ana gaaʼid nihajji kalaam adiil le l‑naas al‑aagliin.Fakkuru fi kalaami wa mayyuzuuh.
Fakkuru fi acha al‑Masiih wa fi kaas asiir al‑inab al‑nacharbo minnah wa nachkuru Allah.Wa wakit nacharbo minnah,aniina ma muchtarikiin fi damm al‑Masiih walla ?Wa fakkuru fi l‑khubza al‑naksuruuha.Wakit naakulu minha,aniina ma muchtarikiin fi jisim al‑Masiih walla ?
Aywa,achaan al‑khubza di waahide wa aniina al‑katiiriin kula bigiina jisim waahid be akilna le l‑khubza al‑waahide di.
Fakkuru fi ibaada hana Bani Israaʼiil.Al‑naas al‑yaakulu min laham al‑dahiiye al‑gaddamooha fi l‑madbah muchtarikiin fi l‑dahiiye di.
Wa maala ana gult leeku al‑kalaam da ?Hal ana gult al‑laham al‑yigaddumuuh dahiiye le l‑asnaam indah gudra walla ?Hal ana gult al‑sanam indah gudra walla ?
La,abadan !Laakin nidoor nuguul leeku kadar al‑dahiiye di,gaddamooha le l‑chawaatiin ma le Allah.Wa ana ma nidoor intu tabgo muchtarikiin maʼa l‑chawaatiin.
Ma waajib tacharbo min kaas Rabbina al‑Masiih wa battaan min kaas al‑chawaatiin kula.Ma waajib tichtaruku fi acha Rabbina al‑Masiih wa battaan fi acha al‑chawaatiin kula.
Walla nidooru nizaʼʼulu Rabbina ?La !Aniina gaadriin minnah hu walla ?La !
Intu tuguulu : Kulli cheyy halaal. Wa laakin nuguul ma kulli cheyy indah faayde.Tuguulu : Kulli cheyy halaal. Laakin ma kulli cheyy yigawwi al‑iimaan.
Khalli ayyi waahid yukhutt baalah fi l‑cheyy al‑yijiib faayde le akhuuh wa ma fi l‑cheyy al‑yijiib faayde leyah hu wiheedah bas.
Al‑laham al‑yibiiʼuuh fi l‑suug da,aakuluuh bala chakak.
Achaan maktuub fi l‑Kitaab :﴾‍Le Allah al‑ard wa kulla cheyy al‑foogha.‍﴿
Kan naadum ma muʼmin yaʼazimku achaan tiʼachchu maʼaayah wa kan induku niiye,amchu wa achchu maʼaayah.Aakulu kulli cheyy al‑yigaddumuuh leeku bala chakak.
Laakin kan naadum waahid yuguul leeku : Al‑laham da hana l‑dahiiye al‑gaddamooha le l‑asnaam ,fi l‑bakaan da bas,ma taakuluuh.Fakkuru fi l‑naadum al‑ooraaku beyah wa fi l‑chakak al‑hu indah fi chaan al‑laham da.
Ana ma nuguul intu induku chakak laakin al‑naadum al‑ooraaku,hu bas indah chakak.Ana ma nihaddid al‑hurriiye al‑indi fi chaan chakak hana naadum aakhar.
Ana chakart Allah fi chaan al‑akil al‑naakulah wa khalaas,ma nidoor naas yuguulu kalaam fasil foogi achaan al‑akil al‑chakart Allah fi chaanah.
Wa khalaas,fi kulli cheyy al‑taakuluuh wa tacharbooh wa tisawwuuh,majjudu Allah.Majjuduuh fi kulli cheyy.
Ma tabgo sabab le ayyi naadum le tamurguuh min al‑derib,wa la le l‑Yahuud wa la le l‑Yuunaaniyiin wa la le naas Allah ummat al‑Masiih.
Sawwu misli ana.Ana nidoor daayman nisawwi al‑cheyy al‑kulla l‑naas yardo beyah.Wa ma nifattich al‑cheyy al‑yijiib leyi ana bas faayde laakin nifattich al‑cheyy al‑yijiib faayde le kulla l‑naas achaan nidoor humman yanjo.
Taabuʼu derbi achaan ana gaaʼid nitaabiʼ derib al‑Masiih.
Wa ana farhaan minku achaan intu gaaʼidiin tifakkuru foogi wa titaabuʼu adiil al‑aadaat al‑allamtuhum leeku.
Wa laakin fi cheyy nidoor intu tafhamooh wa da hu.Raʼiis hana ayyi raajil,hu al‑Masiih wa raʼiis al‑mara,hu al‑raajil wa raʼiis al‑Masiih,hu Allah.
Wa ayyi raajil al‑yikhatti raasah wakit yisalli walla yitnabbaʼ,hu yijiib eeb fi l‑Masiih al‑hu raʼiisah.
Wa ayyi mara al‑ma tikhatti raasha wakit tisalli walla titnabbaʼ,hi tijiib eeb fi raajilha al‑hu raʼiisha.Wa be da,misil zayyano suuf raasha.
Wa kan mara taaba ma tikhatti raasha,khalli tuguss chaʼarha.Wa laakin kan gassiin al‑chaʼar wa zayyiniin al‑raas da eeb le l‑mara,khalaas khalli hi tikhatti raasha.
Wa ma waajib le l‑raajil yikhatti raasah achaan Allah khalagah fi suurtah le yiwassif majdah.Laakin al‑mara tiwassif charaf al‑raajil.
Achaan al‑raajil ma maragooh min al‑mara laakin al‑mara maragooha min al‑raajil.
Wa Allah ma khalag al‑raajil fi chaan al‑mara laakin khalag al‑mara fi chaan al‑raajil.
Wa be sabab al‑malaaʼika,waajib le l‑mara tukhutt cheyy fi raasha al‑yiwassif kadar hi indaha al‑sulta.
Wa da kulla sahiih laakin fi nizaam Rabbina.Bala l‑raajil,al‑mara ma fiiha.Wa bala l‑mara,al‑raajil ma fiih.
Achaan awwal,al‑mara maragooha min al‑raajil wa hassaʼ,ayyi raajil mawluud min mara wa kulli cheyy jaayi min Allah.
Wa leeku intu,nuguul fakkuru adiil wa mayyuzu al‑kalaam da.Kan mara tisalli le Allah wa raasha ma mukhatta,da muwaafig walla ?
Wa naʼarfu min al‑tabiiʼa kadar al‑chaʼar al‑tuwaal eeb le l‑raajil.
Wa laakin kan mara indaha chaʼar tuwaal,da sameh wa da charafha.Wa Allah antaaha chaʼar tuwaal achaan yabga leeha khattaay.
Wa kan ayyi naadum yidoor yinaakhich fi l‑kalaam da,khalli yaʼarif aniina ma nikhassudu be l‑aade al‑hu yidoorha wa battaan naas Allah ummat al‑Masiih ma yikhassudu beeha fi ayyi bakaan.
Wa laakin fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss al‑kalaam al‑hassaʼ nihajji foogah,ana ma farhaan beeku marra waahid achaan wakit tilimmu fi malammat al‑muʼminiin,al‑fasaala katiire min al‑kheer.
Wa gult al‑kalaam da achaan al‑khabar al‑simiʼtah foogku.Awwal cheyy,yuguulu wakit tilimmu fi jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin,intu mungasimiin.Wa fi fikri,al‑kalaam da ma kulla ke kidib.
Aywa,laabudda intu mungasimiin achaan kan al‑khilaaf ambeenaatku ma fiih,kikkeef al‑naas al‑iimaanhum saabit yinʼarfu ?
Wa wakit tilimmu sawa,al‑acha al‑taakuluuh da,ma acha Rabbina.
Achaan fi wakit al‑acha,waahidiin yaakulu ajala gubbaal al‑aakhariin.Wa be da,al‑aakhariin dool jiiʼaaniin wa l‑awwalaaniyiin akalo wa sikro khalaas.
Wa da kikkeef ?Ma taakulu wa tacharbo fi buyuutku walla ?Aw tahguru jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin hana Allah wa tidooru tiʼayyubu al‑naas al‑ma induhum cheyy ?Wa nuguul leeku chunu ?Wa be da,nachkurku walla ?La,abadan.
Asmaʼo,da bas al‑kalaam al‑ligiitah min Rabbina wa allamtuku leyah.Fi l‑leele al‑yukhuunu foogha Rabbina Isa,hu chaal khubza waahide
wa chakar Allah wa kasarha wa gaal : Da jismi al‑nantiih fi chaanku.Sawwu misil da le tizzakkarooni beyah. 
Wa baʼad al‑acha,hu sawwa nafs al‑cheyy be l‑kaas.Hu chaalah wa gaal : Al‑kaas da yiwassif al‑muʼaahada al‑jadiide al‑nisawwiiha maʼaaku be dammi.Ayyi wakit al‑tacharbo minnah,sawwu misil da le tizakkuruuni beyah. 
Wa be da,fi ayyi wakit kan taakulu al‑khubza di wa tacharbo min al‑kaas da,tiballukhu moot Rabbina Isa lahaddi hu yaji battaan.
Wa achaan da battaan,ayyi naadum al‑yaakul khubzat Rabbina wa yachrab min kaasah wa niiytah ma mukhlisa,hu yudurr jisim Rabbina wa dammah.
Khalli ayyi naadum yijarrib nafsah gubbaal ma yaakul al‑khubza wa yachrab min al‑kaas.
Achaan ayyi naadum al‑yaakul wa yachrab acha al‑Masiih bala fikir fi jisim al‑Masiih,hu yijiib al‑azaab fi nafsah.
Wa achaan da bas,katiiriin minku ayyaaniin wa mardaaniin wa waahidiin maato kula.
Wa kan awwal nifakkuru fi nufuusna adiil,khalaas al‑azaab ma yanzil foogna.
Wa laakin Rabbina yihaasibna wa yiʼaddibna achaan al‑azaab al‑yanzil fi naas al‑dunya ma yanzil foogna.
Achaan da,ya akhwaani,wakit tilimmu achaan taakulu acha al‑Masiih,khalli ayyi naadum yarja akhwaanah.
Kan naadum jiiʼaan wa ma yagdar yarja al‑aakhariin,akheer yaakul gubbaal fi beetah.Wa be da,malammitku ma tijiib al‑azaab foogku.Wa khalaas,fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss al‑suʼaalaat al‑aakhariin,nantiiku wasaaya wakit najiiku.
Ya akhwaani,fi l‑cheyy al‑bukhuss barakaat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus,nidoor intu tafhamo adiil.
Taʼarfu kadar awwal intu ma muʼminiin,khachchooku wa waddooku lahaddi abadtu al‑asnaam al‑ma yuguulu cheyy.
Achaan da,nidoor intu tafhamo adiil kadar al‑naadum al‑yihajji be gudrat Ruuh Allah abadan ma yuguul : Isa malʼuun. Wa laakin illa be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus bas,naadum yagdar yuguul : Isa hu al‑Rabb .
Khalaas,al‑ataaya al‑Allah yantiihum chig chig laakin al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus waahid.
Wa l‑khidme al‑nakhdumuuha chig chig laakin Rabbina waahid.
Wa l‑amal al‑nisawwuuh chig chig laakin Allah al‑Waahid bas yantiina al‑gudra achaan ayyi naadum yisawwi ayyi cheyy.
Wa Allah yinazzil le ayyi naadum atiiye min al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus achaan kullina nalgo minha faayde.
Wa l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yanti gudra le naadum waahid achaan yikallim be hikma wa yanti gudra le naadum aakhar achaan yikallim be ilim.Wa da be nafs al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yanti le naadum waahid iimaan gawi marra waahid wa yanti le naadum aakhar atiiye hana gudra al‑yidaawi beeha al‑mardaaniin.Wa da kula be nafs al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Wa l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yanti gudra le naadum waahid achaan yisawwi ajaayib wa le naadum aakhar kalaam naazil min Allah.Wa yanti gudra le naadum waahid achaan yimayyiz gudrat Ibliis min gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa le naadum aakhar yantiih lukhkhaat chig chig al‑yaju min al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus wa le naadum aakhar gudra achaan yifassir al‑lukhkhaat dool.
Wa nafs al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus al‑waahid,hu bas al‑yijiib kulla l‑ataaya dool wa yigassimhum le ayyi naadum misil hu yidoorah.
Wa taʼarfu kadar jisim al‑insaan hu waahid wa battaan al‑jisim da indah aʼda katiiriin.Wa aʼda al‑jisim katiiriin laakin humman jisim waahid bas.Wa ummat al‑Masiih kula misil al‑jisim da.
Achaan khattasoona kullina be l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus al‑waahid le nabgo jisim waahid wa da jisim al‑Masiih.Wa sawwa nafs al‑cheyy leena kullina kan aniina Yahuud aw ma Yahuud,wa kan aniina abiid aw hurriin.Wa l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus bigi leena misil al‑charaab al‑waahid al‑kullina ke chiribna minnah.
Achaan al‑jisim abadan ma udu waahid bas.Hu aʼda katiiriin.
Masalan,al‑rijil udu min al‑jisim.Wa kan hi tuguul : Ana ma iid wa achaan da,ana ma udu min al‑jisim ,al‑kalaam da ma yamrugha min al‑jisim.
Wa kan al‑adaan tuguul : Ana ma een wa achaan da,ana ma udu min al‑jisim ,al‑kalaam da ma yamrugha min al‑jisim.
Wa battaan kan kulla l‑jisim bigi een,kikkeef yasmaʼ ?Wa kan kulla l‑jisim bigi adaan,kikkeef yuchumm ?
Laakin Allah nazzam kulla l‑aʼda fi l‑jisim achaan ayyi udu gaaʼid fi l‑bakaan al‑hu dawwarah.
Kan kulla l‑jisim bigi udu waahid,ween al‑jisim ?
Wa khalaas,al‑aʼda katiiriin wa battaan humman jisim waahid.
Wa ma waajib al‑een tuguul le l‑iid : Ana ma nidoorki. Wa ma waajib al‑raas yuguul le l‑rijileen : Ana ma nidoorku. 
La,da ma yabga achaan aʼda waahidiin al‑gaaʼidiin fi lubb al‑jisim,humman daʼiifiin marra waahid.Wa laakin naʼarfu kadar balaahum al‑jisim ma yanfaʼ.
Wa nantu lubaas le l‑aʼda al‑ma nikarrumuuhum wa misil da,nicharrufuuhum ziyaada min al‑aʼda al‑aakhariin.Wa l‑aʼda al‑ma waajib yinchaafo be sabab al‑eeb,nirayyusuuhum be ikraam ziyaada.
Wa l‑rayyisiin da,ma waajib le aʼdaaʼna al‑yinchaafo.Wa Allah nazzam al‑jisim wa hu anta ikraam ziyaada le l‑udu al‑indah eeb.
Wa be da,aʼda al‑jisim ma yinfargu abadan wa ayyi udu waajib yirayyis kulla akhwaanah be niiye waahide.
Wa kan waahid minhum taʼbaan,kulluhum taʼbaaniin sawa.Wa kan waahid yalga charaf,kulluhum farhaaniin sawa.
Wa khalaas,intu kulluku jisim al‑Masiih wa ayyi naadum udu minnah.
Wa Allah nazzam jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin wa jaʼal leehum khaddaamiin.Awwal ke al‑rusul wa taani al‑anbiya wa taalit al‑muʼallimiin.Wa battaan hu anta atiiye hana gudra achaan naas waahidiin yisawwu ajaayib wa yidaawu al‑mardaaniin wa yisaaʼudu akhwaanhum wa yuguuduuhum wa yihajju lukhkhaat chig chig al‑yaju min al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.
Kulla l‑muʼminiin rusul walla ?Kulluhum anbiya walla ?Kulluhum muʼallimiin walla ?Kulluhum yisawwu ajaayib walla ?
Kulluhum induhum atiiye hana gudra achaan yidaawu al‑mardaaniin walla ?Kulluhum yikallumu be lukhkhaat al‑yaju min al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus walla ?Kulluhum yifassuru al‑lukhkhaat dool ?Akiid la !
Atmanno be niiye waahide achaan talgo al‑ataaya al‑kubaar hana l‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa awwal ke,niwassifku al‑derib al‑adiil marra waahid.
Kan nikallim be lukhkhaat al‑naas wa be lukhkhaat al‑malaaʼika wa ma indi al‑mahabba,kalaami ma indah faayde.Be da kalaami bigi misil daggiin al‑nahaas walla baki al‑jaras.
Wa kan nitnabbaʼ be kalaam jaayi min Allah wa nafham kulla l‑asraar wa kulli cheyy hana ilim wa kan indi iimaan gawi marra waahid lahaddi nihawwil al‑jibaal min bakaanaathum kula wa kan ma indi al‑mahabba,ana ma cheyy.
Wa kan nanti kulli cheyy al‑indi le l‑masaakiin lahaddi nisallim jismi achaan nistakbarwa laakin ma indi al‑mahabba,ma nalga cheyy.
Al‑naadum al‑indah mahabba sabuur wa zeen.Al‑indah mahabba ma hasuud.Al‑indah mahabba ma fachchaar wa ma mustakbir.
Hu ma yisawwi cheyy hana eeb.Hu ma yifakkir fi nafsah bas.Wa ma yazʼal ajala.Hu ma yifakkir fi l‑khata al‑akhwaanah sawwooh.
Hu abadan ma yafrah be l‑zulum laakin yafrah daayman be l‑hagg.
Al‑indah mahabba,hu yahmal ayyi cheyy.Hu yiʼaamin fi kulli haal wa achamah saabit fi kulli haal wa hu yasbur fi ayyi cheyy.
Al‑mahabba abadan ma tikammil.Al‑tanabbu yikammil.Wa l‑lukhkhaat al‑yaju min al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus yabgo ma fiihum.Wa l‑ilim yikammil.
Achaan al‑ilim al‑indina,muhaddad.Wa l‑tanabbu al‑nihajju beyah,muhaddad.
Laakin wakit kulli cheyy yabga tamaam,al‑cheyy al‑ma tamaam yikammil.
Masalan,wakit ana wileed sakhayyar ana hajjeet hije hana iyaal dugaag wa fikri kula hana iyaal dugaag wa agli kula hana iyaal dugaag.Wa laakin wakit ana kibirt khalaas wa bigiit raajil,khalleet minni al‑iyaaliiye.
Achaan hassaʼ fi zamanna da,nichiifu al‑hagg misil nichiifuuh fi amchawwaafa al‑waskhaane wa fi l‑aakhira,nichiifuuh adiil.Hassaʼ da,ana irift chiyya wa baʼadeen naʼarif adiil misil Allah irifni.
Wa khalaas al‑talaata al‑yagoodu daayman,humman al‑iimaan wa l‑acham wa l‑mahabba.Wa l‑akbar minhum hu al‑mahabba.
Achaan da,ankarbu fi l‑mahabba wa battaan atmanno be niiye waahide achaan talgo barakaat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus.Wa min al‑barakaat dool,atmanno ziyaada achaan titnabbaʼo.
Achaan kan naadum yikallim be lukhkhaat al‑yaju min al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus,hu yihajji le Allah wa ma yihajji le l‑naas achaan ma fi naadum yafham kalaamah.Hu gaaʼid yihajji be gudrat al‑Ruuh al‑Khudduus kalaam ma maʼruuf.
Laakin kan naadum yitnabbaʼ,hu yihajji le l‑naas wa yigawwi iimaanhum wa yichajjiʼhum wa yisabbirhum.
Al‑yikallim be lukhkhaat yigawwi nafsah bas laakin al‑yitnabbaʼ yigawwi jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin.
Wa ana nidoor kulluku tihajju be lukhkhaat laakin nidoor ziyaada kadar titnabbaʼo.Al‑yitnabbaʼ le l‑naas akheer min al‑yikallim be lukhkhaat.Achaan al‑yikallim be lukhkhaat ma yigawwi jamaaʼat al‑muʼminiin illa kan naadum waahid yifassir kalaamah leehum.
Ya akhwaani,kan najiiku wa nikallim leeku kalaam be lukhkhaat,ma talgo faayde min kalaami.Laakin talgo faayde muhimme kan nikallim leeku be l‑ruʼya al‑chiftaha aw kalaam al‑ilim aw kalaam al‑tanabbu aw kalaam al‑taʼliim.
